ltesnye / wa / rdo / sna ji ༷ 4 ri

dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib la jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/ rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib la jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib la jug gi snyelas ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dang/la yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur nyi dang 〈bstan 'gyur nyi dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1 28yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ta cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / slog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gcug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad gar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin— legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu'o//spung sha'i bod rig dzi dpe na khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar med du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yu la zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/ 'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nos te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las gar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las gar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser ra khug nang brtan dpe rnying 'chos bas phyogs ga khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla ba 6pa 'i tshes 7la/3

bsdi/sgrig gsal sand/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khrag dang / de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / g.yin yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa 4

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum rmang gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa' gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la zhib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb 1nas 4bar pod rtags (ka༄ 6) rtoganakhong ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas 7bar pod rtags then 6) (ja) ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum ste pod rtags la (ja spu (ja3) (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags 6) sde rgyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod shen mas ma chag ldan/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags (ta)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la pod rtags 6)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags 9)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags rton)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags (pa)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (pha)ste 'dul ba'i 5

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags (ba)ste bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags (pa) (mo) 6 ) ste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (dza)ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags (zha)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma (ba)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma (nga)ste le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa 6 cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su lañdza mang tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du lañdza'i yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags(2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/6

zhu dag byed skabs/ thog ma'i zhu dag dang / bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing / tshig phrad dang / lhag bcas/ rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang / tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/ mtshams la 'tshams/ mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/ med la smad/ byung la 'byung / rang rkya la rang skya/ grwa la ga slong la slong / rig 'dzin larigs 'dzin/ rig gnas la rigs gnas/ rigs pa la rig pa/ gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/ rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang / nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang / shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad gar ram/yig thog zhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/ lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang / mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'chos bsdu phyogs ga khang nas/bod sa glang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15la/7

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog ces byar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang bka' gdems glegs bam/ rat+na'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i ste'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags smyon zil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog (re dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi ban+de zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'brungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sbrul te spyi lo 1617lor lto kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'brungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'a tu thol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung 31 so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ gzhan yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/ chos gzhis mchode rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying la bsdu phyog ga khang nas//()

dkar chagasmon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung las glegs bam dang po/ (1)drin can bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis rgyal dbang btsong kha pa chen po'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i bstod smon sogs/ (1)bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i tshe cho 'phrul chen po'i dus 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i zhal 'don du gnang ba sogs/ (24)dka' bcu bsod nams phun tshogs dus las 'das pa'i dge bar rme ru gtsang khang sbug tu ldebs bris byas pa'i tshe smon lam tshigs bcad sogs/ (57)bi shā ga me lta bu'i ri mo ba chos dbyings rgya mtshos shar gling chos sde'i gnas bcu khang la zhig gsos byas pa'i dge bsngo'i smon lam tshigs bcad sogs/ 569)yan lag bdun pa dang 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs tshig nyung la don rgyas pa sogs/ sno92)mchims phu gsung gi yang dben gyi gnas 'dzin sgrub sde ba rnams la gnang ba'i smon lam tshigs bcad sogs/ (143)sog tsan+dan dgon phyogs su yon bdag rnams kyi srog blu tshe thar mang po byed yong 'dug pa de'i dus su 'don rgyu gnang ba'i smon lam tshigs bcad sogs/ 5168)gnas brtan bcu drug las brtsams pa'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad sogs/ (181)gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi dge 'dun rnams kyi zhal 'don du gnang ba'i smon lam tshigs bcad sogs/ (238)1

rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo mchog dang rjes su 'brel bar brtan bzhugs bya tshul 'dod pa'i re stong sogs/ (247)sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs grags pas nyams len gyi dad rten du dgyes mdzad rdo rje gtso bor gyur pa'i sku brnyan bzhengs tshe rgyab yig gnang ba sogs/ (285)'phags pa phyogs bcu mun sel gyi don dang sbyar ba'i smon lam tshigs bcad sogs/ (363)thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid kyi nyams len snying po bsdus pa sogs/ 4410)smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu lnga/nga las glegs bam gnyi95 pa/ (419)sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i dad rten du bris thang bco lnga bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam tshigs bcad sogs/ 5419)rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi mdzad brgya'i zhal thang gi rgyab yig smon lam rbe1gas/ 5480)ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sprul pa'i sku mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug ngag dbang dkon cog nyi ma'i 'khrungs rabs dang 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam tshigs bcad sogs/ (547)

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanar༅༅/ /smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung las glegs bam dang po bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /4 shu bha na du k+ṣa ya su ni : rā di pu sta ka pra ṇilha rme gal tsu ཿ snyi rwa lha na de rgya / bi ha ra ti sma / /rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i rang bzhin kun+da'i dpyid/ /bsil ldan lus phra'i mngal du lci ba'i khur/ /zur phud lnga pa mi yi lang tsho'i rtsal/ /grub pa'i rnam 'dren 'jam dpal snying po rgyal/ /drin can bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis rgyal dbang btsong kha pa chen po'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i bstod smon sogs/mtha' yas chos kyi gnas lugs bsil zer can/ /rnyog bral blo gros chu mtshor rab shar bas/ /skal bzang dbus gyur bram ze ri bong 'dzin/ /mchis zhes grags pa'i (1na8byangs snyan mgrin par len/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i gsung rab za ma tog /drang nges sra ba mi phyed phyag rgya'i mdud/ /cig car 'grol mkhas kun mkhyen btsong kha pa/ khyod kyi dpe slar 'os pa srid 'dir ci/ /gang gi snang brnyan sngon med mgrin bcu'i gzugs/ /stong khun sgeg mos legs bskrun gan gos kyi//man shel gsar pa'i rtsig ngos la shar 'di/ /dpyod ldan ha nu byu gzigs mor mtshar/ /mtshan —1—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dpe'i dpal kun yongs rdzogs sa 'dzin dbang / /mtshams sprin zhun mas lan brgyar byugs so zhes/ /lhun po skrag ste rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /phyogs kun ma lus dog por bgyis sam snyam/ /phul byung dge mtshan 'khri shing gis 'khyud pa'i/ /phun tshogs gzugs sku'i yongs 'du sa brtol 'di/ /thub bstan 'dzin mar gnas pa de srid du/ /'gyur med g.yung drung gzhi la gnas gyur cig /tshul 'dir ut+pal dkar po'i 'dab ma bzhin/ /(2ba〉ye dman lhag pa'i bsam pas yongs zin nas/ /lus ngag yid kyi ngal bsnyen bdog pa yi/ /phan par rab bsgrubs mas klas skye rgu'i tshogs/ /dag pa'i rang bzhin ngo mtshar rgya mtsho yi/ /yongs gang med byung bkod bas khyad 'phags pa'i/ /zhing khams mchog der ma lus nyer drangs nas/ /zab rgyas chos kyi ro la spyod gyur cig /dge tsho gis 'od zer 'bum phrag 'phros pa yis/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i bad tshal legs rgyas shing / /rab dkon rgyal ba mchog gi dam pa'i chos/ /yongs 'phel 'jam mgon bla ma zhabs brtan shog /ces 'jam dbyangs gzhen nu ngur mig gi rnam rol can rgyal ba'i gsung rabs kyi drang nges 'byed pa la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa mkhas pa'i dbang phyug drin can bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis rgyal ba'i dbang po tsong kha pa chen po'i sku brnyan gan gos bzang bsgrigs kyi rgyu las bzhengs pa gnang ba'i dus/ bstod pa smon lam zung 'brel zhig dgos zhes bka' gnang ba spyi bos nod de/yul lho phyogs sman ljongs su byung ba'i snyan ngag mkhan za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes ja yun gcig la phral du sbyar ba'o/ /dge legs chu gter chen po'i klongs yangs las/ /rab mdzes mtshan dpe'i 'od zer stong 'bar ba/ /phul byung gzugs sku'i rta (3na skong dbang po khyod/ /lus can sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan kun gyi gnyen/ /rgyud mangs glu las ji snyed chos kyi sgra/ /skal bzang rna bar sgrog pa gan+dha skyi/ /mes po'i mthu las sprul snyam 'phyang mo nyug /ster byed gsung de yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs/ /rgyal kun mkhyen rtse'i rang bzhin lus 'degs kyi/ /pha mtha' gzigs mor spyod phyir ngal ba'i khur/ /khyer na brjod —2

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenabral gang thugs 'jal byed pa/ /byis pa'i ngang tshul can gyi blo 'di mtshar/ /rgyal sras dam pa yongs kyi tog gyur pa'i/ /rnam dkar legs lam 'bum du 'dzag pa can/ /gang gi mi 'jigs khri la bgrod /byed zung / /rab bkod mi pham mgon po'i snang rnyan drung / /mchog tu gus pa'i blo yi dge sbyong dpal/dpal ldan shakyu'i sras mchog yo byad kun/ /kun nas lus pa med par phul ba'i dge /dge tshogs rgya mtsho'i gting mthar bsnyegs pa 'dis/ /blo gros gser zangs thog med 'khor lo yis/ /thub bstan gling bzhir dbang bsgyur grags pa'i rnga/ /srid 'di'i khyon kun khyab pa lung rtogs kyi/ /ring lugs sde ba'i kho re dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /legs byas lus phra'i lcag ba'i kyus bkug pa yis/ /gangs can phan bde'i 'dod pa rab 'jo ba/ /rnam par dod pa rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i mgron/ /brgya phrag sgo 'phar phye bas khyab gyur cig /(3ba༄sa pa 'di ni lo pa chos rje dge 'dun rnam rgyal 'ol kha rdzing phyi'i mkhan thog 'byor phral byams pa'i sku brnyan ye shes sems pa dngos su bzhugs pa gang de la/ snam sbyar sogs dge sbyong gi rtags 'ga' zhig 'bul bar smon lam zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ yul lho phyogs gi sman ljongs su byung ba'i snyan ngag mkhan za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes 'phral du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /na maḥ bud+dhā mi tā bhā ya/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar rang snang zhing khams mchog /yid 'ong ljon shing dag gis rab mdzes shing / /dga' bder longs spyod lha mis yongs gang ba'i/ /dbus su rin chen khri steng chu skyes dang / /nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas pa'i rtser/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba mgon po 'od dpag med/ /mtshan dpe'i rgyan ldan sprul sku'i snang brnyan can/ /pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ltar dmar ba'i sku/ /phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag rdo rje dkyil mo krung / /bzod par dka' ba phul byung gzi brjid kyis/ /'dom gang 'od zer khor yug dra ba'i dbus/ /rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis mdzesapar gyur/ /chos dbyings bde ba'i mkha' la gnas bzhin du/ /grangs med 'gro la rjes brtse'i rlung —3—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)shugs kyis/ /gzhan don dus las yol ba med gyur pa/ /bcom ldan(4na ta khor bcas 'dir gshegs gnyis med gyur/ /mtha' yas tshogs gnyis chu gter chen po las/ /ye shes mchog gi bdud rtsi'i za ma tog /mtha' bral 'gro ba kun gyi sman yon du/ /stsol mdzad rkang gnyis gtso bor gus phyag 'tshal/ /ut+pal sdong bu bzang po'i dri tshogs bstar/ /gsal byed mar me dri chab rba rlabs 'brug /ro brgya'i zas dang snyan 'gyur rol mo sogs/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs rnams 'bul/ /thog ma med nas da lta'i bar dag tu/ /sdom gsum rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig las/ /nyams pas mtshon te mdor na mtshams med lnga/ /mi dge bcu sogs sdig pa'i las kun bshags/ /rnam 'dren theg gsum slob ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /rang g.yin don phyir bsgrub pa'i lung rtogs chos/ /skye dgu'i lhag bsam gyis bskrun dge tshogs la/ /bcos min bsam pa thag pas rjes yid rang / /gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /ston mdzad sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa rnams/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gzhi la rtag bzhugs shing / khyu 'bras theg pa'i chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ /thun mong thun mong min pa'i gsung rab rnams/ /thos bsam sgom sogs rab dkar dge legs tshogs/ /'di dang tshe rabs du mar bsags pa rnams/ /kun mkhyen ye shes thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /mi 'dzad gting mtha' (4ba)bral ba 'khor ba'i mtshor/ /nyam thag lus can byang grol la 'god pa'i/ /dam bca'i khur ldan mgon po 'od dpag med/ /smreng gi gsol la rnam dag snyan gyis gson/ /bdag dang ring nas phan byed mar gyur tshogs/ /blang dor tshul bzhin blta la mig ldong te/ /dug gsum zas la sred pas thar pa'i srog /yongs bral duḥkhas mnar 'dir brtse bas dgongs/ /gang zhig rgyal rnams chos dbyings zhi ba'i ror/ /dbyer med bzhugs la dag pa'i gnas kyis ci/ /de phyir 'khor 'khyam skye bo 'dren slad du/ /ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i gnas de bstan min nam/ /sprul pa'i zhing la tshad bzung ma mchis kyang / /mi mjed khams nas chu lha'i phyogs nyid du/ /'khod mnyam rin cen du mas spras pa'i gzhir/ /nor bu'i rdul mangs mthor brtsegs sa 'dzin can/ /gser dngul —4

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ 'dabe+eḍūr shel sbug mu tig rdo'i/ /rtsa sdong yal ga lo 'dab me tog 'bras/ /de lta'i ljon shing gser bus bskul ba las/ /dri yis yongs khyab me rtag phyogs kun 'gengs/ kha zheng gting zab dal gyis 'bab pa'i klung / /rnyog med gser gyi bye ma yongs brdal ba/ /chu skyes tshogos spu da 'dab chags 'phur lding rol/ /tsan+da la sogs rkang 'thung 'phreng bar 'khrigs/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan bla bre rnga yab dang / /snyan pa'i rol mo'i tshogs kyis rab tu khengs/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal ldan mngon shes rdo 'phrul can/ /mi zad 'dod pa'i longs (ldan〉1da mtha' klas pa'i/ /lha mir bcas dang nyan thos byang chub sems//dpag tshad stong dang drug brgya'i bong tshod ldan/ /brjod bral rgyan gyis legs spras ngo mtshar shing / /byang chub ljon pa'i dbang po gang gi drung / /bdag sogs 'gro rnams lnga pa'i lam zhugs tshe/ /thugasarjes thog pa med par mi 'dren na/ /dag zhing 'grub byed tshogs gsog smon lam rnams/ /brgya phrag dka' spyad mdzad pa'i dgos pa ci/ /dri med 'dab stong rgyas pa'i sbub dag las/ / rdzus ste skye ba blangs nas mgon khyod kyi/ /yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs kyi bka' stsal chos/ /ji bzhin thos bsam sgom pa byed par shog /gangs ri zla ba chu skyes rtsa ba yis/ /bsgrun min rab dkar lhag bsam las 'ongs pa/ /rnam dag smon pa'i gnas 'di mchog gsum gyi/ /thugs rje'i mthu yi thog med 'grub gyur cig /ces dag pa'i zhing bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam 'di yang / mchod dpon gyi las 'dzin dge 'dun dar rgyas kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa'i gsung sgros las btus ste za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o/ /phul byung mtshan dpe dar babs za ma tog /'chi ba'i dngos po 'jom byed zil mngar tshogs / /rab phyur 'dren mchog tshe dpag med mgon gyis/ /(5bting 'dir smon pa'i 'bras bu stsol bar mdzod/ /thub bstan dri med blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan/ /'dzin skyong legs spel snying stobs go cha can/ /chos srid 'byor pa'i dpal gyur phyogs kun las/ /rnam par rgyal 'di rdo rje ltar brtan shog /rab dkar bde legs skabs gsum dga' tshal du/ /bsod nams lang tsho rgyas pa dpag bsam —3—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ljon/ /g.yo med rab tu brtan pa'i khrims gnyis 'bras/ /skyong mkhas sa dbang 'gyur med gnas gyur cig /rnam 'dren mchog gyur rgyal dbang btsong kha pa'i/ /dri med ring lugs 'degs pa srid kyi sde/ /rtsod dus 'khor los bsgyur rgyal chab srid rnams/ /brtan cing mnga' thang mtshan jus rgyal gyur cig /bslu med mchog gsum chos srung rgya mtsho dang / /khrims ldan 'dus tshogs smon gnas nyin byed kyis/ /mi mthun mun pa'i smag rum drung phyung nas/ /'dod don 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i bkra shis shog /ces mchod yon gnyis kyi brtan bzhugs smon lam tshigs su bcad pa 'di yang / rab 'byams smra ba blo bzang chos grags kyis bskul ba ltar/ yul lho phyogs sman ljongs kyi lte bar skyes pa'i ban+de snyan ngag mkhan ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o/ /dge legs gter chen slu med mchog gsum gyi/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mthu yis lus can la/byams pa'i blo ldan legs byas kun dga'i dbyid/ /(6na〉pon byung ye shes ljon ba gsar pa gang / /rnam dkar dam chos sgrub pa'i dga' ston ched/ /phun tshogs bzang po'i las kyi 'phro 'thud de/ /chos ldan rten gyi 'bras bu rab smin pa'i/ /bden tshig brjod don ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces rmog lcog pa byams pa kun dga' ye shes kyi skye srid myur du 'dzin pa'i smon lam 'di yang thar pa mkhan po blo bzang 'jam dbyangs 'jigs med kyi ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'o/ /dpal ldan 'dab brgya'i rigs las rgyal ba'i tog /'chi med sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyi gter gyur tshe/ /rab spel ye shes mchog gi snang ba can/ /dpag med 'byung gnas gang gi thugs rje'i mthus/ /rgyal bstan dri ma med pa'i sgo 'phar las/ /sdom brtson lang tsho rab tu rgyas pa gang / /nyi bu'i mche rnon phrag las ring brgal te/ /yun du bde bar spyod pa 'grub gyur cig /ces rong po kirti sku skye bstan pa rab rgyas kyi brtan bzhugs tshigs bcad 'di ni de nyid kyi nu bo dka' bcu pas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'o/ /phun tshogs mtha' dag gzugs can/'dabs stong 'od srung byin yangs par/ /mdzes sdug lang tsho'i —6

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanagazi 'od man shel mdangs//mtshan bzang rlung gi rgyal mtshan gyis 'byud pa//blo gter bsil ldan lhun pos dge legs6ba〉sngor//dpal stug gsang gsum zla ba'i ma ma las//rab blo na 'di ga spyig ma ldan pa'i gzugs can dang 'og ma 'gal ba'i gzugs can/yangs mkhyen pa'i blo gros bcu gnyis bdag/sna tshogs bzang po'i mdzad pa tsha zer gyis/khres bya'i gnad don lta ba'i kun tu sems//lus med nyag phran gyis bcom phyogs kyi gos//legs bsal chos kyi sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan tshal//rab rgyas gcig tu mdzad pa po khri ka/phyogs bral rna bar 'god mkhas rtags tu rgyal//lus skya gas ༅ gyi shis brjod/can bsod nams me zhal sgyu rtsal sar//thub bstan nags kyi bdag po'i 'phreng tshogs dbus//grangs med rgyal ba kun dngos dpag bsam ljon//phan bde'i dri bsung rgyas phyir brtan gyur cig/blo sags༅ gyi shis brjod bzang rgyal bstan shel gyi ba gam du//lung rtogs chos kyi 'dzam bu nā da'i khrir//rgol ga sbyin skyes bcom pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog/ster 'dzin bshes gnyen lha dbang rtag bzhugs gsol/khyad rang sgo smo brjod pa la grangs kyi gab tshig gi brgyan pa/par nag phyogs sde bcas 'joms pa'i ched//phyag na 'khor lo mi rje'i tshul 'dzin par//thub klu dus kyi zla phreng rdzogs min du//bgrod byed rdo rje'i rang bzhin ltar gyur cig/grangs med rnam 'dren stobs bcu mnga' ba 'ga'/zhes ldan rjes brtse bor te snyoms zhugs pa//yang ༅ra 'gog pa/7nasgo gon khyod ched du zhing 'dir srid bzung na//zhi bder bzhugs pa'i mdzad pa rigs sam ci//mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan/'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po grong gsum lha dbang phyug 'a po'i mig gi mes 'dod lha'i lus bsregs pa'i ga rgyud dang sbyar/'joms//'joms byed mi mthun chu srin rgyal mtshan sde//sdebacas wen las 'dren byed zhugs kyi thab//thabs rol mchog des rtag tu rgyal ba'i dpal//dpal gyi dum bu ltar dkar 'chi med lha//lha mchog yid bzhin 'khor lo dbang gi rgyal//rgyal yum des kyang snyan tshig dbyar gyi rnga//rnga gsang ches cher sgrog pa'i dga' ston stsol//rigs gzugs༅ gyi shis brjod/brgya'i khyab bdag dngos gyur gnam bskos lha//bstan 'gro'i phun tshogs gling bzhi'i dpal mgon du//g.yo med lung rtogs gaṅgā skyes 'khor lo//kun khyab shis

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)brjod 'phreng ba 'grub gyur cig /rgyal ba mchog nyid zhabs zung rdo rje ltar/ /bde legs dpal du brtan phyir shis brjod 'phreng / /yan lag mchog bstan bad dkar 'dab stong dbus/ /dbyangs can bzhugs nas gsung las g.yin du ci/ /'on kyang skyes thob blo gros gang bu las/ /grong gtam ring dor da lha'i gzhung bzhin du/ /tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje dpal bzang po/ / me skyes dga' ba'i lang tsho mchog des sbyar/ /nyi ma'i (7ba)gnyen gyi bstan pa'i ba gam spor/ /blo bzang grangs med chos kyi glegs bu'i tshogs/ /lus can bsod nams rgyal mtshan rtser 'god pa/ /rgyal ba gang de'i zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /mtsho byung drin las ngag gi dbang phyugs gi /blo gros mchog thob bzang po'i 'phrin las kyang / /rgya mtsho'i gos can mthar khyab zhi 'tsho'i dbon/ /tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rje brtan gyur cig /dal ba'i rten la shes rab 'dab brgya'i tshal/ /thos bsam nyi ma'i 'od kyis legs bskyangs pa/ /gang 'di skyabs gsum drang srong tsho gos bcas kyis/ /rtag tu srung zhing skyong ba nyid gyur cig /ces mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po'i mtshan dang nged rang gi ming sgra gnyis ka tshang ba 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes rab 'byams pa ngag dbang don grub kyi ngor bris so/ /rgyal ba'i gsung gi gsang mdzod rgyud mang glur/ /zhi ba mchog gi yon tan gre 'gyur tshig /legs ldan thugs rje'i sman gyi sdom gsum srog /'tsho mdzad bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam par 'dud/ /gang de'i phul byung rigs kyi lha lam ngos/ /dbyangs can byed posang ga dbang ti mi'i 'jing / /'phrul las blo bzang snang gter 'phrin las 'od/ /legs 'ong rgya mtsho'i gos can kun khyab 'di/ /'gyur med rdo rje ltar brtan tshig gi tshal/ /dpal ldan lha mchog bsil sbyin mkhan po'i mthus/ /(8na)rab rgyas thog med 'grub pa'i dga' ston gyi/ /dpal 'byor bzang po rtag tu skyong gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang lo pa chos rje dge 'dun rnam rgyal gyis nged rang gi ming sgra tshang ba'i brtan bzhugs tshigasabacad ma zhig nan gyis bskul ba la rten nas/ snyem las pa rig byed 'dzin pa gang des bris/ /'gyur —8

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhe)med kun tu bzang po'i mkha' dbyings las/ /sprul pa'i zlos gar bsgyur ba nyin byed dbang / /phan dang bde ba'i 'dab stong rgyas mdzad pa/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs rjes rtag tu skyongs/ /gang dang dbyer med du mar snang ba'i gzugs/ /rab stims rgyal ba zhi khro 'khor lo'i lha/ /cho ge srung rgya mtshor bcas pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bdud dpung thul la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /bkra shis yon tan 'khyil ba'i mthu stobs kyis/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i rig 'dzin dbang po'i sde'i/ /bka' gter bshad dang sgrub pa'i rig lugs rnams/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i btsas su spel ba la/ /blo gros bzang pos pad+ma'i 'phrin las rnams/ /theg mchog dbang gi rgyal por grub pa'i gzugs/ /yongs 'du'i ljon pa'i sde ltar dge legs su/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i bden tshig 'grub gyur cig /ces byang pa rig 'dzin chen po ngag gi dbang po'i sprul pa'i sku mchog blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las theg mchog (8ba po bang gi rgyal po yongs 'du'i sdes snga 'gyur bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spel ba'i bzhed don 'grub byed kyi bden tshig 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes gsung gi bskul ba ltar dang du blangs te za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'o/ /phul byung ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rang bzhin kun/ /mtshan dpe'i gzugs skur 'khyil ba tshe dpag med/ /rgyal yum yid bzhin 'khor los dus kun tu/ /rlangs ston dam par dge legs stsal du gsol/ /dri med lha rigs rlangs kyi gangs ri las/ /dpal ldan phag gru blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan/ /zung 'brel chu klung spel ba mkhyen brtse'i bdag /dbang phyug yon tan brgyad kyis nyer mdzes pa/ /nor 'dzin lte bar lugs gnyis yongs 'du'i ljon/ /grangs med legs byas 'bras bu'i khur ldan pa/ /chos kyis skyong ba'i rgyal po ngag gi lha/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i khri la brtan gyur cig /ces dpal ldan mi'i dbang po lha gzigs phag mo gru pa blo bzang mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nor 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po ngag gi lha lugs zung gi 'dun sa chen po'i khrir zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di yang / gong dkar sku gnyer dpon dge steng bla ma byams pa kun dga' 'byung gnas kyis bskul ba ltar/ /shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar/ /—9—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rang bzhin grub pa'i tshe/ /(9na skong po'i mgon po ye shes mchog gi dpal//bde legs dpag tu med pa ster mkhas lhas/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin bdag por shis pa stsol/ /ngag gi dpal mnga' dbang phyug yon tan gyi/ /ma shas yongs gang 'jam dpal snying po'i bstan/ /gyen du bteg pas dga' ldan phyogs kun las/ /rnam par rgyal gang rab tu brtan gyur cig /ngag dbang dbyangs can rab rgyas mkhyen pa dang / /brtse chen mnga' 'bang dga' bder spyod pa'i dpyid/ /snying stobs nus pas ga' na sde tshar gcod pa/ /dpal ldan dbyig 'dzin skyong ba rab brtan shog /blo bzang rgyal bstan rmad byung grags pa'i nor/ /rin chen gcod paṇa rgyan du 'ching ba'i lha/ /rje blon 'bangs bcas mnga' thang chab srid kun/ /srid pa'i rtse mor 'phyur zhing 'phel gyur cig /mchog gsum dbyar skyes chu 'dzin phreng ba las/ /phul byung thugs rje'i gru char legs babs pas/ /'dod don dpag bsam yongs 'du gsar pa'i ljon/ /sde bzhi'i 'bras bu smin pa'i bkra shis shog /ces rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa la gcig tu gus pa lhur len pa'i sa skyong rgya ri ba lha ngag dbang dga' ldan rab brtan gyi brtan gzhugasakyi shis pa brjod pa 'di yang 'od 'bar gyis bskul ba ltar/ yul lho phyogs sman ljongs su skyes pa'i snyan ngag mkhan ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o/ /rgyal kun mkhyen (9ba)rab gar mkhan 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /mi yi srid pa'i rnam rol btsong kha pa/ /dngos rgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /bstan srung rgya mtshor bcas pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rnam dkar dge bas 'phangs pa dal 'byor rten//don ldan sgrub la 'dun pa dge ba'i bshes/ /mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rab rgyal zhing / /tshe dpal legs tshogs 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /ces rdzing phyi mkhan po dge 'dun rnam rgyal bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni don gnyer can 'gas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'o/ /phun tshogs bsod nams chu gter las 'ongs shing / /dge ba'i bkra shis rlabs 'phreng rab g.yog pas/ /gdul bya'i re ba yongs su skong ba'i rje/ /mtshungs med dpal ldan bla mar gsol ba — 10

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhana'adebs/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogos gnyis las grub mthus/ /dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i rten bzang rin chen snod/ /byang chub mchog gi bkra shis 'khyil ba yis/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes ja sang chos rje bsod nams bkra shis lnga pa'i lam du song ba'i tshe chos rje nyid kyi gsol 'debs dang dal 'byor gyi rten bzang thob pa'i smon lam gyi tshigs bcad dgos tshul dbon po nang sos nan tan gyis bskul ba'i ngor bris/ /mi 'gyur (10na〉che ba med pa bdud rtsi'i srog /rab brtan rdo rje'i khams su grub pa'i dpal/ /rgyal yum tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo yis/ /dus kun dge ba'i dngos grub char du phobs/ /mchog gsum thugs rje chen po'i sa bon tshogs/ rnam dag smon lam char gyis skrun pa las/ /deng 'dir 'dod pa'i don bzang a mra'i 'bras/ /lhun grub ro brgya'i lang tshor smin gyur cig /ngag gi dbang phyugs blo gros bye ba'i nor/ /grangs med skal bzang gdul byar rab stsol ba/ /legs byas rgya mtsho'i gzhir gyur rdo rje 'dzin/ /g.yo med bskal brgya'i bar du brtan gyur cig /'khon rigs grub pa'i dpa' bo kun snying rje/ /ngur smrig zlos gar blo gros rgya mtshan gyi/ /slob bshad chos kyi srog shing kha'u pa'i/ /lugs bzang srid mtha'i bar du rab 'phel zhing / khyad par nges bzang theg pa'i 'od stong gis/ /sku bzhi'i snang ba brgyad mdzad mtshar pa rje/ /yab sras rgyud par bcas pa'i ring lugs mchog /brtse chen snying po'i bstan la rgyas par shog /gur mgon lcam dral stobs 'phrog dbang po dang / /pu pra ming sring gnod sbyin beg tse sogs/ /bstan srung rnams kyis smon pa'i 'dod don kun/ /thogs med lhun gyis legs 'grub 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces nged rang gi ming sgra yod pa'i brtan bzhugs dang / /gsang chen slob bshad kyi bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam dang bcas pa 'di (10ba) yang yar klung bkra shis chos sde'i spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brjes 'phying ba stag rtse'i pho brang du sbyar ba'o/ /rgyal ba kun dngos rig 'dzin pad+ma yi/ /rdo rje theg mchog bstan pa yid bzhin nor/ /bshad — 11 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)sgrub rgyal mtshan rtse mor 'dzin mdzad pa/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i dpal de rtag bzhugs gsol/ /dpal ldan zab dang rgya che dam chos kyi/ /'byor par mnga' sgyur 'phrin las 'od stong gis/ /phan bde'i snang ba rab tu rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje 'dzin dbang bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs gzhen nu dang / /dbyer med rnam par dpyod pa'i bkra shis dung / /legs bshad g.yas su 'khyil ba kun dga'i dpal/ /lhun gyi grub khyod rtag tu brtan gyur cig /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin pad+ma ka ra dang / /yi dam sgrub sdebargyad kyi lha yi tshogs/ /'dod khams dbang phyug la sogs chos srung kyis/ /rig pa 'dzin mchog rtag tu srung gyur cig /med byung dge legs yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /dngos grub char du 'bebs pa'i dga' ston can/ /phun tshogs bkra shis mchogo gi dus kun tu/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal du 'grub gyur cig /ces khyab bdag 'khor lo'i dbang phyug zur chen bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi brtan bzhugs tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba sirnyi ra stu/ / su sti (11na)bra dzābh+yaḥ mchog gsum thugs rje'i dbyar gyi rnga gsang sgras/ /phun tshogs spu sdug rnam bkra gtsug phud can/ /bde skyed gar bsgyur dbang phyug brgyad ldan pa'i/ /mngal 'dzin bskal pa bzang por spyod gyur cig /dal 'byor rten gyi chu gter chen po la/ /legs byas rlud shugs drag pos nyer bskyod pas/ /tshe dpal stobs lor rba rlabs srid pa'i rtser/ /rab 'phyur gzegs ma phyogasabargyar 'thor gyur cig /mtho ris thar pa'i rin cen them skas la/ /'dzegs te zung 'jug grub pa mchog gi sa/ /dpal ldan stobs bcu mnga' ba'i grong khyer du/ /legs bzhugs don gnyis lhun grub dge legs stsol/ /ces pa 'di yang rnam sras gling pa phun tshogs dbang pos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos pho brang chen po po tā la'i gzims chung khams gsum gzil gnon du sbyar ba'o/ /'jam mgon ngag dbang blo yi dga' tshal du/ /phun tshogs sa bzang dud pa a mra'i ljon/ /rgya chen phan dang bde ba'i grib bsil gang / /dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel mdzad 'od —12

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanadakar can/ /slu med rten cing 'brel 'byung nam mkha' la/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i rlung shugs sa drangs nas/ /gangs can phan bde'i snang ba ma lus pa/ /myur du 'gyed pa'i dga' ston rgyas par shog /srid gsum gtso mo'i 'dod (11bams dbang phyug sogs/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ / deng 'dir yid la smon pa'i 'dod don 'bras/ /thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang bi ri stod pa dge rgyas kyi chos mdzad ma bsod nams chos sgron gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes g.yags gzhung du sbyar ba'o/ /phul byung bdud rtsi'i dpal ster tshe dpag med/ /rgyal ba kun yum yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zhabs/ /'dzad med thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /deng 'dir smon pa'i 'bras bu 'grub nga ra mdzod/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje 'dzin/ /med byung bsod nams dam pa'i gzhir gyur pa/ /rnam kun mchog dang ldan pa'i rig pa 'dzin/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor mi g.yo zhabs brtan shog /slob bshad zab mo'i chos kyi ga ba'i rgyun/ /nam yang chad pa med pa'i legs bshad kyi/ /gangs can blo bsal bye ba'i tshogs rnams la/ /phan dang bde ba'i dga' ston rgyas gyur cig /ces rje btsun bla ma 'a zhwa'i rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyi brtan bzhugs tshigs su bcad pa 'di yang za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o/ /u si rnyi ra stu ༷ li sa rbu 'e / blo gros rab yangs bskal bzang dga' ba'i dpal/ /lung rtogs bstan pa'i rjes su nyer zhugs pas/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan sde las ring gyur cig /gnasalngar mos blo 'dzin pa'i rje 'bangs bcas/ /byang chub snying po'i bdud rtsi a mra'i bcud/ /myong min de srid phan pa sgrub pa'i sems/ /lhag bsam zla gzhen lta bur ches dkar ba/ khyun chad med par yid la 'grog par byed/ /sarba dwa tha dza ya skyo/ /pad+ma sku skye blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du rjes su 'dzin par khas 'che ba'i smon lam tshigs bcad cig dgos tshul byung ba khas len pa po dang len yul gnyis gang sngon du 'tshang rgya mi shes par nam mkha' stong par sbar tshod 'di rigs — 13

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dpyod ldan khrel ba'i gnas las mi 'dug rung / slob ma la snying nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa yod na bla ma de ngan 'gror yod kyang slob mar byin rlabs 'jug pa rten 'brel gyi chos nyid du bshad 'dug cing /dad mos kyi rten 'brel ma 'grig kyang stong shog gi ham pa 'di bla chen rnams kyi spyi zog drag shos yin pas khong pa nan ches pas bris pa yin no/ /ye shes mchoge gi be+eḍūr zhun ma'i khams/ /dpag yas tshe yi gzugs su grub pa'i snod/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud kyi legs gang ba/ /lhag pa'i lha yi bkra shis rgya mtsho stsol/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo ldan skal bzang kun/ /dga' skyed thub pa'i bstan pa rgya mtsho che/ /bshad sgrub rlabs phreng dus lasayol med pa/ /bshes gnyen gdengs can dbang po zhabs brtan shog /ngag gi dpal mnga' dbang phyug yon tan (12ba tha rgyad/ /legs ldan mi 'dzad blo gros gter chen po/ /'gro rnams skal ba bzang por legs bsgyur ba/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sdogang zhabs brtan shog /phun tshogs kun nas yangs pa'i grong khyer can/ /nges don sgrub brgyud ring lugs 'dus tshogos sde/ /srid mthar nyams pa med pa'i ngo mtshar gyis/ /'gro ba'i bsod na mas mchode sdong cher rgyas shog /zla ba bzhun ma'i 'od kyis bsgrun min pa/ /rnam smin dkar por 'dzag byed dge ba'i dung / /legs byas g.yas su rab 'khyil dbyangasasnyan po/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bar du sgrog gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang yangs pa can gyi spyan snga dzin nyi mas thog drangs chos sdospyi tsho gos kyis nan gyis bskul ba la rten nas za hor gyi brnyes chos sde de nyid kyi nye 'dabs su sbyar ba'o/ /rtsa gsum thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo gros bye ba'i gter/ /phan bde'i gos bzang rab smin yongs 'du'i ljon/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du brtan gyur cig /ngag dbang 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos 'dzad med kyi/ /phul byung blo gros mchog tu rgyas pa'i sde/ /gnas skabs tshe dang dpal 'byor kun 'phel zhing / /mthar thug gdod ma'i ye shes mgo gyur shog /ces pa 'di yang gtsug lag rtsis kyi gzhung lugs la rnam dpyod can nang ra chos mdzad ngag dbang — 14

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhena'ajam dpal blo gros (13na)mchog gi sdes bskul ba brten nas/ za hor gyi bzhes dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa'i pho brang gi mdun du sbyar ba'o/ /thugs rje'i gter gyur bla ma yi dam dang / /chos skyong srung ma'i byin rlabs nus mthu yis/ /mgon khyed gangs can bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tsho'i gzhir/ /myur du phebs pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod/ /bdag sogs 'gro kun bar chad mi mthun phyogs/ /kun las rab rgyal tshe dpal longs spyod rgyas/ /mthar thug rnam mkhyen ye shes mngon byas te/ /don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang bi ri stod pa dge rgyas kyi chos mdzad ma bsod nams dpal bzang gi bskul ba'i ngor/ za hor gyi bzhes g.yags gzhung du sbyar/ /phun tshogs dge mtshan rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i dung / /ngag dbang tshangs pa'i dbyangs su 'gran bzod pa/ /blo gros mchog gis skal bzang dga' byed pa/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sde la gsol 'debs/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i zlos gar rdo rje'i khams/ /mi 'gyur seng ge'i gdan khrir grub pa'i steng / /rje btsun bla ma khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor migayo brtan gyur cig /mthuldan chos srung nus pa'i shing rta yis/ /dbang phyogs lha yi lam las thogs med du/ /drangs te gangs can phan dang bde ba'i 'od/ /(13bskong ba dam pa'i gzi byin 'bar gyur cig /sgar chen gong du 'degasapa'i bshul du thog mar zhugs nyan gangs can gyi ljongs su gegs med myur du 'byor ba'i smon lam tshigs su bcad 'di yang sa skyong rgya ri ba ngag dbang dga' ldan rab brtan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes lhun grub rab brtan du sbyar ba'o/ /dal 'byor rten la shes rab dpyod ldan can/ /'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol 'dod blo ldan ma/ /tshe 'dir nyer 'tshe bar chad kun zhi zhing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces pa yang o rod g.yon ru'i dpon mo shes rab sgrol ma'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes 'dam don gnyis lhun grub gling du sbyar ba'o/ /srid zhi'i gtsug tor bde 'byung ral pa'i rtser/ /zhabs sen zla ba'i gcod paṇa 'god mdzad — 15

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)pa/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo mi yi srid bzung gar/ /sgyur mdzad kun mkhyen tsong kha pa la 'dud/ /gang gi lung rtogs bstan pa'i shing rta che/ /ngag gi dbang phyug legs grub rnam dpyod kyis/ /'dren mdzad blo bsal 'gro la bzang po'i lam/ /ston mkhas thub bstan rgya mtsho'i spel 'dud/ /byin rlabs gter gyur rtsa rgyud bla ma dang / dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs/ /bdud dpung 'dul mdzad chos skyong srung ma yi/ /rmad byung mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /ngag gi dbang phyug mi zad blo gros gter/ /skal bzang 'gro la (14nags bshad bdud rtsi'i dpyid/ /rgya chen bstan 'gro'i phan bde dbyar mtsho ltar/ /rgyas mdzad rje btsun bla ma nyi mor byed/ shar phyogs rgyal po'i 'dun sa'i phangs pa yi/ /thun mtshams steg las myur du rab babs te/ /dbus 'gyur kha bas bskor ba bod yul gyi/ /mkha' la thog pa med par bgrod par shog /gangs can 'dzin ma'i sto bar seng ge'i khrir/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje lta bur rtag bzhugs nas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas thub bstan 'phel mdzad pa'i/ /'phrin las srid mtha'i bar du rgyas gyur cig /mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag po yis/ /mchog gsum rin chen thugs rje rab skul nas/ /deng 'dir 'dod don re ba yongs skong bar/ /dpag bsam yongs 'du'i dbang po ltar gyur cig /dge ba des kyang bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams/ /tshe rabs kun tu bshes gnyen dam pa yis/ /rjes su bzung ste zab dang rgya che ba/ /dam pa'i cho gel longs su spyod gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pas thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos rje don grub rgya mtshos nan tan du bskul ba ltar za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes dkar thang mar khu'i mtsho mor sbyar ba'i yi ge'i zlos gar bsgyur ba po ni slob dpon mkhas pa'i dbang (14ba)po smon 'gro paṇa chen no/ /slu med mchog gsum thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang / /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi nus stobs dpung / /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i mthu/ /khrims ldan 'dus sde'i shugs drag smon — 16

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhinalam las/ /ngag dbang dbyangs can lha mos rjes bzung ba'i/ /blo gros bzang pos rgya chen gtsug lag kun/ /mgrin par legs bshad yid bzhin mtsho 'khyil ba/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa gang / /dbus 'gyur lung rtogs bstan pa'i 'bras bzang kun/ /'phyur bur legs spungs dga' bder legs spyad nas/ /dpal ldan gru 'dzin gnyis ba'i pho brang cher/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i khri la brtan gyur cig /'chad rtsod rtsom dang thos bsam sgom la sogs/ /phul byung rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /mkha' khyab 'gro kun phan bde'i sar 'god pa'i/ /ba ched don ma lus gegasamed 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang rgya nag pho brang chen po'i bya 'dabs kyi lha khang ser po'i slob dpon bsam blo sbyin pa rgya mtshos bskul ba la rten nas za hor gyi brnyes bris pa'o/ /rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang 'phags pa dang / /rig 'dzin lha dang drang srong grub pa sogs/ /slu med bden pa'i tshig la dbang thob pa/ /kun gyi smon lam 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /sbyin sogs phyin drug rgyal sras spyod pa la/ /(15na 〉 dus pa'i blo ldan 'dus tshogis rgya mtsho rnams/ /tshe rabs kun tu dal 'byor rten thob cing / /dge ba'i bshes kyi rjes su 'dzin par shog /mtha' yas chos kun thos pas sgro 'dogs bcad/ /de don rnam 'byed shes rab rtsal gyi bsams/ /tshul bzhin bsgrubs pas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen/ /mngon du byas nas don gnyis 'grub par shog /de thob ma gyur tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dam chos snod ldan gdul bya gzur gnas can/ /dge ba'i bshes kyi rjes su 'brang ba la/ /rtag tu ngu yi rnam thar 'dzin par shog /rnam dag tshul khrims rtsa ba rab tu brtan/ /byang chub sems kyi lo 'dabs phang phung g.yo/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gos bu'i khur dud pa/ /sngon med yongs 'du'i dbang po ltar gyur cig /de ltar smon lam yid bzhin nor bu mchog /dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor rab bkod nas/ /ci bsam re ba legs stong 'dod dgu'i char/ /sa steng kun tu khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang lha khang ser po'i bla ma bsam blo rab 'byams pa sbyin pa rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes bris/ /—17

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang / /lha mi'i drang srong bden tshig grub rnams kyis/ /ngag dbang blo bsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /rdo rje lta bur sku tshe brtan par shog /myur du gangs can ljongs der thog med du/ /bgrod (15ba)par gegs med bsam pa lhun grub cing / /bdag sogs rnams kyi nad gdon bar gcod kun/ /zhi zhing phan bde'i dpal la spyod par shog /dkar phyogs mthu stobs rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgrengs/ /nag phyogs mi phyugs nad rim 'byug rtsod zhi/ /bde skyid nyi mo'i snang ba rab rgyas pa'i/ /smon lam ma lus thog med 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang sgar chen pho brang nas yar bteg pa'i byang tal sgar yod skabs sgar spyi so'i 'dod pa ltar khrom dbang bskur cing brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrig dus sgar dmangs rnams kyis nged yun du 'tsho ba dang spyi sger gyi bar chad sel ba'i smon lam tshigs bcad 'di bzhin dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'o/ / slu med dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum gyi/ /dmigs med thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs pas/ /mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyam pa'i bdag so gos 'gro/ /'gas med stobs bcu'i go 'phang thob par shog sol de mthob tsher ba thams cad du/ /dal brgyad 'byor brgya tshang ba'i srid bzung nas/ /rje btsun bla ma mchog gi zhabs drung du/ /'bral med dam pa'i chos la spyod par shog /khyad par gzhon nu rab byung tshangs spyod kyi/ /tshul khrims mig 'bras ltar srung bslab gsum ldan/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing gi mchog gyur nas/ /(16na long 'das rin chen gling du bgrod par shog /nad gdon bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun gyis/ /skad cig tsam yang 'tshe bar mi nus shing / /tshe dang bsod nams lung rtogs yon tan sogs/ /legs tshogs ma lus 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang rgya nag gi rgyal khams myul ba'i tshe mgon po gun gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o/ /'jam mgon lang tsho dar babs mkhyen pa'i gzhin/ /thub bstan dpag bsam sdong po rab rgyas— 18

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung gsab ma dang po/ 'dapa/ /blo bzang grags snyan ring lugs grib bsil la/ /'gro kun longs su spyod pa'i ba po shis shog /phul byung bsod nams mchag tu rab brtan cing / /thub bstan legs skyong sa dbang chos kyi rgyal/gnam skos sa yi tshangs pa'i sku tshe dang / /mtshan jus mnga' thang phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /legs byas bye ba'i yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /sdo bzhi'i 'dod rgu char du bsnyil ba'i 'bras/ /rab yangs nor 'dzin khyen kun yongs khyab pa'i/ /phan bde'i dpal gyis dus kun khyab gyur cig /ces smon lam chen mo'i dam bca'i skabs ma ṇi bskul rgyu'i tshigs bcad brtan bzhugs 'di ni dkon mchog blo gros kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'o/ /'ja' 'od gur nang pad dkar zla ba'i steng / /'chi med dpal ster (16ba)'jo sgeg lha mo'i gzugs/ /rgyal yum yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsil byin mkhan/ /yid mkhar 'gog med rtag par 'char du gsol/ /med byung mchod tshogs sprin phung logs pa las/ dngos grub 'dzad pa med pa'i char rgyun gyis/ /phan bde myu gu'i khri shing g.yur za ba'i/ /don gnyis sa bur spyod pa'i dga' ston stsol/ khyad par blo bzang grags snyan rab 'bar bstan/ /stobs kyi 'khor los legs 'dzin chod kyi rgyal/ /gnam sa'i dbang phyug sbyin pa'i bdag po la/ /tshe dpal dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /oṃ tā re tu t+ta re tu re dwa na pa twe rā yu phri pusti ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa 'di ni bstan pa rin po che la mi phyed pa'i dad pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes shing yangs pa'i sa chen po skyong bar dpa' mdzangs rtul phod pa'i rnam dpyod can bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po bro 'tshal ba'i skabs/ bar chad sel ba'i rim gror dmigs ste za hor gyi bzhes chos sde chen po se 'bras gnyis kyi dge 'dun 'dus pa'i zhal 'don du sbyar ba'o/ / thabs shes zung 'jug 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dpyid/ /rgyal kun gsang ba rab 'byams 'khor lo'i mdzod/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dbang por lhun grub pa/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug na rgyas gyur cig /dus gsum rgyal kun thugs rje'i rang gzugs gar/ /mtha' yas gdul bya'i yid mkhar — 19

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)legs shar ba/ /mkhas btsun grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba (17na〉pa chog /grangs med skye dgu'i nyer 'tshor rtag bzhugs gsol/ /ye shes 'ja' tshon rnam bkra'i gur khyim nas/ /si rgya wa ra'i mdangs 'dzin ngag gi lha/ /bstan pa'i 'khor lo kun mkhyen myong kha pa'i/ /dri med ring lugs spel phyir rtag bzhugs gsol/ /ngo mtshar dag pa 'og min zhing khams nas/ /lhag bsam rin chen them skas las babs te/ kha ba'i ljongs 'dir bsgyur ba'i ngur mig gar/ /grangs med gdul bya'i mgon du rtag bzhugs gsol/ /mkha' khyab dag pa don dam dbyings nyid nas/ /kun rdzob spros pa'i snang ba 'char bzhin du/ /dman pa'i lam gyi rjes 'gro zhi bde'i tshul/ /rnam 'dren mdzad pa min phyir rtag bzhugs gsol/ /legs pa'i cha bsags dpal ldan ka la par/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos snyan pa'i grags 'bar ba/ /bsam bzhin sa la'i ljongs su srid bzung ba/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gdan la rtag bzhugs gsol/ /sdebazhi'i dpal ldan drag po'i brtul zhugs sa/ /kla klo mthar byed stobs kyis 'khor losabasgyur/ /dum bu bcu gnyis sa la spyod min par/ /'gro la chos 'khor skor phyir rtag bzhugs gsol/ /dge bcu'i mngal khur nor 'dzin lus phra'i stor/ /yang dag lam du srid 'khyams 'gro ba rnams/ /rjes su bzung ba nor bu'i do shal gyis/ /skal bzang rgyan du spud pa'i bka' drin stsol la/ /blo gros rab yangs mkhas btsun (17ba)bzang po yis/ /lung rtogs chos kyi dga' ston stsol mkhas pa/ /'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs rgyal mtshan mchog /srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du bsgreng bar shog /dge legs sa bon dar la yongs babs pa/ /'gro ba'i legs byas 'dzaskru'i ljon shing 'bras/ /mi 'dzad longs su spyod pa'i su wa rjes/ /srid zhi'i dbul ba drung nas 'byin par shog /tshe dpag med mgon rnam par rgyal ma dang / /rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo la sogs pa/ /mchog gsum dam pa'i bkra shis nā da'i sgra/ /gzhom med dbyangs kyi nga ro sgrog gyur cig /ces don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te mkhan po rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tshor zhabs pad brtan pa'i rten 'byung gi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni za hor gyi bzhes pho brang bsam grub rtser bris te phul ba —2()

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanasirnyi ra stu/ /dpal ldan mi pham thugs rje'i rin cen khams/ /rgya bod gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍita ra/ /legs grub rgyal ba gnyis pa bu ston rje'i/ /mkhyen brtse nus pas phan bde'i dpal stsol cig /med byung 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu gter che/ /nam yang 'jigs pa med pa'i rlabs phreng can/ /tshe dpal yid bzhin nor bu'i 'dod 'jo mkhan/ /'khor lo'i mgon gyi yum des rtag tu skyongs/ /gsung ngag rdo rje'i dbyangs ldan dbang phyug brgyad/ /lhun grub blo gsal skal bzang dga' ba'i bshes/(18na)/rgya chen gsung rab 'chad la mtsho byung ma'i/ /rjes 'gro rdo rje'i khri la brtan gyur cig /'chad rtsod rtsom par 'jig bral seng ge'i sgra/ /gzhom med rnam par dpyod pa'i go cha can/ /thub bstan thos bsam sgom pa lang tsho'i sde/ /srid mtha'i bar du g.yo med brtan gyur cig /phun tshogs rab dkar dge ba'i ke la sha/ /ma med smon lam tsha zer gyis zhu ba'i/ /legs byas 'dzad pa med pa chu bo'i rgyun/ /byang chub mchog gi rgya mtshor babs gyur cig /ma 'dris 'gro ba kun la mdza' ba'i gnyen/ /stobs bcu'i rtsal 'chang zas gtsang sras po yi/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i ring lugs gdug dkar po/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du 'khor gyur cig /khyad par rnal 'byor dbang phyug s+tha bi ra/ /gnas lnga kun mkhyen shākya shrī'i zhabs/ /bsam bzhin skye ba'i zlos gar bu ston rje'i/ /mdo sngags bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /ring lugs gser gyi shing rta 'dren pa'i rgyad/ /bzang po'i bag chags yongs sad ldong gi rigs/ /lasadang bskal bar ldan pa'i rjes 'dug gi /bstan 'dzin dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel gyur cig /sum rtsen sa la 'phos 'dra gser bkang zhes/ /ngo mtshar rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lo can/ /gangs can ri bo'i phug na dben pa'i gnas/ /khrims ldan 'dus sde rtag tu rgyas gyur cig /bskal ba bzang po'i rnam 'dren bdun pa mchog /dam pa'i chos kyi nyi 'od rab gsal ba/ /(18bsngon med rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston la/ /'gro kun longs su legs spyod bkra shis shog /ces nged rang gi ming sgra thon pa'i gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs bstan pa spyi dang bye brag zha lu ba'i ring lugs 'phel ba'i smon —21 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)lam dang bcas pa 'di ni/ chos sde chen po zha lu ri mthil gyi spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ za hor gyi bzhes gser bkang gi nye 'dabs su sbyar ba'o/ / bdag dang 'gro ba sems can ma lus pa/ /dkon mchog gsum la snying nas skyabs su mchi/ /'gro kun srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sgral phyir/ /smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems skyed do/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar seng shes bteg pa yi/ /pad dkar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i steng / /rtsa rgyud bla ma dus gsum rgyas sras dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun 'dus pa'i/ /skyabs gsum ngo bo 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /'kho gcig phyag bzhi zhi zhid 'dzum pa'i nyams/ /rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar/ /lhag ma gnyis kyi shel 'phreng pad kur 'dzin/ /rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' gsol/ /kri ṣ+ṭha su ra'i pags pa phrag par bkal/ /blta bas mi ngoms mtshan dpe'i lang tsho can/ /zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams bla ma yi dam lha/ /sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro (19na sna la skyong srung ma sogs/ /sprin gyi phung po lta bur bzhugs su gsol/ /rang lus bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing khams kyi/ /rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam par rab sprul nas/ /bslu ba med pa'i skyabs gnas tshogos rnams la/ /mi byed dang ba'i yid kyi phyag la sgos lo/ /kun tu bzang po'i ma rdzo pa'i sprin wo po/ /sa dang bar snang ma lus yongasabakang ste/ /dus gsum bsags dang bsag 'gyur dge tshogs dang / /lhan cig gus pa'i yid kyisadabul bar bgyi/ /thog med dus nas da lta'i bar dag tu/ /mi bzad nyon mongs dug gsum dbang gyur te/ /grangs med bsags pa'i nag po'i las rnams kun/ /gnyen po stobs bzhi'i sgo nas legs par bshags/ /bdag gzhan rnams kyi da lta dus gsum du/ /byas dang byed bzhin byed par 'gyur ba yi/ /phun tshogs rnam dkar dge ba ci mchis par/ /snying nas dang bas rjes su yid rang ngo / /dus gsum byon dang 'byon 'gyur byon bzhi pa/ /rnam 'dren slob mar bcas pa tshogs rnamasakyis/ /lus can rnams la zab dang rgya che ba'i/ /dam chos rgyun chad med par bskor bar bskul/ /—22

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanamachog dman skye dgu kun gyis mngon sum du/ /mthong ba'i bskal ba can gyur gzugs kyi sku/ /nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'jig rten mun pa'i dpung / /sel ba ji srid brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /'bad pa chen pos lus ngag yid gsum gyis/ /ji snyed bsags pa'i dge tsho gos ma lus pa/ /mkha' mnyam mar (19ba〉spyar 'gro ba sgrol slad du/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa thob phyir bsngo/ /grangs med rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i gter/ /bzhin lag gzugs su shar ba pad dkar 'chang / /ma 'drisa'agro ba kun gyi mdza' ba'i bshes/ /slu med gtan gyi skyabs khyod bdag la dgongs/ /thog med dusanas gti mug mun pas bsgribs/ /blangs dang dor byar blta ba'i blo mig ldongs/ /mi dge'i las la bag med spyad pa'i mthus/ /mi zad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i nang du bying / /dngos su bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal can/ /nyam thag dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro'i rten/ /sdug bsngal bde bar rlomasapa lha mi'i lus/ /'dab chags mkha' la 'phur ba ji bzhin du/ /'du byed gyis mnar gzugs dang gzugs med lha/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rgya las ma grol ba'i/ /tshul 'di bsams tshe sgo gsum ngal ba'i gnas/ /de phyir mchog gsum ngo bor gsol 'debs na/ /'khor ba me yi dong las skyabs tu gsol/ /srid pa'i dpal 'byor chu bo che las sgrol/ /rang bde zhi ba'i 'byog dgon gnas las drongs/ /rnam mkhyen rin chen gling du nyer khrid gsol/ /gal te tshe 'dir stobs bcu mnga' ba yi/ /go 'phang thob pa'i skal pa dman gyur na/ /'chi tshe gtan gyi skyabs khyod dngos byon nas/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du drangs du gsol/ /rgyas par 'dod na/ theg gsum dam pa'i chos rnams ma lus pa/ /stsol mdzad dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas mchog /(20na tshe shes gnyen dam pa gtsug gi nor bu ltar/ /'bral med tshul bzhin bsten par byin gyis rlomes/ /dal 'byor yid bzhin nor ltar rnyed pa dka'/ /rnyed kyang chu lhar bzhin du 'jig par sla/ zhi ba'i 'og tu las kyi gzhan dbang can/ /rgyu 'bras tshul la nges shes 'drongs bar shog /ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gis sdig pa'i las/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas rab bsags pas/ /ngan song gnas su skye bar 'gyur ba'i tshul/ /rtogs te skyabs gnas—23

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'tshol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i yon tan kun/ /mngon gyur bslu ba med pa'i mgon gcig pu/ /dkon mchog gsum la snying nas skyabs 'gro zhing / /bslab byar nyams pa med par slob par shog zhas bzhin brtan pos lus ngag yid kyi sgor/ /mi dge bcu yi rgyu ba legs srung zhing / /rnam dkar dge ba'i yon tan ma lus pa/ /dbyar gyi chu gter lta bur 'phel byed shog /tshangs pa brgya byin 'khor los bsgyur ba sogs/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs dpal la longs spyod rnams//slar yang ngan song gnas su lhung ba dag zhas nas 'khor bar nges par 'byung bar shog /sdug bsngal myu gu ma lus skyed byed pa'i/ /sa bon kun 'byung yin par rab rtogs nas/ /phra rag nyon mongasam lus spong ba'i phyir/ /rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs ldog sgom par shog /zhi bde dman pa'i lam du gol shes nas/ /ma gyur 'gro ba (20ba tsher dren pa'i lhag bsam gyis/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod tshul nyams len par/ /ngang pa'i tshogs rnams pad mtshor 'jug ltar shog /grangs med bskal bar 'gro rnams nyam thag pa/ /ma bzod nye lam rdo rje theg pa la/ /brten nas myur du sangs rgyasago 'phang mchog /tshe 'dir mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhe bdun rnam dag smon lam gyis mtshams sbyor ba'i nyams len gyi rim pa dang sbyar ba 'di ni dpon mo sa'i khan jus bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes ra sa 'phrul snang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i tshe cho 'phrul chen po'i dus 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i zhal 'don du gnang ba sogs/ /spangs rtogs yon tan mthar phyin rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /srid zhi'i 'jigs pa kun sel dam pa'i chos/ /theg gsum skye 'phags dge 'dun tshogs rnams kyis/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mthu —24

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (na)dpung skyed du gsol/ /sa chen legs skyong bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis/ /thog med dus nas bsags pa'i sdig pa'i las/ /rnam smin nag po'i 'bras 'byin mun pa'i dpung / /thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od kyis bsal du gsol/ /mi khom gnas kyi 'khyog po'i yal ga can/ /ma dag skye srid nag klung yongs spangasanas/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i 'chi med dga' tshal du/ /phan bde'i dpag bsam ljon par spyod gyur cig /gnas skabs su yang mngon mtho'i rten thob nas/ /bstan la legs zhugs dri med tshul khrimasaldan/ /thos bsam sgom gsum nor la longs spyad de/ /nges par legs pa'i lam mchog (21na/sgyub par shog /dge bcu'i rdzogs ldan tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'dir mi pham mgon phebasatshe/ /'khor gyi thog mar skyes nas srid pa las/ /yongs grol myang 'das bdud rtsir spyod gyur cig /dus gsum bsags dang bsag 'gyur dge tshogs kyis/ /thar pa'i rin chen them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /dpal ldan stobs bcu'i rtsal 'chang sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang bde chen gnas su bgrod par shog /ces pa 'di ni gnam sa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i tshe cho 'phrul chen po'i dus 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i zhal 'don du shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /ngag dbang blo gros dang mtshungs zab cing yangs/ /pad dkar 'dzin ltar bzang po'i lhag bsam can/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin 'phrin las yol med pa/ /lag na rdo rje'i rjes 'gror gsol ba 'debs/ /mi mthun phyogs la 'jigs med go cha can/ /thub bstan lang tsho rgyas pa'i rnam dpyod sde/ /skal bzang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho bla na med/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge des gnas skabs 'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub/ /tshe rabs kun tu mgon khyod zhabs drung du/ /skyes nas mngon par mtho dang nges legs kyi/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs stsol ba'i (21brdzi dam lha/ /rgyal ba kun yum rje btsun sgrol ma yi/ /med byung mtshan gyi ming ldan rje 'bangs rnams/ /lhag pa'i lha des rjes su 'dzin par shog /bcom ldan lha mo —25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)gzungs chen grwa lnga yi//thugs rje'i 'od kyis bar chad mun bsal te//rigs brgyud 'phel zhing bde bar btsa' ba sogs//legs tshogos bye ba'i snang ba 'bar gyur cig zhes gso le 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes dpon mo phun tshogs sgrol mas skul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar//rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tsho gos dang //dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma yis//bdag gi nad gdon bar chad kun zhi zhing //bsam pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par mdzod//ces pa 'di ni mdar pa ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub brda sprod pa tsan+d+ra pa'i slob gnyer skabs bar chad mi 'jug pa'i ngag 'don zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar bris//bzang po'i bskal pa tshig mda'i lam yangs por//mdzad bzang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing g.yur za ba//byams brtse'i mtshan gyi lo 'dabs phang phung can//mi pham phan dang bde ba'i grib bsil gnas//mtha' yas srid zhi dngas pa'i nyal 'gro'i mtshor//thugs rje'i zla gzugs bgrang yasalegs 'char ba//rtsol bral lhun gyis grub pa stobs bcu'i rtsal//rdzogs pa'i gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul tshad bzung ci//'brug sgra dal gyis rgod tshe gtsug phud can//dga' 22na tha'i sgro gshog zlum por sgyur byed na//bden tshig smreng du gsol tshe rgyal ba kun//byin rlabs 'jug pa'i snang ba cis mi dkar//sna tshogs chu skyes grangs bzhin 'gro ba'i blo//mchog dman bar ma'i ngang tshul ji snyed pa//brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi gru char ches//gtan bde'i snang ba rab bkra'i 'dab ma 'dzum//de phyir srid mtsho sgrol ba'i gru bo che//thub dbang rjes zhugs ri med grub pa'i mtha'//nges legs nor bu 'dren pa'i snying stobs can//ma lus thos bsam rin cen gling bgrod shog/'jam dpal rdo rje kun mkhyen tsong kha pa'//mkhyen dpyod rnam par rab yangs mtshon rnon pos//srid zhi'i 'ching rgya gcod pa'i ring lugs mchog/dkar phyogs zla ba'i cha ltar 'phel bar shog/legs bshad nor bu skyug la 'chad pa'i mgrin/zhes rab rnam thos bu yis nyer btsir bas//'bad med char 'beb yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal//mi shes dbul phongs sel ba'i gan mdzoX can//mkhas dbang bishwa ga rma'i lag nyal gyis//

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedalog rtogs nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis 'char/ /rdar byed dngos stobs rigs lam rtsod pa'i mtshon/ /thub bstan ni ru ka yi 'dod pa 'jo/ /ngo mtshang tsān+ta'i srad bu la brgyus pa/ /gtsug lag be+eḍūr ser po spel ba'i phreng / /legs bshad rtsom la spobs pa dge ba can/ /blo bsal bstan 'dzin dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog /tshe ring gnam gyi she mong dpung pa yis/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin (22ba)khyon la dbang bsgyur ba/ /chos ldan rgyal po'i chab srid mnga' thang kun/ /nyi mor byed pa'i 'od ltar gsal gyur cig /gzhung mang brgal brtag dpyad la nyer bzod pa/ /lung rigs smra ba mnga' ris 'dus pa'i grwa /dge 'dun tshogs brgyas thos bsam dpal be'u'i/ /ri mo snying kha'i ngos su 'dzin gyur cig /mthun rkyen sor mos legs bskul dge ba'i rgyud/ /rtag tu snyan par sgrog pa'i glu dbyangs can/ /rab 'byams smra ba dge legs dpal ldan sogs/ /phan par sgrub kun ches dkar 'brasasmin shog /kun gsal sgeg mo'i dkyus ring mig zur gyis/ /pha mtha' rnyed min bgrang yas 'gro ba rnams/ /tshe rab kun tu phan bde'i srog 'tsho ba/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i bdud rtsis sbran gyur cig/ces 'on mda' sa sa khang rtse'i mnga' ris grwa tshang gi kun dga' ra bar lnga pa no mon khang dge legs dpal ldan gyis byams mgon gyi sku brnyan bzhengs dus 'dod gsol gyi smon lam shis brjod dang bcas pa zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes de phral du bris/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i snying po dpag bsam ljon/ /dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba dbang gi rgyal/ /bsam pa'i re skong yid bzhin nor bu'i char/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar yol ba med gyur cig /phul byung legs byas rlung gis nyer drangs pa/ /tshe dpal stobs 'byor ma la ya yi dri/ /rgud pa'i tsha gdung ma lus rab bcom nas/ /phan (23na tha de'i grib sil dag la ngal gsor shog /mngon par mtho rten rin chen them skas la/ /'dzegs nas nges par legs pa'i khang bzang du/ /rab zhugs rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub pa/ /dpal ldan stobs bcu'i go 'phang thob par shog /legs byas rgya mtshor bying ba gdeng can dbang / /med byung 'dod rgu ma lus 'byung ba'i gter/ /lus sems bde ba'i —27—
