rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dpal la longs spyod pa/ /legs ldan dpyid kyi dpal mo bzhad par shog /dag pa don dam mkha' khyab spros bral yang / /kun rdzob rten cing 'brel 'byung slu med pas/ /bla ma yi dam chos srung byin rlabs kyis/ /smon pa'i gnas kun ji bzhin 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di yang yar klungs sde pa bying pa bde legs kyi skul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes cho 'phrul mchod pa'i dus kyi thun mtshams kyi nges pa zhig la bris/ /bgrang yas mnyam med sangs rgyas de'i gsung chos/ /dge 'dun tshangs dbang drag po gtsug na zla/ /lha mi'i drang srong bden tshigs grub rnams kyis/ /smon pa'i gos bu ji bzhin smin par mdzod//sna mang grags pa'i rnga gsang cher sgrog pa/ /ngo mtshar sprul pa'i dbyar gyi lang tsho'i 'bras/ /'jam mnyen phang phung g.yo ba'i rgyal mtshan mchog /skye srid zlos gar g.yur du za bar shog /gzhan phan 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i 'phrul/ /legs byas gan mdzod rnams la dbang bsgyur nas/ /yang srid sa (23ba spros sa 'dab brgya grol byed pa/ /bdag gzhan don gyi snying po lhun grub shog /mos ldan gdul bya'i dga' ston rab 'phel ba/ /phun sum tsho gos pa'i dbang phyug yon tan mthus/ /zhi ba'i tshul las nyer 'gong 'phrin las kyi/ /kun+da'i phon po'i do shal mdzes gyur cig /phul byung rnam par dkar ba'i kun gsal ngos/ /ngo mtshar skyes rabs dbang po'i gzhu ris can/ /'dren byed yul gyi bdud rtsi bla na med/ /yid kyi mos ngor 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces sprul sku grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sku skye myur byon gyi smon lam tshigs bcad 'di ni byams pa kun bzang gis nan gis skul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes bris/ /rgyal kun gsang gsum 'khor lo'i gan mdzod nas/ /rmad byung 'phrin las yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /ris med 'gro ba kun la 'jug pa'i rdzas/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar yol ba med gyur cig /khyad par sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung / /bde chen gar gyi nyams ldan bka' brgyad lha/ /stong nyid snying rje'i rang gzugs gnam zhal yum/ /rtsa gsum thugs rje'i dngos grub char ltar phob/ /skyabs —28

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanamachog kun 'dus mkhyen brtse nus pa'i sman/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi ro nus legs bsdebs pas/ /mkha' mnyam rigs drug sems can ma lus pa'i/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyi nad kun drungs 'byin shog /rang bde dman lam zhi ba'i chu 'dzin kun/ /rab dkar lhag bsam rlung (24na tshe gis mthar bskrad nas/ /tsho gos gnyis mkha' la sku gsum nyi mor byed/ don gnyis snang ba rgyas pa' dpal thob shog /dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi bden pa'i mthus/ /rnam dkar 'phrin las spel ba'i rig pa 'dzin/ /'di phyi'i legs tshogs mdun ma lhun grub par/ /smon lam yongs 'du g.yur du za gyur cig /re zhing bltos byar gyur pa'i skye bo kun/ /srid zhi'i rgya mtsho che las rab bsgral nas/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang rin chen gling du bgrod gyur cig /smon lam tshigs bcad ma 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes 'bri gung pa'i chos brgyud 'dzin pa rig 'dzin dkon mchog 'phrin las kyis skul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes bris/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mnga' bdag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de'i gsung snying po zhi ba chags bral chos/ /rig grol gnyis ldan 'phags mchog dge 'dun sogs/ /mchog gsum dam pa'i ma rmad thugs rje'i mthus/ /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun tsong kha pa'i/ /gdung 'tshob 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud rim byon las/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan rnam sprul nyi mor byed/ /thub bstan mkha' la myur du 'char bar shog /rgyal ba'i ring lugs 'chi med dga' tshal gyi/ /ngo mtshar rgyan mchog skyes rabs yongs 'du'i phreng / /skal ldan gdul byar dbang phyug yon tan gyi/ /'brasabazang dga' ston (24bskol phyir chad med shog /rgyal bstan 'o ma'i chu gter bsrubs pa las/ /dga' ldan bshad sgrub rtsi bcud snying po'i gter/ /thos bsam sgom pas longs spyod 'dus tshogis kyi/ /rnam dag smon pa'i re ba skong bar shog /mched zla gnyis med yid bzhin dbang gi nor/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mor bkod pa ji bzhin du/ /som nyi dbul phong sel ba'i yang srid kyi/ /rnam 'phrul 'dod rgu'i char chen 'bebs par shog /lhag bsam cha shas rdzogs pa zla ba'i gzugs/ /rnyog bral 'phrin las rdzing bur rab bsal bas/ /phan dang bde skyid ut+pal dkar po'i tshal/ /dga' ston bsu ba'i 'dzum —29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rlabs ba shā da par shog /rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogasarnams kyis/ /dpal ldan bla ma skal bzang skye dgu yi/ /mgon du byon pa'i bden tshig 'grub gyur cig /ces ba so sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang chos kyi dbang phyug bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i sprul sku gsal por byon pa'i bden tshigs tu brjod pa 'di ni dam pa gang de'i slob bu dad ldan 'ga' zhig gis bskul bar brten za hor gyi bzhes dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar/ /chu gter rlabs ltar dus las yol med pa/ /mchog gsum thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs dang / /grangs med rnam dkar dge tshogs bskrun pa sogs/ /ma lus sdomes pa dpyid kyi mngal yangs por/ /thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i za ma (25na〉me /legs byas dang ma'i lang tsho dar bab 'bras/ /grangs med sprul sku'i myu gu g.yur za ba/ /ring min dus su smin pa'i dga' ston stsol/ /rnam par legasasmon 'dod don mkha' dbyings la/ /rgyal dang de sras nyan rang slob mar bcas/ /kun gyi bden tshigasabasil byin mkhan po yi/ /ngal gso'i ga bur gzegs ma spro bar shog /ces sems dpa' chen po ngag dbang phun tshogs kyi sprul pa'i sku myur du byon pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni gang de'i gdan sa pa tre bo sku skye dang dbon po rgya mtsho gnyis kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /'chi med grub pa pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /'khor lo'i bdag nyid bde gshegs kun 'dus lha/ /bdud dpung tshar gcod chos srung gter bdag tshogs/ /med byung byin rlabs thugs rje'i mthu dpung gis/ /rig 'dzin pad+ma dbang gi grong khyer mchog /dpal 'byor 'phrin las rab tu rgyas pa'i sder/ /nyer 'tshes glags lta'i bar chod kun choms la/ /'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing brtan par mdzod/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i bdud rtsi gzegs ma yis/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams yongs bkrus nas/ /phun tsho gos lang tsho'i gzugs skur rab rgyas pas/ /dus kun bde ba'i dpal la spyod gyur cig /thugs rje'i 'od stong 'bar ba gtan gyi skyabs/ /bden tshig smod pa grub pa'i drang (25ba〉sbong dang / /mthu ldan srung ma sde brgyad tshogs rnams kyis/ /deng 'dir 'dod pa'i re ba skong bar mdzod/ /bkra —30

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanashis zla ba rgyas pa yar gyi ngor/ /bza' skar 'phrod kyi dge ba'i dus bzang por/ /rtsa gsum thugs rje bskul ba'i bden tshigs dbyangs/ /rab snyan yid kyi 'dod pa 'jo bar shog /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid rig 'dzin chen po zur 'jam dbyangs rkun dga'i mtshan can gzhan snang du bsnyun pa'i tshul bstan par bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i bden tshig gi smon lam 'di ni za hor gyi brnyes sgo gsum mi 'da' ba'i bcad rgya'i skabs thun mtshams kyi nges pa zhig la sbyar ba'o/ /thub pa'i bstan la 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i ngag /smra ba'i dbang phyug pir gyi sgyu dra'i gar/ /legs bshad ri mo rnam bkra'i dam chos kyi/ /dus kun dge zhing shis der gsol ba 'debs/ /legs par bshad pa chos 'khor 'dus sde'i gling / /gang gi dam pa'i chos kyi khri chen por/ /mgon khyod yun du 'tsho zhing rab bzhes nas/ /chos tshul rgyun chad med par spel gyur cig /legs bshad cho me 'khor gling pa'i slob dpon ngag dbang bkra shis kyi gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs dang bcas pa 'di ni grwa dmangs gnyer pa rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'o/ /blo chen mchog gis skal bzang 'gro ba kun/ /byang grol lam du 'khrid pa'i grags snyan rnga/ /srid (36na)zher brdung ba 'jam dpal snying po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung / /ngag gi dbang phyug rgyal ba gnyis pa de'i/ /ring lugs 'dzin pa'i dbyig gi blo gros mar/ /rnam dkar bzang po'i 'phrin las nor bu'i dpya/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can kun tu khyab der 'dud/ /mi phyed dang bas snying nas gsol 'debs na/ /gnas skabs 'gal rkyen nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing / /mthar thug bla na med pa'i ye shes sa/ /mngon du 'gyur ba'i dge legs 'thob par shog /ces pa yang ja sag thu hong tha'i jis bskul ba ltar ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o/ /khyab bdag gar gyi dbang phyug 'chi med lha/ /tshe mtha' rnam par yas pa'i mgon mchog gi /ma rmad thugs rje'i ga bur gzegs ma yis/ /'chi bdag tsha gdung g.yul las rgyal bar mdzod/ /bsod nams dpung gis nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khyen/ /mngon par 'degs la rnam dpyod brtson pa —31 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)can/ /nam yang g.yo med ri dbang lhun po ltar/ /rab brtan rdo rje'i mched slar grub gyur cig /srid mun nyi zlas rab bcil bde skyid kyi/ /'od snang bskal bar yongs gsal de srid du/ khrims gnyis gdug dkar 'dzin pa mi yi dbang / /'gyur med g.yung drung khri la brtan gyur cig /ces phyag mdzod sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan gyi brtan bzhugs tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni ngam ring mkhan po chos rje lo (26bsnin gyis don gnyer chen pos bskul ba'i ngor za har gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o/ /dkon mchog thugs rje chen po'i nam mkha' las/ /mngon mtho'i rten bzang rlung gi rgyal mtshan can/ /phan dang bde chen 'od mdangs yongs 'tsher ba'i/ /dga' ston mchog la myur du spyod par shog /khyad par gar gyi dbang phyug 'od dpag med/ /gnyis med sprul pa'i rnam rol pad dkar 'chang / /med byung byin rlabs shing rtas nyer drangs te/ /bde ba can du srid pa 'dzin par shog /zhing der skyes nas snang ba mtha' yas kyi/ /mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan mig gi bdud rtsir byas/ /drug bcu'i gsung dbyangs las 'ongs theg pa che'i/ /chos la thos bsam sgom pas spyod par shog /tshul des khyod thugs bla med ye shes che/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa mngon byas te/ /'gro rnams srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ba/ /chos kyi rgyal srid chen po thob par shog slu med skyabs kun dbang por legs bzhugs nas/ /bden pa'i tshigs tu rab brjod nus pa dang / /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras mthus/ /ji ltar smon pa de bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces dpon nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dag pa'i zhing du skye ba'i smon lam 'di ni hor chos rje ngag dbang phun tshogs spun gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ja'i sang sde pa'o/ /phyag na 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /legs (27na tshe lo byel bum pa bzang pos 'gro ba kun/ /bde ba'i ngal gsor dbungs phyung bcom ldan 'das/ /tshe mtha' yas de'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang / /mos ldan rnams kyi bsam pa rtse gcig tu/ /gdung shugs drag pos bden pa'i tshig brjod cing / /'dus sde'i tshogs kyis smon lam legs btabs pa/ /slu med rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i —32

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ sgon)mthus/ /ngag gi rang bzhin mtha' yas cho me kyi sgrar/ /sgrog la rab dbang yang dag dge ba'i bshes/ /legs tshogis la ma ston mi mthun las rgyal ba'i/ /mtshan ldan mgon khyod rtag tu zhabs brtan shog /seng ges bteg pa'i 'gyur med g.yung drung khri/ /rtag brtan sna tshogs rdo rjes legs mtshan par/ /lha dbang phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba yi/ /yang srid sprul pa'i zlos gar zhabs brtan shog /dkon mchog byin rlabs chos skyong srung ma'i mthu/ /drang srong rig 'dzin grub pa'i bden tshigs gis/ /'dod don a mra'i 'bras bzang yongs smin par/ /spyod pa'i bskal pa bzang po bdag gyur shog /ces de mo sprul sku ngag dbang dge legs rgyal mtshan gyi brtan bzhugs slo ka lnga tsam yod pa zhig dgos zhes de mo dbon po phun tshogs dang nor bu spun gnyis kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar/ /mthong thos dran dang reg pas phan bde'i dpal/ /stsol mdzad sangs rgyas de gsung slob mar bcas/(27ba)/bden tshig grub pa lha dang drang srong sogs/ /phul byung thugs rje nus par ldan pa'i mthus/ /rab yangs nor 'dzin khyon la bsod nams kyis/ /mngon par dbang bskur chos srid legasatshogs rnams/ /dkar cha'i zla ba lta bur 'phel mdzad pa/ /mi dbang mchog de zhabs pad brtan par shog /rtsa gsum byin rlabs rlung gis bgegs rigs rnams/ /legs bsal chos ldan rgyal po'i nyi 'od kyis/ /mnga' 'bangs bde skyid pad dkar rab bzhad nas/ /phun tshogs dga' ston sbrang rtsir spyod gyur cig /ces phyag mdzod sa skyong bsod nams chos 'phel gyi brtan bzhugs tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan phun tshogs 'dod rgu'i 'byung gnas chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sa ba ru bzhi spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o/ /na ma ārla dzi ta nā then shrīḥsi d+dhi ku rba n+tu/ byams brtse'i sa bon yongs su smin pa las/ /gser sbyangs zhun ma'i 'khri shing g.yur za ba/ /ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i me tog rnam bkra'i gzugs/ /ston mdzad rgyal tshab mi pham mgon po kye/ /'char nub spangs pa thugs rje'i rta ljang 'od/ /nye ring dang bral —33—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)skye rgu'i pad tshal la/ /'jug pa ma 'dris mdza' ba'i dam bca' gang / /nam yang gtong ba min de phan bde'i dpyid/ /de phyir zla 'od bad rtsa gangs kyi ris/ /bsgrun par nus min rab dkar lhag bsam gyis/ /nyer drangs smon lam btab pa'i 'bras (28na〉sdu kun/ /re ba don ldan mdzod cig lha yi lha/ /tshe ring gnam gyi brgyud 'dzin sa skyong rigs/ /rin cen mig gi mtshan pa'i hong tha'i ji mtho ris rten gyi them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /gnas ngan 'bras bur spyod las thar bar shog /mi khom gnas spangs dal 'byor bco brgyad kyi/ /dam chos bsgrub pa'i rten bzang lus rnyed de/ /sdig lhung dri ma drungs nas phyung byed pa/ /dge tshogs gaṅka'i rgyun la spyod par shog /khyad par sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i rten gyi mchog /mtho ris yon tan bdun dang ldan pa'i lus/ /'grub byed rgyu las slu med 'byung ba'i 'bras/ /mi 'dzad khur gyis dud pa'i dpal thob shog /bde bar rlom yang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal can/ /srid pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las/ /thabs shes gzings kyis bsgral te gtan bde'i lam/ /thar pa'i rin chen gling du bgrod par shog /pha mtha' rnyed min drin gyis bskyangs pa 'a ma/ /'gro rnams 'dor bar ma bzod theg pa che'i/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i gom gcig gis//rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar bgrod shog /zab yangs rgyud sde'i ma dros mtsho chen las/ /smin byed dbang gi chu bo rnam pa bzhi/ /bgrod byed rim gnyis rgya mtshor legs 'khyil bas/ /lnga ldan ye shes rlabs phreng yol med shog /zung 'jug yid bzhin nor bu'i za ma tog /sku bzhi bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis rab gtams nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'chi ba med pa'i srog /legs grub rigs kun bdag por (28ba tshe sngur bar shog /dri med rnam par smon pa dbang gi rgyal/ /mchog gsum klu dbang gdengs gar mdzes pa'i nor/ /'dod pa'i re ba ma lus skong ba yis/ /dga' ston mchog desanor 'dzin khyab gyur cig /ces rgyal ba'i bstan pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa can nor 'dzin skyong ba khar kha er ti na hong tha'i ji lnga pa'i lam du gyur pa'i tshe smon lam tshigs bcad bcu skor zhig dgos zhes rgyal khang rtse sprul sku blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar//—34

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedapra shī ta n+t+ra pha la pra 'i dhi / a tsa ni dzā su 'a / swā kā na wa ti swā ma tsa /tri ra sne na so rgyu ku sa /rab dkar yid dge'i smon lam 'bras/ /'di dang gtan gyi bde ba sa /smin pa'i re ba don ldan par/ /mdzod cig slu med dkon mchog gsum/(29na)/zhes pa 'di ni stag lung phyag mdzod ngag dbang bzang sbyin gyi dad rten du nged kyi 'dra 'bag stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub kyi phyag bris ma zhig 'dug pa'i rgyab ngos su smon lam tshigs bcad lag bris ma dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sug bris byas pa yin no/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan sangs rgyas de gsung chos/ /slob mar bcas pa'i dkon mchog rin chen gsum/ /slu med skyabs mgon thugs rje'i byin rlabs mthus/ /rnam dag smon pa'i re 'bras don ldan mdzod/ /dngos lhor gyis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa yi/ /rnam dkar dge tshogs sa bon legasasmin pas/ /bsod nams mtho ris tshal du mngon mtho'i rten/ /rab brtan yongs 'du ri khri shing g.yur zar shog /las nyen ma dag dkar mi na lcags kyi khams/ /thar lam gser du bsgyur byed dge ba'i rtsis/ /gtan bde zad mi shes pa'i 'byor pa'i mdzod/ /longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang thob par shog /srid zhi'i mtha' bral sems skyed chu gter dbus/ /phyin drug spyod pa'i gdengs ka g.yo ba'i rtser/ /rnam mkhyen nor bu'i gcod pan 'bar ba'i gzis/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun 'dod 'jo'i byed por shog /bsod nams dpung pas sa chen chos bzhin du/ /skyong ba'i mdzad bzang 'phel zhing rab brtan pa/ /grangs ring skye bar mngon mtho nges legs rten/ /legs brgyud (29ba)bla med byang chub thob par shog /ces pa 'di yang sa skyong phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i tshe dbus gtsang du ser tshogs khag brgyad btsugs skabs 'dus tshogs rnams kyi zhal 'don du za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /bde ba can du gar dbang 'od mtshan 'bar/ /gru 'dzin rtse na 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang / /sirtse'i rgya mtshor rigs 'dzin pad+ma 'byung / /sku gsum dbyer med 'phrin las ga sgo'i rgyun/ /—33—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)phyag na rdor 'dzin nor bu'i mtshan 'chang ba'i/ /lhag bsam skal ldan shing rtas legs drags pas/ /sgrib gnyis 'bras bu'i dri ma kun bkrus nas/ /phan bde'i rgyal mtshan tog gi 'od 'bar shog /rgyal dang de sras sku gsung thugs rten bzhedas/ /'gro rnams bde bar bgrod byed zam pa btsugs/ /thos grol yi ge drug pa'i 'phrin las kyi/ /dge des mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog /gnas skabs dam chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'phel/ /mthar thug ka dag rig pa'i rang zhal mthong / /lhun grub bya rtsol bral ba'i thugs rje yis/ /kun gyi 'dod 'jo'i yid bzhin dbang por shog /de ltar sgo gsum gus 'dud mchod sprin spro/ /sdig bshags dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / /cho rtse 'khor bskor bskul rtag bzhugs gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba ma lus rnam mkhyen rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di ni sprul sku phyag rdor nor bus bka' 'gyur dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi gser sku bzhengs shing / ma ṇi dung (30na)phyur nyi shu rtsa lnga btsugs pa/ lcags zam mang po'i zhig gso grub pa'i dge ba rdzogs byang du spel ba'i ched du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o/ /byin rlabs 'od du 'bar ba thugs rje'i gzis/ /'khor mun gdung ba 'phrog pa rin chen gsum/ /bden tshigs char gyis bskrun pa'i legs byas kyis/ /gser gyi myu gu yongs smin 'brasabazang stsol/ /blo gros rnam par rab yangs mngal nang du/ /bsod nams gser sgong sbrums pa'i gdong bzhi pa/ /zla ba rgya mtsho las zhabrung ji bzhin du/ /yon tan bdun dang ldan pa'i srid 'dzin shog /khrims gnyis 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi rtse gcig tu/ /smon lam rnam dag stobs kyis mtshams sbyar ba/ /ji bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i skal bzang la/ /mos ldan slob mar bcas pas spyod gyur cig /ces cha dkar no mon khang blo gros rgya mtsho'i sprul sku myur byon gyi smon lam tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni dge slong 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /phyag na 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /legs 'khyil pad+ma rā ga'i bum bzang gis/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i dpal ster bcom ldan 'das/ /bde ldan zhing gi mgon des dge legs stsol/ /—36

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanangag gi 'dod 'jo dbang phyug yon to gyis/ /blo bsal skal bzang re skong yongs 'dzin mchog /rgya mtsho'i gos can nyi zla'i 'od snang gis/ /(30bskos la ba de srid rdo rje ltar brtan shog /bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba 'jigs med kyi/ /brtse ldan byams pa'i go cha rab bgo ba/ /thub bstan bshad grub lang tsho rgyas pa'i sde/ /rje btsun bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /dus dgra'i dbang po smra mkhas 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /thugs gsang dpal gyi be'u dga' ba'i nyams/ /'dzum ldan tshemasadakar mu tig 'phreng mdzes pa'i/ /bshes gnyen dam pa nam yang g.yo med shog /sangs rgyas de gsung sras bcas byin rlabs dang / /slu med phun tshogs rten 'brel sgo 'phar phye/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i smon lam mtshams sbyor gyis/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu yongs su smin gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni grwa bsam dar ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis ched gnyer du bskul ba ltar za ho skru bzhes po tā lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /oṃ a tha la sirnyi ra stu/ bde ldan ngo mtshar bkod pa'i zhing gi mgon/ /gar dbang mdzod spu'i 'od zer stong 'bar gzis/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi mun 'joms 'bor lo gsum/ /mi gshig rdo rje'i dpal du 'grub gyur cig /ngag la sa ba'i chos kyi bkra shis dung / /mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus na g.yas 'khyil ba/ /dbang phyug blo bsal skal bzang rgya mtsho la/ /theg gsum chos 'khor bskor phyir zhabs brtan shog /ches cher snyigs pa'i dus glang po'i dgrar/ /'jigs med lhag bsam gdong lnga'i nga ro'i rgyud/ /zhi bde'i mtshon gyis (31na gi zhom min go cha mchog /thub bstan gangs ri'i spo la brtan par shog /las rlung dag pa dhu ti'i lam yangs por/ /a lha mi gshigs srog gi ka ba can//'ja' lus rdo rje'i lang tsho rgyas pa' sde/ grub pa'i skal ba bzang por g.yo med shog /dus gsum ma la ya yi nags klung nas/ /bsags pa'i dge tshogs ga skru ra yi dris/ /dkar min 'bras bu'i tsha gdung kun bcil nas/ /'gro rnams bde ba'i ngal gsor spyod par shog /chos srid zung du 'brel ba'i nyi zla yi/ /rdzogs ldan snang ba gsar pa 'od po ches/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin ma lus kun khyab —37

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)pas/ /'di dang gtan gyi legs tshogs lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di ni dus zhabs pa chen po grwa phug pa dpal gyi seng ge'i sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang snyan grags dpal bzang po'i gsung gis nye bar bskul ba la rten nas za hor gyi brnyes g.yar khral tsam du bris/ /kun bzang snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje'i gar/ /si rgyu'i rgya mtshor legs bsgyur pad+ma 'byung / /rtsa gsum dkon mchog 'dus pa'i bdag nyid kyis/ /phun tshogs smon lam 'bras bu grub par mdzod/ /gangs can lha cig sras po ti mug btsan/ /sna tshogs rang sar grol ba'i yang srid can/ /theg mchog chos kyi snyan grags srid gsum du/ /khyab mdzad sprul sku'i zla tshes mngon gyur shog /bka' phyag zung du 'jug pa'i chu bo kun/ /mkhyen (31ba)dpyod 'phrin las rgya mtsho cher babs pas/ /yid srubs g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde/ /slar yang zhing 'dir srid pa 'dzin par shog /dkon mchog gsum dngos rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal/ /'jig rten gsum mgon kyu ra rin po che/ /phun tsho gos bstan pa rin chen spel ba'i phyir/ /mchog sprul gdul byar mngon sum bstan du gsol/ /snyigs mar spyod pa lus med glags lta'i dpung / /nag po bdud kyi sdodang bcas pa rnams/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon dus kyi dgrar/ /'jam dpal drag po khros pas 'jom par shog /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung dang / /drang srong rig 'dzin grub pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /smon lam btab pa'i 'bras bu ji bzhin du/ /lhun grub skal ba bzang por bdag gyur cig /ces dpal 'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung las sku 'khrung shing rgyal dbang pad+ma'i gdung 'tshob rigs 'dzin chen po chos kyi grags pa 'phrin las rnam par rgyal ba dbang po'i sde'i mchog gi sprul sku myur byon gyi smon lam tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni/ dam pa gang gi nyam 'bring ba phyag mdzod dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos po tā lar sbyar ba'o/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rdo rje thod phreng rtsal/ /brtse chen snying po'i zhabs dang tshar pa rje/ dgyes mdzad rdo rje gur mgon gdong bzhi pa/ /(32na)bla ma yi dam srung mar bcas pa dgongs/ 'khor —38

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenalo'i mgon po gdul bya'i bsod nams kyi/ /zhing du rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /mkha' spyod 'chi med dga' ma'i gnas chen nas/ /zhing 'dir srid pa 'dzin par bdag byin rlobs/ khyad par snyan rgyud zab mo slob bshad chos/ kha'u brag rdzong ba ched srol ring lugs mchog /spel phyir ma dag 'gro ba mi 'dren na/ /thugs skyed dam bca' nyams par mi 'gyur ram/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dbang mo'i zhing khams dang / /zang mdog dpal gyi ri bo'i pho brang na/ /bde chen klong du bzhugs las bskul ba'i glu/ /gsol 'debs dbyangs su 'tsher la nyer dgongs kye/ /gangs can zhing 'dir sprul sku myur byon ste/ /spyi dang bye brag thub bstan rab spel nas/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i re ba legs skong ba//yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po 'grub par shog /'a zha'i rigs las khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan zhing 'di'i sku'i bkod pa nye bar bsdus pa'i dus 'phags pa mched kyi drung du sprul sku 'byon mi 'byon gyi brtag pa lan gnyis su byas par mkha' spyod sogs dag pa'i zhing las bod yul 'dir 'byon pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo phye ba zhig ma byung rung nyang ston rigs sngags 'chang ba mkhas grub chen po sman lung pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i gsung gis nan gyis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes 'phags pa mched dang / skyon chen po'i (32ba〉glu rten bsod nams dpal 'bar gyi drung du gsol ba btab te sbyar ba'o/ /gsung ngag chad med dbang bzhi'i mtho ris chab/ /rnam dpyod blo gros sto bar dog min kyang / /skal bzang rgya chen gdul bya'i mtshor 'bab pa/ /drang srong rdo rje 'dzin par gsol ba 'debs/ /a snya mi shigs 'chi med rdo rje'i srog grub pa'i rigs 'dzin sku ru bshes gnyen khyod/ /bzhengs te stug po bkod pa'i mgon po bzhin/ /'khor ba mtha' can de srid bzhugs gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas mang por blta ba'i blo mig rnam par yangs pa'i glang bu ba dgra 'dul tshe ring gis rgyun khyer nyung ngu zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes rang byung 'phags pa mched kyi drung du dge sbyor gyi lugs su gnas pa'i thun mtshams zhig la bris pa sirnyi ra stu/ /—39

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba yi/ /tshe mtha' yas dang yid bzhin 'khor lo so gos/ /'chi med 'dod pa'i 'bras ster dpag bsam dbang / /lha mchog rnams kyis bsam don lhun grub mdzod/ /lus ngag yid gsum smin nus dbang gi chu/ /rgyun chad med pas blo gsal skal bzang rnams/ /tshim byed rnam dkar 'phrin las rgya mtsho yi/ /rlabs phreng yol ba med par zhabs brtan shog /rab brtan sna tshogs rdo rje g.yung drung gis/ /legs mdzes seng ges bteg pa'i khri chen por/ /bskal pa (33na)bye bar mi g.yo rtag bzhugs nas/ /'gro kun phan bde'i dpal la spyod par shog /ces pa 'di ni lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi bya 'dabs su 'khod pa'i tshes bcu ma ṇi dmigs brtse ma bsnyen gnas ma khag bzhis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes bris/ /su ste pra dzā saḥ mchog gsum rin chen thugs rje chen po yis/ /'di phyi'i gtan 'dun 'grub pa'i bsod nams kyi/ /ma rmad 'byor ba rab tu rgyas gyur ba'i/ /phun tshogs dga' ston dpal la spyod gyur cig /bsod na mos dbang gi lcags kyus brtan g.yo rnams/ /bkug dang lhan cig dbyangs can ngag gi dpyid/ /ngag la 'jug pa'i skal bzang nyer 'grub pa/ /smra ba kun las rgyal ba'i dpal thob shog /smon lam tshigs bcad 'di ni mon mkhar rngam sras gling pa 'byor rgyas dang bsod dbang spun gnyis kyis ngag 'don zhig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sug bris su bgyis pa'o/ /dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /dngos grub 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma mchog /ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes/ /blo bsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i mgon khyod kyis/ /bdag sogs deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /rmad byung thugs rje chen pos rjes bzung ste/ /'di dang gtan gyi 'dun ma ma lus pa/ /bsam pa ji bzhin lhun gyis 'grub par shog /(33ba〉sred gsum bdag mo 'o dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /stobs 'phrog nag po lha chen gdong bzhi sogs/ /bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i chos srung tsho gis rnams kyis/ /'phrin las sgrub la g.yel ba med gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang de mo dbon po phun tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o//—40

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ 'deblo gsal skal bzang 'phrin las thos bsam dang / /sgom pa'i tshul la gegs byed mun pa'i dpung / /dkon mchog thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis/ /rab gsal brtson 'grus snang ba 'bar gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang khar kha khu 'du lu chu khur gyi sku skye blo bzang 'phrin las kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /snang srid zil gnon 'chi med sku brnyes pa/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa skyon thod phreng rtsal/ /'dzam bu gling na che ba'i rigs sngags kyi/ /brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang pos dge legs stsol/ /chos kun gang shar dbyings nas rang grol ba/ /lhun grub 'od lnga'i mdangs gsal drag po rtsal/ /thugs rje'i snang ba kun khyab rdo rje 'dzin/ /bskal brgyar mi 'gyur chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ /na bzang thugs kyi yang tig rdzogs pa che/ /'jig med smra la spobs pa'i dbang po mchog /ngo mtshar rnam sprul sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam rgyal brtan gyur cig /zhi khro rab stims kun 'dus bka' brgyad lha/ /nges gsang snying po'i bka' skyong ral (34na〉ltig ma/ /zab don gter srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /'gal rkyen kun gsol mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs/ /nyan rang byang sems theg pa'i rtsa ba brtan/ /kri yog sde gsum sdong po yal 'dab 'phel/ /rnam gsum yo ga'i 'bras bu khur dud pa/ /theg mchog yongs 'du'i dbang po rgyal gyur cig /ces nged rang yun du 'tsho ba dang chos rje rdzogs chen pa kun bzang rnam rgyal gyi sku skye'i brtan bzhugs dang bcas pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes dbon po chos dbyings lhun grub kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ban ngag dbang 'phrin las so/ /su sti/ 'chi med tshe dbang grub pa'i rigs 'dzin mthus/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /bstan 'gro'i dpyid du bskal brgyar 'tsho bzhes nas/ /chos 'khor rgyun mi 'chad par skor gyur cig /sde bzhi'i 'phrin las sgo 'phar legs phye nas/ /phun tshogs bde skyid rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyi 'phreng / /nam yang yol ba med pa'i nor 'dzin bdag /rdo rje lta bur mi 'gyur brtan par shog / 41—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ces nged rang dang phyag mdzod 'phrin las rgya mtsho yun ring 'tsho ba'i bden tshigs spel ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni lha ldan spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes bris/ /ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba'i ring lugs mchog /bkra shis thugs gsang dpal gyi be'u sa /legs gtams dpal ldan grub brgyud gtsug gi rgyan/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor (34ba/skabs pad brtan gyur cig /chos kun phyag rgya wo por rgyas 'debs pa'i/ /nges don chos kyi nyi ma 'od po ches/ /skal ldan pad+ma'i 'dab brgya rnam grol ba/ /mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas ltar brtan shog /gangs can grub rigs smra ba yongs kyi sde'i/ /gtsug rgyan rje btsun stag lung rin po che/ /dpal ldan phag gru'i ring lugs dri med pa/ /spel phyir bskal brgyar chos 'khor skor du gsol/ /zhes rje btsun stag lung pa chen po ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub kyi brtan bzhugs 'di ni dbu ma phyag mdzod ngag dbang bzang sbyin gyis bskul ba'i mtshams sbyar las za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o/ /ngag gi dbang phyug yigs byas phun tshogs pa/ /rnam rol bsod nams bye ba'i myu gu las/ /ngo mtshar 'bras bu dpal gyi yongs dud pa/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i nyer 'tshor brtan gyur cig /phun tsho gos rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las rnams/ /chad pa med pa'i ga bla'i chu bo'i rgyun/ /lus can bsod nams zhing gi rgya mtsho cher/ /legs 'bab skal ba bzang po 'gyur bar shog /bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog rin chen gsum/ /drang srong rig 'dzin bden tshigs grub rnams kyis/ /mgon khyed mi 'gyur chos kyi khri chen por/ /rdo rje lta bur brtan par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes sems dpa' chen po ngag dbang phun tshogs kyi sprul sku phun tshogs bsod nams dpal bzang gi brtan bzhugs shig (35na) dgosazhes tre bo sku skye nam mkha' bsam grub kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /rnam 'dren de gsung sras dang slob mar bcas/ /skyabs mchog mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od stong gis/ /ngag dbang dge legs rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por/ /bdud bzhi mun pa'i smag rus zhi bar mdzod/ /ngag gi dbang phyug dge tsho gis rgya mtsho'i gter/ /legs pa'i lam ston cho ge kyi rgyal mtshan 42

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenache/ /med byung dam pa'i chos kyi khri chen por/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje lta bur brtan par shog /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs dang / /drang srong rigs 'dzin tshogs kyi bden pa'i tshigs// khrims ldan 'dus tshogs smon lam rnam dag mthus/ /ji ltar bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par shog /de mo sprul sku ngag dbang dge legs rgyal mtshan gyi brtan bzhugs 'di yang de mo dbon po phun tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /bkod legs rin chen phras mdzes gser sbyangs/ /cod pan phul bas thub bstan gnas pa'i bar/ /zas gtsang sras kyi sku gzugs dbang gi rgyal/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir brtan par bzhugasagyur cig /sgo gsum 'bad dang mthun rkyen byed po rnams/ /'di dang gtan gyi mdun ma lhun 'grub cing / /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun srid zhi'i rgya mtsho las/ /bsgral te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen thob shog/rgya hor bod sogs yangs pa'i 'jig rten du/ /(35ba 〉 khrug rtsod nad mug dus kyi chad pa kun/ /rab zhi chos dang srid kyi bde skyid la/ /rdzogs ldan bzhin du spyod pa'i skal bzang shog /ces lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du jo bo rin po che shākya mu nir dbu rgyan gsar bzos lcags glang hor zla bdun pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin phul skabs dpal ldan stod rgyud grwa tshang pa rnams smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor mdzad bcug pa'i tshe zhal 'don du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /phun tshogs mkhyen brtse nus pa ga sgo'i chus/ /snyigs mar spyod pa'i nyes tshogis kun zhakhyud par/ /thugs rje'i mthu dpung lhag par che ba'i mgon/ /rnam 'dren sman gyi bla ma mched brgyad kyis/ /ngag dbang 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa yi/ /rgya chen chos srid zung du 'jug pa'i bstan/ /dbyar mtsho lta bur legs 'phel byed po mchog /bskal brgyar g.yo med smon lam 'grub byin rlobs/ /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par bod yul 'dir/ /nad rims 'khrug rtsod mu ge la sogs pa/ /dus kyi chad pa ma lus kun zhi nas/ /phan bde'i dga' ston dpal la spyod gyur cig /ces sman bla'i mdo chog gi smon lam 'jug tu 'dogs rgyu'i 'dod gsol 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes gnyal sde drug mkhan po blo bzang —43

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dar rgyas kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /nor 'dzin lto bar lha mi'i snod bcud kyi/ /phun tshogs ngo mtshar bkod pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i (36na〉dul snyed rgyal ba dang / /de sras slob mar bcas la legs phul bas/ /thub pa'i ring lugs chos spyod rnam bcu dang / /'jig rten khams su bde skyid dga' ston 'phel/ khyad par kun mkhyen blo bzang grags pa yi/ /chos srid bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog /dge tshogs tshul 'di sgrub la gtogs so cog /gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis lhun grub cing / /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /bla med byang chub thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang 'phrul snang du bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing mchog dam par dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal zung ldan gsar bzos chu stag hor zla bcu pa'i tshes nyi shu'i nyin phul skabs skyor lung gsung sgrogs pa rnams smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor spel bcug pa'i dus kyi zhal 'don du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /mchog gsum 'chi med gar dbang snang mtha' yas/ /byin rlabs 'od gzis ngag dbang blo gsal ba/ /skal bzang dga' ba'i bshes gnyen rdo rje'i khrir/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor zhabs pad brtan par shog /ces pa 'di yang chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sa ba spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor bris/ /tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam 'dren dang / /lung dang ma rga par rtogs pa'i chos dkon mchog /tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad slob mar bcas pa yi/ /thugs rje'i rlung gi shing rtas rab drangs te/ /med byung thub bstan (36ba〉lha yi lam yangs par/ /ngo mtshar sprul sku'i zla ba yongs tshes pa'i/ /zlos gar lhar bcas skye dgu'i kun+da'i tshal/ /'dzum pa'i re ba myur du skong bar shog /blo bsal skal bzang gdul byar dam pa'i chos/ /zung 'jug dbang gi rgyal po'i za ma tog /thos bsam sgom gsum rgyal mtshan rtser bsgreng ba'i/ /yang srid bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tshor 'dzin par shog /ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal grags pa'i lha/ /lus can bsod nams zhing du ngur mig gar/ /rnam par yongs bsgyur ma smad mdzad pa'i dpyid/ /lhun grub 'phrin las chad med 'jug gyur cig /mchog gsum mthu dang 44

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ 6)rten 'brel bslu ba med/ /mos ldan 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis rtse gcig tu/ /snying nas gsol ba btab pa'i bden tshig gis/ /re ba'i 'bras bu dus su smin gyur cig /ces don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhan chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i gnas tshul thos 'phral du sprul sku'i yang srid myur du 'dzin pa'i gsol 'debs su za hor gyi bzhes dang ba'i yid kyi sbyar ba'o/ /rnam 'dren de gsung slob mar bcas pa yi/ /med byung thugs rje'i rten 'brel slu med mthus/ /blo bzang dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal mtshan che'i/ /yang srid sprul pa'i zlos gar myur ston shog /dag pa'i zhing dang gnas ngan 'khor ba'i grong / /'phags chen dam par bde sdug yongs (37na)bral phyir/ /sngon gyi thugs bskyed ji bzhin gangs can 'dir/ /mchog sprul zla ba gsar pa myur tshes shog /smon 'jug sems kyi tshangs pa'i ral klung nas/ /g.yin phan 'phrin las chad med gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /gangasacan ra ba dkar po'i rgya mtsho cher/ /nam yang chad pa med par 'bab gyur cig /rang don nyi zla'i 'od kyis phyed min pa'i/ /ma 'dris 'gro la rjes brtse'i ba kū la/ /lhag bsam lus phra'i sbrang chang dngar po yis/ /sprul pa'i 'dabs rgya yongs su grol gyur cig /phyag drug legs ldan ma lha'i yis can sogs/ /zhwa ser mnabs pa'i bstan srung tshogs rnams kyis/ /'dod don 'bras su yongs su legs legs smin pa'i/ /re ba ji bzhin lhun grub 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i sprul pa'i zlos gar zhing 'dir myur du phebs pa'i smon lam gyi rim pa 'di ni chos sde chen po bkra shis lhun po spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ /stsol mdzad 'dod don re skong yid bzhin nor/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos rtsa rgyud bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so sgo gsum byin gyis rlomes/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho chen po las/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus nye bar rab drangs nas/ /(37ba tha de —45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)chen thar pa'i grong khyer nyams dga' bar/ /bdag sogs 'gro kun 'jug par byin gyis rlobs/ /sdug sngal gsum gyis mnar ba'i sems can la/ /da lta bdag gis phan thog ma nus pas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang tshe 'di la/ /thob pa'i smon lam ci btab 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang er ti ni tha yan phyis snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa la thag nye ring med cing go gsal ba zhig dgos zhes bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /ngag dbang blo gros mchog gyur 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /brtse chen bzang po'i byams ldan pad dkar 'chang / /mthu stobs rgya mtsho ltar zab gsang ba'i bdag /rigs gsum kun gyi ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsol btab byin rlabs bdag snying la/ /zhugs nas tshe 'di'i bar chad kun zhi zhing / /phyi ma nges legs gtan 'dun lhun grub pa'i/ /smon lam gang btab 'bras bu smin par shog /ces pa 'di yang mgon khang bla ma dpal 'byor rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o/ /mkhyen brtse nus mnga' sangs rgyas bdag nyid chos/ rigs grol dpal ldan dge 'dun byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag sogs 'gro kun srid zhi'i rgud pa las/ /legs thar 'di phyi'i gtan 'dun lhun grub shog /smon lam tshigs su bcad pa 'di (38na ji bde chen yangs pa can gyi spyan snga ga me nyi ma bro tshal ba'i dus ngag 'don du dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes bris/ /dpal ldan ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /mchog gsum kun 'dus ngo bor yid ches pas/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs na 'di phyi'i don/ /bsam pa ji bzhin 'grub par bdag byin rlobs/ /'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes lha sa ba byams rgyab gzhi dgas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes bris/ /zhi khro rab 'byams 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor kun/ /spro zhing sdud mdzad rigs brgya'i khyab bdag mchog /dpal ldan chos kyi 'byor pa'i 'phrin las rnams/ /rab rgyas byed po rdo rje slob dpon che/ /chos sku ka nas ye dag dbyings chen por/ /rang grol kun tu bzang po'i klong nyid nas/ /lhun grub gzugs sku'i bkod par yongs bzhengs te/ /ngo mtshar sprul pa'i rol gar myur bstan gsol/ /—46

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedasangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma thod phreng gi /dri med ring lugs nor bu bsam 'phel dbang / /spel bar gnyag ban sngon dus thugs skyed pa/ /dus las yol med zhing 'dir mngon gyur shog /rnga yab dpal rir rdo rje rgyal tshab tu/ /legs bzhugs dag pa'i rnam ci rol ngo mtshar yang / /bka' gter bshad sgrub gna' bo'i ring lugs mchoge /spel ba'i gdul bya gangs can ljongs 'dir mang / (3sdeb)/de phyir yar klung shel gyi brag phug tu/ /mgon khyod pad 'byung rdo rje 'chang gi skur/ /rig pa'i rtsal du rdzogs par 'dzab bsnyen gyis/ khyud bskul rten 'brel bsgrig don ltar 'grub shog /rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa dang / /sgrub sde brgyad sogs yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /ma ning dregs pa'i sde dpon srung ma yis/ /'gal rkyen kun gsol mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs/ /pad+ma rgyal po'i zhal bzhesaji bzhin du/ /gsol ba gang btab lhun gyis legs 'grub par/ /rtsa gsum kun khrus mtsho skyes rdo rje yis/ /rmad byung byin rlabs snying la 'jug gyur cig /ces dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol gyi sprul pa'i zla tshes 'char ba'i gsol 'debs 'di ni smon sgom 'brang rgyas pa dge slong ngag dbang don grub yar klung shel gyi brag phug tu bla ma dam pa gang de'i sprul sku myur phebs kyi rten 'brel sgrig pa'i gsol 'debs bgyid tshe kha 'don du za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs so/ /rdo rje'i sku brnyes tshe dang ye shes rnams/ /dpag med lhun sa grub pa'i mgon po dang / /sangasargyas kun gyi 'phrin las gcig bsdus ma/ /bcom ldan yid bzhin 'khor lo'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ngag dbang 'jam mgon lha yis rjes bzung ba/ /blo ldan skal bzang rgya mtsho'i dge ba'i bshes/ /'chi bdag g.yul (39na〉pas rgyal te yun ring du/ /gnas shing rnam dkar 'phrin las rgyal gyur cig /bdud sde'i dpung la 'jig pa med pa yi/ /mthu stobs btsan po'i go cha rab bgos nas/ /thub bstan lang tsho rgyas pa sde chen por/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur brtan par bzhugs/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i rten cing 'brel 'byung mthus/ /zla ba'i ma ma las 'ongs 'chi med kyi/ /ma smad bdud rtsi —47

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)thugs kyi za ma tog /legs par 'khyil ba'i dga' ston 'grub par shog /khrims ldan mang du thosapa'i 'dus tshogs kyis/ /rab dkar lhag bsam dag pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser/ /rtse gcig smon lam btab pa yid bzhin nor/ /bsam pa'i 'bras bu dus su smin par shog /'khor ba'i yang srid skye zhing skye ba sto /dam pa'i mgon mchog khyod kyis rjes bzung zhing / /'di dang gtan gyi 'dun ma ma lus kun//tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i re ba skong bar shog /mtho ris bdun dang ldan pa'i rten bzang por/ /mngon par mtho dang nges par legs pa'i lam/ /rab tu sgrub pas phan dang bde ba yi/ /med byung ro brgya'i dpal la spyod par shog /sgrib bral don gnyis ldan pa sangs rgyas dang / /spangs rtogs yon tan 'byung gnas dam pa'i chos/ /rig dang grol ba'i dpal ldan dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog mthu yis bden tshigs 'grub gyur cig /dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje dang / /bstan pa skyong bar zhal bzhes srung ma'i tshogs/ /khyad par 'dod khams dbang phyug (39ba'i sa mthu yis/ /'dod pa'i don rnams lhun gyi 'grub par shog /gser mngal can dang mgrin sngon pad dkar mig /'chi med dbang po drang srong rig pa 'dzin/ /bden tshigs grub pa rnams kyis dus kun tu/ /phun sum tsho gos pa'i bkra shis spel bar shog /thub pa'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin dge 'dun sde/ /bsnyen bkur phu dud sgrub pa'i sbyin pa'i bdag /'gro ba'i bde skyid ma lus 'phel ba yi/ /bde legs chen pos nor 'dzin kun khyab shog /ces brtan bzhugs dang smon lam gnyis ka tshang ba blo ka bcu tsam zhig dgos zhes nyung ja khang pa rnams kyis nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o/ /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lung rtogs bstan pa 'dzin cing rab spel bar/ /rmad byung 'phrin las bzang po'i bshes gnyen mchog /gang de'i mched grogs zung dang bcas pa rnams/ /deng nas byang chub snying po ma thob bar/ /drin can bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral zhing / /rtag tu dgyes pa chen pos rjes bzung te/ /dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis tshims par shog /dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi byin rlabs dang / /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i mthus/ /ji ltar smon lam —48

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung lhags bam dang po/ zhenabatab pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /re ba ji bzhin yongs su smin gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang skyid shod chos rje'i sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyi gsung gi bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /dam pa rtag dkar rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab tu/ /rin (40na༄na cod pan bcings te dbang bskur bas/ /dga' ldan zhing khams zhing gi gtsor bzhedas te/ /theg chen sna'i/sgra legs sgrog mi pham pas/ /byams pa chen po rdo rje rtse brgya'i mtshon/ /gdengs pas bdud bzhi'i nus stobs lha min mo'i/ /mngal lhung rnam par rgyal ba'i dge tshogs dar/ /srid pa'i rtse mor 'phyar ba'i mgon po kye/ /phun tsho gos rin cen dngul dkar zhun ma'i khams/ /rnam rgyal sor mo'i 'phrul ldan nai pa las/ /'dren byed bdud rtsir bskrun pa'i sku rnyan gyis/ /byams mgon mngon sum blta ba'i skal bzang bzhin/ /bsod nams tshogs 'di mtha' 'khob hor yul du/ /thub bstan legs spel rab 'byams chos kyi rgyal/ /nam mkha' rgya mtsho mngon par mtho ba'i rten/ /rim brgyud myur du kun mkhyen myur thob shog /dge ba'i bshes gnyen ngag dbang dpal 'byor dang / /gung thang dka' bcu blo bzang la sogs pa/ /tshul 'dir sgo gsum 'bad par gtogs so cog /yang srid kun tu khyod kyis rjes 'dzin shog /ji srid nyi zla'i 'od kyis gling bzhi'i mun/ /sel ba de srid lus can bsod nams kyi/ /zhing du rje btsun sku gzugs yid bzhin nor/ /g.yo med rdo rje lta bur brtan par shog /dga' ldan bstan pa spyi dang khyad par du/ /bkra shis sgo mang yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun mngon mtho nges legs kyi/ /phan bde'i bdud rtsir rtag tu spyod gyur cig /ces sngags pa no mon khang rab 'byams (40ba)chos rje nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i phyi rten du dngul dkar las grub pa'i byams pa'i sku thog tshad ma sgo mang slob dpon zur pa ngag dbang dpal 'byor dang gung thang dka' bcu blo bzang sogs kyis do dam byas nas bzhengs pa'i dus brtan bzhugs 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs so/ /—49

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /gnyis su med pa bcom ldan sman gyi bla/ /bde bar gshegs pa brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnams/ /thogs med brtse bas 'dir spyon nye bar dgongs/ /thugs rje'i mthu yis srid zhi'i 'jigs pa sel/ /mtshan thos tsam gyis ga song las skyob pa'i/ /bcom ldan bde bar gshegs pa mched brgyad la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro ba'i lus ngag yid gsum dge tshogs la/ khams dang dbang po blo gros dang mtshams par/ /bkod de skal bzang gdul bya rgya mtsho'i mgon/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam bkra'i me tog ches dngar bdug spos dang / /nyi zla ltar gsal mar me byug pa'i dri/ /phun tshogs ro brgya'i dpal ldan lha bshos sogs/ /lusang ga yid kyis ji ltar zhi nus ban 'bul/ /thog med dus nas da lta'i bar dag tu/ /bsags pa'i mi dge bcu yi las ngan rnams/ /sngar byas la 'gyod phyis nas sdam sems kyi/ /bsam pa thag pas snying nas mthol lo bshags/ /sangs rgyas srasabacas nyan rang so skye yis/ /bsags dang (41na gi sog bzhin gsog par yongs 'gyur pa'i/ /mtha' klas rnam dkar dge ba'i tsho gos rnams la/ /legs smon dga' zhing spro bas rjes yi rang / /mchog dman skye rgu'i mos pa dang mtshams par/ /rdo rje theg nas so so thar pa'i bar/ /chags bral rlabs chen spyod dang 'dod yon rnams/ /lam byed chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bkul/ /snyigs ma lnga yi cher sbags gdul dka' 'gro'i/ /tshul la brnag nus zhus med snying stobs kyis/ /chos dbyings zhi ba'i klong du mi mnal bar/ /bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol/ /mdor na mtha' bral bsod nams tshogs chen nas/ /gzan changs gcig tsam byin pa yan chad kyi/ /bdag gis bsags pa'i dge 'bras mkha' mnyam gyi/ /ma rgan don du sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di'ang ju rig thu dbon po ngag dbang blo gros dang 'ol dga' ba 'bri lung pa blo bzang dpal 'byor gnyis kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs so/ /ngo mtshar bde ldan zhing na tshe mtha' yas/ /'chi med pad+ma thod phreng rnam rol can/ /mchog —50

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenagasum rgya mtsho'i ngo bor lhun grub pa'i/ /byin rlabs nus mthu'i nyin byed 'od dpung gis/ /yid srubs nag po'i mun pa mthar bskrad de/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /bskal brgyar rdo rjes mtshan pa'i khri chen por/ /rab brtan phan bde'i snang ba ches dkar shog /dkar (41ba)cha yar la ches 'phel bkra shis tshes/ /mkha' la gza' skar bzang po'i 'phrod kyi dge /gnas 'dir rgyu rkyen 'dzoms pa'i rten 'byung gis/ /bsam pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub gyur cig /ces brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni ra sa 'phrul snang gi ru bzhi spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /phun tshogs bkod legs bde chen zhing gi gtso/ /gar dbang tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med/ /rnam par rgyal ma yid bzhin 'khor lo sogs/ /'chi med grub pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis skyong / /sra brtan rdo rjes legs bsdams rin chen khri/ /mi 'gyur tshe yi g.yung drung 'khyil ba'i steng / /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho dpal/ /bskal brgyar brtan bzhugs chos 'khor skor gyur cig /'jigs med dus dgra'i dbang po khros pa'i gar/ /bdud bzhi g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo'i rtags/ /mi shigs ting 'dzin go cha cher bgos nas/ /bgrang yas skye rgu'i gnyen du brtan gyur cig /thub bstan lang tsho dar ba'i nag klung sder/ /zhwa ser 'chang ba'i ring lugs yongs 'du'i ljon/ /thos bsam ro brgya'i 'bras bu smin pa'i ched/ /zhing 'dir rdo rje lta bur g.yo med shog /a lha mi 'gyur ka ba zlo ti'i lam/ /las rlung dag pa'i 'chi med rdo rje'i skur/ /bzhengs nas 'og min zhing gi mgon po ltar/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i dpal du bzhugs gyur cig /dga' ldan phyogs las rnam rgyal pho brang che'i/ /bstan srid 'phrin las dbyar gyi rgya mtsho ltar/ /ches cher rgyas (42nasgo dzad nor 'dzin skyong ba'i dbang / /rdo rje lta bur mi 'gyur zhabs brtan shog /bka' khrims gser sbyang zhun ma'i gnya' shing ri/ /'dzam gling yongs kyi phrag par rab lci zhing / /'bangs rnams rdzogs ldan dga' ston la spyod pa/ /mang bkur rgyal po'i rnam thar 'dzin par shog /mkhyen brtse nus ldan sangs rgyas bden gnyis chos/ /—51 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rig grol yon tan gter gyur dge 'dun ste/ /mchog gsum byin rlabs bstan srung rgya mtsho'i mthus/ /smon pa ji bzhin 'grub par bdag byin rlobs/ /rgyu 'bras rten 'byung nam yang mi bslu zhing / /drang srong rig 'dzin grub pa'i bden tshig dang / khrims ldan 'dus pas smon lam rtse gcig tu/ /btab pa'i 'dod don re ba yongs skong shog /ces pa 'di'ang chos 'bor rgyal nas chos rje legs bshad gling pa blo bzang chos 'dzin gyis don gnyer chen pos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /bde ldan zhing gi 'dab stong zi'u 'brur/ /'chi med bdud rtsi bzhu blug 'khyil ba'i khyuḥ/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i mgon po'i bzhin lag skur/ /rnam rol thugs rje'i mthu dpung deng 'dir skyed/ /mgrin pa'i pad mtshor ngag dbang dbyangs can lhas/ /spobs pa dge ba'i rgyud mangs 'brol ba las//blo bsal skal bzang dga' byed legs bshad gter/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can gzhi 'dir rab brtan shog /'gro la rjes chags snying rjes srid pa la/ /'jigs med lhag bsam (42ba〉btsan po'i go cha can/ /yid grub dpung gis nam yang gzhom min par/ /rdo rje'i khri la rtag tu bzhugs gyur cig /thub dbang bstan pa'i lang tsho dar drag pa/ /rgya chen thos pa'i sde snod sdong po'i rtser/ /bslab gsum sgom pa'i 'bras bu g.yur za ba/ /bskal ba rgya mtshor chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ /snying dbus dri za'i bu mo'i 'jo sgeg la/ /dga' bas legs 'byud 'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i 'od/ /rnam dpyod dpung gi rgyan du rab 'tsher ba/ /bshes gnyen dam pa g.yo med brtan gyur cig /bshad sgrub dar zhing rgyas pa'i khrims ldan gling / /cha dkar brag dbar gsung rab 'chad nyan grwa/ /rnam gsum 'khor lo'i bya ba dbyar dus kyi/ /chu gter bzhin du ches cher 'phel bar shog /slu med rten 'brel chu 'dzin lang long 'khrigs/ /'dus sde'i bden tshigs dbyar rnga ldir ba las/ /byin rlabs char gyi 'dod don snye ma rnams/ /rab smin phan bde'i 'bras bzang dud gyur cig /ces brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'ji ni cha dkar brag dbar ba grwa tshang bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling pa'i slob dpon ngag dbang nor bus —52

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ smyon)thog drangs grwa dmangs rnams kyis don gnyer chen pos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /sngon byon da lta bzhugs dang 'byon gyur gyi/ /sangs rgyas byang sems slob mar bcas rnamasadagongs/ /bdag sogs ma rgan sems can thams cad kun/ /mkhyen brtses nyer gzig ba'i nusamathus (43na/spyobs tu gsol/ /deng nas tshe rabs kun tu mtho ris kyi/ /yon tan bdun dang ldan nga/'i rten thob cing / /rgyal sras spyod pas tshogs nga gnyas myur rdzogs nas/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen par bdag gyur cig /dge ba phra mo nas bzung lus srog kyang / /gzhan phyir gtong ba'i bar gyi rnam dkar kun/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i skye rgu rnams/ /bla med byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di'ang ra kho chos rjes bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /'chi med grub pa mgon po 'od mtha' yas/ /tshe dbang rig 'dzin skur bstan pad+ma 'byung / /mchog gsum kun 'dus thugs rje dpag bsam ljon/ /phan bde'i 'bras bzang byin chen char du phobs/ /'gro ba'i lus ngag yid gsum smin byed dbang / /chad med blo yi bum bzang legs bkang sde/ /rgya chen mtsho ltar gting zab grol byed lam/ /ston mdzad rdo rje'i slob dpon zhabs brtan shog /dus kyi dgra bor 'jigs med 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /mthu stobs btsan po'i go char 'khor 'das kyi/ /phyag rgya ma lus zil gnon brtul zhugs rtsal/ /lhun grub gdod ma'i ngo bor rtag bzhugs sa sol/ /thub bstan yang snying 'od gsal rdo rje'i theg /thos bsam sgom pa'i lang tsho dar drag pas/ /skal ldan skye rgu'i 'dod 'jo yongs 'dus sde/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i khri la brtan par shog /yis srubasal khros gtum drag rab 'bar ba/ /che mchog 'dus pa'i bla med rdo rje rtsal/ /(43bsgos kun gang shar ka nas dag pa'i dbyings/ /rang sar grol ba'i mgon khyod rtag brtan shog /bka' gter rigs 'dzin rtsa rgyud bla ma dang / /yi dam bka' brgyad zhi khro rgya mtsho'i lha/ /ma ning ral gcig ma sogs chos srung gis/ /smon pa'i re ba kun 'grub 'phrin las mdzod/ /rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo —53

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)thod phreng rtsal/ /bdag sogs snying gi ze'u 'brur rtag bzhugs nas/ /mchog thun dngos grub gang bsam lhun grub pa/ /nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i skal bzang stsol/ /zhes brtan bzhugs tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni sham+bha lar chos rje sngags 'chang brag lha ba don grub rgyal mtshan gyis ched gnyer du bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi btsun pa gang shar rang grol gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /zhi khro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gtso/ /mchog gsum kun 'dus pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /mgon khyod phul byung thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang / /rten 'brel slu med bden pa chen po'i mthus/ /phyag na mthu stobs rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon/ /rnon pos yis srubs sde las rab rgyal yang / /nor bu pad+ma'i 'phrin las 'od dkar gyis/ /'gro la phan bde'i snang ba ster mkhas mchog /slad mar ma dag zhing gi gdul bya'i tshogs/ /'dren phyir ngo mtshar sprul sku'i srid 'dzin par/ /glags lta'i bdud sdes 'tshe bar mi nus zhing / /bzhed pa'i re ba ji bzhin lhun grub shog /lhag bsam ga d+ma'i yab cig las 'ongs pa/ /gzhan (44na)phan 'phrin las chad med chu bo'i rgyun/ /ris med skye rgu'i phan bde rgya mtsho cher/ /'bab pa'i byed po khyod ba ched 'grub gyur cig /rtsa gsum byin rlabs lha dang drang srong sogs/ /bden tshig grub pa rnams kyi smon lam dang / /zab gter chos srung rgya mtsho'i nus mthu yis/ /bsam pa'i re ba lhun gyis 'grub gyur cig /ces sprul sku phyag rdor nor bu'i sprul sku myur 'byon gyi bden tshigs brjod pa'i smon lam 'di ni bla ma mnga' bdag pa dang skyi ston pa gnyis kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /'chi med mchog sbyin tshe mtha' yas pa'i mgon/ /mgon des legs bsngags bcom ldan rnam par rgyal/ /rgyal yum sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zhabs/ /zhabs pad dus kun bsten no dngos grub stsol/ /ngag la dbyangs can nyer zhugs smra ba'i dbang / grub pa'i blo gros rtsal ldan khrims kyis btsun/ /bzang po'i lhag bsam rgya chen ris med 'gror/ /dbyar mtsho lta bur skyed mdzad zhabs—54

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhinabartan shog /'jigs bral spobs pas bu ram shing pa'i gzhung / /dka' gnad 'khrul med go rim ji bzhin du/ /cha shas gang ba'i zla ltar gsal mdzad pa/ /rje btsun bla ma bskal brgyar bzhugs gyur cig /thub pas legs bstan bden gnyis zung 'jug mdas/ /bdag 'dzin laṅka rnam gnon 'phong skyen tsho'i/ /rtser son g.yin phan snying stobs dga' byed lha/ /sdebazhi'i mchod sbyin spel phyir g.yo med (44ba〉rdog /'jam dpal rdo rje'i zhal lung dbyangs 'dun skur/ /blangs pas dpyod ldan dga' ba bskyed pa'i bshes/ /bstan dang yid can kun gyi dpung gnyen shog /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i khri la rtag bzhugs gsol/ /zhwa ser cod paṇa 'chang ba'i chos srid kyi/ /bstan pa'i gdug dkar gcig gisanor 'dzin khyon/ /kun khyab phan bde'i grib ma nyer bsil bar/ /lus can mtha' dag ngal gsor spyod gyur cig /dkon mchog sri zhun gzugs can snying po'i grogs/ /dad dang gtong bas mgon med zas sbyin rigs/ /dpa' mdzangs rtul phod sa skyong sbyin pa'i bdag /tshe dpal stobs 'byor rnam thos bur 'gran shog /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par rgya nag hor/ /bod yul kun tu sdig to'i 'bras zhi zhing / /rdzogs ldan dus kyi 'dzam gling skye rgu dang / /bsod nams mnyam por thob pa'i skal bzang shog /mkhyen brtse nus mnga' 'gog lam gnyis dang ldan/ /rig grol rgyan mdzes slu med gtan gyi skyabs/ /lha dang drang srong bden tshig la dbang mthus/ /legs btab smon pa'i don kun lhun grub shog /ces ring por 'tsho ba'i shis brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang 'brel bar rgya bod hor gsum gyi skya ser gang gi ngag 'don du byed kyang ris bcad kyi kha gsal med pa'i bstan 'gro spyi bye brag gi smon lam bcas pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes lugs zung gi tshul la blta ba'i rnam dpyod kyi mig yangs pa dpon mkha' 'gro blo bzang bstan skyong gi dang ba'i yid kyis don gnyer chen pos bskul ba'i ngor shā kya'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos thun (45na sti5tshams kyi nges pa zhig la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /mtshan tsam rna bar thos pa'i bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /snying dbus 'chi med dga' ba g.yas 'khyil —55

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dung / /srid zhi'i phun tshogs 'bod byed sgra snyan lha/ /tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor los shis pa stsal/ /ngag dbang 'jam mgon mkhyen pa'i blo gros rgyas/ /bzang po'i brtse chen phyag na pad ma'i gar/ /rgya mtsho ltar zab nus ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /'og min zhing gi mgon ltar brtan gyur cig /zhwa ser 'chang ba'i chos srid 'phrin las rgyun/ /rgya chen nam mkha'i mtha' klas de snyed du/ /dbyar mtsho lta bur rab spel nor 'dzin dbang / /'gyur med g.yung drung gzhi la brtan gyur cig /ces brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni gong dkar rdzong sdod sgom bu ba dang ge ra ba thun mong gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba'o/ /mi 'gyur dad pa'i g.yung drung khams las grub/ 51gas drag smon lam gdan khri'i gzugs su shar/ /bden tshigs rdo rje'i ri bo bkra ba'i steng / /rje btsun bla ma bskal brgyar bzhugs gyur cig /chos dbyings 'gyur ba med pa gnas lugs gshis/ /chos can rgyu 'bras rten 'brel mi bslu zhing / /dkon mchog thugs ji'i mthu dpung 'dzad med kyis/ /deng 'dir smon lam ci btab lhun 'grub shog /rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam chos srung tshogs/ /drang srong rigs 'dzin tshig la dbang ba dang / /dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i lhas/ /(45ba 'dod don yongs 'du'i 'bras bzang smin par mdzod/ /ces bden tshigs brjod pa'i rim pa 'di ni sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po'i gsung bzhin chos spe chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs spyi sos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs so/ /mdzod spu'i zer 'phreng las 'phros bdud rtsi yis/ /'chi med mchog sbyin spobs pa smon lam mthus/ /thos pas dpag med tshe yi mgon po zhes/ /bde ldan dag pa'i zhing gi gtso des skyongs/ /mchog gsum thugs rje mthu dpung bskul ba'i tshig /mi shigs rdo rje'i dbyangs su nyer blangs pas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas slob ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /don kun 'grub pa'i bden tshig brjod du gsol/ /ngag dbang 'jam mgon blo gros rtsal ldan gang / /bskal bzang 'dren mchog bzhi pa'i bstan pa la/ /—56

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanarnam gsum 'khor los ri mor bya ba'i ched/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can bzhin du brtan gyur cig /mkha' mnyam lus can yongs kyi mgon skyabs dang / /dpung gnyen gling las gud na mdzad pa g.yin/ /med phyir ches cher snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i/ /'gro rnams phan bder sbyor phyir rtag bzhugs gsol/ /'jig rten gsum mgon skyob pa'i ring lugs spyi/ /theg mchog dgongs pa yang zab rin chen gter/ /phun tshogs smin grol chad med ga thi'i rgyun/ /skal ldan chu gter slong du rtag babs shog /gangs can sa la'i 'khri shing nyer 'khrigs pa'i/ /ljongs 'di'i sdig to'i rnam par smin pa'i 'bras/ /mig gi lhag mar byas nas (46na)rdzogs ldan gyi/ /bde skyid dga' ston mchog la spyod par shog /ma rgan 'gro rnams sku gsum grong khyer du/ /'khrid la sa bcu'i lam mkhan cig pu ba/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob pa'i rgyur/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs bsngo/ /zhes yun du 'tsho ba'i rten 'byung gi tshigs bcad spyi sgos dang 'brel ba'i smon lam 'di ni 'bri gung zhabs drung sku 'bring po'i sprul sku rin po che dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang po'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /bka' brgyad sbug pa'i dka' bcu bsod nams phun tshogs dus las 'das pa'i dge bar rme ru gtsang khang sbug tu ldebs bris byas pa'i tshe smon lam tshigs bcad sogs/ /ma smad dad pa gnam sngon zhan ma'i mtshor/ /bgrang yas rgyal ba'i snang rtan zla ba'i gzugs/ /sor mo'i 'phrul dang gtong ba'i bdog pa yis/ /'dren byed bdud rtsir spel ba'i dge tshogs mthus/ /bsod nams phung por spungs pa'i ljon pa'i shing / /phun tshogs smon lam rtsa ba rab brtan gang / /mngon par mtho ba'i them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /nges legs thar pa'i grong du 'jug par shog /lus —57

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ngag yid gsum tshul 'dir nyer 'bad la/ /bcos min bsam pas sgrub par gtogos so cog /'di dang gtan du phan bde'i dga' ston la/ /longs su spyod pa'i bskal bzang thob par shog /ces bka' brgyad sbug pa'i dka' bcu bsod nams phun tshogs dus las 'das pa'i dge bar rmi ru gtsang khang sbug tu ldebs bris byas pa'i tshe smon lam tshigs bcad dgos tshul (46ba〉grang ba bzhin za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs so/ /snying dbus 'dab stong bzhad pa'i ge sar rtser/ /rab dkar dad pa'i zla rgyas gdan steng du/ /rang snang rig pa'i ngo bo dmar ser dhīḥ /yongs gyur zur phud lnga pa 'jo sgeg can/ /rgyun du khyod sku yid la 'bral med dang / /gzungs sngags zab mo kha rtan bgyis pa'i mthus/ /deng nas byang chub bar du mgon khyod kyis/ /mi 'bral rtag tu dge ba'i bshes mdzod cig /'chad rtsod rtsom la blo gros nyer rtul tshe/ /ngag la ngag dbang brtan pa'i 'khor lo khyod/ /zhugs nas smra ba'i spobs pa nyer thob ste/ /mkhas mang bye ba'i dbus na gzengs mthor shog /ces pa 'di yang gong nas lo tsā slob par mngags pa'i pa k+shi sa na phyag gis shes rab la phan pa'i kha rtan byed rgyu zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba'o/ /rgyal kun thugs rje'i bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i khams/ /med byung mtshan dpe'i sgyu 'phrul gar dbang lha/ /bde ldan mgon gyi mdzod spu'i zer 'phreng 'od/ /ches 'bar snang bas 'chi bdag mun thar mdzod/ /rnam par dpyod la 'jam dbyangs rab dga' ba'i/ /bshes gnyen ngur smrig gos kyis klubs pa'i gzugs/ /bskal brgyar skye rgu'i mig la mngon sum du/ /gzigs mor tshar du dngar ba'i dpal thob shog /sgra tshad bzo gso nang rig gnad gsang kun/ /ngag la smra ba'i dbang por lhun grub pas/ /legs bshad (47na ji za'i rgyud las drangs pa'i glu/ /skal ldan rna bar chad med len par shog /rang bzhin dag pa'i snang cha snying rje che/ /zung 'jug blo gros lhag bsam bzang po'i thugs/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can lte ba gangs can 'gro/ /'dren la skyed pa'i gzigs pa g.yel med shog /dri med —58

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenadapal ldan sa zhal dge gsum bstan/ /klog dang spong ba las kyi 'khor lo yis/ /'gro rnams bde chen sar bkri 'dus pa'i gling / /nyi zlas mun sel de srid rgyas par shog /legs byas zhing gyur chu gter chen po'i bcud/ /dge tshogs dzam+bha'i snye mas nyer 'thung ba'i/ /byed por gtogs kun srid zhi'i bde skyid gser/ /byang chub bar du spyod pa'i skal thob shog /bsod nams sa mchog ljon pa'i dri dngar por/ /'thul ba'i ngad kyis rang bde tsam min par/ /yid can mtha' dag sgrib gnyis tsha gdung tshogs/ /gzhil ste rnam pa thams cad mkhyen rgyur bsngo/ /ring por 'tsho ba'i smon lam tshigs su bcad pa zhig dgos zhes mda' dpon gzer chen pa rnam rgyal tshe ring gis don gnyer chen pos bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /ye shes bzhu blug gzhoms med srung 'khor dbus/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i gtso bo rigs kun bdag /bcom ldan mi skyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mthus/ /ci btab smon lam 'grub par bdag byin rlobs/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon lusang ga yid gsum la/ /smin byed dbang chu rin chen gdul bya'i tshogs/ /grol bzhi'i (47ba)blo chen bskal bzang rgya mtsho cher/ /'bebs mkhas rigs kun khyab bdag zhabs brtan shog /sngon nas chos longs lam du 'byer ba'i 'bras/ ma smad sprul sku'i mtshan dpe'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ dkyil 'khor bye ba phrag brgya'i mgon po sa /sgyur ba'i bka' drin nam yang g.yo med stsol/ /tha mal dris dben gsang gsum rdo rje'i khams/ /rlung sems sgyu lus 'od gsal dbyings dag las/ /zung 'jug kha sbyor bdun ldan skur bzhengs nas/ /'khor ba ma stong bar du bzhugs gyur cig /mya ngan med ljon gyis mtshan 'phags yul nas/ shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i mthas gtugs dbyigs 'dzin khyon/ /zhwa ser mnabs pa'i thos bsam don bsgoms bstan/ /nyi zlas mun sel de srid khyab par shog /mdo sdom ma tog gyur rgyud kyi rgyal/ /nges gsang 'i 'dus pa lung rtogs chos 'dzin pa/ /dge 'dun dkon mchog stod rgyud mkhas 'dus sde/ /dbyar gyi chu gter lta bur 'phel bar shog khyud lnga'i 'gro la rgyal kun thugs rje che/ /rab bzhugs mngon sum bde ba'i dpal thob cing / khyad par —59

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rgya hor gangs can yul ljongs su/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i rtse dga' dgod par shog /ces yun du 'tsho ba'i ched du bden tshig brjod pa'i tshigs 'di ni gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir rigs sngags 'chang ba rnams kyi gtsug na mngon par mtho ba dpal ldan stod rgyud grwa tshang gi zhal 'don du rgyud pa slob dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen byams pa bkra shis kyis don gnyer chen pos bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs (48na)dpal bzang ngo / /'dus pa gsang chen rten dang brten pa'i gtso/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bo 'jig rten dbang / /mchog gsum mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid can/ /'chi med dngos grub 'dod 'jo'i char stsol zhig /sde bzhi'i mtho ris chu bo'i 'phrin las rgyun/ /dga' ldan chos srid rgya mtshor 'khyil mdzad pas/ /gtsug lag lugs brgya'i rlabs phreng yol med can/ /nor 'dzin skyong ba rdo rje ltar brtan shog /gnam gyi she mong dpung pas rtsod pa'i dus/ /'khor los bsgyur rgyal mchad yon zung 'jug gi /bka' khrims gdugs dkar gcig gi grib bsil la/ /'bangs kun ngal gso'i bde skyid dpal thob shog /ces sa skyong phyag mdzod 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i brtan bzhugs tshigs bcad 'di ni stod rgyud 'dus sde'i zhal 'don du grwa tshang slob dpon bshes gnyen byams pa bkra shis kyis 'bad pas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /dpag med yon tan bkod pa'i zhing gi mgon/ /gzi brjid rgyal po'i brgya rtsa brgyad kyi mtshan/ /thos 'chang 'bri klog byed rnams mthar phyin tshe/ /'byung bar zhal 'tshes bden tshigs 'grub gyur cig/ngag dbang tshangs pa'i bu mo'i blo gros nor/ /rab thob skal bzang mgrin par 'jam dpal dbyangs//legs 'khyud dgyes zhal rtse dga' dgod pa can/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dpyid du brtan par shog /rnam gsum sgeganod snying po pha rol phyin/ /'dul mngon tshad mas gtan phab (44thos bsam gyi/ /sgro 'dogs legs gcod gsang phu ne'u thog /khrims ldan 'dus sde srid mthar rgyas gyur cig /gnam skos mchod yon khrims gnyis drang po'i thig /chos rgyal me long gdong gi rnam par thar/ /nor —60

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ 'da'adzin pa blo'i mngal khur rab lci ba'i/ /bde skyid nyi ma gung nas rtag 'char shog /'gro rnams rgyud lnga'i sar 'khyams rkang 'og tu/ /mdzad med phan bde'i gos khyab byed por dge /bsngos 'bras gro bzhin bye ba nyi shu pa'i/ /ngang tshul kun gyi mngon sum myong gyur cig /ces tshigs su bcad pa 'di ri gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir lung dang rig pa smra ba kun gyi 'byung khungs gcig pu ba gsang ne'u thog gi mkhan slob spyi tshogs kyis don gnyer chen pos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs so/ /rten 'brel bslu ba med pa rdo rje'i khrir/ /mchog gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid bshes gnyen tshul/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag med ngo bo mā /mi phyed dad pa'i yid kyis gus phyag 'tshal/ /dngos su bshams dang lha mi'i dpal 'byor rnams/ /yid kyis sprul pa'i bsod nams cher spungs pa/ /kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin nam mkha' mdzod/ /'dzad med sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye nas 'bul/ /rang rgyud nag po brtsegs pa'i sdig to'i dri/ /zhing mchag la brten 'gyod sdom kun tu spyod/ /mtho ris chu bos lan brgyar rab bkrus te/ /bcos min bsam pa thag pas snying nas bshags/ /thub rnams tshogs rdzogs byang sems phyin drug spyod/ (49na)/nyan rang bder gzhol skye phal ma lus pas/ /byas zin bsgrub 'gyur da lta spel bzhin pa'i/ /rnam dkar dge tshogs rgya mtshor bdag yi rang / /blo dang 'tshams par 'jug byed sa 'dzin dbang / /gtsug lag zla ba'i ma mar 'khyil ba las/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi chos kyi 'khor lo che/ /gangs can skal ldan gdul byar bskor bar bskul/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas kun gyis lus can rnams/ /byang chub mchog la sbyor bzhed dam bca'i khur/ /mgon khyod lhag bsam dpung pas rab bteg nas/ /bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /'di snang bde skyid yang srid lha mi'i rten/ /dman pa'i lam tsam don du gnyer min par/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i las dkar sa bon tshogs/ /kun mkhyen yongs 'du'i 'khri shing spel phyir bsngo/ /zhes brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad 'di ni stod lung chu lam sdings gsum spyi sos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi —61 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs so/ /'gro kun gtsug na bskal brgyar mi shigs pa'i/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung gcig gis 'chi bdag bdud/ /sdebacas las rgyal 'od mtshan ches 'bar ba/ /ma smad snang ba'i dga' ston rtag tu stsol/ /dpal ldan zhwa ser cod paṇa legs 'chang ba'i/ /chos srid bstan pa sa mchog ljon pa'i dri/ /lusacan bsod nams rlung gis nyer drangs te/ /rgud pa'i tsha gdung ma lus sel bar shog /'dzam gling spyi dang bye brag swā la'i nags/ /'phreng bar 'khrigs pa'i ljongs 'dir sdig rta'i 'bras/ /ming gi (49ba)lhag mar byas te sum rtsen pa'i/ /dga' ston mngon sum nyams su myong bar shog /ces pa 'di yang ra sa 'phrul snang ba'i ru bzhi spyi tshogs kyis brtan bzhugs sngon ma'i mjug tu 'thud rgyu 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba'o/ /oṃ su sti sid+dhi/ bye ba phrag brgya'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mgon/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i bka' gter bshad sgrub bstan/ /blo gros mchog gis spel ba'i rigs kun bdag /rdo rje'i slob dpon dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /thub gsung 'gyur ro cog gi rgyun 'dzin cing / /bstan bcos dgongs don 'grel la blo gros rgyas/ /khyad par theg mchog bstan pa'i srog gi shing / /rdo rje'i ngo bor grub la gsol ba 'debs/ /lha sras khri srong rnam sprul nyang ral pa/ /yang sprul chos kyi dbang phyug zab gter gyi/ /smin grol gdams pa'i bang mdzod sgo phye nas/ /gdul bya'i dga' ston spel la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bo thod phreng rtsal/ /'chi med rig 'dzin grub pa'i thugs rje yis/ /shes bya kun la blo gros rab yangs pa/ /mchog gi rdo rje 'dzin mkhas rtan gyur cig /bdud bzhi ka nas dag pa'i gzhes med khrir/ /lhun grub sra mkhregs g.yung drung 'khyil ba'i steng / /blo mchog rtsal gyi rig sngags brtul zhugs mthu/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje ltar brtan shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bdag nyid tshe dbang rtsal/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba kun 'dus bka' brgyad lha/ /ma ning sdod pon sum cur bcas pa'i mthus/ /smon pa'i re ba (50na thad bzhin 'grub byin rlobs/ /ma dag dri —62

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ smyon)sbyangs nges gsang gser zhun khams/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying por lhun grub pa/ /bka' gter bshad sgrub khrims ldan 'dus pa'i gling / /mtsho skyes bstan pa'i dbyid du rgyas gyur cig /ces rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang phyug nyang ston mkhas shing grub brnyes chen po sman lung pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni gong ra nges gsang rdo rje gling pa'i tshogs 'don du za hor gyi bzhes dang ba'i yid kyis sbyar ba'o/ /bsam pa'i re ba yongs skong tshe sbyin ma'i/ /zhabs sen brtan g.yo kun gyi btud bya'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun yum yid bzhin 'khor lo yi/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mthu dpung deng 'dir skyed/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang grags pa'i bstan/ /dzā ti'i dri ngad 'thul nas rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /spel mdzad mgon khyod lhar bcas skye rgu'i gtsug /rdo rje'i skyil krung g.yo med rtag brtan shog /rab dkar lhag bsam 'o mtsho las 'thon pa'i/ /dge tshogs zla ba gsar pa'i 'od snang gis/ /srid zhi'i gdung mun ma lus gzhil byas te/ /gtan bde'i mgrin sngon ral par mdzes gyur cig /ces brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni gong gser yig pa mchod rten bla ma dang dge slong chos 'phel gnyis kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang 'phrin las so/ /sras bcas rgyal kun gsang gsum rdo rje'i gar/ /tshe dpag med mgon ngo bor legs bzhengs nas/ /(50ba)ngag dbang lha mos mgrin 'byud blo gros kyi/ /skal bzang rgya mtsho'i dga' ston brtan par mdzod/ /rten 'brel slu med sna tshogs rdo rje'i khams/ /dkon mchog mthu yis bzhu blug gzhom med khrir/ /mgon khyod gangs can bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i dpyid/ /bskal brgyar chos 'khor skor phyir bzhugs gyur cig /nges par thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rje'i/ /bstan pa rnam gsum 'khor lo 'phel rgyas shing / /srid mthar g.yo med sgrub nus bdag rgyud la/ /mchog gsum thugs rje chen pos 'grub byin rlobs/ /zhes brtan bzhugs smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni zha lu gdan sa pa mkhas grub chen po rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi gsung gi bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi —63

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bsdos sug bris su byas so/ /su sti si d+dhi/ byams mgon mi yi srid bzung bu ston rje'i/ /bstan pa rin chen 'dzin la bsod nams dang / /ye shes tshogs gnyis mchog tu lhun grub pa/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i mgon por gsol ba 'debs/ /bde ldan zhing gi dbang phyug gar dbang lha'i/ /mdzod spu'i zer gyis 'chi bdag smag rum mun/ /mthar byas bskal brgyar 'tsho bzhes snang ba'i gter/ /'dzad med dga' ston bshes gnyen dam par stsol/ /ma byon rnam 'dren rab gsal kun mkhyen bu'i/ /rin cen rang bzhin rdo rjes mtshan pa'i khrir/ /bsod nams zhing mchog rigs kun khyab bdag tu/ /grub pa'i zlos gar g.yung drung ltar brtan shog /gur zhal gtsor gyur chos srung tsho gos spyi dang / khyad par nyi ma grub sogs bstan dgra rnams/(51na)/tshang gcod rnam thos sras dang rab brtan mas/ /mgon khyod bskal brgyar brtan pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇa chen rin cen grub/ /gang de'i rnam sprul 'khrul med mtshar chen zhabs/ /brgyud par bcas pa'i bstan 'dzin zha lu pa'i/ /ring lugs phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces zha lu mkhan chen mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub rgyal ba gnyis pa bu ston rin chen grub dang rdo rje 'chang mtshar pa chos rje'i bstan pa'i srog shing lta bur gyur pa'i tshul la bsams te za hor gyi bzhes lhag pa'i bsam pas sug bris su bgyis/ ta ta rba si rtsir sdu/ /ngag dbang lha yis rjes bzung blo gros gzings/ /skal bzang rgya mtshor 'jug la 'jigs med pas/ /yid srub mtshon gyis gzhom min go cha can/ /thub bstan lang tsho'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor ba'i mya ngam thang rgyu bgrang yas 'gron/ /bde bar dbug dbyung slad du mgon po khyod/ /mi shigs skyil krung gcig gis bskal pa brgyar/ /rdo rje'i khri la g.yo med bzhugs gyur cig /blo gros bzang po'i bag chags sad pa'i stod/ /bcu phrag rig gnas nor bus yongs gtams te/ /grags pa don ldan sngon byon lo paṇa gyi/ /rnam thar thams cad bdag gis 'dzin gyur cig /ces —64—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ smyon)gsol 'debs smon lam tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni nyang stod 'byong rtse lhun grub gling pa'i rig byed pa blo bzang nor bus bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban (51ba 'jam dbyangs so/ /mchog gsum thugs rje zhun mar 'khyil ba'i khams/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i gzugs su grub pa'i khrir/ /ngag dbang lha yis rjes bzung blo gros gter/ /skal bzang rgya mtsho'i mgon khyod zhabs brtan shog /thub bstan snying po kun mkhyen tsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs de 'dzin chos dang srid kyi bstan/ /rab rgyas yongs 'du'i grib mar bod 'bangs rnams/ /sgo gsum skyid pa'i ngal gso thob par shog /skye 'phags kun gyi bang bsags dang gsog 'gyur dge /che blo/dkar ga thi'i yab brjeg labs ba babs pa/ /phan bde'i yan lag brgyad ldan chu bo'i rgyun/ /rnam mkhyen ye shes rgya mtshor 'bab gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang sne'u rdzong sdod mnga' khul spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /mgrin par ngag dbang lha mo bzhugs pa'i blor/ /'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i skal bzang rab thob pas/ /lnga rig rgya mtshor tsan+d+ra go mi yi/ /rnam dpyod dpal kun 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /ba ched pa'i phyin drug pha mtha' rdzogs min par/ /'chi bdag bdud mun mdzod spu'i zer tsam gyis/ /mthar byed pad+ma gar dbang ngo bo ru /bzhengs te su la'i ljongs 'dir rtag bzhugs gsol/ /ma rgan skye rgu'i chos dkar sa gzhi la/ /rgyal kun thugs bskyed sa bon legs smin pa'i/ /sa lam yon tan mthar phyin yongs 'du'i ljon/ /byang chub snying po'i 'bras bus dud gyur cig /ces gsol 'debs smon lam zung 'brel gyi tshigs bcad 'di ni lho brag lha khang pa (52na)rdo rje nor bus nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /blo gsal skal bzang gdul bya'i tshogs rnams la/ /gar dbang chos kyi grags pa'i ring lugs mchog /spel phyir sprul sku'i zla tshes dbang po'i sde/ /mchog gsum mthu yi rdo rje ltar brtan shog /spre(15

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ces pa 'di ni dge 'phel dbon pos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /bde ldan ngo mtshar bkod pa'i zhing khams na/ /lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku tshe mtha' yas/ /dran pas srid zhi'i gdung sel mgon po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dag pa'i zhing du drongs/ /pad rā ga lhun po dus mtha mes klub pa'i/ /rta mgrin mi bzad gsang gsum 'khor lo'i gar/ /byang chub bar du sgrub thabs lhur len na/ /yi srubs na ga po'i sde las rgyal bar mdzod/ /lha chen mahā de ba'i thugs kyi sras/ /bstan srung gnod sbyin beg tse lcam dral la/ /rtag tu gsol mchod bsten na zhi rgyasadabang / /mngon spyod 'phrin las lhun rgyas 'grub par mdzod/ /ces khar kha sku skye blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgyas bskul ba'i ngor za har gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /ngag dbang 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa'i bstan/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas rgya cher spel ba la/ /mtsho byung lha mos rgyud mangs mgrin pa nas/ /legs 'brol bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag la smra ba'i dbang phyug grub pa'i blo/ /bskal bzang rnam (52ba〉ra dren bzhi pa'i ring lugs kyi/ /gnad gsang rgya bkrol dbyar mtsho ji bzhin du/ /'phel mdzad rdo rje lta bur zhabs brtan shog /sgo gsum nyer 'bad rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag /'di phyi'i bde skyid dpag bsam yongs 'du'i 'bras/ /rtag tu spyod la dge ba'i brgya byin gyi/ /gtsug tor reg pas 'chi med lus grub shog /ces pa 'di yang nya shul skya ril gyis sog dga' ldan lhun por 'dzugs rgyu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sug bris bgyis so/ /'jigs med dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus yum/ /'jigs brgyad gnyen por 'phags ma'i skur bstan nas/ /'jig pa kun la skye rgu rnams bsgral te/ /'jig bral sar 'god legs sbyin lha mos skyongs/ /rab ljang 'khri shing ltar mnyen skyabs sbyin phyag /rab mang yid can dbug dbyung ched skyong yang / /rab dkar mdzes sdug zla bzhin 'dzum zhal can/ /rab gsal spyan bdun nyer gzigs 'chi med lhas/ /gnas lnga rig par mang thos mkhas gral snyeg /lus ngag yid gsum bag yod la —66
