smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenadabang blos/ /nyer btsun brtse ldan bzang po rgya chen 'gror/ /dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel te brtan gyur cig /blo bzang grags snyan rab 'bar 'phrin las kyi/ /ma smad bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gos can gzhi/ /snying stobs rus sbal gyis 'degs mi yi bdag /sum rtsen dbang po rdo rje ltar brtan shog /mang thos lung gi nags tshal stug po'i dbus/ /rig pa'i skad gsang cher sgrogs stag gi tshang / /gangs can ra ba'i stod smad bar gsum gyi/ /blo gsal 'dus grwa srid mthar rgyas gyur (53na༄ga /ces brtan bzhugs smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni skal bzang skye rgya'i 'jug ngogs gsang phu ra stod pa spyi tsho gos kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo /ngag dbang blo gros bye ba'i gter mdzod mchog /bzang po'i skal ldan rgya mtsho'i dpal mgon du/ /'og min zhing gtso nges pa lnga ldan ltar/ /rtag tu g.yo ba med par bzhugs gyur cig /nam yang yol med dkon mchog thugs rje'i rlabs/ /bde legs chu gter 'bum stsegs mtsho slong nas/ sgyu bsam 'dod 'jo yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /gtsug tor rtse mor 'bral med mdzes gyur cig zhes smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling slob dpon pas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brjes sbyar/ /bde chen zhing gi mgon po tshe mtha' yas/ /lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rnam rol can/ /mdzod spu'i zer 'phreng 'bar bas 'chi bdag mun/ /mthar byas snang ba'i phun tshogs dga' ston stsol/ /rnam 'dren de gsung sras dang nyan rang sogs/ /slu med gtan gyi skyabs su gyur to cog /rtag tu bden pa'i mthu dang thugs rje ches/ /deng 'dir smon pa'i re 'bras smin gyur cig /ngag dbang dbyangs can blo gros la spyod pa'i/ /skal bzang thob pas rgya chen shes bya'i gnad/ /mtsho nang gzugasaltar mngon sum gzigs pa'i mgon/ /nyi zlas mun sel de srid chos bstan gsol/ /dus dgra'i brtul zhugs 'jigs med seng ge'i stsal/ /yid grub gcan gzan mche bas 'bub min (53ba〉go /dkar cha'i chu shel dbang po ltar 'phel te/ /thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal du brtan gyur cig /rnam —67

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dpyod lang tsho dar ba'i lcags kyu yis/ /phun tshogs sdebazhi'i dngos kun yongs bsdus par/ /'jam dbyangs dga' bas mgrin pa pa zla'i mtshor/ /legs bzhugs bshes gnyen dam pa zhabs brtan shog /mi 'gyur chos nyid gser ldan lto ba mā /chos can rgyu tshogs sa bon legs btab pas/ /re ba ji bzhin 'grub pa'i dpag bsam ljon/ /phan bde'i sa bus yongs su dud gyur cig /lhag bsam gangs kyi rdul brtsegs las babs pa'i/ /chos dkar gaṅgā'i chu rgyun 'dzad mi shes/ /byang chub snying po'i zla ba'i ma ma dang / /ro gcig 'gro rnams kun mkhyen thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni gzims dpon gyi las 'dzin ri khrod dga' ldan slob dpon zur pa byams pa rin r+ṣa sogs nged rang gi nye skor du rgyun sdod kyi drung 'bor spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa blo bzang dngos grub bo/ /yid bzhin mtshor zhakhrungs 'dab brgya'i ze'u 'bru'i rtser/ /rab dkar cha shas 'khor lo nya gang steng / /yid 'phrog blta bas ngoms min tshe sbyin lha/ /bcom ldan 'das mas 'chi med dngosagrub stsol/ /gnam gyi she mong dpung pa'i lde mig gis/ /zhwa ser chos srid 'phrin las sde bzhi'i sgo/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can mthar khyab legs 'byed pa/ /nor 'dzin skyong ba'i dbang po zhabs brtan shog /slu med dkon mchog rnam gsum thugs rje'i gzi/ /stobs ldan dam pa chos kyi srung ma'i mthu/ /lhar bcas (54na tha den tshigs sa bon yongs btab pa'i/ /'bras bzang legs smin dga' ston deng 'grub shog /ces sa skyong phyag mdzod 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i brtan bzhugs 'di ni ri khrod dga' ldan slob dpon gtso bos gyur pa'i nye 'khor drung 'khor spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs so/ /las kyi me long ri mo ltar bkod nas/ /'khor ba mtha' can de srid rdo rje'i sku/ /nges pa lnga ldan ji bzhin ston mdzad pa/ /pad+ma thod phreng thugs rje'i mthu dpung bskyed/ /khri srong rigs sras lha lcam pad+ma gsal/ /zab gter sgo 'byed don du las brel rtsal/ /klong chen chos kyi rgyal po pad gling —68

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa ra bdakar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedasogs//rim byon sprul pa'i zlos gar chad med shog/mgon khyod gsung gsang rdo rje'i rang bzhin gang //mchog dman gdul bya'i spyod yul skyed tshal du//ngo mtshar sprul pa'i 'dabs stong rab bzhad pa//thugs skyed nyin byed mngon sum 'char bar shog/bag yod tshul khrims rnam dag ngur smig 'chang //gsang chen rdo rje theg mchog snying por 'dzin//snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog shing dam pa yi//yang srid kha ba'i ljongs 'dir myur byon shog/zang mdog dpal rir pad gling dngos bzhugs kyang //slar sprul rang bstan chos kyi rgyal srid du//theg mchog rin cen cod paṇa legs bcing nas//ring min dbang skur bkra shis phyin chen phob//tsho gos gnyis rgya mtsho'i nya phyis khog yangs las//rtag tu bams 'dod 'bras yongs smin shog/sras bcas rgyal ba'i ngo bo pad+ma 'byung //bde gshegs zhi khro kun 'dus bka' 54ba tha rgyad lha//ma ning bstan srung rgya mtshor bcas pa yis//bsam don lhun gyisahrūb par bdag byin rlobs//zhes 'khrul med gling pa bcu gcig gi nang tshan rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma gling pa'i gsung gi sprul pa tshul khrims rdo rje'i sprul pa'i sku myur 'byon gyi smon lam bden pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni dbang chen rta mchog gi sprul pa thugs sras zla ba'i yang srid bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so//bi shā ga me lta bu'i ri mo ba chos dbyings rgya mtshos shar gling chos sde'i gnas bcu khang la zhig gsos byas pa'i dge bsngo'i smon lam tshigs bcad sogs/bud+dhā pra sku yadharma phyaṅgā tuḥ2nirmā gi rga nu tsa lha mi tā ge/sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings//mthong ba'i skal phra 'khor 'khyams 'gro ba la//ni mi stordu4pi dz+ra ta bra tu tsa/9〉〉rmi tres ha he yud shi ṣ+yo/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan dngos ston nyi ma'i gnyen/ /gang gi sras dang slob mar bcas pa kye/ /(55na thad srubs rtsod la tshad mar gyur pa'i dpang / /sa yi lha mo gser ldan las 'phags bzhin/ /lhag bsam dag pas bskrun pa'i chos dkar gyi/ /phung po byang chub snying por bsgyur ched dgongs/ /snang srid gzugs su 'char ba'i sgyu ma mkhan/ /chos dbyings rgya mtshor nyer grags ri mo bas rab bsgrubs rten dang brten pa'i nyal 'gro'i tshogs/ /rnam mkhyen rgya mtsho'i klong du ro gcig shog /skye rgu'i phan bde bla nas blar 'degs pa/ /snying stobs kun bzod ma yi rje 'gro gang / /srid zhi'i skye brgyud 'dzad med mtha' can bar/ /mi 'bral rlabs chen spyod pas dus 'dar shog /dge ba'i mthun rkyen bsgrub par gtogs so cog /mi zad sdig rta'i smag rum las slong ba/ /thabs shes nyi zla zung gi gnas skabs dang / /gtan 'dun snang ba'i 'od chen 'bar gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni bi shā ga me lta bu'i ri mo ba chos dbyings rgya mtshos shar gling chos sde'i gnas bcu khang la zhig gso byas pa sogs kyis mtshon te bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i dge tshogs bgyis pa rnams byang chub kyi rgyur bsngo ba'i smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs tshogs gnyis mthus bcil ste/ /mtshan tsam thos tshe tshe yi dpal ster ba/ /bde ldan dag zhing zhing khams gtso bo'i mgon/ /thugs rje'i spyan dkyus dkyus ring lhur gzigs gsol/ /dbyangs can mgrin 'byud brjod pa rnam dag ngag /dbang phyug grub pa'i blo grosabazang po yis/ /rgya chen shes bya rgya mtsho ltar zab yangs par/ /spobs pa (55bsko ge ba'i bshes khyod brtan par shog /zhwa ser 'chang ba'i bshad dang sgrub pa'i bstan/ /de 'dzin 'dus sde chos srid bla nas blar/ /rab 'degs nor 'dzin skyongs ba'i mnga' thang sogs/ /phun tshogs skyid pa'i nyi ma dgung 'char shog /'jig rten spyi dang gangs can skye rgu yi/ /dus gsum bsags dang gsog 'gyur sgrub bzhin pa/ /rab dkar dge ba'i 'bras bu mu sti ga'i/ /'dzad med char chen rtag tu 'bab par shog /lhag bsam ga bla'i yab cig las 'ongs pa/ /bsod nams byas pa'i chu klung 'bab pa'i rgyun/ /—70

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ 6)mkha' mnyam ma rgan yid can ma lus pa/ /byang chub snying po'i rgya mtsho rgyas phyir bsngo/ /zhes kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī'i gdan sa pa mkhan chen tshul khrims rgya mtshos 'phyong rgyas skya ser spyi'i ngag 'don du bden pa brjod pa'i tshigs bcad gcig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyos chang khyim pa blo bzang dngos grub bo/ /brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i mtshan snyan gru gzings kyis/ /'khor mtshor 'chi bdag rba klong las bsgral te/ /bde skyid rin chen gling 'khrid ded dpon che/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i mgon de 'dir gshegs shig /grangs med lus sprul phyag 'tshal mchod sprin spro/ /nyes tshogs kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor bskor phyir mya ga mi 'dar bzhugs/ /bdag sogs smon lam ci btab 'grub byin rlobs/ /gdangs snyan ngag gi dbang phyug brgyad ldan lha'i/ /thugs rjes bskul byed mos blos gsol btab mthus/ /bskal bzang gdul bya rgya mtsho'i bshes gnyen mchog /nges pa lnga ldan bzhin du (56na tha rtan par shog /'jam dpal rdo rje kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i/ /bstan pa rin chen rnam gsum 'khor lo yis/ /dkar cha 'phel ba'i bsil zer rjes 'gro bas/ /'dzam gling skye rgu'i gdung ba'i mun bsel shog /tshe ring gnam gyi she mong dpung pa yis/ /dus kyi bdag por grub pa'i las shugs rjes/ /bod chen nor 'dzin 'brang ba'i mi yi bdag /sku tshe chab srid mnga' thang 'phel bar shog /brgal brtag dpyad bzod lung rigs shing rta yis/ /legs bshad yid bzhin nor bu 'dren mkhas pa'i/ /blo gsal dwags po gra tshang srid mtha'i bar/ /yongs rgyas thos bsam bstan pa dar bar shog /bsod nams zhing la sri zhu yi ge drug /bye ba dung phyur grangs spel sbyin pa'i bdag /lusang ga yid kyis mthun rkyen sbyor ba rnams/ /'di phyi gtan gyi 'dun ma lhun grub shog /spyi dang khyad par gangs can sman ljongasa'adir/ /nad mug 'byug rtsod dus kyi chad pa'i tshogs/ /rab zhi tshe 'byor bde skyid brgyad khri'i lor/ /spyod pa'i 'dzam gling yid can skrun zlar shog /mdor na bsags dang gsog 'gyur byed bzhin pa/ /rnam smin dkar por 'dzag pa'i las bzang kun/ /lha lam mtha' bzhi tshad bzung nus min pa/ /ma —71

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)rgan 'gro rnams sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo//zhes pa 'di ni stag ru ba nor bus bde chen khang gsar du yig drug dung phyur btsugs skabs dwags po grwa tshang gi zhal 'don du 'dzugs rgyu'i brtan bzhugs shig dgos tshul byung ba ltar mgon po tshe dpag med la yan lag bdun pa dang 'brel bar ring 'tsho bden tshig spyi sgos kyi smon lam dang bcas te za hor gyi 56na tha rnyes sug bris su byas so//dus gsum rgyal kun sras bams ngo bo nyid//mtshar wo rdo rje 44 dbang sbyang gzhi'i sku//sbyangs 'bras tshe mtha' yas pa'i mgon po mchog/dbyings rigs dag pa'i klong 'dir gshegs shing bzhugs//ga ba'i rdul grangs lus sprul gus phyag 'tshal//phyi nang gsang mchod nam mkha' mdzod phye 'bul//bsags pa'i sdig tsho gos stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags//srid zhi'i mtha' klas dge la rjes yi rang //mgon rnams 'gro blor 'tshams chos ston pas sprul//chos kyi dbyings su nyi zla rtag bzhugs gsol//rang bzhan kun gyi legs byas sa bon tshogs//byang chub mchog gi myu gu skye rgyur bsngo/slu med gtan gyi skyabs gnas khyed rnams la//dbang rnon chos rjes 'brang te bcad brdar bas/khyu mtshan rab nges mi phyed dad pa yis//snying nas gsol ba 'debs na bdag byin rlobs//gdon bgegs 'byung po'i gnod 'tshe'i geg sri langs//nad rim dus min 'chi dbul zhal lte babs//seng glang dug sprul chom rkun me chu dang //lcag sgrog sha za'i 'jigs kun las thar shog/rtsod pa'i lcags khams rdzogasaldan su waṇa ra//legs bsgyur tshe dang dpal dang longs spyod sogs//mngon sum nyams su myong ba sun rtsen gyi//dbang phyug brnyes pa'i skal bzang lhun grub shog/'di nas 'phos tshe bde ldan zhing khams su//thogs pa med bgrod rgyal ba'i sras gyur te//rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub phyir phyin drug gi/rlabs chen spyod ba'i tshogs la 'jug par shog/ma rgan skye rgur brtse bas 'khor ba las//mi skyo'i yang srid 'dzin tshe slob bshad chos//57na skon brgyud phroṃ ma bzhi ldan legs ston pa'i//yongs 'dzin rnams kyi rtag tu rjes 'dzin shog/nges gsang smin grol 'bras bu yongs dud pa//zung 'jug sku bzhi'i dpag bsam ljon pa /yi//grib ma nam mkha'i pha mtha' gzhal nus pa'i//yid can

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshig su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenamatha' dag ngal gsor spyod gyur cig ces pa mtshar chen chos kyi rgyal po la sbyar ba yin cing /rigs 'dzin chen po la sbyor na/mtshar chen rdo rje 'chang dbang sbyang gzhi'i sku//zhes pa/rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje sbyang gzhi'i sku//zhes pa dang /mi skyo'i yang srid 'dzin tshe slob bshad chos//snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan legs ston pa//zhes pa/mo skye'i yang srid 'dzin tshe ka dag dbyings//lhun grub 'od lnga mngon sum ngo sprod pa'i//zhes 'don pa bsgyur bas 'grub bo//gnas skabs mthar thug gi rgyad pa zhi zhing /mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'grub pa'i smon lam zhig dgos zhes kha'u brag rdzong pa dang rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje'i ring lugs la mi phyed pa'i dad pa can mang du thos pa'i dpyod ldan glang phu nas dgra 'dul tshe ring gis bskul ba la brten za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang dngos grub bo//dge ba'i zhing sar smon lam legs btab 'bras//'dren mchog bla ma zhabs pad rab brtan zhing //sa stong mi dbang sku tshe chab srid dar//'bangs rnams bde skyid dpal la spyod par shog/cesabartan bzhugs smon lam tshigs bcad 'di'ang lha sa spyi tshogs kyi ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar//mi shigs skyil krung gcig bcas ting 'dzin gyis//bdud sde'i dpung tshogs zhig 57bapa'i sgra snyan pa//tshangs pa'i yul sar sgrog mdzad don kun grub//dkyus ring spyan gyis rtag tu btsa' bar mdzod//'khor rtsa dug gsum nad rnams gso byad sman//chos phung ga tho'i yab gcig las babs pa//mdo rgyud glegs bam yan lag brgyad ldan chab//gangs ljongs zla ba'i ma mar 'khyil 'di smad//brda dag dbyibs legs gzugs su gsung rab rnams//sor mos gar bsgyur rnam dpyod si ta ma//'phrog byed yid srubs la tho'i mgrin gcod pa'i//mthu rtsal dga' byed lha dang mnyam 'thob shog/'phel zad 'du ba 'khrugs dang gdon gyi bya//dkon cog thugs rje'i nags la sbar ba'i me//gsol 'debs rlung gis bdas pas lus sems rnams//mnar byed zug rngu ming gi lhag mar shog/dkar phyogs skyong bar zhal 'tshes phyi nang mgon//bye brag gnas yul lha srung rlung shugs kyis//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gegs byed 'thibs po'i sprin nag ga gshed du/ /gtor te btsal yang dmigs su med par mdzod/ /rgyud lnga'i mya ngam thang du las nyon mes/ /tsha gdung ris med yid can ma lus pa/ /rgyal bstan yongs 'du dar drag grib bsil la/ /bde skyid rtse dga' gzhal nus ngal gsor shog /sems can bsam pa'i nam mkha' zad min bar/ /'char dang nub spangs dam bca' 'og min gyi/ /nges pa lnga ldan mgon bzhin bshes gnyen mchog /rtag tu chad med chos 'khor bskor bar shog /tshangs pas ka ba med par gnam gyi sgo/ /phye nas mang bkur rgyal khab yangs pa'i khrir/ /dus kyi bdag por nyer bkod mi yi bdag /chab srid mnga' thang dgung dang mnyam par shog /rtsod dus (58na sgos phra'i mig zum phra mos kyang / /reg min rdzogs ldan skye rgu'i dpal 'byor tshe/ /spyi dang khyad par rgya hor bod 'bangs kyi/ /mngon sum nyams su myong ba'i skal bzang shog /rten 'brel rgyu 'bras slu med che ba 'das/ /'dri klog las byed rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag rnams/ /ring 'tsho'i srog gi /ba brtan po yis/ /las kyi tshe le me 'dzin pa'i ngal bsten shog /gnyis mi za ba dad pa'i mngal yangs por/ /dge tsho gos phung po'i gser sgong smin pa yis/ /chos nor 'dod thar 'dzum zhal bzhi ldan pa/ grub pa'i mes po'i mched zlar gyur bar shog /legs byas spel ba'i mchod sbyin brgya phrag gis/ /lha mi'i rten bzang 'khor mo yug myong mthar/ /mya ngan las 'das 'chi med bdag po'i khri/ /rnam par gnon pa'i dbang thang ches 'bar shog /ye shes tshogs kyi gyad rigs dpa' bo'i g.yul/ /bsod nams ru ldan go mtshon mthor bsgrengs te/ /lus med 'jug pa bzhi yi dpung bcom pa'i/ /rgyal rnga sku gsum khang rtser rdung gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang gnam sa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin dwa yan rgyal po dang / stobs kyi dpung pas sa'i dkyil 'khor rnam par gnon pa o chi thu tha'i ji gnyis kyis lung sde bzhi/ sher phyogs/ mdo sde rnams gangs ljongs su 'gyur ro tshal dang / rgyud 'bum thor bu bcas pa'i glegs bam brgya phrag bzhengs pa'i dus/ spyi sgos kyi smon lam dpon yig pa rnams kyi kha ton byed rgyu zhig dgos zhes nang so dkon mchog dar rgyas kyis bskul ba'i ngor lha sde mi sde gang gis chos bzhengs sar yang brtan chog (58ba〉rtses kyi spyi —74

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhinakhyab las dmigs gsal med pa'i snyan tshig gi sbyor ba 'di ni za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge'i 'du byed pa chang khyim pa blo bzang dngos grub bo//bskal brgyar mi shigs mchog gsum thugs rje'i gar//rgyal ba kun yum rnam rol tshe sbyin ma//yid bzhin 'khor lo'i dkyus ring spyan ras kyis//mi g.yel gzigs pas bden tshig 'grub byin rlobs//ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i bshes gnyen mchog/blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i rnam 'dren du//ji srid 'khor ba mtha' can gyur min bar//nges pa lnga ldan bzhin du brtan par shog/kha ba'i ljongs 'dir thub bstan rab rgyas shing //sa skyong rgyal po'i mnga' thang chab srid 'phel//'gro kun rdzogs ldan dus kyi bde skyid la//lhan cig longs su spyod pa'i skal ldan shog/ces smon lam tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni gri gu rdzong sdod tshe bdag gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar//srid na mtshupa ga med bsod nams brgya pa'i 'od//mngon sum rab 'bar shākya seng ge yi//bstan la yang dag ri mor bgyid kun gyi//tshol med lam du 'jug ngog brda' sprod gzhung /shes byar srid pa'i gnas lugs rtogs byed pa//sgra rig rgya mtsho'i snying po bsrubs pa'i 'bras//dbyangs can gtsug lag yongs 'du'i ljon pa las//'dzad med legs bshad 'dod pa ci yang 'jo//cha bsags mdo ltar rtogs sla brda chad rnams//btsun pa zla ba'i gzhung la nyer 'khu ba//tshig nyung don rgyas 'phangs 'gro'i dbyangs kyi sgra//dpyod ldan yongs kyi rna ba'i rgyan 59na'i 'jebs//tshangs sras lha mo'i rol mo g.yas 'khyil mgrin//byings dang rnam 'gyur rkyen gyi skad snyan pos//'phags yul mkhas rnams dga' skyed paṇ+ḍita//a nu bhu ti'i grags pa phyogs kun dkar//lugs 'dzin don gyi paṇa chen kha spu can//ba la bha dra mched gnyis legs bshad sgo//thos brtson lde mig gis 'byed se dkar rigs//'dar lo ngag dbang phun tshogs 'jig rten mig/gang des ljongs 'dir mngon med bstan bcos che//'byul bral dpyad gsum dag pa'i zhus chen gyis//bsgyur tshe shong dpang bstan pa cha phra'i zla//gang byed lnga rig rdzogs ldan gsar pa bzhin//bstan la gces par 'dzin pa'i shes

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ldan rnams/ /yid la kun dga'i mdza' bos dam 'khyud pa'i/ /dge tsho gis rtsa ba sbom por skyed bsringasartser/ /tsho gos gnyis dar drag 'bras bu 'grub par shog /legs sbyar gtsug lag 'di la sgo gsum du/ /'bad pas thos dang bsam par byed rnams kyi/ /snying la ngag dbang dbyangs can lhag pa'i lha/ /zhugs nasasmra ba'i rgyal po 'grub par shog /gangs can ljongs 'dir kla klo blun skad kyis/ /brda don 'tshol la dam pa'i rnam thar du/ /mi 'dzin tshul 'dir sbyangs pa'i dpyod ldan gyi/ /dog por 'god pa'i skal bzang thob gyur cig /chos kun blta ba'i rig gnas mig stong can/ /sgra don rdo rje rtse brgya gdengs tsam gyis/ /dri bcas bstan pa'i sa 'dzin bgrod byed dang / /lhan cig rmongs kho lha min dpung 'jomasashog /dbyangs can brda sprod rtsa 'grel nyi zla zung / /don kun rab gsal (59bskong ba 'od po ches//byams mgon mchog sprul zlos gar bsgyur min bar/ /'jig rten kun gyi mun sel sgron mer shog /ces legs par sbyar ba'i bstan bcos dbyangs can byā ka ra'i rtsa ba'i stod cha tsam zhig lha mthong lo chen gyis bal yul du bsgyur 'dug na'ang dus dbang gis legs bshad don du gnyer ba nyung bas ma 'phel zhing / phyis rtag brtan sprul skus paṇ+ḍita ra 'phral skad kyi dri gtugs tsam la brten nas rtsa ba bsgyur zhing bod 'grel zhig brtsams 'dug na'ang 'gyur skyon dang 'grel pa 'dre shar sgo dang glud nub sgo bzhin don thog tu phebs par ma mthong bas/ rtsa ba la 'gyur bcos dang paṇ+ḍita a nu bhū tis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa rab tu bya ba gsal ldan zhes pa gsar du bsgyur na bstan rgyun la phan par bsams nas pā ṇi sogs kyis bskul ba ltar brda sprod kyi gzhung lugs mang por sbyangs pa'i se dkar rigs kyi 'dar lo ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub la tshul 'di bsgrub par rigs zhes mtshams sbyar bar brten gegs med grub pa'i tshe smon lam gyi tshigs bcas gcig dgos zhes lo tsā ba nyid kyis bskul ba ltar bden tshigs brjod pa yongs 'du'i ljon pa 'di ni za ci hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /dkon mchog thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs dang / /rten 'brel slu med chos srung mthu stobs—76

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenakyis//sprul sku blo bzang ngag dbang g.yung drung ltar//nam yang gzhes zhig med par brtan gyur cig/ces cha dkar no mon khang gi sprul sku'i brtan bzhugs 'di'ang 'od zer gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sug bris su byas so//rkang 60na skonyis gtso bo sangs rgyas dang //'dod chags dang bral dam pa'i chos//tshogs mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la//byang chub bar du skyabs su mchos//bdag gis 'gro rnams don wo du//das mchog gsum po ma lus pa//kun 'dus bla ma'i ngo bo sa/bgo nams tshogs bsags par bya//mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge'i khri//pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du//drin can rtsa ba'i bla mni//sku mdog dkar dmar rab byung tshul//g.yas pa chos 'am da g.yon glegs bam//dbu la paṇa zhwa gser mdog gsol//zhabs gnyis rdo rje dkyil krung bzhugs//de yi sku la dus gsum gyi//sangasargyas byang chub smos dpa'i tshogs//to rang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang //dam can chos skyong srung ma sogs//skyabs gnas kun 'dus ngo bor gyur//bde gshegs sras dang slob mar bcas//'khor bcas thugs rje chen po'i mthus//thog med 'dir gshegs mchod yul du//rab bzhugs bdag la dgongs par mdzod//sman spos chab kyi khrus gsol bas//bdag sogs 'gro kun nyon mongs dang /shes bya'i sgrib pa rab bkrus te//srid zhi'i dngos grub stsal du gsol//oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye āḥlha/reg na bde zhing 'jam pa yi//lha rdzas dar dkar bzang po'i dri//yongs su bgos pas rab dbyi na/khru med sku mchog thob par shog/6lha〉〉ākar ṣa ya bi sho dha na ye swāhā/srab 'jam gos bzang rin cen rgyan//gdugs dang ba dan bla bre dang //bum bzang bdud rtsi'i chus bkang 60ba tha//dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tsho gos la 'bul//mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos//mar me dri chab zhal zas dang //gdangs snyan glu dbyangs rol mor bcas//dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tsho gis la 'bul//'khor lo nor bu btsun mo dang //blon po glang chen cang shes rta//dmag dpon 'dod yon rnam pa lnga//dkon cog rgya mtsho'i tsho gos la 'bul//khod snyoms gser gyi sa gzhi'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung tsom/ (4)steng //lhun po gling bzhi gling phran brgyad//rin ོ ri bo dpag bsam shing //'dod 'dzo ba dang ma rmos pa'i//lo tog rgyal srid sna bdun dang //ga kho bum sgeg phreng glu gar ma//tshe togo bdug sposamar me dri//nyi zla gdugs dang rgyal mas sogs//dngos bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i//ma rdzo sprin rgya mtsho bzhes nas kyang //bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus pa'i//bsod nams zhis wo rdzogs par shog/'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi//stobs brgya mnga' ba'i sa rnams dang //byang sems rang rgyal nyan thos la//gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs//sku gsum thugs yon 'phrin las rnams//mthong thos dran pas don ldan par//'god mdzad zas gtsang sras po la//gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs//sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen brtse dang /zhus mthu ma lus gcig bsdus pa//'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po la//gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs//gzod ma nyid nas sangs rgyas kyang //nyan thos tshul gyis 'gro 'dren pa//gnas brtan chen po bcu drug la//gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs//bstan pa rim brgyud ho med du//'dzin mdzad 'od srung wo po sogs//gtad rab bdun gyi 'phags tshogos la//gus6na7sa phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs//gsang sngags nye lam zab mo la//brten nas dngos grub mchog bsnyes pa/grub wo brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi la//gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/zheng rta chen po zung ldan gyis//thog dra pas rgyan drug mchog gnyis so gos//'phags yul paṇa chen thams cad la//gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs//gangs can mgon med rnams kyi mgon//chos rgyal mes dbon rim byon dang //mkhan slob pad+ma'i ngang tshul la//gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs//dam chos rgya nas gangs can du//bsgyur mdzad 'jig rten mig gcig po//skad gnyis smra ba'i tshogs rnams la//gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs//skyes bu gsum gyi rim pa yis//thub bstan nyi ltar gsal mdzad pa//mnyam med jo bo yab sras la//gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs//'jam da byangs ga'one nu ngur mig gi/rnam rol bod yul bstan pa'i bdag/kun mkhyeX blo bzang grags pa la//gus pas phyag 'tshal

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedagasol ba 'debs//mtha' 'khob hor yul mun pa'i gling //dam chos snang bsags la mdzad pa//rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho la//gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs//dran pa tsam gyis dngosagrub kun//stsol mdzad yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal//drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la//gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs//yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tsho gis dang //dpa' bo mkha' 'gro srung ma'i tshogs//slu med skyabs mgon thams cad la//gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs//bdag gi lusang ga yid gsum gyi//'bad pas bsags pa'i dge ba'i 'bras//theg chen sems bskyed mthus spel nas//nam yang 'dzad pa med 6ba par shog/de ltar bsod nams phung po'i mthus//dmyal ba'i 'gro rnams tsha grang gi/sdug bsngal las thar gnas ngan kun//mtho ris skyed tshal ltar 'grub shog/yi dwags rnams kyang bkres skom las//rnam grol zas skom 'byor ba'i tshogs//gnod sbyin bang mdzod ltar rnyed cing //longs su spyod nus bde ldan shog/gsod spyod bkol zhing brdeg dang brdung //gcig la gcig za la sogs pa'i//sdug bsngal kun las dud 'gro rnams//thar nas bde dang ldan par shog/mi rnams nad kyis mnar ba dang //dbang po ma tshang dbul zhing phongs//mi rgod gcan gzan dug mtshon g.yul//'jigs pa kun las thar bar shog/kha na ma mtho med pa yi//longs spyod ldan zhing ring por 'tsho//dam chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen rnams//'bad pa med par tshang bar shog/lus gcad gtub cing dril ba sogs//'thab cing rtsod pa'i sdug bsngal las//lha min tsho gos rnamasarab thar nas//byams pa sems dang ldan par shog/'chi 'pho lhung bar byed pa dang /khyab pa 'du byed sdug bsngal las//'dod dang gzugs khams gzugs med lha//thar nas gtan bder spyod par shog/bdag kyang deng nas sangs rgyas kyi//byang chub ma thob de srid bar//mi khom gnas su mi skye zhing //dal 'byor rten bzang thob par shog/dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes 'dzin cing //bstan la rab zhugs khrims dang ldan//sdosnod rnam gsum thos pa dang //de don bsam zhing sgom par shog/lus bde blo gsal rig pa rno//mas pa'i rkyen kun ngang gis tshang //mi 'dod nyer 'tshe ming tsam yang /9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)mi 'byung rtag tu spyod par shog /thog med nas bgos sgrib gnyis tshogs/ /rab byang sa lam yon tan kun/ /rang sems(62na tha rdzogs chos gzugs sku/ /lus can kun don 'thob par shog /mdor na bdag gis bsgrubs pa dang / /g.yin gyi dge la yi rang sogs/ /legs byas rgya mtsho gang thob de/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen rgyur bsngo/ /zhes rgyun 'khyer nyams len gyi rim pa don tshang zhing tshigs nyung ngur byas pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes dkon mchog gsum la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa dpon mo su khan jus bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo /ngag dbang lhag pa'i lha yi blo gros gter/ /thob pa'i bskal bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho'i sde/ /'jam dbyangs dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /mi khom gnas su nam yang mi skye zhing / /mtho ris yon tan bdun tshang rten bzang thob/ /srid zhi'i bde skyid brgyud mar myong bzhi nas/ /myur du rdzogs pa'i byang tso thob par shog /dkon mchog la mchod dbul phongs tshogs la sbyin/ /srog stob kha rtan phyag skor khrims bsrung 'debs sogs/ /ci nus bgyis pa'i dge ba ma lus pa/ /kun mkhyen ye shes thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes gsol smon lam bsngo ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni dpon mo bsod nams sgron mas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /ngag dbang 'jam mgon blo gros bzang po yis/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i mthar son dge ba'i bshes/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog zur phud lnga pa dang / /dbyer med ngo bo gcig la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i dpal du gzugs kyi sku/ /nges pa lnga ldan ji bzhin 'khor ba'i mtha'/ /(62ba〉(gas min de srid bzhugs nas zab rgyas kyi/ /chos 'khor bla na med par bskor bar gsol / /mgon khyod thugs rje chen po'i bdud rtsi yis/ /bdag snying za ma tog tu rtag 'khyil bas/ /'di phyi kun tu dge ba'i bsod nams gzugs/ /nor 'dzin lto bar yangs min dogs por shog /ces pa'i tshigasasu bcad pa 'di ni gong nas chos bsgyur ba'i lo tsā slob pa sogs mang du thos par 'ongs pa'i san chag —80

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenapa lhas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa blo bzang dngos grub bo/ /som nyi dang bral nges par skyabs song na/ /slu med sangs rgyas dam chos 'dus pa'i tshogs/ /khyad par kun bzang rigs gsum mgon po la/ /'o dod drag pos gsol na 'jigs chen stobs/ /ji snyed phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas rnams dgongs/ /bdag gis thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /rje bo pha ma mchos 'drang bu tsha dang / /mdza' grogs gnyen bshes mnga' 'bangs longs spyod don/ /'dod chags dbang gis bsags pa'i sdig pa dang / /dgra dang mi mdza' 'joms byed ga g.yo'i 'phrul/ /dug sbyor mtshon snun gzhan dag rbad pa sogs/ /tshe srog longs spyod bde skyid 'phrog nus pa'i/ /zhe sdang dbang gis bsgrubs pa'i sdig las tshogs/ /byol song bkol spyod gsod dang ri dwags rngon/ /pha ma nad pa bkres skom phongs sogs la/ /phan gdags mi byed mi gus 'tshe zhing 'dor/ /bla ma dkon mchog rnam gsum rgyu 'bras la/ /the tshom log par blta dang spongs sems byed/ /rgyags pa'i snyems dang dngos por 'jungs pa sogs/ /nyes kun rtsa ba gti mug ma rig ste/ /mdor na dug lnga'i rgyu las (63na〉sko gsum gyis/ /bsags pa'i sdig lhung nyes pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan khyed rnams kyi/ /spyan sngar mi 'chab mi sped rab bsgrags te/ /'gyod pa drag pos nongs rnams ma lus bshags/ /ji srid 'tsho dang lo zla zhag dus sogs/ /gang nus de srid nag po'i las rnams sdom/ /sdig pa'i gnyen por bsgrubs pa'i dge tshogs kyi/ /'bras bu tshe 'dir bde zhing skyid pa dang / /yang srid kun tu mi khom gnas spangasanas/ /mtho ris rten thob dam pa'i chos dang mjal/ /sa dang lam gyi yon to gong du 'phel/ /ga song gnas stongs 'gro kun bde 'gror spyod/ /ring por mi thog bdag gis gtso byas pa'i/ /yid can ma lus sangs rgyas 'thob par shog /ces gnyen po stobs bzhi'i bshags pa thams cad mkhyen pa tsong kha pa chen po'i bka' 'bum du bzhugs pa de cung zad ma 'khyongs par shin tu mdor bsdus shing don tshang ba 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes dad stobs kyi dbang phyug u chir du tha'i ji'i bskul ba la —81—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)brten nas za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /mang thos don kun grub pa'i gru gzings kyis/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i mthar bgrod dge ba'i bshes/ /sa chog gsum thugs rje'i mtho ris yon tan bdun/ /tshang ba'i rten bzang 'dzin smon 'grub byin rlobs/ /zhes chos rje don grub rgya mtsho'i skye srid myur du 'dzin pa'i smon lam 'di'ang dbon po grwa ris kyi 'dod pa ltar za hor gyi bzhes bris/ /gzhi lam 'bras ston dngos brgyud rdo rje 'dzin/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i khrag 'thung kun gyi gtso/ /bstan srung mchog gyur gur mgon stobs log dbang / /deng 'dir byin rlabs nus pa'i mthu (63ba)ja ma yi dam srung mar gsol ba 'debs pa dang mchod pa 'bul ba gang 'dod bsgyur chog rtsis yin/ dpung bskyed/ /snod ldan kun la dga' bzhi'i ye shes mchog /legs stsol he ru ka dpal rtul zhugs kyis/ /yid srub g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba yi/ /ring lugs rdo rje 'chang dngos ja mar gsol ba 'debs dang mchod pa 'bul gang 'dod du sgyur/nyi zla'i snang ba ltar gsal shog /gsung ngag dbang bzhi'i mtho ris chu bo'i rgyun/ /jo gros za ma tog 'khyil skal bzang can/ /rgya chen thub bstan dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel ba'i/ /gdan gsol ba 'debs dang mchod pa 'bul gang 'dod du sgyur chog /gsum tshang ba'i mgon de zhabs brtan shog /rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol phyag bzhed rnams/ /'dzin mkhas gdan gsum ngo bo'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /sde 'di yongs gang 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa rin po che la gsol ba 'debs dang mchod pa 'bul gang 'dod du sgyur/rin chen phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /khams gsum dbang sdud rje btsun rig byed ma/ /dngos grub mchog stsol lha chen tshogs kyi bdag /bsam pa'i re ba yongs skong 'dod pa'i rgyal/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs stol la gsol ba 'debs dang mchod pa 'bul gang 'dod du sgyur/kun stsol bkra shis shog /ces ring por 'tsho ba'i rten 'byung gi tshigs bcad blo ka gcig la gsol 'debs ja mchod sogs gang 'dod du bsgyur chog pa zhig dgos zhes rgyud sde bzhi'i smin grol phyag bzhes kyi rgyun bzang po ma nyams par —82

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zheda'adzin pa'i 'dus grwa gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba ltar gsol 'debs smon lam ja mchod sogs rgya 'bag gi mig bzhin 'phrul chog pa 'di bzhin za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /rnyed rgyud 'bum rdzogs 'tshams su 'dri/ dka' gsang chen smin grol lam zab mos/ /(64na ji sbyor gtsor gyur mkha' mnyam lus can kun/ /'di'am yang srid bdun dang bcu drug las/ /mi 'da' bcu gsum rdo rje'i sar bgrod shog zhar phyogs rdzogs mtshams su 'dri/ /rtag dang chad pa'i mtha' las rnam grol ba/ /chos kun rang bzhin gyis stongs dbu ma'i lam/ /yon sbyor dang bcas 'gro rnams kyis rtogs nas/ /srid rdzun tshang rdib 'khor mtsho las sgrol shog /bye ba phal chen rdzogs mtsham mas su 'dri/ phrag brgya'i rdul rnyed sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhing khamasargya mtshor mtha' med ma rgan tshogs/ /'khrid pa'i sa mkhan byed nus rang rgyud la/ /'jug par rgyal ba kun gyis byin brlabs gsol/ /zab dkon brtsegs rdzogs mtshams su 'dri/cing rgya che 'khor lo mtha' ma'i don/ /bdag sogs skye rgu yongs kyis legs rtogs shing / /snang mtha'i mi 'khrug 'jam dpal zhing khams der/ /srid bzung theg chen chos la longs spyod shog /rtul mdo mang rdzogs mtshams su 'dri/'bring rnon po'i gdul bya 'jug pa'i sgo/ /mchog dman theg pa sna tshogs mdo yi don/ /sman gyi ljon pas sbyin bdag gis mtshon 'gro'i/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa'i gnyen por shog /skye bar 'dul lung rdzogs mtshams su 'dri/ tshul khrims gtsang ma'i zhing sa la/ /thar pa'i myu gu dar drag smin pa'i rtser/ /rnam grol dgra bcom snye mas yongs dud par/ /bdag sogs 'gro rnams longs su spyod gyur cig /ces rgyud/ sher phyogs/ mdo mang / 'dul lung rnams sde tshan so so'i rdzogs mtshams su 'dri rgyu'i smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni mda' dpon bsam dar ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o/ /—83

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)(64bsgo byad mtshan bsil zer tsam gyis srid gdung mun/ /sel na thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor nya rgyas pa/ /dad pa'i yid mkhar shar tshe bde skyid kyi/ /ga bur zeg ma stsol ba'i mchog gsum gyi/ /bden par gsung ba zas gtsang sras kyi bka'/ /lung nod kha ton 'dri klog byang chub par/ /byed por gtogs so cog la yid srub mdas/ /nam yang 'bigs par nus min byin gyis rlobs/ /skye rgu'i sa chen bde byed grib bsil bar/ /thub bstan yongs 'du'i lo 'dabs rab rgyas rtser/ /de 'dzin skyes bu khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde/ /phun tsho gos gos bu'i dpal gyis nyer dud shog /yangs pa'i sal legs byas gser 'khor gyis/ /dbang sgyur sa spyod sku tshe mnga' thang rgyas/ khyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po'i 'di dang phyi'i/ /bsod nams nyi ma'i dngos brgya 'bar bar shog /rgyal gsung thos bsam mchod dang ri mo sa /byed rnams bsrungs bar zhal 'tshes gsang bdag dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i dbang po mtha' dag gis/ /rtag tu grogs byed bkra shis dga' ston stsol/ /zhes pa 'di'ang lha sa byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos rgyud sde thor bu dang / 'dul ba sher phyogs mdo mang rnams gangs ljongs su 'gyur ro cog bzhengs pa'i dus yi ge ba rnams kyis kha rtan du byed rgyu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /dam pa rigs brgya'i thugasarje'i chu rgyun gyis/ /bkra shis chos ldan las nyen dri ma kun/ /rab bkrus bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /rdzus ste skyes nas byang chub 'thob par shog /ces pa 'di'ang sngags ban ngag dbang 'phrin lasakyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /thub bstan 'phel zhing de 'dzin (65na)skyes bu dang / /sa chen byams pas skyong rnams rab tu brtan/ /'jig rten kun bde bdag sogs smon pa rnams/ /'grub par mchog gsum thugs rjesabyin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di'ang lha sa ba spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /dkon mchog rin cen gsum gyi bden pa dang / khyu 'bras rten cing 'brel 'byung slu med mthus//—84—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu spung glegs bam dang po/ zhenaci btab smon lam dpag bsam yongs 'du'i 'bras/ /legs smin ro brgya'i dpal la spyod par shog /ces pa 'di'ang legs gling pas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes bris/ /'jig brgyad las sgrol rgyal yum 'phags ma dang / /dbyer med dpal ldan bla mar gsol 'debs na/ /snying dbus ze'u 'brur rtag bzhugs deng nas bzung / /byang chub bar du 'bral med rjesa'adzin shog /ces pa 'di'ang o rod g.yon ru ā nan+ta'i kha 'a du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /zag med bde chen gar bsgyur thod phreng rtsal/ /stong pa'i rang mdang yid 'dzin 'tsho rgyal gnyis//gang 'dul sna tsho gos sprul pa mtshan brgyad sogs/ /rtsa gsum mkhyen nus thabs shes zung 'jug mthus/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag bshes gto rdo rje 'dzin/ /zur wo chos dbyings rang sar rnam grol ba'i/ /ngo mtshar sprul pa'i sku mchog gangs ljongs 'dir/ /ring min zhabrul med ma rga sum bstan du gsol/ /a nya mi gshigs 'chi ba med pa'i sku/ /rgya chen chos 'khor bskor ba tshangs pa'i gsung //mkhyen brtse nus ldan rdo rje'i thugs mnga' bas/ /bka' gter bstan pa'i (65ba)srog tu 'gyur byin rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di'ang sman sgom 'brang rgyas pa ngag dbang don grub gyis zur chen rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol gyi sprul pa'i sku mchog myur 'byon gyi rten 'brel du dpal phyon yab yum mtshan brgyad rnams bzhengs pa'i gzungs 'bul gyi smon lam du za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /pad+ma thod phreng thugs rje'i nyi zer gyis/ /ngag dbang shes rab phan bde 'dabs brgya'i tshal/ /rab bzhad 'di dang gtan 'dun snang ba'i rtser/ /'bral med snying gi dbus su rtag 'char shog /ces pa'ang za hor gyi bzhes sug bris su byas so/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma sogs/ /dkon mchog gsum 'dus rnam pa spyan ras gzigs/ /bdag la dgyes pa'i tshul sa bzhugs par gyur/ /brgya phrag lus sprul gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing / /dngos lor yid sprul kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul//—85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)byas dang byed bzhin byed 'gyur sdig tshogs bshags/ /srid zhi'i dge tshogs rnams la rjes yi rang //chos 'khor chad pa med par bskor bar bskul/ /bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge ba'i 'bras bu mkha' mnyam sems can rnams/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa thob phyir bsngo/ /bdag sogs snying nas khyed la gsol 'debs na/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gag dang lhan cig tu/ /mgon khyod mngon sum byon nas dag pa'i zhing / /bde ba can gyi gnas su drang du gsol/ /der ni sgrib bral me tog pad+ma'i sbubs/ /brdzus te skye ba blangs nas 'od dpag med/ /sras bcas ma ro zhe sum (srin)mjal zhing dam pa'i chos/ /legs thos theg chen lam gyi rgyud smin shog /gal te sngon bsagasalas ngan stug po yis/ /de 'dra myong ba'i skal bzang ma thob na/ /byang chub snying por ma mi sa min de srid du/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten bzang rnyed par shog /skye bar mgon po khyod kyis bshes mdzad nas/ /chung 'bring lam gyi rgyud sbyang gzhan don du/ smon 'jug sems skyed rgyal sras spyod la bslab/ /ring por mi thogs sangs rgyas thob par shog /mdor na 'di phyi bar do ma lus par/ / skyabs dang dpung gnyen gzhan du mi tshol na/ /'khor 'das kun gyi gdung ba rab bcil nas/ /phan bde'i dpal la spyod par bdag byin rlobs/ /zhes nyams len gyi snying po bsdus pa 'di ni u rang khang bstan 'dzin tho yon gyisabaskul ba ltar ja hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o/ /'phags bod mkhas grub gsung ngag chad med dbang / /mtho ris chu bos blo gros za ma tog /legs gtam sku bzhi'i sa bon rab theb pa'i/ /skal bzang theg mchog snod la gsol ba 'debs/ /lta bar sgro btags gzhan blo brid min pa'i/ /don gyi phyag rgya chen po skyed rdzogs kyi/ /zab lam las 'ongs rang byung ye shes mchoge /dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgra tshad bzo gsonang rig smra ba la/ /'jigs pa'i rngul chu 'gram par mi 'chang bar/ /phyogs med sbyangs pa'i thos bsam go cha can/ /spobs pa dge ba'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /sgrib gnyis kun thub nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan/ /'khrul med zhwa ser 'chang ba'i ring lugs kyi/ /gsar pa'i lang tsho ma nyams dar ba'i —86

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ 6)sde/ /tshangs sras(slob thag pa'i rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /bde ldan dag zhing mgon po'i mdzod spu las/ /'phros pa'i thugs rje'i zer phreng 'od 'bar bas/ /'chi bdag bdud sde'i smag rum mthar byas te/ /ring por 'tsho bzhes snang ba gsal bar shog /bde skyid rtse 'jor rtag tu rol ba'i gzhi/ /legs byas mchog tu yangs pa'i thang chen por/ /lnga brgya'i gnyen du dkon mchog mchod pa'i sde/ /chos srid yon tan bla nas blar 'bar shog /bsod nams rtsa ba sbom por skyed sring ba'i/ 'dod don yongs 'du'i 'bras bus smon lam mtshor/ /nyer lhung re stong dzam+bha chu bo'i gser/ /'gro kun rna ba'i brgyan du 'od 'bar shog /ces gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhesang ga dbang dpal 'byor gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /ma 'dris 'gro ba mtha' dag rjes 'dzin par/ /'char nub med pa'i dam bca' srog gi shing / /srid zhi'i gnyen por skyed pa'i ljon pa'i rtsa/ /rab brtan zas gtsang sras por gsol ba 'debs/ /zab dang rgya che'i gzhung lugs shing rta che/ /dman lam 'dam las 'dren pa'i kha lo ba/ /klu sgrub thog med smra ba'i nyi zla zung / /bstan 'dzin yongs kyi dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /stong nyid sder mos gnyis 'dzin glang po'i srog /yongs phral rkang pa brgyad pa 'phags pa lha/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i mthar son dbyig gi gnyen/ mang rta'i srol 'dzin zung la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshad ma rig pa'i thog mdas rgol ngan brag /phyer 'thag phyogs glang chos grags smra ba'i dbang / /tshul khrims dri ldan yon shāka tsun dan ljon/ /'phags yul mdzes byed rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dri bcas bod yul bstan (67na〉pa khyab 'jug rkang / /dpyad gsum mtho ris chu bos rab bkrus par/ /phyag dang legs so bde bar gshegasakun gyi/ /rab byin mar me mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /ches phra'i na tshod myu gu'i dus nyid nas/ /rgan po'i mkhyen dpyod snye ma yongs smin pas/ /bod yul mkhas mang dbus na zla med pa'i/ /tshad ma'i ston pa tsong kha pa la 'dud/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i gsung rab 'brul med gang / /ston la sangs—87—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rgyas kun gyi rgyal tshab tu/ /dbang skur rnam dpyod lang tsho dar drag pa/ /ma smad rin cen gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngal brgyas 'bad pas sgrub min mgrin pa'i dbus/ /dbyangs can lha mos rgyud mang rtag 'brol bas/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tsho gos la legs bshad rgyun/ /rgya mtsho lta bur spel la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag la smra ba'i dbang thob blo gros kyis/ /don bzang tshigs rling rgyal gsung dgongs 'grel tshogs/ /rgya chen mtsho ltar gting zab dka' ba'i mdud/ /thos brtson sor mos 'grol la gsol ba 'debs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la 'jigs med spobs pa'i ga /rnam dpyod cha shas nya gang zla 'dra yis/ /thub bstan chu gter lang tsho 'phel ba'i sde/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ /skye rgu'i gdung ba'i nad brgya sel ba'i sman/ /bu ram shing pa'i ring lugs rtsi sman ljon/ /byang phyogs sa la'i ljongs 'dir rab rgyas pa'i/ /phan bde'i nags klung stug po 'khrig par shog /khyad par 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa yi/ /chos srid zung 'brel bstan pa'i gdugs dkar po/ /tshangs pa'i yul sar 'khor ba'i grib bsil la/ /yid can mtha' dag ngal gsor spyod par shog /ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i blo gros kyis/ /bskal bzang 'dren pa bzhi pa'i (67ba)bstan pa mchog /rgya mtsho'i gos can kun khyab spel ba'i slad/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje lta bur brtan gyur cig /mes po tshangs pa'i lung gis mang bkur khrir/ /nyer bskos nor 'dzin dbang po mchod yon zung / /sku tshe chab srid mnga' thang dbyar dus kyi/ /chu gter bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas par shog /bod yul gling dgu'i yangs pa'i rgyal khams su/ /nad zhabrug dbul phongs nyes tshogs kun zhi zhing / /ring po'i tshe dang nad med bde ba'i lus/ /'byor pa smugs 'dzin dpal la 'gran nus shog / dga' ba'i dpal ldan zhwa ser lugs 'dzin sder/ /ma smad bshad dang sgrub pa'i bya ba rnams/ /rab 'phel blo bsal mtsho gling ngang mo ltar/ /'dus te legs bshad dbyangs snyan rtag sgrog shog /chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i nam mkha' la/ /chos can rten 'brel mi slu dbang gzhu bzhin/ /'gog med 'char ba'i bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /smon pa'i re ba ma lus 'bras ldan shog /ces gsol 'debs smon lam gyi —88

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanatshigs su bcad pa ma nyung tsam zhig dgos zhes gong dkar thod ri dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling gi slob dpon bzod pa rgya mtsho grwa dmangs dang bcas pas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /dus mun mthar byed smon lam skya rengs kyis/ /'chi med nyin byed dngos 'dren bde ldan mgon//khyod mtshan thos dang gzungs sngags klags tsam gyis/ /'chi bdag las rgyal 'kha 'ches mngon sum ston/ /lusang ga yid gsum rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la/ /rab dbang blo gros ting 'dzin bzang po'i grus/ /bskyed rdzogs rgya mtsho las brgal zung 'jug nor/ /'dren pa'i ded dpon mchog khyod zhabs brtan shog /zhwa ser 'chang (68na tha'i bstan srid bla nas blar/ /'degs pa'i gnam bskos mchode yon nyi zla zung / /sku tshe mnga' thang chab srid dbyar dus kyi/ /chu gter lta bur gyen du 'phyur bar shog /lusacan dga' bder spyod pa'i dpal ldan pa/ /thub bstan snying po gsang sngags 'dus pa' sde/ /theg pa kun gyi yang rtser nyer son pa/ /srid mtha'i bar du dar zhing rgyas par shog /'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa'i ring lugs 'phel/ /yangs pa'i 'jig rten thams cad bde skyid ldan/ /rtsod pa'i dus rnams rdzogs ldan bzhin 'gyur ba'i/ /smon pa'i 'bras dud yongs 'du'i mched slar shog /ces pa 'di'ang yer pa grwa tshang dga' ldan gsang sngags yang rtse spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lcang gseb pa 'jam dbyangs so/ /lta na sdug pa bde ldan dag pa'i gnas/ /ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i zhing gi gtsor gyur mgon/ /mdzod spu'i zer gyis yid srubs smag rum bcil/ /dga' skyid snang bas yongs khyab dge legs stsol/ / lhun grub mkhyen brtse nus mnga' rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gog lam bden pa gnyis ldan dam pa'i chos/ /rig dang grol ba'i dpal gyur dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog rin chen thugs rje'i mthu dpung skyed/ /rigs gsum sgyu dra'i sa skyong mes dbon gsum/ /gangs can bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhan slob gnyis/ /ra sar sri zhu zla med tsong kha pa/ /sgrib med spyan gyis rtag tu btsa' bar mdzod/ /chos nyid —89

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'gyur ba med pa'i lha lam dbyings/ /chos can rten cing 'brel 'gyung chu 'dzin las/ /slu med bden pa'i mi 'dzad char rgyun gyis/ /ji bzhin smon pa'i myu gu g.yur zar shog /brjod pa rnam dag dmod pa gang bor (68ba)ba/ /thog med 'grub pa'i lha mi'i drang srong dang / /rigs 'dzin sar bzhugs mthu stobs can rnams kyis/ /bden pa'i tshigs gis smon lam gdab tu gsol/ /phan dang bde ba ma lus 'byung ba'i sgo/ /don kun 'grub pa shākya'i ring lugs spyi/ khyad par zhwa ser cod paṇa 'chang ba'i bstan/ /'jig rten snang byed sgron mer 'bar gyur cig /dri med rnam gsum 'khor lo'i mdzad bzang gis/ /rgyal bstan tshul bzhin mngon gyur bag la zhas/ /'dzin mdzad grags pa don ldan bshes gnyen rnams/ /zhabs brtan ches dkar 'phrin las rgyas gyur cig /'phags bod mkhas grub gsung ngag 'chad pa la/ /rab dbang blo gros mchog gi skal bzang can/ /rgya chen sde gnod gsum gyi gnad grol bar/ /mtsho byung snying gar rol gang zhabs brtan shog /tshe ring gnam gyi she mong dpung pa yis/ /mnga' 'bangs skyid pa'i nyi ma dgung 'char ba'i/ /mchod yon nyi zla zung gi sku tshe dang / /mtshan jus mnga' thang dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog /srid na gtogs so cog gi lus can spyi/ /bye brag gangs can swā la'i ljongs kyi 'gro/ /legs byas 'bras bu rdzogs ldan skye rgu dang / /lhan cig longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang shog /khyad par tshong zong skyed 'phel rgyu ba'i las/ /mi rgyu son ma gos bu dus su smin/ /phan tshun mnyes gshin 'thab rtsod mtshang 'bru med/ /yams nad 'tshe bral sgo gsum bde ldan shog /yang sgos lha cig srong btsan ba ched pa ltar/ shwakya'i pho brang 'phrul snang sdebacas su/ /mtha' bzhi'i las sgo ma lus kun 'du ba/ /smug 'dzin dbang po'i mdzod la 'gran nus shog /kyi lus nyer 'bad mgrin pa'i rgyud mangs las/ /legs drangs bden pa'i tshig tu brjod pa'i glu/ /rtse gcig yid (69na)kyi sor mos legs bskul ba'i/ /dbyangs snyan rtag tu rna ba'i bcud len shog /ces chos 'khor lha sa ba spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba la brten nas jo shāka gi mchod 'bul sogs rnam dkar gyi bya ba dang srid kyi 'dod don bsgrub pa sogs gang gi tshe yang bston chog pa'i smon lam rab snyan rgyud mangs —ga

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhena'adi'ang za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ shākya mu ni'i zhal skyin mjal ba sogs/ /dbus gtsang dag zhing yang yang bskor ba la/ /yid la bsam pa sngi bzhin mchog gsum gyi/ /thugs rje chen pos lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang dpon mo tshe ring gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brjes bris/ /kun rgyud 'bus la 'dri/ la khyab par 'asngug pa rang sems rkang / /smin grol mtho ris chu bo'i lhab lhub rtser/ /zung 'jug tog gi 'od stong cher 'bar ba'i/ /rgyal mtshan theg kun khang bzang rtser 'dzugs shog /chags sher phyogs la 'dri/ sdang zhabrul pa'i nags klung sdug po kun/ /mtha' bral lam bzang zhugs kyi nyer bsregs pas/ /'khor ba'i 'brog dgon 'khrigs pa dang bral te/ /zhi ba'i spangs ljongs yangs par bder spyod shog /stong das gyes la 'dri/ phrag brgya pa'i le'u gangs ldan can/ /ches dkon mchog gi theg pa yongs rtsegs pa/ /bris 'bras 'od dpag med dang mi zhakhrugs pa/ /zhing khams bstan pa ji bzhin der skye shog /45cho la 'dri/ nyan rang kun dang thun mong ma yin pa/ tshen tu dge ba'i sde snod phal mo che/ /'khor lo mtha' ma'i yang zab snying po'i don/ /tshe rabasakun tu nyams su len nus shog /skye lo mang la 'dri/ rgu'i khams dang bsam pa'i tshad de snyed/ /nyon mongs gnyen por gsungs pa drang nges chos/ /(69bsgo cho go dman dang mtshams rtsi sman ljon pa ches/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong nad kun drungs tshwan shog /rang snyul lung la 'dri/ rgyud tha rgod ltar rengs glang po che/ /tshul khrims lcags kyu gnyen pos nyer btab nas/ /bag yod ra bar bcug ste yongs dul bar//ting 'dzin shes rab gser rgyan gyis spras shog /'dir bstan po ti re re 4sto la smon snyo dgos mdog ma gang byed tshe 'di kha 3bas pas sa pa yod/ brjod tshigs thos pa sa bon tshogs/ /don bsams char gyis skyed bsrings myu gu rnams/ /bsgoms pa'i snye ma smin pas rang rgyud zhing / /gshin por tshe rabs so nam byed par shog /ces rgyud/ sher phyogs/ mdo mang / lung sdo bzhi sogs so so'i rdzogs mtshams su 'dri rgyu'i smon lam 'di'ang phyag mdzod phun tshogs rab brtan gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /chad med rgyud 'bum la 'dri/dbang chus rang sems zhing sa brlan/ /'khrul med sku bzhi'i sa —91—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bon rgyud la btab/ /gnyis med bskyed rdzogs lam gyi dmar khrid nor/ /'bad med phung po 'od skur grol bar shog shes rab sher mas la 'a/ mtshon cha rnon pos nye ni sgrib srog /rab bcad bcings lasarnam par grol ba'i lam/ /gtan du bde ba zhi ba'i grong khyer gyi/ /'jug ngog yangs pa'i lam bzang brnyed par shog yid das ga smos la 'dri/ bzhin nor ltar ches dkon mchog gi lam/ /sa bcu rim brtsegasal 'dzegs sangs rgyas sar/ /bgrod nus zab las ches zab theg pa che/ /dgongs don 'khrul pa med par nyams len shog /shin tu phal chen la 'dri/ rgyas pa chen po'i sde snod gzhung / /theg chen thun mong ma yin phal po che/ /bzhengs pas bzang por spyod pa las byung ba'i/ /smon lam 'i 'bras bu ro brgya bdag myong shog /phra rag mdo mang la 'dri las/ gos mi bslur nges pa brnyed/ /las nyen bag la zha ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ /(70na〉de gshegs snying po kun khyab gru gzings kyis/ /bla med ye shes rin chen gling bgrod shog /rnam dag 'dul lung la 'dri/ tshul khrims ma la ya rlung gis/ /phra rgyas tsha gdung mngon gyur rab bcil nas/ /rang rgyud 'dul ba sde bzhi'i dgong don bzhin/ /tshe rabs kun tu bag dang ldan par shog /ces gzer chen pas bka' 'gyur bzhengs skabs rgyud 'bum sogs sde tshan so so'i 'jug la 'dri rgyu'i smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /yan lag bdun pa dang 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs tshig nyung la don rgyas pa sogs/ /ba sti mā pa smyu su kha ba shu dhi snyi tu ho rgya sa k+ṣa tri tsa na ni dha toḥ /nub phyogs bde ba kun ldan dag pa'i gnas/ /bkod legs ngo mtshar sprul pa'i zhing khams nas/ /no : ngu si dzñā u ra tha rna ma n+ti ka ru ṇa dī nywa skyi ga se da pa shu/—92

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zheda'achi med grub pa'i mgon po tshe mtha' yas/ /thugs rje'i spyan dkyus ring pos deng 'dir gzigs/ /(70bsgo tho ris 'od gsal lha yi gdung gis btsun/ /nor 'dzin sa la spyod pa stobs kyi mche//ya rabs sgrigs srol gong ma'i rgyan gyis mdzes/ /nor 'dzin skyong ba'i dbang po zhabs brtan shog /ngag dbang dbyangs can lha mo'i yab gyur pa/ /dga' ba brgya pa la sogs legs bris gtsos/ /stobs ldan mi yi bdag por dbang bskur ba/ /rdo rje lta bur rab tu brtan par shog /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang grags pa zhes/ /zhwa ser 'chang ba dga' ldan ring lugs mchog /snying dbus theg ler 'dzin la rab brtan pa/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i khri la g.yo med shog /rgyal kun thugs rje bskul ba'i tsha sreg gis/ /byin rlabs bzhu blug srog gi ka ba yi/ /thabs shes a nya nyi zla 'pho med du/ /zung 'jug mngon sum 'phel grib med par shog /geg 'phreng chom po'i 'jig las bsu ba'i grogs/ /bden tshig rtul phod dpa' bo stag shar gyis/ /'jigs med btsan po'i mkhar du rab bskyal te/ /'di nang bag phebs rtse dga' dgod gyur cig /lha cig zhabs brtan bka' drin nyi zer gyis/ /mnga' 'bangs pad dkar rdzing bu ches cher dar/ /log spyod gnyis 'thung gom pa mi 'god par/ /skyid pa'i bung ba glu dbyangs len par shog /mtshun lhas me long 'dzin pa snying gi las/ /thung ngur byed pa bskal brgyar 'tsho ba'i tshe/ /smon lam ci btab 'grub pa dkon mchog gsum/ /lha dang drang srong srung mas bdag byin rlobs/ /zhes 'od gsal lha yi gdung sa skyong rgya ri ba ngag dbang dga' ldan rab brtan gyi dgung gag la dmigs pa'i brtan bzhugs 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes rnam rgyal rab brtan gzhis stod a bar dgos dgos kyis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi brnyes (71na spur ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus dkon mchog rnam gsum la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul zhing sdig tshogs bshags/ /mdzad par yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhugs/ /sku gsung thugs kyis bdag rgyud byin brlabs nas/ /'di phyi'i gtan 'dun 'grub par gsol ba 'debs/ /bsags dang gsog 'gyur sgrub pa'i dge ba —93

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rnams/ /mkha' mnyam ma gyur sems can don du bsngo/ /zhes yan lag bdun pa dang 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs tshig nyung la don rgyas 'di ni chos skyabs tha yan chis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes bris/ /grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba thang stong pas/ /byin rlabs nyi zla ltar gsal 'gro kun la/ /'jug pa'i dga' ston bsod nams bye ba'i gter/ /dbang phyug dam pa'i sprul pa myur byon shog /kun bzang dga' chen khyab bdag he ru gaḥ /lus can bsod nams zhing du ngur smig gar/ /legs bsgyur dbang phyug brgyad ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /zhing 'dir gzugs sku'i bkod pa myur ston shog /ngag dbang spobs pa dge ba'i nyi zla zung / /'khor mun gdung sel slad du dpal 'bar ba/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar yol med pa'i/ tsheng rta chad med rtag tu rgyu bar shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog rin cen gsum/ /bstan srung dbang phyug gur mgon gdong bzhi pa/ /lha dang drang srong rig pa 'dzin rnams kyis/ /ji ltar smon pa 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces grub pa'i dbang phyug lcags zam sprul pa'i sku bsod nams dbang phyug gi sprul pa'i sku zhing 'dir myur (71ba)du 'byon pa'i smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes dam pa gang de'i zhams ring ba rnams kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /rab gsal ye shes spyan bdun g.yel med du/ /gzigs nas 'chi bdag bdud sdomathar mdzad pa/ /rgyal yum yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe sbyin ma/ /rmad byung thugs rje chen po'i mthu dpung bskyed/ /ngag dbang zur phud lnga pa mi'i gzugs su/ /'gro la ston mdzad blo bzang grags pa yi/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gos can mtha' snyed du/ /spel phyir yongs 'dzin bla ma zhabs brtan shog /bgrang yas rgyal ba'i gsung rab mang thos shing / /de don bsam pas gtan la 'bebs mkhas sde/ /dbyar mtsho lta bur dar drag rab rgyas te/ /'dzam gling kun gyi rgyan du 'gyur bar shog /mar gad gdangs 'dzin 'khor ba las sgrol mas/ /ring po'i phyag brkyangs bdag sogs sems can rnams/ /'jig chen brgyad las rab bskyabs dbug dbyung ste/ /nges par legs pa'i lam la 'khrid du gsol/ /sgo gsum bag dang —94

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ 'daldan pas tshul khrims gtsang / /dngos stobs rigs pas rgol ngan spobs pa 'phrog /lung don thub gsung dgongs pa ji bzhin du/ /bkral te bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /ces ring por 'tsho ba'i rten 'byung gi tshigs su bcad pa 'di'ang thos bsam dar rgyas gling gi slob dpon 'dus pa'i sde dang bcas pa rnams kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam/ dbyangs so/ /tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i chu gter cher/ /brtson pa'i (72na)ri bo sgril las yongs thon pa'i/ /mtshan dpe'i 'od gzis 'khor mun gzhil mdzad pa/ /thub bstan nyin mor byed la gsol ba 'debs/ /snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje si rgyu'i mtshor/ /ngo mtshar sprul sku'i sgyu dra'i gar mkhan can//'dzam gling brtul zhugs grub pa'i rig sngags 'chang / /phyon sangs rgyas gnyis par gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang lha yis rjes bzung blo gros la/ /spyod pa'i skal bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sde//bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug rdo rje'i rnal 'byor can/ /gang shar rang sar grol la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sogs/ /skyabasaganas ma lus 'dus pa'i ngo bo sa /grangs med lus sprul gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhun po gling bzhi gling phran lcags ri yis/ khor yug gcig gyur nyi zla zung du 'jug /phun tshogs lha mi'i 'byor pas yongs gang ba'i/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /thog med 'khor bar 'khyam pa de srid nas/ /da lta yan chad bsags pa'i nag po'i las/ /kun la gnong 'gyod phyin chad sdom sems kyis/ /bcos min bsam pa thag pas mthol lo bshags/ /srid dang zhi ba'i khongs 'dir rnam dkar las/ /skye 'phags gang gis bsgrubs zin sgrub 'gyur dang / /da ltar mdzad pa mthong thos rjes dpag nas/ /dga' dang spro ba'i sems kyis yi rang ngo/ /lus can bsam pa'i khyad par mtha' (72ba)klas pa/ /de snyed dang mtshungs nyon mongs 'dul ba'i gnyen/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo chad med du/ /rgyal sras slob mar bcas pas bskor bar bskul/ /snyigs ma lnga bdo ngan —95—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)pa'i spyod tshul la/ /mgon rnams skyo ngal spangs te lhag par yang / /thugs rje'i mthu dpung bskyed de 'gro 'dren slad/ /bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /gnas skabs su yang nad gdon bar gcod sogs/ /'khor ba'i zug rngu nam yang mi ldang zhing / /ring po'i tshe dang dpal 'byor phun tshogs rnams/ /'chi med bdag po'i rjes su 'gro bar shog /myur du srid pa 'bor ba'i phrang ring po/ /brgal te gtan gyi bde ba bla na med/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan rdo rje sems/ /mngon gyur don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /sgo gsum 'bad pas bsags pa'i chos dkar las/ /ma lus rang don kho na'i ched min par/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam ma rgan 'gro ba'i tshogs/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa thob rgyur bsngo/ /nam yang slu med dkon mchog rin cen gyis/ /thog mtha' bar du rtag par rab dge ba/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis rgya mtsho yis/ /'khor 'das kun la yongs su khyab par shog /ces bde chen khang gsar ba nor bus dad rten gyi sku brnyan gsum bzhengs pa bsod nams kyi yul du byas pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /phrag (73na)dog dag pa'i dbyings las 'du byed kyi/ /phung po gnas gyur bye ba lhun grub pa'i//ye shes thugs rje'i nyi mas 'khor ba'i mun/ /rab gsang mtho ris snang ba gsal byin rlobs/ /skye bar bsags pa'i bsod nams myu gu'i tshogs/ /smon lam rlan gsher drod kyis rab bskyed pas/ /mngon mtho nges legs snye ma dar drag par/ /rab smin rgyas pa'i 'bras bus dud par shog /srid zhi'i mthar lhung 'dam rdzab chen po las/ /dge tsho gos shing rta stong gis rab drangs te/ /bla med ye shes grong khyer nyams dga' bar/ /ma rgan 'gro rnams 'asdug pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di'ang skyar po ba blo bzang legs ldan gyis pha'i don du don grub kyi sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig tu smon lam zhig dgos zhesabaskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o/ /dpal ldan thang pa'i chos dang srid kyi rigs/ /legs 'dzin ngag gi dbang phyug 'gro kun la/ /—96

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rang dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanam smad dga' ston 'bad med lhun grub tu/ /stsol des 'dis mtsho ni dus gsum bsags pa'i dges/ /rgyal rnams bzhed pa'i dam bca'i khur lci ba/ /nam yang gtong min lhag bsam gru gzings kyis/ /mkha' mnyam ma rgan 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /sgrol ba'i ded dpon chen por 'gyur bar shog /'di snang ring po'i tshe dang phun tsho gos stobs/ /'tshe med bdag po'i rjes su nyer 'gro zhing / /yang srid rgyud mar phan bde'i them skas la/ /'dzegs nas bla med ye shes myur thob shog /ces(73bskog lung zhabs drung ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub kyi thugs dam thang sku'i rgyab yig tu 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes gsung gisabaskul ba bzhin za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /bde ldan 'od mtshan mtshan dpes mdzes pa'i zhing / /zhing mchog rnam 'dren 'dren pa 'od mi 'gyur/ /'gyur med sku tshe tshe mtha' yas pa'i mgon/ /mgon gyi thugs rjes rjes su 'dzin par mdzod/ /ngag la smra ba'i spobs pa dge ba'i dbang / /dbang phyug blo gros ches bzang lhag pa'i sems sems can yongs la rab dkar 'phrin las rgyun/ khyun chad med par rtag tu 'jug par shog zhas bya'i rgya mtshor 'jigs med thos brtson zung / /zung 'jug go cha'i gzings kyis thub bstan gling / /gling yangasabader bgrod spangs rtogs lang tsho'i dpyid/ /dpyid kyi dpal mo'i dga' ston bzhad par shog /chos nor 'dod dang thar pa sde bsto sgo/ /sgo 'phar las 'ong rdzogs ldan phan bde'i nor/ /nor bu dbang rgyal ji bzhin bsam pa'i don/ /don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces gzhan 'dres med pa'i brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes e gzims shag byang ma ba mgon po rab brtan gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /bskal bzang 'di la sras bcas rgyal ba yi/ /mgrin gcig mchog gi snying stobs la bsngagasapa/ /(74na sko yi lhar gyur shākya seng ge zhes/ /don kun grub pa'i dpal der gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi mgur nas gsung pa'i chos phung che/ /'khrul med tshul bzhin sdud mdzad dgra bcom dang / /—97—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)shing rta chen po klu sgrub thog med sogs/ /'phags yul paṇa grub rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgo gsum bag yod dri bsung ches mang ra ba/ /tshul 'chal tsha ba'i reg bya mthar bcil ba'i/ /sdom rtson ma la ya rlung dbang po che/ /paṇa chen shākya shrī la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi ring lugs ru bzhi'i rgyal khamadze su/ /spel ba'i 'phrin las sgo brgya 'byed mdzad pa/ /byang rdor rnam gnyis rjes 'brang rnam par thar/ /gtsang ma'i mkhan brgyud tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rigs gsum sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar mkhan gzugs/ /'jam mgon 'khon gyi me long ngos shar ba'i/ /yab sras rnam gsum khu dbon don yod pa/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i phul/ /ngur smrig gar sgyur blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /sras kyi thu bo dar ma rin chen sogs/ /bstan 'dzin mu tig phreng bar gsol ba 'debs/ /brjod pa rnam dag ngag gi rgyud mangs sgra//legs drangs mkhas dbang brtan pa 'phrog pa'i glus/ /blo chen mes po'i rjes 'gro skal bzang rnams/ /chos tshul rgya mtshos 'dod 'jor gsol ba 'debs/ /mang thos khrims ldan 'dus pa'i tshogs rnamasakyis/ /mchog gsum dpang (74ba)por byas te rtse gcig tu/ /gsol btab 'bras bu bshes gnyen dam pa khyod/ /rdo rje'i khri la bskal brgyar brtan par shog /gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag tsong kha pa'i/ /chos srid ring lugs dzā ti'i 'bras smin nas/ /za 'og thags su bskrun pa'i rgyal khams bar/ /spel mdzad yongs 'dzin bla ma zhabs brtan shog /chen po bod kyi gzhir 'khod skye rgu yi/ /gnya' bar rab lci sa spyod bka' yi rtags/ /me long gdong gi rnam par thar pa bzhin/ /gnam gyi she mong drang thig 'debs par shog /sa 'og sa steng sa blar rgyu ba dang / /mi rgyu'i skye rgu kun gyi sgo gsum la/ /bde ba'i ro brgya myong ba mtho ris kyi/ /dpal mo'i khengs pa yongs su 'phrog par shog /tshul khrims gtsang ma'i zhing sa gshin po la/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i snye ma g.yur za ba/ /jo bo stan gcig dpal ldan tshogs kyi sde/ /srid mtha'i bar du 'phel zhing rgyas par shog /dri med ga smi ra pa'i paṇa chen gyi/ /rnam dag sdom pa'i rgyun gyis gangs can 'di/ /yongs khyab thub bstan rin chen mi pham mgon/ /gling —98

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhana'adir 'byon min bar du dar gyur cig ྅sa ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung gi tshigs su bcad pa zhig dgosazhes paṇa chen shākya shrī'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i rtse tshogs kyi mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang sa dge spyi sos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus 'dir thugs rje'i mthu/ /ches cher ston mdzad mgon po bde gshegasabadun/ /zas (75na gi tsang sras bcas brtse ba'i spyan gyi zur/ /lhung ba'i mod la nyes brgya'i gdung sel mdzod/ /tshul gnas thos pa'i kun bzod cher yangs pa/ /'degs la snying stobs rgya mtsho ltar zab gang / /'khor ba'i gnas las brgyal te be+e ḍūrla/ /ngo mtshar snang ba'i zhing du srid 'dzin shog /dri med smon lam dag pa'i sa bon tshogs/ /yongs su smin pa'i a smra'i ljon pa yi/ /phan bde'i 'dab stong grib tu nyer bsil bar/ /gnas te bla med 'bras bur longs spyod shog /ces pa 'di'ang slob dpon bzod pa rgya mtsho'i nye du rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /mtshan bzang mdzod spu'i zer snang 'phros tsam gyis/ /'chi bdag bdud mun mthar byed gar gyi dbang / /bde ldan zhing nas 'dzam gling skye rgu la/ /ri dkyusang dgyes spyan rtag tu gzigs par mdzod/ /gaṅgā'i yab gcig mdzes pa 'phrog pa'i sku/ /legs bris lus phra'i gzugs kyi 'jo sgeg can/ /mchog sbyin phyag rgyas 'gro la tshe sbyin ma/ /bcom ldan yid bzhin 'khor los rtag tu bsrungs//yid srub sde las rnam par rab rgyal ma/ /phyag zor gyis bteg rin chen bum bzang gi /bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis yid can ma lus pa'i/ /mi shig srog gi ka ba legs tshugs mdzod/ /a 'dus/phreng brjod pa ngag gi gdangs/ /thub dbang gsung rab tshig gi sgrar shar ba/ /blo bsal rnar 'bab don bzang rgya mtshoche/ /snying gi 'dzin mar 'khyil byed rab brtan shog /khrims(75bsko nyis lcid kyis mtshan pa'i sagazhi'i bzhin/ /rdzogs ldan rngul chu'i mu tig 'phreng mdzes pa/ /stsol byed mchod yon sa dbang nyi zla zung / /sku tshe chab srid mnga' thang rgyas par shog /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par gangs ljongs 'dir/ /mi phyugs—99

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)nad 'tshe 'byug rtsod dbul phongs sogs//dus kyi chad pa kun zhi 'chi med lha'i//bde skyid mngon sum nyams su myong bar shog/chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i kun gsal ngos//chos tso rten 'brel mi bslu rgyu 'bras gnyis//srid zhi'i dge legs snang ba bla nas blar//'bar ba'i phun tshogs dga' ston 'phel bar shog/ces bden pa'i tshigs tu brjod pa'i smon lam 'di ni pho brang bsam grub rtse'i mnga' 'bangs spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so//ngag dbang lhag pa'i lha mo yis//rjes su bzung ba'i blo gros mthus//bskal bzang gdul bya rgya mtsho yi//re ba skong la gsol ba 'debs//rgya che zab mo'i lam rnams kun//bstan nas lus can nges legs su//'dren mdzad dngos dang brgyud pa yi//yongs 'dzin tsho gos la gsol ba 'debs//gsang 'dus zla ba'i cod paṇa lha//ma he'i zhal can gyis mtshon pa'i/khyud sdebazhi yi dkyil 'khor che'i//lha tsho gis rnams la gsol ba 'debs//mar me mdzad dang shākya'i rgyal//mi pham pa sogs dusagasum du//byon zin 'byon dang 'byon 'gyur dang //bde gshegs kun la gsol ba 'debs//zasagatsang sras po bcu gnyis lor/7na/bslebs pa'i sku tshad gser gyi lha//mthong bas don ldan snang bas mchog shwakya mu nir gsol ba 'debs/khur phud lnga ldan 'jig rten dbang //lag na rdo rje legs byin ma//la sogs rgyal sras mthu bo che//byang sems tshogis la gsol ba 'debs//bya rog ma dang myur mdzad mgon//gur zhal dud gsol dmag gzor mas//mtshon pa'i dam pa chos skyong ba'i//srung ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs//skyabs mgon lus pa med pa la//sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing //dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa 'bul//nag po'i tshogs kun snying nas bshags//bdag gzhan dge la yi rang zhing //chos 'khor rgyun chad med skor bskul//mya ga mi 'dar bzhugs gsol 'debs//legs byas byang chub chen por bsngo/khyad par thog med tshe rabs nas//da lta'i bar du sdig pa'i tshogs//rang gis bsags shing 0gzhan dag bskul//mthong thos rnams la yi rang

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenasogs/ /bsags pa'i nyes tshogos ma lus pa/ /mi 'chab mi sped yongs bsgrags te/ /snying nas bshags so slan chad srog /phyir yang mi bya'i sdom sems bgyid/ phyag skor bzlas brjod gsol 'debs dang / /dad pa snying rje ting nge 'dzin/ /bsgom zhing mchod pa sbyin gtong sogs/ /dge tsho gos rang gis dngos su bsgrub/ /g.yin dag nus pas de la sbyor/ /thabs kyis legs bskul ngang tshul dang / /mtshudas par spyod pa'i rnam par thar/ /rnar son mngon sum gyur pa la/ /bdag gis lag tu bstar ba dang / /(7ba)mnyam pa'i dga' bde'i spro shugs sogs/ /bsod nams phung po ci bsag mthus/ /'di nang rdzogasaldan dga' ston thob/ /mtha' med srid pa'i lam ring por/ /bgrod tshe gnas ga len spongs zhing / /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon gyis zin/ /dri med rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal/ /thos bsam sgom pa lhur blangs pas/ /mkha' mnyam ma rgan sems can ched/ /ring por mi thog chos gzugs sku/ /thob nas 'gro ba 'dren par shog /ces nged rang gi ming sgra yod pa dang / lam rim brgyud pa sogs bla ma spyi gnyis so so/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs yi dam/ dus gsum sangs rgyas spyi dang jo shāka so so/ rigs gsum mgon po/ sgrol ma sogs byang sems spyi/ phyag bzhi drug gur zhal/ lha mo rje khol sogs chos skyong spyi rnams la blo ka res 'thus pa' gsol 'debs yan lag bdun pa spyi dang / bye brag sdig bshags gnyis so sor blo ka gnyis re/ smon lam blo ka lnga rnams yod pa'i lha sar zhabs skor bsag dus zhal 'don mdzad rgyu zhig dgos zhes dpon sa chos ldan dbang mos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o/ /dkon mchog gsum 'dus pad+ma thod phreng gi /thugs rje'i 'od kyis sna tsho gos 'khor 'das cho me/ /rang sar grol ba'i yang srid gangs ljongs 'dir/ /'khrul med myur du 'byung bar byin gyis rlomes/ /zhes pa 'di ni bla ma sna tshogs rang grol gyi grwa rigs rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni (77na slong khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o/ /ngag la smra ba'i rtsal ldan rkang sen zla/ /rnam dpyod dbang phyug ral pa'i rtser shar tshe/ /blo chen —10/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rgan po chos bzang bdag po sogs/ /'gro kun bsnyen srid med pa'i sri zhu spel/ /som nyi'i rgya bral dwangs mtshor byad bzhin ltar/ /chos kun gnas lugs mthong la mi 'jigs pas/ /yod med mtha' bral lta dang lhag bsam go /cha shas gang ba'i zla ba ji bzhin 'phel/ /thub pa'i bzhed gzhungs blo bzang grags pa'i bstan/ /thos bsam me tog ma rnyigs chun po yis/ /skal ldan lang tsho dar ba'i thod chings su/ /spel mkhas 'chi med sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog gsum thugs rje bskul ba'i bden tshigs bzhin/ /phun tshogs rten 'byung sgo brgya 'grig pa'i khri/ /mi phyed dad pa'i gzer gyisayongs btab par/ /mgon khyod bskal brgyar yun ring bzhugs gyur cig /bsod nams gser gyi 'khor los yangs pa'i sar/ /dbang bsgyur skye rgu'i bdag po mchod yon zung / /nyi zla dang mnyam ring 'tsho'i sku tshe yis/ /chab 'bangs bde skyid snang ba ches 'bar shog /bu ram shing pa'i rjes su nyer zhugs kun/ /tshul gnas rtsa ba rab brtan thos bsam gyi/ /yal 'dabs rab rgyas sgom ba'i 'bras dud pa'i/ /dpag bsam yongs 'du'i mched zlar 'gyur bar shog /khyad par gser mdog zhwa yi cod paṇa gyi/ /gzi byin nyi ma 'bum phrag lus 'dzin pas/ khams gsum nyes brgya'i mun pa drung phyung ste//nges par legs pa'i 'od kyis khyab par shog /rgyal gsung (77ba/sna grel par bcas la brgal brtag gis/ /dpyad don nyams su bstar gos dga' bde'i dpal/ /legs ldan 'og min dag pa'i gling yangs por/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub smon mthar phyin shog /mchog dman yongs kyi phrag par rab lci ba/ /drang thig gser gyi gnya' shing 'dzin ri yi/ /mang bkur rgyal po'i bka' btags mngon sum du/ /rtsod ldan yid can kun gyis nyams myong shog /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par bod yul 'dir//rdzogs ldan rjes 'gro'i bde skyid dpal la spyod/ /ring min 'gro rnams kun mkhyen ye shes che/ /'thob phyir bsags pa'i dge tsho gos ma lus bsngo/ /dkon mchog yon tan brjod pa rnam dag glu/ /snyan gyur rgyud mangs sgra las nyer drangs dang / /lhan cig me tog man+da ra yi char/ /yongs babs phyogs dus kun tu bkra shis shog /ces gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs smon lam dang bcas pa'i blo ka bcu gcig yod —102

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanapa zhig dgos zhes dga' ldan 'og min gling pa'i slob dpon bstan pa rgya mtshos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o/ /gsung ngag chad med dbang bzhis mos ldan blo/ /legs smin skal bzang rgya mtshor bsgyur byed pa/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems pa'i ngo bo mā /sgo 'don pa bsgyur na/ sgo gsum gus pa sgo nas ma chad pa 'bul/ /gsal ba'i spyan sngar sdig lhung ma lus bshags/ /dpang por byas te rang gzhan dge la rang / /mngon sum bstan nas chos 'khor skor bar bskul/ /sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs/ /g.yo med mya ngan mi 'dar bzhugs su gsol/ /sgo gsum gus pas gso le (7ni) 'debasabadag byin rlobs/ /mes blos bsag pa'i dge tsho gos byang chub bsngo/ /gsum gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes tshig rkang phyi ma 'di gang 'dod du 'don pa bsgyur chog pa cig dgos zhes bzo dang gso ba rtsis skar nag sogs la blo gros kyi 'jug pa rgyas pa'i 'byom sding pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba ltar zla hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o/ /yangs pa'i byang phyogs hor gyi rgyal khams su/ /dga' ldan ming 'dzin sa skyong mi yi rje/ /mchog gsum thugs rjes bde ba can zhing du/ /drangs te pad+ma'i sbubs su skye bar shog /gar dbang snang mtha' yas pa'i mgon po yi/ /mngon sum zhal mthong tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan pos/ /theg chen zab dang rgya che dam pa'i chos/ /legs bstan de don nyams su longs par shog /tshogs sbyor lam gyi rkang stegs la brten nas/ /sa bcu'i rin cen them skas rim 'dzegs te/ /rnam par grol ba mchog gi sgo phye nas/ /mi gnas myang 'das khang par 'jug par shog /chos gzugs zung 'jug nges pa lnga ldan sku/ /'og min zhing las 'pho 'gyur med bzhin du/ /sna tsho gos sprul pa'i rol gar mtha' klasapas/ /mkha' mnyam lus can kun gyi mgon byed shog /chos nyid dag pa don dam 'gyur med chos/ /chos can rgyu 'bras 'ja' mtshon ltar bkra ba'i/ /slu med rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i mthus/ /smon lam btabs pa ji bzhin lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di'ang hor gyi rgyal khams chen por stobs kyi —103—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dbang phyug dga' ldan (78ba)pa dus kyi chos nyid du gyur skabs skyid shod sprul sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o/ /gang shar kun rdzob chos rnams rig pa'i dbyings/ /rang sar grol ba'i che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/ /ngag dbang blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sder/ /mi phyed dad pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /a nya srog gi ka ba khyu ti'i rtsa/ /gzhom med rdo rje'i khams su legs grub nas/ /lnga ldan longs sku ji bzhin rtag bzhugs par/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i mthu yis 'grub byin rlobs/ /bdag sogs grangs med skye bar mgon khyod kyi/ /'khor gyur rjes su bzung nas zab rgyas chos/ /nyams su blangasate zung 'jug rdo rje la'o / /ring por mi thog mngon du 'gyur bar shog /ces gsol 'debs smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis don gnyer chen pos bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /gar dbang mdzod spu nas spros zer phreng 'od/ /stong phrag nyi ma bzhu ba'i gzi byin gyis/ /'chi bdag smag rum ming gi lhag mar yang / /rnyed skabs bral te tshe byin rlob tu gsol/ /ngag dbang 'jam mgon blo yi lang tsho'i dpyid/ /dar drag mtshan bzang dpe byad 'bar ba'i sku/ /mgrin pa'i 'khor lor 'gying bas rig pa'i gnas/ /rgya mtsho'i pha mthar bgrod la gsol ba 'debs/ /(79na)chos kun gdod nas stongs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /chos can rgyu 'bras nyi zla zung 'brel bas/ /bskal brgyar g.yo med bzhugs gsal sa bon tshogs/ /re ba ji bzhin smin par byin gyis rlobs/ /gnam gyi she mong dpung pas sa chen la/ /dbang bsgyur mi yi bdag po mchod yon zung / /zhabasabartan chab srid nya chen khog yangs por/ /mnga' 'bangs phan bde'i mu tig 'phyur bar shog /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par kha ba'i ljongs/ /bye brag phyogs 'di'i dgon gnas grong khyer ba/ /mtha' dag bde skyid —104—

wa smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sog kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenastegs la ngal gso zhing / /ring min kun mkhyen ye shes 'thob par shog khes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni rong rin spungs mnga' khul gyi chos gzhag dang drung gzims spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /tshe dpag med mgon phyag gi bum pa las/ /legs 'bab 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs spu'i dpal be'ur/ /rab 'khyil mi shig srog gi ka ba tshugs/ /rgyal kun ngo bo blo bzang grags pa yi/ /thub bstan shar phyogs ljon pa'i tshal chen por/ /spel zhing 'dzin mkhas bshes gnyen dam pa mchog /rdo rje lta bur g.yo med zhabs brtan shog /zhwa ser mnab pa'i chos skyong srung ma dang / /khyad par 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma tis/ /mgon 'di bskal brgyar bzhugs nasagadul bya'i tshogs/ /'dod pa'i re ba bskong ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dwags po dga' ldan rab brtan gyi mkhan po sgom mda' chos rje blo (79ba)bzang bstan 'dzin gyi brtan bzhugs 'di ni se ra theg chen gling du sdod mi'i grwa rigs rnams kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o/ /slu med mchog gsum thugs rje'i bden tshig gis/ /ngag dbang 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa yi/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho'i pha mthar yongs spel ba'i/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes khyod zhabs brtan shog /blo ldan skal bzang yid kyi mun pa kun/ /dam pa'i chos kyi sgron mes rab gsal te/ /ngo mtshar smad byung bkod pa'i zhing khams su/ /seng ge'i nga ro'i drung du skye bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang shangs bkra shis rtse pa'i ma blo bzang chos sgron gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i legs byas sa pon tshogs/ /smon lam drod gsher rkyen gyis skyed bsrings pa'i/ /grangs med skye ba'i ljon shing yal 'dab rtser/ /dam ba'i mgon gyi 'bras bus dud par shog /'khor bar rtag rgyu'i yang srid mkha' lding dang / /mgon khyod grib ma gnyis pa'i grogs bzhin du/ /nam yang mi 'bral nges par
