legs pa yi/ /dpag bsam yongs 'du'i rtse mor bder —105

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bgrod shog /chos can rgyu 'bras mi bslu'i nyi zla zung / /chos nyid 'gyur med mkha' la yongs shar bas/ /ji ltar stson pa'i snang ba rab rgyas dpung / /mchog gsum thugs rje'i gzi byin 'bar bar shog /(80na)shā wa ṇa nā mi sta ba de sha sgru rta rta byu du ཿ su klo she lha kā ra/khyod mtshan sgra 'dzin yul du gyur tsam gyi/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mun sel nyi ma che/ /pu khye na a : na pra ti bi spa yo gi gyu pa ñtsa ti ༈ da sha : mi i shu/ /bde bar gshegs pa sum cu rtsa lnga yi/ /snang brnyan mthong bas don ldan la sbyor ba/ /gser zhun pad rā ga thags ris ngos 'khyil bas/ /'gro kun rgyud la btab pa'i byang chen gyi/ /sabon rnam smin dkar po ga sgo'i rgyun/ /ye shes mchog gi chu gter cher 'bab shog /sa skyong 'phrin las rgya mtsho yang srid kun/ /lha mi'i rin chen skas la gyen 'dzegs nas/ /ring min thar pa'i sgo 'phar la brgyud de/ /sku gsum ba gam yang rtser 'jug par shog /'di'i ched sgo gsum ngal bsten shing rta yis/ /bsod nams zla ba'i phung po 'dren byed par/ /rtogs kun tshe dpal 'byor ba'i 'od 'bar (80bti/ /nges legs kun+da'i chun po thod 'ching shog /spyi dang khyad par gangs ljongs mgrin sngon gyi/ /gnag snum ral pa'i rtse na phan dang bde/ /'byung gnas thub bstan zla ba rtag tshes pa'i/ /cha shas srid mtha'i bar du 'phel bar shog /ces sa skyong phyag mdzod 'phrin las rgya mtsho dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i tshe gtsug lag gnyis pa shes pa'i mig yangs stag lung dpal mgon gtso bor gyur pa'i 'o rlon pa/rags kha 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ shar gling dkon mchog dar gling 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ skyid rong dgos phrug /khang gsar dgos bsam/ ser ngag dbang dar rgyas/ rags kha rta mgrin/ ram pa brag logs pa/ khang gsar lho 'jam dbyangs don grub/ /lcang srungs khang rin cen rdo rje/ ban rtsa blo bzang / shun shag a khyag /'brang shag skos pa/ byang steng bkra shis rnams kyis phung bo gsum pa'i mdo nas bstan pa'i bde bar gshegs pa sum cu rtsa lnga'i sku brnyan gyi gser thang bskrun pa'i tshe za —106—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanahong gyi brjes sbyar ba'i smon lam 'di dang lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal byang gi yi ge pa ni lcang gseb pa 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang / e pa ngag dbang tshe ring / grwa nang bsod nams lhun grub rnams kyisabagyis pa sirnya sku/ /gsol 'debs ta'i ra yi dbyangs snyan glu/ /mi phyed dad pa'i rgyud las nyer 'dren na/ /rnam mkhyen thob min bar gyi tshe rabs su/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes 'dzin shog /ces pa 'di'ang skyid shod chos rje'i grwa pa zhig gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /'khor ba'i pha mthar rdzogs min de srid du/ /gzugs sku mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo che/ /'char dang nub pa spangs pa'i dam bca' can/ /'khor 'das mun sel sngon med nyi (81na〉 kye/ /kun yags ming 'dzin dus kyi mche ba'i phrag /mi zad shugs drag las nyon dbang song bas/ /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad gangs can mtsho'i/ /thugs rje'i zer gyis 'og min gnas su drongs/ /bsod nams byas pa'i me long gtsang ma'i ngos/ /mkha' mnyam mar gyur skye rgur gtogs so cog /'di phyi yang srid kun bde myang 'das kyi/ /bzhin ras rtag tu 'gog med gsal 'char shog /ces dar 'bag dgos pas rnam snang gi brgya thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig tu 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /ku lo da yi na du khya tsi ta na nu bya khya na ni mi t+ta ra smi tsa/so gnyis mtshan bzang brgyad cu'i dpe byad zer/ shar tshe rigs su ma chad lus can gyi/ā rwa sha yi ga ṇa rba pā shu 'o ga pa 〉 bha wa a ༷ ka ra tsa/ /'khor 'das rgud pa'i smag rum kun gzhil ba'i/ /zhal skyin mthong bas don ldan la sbyor bas/ /bstan 'dzin dwa yan rgyal (81ba)por nyer 'bod pa'i/ /gnam gyi she mos sa la dbang bsgyur ba/ /bsod nams byang chub mchog gi snying po'i bar/ /mi 'dzad gter gyi bum bzang deng 'dir —107

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'grub/ /snang srid gzugs rnyan mtha' dag ri mo sa /'dri bar sman mkhyen nyi zla zung 'jug las/ /sman thang lugs srol 'dzin la rtser son pa'i/ /dpal mgon gtsor gyur sor mo'i zlos gar spel/ /chos dkar te si'i gtsug tor las 'bab pa/ /rtag tu phan bde'i yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /dmigs yul gyis mtshon 'di sgrub byed pa po/ /dzaḥ yis ngoms med 'thung bar shog /mkha' mnyam ma rgan srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /sgrol ba'i gzings gyur deng bsgrubs dge tshogs rnams/ /bsngos 'bras chos gzugs sku gnyis zung 'jug pa'i/ /rin chen gling du 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog /ces gnam gyis bskos pa'i sa'i tshangs pa bstan 'dzin dā yan rgyal po dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa mtho ris kyi srid pa 'dzin pa'i ched du stag lung dpal mgon gyis thog drangs pa'i rags kha 'jam dbyangs dbang po/shar gling dkon mchog /dar gling 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ skyid rong dgos phrug /khang gsar sbug dgos bsam/ ram pa brag logs pa/ rags kha rta mgrin/ khang gsar lho 'jam dbyang don grub/lcang srungs khang rin chen rdo rje rnams bzheng bcug pa'i rnam par snang mdzad dang sman bla bde gshegs brgyad gtso bor gyur ba'i rnam snang stong thang gi rgyab yig smon lam tu za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lcang gseb pa 'jam dpal lo/ /mtshan snyan skye rgu'i gtsug phud can gyi rnar/ /thos pa'i mod la 'chi med mngal sbrum (82na)pa'i//byed po tshe mtha' yas pa dbyar rnga'i sgra/ /byang chub mtha' snyed thos 'dzin rgyan du spud/ /rma byas btegs pa'i mi 'gyur g.yung drung khri/ /'khor skyon dag pa'i 'dab stong ze'u 'bru/ /thabs shes nyi zla zung la jug gdan steng du/ /bshes gnyen dam pa rdo rje ltar brtan shog /ngag dbang 'jam dpal thun mtshams bla gos can/ /blo bzang grags 'bar ring lugs 'dzin ma'i mtha'/ /zad min de srid spel ba'i 'phrin las rgyun/ /lha bcas 'gro ba'i rgya mtshor rtag 'bab shog /rnam 'dren bu ram shing pa'i rgyal tshab tu/ /zhwa ser cod paṇa bcings nas dbang bskur ba'i/ /'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs rtsibs stong shugs/ /thub bstan gling bzhin thog med 'khor bar shog /'dzam bu'i grib tu ngal gso'i —/08—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung snyegs bam dang po/ (zhanayid can gnyar/khrims gnyis gser shing drang po'i thig 'debs pa'i//sa dbang chab srid legs 'phel mnga' 'bangs kun//rdzogs ldan dga' ston bzhin du spyod par shog/thog mtha' bar du bkra shis chos kyi dung //g.yas 'khyil phan dang bde chen 'byung ba'i gling //thub bstan sgron mes 'jig rten mun sel bar//rnam gsum 'khor lo'i sgo nas 'phel bar shog/'gro kun rgyud la gosapa'i bsod nams gzhin//smon lam sa bon btab las bde skyid 'bras//thar pa'i srog 'tsho'i zung gyur sa bcu yi//them skas la 'dzegs byang chen bgrod par shog/ces pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni 'phyos bkra shis bde chen spyi sos nan gyis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs 82bso//thub bstan rdul bral ston mtshan zla ba las//zhwa ser 'chang ba'i ring lugs bsil ba'i zer//snang ba 'bum du ches cher 'bar ba'i zhar//'gro rnams phan bde'i kun+da bzhad par shog/khyad par skor gsum mnga' ris rgyal khams su//'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa'i rjes 'dun tshogs//mang thosalung gi brgya phrag chu bo rnams//gcig 'dus dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel bar shog/de 'dzin dge ba'i bshes dang 'dus pa'i grwa//dar zhing rab brtan yangs pa'i 'jig rten gsum//spyi dang khyad par pur rgyal bod yul 'dir//bde skyid snyan pa'i dung dkar g.yas 'khyil shog zhes pa 'di'ang rab 'byamasapa blo bzang brtson sa kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so//rgyal rnams mkhyen brtse nus kun khyod yon du//lhun grub 'dzam gling che ba'i rigs sngags 'amang //dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso mchog thod phreng rtsal//bod 'bangs bde skyid nyi ma rtag 'char mdzod//gang dang mnga' bdag rje la las smon 'bras/khung zad smin par sprul pa'i dbug dbyung gi/lung zin za hor sngags smyon ba 'ad pa rtsal//gang shar rang sar grol la gsol ba 'debs//rab btags snyan dngags ji bzhin gcam bu'i tshig/ma yin gsoX por brjod pa'i bden stobs mthus//swā la'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ljongs kyi skye rgur gtogs so cog /rdzogs ldan dus kyi dga' ston ltar spyod shog /ces pa 'di ni g.yas ru gtsang bsam grub rtse'i rdzong sdod mnga' khul rnams kyis ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs shing (83na)de bstun bzhi sde khang du 'jog 'dun gyi gsol 'debs le'u bdun pa bsam pa lhun grub ma dang bcas pa par du brkos tshe thag khra'i sbrul ltar lung bstan zhig la sgro brtags kyis bsnyad nas tshigs bcad dgos tshul bzhin za hor gyi bzhes sug bris su bgyis so/ /phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba'i tshangs dbyangs gsung / /yig drug gzugs shar rgyun chad med 'khor bas/ /bshes gnyen dam pa bskal brgyar zhabs brtan cing / /bstan 'gro'i bde skyid nyi ma gung 'char shog /byang gling bsam grub rgyal po gnyen bshes sogs/ /lus ngag yid kyis sgrub la gtogs so cog /'di snang lha yi tshe 'byor rjes 'gro zhing / /phyi ma gru 'dzin zhing du skye bar shog /khor yug gangs kyi ra bas yongs bskor 'dir/ /dbul phongs nad 'khrug dus kyi chad pa rgan/ /ming gi lhag mar gyur te bde skyid la/ /sgo gsum spyod par bcud rnams skal mnyam shog /ces pa'i smon lam tshigs bcad 'di'ang byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos ma ṇi dung phyur gyi chos 'bor 'dzugs skabasadagos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /bde ba can zhing mgon po 'od mtha' yas/ /rgya gar paṇa chen tshul bzung thod phreng rtsal/ /zhi khro gas kun khyab bdag dbang po yis/ /dri med spyan ras gzigs pa lhur mdzod cig /stong nyid snying rje'i rang mdangs a yig steng / /dhu ti'i ka bas bde chen ham gteg nas/ /rdo rje'i srog tu byin brlabs ba 'ad pa rtsal/ /che mchog 'dus pa'i ngo bor rtag bzhugs gsol/ /(83bsko zhen nu bus sku 'ja' tshon 'od kyi mdangs/ /bzhin lag rnam par shar ba'i longs spyod rdzogs/ /nges pa lnga dang ldan phyir bskal ba 'di/ /stong min de srid bar du brtan par bzhugs/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon dus dgra'i dbang / /drag rtsal rdo rje 'bar ba'i rwa gdengs nas/ /bdud sdodapung bcas snying la rab bsnun te/ /bsam sbyor ngan pa'i nus pa thal bar rlog /gsung ngag chad med theg dgu dbang gi rgyun/ /blo —1/khri

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu spung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanagros bum par yongs gtams skal bzang gi /gdul bya rgya mtsho smin grol lam 'god pa'i/ /'jam dbyang dga' ba'i bshes gnyen zhabs brtan shog /skyon yul mtshungs mchims phu gsung gi gnas/ /dge bcu kun tshang yar klung sman ljongs su/ /zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo mngon sum du/ /'phos 'dra'i 'dus sdod ra zhing rgyas par shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha/ /ma ning nag po sde dpon sum cu dang / khyad par bstan srung rdo rje gzhog rgod mas/ /'di phyi'i gtan gyi 'dun ma lhun grub mdzod/ /ces ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung gi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni be+e ro'i thugs sprul gter ston pra dzñā ra smi'i yang srid ngag dbang pad+ma 'phrin las kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i cha shas yongs rdzogs pa/ /mchog gsum thugs rje chen po'i bsil zer gyis/ /yongs btab smon lam ku mu da yi tshal/ /'jam mnyen 'dab stong kun nasaba'ad par mdzod/ /ngag dbang brtan pa'i 'khor lo tsong kha pa'i/ /rab dkar dge ba'i ring lugs legs pa'i lam /rgyal mtshan (84na)rtse mor bsgrengs pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /myur du zhing 'dir srid pa 'dzin par shog /sprul pa'i zlos gar nyin mor byed pa yis/ /yid srubs mun pa'i smag rum mthar byas nas/ /thub bstan snang ba ches dar gser ldan khyon/ /yongs khyab bzhed pa'i 'bras bu lhun grub shog /de tshul 'grub la sdig to'i lha min mngal/ /chos srung 'chi med dbang pos rdo rje'i rwa/ /gdengs pa'i mod la lhung dang lhan cig tu/ /brlang por spyod pa'i bsam sbyor kun zhi shog /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i ngang tshul slu med du/ /de bzhin gshegs pas nyer gsungs bden pa'i bka'/ /tshad mar gyur pa ji ltar smon pa'i don/ /re ba ma lus lhun gyis 'grub par shog /ces de mo sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang dge legasargyal mtshan gyis sprul sku myur du byon pa'i smon lam tshigs su bcad pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes dpon po bsod nams nor bus bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /—/1/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)brjod pa rnam dag ngag la smra ba'i dbang / grub pa'i blo yis skal bzang 'gro ba la/ /rgya chen spyod dang zab mo lta ba'i chos/ /dbyar mtsho lta bur spel la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi 'jig spobs pasaganyis med gsung ba'i gzhung / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i go ldan lnga rig chas/ /thub bstan thos don bsam sgom lang tsho'i dpyid/ /'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /dad dang dam tshig rtsa ba rab brtan khrir/ khugs drag smon lam me tog rab gtor nas/ /mgon khyod skal brgyar bzhugs gsol legs 'debs na/ /'grub par mchog gsum thugs rjes byin gyis zlo bres/ /bdag gis (84ba7gyis dang bgyid gyur bgyid bzhin pa'i/ /dge tshogs dzasbu'i gos bu sems bskyed mtshor/ /lhung ba'i snye ma byang chen gser sbyangs su/ /rab smin lus can kun lagato me bar shog /nyesabargya'i dri ma smon lam chus bkrus pa'i/ /bstan 'gro'i bde skyid ston mtshan zla ba'i bzhin/ /rgyud lnga'i bsod nams me long gsal ba'i ngos/ /rtag tu 'gog pa med par 'char bar shog khe'i/smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni rgyal sras shes rab 'phel ba'i sprul sku blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis don gnyer chen po'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /bskal mang rlabs chen spyod pa'i gom stabs kyis/ /tshogs sbyor sa bcu'i them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /bla med sku gsum khang par legs bzhugs te/ /lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zlos gar can/ /ches cher gdul dka'i 'gro ba 'dren pa'i slad/ /'dzam gling dbus 'gyur spo la mchog sprul du/ /yongs bstan skal bzang 'dren pa shākya'i rgyal/ /ma 'dris lus can kun gyi mgon gcig pu/ /gang gi snang brnyan ma la la skyes las/ /legs grub grong 'khyer bsod snyoms gshegs pa'i tshul/ /ye shes sems dpa'i gzi byin rab 'bar ba/ /ba thong bas don ldan sal sbyor mdzad kye/ khyod drung dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa dang / /bstod cing gsol 'debs smon lam byed pa kun/ /bgrod dka' srid pa'i 'phrang ring las bsgral nas/ /bde chen thar pa'i gling du dbugs dbyung drongs/ /dkar —112

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshags su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenamin lasang na gos bu nyer zhi zhing //tshe dpal stobs85na tshe cur legs pa'i yon tan rnams//yid la 'dod pa ji bzhin lhun grub par//mgon po thugs rje chen pos byin gyi rlobs//zhes tsas las grub pa'i thub dbang grong khyer du gshegs pa'i sku bas la bstod cing smon lam 'debs pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes san chag pa lhas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so//bde ldan zhing na 'od snang mtha' yas mgon/khru 'dzin gnas su 'phags mchog snying rje'i gter//gis rgya mtshor tshe dbang thod 'phreng rtsal//dbyer med sku gsum ngo bor gsol ba 'debs//gang byin snying la sim pa'i las smon mthus//bod 'bangs phan bde sgrub khur lhag bsam gyis//gyen 'de gsang ga dbang blo gros rab yangs pa//skal bzang rgya mtsho'i gnyen la gsol ba 'debs//ye shesa'od lnga gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus//seng khri pad nyi zla steng mgon po khyod//tshe mtha' yas pa'i skur bzhengs srid pa'i mtha'//rdzogos min bar du g.yo med bzhugs gyur cig/nor 'dzin lus phra'i mngaladu legs sbrums pa'i/khrims gnyis gser shing yid can yongs kyi gnyar//lci bas phan bde'i mchod sbyin mi bdag gi/sku tshe mnga' thang chab srid rgyas gyur cig/gser mdog zhwa yi cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan//'phags yul nas bzung shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i bar//yongs khyab lugs gnyis 'dod rgu'i char chen pos//phan bde'i snyem g.yur du za bar shog/rtag tu dag 'bade ra spyod pa'i dpal ldan pa//ma smad thar pa'i gos bu rin chen gling /r+sām gsum 'khor 85ba〉so re bya bas dbyar mtsho ltar//gyen nasagyen du 'phel zhing rgyas gyur cig/sa 'og sa steng sa blar gnas so cog/khyad par pur rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir//'thab rtsod nad gdon dbul phong nyer zhi zhing //bde skyid gsum rtsen bzhin du spyod par shog/rdul bral ston zla ltar dkar lhag bsam gyis//legs bskrun dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tsho gos gos//nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro la yongs smin nas//mi gnas myang 'das grong khyer la 'jug shog/byin rlabs myur 'jug rtsa rgyud bla ma dang //dngos grub stsol ba'i yi dam

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dkyil 'khor lha/ /las bzhi kun sgrub chos skyong srung ma yis/ /bsam pa ji bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung dang 'brel ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni chu shur dga' ldan thar pa gling gi slob dpon grwa mang dang bcas pas don gnyer chen pos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /ngag dbang blo yi bum bzang dngos grub kyi/ /rgya mtsho legs 'khyil bdag gi spyi bo'i gtsug /rab bzhugs bdud rtsi snying la yongs sim pas/ /'di phyi'i 'dun ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes cha kur tha yang chi dbang phyug dge slong gi kha tan du byas mchog pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o/ /rnam 'dren sku gsung thugs kyi phung po kun/ /mdzes sdug lus phrar shar ba'i 'jo sgeg can/ / tshe dpal sbyin la yi bzhin 'khor lo'i lha/ /(86na)rgyal yum 'phags mas deng 'dir ma dpung skye/ /lus ngag yid gsum dal 'byor don ldan du/ /sgrub la dbang byed blo gros bum pa bzang / /'chi med zil mngar rgya mtshos yongs bkang ste/ /bskal brgyar mi g.yo brtan par byin gyi rlobs/ /srab gnyen stod g.yogs pa ñtsa li ga'i dar/ /mtshams sprin rung mthun gos su nyer bsgyur nas/ /'jam mgon mi yi gzugs 'dzin btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs bskal pa'i bar du rgyas par shog /dga' skyid kun ldan sdo bzhi'i pho brang che'i/ /zhwa ser mnabs pa'i chos dang srid kyi bstan/ khrims gnyis 'jigs rten yongs kyi gnyar lci ba/ /mang bkur rjes 'gro'i ngang tshul dar drag shog /mi zad gnas ngan len gyi tsha gdung rnams/ /rgyal mtshan rab sgrog ma la yar skyes dang / /'thul ba'i mod la so skye las 'phags pa'i/ /'dus sdo 'khor lo gsum gyi yar 'phel shog /sems can ci dang khyad par rgya hor bod/ khyu dang mi rgyu'i lus can rtag bde zhing / /sdig sdo'i bsam sbyor kun spangs rnam par smin/ /zla zhun khu ba ji bzhin 'dzag par shog /rang gi rgyud la gos so cog gi dge /skye rgu mtha' dag sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur/ /legs bsngos dzaḥ yi bu mo'i rgyun/ /byang chub rgya mtsho zad min 'phel bar shog /ces ring 'tsho'i —/14

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa ra bdakar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhanarten 'byung smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni mtshan sgrog mkhan po sngags rams pa ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis bskul ba ltar ja hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so//dbus 'gyur dag pa'i zhing gi rten brten 86ba pa//mngon gsum mig gi yul du legs bstar nas//rnam dkar las 'brel 'jog 'dod bsam pa bzhin//'grub par dkon mchog gsum gyisabyin gyis rlobs//zhes pha ma gnyis dbus phyogs la yong ba 'dun pa bzhin 'grub pa'i smon lam tshig bcad 'di lta bu mgon po yi ding gi tsha bo rab 'byams pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi bskul ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar//'od mtshan dpag med stong du 'bar ba'i gzis//'chi bdag smag rum mthar byed gar gyi dbang //bde ldan zhing nas thugs rje'i spyan gyi dkyus//ring por deng 'dir rtag tu btsa' bar mdzod//thub pa'i gsung ngag sde gnod rnam pa gsum//lar rtsod rtsom par dbang ba'i blo gros can//bag yod gosaklubs bzang po'i lhag bsam gyis//ris med 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur g.yo med shog/yangs pa'i rgya mtsho'i gos ro khyen kun la//'jigs med bzha po'i go cha'i tso pa'i bstan//yongs 'du po lang tsho rgyas pa'i grib bsil sder//lus can ngal gsor 'god mdzad zhabs brtan shog/mgrin par 'jam dbyangasadabyangs can ngag gi lha/khung 'jug zlos gar gar gyis yongs btsun pas//ma smad rnam dpyod dpyod ldan tsho gos 'ga' ba'i//byed po bshes gnyen gnyen 'gyur bzhugs gso lo 'debs//dus gsum rgyal bsaji ltar mkhyen pa'i chos//dri med spyan gyis mngone gsum nyer gzigs pa//kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i//lugs zung bstan pa dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog dpal ldan grags pa'i rigasagazhung thos bsam gyis/87na/gtan la 'bebs pa'i mnga' ris 'dus pa'i sde//nyi zla'i 'od kyi 'jigs rten snang ba'i bar//thub bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan du 'phel gyur cig/srid 'dir gnas so cog gi lus can spyi/khyad par kha bas bskor ba'i sman ljongs 'dir//'chi med bdag po'i 'dun sa dang mtshungs par//sgo gsum phan bde'i dpal la spyod par shog/rdul dral ston mtshan zla ba'i rjes

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)'gro ba//ches dkar dag pa'i sems kyi rab btab pa'i//smon lam ji bzhin 'grub par dam pa'i chos//bsrung bar zhal ches rnams kyi grogs mdzod cig/dus gsum bsags pa'i legs byasasabon tshogs//gzhan phan ched dmigs sa lus drod gsher gyis//smin pa'i myu gu byang chub snying po'i bar//spyod pa'i skal pa bzang por bdag byin rlobs//zhes ring por 'tsho ba'i smon lam dang 'brel ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni rigs gzhung smra ba'i 'dus sde mnga' ris grwa tshang gi slob dpon bstan mdzes grwa rigs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so//bde ldan zhing gi mgon po 'od mtha' yas//'chi med tshe sbyin ye shes 'khor lom/khrin pasagadung sel gtsug gtor 'phags ma'i zhabs//mi gzad thugs rje'i mthudapung deng 'dir skyed//lha mchog rnam gsum mdzod spu 'od zer phreng //rdul bral ston zla ltar dkar nyer 'phros pas//nyi bu'i smag rum mthar byas rigs brgya'i bdag/rdo rje'i khri la g.yo med brtan par mdzod//thub bstan rin chen 'dzin pa 'khor 8bebata'i mgon//grangs med gdul bya'i bsod nams zhing sgomachoge/mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug gshes gnyen che//bskal brgyar g.yu drung lta bur rtag brtan shog/gur mgon legs ldan gdong gzhi rnam thos sras//las shin rab brtan ma sogs srung ma yis//bgegasarigs yid srubs sde dpungs tshar chod la//'dod pa'i 'bras bzang smin pa'i 'phrin las sgrubs//chosanyid 'gyur ba med pa gdod ma'i shis//chos can rgyu gos slu med rten tshol mthus//smon pa ji bzhin 'grub pa mchog gsum gyi//thugs rjes myur du 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog zhes dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mkhan chen zhwa lu ba rin chen bsod nams mchog grub cung zad snyan tshul gyi tshe/brtan bzhugs kyi ched du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o//snyigs ma'i 'gro 'dren mthu stobs rgyal gzhan las//ches lhag bde gshegs bdun dang 'od mtshan mgon//thugs rjes bdag so gos byang chub ༷ rnyes bar//mngon mtho'i rten bzang brgyud mar

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenathob byin rlobs//zhes pa 'di yang tshogs gsog pa rgyal mtshan gyi bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o//thub gsung 'grel par bcas pa mang thos gos//deng nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen min par//yang dag dge ba'i gshes kyi rjes bzung ste//sal ma yon tan bla nas blar 'phel shog tesapa 'di'ang rin cen rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o//zhi khro bka' brgyad 88na / kun 'dus dkyil 'khor gtso//rigs 'dzin bla ma rdo rje drag po rtsal//ma smad thugs rje'i bdud rtsi bdag snying la//legs zhugs dngos grub rnam gnyis myur stsol cig/ces rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi sku thang rgyab yig gcig dgos zhes thon legs ldan dbang pos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes bris pa'o//gar dbang mdzod spu'i 'od zer nyi brgya'i lus//'bar bas tshig bdag smag rus mthar byas nas//blo bzang grags snyan chos srid legs 'dzin pas//sa dbang mthu thob srid mthar rgyas gyur cig/slu med mchog gsum thugs rjes mi yi bdag/rdo rje'i khri lahrū ra med rab brtan zhing //gser ri'i rjes 'gro khrims gnyis btsuni po'i ljid//ris med skye rgu'i gnya' bar mdzes gyur cig/dga' ba'i dpal ldan byams chen 'dus pa'i gling //kun mkhyen bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar/r+sām gsum 'khor lo'i bya ba dar rgyas shog/ji ltar smon pa'i re ba lhun grub shog khes pa sa skyong phyag mdzod blo bzang mthu stobs kyi brtan bzhugs 'a ni rong byams chen spyi tsho gis kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo //snang ba mtha' yas ye shes gzigs pa'i dkyus//ring por brkyangs nas mang thos sdom brtson can//ngag dbang dpal 'byor legs drangs gdul bya'i gtsor//mdzad de theg chen lam du 'khrid par gsol//rang bde dor nas gzhan don nyer bsgrub pa'i//rgyal ba'i sras phyin drug spyod pa la//88ba'i mchog bgrod pa ji bzhin thogs med du//'jug pa mgon pos bdag rgyud byin gyis

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rlobs/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum rab bsags dge ba kun/ /mi mdzad mtho ris chu bo'i spun zla ltar/ /rnam pa thams bcad mkhyen pa'i chu gter slong / /'bab pa'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog /ces pa 'di yang dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi grwa tshang bkra shis sgo mang pa'i slob dpon zur pa ngag dbang dpal 'byor gyi phyi rten du 'od dpag med kyi stong thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig du nye gnas kyi bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /bde gshegs sras dang slob mar bcas pa yi/ /dri bral ye shes spyan gyis nyer gzigs te/ /dus kyi chos nyid gyur pa ā nan+da/ /thugs rje'i phyag gis dag pa'i zhing du drangs/ /bde ldan ngo mtshar bkod pa'i dga' tshal du/ /'jam mnyen pad+ma'i sbubs su nyer btsas te/ /rnam 'dren 'od dpag med zhal mngon sum mthong / /des gsung chos kyi bdud rtsir longs spyod shog /rab dkar lhag pa'i bsam pa dar drag pos/ /sa lam spangs rtogs bla nas blar spel nas/ /ma 'dris 'gro kun 'dren pa'i ded dpon mchog /kun mkhyen ye shes grong du 'jug par shog /ces o rod g.yon ru'i dpon po ā nan+da 'jig rten pha rol du dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i tshe smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes sprul sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'o/ /gar dbang 'od mtshan drod kyis sprums pa'i mngal/ /(89na ji pag med tshe yi gser sgong yongs smin can/ /chos nor 'dod thar sgo bzhi legs phye nas/ /'gro kun rdzogs ldan dga' ston mchog la sbyor/ /yid srubs sde las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ /skye rgur rjes brtse'i thugs gsang dpal be'ur/ /tshe yi g.yung drung 'khyil las zil dngar chus/ /gzhom med srog gi snye ma smin par mdzod/ /thub gsung slob mar bcas zhal 'dab brgya'i sgo/ /yongs grol bden par brjod pa'i dbyangs snyan pos/ /mtha' yas lus can kun la rab dge ba'i/ /bkra shis me tog 'phreng mdzes char du snyil/ /ngag dbang tshangs sras lha mo'i pi wang rgyud/ /blo gros sor mos bskul ba'i legs bshad sgrar/ /skal bzang rgya mtsho'i thos 'dzin mtshar dngar ba/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes khyod brtan gyur cig /yangs —118

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenapa'i grong khyer las 'phags ri bo'i spo/ /khrims ldan dam pa'i cho sel spyod pa'i gling / /rnam gsum 'khor lo'i bya ba mi pham mgon/ /dbus 'gyur 'byon min de srid 'phel bar shog /rtsod ldan dus kyi chad pa'i zug rngu yis/ /yangs pa'i 'jig rten kun nas mi mnar zhing / /brgyad khri'i bgrang byar spyod pa 'dzam gling mi'i/ /legs byas bgo bshar byed la dbang bsgyur shog /thos bsam sgom pa'i rin cen yu ba yis/ /zhwa ser lung rtogs bstan pa'i gdug dkar po/ /rab bteg tshangs pa'i yul sar yongs 'khor ba'i/ /grib tu nyer bsil 'gro 'di'i gdung skyob shog /ces ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni ri bo chos gling spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi (89ba tha zhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /nyi ma'i 'od brgya 'bar ba'i thugs rje'i 'od/ /ris med 'gro ba'i khams dang bsam pa bzhin//'jug mdzad dkon cog rin cen rnam gsum gyis/ /bden tshigs brjod pa'i 'bras bu smin par mdzod/ /ston mtshan zla zhal shar ba'i mod nyid la/ /'chi bdag smag rus ming yang mthar byas te/ /yun 'tsho'i snang ster yid bzhin 'khor lo mas/ /dkyus ring bdun ldan spyan gyis btsa' bar mdzod//blo dang brtson pa mi dman bzang po'i las/ /bsod nams ri bo dngos su rgyu 'dra'i mthus/ /stobasaldan sa la spyod pa mi yi bdag /rdo rje'i khri la 'gyur med rab brtan shog /tshe ring gnam gyi she mong shugs drag pos/ /khrims gnyis rtsibs stong 'bar ba'i 'khor lo gang / /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khyon la rtag 'khor ba/ /mang bkur rgyal po'i rnam thar 'byongs bar shog /dzā ti'i me tog 'grum pa'i sman ljongs nas/ /za 'og thags su bskrun pa'i grong khyer bar/ /'khod pa'i skye rgu'i phrag par 'god pa'i khrims/ /gser gyi gnya' shing rtag tu lci gyur cig /gangs kyi ra bas yongs skor ru bzhi'i char/ /g.yul 'khrug dbul phongs nad rim kun zhi zhing / /ma smad rnam smin dkar por 'dzag pa'i rgyun/ /bde skyid dga' ston dpal la spyod par shog /don dam 'gyur ba med pa'i mkha' dbyings la/ /kun rdzob rten 'brel nyi zla zung 'brel bas/ /ji ltar smon pa lhun grub snang ba'i gter/ /'dzad med nam —1/mi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)mkha' mdzod la dbang 'byor shog /ces sa(90na tshe skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyi brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes yar klungs ri bo chos gling pa spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /gang mas rna bar thos pa'i mod nyid la/ /'khor ba'i zug rngu gzhil ba'i rtsi sman ljon/ /dkon cog rnam gsum thugs rje ka su ra'i/ /gzegs mas bdag snying kun+da bsad du gsol/ shwakya'i bstan pa rin cen gnas pa'i zhing / /gangs can ljongs son rgyal dang rgyal sras kyi/ /rten dang brtan pa khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde/ /ring min blta ba'i skal bzang thob par shog /rnam 'dren slob mar bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang / /lha dang drang srong bden tshig grub pa'i mthu/ /med byung rten cing 'brel 'byung slu med pas/ /smon lam btab pa ji bzhin myur 'grub shog /ces pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni bsod nams sgrol mas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lcang gseng pa 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo /nges par sgrib gnyis spangs pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ khu thi la phreng ji bzhin bskal pa 'dir/ /byon dang 'byon gyur nang nas snying stobs la/ /rgyal rnams legs gso'i me tog 'thor ba'i yul/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi gsung rab chu gter las/ /stong nyid seng ge'i rgyud kyi nga ro yis/ /mtha' 'dzin ri dwags lkog mar snying 'byin pa/ /yum sras bcu bdun zhes su mkhas rnams gleng / /de'i nang blo gar bgrang gcod mtshams 'bum/ /tshig gi nyer bstan don gyi sa bon las/ /rnam (90ba)'dren sras slob ma lus bskyed pa'i yum/ /'bri klog mchod pas srid pa hrul por byed/ /de phyir glegs bam bskrun 'di'i legs byas kyis/ /blo bzang dbang rgyal bkra shis pho nu zung / /sa lam rin cen skas la nyer 'dzigs te/ /bla med sku gsum khang par 'jug gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang shangs bkra shis rtse pas 'bum dum pa bcu drug bzhengs pa'i smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lcang gseb pa 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /—/20

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenangag dbang 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa'i bstan/ /'dzin ched bskal pa rgya mtshor rtag bzhugs pa'i/ /bden tshig phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas mgrin gcig tu/ /legs gsung bkra shis me tog char du phob/ /tshe yi g.yung drung nya phyis khog yangs por/ /srog rten dkar dmar a lha mu thi la/ /'bum phrag bgrang bya'i srad bur yongs brgyus te/ /do shal mdzes pa'i rgyan du rtag 'chang shog /gtan bde'i gzugs shar rkang sen me long rdul/ /rdo rje'i gdan la bkod tshe nyi ma'i bu/ /skyid lug bskal par 'gog pa'i ting 'dzin la/ /g.yur nas bde ldan mgon de'i rjes 'gror shog /ces ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung gi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni gnam gyi bskos pa'i rgyal po lha gzigs phag mo gru pa blo bzang mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nor 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po ngag gi lha'i bka' gnang ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /mchog gsum byin rlabs rlabs phreng yol med mtshor/ /bden tshig rang brjod brjod pa rnam (91na pog zla/ shar ba'i 'od snang snang ba 'bum sde'i gzis/ /lnga pa'i mun stug stug po pha mthar skyod/ /blo bzang grags snyan snyan pa'i gdugs dkar po/ /srid pa'i rtser 'khor 'khor los nor 'dzin la/ /mnga' sgyur mi dbang dbang phyug brgyad ldan gang / /dkon mchog mthu stobs stobs kyi rab brtan shog /lha dang drang srong srong por smra rnams kyis/ /bkra shis glu dbyangs glu ru rab blangs te/ /dus kun dge ba'i dge legs char chen po/ /sa steng kun khyab kun tu dga' bar shog khes sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyi brtan kyi bzhugs bden tshig brjod pa 'di ni gangs can gyi lha gcig pu dpal phag mo gru pa blo bzang mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nor 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po ngag gi lhas bka' stsal ba dang du blangs te za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /ngag la smra dbang blo ldan skal bzang mthus/ /gtsug lag rgya mtshor 'jigs med go cha yis/ /thub bstan lang tsho bla na 'phel ba'i sde/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen snang brnyan 'di/ /sgyu ma mkhan po'i khengs 'phrog ri mo ba/ /ja chang 'dod rgu tshim byed khyim gyi bdag /blo bzang mkhyen —121—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)brtse'i lhag bsam ston zla ltar/ /ches dkar gyis bskul sgo gsum rab 'bad pa'i/ /legs byas dzaskru'i chu bos nyer smin pa'i/ /rang sems kun mkhyen gser gyi snye ma sa gyur min de srid kun tu mi 'bral ba'i/ /re 'bras 'grub pa'i 'dun pa nan tar bgyid/ /nges par legs pa'i lam du ma zhugs par/ /lha mi'i rten bzang brgyud mar rab (91ba)thob cing / /'jigs chen brgyad sogs zug rngu 'tshe ba bral/ /rdzogs ldan dus bzhin mthun rkyen kun tshang shog /rgyal dang des gsung sras slob bden pa che/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bslu ba med/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro srung ma'i mthu stobs kyis/ /ji ltar bsams pa lhun gyis 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di yang 'phyos chang khyim pa blo bzang mkhyen brtses thang ga'i rgyab yig tu dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sug bris su bgyis so/ /gangs can bstan 'gro'i legs byas nor 'dzin stor/ /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin thugs rje'i sa bon 'bras/ /rab smin sprul pa'i sku mchog yongs 'du'i ljon/ /'gyur med rdo rje'i rang rnabazhin 'grub gyur cig /sgra bsgyur be+e ro grwa pa mngon shes zhabs/ /ra shag gter ston shar phyogs zab gter bdag /rdo rje gling dang kun skyong mdo sngags gling / /skyes rabs rin cen phreng la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgongs dang brda las snyan brgyud gsung ngag la/ /dbang 'byor 'jig rten mig gcig rnam snang mdzad/ /pad+ma thod phreng bstan pa 'dzin pa'i ched/ /sprul pa'i zlos gar bsgyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /med byung kun dga'i 'byung gnas ga chen ga kho/ /dngos grub rgya mtsho'i mdzod la mnga' sgyur zhes/ /skyon lung zin 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling / /bod yul phan bde'i nyer 'tshor gsol ba 'debs/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlang mo drod can/ /dngos grub zab gter yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /las lo skal bzang nyin byed dpal 'bar gzi/ /yid srubs smag rum (92na 'jom la gsol ba 'debs/ /'pho ba chen po'i gzugs sku nor bu'i tog /gos dkar ral pa'i thor tshugs cod pan rtser/ /rab mdzes gar dgu'i nyams ldan he ru da:/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'o mgon por gsol ba 'debs/ /log rtog rnyog bral dad mtshor rgyal kun mdangs/ /'od mtshan stong 'bar pad+ma gar dbang zla'i/ /'gyur med thugs —/22

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanarje'i bdud rtsi ga bur ngad/ /'thul bas mgon khyod rdo rje'i rtsal ldan shog /pad+ma thod phreng me tog man+da ra/ /snyom 'jug dga' bzhi'i zil dngar gyis sbran pa/ /dbu ma mi shigs rdo rje'i /ba yis/ /thabs shes nyi zla g.yo med brtan par shog /ngo bo kunas dag pa'i kun bzang slong / /rang bzhin dga' bde'i lhun grub ma 'gags rtsal/ /thugs rje rin cen 'dod 'jo'i bum pa bzang / /dngos grub rgya mtsho'i byed por rtag brtan shog /ngag dbang lha yis rjes bzung sa kun la/ /spobs pa gzengs mtho gan jag thang tha yi/ /sgyu 'phrul gar khyod rgyal dbang pad ma'i bstan/ /swā la'i ljongs 'dir 'dzin phyir zhabs brtan shog /pad 'byung mkhar chen bza' dang bai ro yi/ /smon lam gtad rgyas nyer dbang rang skal gter/ /bgegs bral ma lus thon nas bka' babs kyi/ /las can rnams dang rten 'brel lhun grub shog /skyon dus gsum mkhyen pa'i smin grol gyi/ /bstan pa nyer 'dzin rig sngags 'chang ba'i gling / /bka' gter zung 'jug bshad dang sgrub pa kun/ /srid mtha'i bar du dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog /rten cing 'brel 'byung nam mkha' gsal grib med/ /dkon mchog thugs (92ba)rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /chos srung gter bdag mthu stobs tsha zer gyis/ /ji ltar smon pa'i snang ba 'bar gyur cig zhes sprul pa'i sku rigs 'dzin chen po gter bdag gling pa'i gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs kyi rim pa 'di ni rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa klong yangs 'od gsal gyis don gnyer chen pos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos tshe dbang thod 'phreng rtsal/ /sgrub pa sdebargyad yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /bstan srung dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu sogs/ /rtsa gsum bden stobs rten 'byung slu med mthus/ /chos kun gang shar rang sar grol ba'i mkhar/ /che mchog 'dus pa'i lhun grub 'od lnga'i rtsal//'gag med yongs shar bshes gnyen rdo rje 'dzin/ /bskal brgyar rtag bzhugs chos 'khor skor bar shog /dad dang dam tshig zhing sa gshin pa la/ /bden tshigs smon lam sa bon yongs btab pa/ /—123

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)mchog gsum thugs rje'i chu lud drod gsher gyis/ /ling ling 'dod pa'i snye ma g.yur za shog /cesaring por 'tsho ba'i rten 'byung gi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni zab mo'i gter la dbang ba'i gnyos kyi rigs 'dzin sprul sku ngag dbang pad+ma'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /mi 'gyur chos dbyings dag pa'i lha lam ngos/ /rab bsags rgyu tshogs chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa las/ /bslu med 'bras bu'i char gyi dmigs yul 'gro'i/ /(93na)/mngon mtho nges legs snye ma smin par shog /sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs mchod bklags pa dang / /'dus sder bsnyen bkur ngan slong sbyin gtong sogs/ /bsod nams byas mthus don grub rgyal mtshan gyis/ /yang srid kun tu rnam smin ches dkar shog /dus las nyer 'das byang chub mchog thob dang / /mchos brang rigs kyi bu dang brgyud par bcas/ /'di dang gtan gyi 'dun ma yongs 'grub rgyur/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs ma lus bsngo/ /zhes mgron gnyer don grub rgyal mtshan gyis don du snyan dar zhal byang dang /'dus tshogs kyi zhal 'don gang 'os la byas chog pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes shul mi rnams kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po'i sku brnyes nas/ /'khor ba stong min de srid 'gro kun gyi/ /gtsug na rdo rje'i skyil mo krung bcas pa/ /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin thugs rje'i mthu dpung skyed/ /blo gsal skal bzang gdul byar nyer 'jug pa'i/ /pad+ma thod phreng 'phrin las ga d+ma'i klung / /theg mchog yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po'i rlabs/ /'phreng ba srid mthar dus las yol med shog /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpag bsam yongs 'du'i sde/ /bka' gter bshad sgrub 'bras bu g.yur za ba'i/ /ring lugasayal 'dabs phang phung grib bsil du/ /'gro rnams bde ba'i ngal gsor spyod par shog /rtsa gsum thugs rje'i nyi 'od 'bar ba'i gzis/ /yid srubs sde bcas smag rum mthar bskrad nas/ /(93ba)mgon khyod nges pa lnga ldan longs sku bzhin/ /rdo rje'i khri la g.yo med zhabs brtan shog /sna nam rgod ldem —124

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenalegs ldan ngag gi dbang / /dam pa'i yang srid bsam bzhin sprul pa'i gar/ /nyer bstan thugs bskyed don bzhin bstan dang 'gro'i/ /phan bde'i rtsal ga dam par zhabs brtan shog /rgyal kun ngo bo rigasa'adzin pad+ma 'byung / /zhi khro rab stims kun khrus bka' brgyad lha/ /ma ning bka' skyong dregs pa'i sdedapon gyis/ /smon pa ji bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ khyod mtshan thos pa tsam gyis dus min gyi/ /'chi bdag g.yul las rnam rgyal gar gyi dbang / /dgyes zhal 'dzum 'phreng zer gyis nyer bsus pa'i/ /bkra shis rgya mtshos nor 'dzin kun khyab shog /ces rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs 'du'i sde phyi nang gi mtshan ltas rtsub pa byung tshul thos pas ring por 'tsho bzhes kyi bden tshig tu za hor gyi bzhes thun mong zhes pa lcags khyi spre'u zla ba'i tshes bcur brjod pa'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs so/ /rtsa gsum byin rlabs bzhu blugs rdo rje'i khrir/ /blo chen mes po'i ched gyur nor 'dzin bdag /lugs zung khrims kyis 'gro rnams skal bzang du/ /'god mdzad mthu stobs dbang po zha khas brtan shog /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi/ /rgyal ba'i 'khor lor mi phyed mos pa yis/ /gsol bto bden pa'i tshig tu wo brjod pa'i/ /re ba ji bzhi yongs su skong bar shog /chos(9g.yod ngo bo ka dag mkha' dbyings ngos/ /chos tshan rgyu gos nyi zla zung 'jug pas/ /'dzam gling skye rgur phan bde'i snang ba yis/ /khyab phyir 'gro yongs 'phel grib med brtan shog zhes sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyi brtan bzhugs 'di ni dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag rdo rje slob dpon chen po blo gros mchog gi rdo rjes gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam bstan no/ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam la sogs kyis/ /med byung thugs rje chen po nyer bskul na/ /dri bral dag pa'i thugs kyis rab dgongs nas/ /'od dpag med mgon 'khor bcas 'dir gshegasashig /bsod nams rab brtan dad dus lnga pa yi/ /lam gyur bar de'i 'jigs skrag gis mnar ba/ /mgon khyod mkhyen brtse'i phyag gis dbug dbyungs nas/ /bde ldan dag pa'i zhing du drang du gsol/ /—125

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bdag gir bzung dang nye du bcas rnams kyis/ /dkon mchog mchod dang ga slong sbyin gtong sogs/ /rnam dkar bgyis so cog gi 'bras bu kun/ /gang dmigs deng smin bde skyid ldan par shog /gnas ngan len pa'i rgyu sbyang lha dang mi'i/ /srid pa nyer brgyud sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas/ /drungs phyung ring por mi thogs stobs bcu'i rtsal/ /lhun grub rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par shog /dus las 'das dang shul du mchis rnams kyis/ /'di phyir phan bde'i sa bon dus gsum du/ /btab pa deng 'dir bsod nams yongs spel ba'i/ /(94ba 'dzad med char gyis smin par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di'ang skyar po bsod nams rab brtan lnga pa'i chos nyid du gyur pa'i dus dge 'dun gyi zhal 'don du mdzad rgyu'i smon lam tshigs bcad cig dgos zhes skyar btsun rdo rje dbang phyug gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /sangs rgyas de gsung byang sems slob mar bcas/ /mchog gsum dam par snying nas skyabs 'gro na/ /byang chub mchog thob ma gyur de srid du/ /rmad byung thugs rje chen pos 'dzin par shog /ces pa 'di ni al dar tha'i jis ste dmangs dang bcas pa'i kha ton du byed rgyu'i slo ka gcig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'o/ /bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog rnam gsum la/ /mi phyed dad pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag cag gangs can bod kyi yul bgrod nas/ /bsam pa'i re ba skong bar byin gyis rlomes/ / zhesapa 'di ni thor god kyi dpon mo mkha' 'gros bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o/ /theg pa chen po'i mdo sde phal chen las/ /med byung bzang spyod smon lam loms sbyor mthus/ /'di nas shi 'phos skad cig gnyis pa la/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du skye bar shog /tshe rabs kun tu bshesaganyen dam pa yis/ /'bral ba med par brtse bas rjes bzung ste/ /zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsis rab tshims nas/ /myur du stobs bcu mnga' ba thob par shog /ces pa'i smon lam tshigs bcad 'di ni ma ṇa rab (95na) 'byams pa ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o/ /—/26—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanakhyod mtshan skye rgu'i thos 'dzin du/ /legs par yongs su rab bsgrags pas/ /srid gdung smag rum nyer bcil te/ /gtan bde'i snang ba gsal bar shog /mtshan dpe'i gzi brjid 'bar ba'i sgra/ /dbyangs kyi rgyal po seng ge yi/ /nga ro bsgrags pas 'khor 'das kyi/ /sdug bsngal ri dwags mthar byed shog /'gro ba'i ma dag khams kyi lcags/ /bla med ye shes gser bzang po/ /sgrib gnyis dri med rin cen gyi/ /snang ba dam pa'i 'od 'bar shog /'khor ba'i 'brog dgon la gnas 'gro'i/ /mya ༅ mtha' dag med mdzad nas/ /byang chub mchog gi dpal chen por/ /thugs rje chen pos sbyor bar shog /gang gi dpal gyi mgur yangs nas/ /dam pa'i chos kyi grags pa yis/ /'gro kun 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /sgrol ba'i dbyangs snyan rnar 'jib shog /ji lta ji snyed chos rnams kun/ /mngon sum mkhyen pas lus can tshogs/ /chos kyi rgyal srid chen po yi/ /go 'phang mchog la 'god par shog /kun la sman mdzad bla na med/ /be+eḍūrla 'od rgyal po'i mthus/ /'gro rnams sdug bsngal rab zhi nas/ /bde ba can du skye bar shog /rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras gang gis/ /bka' stsal sman mdo las byung ba'i/ /phan yon 'bras bur lnga brgya pa'i/ /lus can yongs kyis spyod par shog /don kun grub pas byang chub mchog /brnyes nas 'gro ba'i mchod rten du/ khri spyar ltar mkha' (95ba〉5 nyam ma rgan kun/ /gang gi mched slar myur 'gyur shog /'jigs pa brgyad sogs rgud pa'i rgya/ /thugs rje'i mtshon gyis nyer bcad nas/ /bde skyid dpal la lus can kun/ /sbyor zhig ārla tā rī ma/ /ngag la smra ba'i dbang phyug gis//blo gsal skal bzang re skong ba/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar thos bsam sgom/ /dus las yol ba med de rgyal/ /zhes pa 'di'ang lha sa zur khang pa don grub dbang rgyal gyis mgron gnyer don grub rgyal mtshan gyi don du bde bar gshegs pa brgyad/ byang chub mchod rten/ seng ldeng nag sgrol/ nged rang gi 'dra 'bag dang bcas bzhengs pa'i rgyab tu gzong 'phrul gyis brkos chog pa'i zhal byang smon lam zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /lus can kun la byams ldan mi pham mgon/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yab gyur 'jam dpal —/27—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dbyangs/ /gangs can lha gcig 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /phul byung thugs rje chen pos nye bar dgongs/ /ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i gnas lugs kun/ /mngon sum gzigs pa'i ston pa btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin ngag gi dbang phyug blo gros gter/ /skal bzang rgya mtsho'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /thub gsung mchog gyur stong phrag brgya pa dang / /brgyad stong bskal bzang gzungs 'dus gra tog gser/ /dgongs 'grel bka' gdams glegs bam lam rim sogs/ /gser dngul snag tshas rgyu byas pu sta gaḥ/ /sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnas brtan bcu drug sku/ /gu ru mtshan brgyad zab mo lta ba dang / /rgya chen (96na〉grad rgyud 'khrungs rabs la sogs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas byang sems sku brnyan bris thang rnams/ /yul dbyibs e gzugs chos lung dkar mo yi/ /dpon yig ngag dbang dpal 'byor zhes bya bas/ /rdul bral ston zla ltar dkar lhag bsam gyis/ /sgo gsum 'bad pa chen pos nye bar bskrun/ /legs byas 'bras bus bzod dka'i sdug bsngal kun/ /ming yang mi bsgrag tshe 'byor bde skyid rgyas/ /'khor 'khyams de srid ngan song gnas gsum du/ /nam yang mi skye mngon mtho'i rten thob shog /ring por mi thogs srid pa'i 'tshing rgyalas/ /nyer grol thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam/ /mngon gyur gtan gyi bde ba bla na med/ /nyams su myong ba'i skal bzang 'thob par shog /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa/ /gnas skabs srid pa'i zung rngu rab zhi zhing / /ring min mthar thug srid zhir mi gnas pa'i/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di'ang e pa yig mkhan ngag dbang dpal 'byor gyis gong gsal gyi rten rnams bzhengs pa'i kha byang dang rgyun gyi ngag 'don sogs gang 'os la byas chog pa'i tshigs bcad smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /'jam dbyangs mthon mthing ral pa'i khur dor nas/ /ngur smrig gar gyi rnam rol btsong kha pa'i / /sku brnyan ngag gi dbang phyug nam mkha' yis/ /chos dkar zhing du 'bad pas bskrun pa'i mthus/ /'di nang chos dang srid kyi legs tshogis (96ba)rgyas/ /yang srid kun tu lha mi'i rten bzang —128

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenarnyed/ /sgrib gnyis 'ching ba'i rgya lasang min du/ /rnam grol mi gnas mya ngan 'das thob shog /ces pa 'di'ang rig byed pa tre bo ngag dbang nam mkhas rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i sku thang bzhengs par rgyab yig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /dge dge 'dun grub tsho gos rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i bsod nams grus/ /phun tshogs dbang po rigs brgyud mnga' 'bangs rnams/ /srid zhi'i sdu bsngal mtsho bsgral phan dang bde'i/ /rin cen gling bgrod bsam don lhun grub shog /thub rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho dbang de gsung dge 'dun tshogs bcas kyis/ /thugs rje rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng yol med mthus/ /rnam sras gling pa mi nor 'khor bcas kyi/ /'di phyi'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /bsod nams bsod nams rgya mtsho/nams nyer bsags phung bo rgya che zhing / /mtsho ltar gting zab a smra'i gos smin pa/ /bde skyid ro brgyar phun tshogasadabang gi rgyal/ /brgyud par bcas pas rtag tu nyams myong shog /dbang rje yon tan rgya mtsho khyug yon tan brgyad kyis rgya mtsho'i gos/ /yongs gtams phun tsho gis dbang po rigs brgyud kyis/ /rtag par myong ba'i legs byas nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /byang chub mchog gi chu gter cher 'bab shog /ngag dbang tshangs sras lha mo'i blo gros la/ /mnyam du spyod pa'i skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /deng 'dir bden pa brjod pa'i tshigs ji bzhin/ /phun tshogs dbang por lhun rgyas grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di 'ang rnam sras gling pa phun tshogs dbang pos zhal thang gra tshar bzhengs par (97na)rgyab yig smon lam zhig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /dkon mchog gsum 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /byang chub ma thob bar du gsol ba 'debs/ /mi 'dir 'gal rkyen bar chad kun zhi zhing / /ring 'tsho mnga' thang dpal 'byor rgyas par shog /de nasanying mtshams sbyar tshe bar do yi/ /'jigs skrag sdug bsngal nyams su mi myong bar/ /'od kyi lam nas bde ba can zhing du/ /pad+ma'i sbubs su rdzus te skye bar shog /snang ba mtha' yas zhal mthong de gsung chos/ /nyams su blangs pas srid zhi las 'das pa'i/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa myur thob ste/ /—129

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'gro kun 'dren pa'i ded dpon byed par shog /ces pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam 'di ni bsod nams ja lang jang gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /'gro la mngon sum snang ba dge ba'i bshes/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bor nges brnyed nas/ /mi phyed dad pas snying nas gsol 'debs na/ /gang byin bdag gi snying la myur 'jug shog /lha dang skal mnyam bde skyid tshe la dbang / /rnam thos bu yi dpal dang 'byor pa rnyed/ ji 'phos bde ba can du rdzusaskyes nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /ces pa 'di'ang mo gol sbi sgrol chis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /mthong thos dran pas rnam grol bdi gshegs sku/ /ri mo rab bkra mes po'i thong yangs nas/ /bsod nams mtho ris chu bo'i rgyun 'khyil ba'i/ /rten (97ba tha zang rin cen yol gor rab brtan shog /dge ba'i 'bras bu nam yang mi 'dzad pa'i/ /byang chub mchog gyur yongs bsngag gter chen po'i/ /phun tshogs bum pa bzang por longs spyod pa'i/ /bzang po'i bskal ba can du 'gyur bar shog/ces skyar po ba bsod nams rab brtan gyi phyi rten du bzhengs pa'i thang sku'i rgyab yig tshigs bcad 'di ni rdo rje dbang phyug gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma mgon po 'od dpag med/ /dbyer med bdag snying pa khro'i dbus bzhugs nas/ /nying mtshams sbyar tshe bde ba can zhing du/ /pad+ma'i sbubs su skye ba len par shog /ces pa 'di'ang khal kha gu yang ji'i sang gi kha ton du za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /snying dbus 'dab stong rgyas pa ze'u 'bru'i steng / /dkon mchog kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /mi phyed gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs rje bdag gi rgyud la 'jug byin rlobs/ /'di snang dam chos sgrub pa'i nyes tshogis zhi/ /nying mtshams sbyar tshe bde ba can nyid du/ / legs skyes 'od dpag med kyis rjes bzung ste/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal gyur cig zhes pa 'di yang bsam blo dka' bcu chos bzang rnam rgyal sa bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /—13()

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung lhags bam dang po/ zhedagazod ma nyid nas lus can ma lus pa//'dren pa zhal 'tshes rgyal tshab mi pham mgon//thugasarje'i 'od kyi sbu gu'i lam yangs por//sa spyod seng ge dgra 'du po nyer drangs gsol//zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul kyi rtser son pa//dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin gnas mchogo tu//pad+ma'i sbubs skyes mgon 98na khyod zhal gyi lung //theg chen chos kyi bdud rtsi 'thung bar shog/sa bcu lam lnga'i rin cen them skas la//'dzegs nas ring min stug po bkod pa sa/nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur//sngon sangs rgyas nas 'gro kun 'dren par shog/nye du 'bangs 'khor rnams kyis legasami dgas nas//rten bzhengs dkon cog mchod dang thub gsung bklags//sbyin sogs dge ba'i sabon yongs smin pa'i//a smra'i 'bras bzang yis su myong bar shog/chos nyid don dam gdod nasa'agyur ba med//chos can rgyu dang 'bras bu slu med kyis//ji ltar smon pa yid bzhin lhun 'grub par//rgyal sras slob mar bcas pas bdag byin rlobs//zhes o rod g.yon ru'i dpon po seng ge dgra 'dul dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i tshe sprul sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no//mkhyen brtse nus par ldan pa rdzags sangs rgyas//de gsung bden pa gnyis ldan dam pa'i chos//legs bsgrubs rig grol gnyis ldan dge 'dun te//mchog gsum thugs rje'i mthu dpung deng 'dir skyed//bā khan ban+de mchos 'brang bcas pa rnams/'i kya mu ni gtso gyur rten brtan pa//'dusasder bcas sogs blta phyir gangs ljongs su//bgrod pa'i 'dun pa bgegs med 'grub par shog/sgo gsum zug rngur byed pa las nyon gdon//mthar byed legs byas lag na rdo rje mtshon//rab 'bar gsang ba kun 'dzin rnam par thar//bsgrubs 98ba ) pa'i skal ba bzang po 'gyur bar shog/ces pa 'di'ang o rod g.yon ru'i dpon po bā khan ban+de dang dpon mo tshe ring rgyal gnyis kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no//dpal ldan shākya'i 'phrin las gangs ri las//grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i legs bshad ga d+ma'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rgyun/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i rgya mtshor 'bebs mkhas pa/ /bshes gnyen drang srong mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod yongs ba ched dag pa'i zhing byon nas/ /sa lam mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan kun/ /gong du spel la sgrub pa'i bgegs bral zhing / /gzhan don rlabs chen lhun gyis 'grub par shog /snying nas mos par ldan pa'i bu slob rnams/ /mkhyen brtse'i mdza' bsan ma yang mi gtong bar/ /skye bar rjes su bzung ste nges legs su/ /'dren pa'i smon lam lhun gyis khrub par shog /ces slob dpon lcang lo can pa 'phrin las rgya mtshor gsol 'debs smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes thos bsam dar rgyas gling spyi tsho gos kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o/ / chos nyid dag pa'i zhing sa rab gshin par/ /bden tshig rgyu 'bras sa bon legs smin pa'i/ /'dod don dpag bsam yongs 'du'i grib bsil la/ /spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por bdag gyur cig /ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i blo gros kyis/ /skal bzang gdul bya rgya mtsho'i re stong ba'i/ /yang dag dge ba'i bshes khyod srid pa'i mtha'/ /rdzogs min rdo rje lta bur (99na tha rtan gyur cig /blo bzang grags snyan lugs zung bstan pa'i srog /mthu stobs nus pas legs 'dzan yangs pa'i sa/ /stong mdzad mi dbang sku tshe chab srid rnams/ /dbyar gyi chu gter ji bzhin 'phel bar shog /'dus pa'i sde 'di khrimasagatsang thos bsam sgom/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor lor bcas pa yi/ /srid zhi'i yon tan ma lus bla nasablar/ /'phel ba'i dga' ston rtag tu myong bar shog /rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / /dpal chen 'phrin las 'khor lo'i mthu stobs kyis/ /dus rnams rtag tu shis pa'i gru char gyis/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khyon kun khyab gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang pho brang gong ri dkar po'i dkon gnyer dge steng bla ma ngag dbang kun bzang gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /dri med kā shi'i man shel ngos yangs par/ /bla ma yi dam srung ma'i snang brnyan tshon/ /rnam bkra —/32

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa ra po dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanaji bzhin rang sems dag pa'i skur/ /yongs shar 'di phyi'i don kun 'grub par shog /ces mdo btsun ngag dbang lhun grub kyis thang sku'i rgyab yig tu 'dri rgyu'i tshigs bcad cig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o/ /dpal ldan rtsa gsum 'khor lo'i byin rlabs kyis/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya gzil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal/ /gang shar rang sar grol ba'i rig pa 'dzin/ /bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tshor g.yo med brtan gyur cig /mes po tshangs pa'i blo dang brtson pa yis/ /'bangs rnams rdzogs ldan (99bskol bzang la sbyor bas/ /gnam gyi she mong dpung pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin skyong ba zhabasabartan shog /dga' ldan phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba yi/ /'chi med dbang po'i 'dun sa pho brang che'i/ /chos srid bstan pa mu ti ka yi 'phreng / /yid can bsod nams srad bur rtag rgyu shog /skyon sangs rgyasaganyis pa'i smin grol gyi/ /bshad sgrub snga 'gyur bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan du/ /sprul pa'i sku mchog gter bdag gling pa yi/ /bzhed pa ji bzhin bla nas blar 'phel shog /cho so nyid kunas dag pa'i mkha' dbyingasangos/ /chos can rgyu gos lhun grub chu 'dzin las/ /'dzad med byin rlabs char gyis phan dang bde'i/ /gser gyi snyem g.yur du za bar shog zhes brtan bzhugs smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni lung bstan dus la bab pa'i rtsod bral gyi gter ston sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa'i gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs te za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa ngag dbang nam mkha'o/ /'od mtshan dpag tu med pa snang mtha' yas/ /tshe dbang rig 'dzin grub pa thod phreng rtsal/ /ma smad thugs rje'i bum pa bzang po las/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rtag tu stsol/ /ngag dbang 'jam dpal zhi khros rjes bzung bas/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal/ /blo bsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i dpal mgon du/ /nges pa lnga ldan ji bzhin g.yo med shog /rgyal dbang blo bzang grags pa'i chos srid bstan/ /mthu stobs nus pas gyen du rab 'degs pa/ /dpal ldan (100na〉rdor 'dzin skyong ba mi yi rje/ /gzhom med rdo rje'i khri la rtag brtan shog /dzā ti'i dri bsung 'thul ba'i yul gru —133

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)nas/ /rnam bkra za 'og 'thag pa'i rgyal khams bar/ /khrims gnyis gser gyi gnya' shing rab lci bas/ /'gro rnams rdzogs ldan dga' ston la spyod shog /phyogs las rnam rgyal phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /smin grol rgyud 'brel man ngag rdo rje'i theg /legs par bshad pa'i khrims ldan rigasa'adzin gling / /srid mtha'i bar du bla nas blar 'phel shog /lhag bsam zhing sar dge ba'i sa bon tshogs/ /legs btab 'bras bzang snye ma ro bda'i bcud/ /bdag sogs mkha' mnyam skye rgu ma lus pas/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du myong bar shog /dngos grub 'byung gnas rtsa rgyud bla ma dang / /byin rlabs gter mdzod bde gshegs zhi khro'i lha/ /'phrin las kun sgrub 'dod khams dbang phyug mas/ /bsam pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ces mchode dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyisarnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par snyan dar sum brgya skor gong bcas phul dus nged rang dang sde pa gnyis ku'i ring 'tsho'i smon lam tshigs bcad dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tre bo ngag dbang nam mkha'o/ /bde legs dbyar skyes gsar pa'i sgrib bsil las/ /phan bde'i la ba dkar por stegs bcas pa'i/ /skal ldan legs bris tsho gos kyi dga' ston can/ /blo bzang grags pa mchod sbyin brgya par 'dud/ /yun du mi dman goms pa'i bsod nams kyi/ /(1yib jig dbang 'jam mgon blo gros bzang po yi/ /ring lugs rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab pa'i khur/ /'dzin mdzad yongs 'dzin dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe rabs kun tu dal ba'i rten thob nas/ /bshes gnyen mchog gi mgon gyis legs bzung ste/ /'jam dpal snying po'i bstan pa dri med la/ /thos bsam sgom pa byed par byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas skabs dam chos sgrub par byed pa'i dus/ /nyer 'tshe'i mi mthun dgra lasarnam rgyal zhing / /mthar thug mos pas spyod dang 'phags lam la/ /bslab cing bgrod tshe thogs pa med par shog /gang zhig sangs rgyas de gsung sgrub pa'i tshogs/ /slu med dam pa'i mthu yi legs byasakyi/ /brgya phrag sgo gleg bkral las dus kun tu/ /don gnyas lhun gyis grub pa'i ba po shis stsol/ /ces—/34

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (na)pa 'di yang khal kha dpon po bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ba la rten nas ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o/ /blo ldan thos 'dzin be+eḍūr dkar po'i snod/ /legs bshad bzang po'i bdud rtsi rab 'khyil ba'i/ /byed po 'jam dbyangs bla ma btsong kha pa/ /grags pa don ldan khyod kyi thugs rje dang / /rgyal kun yum gcig ngag dbang dbyangs can lha/ /'dod khams dbang phyug gtso mo'i skur bstan pa'i/ /srid gsum bdag mo dpal ldan re ma ti/ /gang gi thogs pa med pa'i 'phrin las mthus/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi gsung rab ji snyed rnams/ /'khrul med dgongs 'grel bstan bcos gleg bam tshogs/ /mi zad chos sbyin par gyi sbyor ba dang / /snyim pa'i 'phrul gyis mang du spel ba la/ /nyer 'tshe'i nad gdon (101na tha gegs dang bar chad sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams ma lus rab zhi zhing / /bsam don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i dge legs gang / /'bad med lag rtser stsol ba'i dpal thob shog /gang de bsgrub pa'i sgo nas sbyin pa'i bdag /sor mo'i sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i byed po dang / /phyogs 'dir lus ngag yid kyi ngal ba dag /bsten kun don gnyis ma lus 'grub gyur cig /ces pa yang sa skyong mi'i dbang phyug ngag dbang dga' ldan rab ldan gyis nged rang gi brtsams chos phar phyin mdzod sogs po ti 'ga' zhig par du bzhengs pa'i tshe par yig pa gnyis kyis bskul ba'i ngor sbyar/ /dpal ldan dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa/ /gcig tu bsdoms pa khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i sde dpon rdo rje 'dzin/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /'di nas bla med byang chub ma thob bar/ /tshig tsam min par snying nas gsol 'debs na/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas par dri med spyan gyis gzigs/ /re sa g.yin na med do thugs rje'i gter/ /las dang nyon mongs dbang gis 'khor ba 'dir/ /skye srid grangs med blangs kyang stong par log /dal 'byor rten bzang lan gcig thob pa gang / /don ldan snying po len par byin gyis sgro mes/ /sngon chad rtag par 'dzin pa'i gdon chen 'dis/ /dgra 'dul gnyen skyong tshe 'di'i bya bas g.yengs/ /da ni nges med myur du —/35

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'chi snyam pa'i/ /long med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /de lta'i bde dang sdug bsngal ma lus pa//ring nas dge dang mi dge'i las bsags pa'i/ /'bras bur shes nas (101ba)rgyu 'bras phra mo la/ /blang dor tshul bzhin bsgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshangs dang brgya byin 'khor ༷ rgyal sogs/ /chen po'i go 'phang grangs med myong ba'i mthar/ /bzod dka' ga song skye mang brgyud pa 'dis/ /rnam dag nges 'byung skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyis ya nga'i g.yang sa las/ /rnam par grol ba'i zhi ba'i gling mchog tu/ /bgrod kyang 'gro rnams nyam thag tshul bsam nas/ /byang chub sems mchog 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /grangs ring sgrub dka' bskal chen gsum gyi tshogs/ /snyigs dus tshe thung gcig la rdzogs nus pa'i/ /zab mo nye ba'i lam gyis yid phyogs te/ /rdo rje'i theg la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs/ /mdor na deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa'i bstan pa la/ /zhugs nas mtha' bral lta dang rim gnyis lam/ /zung 'brel nyams su len par byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas skabs su yang tshe dang bsod nams dang / /dpal 'byor longs spyod snyan grags rab rgyas shing / /mthar thug sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'ams / /mngon du gyur ba'i dga' ston rgyas par shog /ces pa 'di yang hor dka' bcu ngag dbang phun tsho gos kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor las byung ba'i/ /bcom ldan gdug dkar lha yi mthu stobs kyis/ /bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs ma lus tshar bcad de/ /mi mthun rgol ba kun las rgyal bar mdzod/ /mtshan tsam thos pas 'chi bdag dpung 'joms pa/ /nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing gi mgon/ /bcom (102na skon tshe dang ye shes dpag med pa'i/ /thugs rje chen pos deng 'dir byin gyis rlomes/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po blo bzang grags pa yi/ /bstan pa rin cen yar ngo'i zla ba ltar/ /spel phyir ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /'gyur med seng ge'i khri la zhabs brtan shog /de ltar gsol ba ji bzhin btab pa yis/ /bsam pa'i re ba don dang ldan pa'i ched/ /deng nas bzung ste khri —136

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenakhrag lo yi bar/ /nam yang g.yo ba med par khas len 'cha'/ /gangs kyi ra bas bskor ba'i bod yul 'dir/ /bka' khrims btsan pos rgyal po'i srid 'dzin pa/ /sa chen skyong ba blo bzang mthu stobs kyi/ /zhabs pad rdo rje lta bur brtan par shog /zhwa ser 'chang ba'i dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde/ /dpal ldan mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa'i/ /ring lugs gong nas gong du legs 'phel zhing / /srid mtha'i bar du brtan par gnas gyur cig zhan tu dkar ba'i bsam pa rnam dag gis/ /smon lam 'di skul dge 'dun 'dus tshogs la/ /nyer 'dzugs sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus byed pa po/ /'di phyi kun bde sangs rgyas myur thob shog /'jig rten khams su nad yams 'thab rtsod dang / /dbul phongs la sogs mi mthun kun zhi zhing / /lo tog dus smin tshong pa khe spog sogs/ /mthun rkyen thams cad bsam pa ltar 'grub shog /slu med dkon mchog rnam gsum byin rlabs dang / /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i mthu stobs rtsal/ /dge 'dun rnams kyi bden tshig brjod pa'i mthus/ /smon lam btab pa ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces snyan (102ba)ngag gi lam nas ma drangs par 'bol rtsom go bde zhing 'di tsam 'tsho zhes pa'i tshigs bcad zhig dgos zhes gsol dpon ge ra ba blo bzang mkhyen brtse dang blo bzang dge 'dun spun gnyis kyis nan gyis bskul ba la brten nas dus dang bstun pa'i lo grangs kyi mtha' 'dzin pa ni rgyal sras lag len gyi don bzhin 'dri ma nus/ 'on kyang bla chen spyi'i phyag mdzod nas bton te khri khrag lo'i grangs gsal ba dang bcas grong tshig rkang par bcad de za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o/ /byams pas nyer drangs sems skyed dzaskru'i 'bras/ /phul byung tsho gos gnyis rgya mtshos yongs bsgyur bas/ /chos gzugs gser gyi snyem dar drag pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs gzhen nu 'khon rigs su/ /rim byon bstan pa'i snying po rdo rje'i theg /bskal par bsgrubs pa'i bsod nams tsho me zong gis/ /legs rnyed bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun dngos dpal ldan chos skyong gi /gsung ngag zab mo'i smin grol lam ston par/ /mtshan —/37—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)nyid kun ldan rdo rje slob dpon che//dpal ldan skal ba bzang bor gsol ba 'debs//byams pa' chus brlan brtse chen snying po'i zhabs//ngur smrig gos bklubs blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal//ngag gi dbang phyug grub pa'i dpa' bo yi//dri med ring lugs 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs//bsod nams ye shes zung 'jug sku bzhi'i bdag/tshar chen chos kyi rgyal bo yab sras kyi//bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs 103na sta༄ra 'dzug pa'i dpal//skal bzang gdul bya'i mgon por gsol ba 'debs//gar gyi dbang phyug bcom ldan rnam par rgyal//tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo bcas rnams kyi//med byung thugs rje'i nyi ma 'od po ches//bdud bzhi'i smag rum ming gi lhag mar mdzod//byams pa'i thugs kyis 'gro kun 'dren slad du//ngag la smra ba'i dbang phyug zhal sgo nas//zab rgyas chos tshul dbyangasacan rgyud mangs glu//len phyir rdo rje'i khri la zhabs brtan shog/lus can bsod nam rgya mtsho'i zhing mchog tu//nges pa lnga ldan lta bur rtag bzhugs nas//gsang chen slob bshad bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal//bzang po'i skal ldan don du bsgreng bar gsol//thabs shes nyi zla zung 'jug a lha gzugs//brtan byed ka ba a wa dhū ti'i rtsa//gzhe me med rdo rje'i srog tu legs song nas//'ja' lus gzugs skus 'gro 'di rtag skyong shog/rtsa rgyud bla ma rdo rje lang dbang dngos//dgyes mdzad rdo rje dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag/gur mgon zhal bzhi bstan srung kun gyi gtso//deng 'dir smon pa ji bzhin 'grub byin rlobs/khams gsum dbang byed rje btsun rigs byed ma//lha chen tshogs bdag 'dod pa'i rgyal po yis//chos dang srid kyi legs tshogos ma lus pa//dbang bsdus dus kun dge ba'i ba po shisashog zhes tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i ring lugs 'dzin pa chen po bdag po rgyal rtse ba mkhan chen byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs tshigs su bcad pa 'di 03ba ji pā ṇi byā ka ra ṇa ka tsan su ra su sogs brda sprod rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa se dkar rigs kyi theg le 'dar pa lo tsā ba ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub kyis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar yi ge ༷ ni dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o//

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu spung glegs bam dang po/ zhenabyin rlabs gter gyur rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /dngos grub stsol mdzad sgrub sdebargyad kyi lha/ /'phrin las kun sgrub legs ldan ma ning sogs/ /rtsa gsum thugs rje'i mthudapung ding 'dir bskyed/ /med byung mkhyen khyod blo gros rab yangs shing / /mchog gi rdo rje'i slob dpon rig kun bdag /mkha' khyab 'gro 'dren ba ched pa myur 'grub nas/ /ljongs 'dir sprul sku'i yang srid gsal bar shog /gdul dka'i 'gro rnams yal bor zhi ba'i klong / /bzhugs pa rgyal sras rnam thar ma yin phyir/ /spyi dang khyad par chos kyi dbang phyug gi /bstan pa'i srog shing ched du myur 'byon gsol/ /pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nyams dga' yang / /nyang ston rigs sngags 'chang ba'i smin grol rgyun/ /spel ba'i snying stobs gzengasamatho khyod tsam du/ /nges phyir yang srid zhing 'dir 'dzin byin rlobs/ /chos nyid gdod nas mi 'gyur lha lam gzhis/ /chos can rgyu gos slu med mkha' glang las/ /bden tshigs char rgyun gyis bskyed re ba'i 'bras/ /dus su yol ba med par smin par shog /ces pa 'di yang rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'khor ༷ ba khyab bdag blo gros mchog gi rdo rje zhing 'di'i sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i tshe chos rje thub bstan pa sogs sprul sku'i bkod pa myur (104na 〉 cu na gyi mos pa cher 'dug pa dang bcas thog ma nyid nas gsol ba btab pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo ma log pa gal che bar mngon te za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs bzhu blugs su/ snyam par 'khyil bas 'jigs med rdo rje'i mtshon//gdengs nas yid srubs sdodang bcas pa dpung / /phye mar thogs shig dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag /bde ldan zhing gi 'dren pa gar gyi dbang / /mgon des bsngags pa'i me rtag man+da ras/ /legs brgyan rnam par rgyal ma bcom ldan 'das/ /dgyes zhal 'dzum gyis 'gro 'di dbugs dbyungs zhig /'chal ba'i dri bral khrims kyi rtsa ba brtan/ /rgya chen gsung rab thos pa'i 'dab stong bzhad/ /bsam gtan ro yi myos pa'i ze'u 'bru rgod/ /'dus pa'i tshogs kyis bden pa'i tshigs brjod na/ /'go rtsod rtsom pa'i dkyus ring zur mig gis/ /'jam dbyangs gzhen nu'i brtan pa nyer phrogs nas/ /dga' ba'i —139

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)zlos gar mgrin pa'i pad mtsho sa/sgyur mdzad bshes gnyen rdo rje ltar brtan shog/bsod nams dpung pas bgrod shul rjes snyeg par//kun bzod dkyil 'khor 'breng ba'i mi yi bdag/nyi bu'i mche ba'i phrag las ring brgal te//sku tshe'i g.yung drung rtag tu 'khyil bar shog/dga' ba brgya pa la sogs dregs ldan gyi//gtsug na zhabs rdul nyer bkod tsong kha pa'i//gsang chen sngags kyi yang rtse 'dus pa'i lam//legs 'dzin sde 'di srid mthar 'phel bar shog/sa 04bzla zhun ma'i mdangs 'dzin zhwa ser bstan//chos srid bla nas blar 'bar 'od stong gis//lus med ma mig gong sde dang bcasapa'i dpung //pha mthar byed pa'i dga' ston rtag myong shog/mang por phan pa bsgrubs kyang sgrib g.yogs kyis//da dung ngo 'phrod ma gyur ris bral 'gro//mi bzad sdug bsngal gsum las nyer thar nas//gto bde'i ro brgya'i bas kyis mi par shog/lpo par rgya hor bod kyi sar la//༅sasocog gi lus༅ ma lus pa//rdzogos ldan bde skyid dngos myong lnga bdo ba//ma' sum lta zhog ming yang migrags shog/rang sems som nyi bral bas gsol btab na//rang gak+ṣ-i na lus can thams cad srid mtsholas//rang dbang med par nyer sgrol dkon mchog gsum//rang snang mos ngor 'dir spyon byin gyisalhos//mthong thos dran reg don ldan mdzad pa'i mgon//mgon po bslu ba med pa'i bden pa'i stobs//stobs dang nus pas bsam pa'i don rnams kun//kun tu smon pa ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig/ces pa 'di'ang yer pa dga' ldan gsang sngags gling pa'i slob dpon grwa bcas kyis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o//bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod//legs 'dzin stobs chen gtum po'i gad brgyangs kyis//me tog mda' can sde bcas byer ba dang //lhan cig sra mkhregs rdo rje'i gur chen phub//bde ldan zhing gi mgon des dgongs pa mdzad//rnam par rgyal dang bcom ldan tshe sbyin mas//bdud 05na ) rtsi'i bcud kyis gtam pa'i bum pa yis//lus can kun la 'chi med dbang skur stsol/khrims ldan 'dus pa'i tsho gos rnams ma/na gcig tu//mchog gsum thugs rjes bskul

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenaba'i rgyud mangs glu/ /bden pa'i tshig tu brjod pa'i 'gyur khug sgra/ /rna bar zil dngar snyan pos tshim par shog /'khor 'das zil gnon 'jam dpal rdo rje yi/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i dga' bsartag mos pa/ /yang dag lam bzang ston pa dge ba'i bshes/ /bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen dam par zhabs brtan shog /ngag dbang zur phud lnga ldan mi'i zlos gar/ /legs bsgyur blo bzang grags pa'i ring lugs mchog /rgya chen nam mkha'i pha mthar spel slad du/ /mtsho byung snying gar rol khyod brtan par shog /rab yangs blo gros te se las 'ongs klung / /lugs zung khrims kyi rgya mtshor nyer babasanas/ /rtag tu skal bzang la sbyor mthu stobs dbang / rdo rje'i khri la g.yo med brtan par shog /bu ram shing pa'i lung rtogs sa chen po/ /'degs pa'i rnam dpyod rus sbal snying stobs can/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa'i/ /bstan pa 'dzam gling kun la khyab par shog /rgyang grags grong las dben pa ri bo'i spor/ /chos dang srid kyi legs tshogos ma lus pa/ /yongs 'dus thos bsam sgom pa'i sgron me yis/ /gling bzhi mun pa sel ba'i dpal 'bar shog /'gro dang mi 'gro'i yid can tha dag gi khri spyad la gos par kun 'byung nyer zhi bas/ /'bras bu sdug bsngal bden pa dang bral te/ /nges par legs pa'i dga' ston spyod par shog /bcom ldan ma he'i zhal can (105ba lnga ka' sdod bcas/ /myur mdzad mgon po 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho so 'phrin las lhun grub cing / /dus rnams kun tu dge zhing shis par mdzod/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang chags bral dam pa'i chos/ /theg gsum dge 'dun chos nyid 'gyur ba med/ /chos can rgyu 'bras mi bslu rten 'brel mthus/ /ji ltar smon pa de bzhin 'grub par shog /ces brtan bzhugs smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni rgyal dar gong pa mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis ri bo chos gling du 'dzugs rgyur bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o/ /'bor los sgyur rgyal stobs ldan khro bo bcu'i/ /ye shes rang snang srung 'khor rtsibs rnon pos/ /gnod byed bgegs kyi dpung tshogs phyer btags nas/ /gzhom med rdo rje 'bar ba'i gur —141—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)khang dbus//dpal ldan bla ma rigs rnams kun gyi bdag/sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar mkhan he badz+raḥ/longs spyod rdzogs sku ji bzhin srid mtha'i bar/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon por bzhugs par gsol//gsung ngag chad med dbang bzhis rgyud smin blos//lam bzhi'i 'gros kyis rnam grol rnal 'byor can//skal bzang gdul bya rgya mtsho'i dpal mgon du/khyu ti'i ka ba rdo rjer 'grub par shog/blo gros bzang pos 'bangs rnams byams pas skyong //mthu stobs nus pas gzhan sde tshar gcod pa//sa spyod dbang phyug sku tshe chab srid brtan//lugs zung khrims kyis 'gro rnams bde bar shog/tshul ldan rig 'dzin bkra shis g.yas 'khyil dung //106na ) snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan slob bshad chos//sgra dbyangs sgrogs pas sdo 'di yongs gang ste//tshar chen ring lugs phyogs bcur rgyas par shog/'od gsal lha rigs 'khon gyi gdung 'dzin las//rigs gsum sgyu dra'i gar mkhan sa skya pa'i//lung rtogs bstan pa mu nyi ka yi 'phreng //chad med 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan 'gyur shog/khor yug gangs kyis bskor ba'i gser ldan stor//snod kyi lang tsho'i dge mtshan dar drag cing //bcud rnams ring 'tsho'i tshe dang dpal 'byor gyi//dbang thang dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel bar shog/srid gsum dbang sgyur rje btsun rigs byed ma//'dzad med mchod sbyin lha chen tshogs kyi bdag/stobs ldan dpa' bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po yis//bkra shis dpal gyi sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye//chos srung bye ba'i sdod pon rdo rje gur//stobs 'phrog legs ldan nag po gdong bzhi pa//dbang drag zhi dang 'a rgyas pa' 'phrin las kun//thogs med sgrub pa'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzod//ces pa 'di'ang rgyal dar gong pa mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bkra shis chos sder 'dzugs rgyur bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dka/ brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o//

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanamachims phu gsung gi yang dben gyi gnas 'dzin sgrub sde ba rnams la stag ru ba blo bzang dngos grub kyis bsnyen bkur ba'i tshe zhal 'don du gnang ba'i smon lam tshigs bcad sogs/rgya bod bka' gter rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs/ khyad par pad+ma thod 'phreng be+e ro'i zhabs/ /legs ldan rdo rje gnam lcags me 'bar rje/ /pradzha ra smi rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /zhi khro kun 'dus sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha/ /rtsa gsum spyan gyis ma rgan lus can kun/ khyad par rgyu sbyor yon mchod bdag sogs la/ /(106ba〉na zigs pa lhur mdzad thugs rjes rtag tu stongs/ /thog med dus nas da lta'i bar bsags pa'i/ /mi dge bcu dang mtshams med nye ba lnga/ /so thar byang sems sngags sdom nyamasapa sogs/ /mdor na sdig pa byas kun snying nas bshags/ /de 'bras mi khom gnas su mi skye zhing / /chos ldan bsgrub nus lha mi'i rten bzang rnyed/ /ring min rang rig dag pa'i rdo rje sems/ /mngon gyur 'gro rnams 'dren par bdag byin rlobs/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i spyan snga mā /snying nas bshagasasdom gsol ba nyer btab pa/ /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i mthus/ /thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par shog /ces pa 'di'ang mchims phu gsung gi yang dben gyi gnas 'dzin sgrub sde ba rnams la stag ru ba blo bzang dngos grub kyis bsnyen bkur ba'i tshe zhal 'don du dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed 'dzin pa ngag dbang 'am mkha'o/ /sras bcas rgyal ba slob mar bcas pa yi/ /med byung thugs rje chen po'i char rgyun gyis/ /ma dag las nyon dri ma kun bkrus nas/ /nges par legs pa'i lam du bkri bar gsol/ /dug gsum lang tsho dar ba'i glang po yis/ /dge tshogs pad+ma dkar po'i rdzing bcom nas/ /sdig lhung rnyog mar —143—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)byas pa'i nyes pa kun/ /'gyod sdom bsam pa thag pas snying nas bshags/ /phyag skor bzlas brjod gsung rab klog pa dang / /sāts+tsha sbyin gtong la sogs legs byas rgyu/ /gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i nyin byed kyis/ /mi dge'i smag rum drung nas 'byin par shog /ces pa 'di'ang dpon sa bsod nams rgyal mos (107na tha skul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa ngag dbang nam mkha'o/ /lag na gdengs pa'i rdo rje las 'phros gur/ /sra mkhregs dum bu gcig dbus tshe mtha' yas/ /gos dkar yum gyis btegs pa'i bum pa'i rgyun/ /bdud rtsis 'chi ba med pa'i dbang bskur stsol/ /thub pa'i gsung ngag mdo rgyud la dbang ba'i/ /blo gros skal bzang dga' ba bskyed pa la/ /rgya chen rnam dpyod stsol bar mtsho byung ma/ /mgrin zhugs bshes gnyen bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /glang chen gdan la nyal 'dra'i ri bo'i spor/ /phan dang bde ba chen po 'byung ba'i gzhir/ /khrims ldan 'dus pas yongs gang bshad sgrub kyi/ /lung rtogs bstan pa srid mthar rgyas par shog /don kun grub pa'i ring lugs za 'og gdugs/ /mdzes byed zhwa ser bstan pa'i gser tog can/ /chos srid zung 'jug khrims kyi yu ba yis/ /nyer bteg grib mar 'gro rnams ngal gsor shog /gtan gyi skyabs gcig slu med dkon cog gsum/ /lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin bden pa'i tshig /legs grub kun gyis mgrin gcig glur blangs pas/ /re ba'i 'bras bu ji bzhin smin par shog /ces pa 'di'ang chos sde ri bo bde chen du 'dzugs rtsis kyi dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa ngag dbang nam mkha'o/ /rnam 'dren thugs rje'i 'jug pa nam du yang / /yol ba med mod khyad par snyigs ma lnga//ches cher bdo ba'i dus 'dir mthu stobs dpung / /myur bar sman gyi bla zhes grags (107ba)pa dkar/ /de phyir mchod bstod gzungs sngags bklags bris pas/ /'bras bu bde ldan zhing gi mgon po'i drung / /pad+ma'i sbubs su chos ldan dbang mo'i srid/ /'dzin par mgon kye brtse bas rjes bzung ste/ /rnam dag smon pa'i zhing sa gshin po la/ /nyer btab legs byas sa bon yongs smin —144

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ rton)pas/ /gtan mdun gser gyi snye mas srid dang zhi'i/ /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal drung nas 'byin par shog /ces pa 'di yang gdong kha chos mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gyis lcam chos ldan dbang mo'i phyi rten du 'od dpag med kyi bris thang bzhengs ba'i rgyab yig tu dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lcang gseb pa 'jam dpal lo/ /rdo rje'i slob dpon lus la gdan gsum rnams/ /tshang bar kun bzang mchod sprin nyer spros mthus/ /dpal ldan bla ma
