bskal brgyar zhabs brtan cing / /bdag sogs 'di phyi'i don kun 'grub par shog ces pa 'di'ang lha ldan gtsang khang lho steng na nged rang gi 'dra 'bag cig 'dug par byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos mchod rgyun btsugs pa'i tshe kha ton du smon lam dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lcang gseb pa 'jam dpal lo/ /'jam dpal rdo rje khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ /brgya phrag lo paṇa spyan drangs bsnyen bkur nas/ /grangs med chos phung bsgyur rtse theg dgu'i rgyud/ /zab las ches zab snga 'gyur rin chen 'phreng / /byang gling bsam grub rgyal po'i snying stobs kyis/ /bzhengs la mthun rkyen bsgrub kun gnas skabs su/ /rmugs 'dzin dbang po'i tshe 'byor la (10ni snyad cing / /ring min kun bzang rang ngo rang 'phrod shog /che mchog zhi khro 'i 'dus pa rtsal chen pos/ /snang srid 'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon pa'i/ /rdo rje'i slob dpon dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtsor/ /'pho 'gyur med par rtag tu brtan par shog /ces pa 'di yang byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos rnying ma rgyud 'bum bzhengs pa'i dus smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lcang gseb pa 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /bskal bzang 'di la mu thi la 'phreng ltar/ /chad med nyer byon bde gshegs stong phrag gi /snang brnyan mthong bas don ldan thos pas grol/ shes can yid kyi shing rta tshar dngar ba/ /dge slong dpal 'byor rgya mtsho'i blo brtson mthus/ /bzhengs pa'i dge 'bras bstan dang bstan 'dzin rgyas/ /—145

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bdag sogs 'gro kun bla med byang chub che/ /ring por mi thogs mngon du 'gyur bar shog /'dren pa gzhan las thugs rje khyad par du/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bla lhag bde gshegs bdun/ /sangasargyas sum cu rtsa lnga'i snang brnyan tshogs/ /bzhengs pas don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /rgya chen spyod dang zab mo lta ba'i lam/ /chad med brgyud pa sum ldan rin chen 'phreng / /gang gi rnam thar tshe rabs thams cad du/ /'dzin pa'i skal ba mchog tu bdag byin rlobs/ /rgyal rnams dngos lta'i skal dman 'gro ba la/ /bshes gnyen gzugs su shar bar nges rnyed nas/ /mi phyed snying nas gsol ba 'debs byed na/ /ma smad byin rlabs sems la 'jug par shog /ces dge slong dpal 'byor rgya mtshos sangs rgyas stong sku/ (108ba〉de gshegs bdun/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo las byung ba'i sangs rgyas/ lam rim brgyud pa/ nged rang gi 'dra 'bag rnams bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lcang gseb pa 'jam dpal lo/ /rdo rje dril bu pa dang rtse mo'i zhabs/ /sku dngos dag zhing gshegs 'dra'i skal zhan yang / /tsha ba 'od gsal don gyi rnal 'byor ma/ /rang ngo 'phrod nas mkha' spyod gnas 'dren shog /smin zin slob ma snod rung byin rlabs kyis/ /ras bris sku dkyil 'di ru rjes bzung nas/ /bskyed rdzogasagadams pa la brten grol ba'i lam/ /mngon gyur dal 'byor don ldan bsgrub nus shog /tshogs bshad za zi tsam min nā ro pa'i/ /gsang chen slob bshad 'di ston bla mar bcas/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du mi 'bral ba'i/ /smon lam rdo rje btsun mos 'grub byin rlobs/ /zhes nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor tshar chen yab sras kyi gzigs snang zhing bkod dang bcas pa nged rang gi dmigs rten la dbu mdzad dpal mgon gyis bris pa'i tshe smon lam mtshams sbyor du za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /gshin po'i zhing sar bskrun pa'i 'bru tshogs rgyun/ /nam yang chad med dge ba'i sa bon du/ /btab pas 'di phyi gnyis su dga' ba'i dpal/ /mu tig 'khri shing rnam thar 'dzin par shog /bsngo —146

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanaba'i rgyas thebs legs byas gaṅgā'i klung / /dmig ba yul byang chub rgya mtshor rtag 'bab zhan/ /rjes 'jug nye dur bcas pa'i bsod nams dpung / /nyi ma'i dngos brgya 'dzin pa'i rjes 'gror shog /ces pa 'di'ang lha sa khang gsar bas ma gnyis dga'i/ (109na〉rtsed du dmigs nas rme rur zhing phul ba'i dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o/ /thub dbang bsod nams dpung gis brtan g.yo dbang 'dus shing / /sras bcas rgyal bar mos pa'i dpyod ldan mas/ /dad rten thub dbang byang sems nyan thos kyi/ /snang brnyan dbang po'i grangs su tshar dngar ba/ /pir thogs rtser son stag lung dpal mgon gyi/ /sor mo'i zlos gar 'phrul las ngo mtshar gzugs/ khel la 'ja' tshon bzhin du rnam bkra bas/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyi khengs pa thung ngur byed/ /legs byas sa bon dar drag ljon pa'i rtser/ /deng nas byang chub bar gyi phan bde'i 'bras/ /yongs smin ro brgya bda' ba'i dga' ston la/ /spyod pa'i skal bzang nyams su myong bar shog /myon rin po che/ 'dzam gling lus med dregs pa mtha' dag gi /gdug pa'i tsha ngar dbal gyi me lce kun/ /mthu stobs gsher gyis bcil mdzad thod 'phreng rtsal/ /thugs rje'i nyi mas yid kyi 'dab rgya phye/ /jo bo rje/'od mtshan stong du 'bar ba'i sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /lnga rig paṇa chen tshul du yongs bsgyur ba/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mar mes gangs can mun/ /sel mdzad mgon kye sgo gsum byin gyis rlomes/ /rje si po che/ gang gi dpung pas nyer bteg ut+pal rtser/ khesarab ral gris log rtog dra ba kun/ /gcod mdzad 'jam dpal rdo rje myong kha pa'i/ /brtse ba'i spyan gyis rtag tu btsa' bar mdzod/ /ngag 'dra 'bag dbang 'dod 'khro'i blo gros dpal bzang pos rgya chen shes bya mtsho ltar gting zab pa/ /legs dpogs 'jam mgon dgyes pa'i (109ba tshes shes gnyen gyis/ /nor 'dzin kun tu dge ba'i bkra shis shog /ces sne'u sdong bdag mo bsod nams dbang 'dus rgyal mos dad rten gra tshar bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul byung ba ltar za tor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o/ /—147

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)me dpung rdo rje rtsibs bcu'i srung 'khor nang / /lnga ldan ye shes gzhal yas khang gi dbus/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i bshes gnyen he ru gaḥ/ /zhal brgyad rdo rje'i ngo bor rtag bzhugs gsol/ /gsung ngag dbang bzhi'i grol lam mtho ris chab/ /blo gros lang tsho dar drag bcud bzang rgyun/ /sku bzhi'i rgya mtshor ro gcig bla ma rje/ /bgrang yas gdul bya'i dpal du brtan par shog /rigs kun khyab bdag dga' chen ye shes mchog /bzang po'i skal ldan gdul byar ston mkhas pa/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang rje btsun e waṃ pa'i/ /ring lugs srid mtha'i bar du rgyas par shog /bstan srung yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal/ /gur gyi mgon po legs ldan gdong bzhi pa/ /bka' nyan dam can rgya mtshor bcas pa yis/ /bsam pa'i re ba skong ba'i 'phrin las sgrubs/ /bcom ldan rigs byed ma dang tshogs kyi bdag /lha chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i gzi byin gyis/ /chos srid yon tan ma lus dbang sdus la/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog kho〉sa pa 'di yang smin grol chos kyi 'byung gnas ngor e waṃ chos ldan gyi mkhan chen gdan sa pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gi gsung gisabaskul ba la brten nas༄ hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lcang gseb pa 'jam dpal lo/ /rigs kun 'khor los sgyur ba'i grags pa'i sgras/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i bshesakhyod kyis/ /(110na ting nas byang chub bar du rjes bzung ste/ /'di phyi'i gtan mdun 'grub par bdag byin rlobs/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje ngur smrig sgyu 'phrul gar/ /legs bsgyur tshar chen 'khor lo'i mgon po yis/ /thugs rje'i bdud rtsis snying gi za ma tog /rab gtams mchag a dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis rje bas si po che dang tshar byu rdo rje lang gi sku bas dad rten bzhengs pa'i kha yag tu zla hor brnyes sug sa byas pa sa r+bhe di klu le mog lo/ /mā tā tsa shā spyu su kha ba sha so : yo gi shu klo ma tri rlu ma tso ba de shi na /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i kha rlang zil dngar can/ zhal 'byor dbang phyug bzhed gzhung mnang ga lugs/ /—148

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (na)badz+ra ma ṇ+ḍi lu hi ca gra mā tra 〉 〉 tsā pa re ma khya ba tsi ra dhi nga ta/dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo 'dir/ /bdag gzhan smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs//(110ba〉tho ga snya ga 〉 ti sha rā sa ga/ khyi ཿ tra tho kra bā rba hi ma khyi nye sarnal 'byor gsang mtha'i yang bcud dril bu'i gzhung / /bde mchog 'khor lo'i phyi dkyil he ru ga'i/rka mā tā na ga ra ma tsa ha sarba ga ta tā khu nga tre ju ba tā ra phe bha nyu//grong khyer chen por bdag dang lus can kun/ /zhugs nas tshe 'dir zung 'jug thob par shog /ces rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bzhed gzhung kye rdor man ngag lugs la bkram gdan dang brtsegs gdan gnyis su yod pa'i phyi ma dang / grub chen dril bu pa'i bzhed srol 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i dkyil thang gnyis rang nyid kyi dmigs rten du bzhengs pa'i zhal byang smom lam du za hor gyis bzhes bkod pa dzagaḥpa tsa muḥbhawastu/ /bsnyen sring bral yang lnga bdo'i 'gro ba la/ /lhag par che ba'i thugs rje ga t+pā raḥ/ /sdug bsngal sgrib gnyis tsha gdung bcil mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan sman gyi bla ma bde gshegs brgyad/ /snang brnyan mig gi bdud rtsir tshar (111na rkong ra ba/ /yar shar gso rig 'dzin mkhas dar mo ba/ /blo bzang chos grags dang ba'i dad pa yis/ /dgos dgos gtsor gyur rtsa lag don du bzhedas/ /'dzad med dge ba'i mdzod kyi srid dang zhi'i/ /yon tan 'byor pas duḥkha'i dbul ba kun/ /lhag mar byas te nying mtshams sbyar ma thag /be+eḍūr snang ba'i zhing du skye bar shog /sum cu rtsa lnga bde bar gshegasapa'i sku/ /mthong bas don ldan thos pas rnam grol ba/ /gso rig 'dzin pa blo bzang chos grags kyis//ma rgan lha lhas thog drangs nye 'brel ched/ /pad rtsa ltar dkar lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus/ /sgo gsum 'bad pa'i 'bras bu dmigs yul rnams/ /gtsor gyur mkha' mnyam skye rgu ji snyed pa/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa mngon gyur shog /ma thob de srid skye ba'i 'phreng ring por/ / mi khoms gnas kyi 'jigs pa kun bral te/ /lha mi'i bde skyid kho nas nyer 'tsho zhing / /nges legs lam bzang —149

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bgrod pa'i skal ldan shog /rang snang dag pa'i ngo bor gdan gsum lha/ /rdo rje slob dpon lus la yongs tshang bar nges rnyed snang brnyan 'di ko tshe'i rig byed/ /'dzin pa'i tshangs ris blo bzang chos grags kyis/ /rang dang nye du'i ched du rab bzhengs pa'i/ /chos dkar chad pa med pa gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /byang chub snying po'i zla ba'i ma ma sa /ro gcig don gnyis rlabs 'phreng yol med shog /thar pa'i khang bzang nang du chud min bar/ /legs bris tshe dang rmugs 'dzin dbang po'i nor/ /mchod sbyin brgya pa'i dbang thang la sogs par/ /spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog /ces gso ba (111ba)rig pa'i gzhung la sbyangs pa dar mo rab 'byams pa blo bzang chos grags rang nyid kyis gtso byas/ pha dgos dgos/ ma lha lha/ dbang 'dus/ bstan 'dzin/ bsam grub/ gsal sgron rnams kyi ched du bde gshegs brgyad/sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga/ 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag rnams bzhengs pa'i thang ka gsum gyi rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson rig pa 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis rbesna/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs rje'i mthus/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal/ /yid srubs g.yul las rnam par rab rgyal te/ /bskal brgyar rdo rje lta bur brtan par shog /ces pa 'di'ang rim gro'i skabs thun 'tshams zhal 'don du rig 'dzin chen po dkon cog lhun grub kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o/ /'chi med grub pa snang mtha' yas pa'i mgon/ /'phags yul paṇa chen gar sgyur a ti sha /dbyer med sangs rgyas kun 'dus tsong kha pa'i/ /thugs rje gaṅgā'i klung rgyun rtag 'bab mdzod/ /ngag dbang dgyes zhal tshems 'phreng ze'u 'bru gang / /ba 'ad nus blo gros nyin byed skal bzang 'gro'i/ /gdung ba'i smag rum mthar byed snang ba'i 'od/ /rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas kun khyab brtan par shog /'jam dpal rdo rje mi yi zol bzung blos/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i rtser son grags pa'i sgra/—150

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zha)khams gsum yongs la dar ba'i chos srid bstan/ /spel phyir mgon khyod rdo rje ltar 'gyur shog /myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang nag po che/ /dus kyi dgra bor gar mdzad ma he'i (112na〉sgor/ /srid gsum dbang mo la sogs srung ma yis/ /smon pa'i re ba ji bzhin lhun grub mdzod/ /nam yang bslu med dkon cog rnam pa gsum/ /lha dang rig 'dzin sa brnyes drang srong gis/ /bden pa'i tshig tu brjod pa'i dbyangs snyan po'i/ /'bras bu mngon sum nyid du myong bar shog /ces tshe ring gnam gyi she mong gis mang bkur rgyal khab chen po pho brang pi cing gi ser mo ba rnams kyis btan chog pa'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad dgos the kha byams gling em chi sangs rgyas 'byung gnas kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson rig pa 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis so/ /mngon mtho'i them skas la brten nges legs kyi/ khang par 'khrid pa'i byed po mkhan slob drin/ /dran pas gsol ba 'debs na thugs rje yi/ /bdud rtsis bdag snying za ma rtag 'geng shog /deng nas sangs rgyas ma thob de srid du/ /tshad ldan dag pa'i bshes kyis rjes bzung ste/ /spang dang rtogs pa'i sa lam yon tan kun/ /dkar cha'i zla ba ji bzhin 'phel bar shog /mi 'jigs bzhi ldan kun mkhyen gdong lnga'i rtsal/ /lhun grub dam pa'i chos kyi seng ge'i rgyud/ /sgra dbyangs 'gro kun rna bar yongs bsgrags pas/ /yid grubs gnyis 'thung g.yul las rgyal bar 3rdog /ces pa 'di ni dge slong yon tan bkra shis kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal/ /rdo rje slob dpon khyod skur zhi dang khro'i/ /dkyil 'khor (112ba〉kun tshang rtsa gsum ngo bo sa /yid ches dad pas gsol 'debs bdag byin rlobs/ /khri srong sprul pa'i zla gzugs bgrang yas las/ /'gro ngo'i rdzing bur shar ba ngag gi dbang / /blo gsal skal bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sdes/ /deng nas byang chub bar du rjes bzung gsol/ /zur rigs gu ru rta dpal ldan nor bu dang 'phrin las rnam rgyal zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ mgrin ming 'dzin bdag /—151—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)yang srid 'khor ba'i 'phrang la bshes khyod kyis/ /sa mkhan mdzad de mtho ris thar lam la/ /khrid nas ring min kun mkhyen thob byin rlobs/ /rtse gcig gsol 'debs dad mos 'gugs pa'i lung / /thugs rje'i lcags kyus 'dren nus rten 'brel gshis/ /de phyir khas len 'bras smin mchog gsum mthus/ /'grub par nges pa rnyed pas g.yar dam 'cha'/ /rgyal sras slob mar bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang / /lha dang drang srong bden tshig char wo pos/ /phan dang bde ba'i lo tog dar drag pa'i/ /'dod don re ba'i snye ma g.yur za shog /gsol 'debs smon lam gyi tshigs bcad 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes lha ldan gzhis ka shar pa spun rigs kyi bu dang bcas pas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa sirnyi ra stu/ /dus kyi dgra bo khros pa zil gnon lha'i/ /ye shes sems dpa' bcom ldan tshe dpag med/ /thugs rkar rje dbus rdo rje slob dpon mchog /nges pa lnga ldan ngo bor rtag bzhugs gsol/ /gnam lcags drag po 'bebs pa'i mthu stobs zhal/ /ha har bzhad pas sa gsum (113na〉rtser g.yo ba/ /che chog zhi dang khro bo 'dus pa'i rtsal/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso bor zhabs brtan shog /lha sngags ye shes rdo rje rnon po'i mtshon/ /gdengs nas yid srubs klad pa 'gems byed pa/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i mgon du bshes gnyen gar/ /nam yang yol med bsgyur ba'i bka' drin stsol/ /dga' chen khyab bdag khrag 'thung rnal 'byor dang / /legs ldan gsang ba sngags kyi 'dus pa'i gling / /smin grol rgyud bshad gdams par thos bsam sgom/ /yar 'phel bskal pa'i bar du zhabs brtan shog /srid gsum dbang sgyur 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /dregs pa'i sdod pon dpal mgon ma ning nag /lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin tshogs rnams kyis/ /bden pa'i tshig 'di lhun grub 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa 'di'ang gong dkar blo bzang bsod nams kyis dga' ldan gsang sngags gling du 'dzugs rtsis kyi dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /—152

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenardo rje rwa gur rin chen zur brgyad kyi/ /lte bar seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma tshe dbang rigs 'dzin rtsal/ /'chi med grub pa'i ngo bor rtag bzhugs gsol/ /za hor gdung 'tshob zil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng yab yum gyis btags ming / /rdo rje thogs med rtsal khyod gdul bya'i don/ /gangs ljongs seng ge'i khri la rtag brtan bzhugs/ /sgra sgyur be+e ro dri med badz+ra zhabs/ /ngo mtshar skyes rabs 'phreng 'dzin dus babs kyi/ /zab (113ba thag ter sgo 'byed chos rgyal gter bdag gling / /bod 'bangs phan bde'i gnyen du zhabs brtan shog /pad+ma las zhabrungs gar dbang thod 'phreng gis/ /nam yang 'gyur ba med par rjes bzung nas/ /rdo rje'i theg mchog chos gter bdag po sa /mnga' gsol mkhyen brtse nus rtsal rtag brtan shog /bka' babs gtor kha ma lus gegs med du/ /lus can bsod nams zhing du legs thon te/ /de 'bras skor gsum swā la'i ljongs chen por/ /bde skyid dpal gyi rtse dga' rgod par shog /gra nang phun tshogs dge ba'i yul gru 'dir/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa rgyas pa'i srog shing du/ /skyon smin cing grol ba'i sngags yong gling / /chos srid yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar shog /rigs 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /yi dam sgrub pa bka' brgyad nus mthu'i stobs/ /sdodagu bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs kun gyis/ /ji ltar smon pa 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dkon cog rnam gsum lha dang drang srong sogs/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams kyis bkra shis glu/ /rab snyan rgyud mangs sgra las nyer drangs te/ /phun tsho gos me tog sil ma char du phab/ /rtsa gsum dpang por byas pa bden tshig dang / /chos nyid ka nas dag pas 'gyur ba med/ /chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i phyir/ /smon lam btab bas don kun 'grub gyur cig /ces skyon smin grol gling gi dbu mdzad ngag dbang bzod pas 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes go bde bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /(114na sgom 'dren rgya mtsho'i thugs rje bskul ba'i dbyangs/ /mgrin pa'i rgyud las legs —153

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)drangs gsol ba'i don/ /re ba'i 'bras ldan mchog gsum yongs 'du'i ljon/ /phan bde'i grib tu 'gro 'di nyer bsil mdzod/ /thub bstan de 'dzin klog dang spong ba'i sde/ /yid can chos dkar yul du nyi zla yis/ /smag rum mthar byed de srid rab brtan cing / /dar bas kun bzod dga' ma mngal lcir shog /lhag bsam dag pa'i sa gzhi gshin pa la/ /rtse gcig smon pa'i sa bon yongs btab pa/ /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel chu lud drod gsher gyis/ /smin pa'i skal bzang ma' sum nyams myong shog /ces pa 'di'ang bkra shis ljongs dge 'dun spyi so'i zhal 'don du dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /nges pa'i don du gsang yum dbyings phyug lha/ /ngag dbang tshangs pa'i bu mo 'jo sgeg can/ /dregs pa'i gtso mor dpal ldan srid rgyal ma/ /kun kyang sems kyi rnam par phrul pa tsam/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /gsang ba shes rab rtsa brgyud bla ma yi/ /bka' dang dam tshig gnyen po nyer dgongs la/ /tshul 'di'i rgyu sbyor rig 'dzin rtag tu skyongs/ /nyin mtshan dus kun g.yel ba med bsrungs nas/ /mi mthun dgra bgegs nyer 'tshe rab bzhi zhing / /tshe 'byor lung rtogs rgyas pa'i las bsgrub lhar/ /deng nas byang chub bar du mnga' gsol lo/ /zhes pa 'di'ang mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i 'phrin bcol dgos tshul ltar (114ba)za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /rdo rje'i spo mthor sngo ljang rtswa yi steng / /skyil krung gcig bcas mod la bdud bzhi'i mun/ /mthar byed nyi ma'i dngos brgya 'dzin pa'i gnyen/ /ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i snang 'od kun khyab mdzod/ /bkra shes ri mo g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / /chos phung rgya mtsho'i mi zad sgra dbyangs kyis/ /'jig rten gsum rnar ches dngar phan dang bde'i/ /grangs med ro bdar rtag tu spyod byin rlobs/ /de gsung blang byar byas nas bden pa gnyis/ /sgrub grogs nyan rang byang sems skye 'phags zla'i/ /spang rtogs ga pur gzegs ma nyer 'thul bas/ /lus can kun+da'i dge legs 'dab bzhad mdzod/ /dmar ba'i ljags chen ring du brkyangs pa glur/ /—154

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (na)cher bsngags bde ldan zhing khams zhing gi mgon/ /mdzod spu'i 'od gzis mtshun lha'i lkog mar snying / /nyer bskrad 'chi med bdud rtsis 'gro 'di sos/ /ngag la 'chad rtsod rtsom pa dbang phyug blos/ /skal bzang rgya chen kun bzod yongs khyab par/ /'phrin las dbyar mtsho'i rlabs 'phreng srid pa'i mthar/ /rdzogs min de srid yol ba med gyur cig /'jigs pa med pa rnam dpyod spobs pa'i gos/ /dkar cha'i zla bzhin thub pa'i lung rtogs bstan/ /lang tsho dar drag thos bsam sgom pa'i sde/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen brtan gyur cig /rnam 'dren kun yab zur phud lngas mtshan lha/ /gangs ljongs bstan pa'i bdag por dbang sgyur tshe/ /bla dwags mtshan gyi khyad par tsong kha pa'i/ /chos srid mnga' thang bla nas blar (115na/sna phel sgo thog /bkra shis dge mtshan g.yang chags g.yas ru'i char/ /'dus gling dbus na lhun po ltar brjid pa/ /'phags yul ma pham mgon po 'byon min bar/ /lha chos bdun ldan ring lugs dar bar shog /mi dge las bcu drang srong dmod pa'i mthus//brnag dka' zug rngu'i lcags kyi gtun bu yis/ /gtses pa'i 'gro brgyud de rgyu nyon mongs dri/ /'khrud la skal ldan shing rta'i khengs 'phrog shog /'gro ba'i legs byas ri bo mtho ris rten/ /bskyed pa'i chu gter nang du bsgril ba las/ /srid zhi'i bde skyid sa srungs lhod lhod por/ /rgyu ba'i goms pas byang chub sar bgrod shog /rab brtan mos pa'i me'i zhal rdzings ring du/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i mkha' glang 'khrigs pa las/ /byin rlabs 'dzad pa med pa'i char rgyun gyis/ /'dod pa'i snye ma 'bras bus yongs dud shog /ces ring 'tsho'i smon lam dang 'brel ba'i blo ka bcu lhag tsam zhig dgos zhes chos sde chen po bkra shis lhun po nas phyag mdzod phun tshogs rab brtan grwa tshang khag gsum sngags pa grwa tshang dang thob rgyal dga' ldan rab rgyas gling gi slob dpon pa rnams kyis gros thog nas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /yid srubs sde bcas g.yul ngor bsad pa'i khrag /mchu sgros mtshams sprin mdangs su rjes chags pa/ /rnam par rgyal ma rje btsun bcom ldan 'das/ /zil dngar chu rgyun tshangs bug —155

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)nas 'geng mdzod/ /'jam dbyangs kun tu dga' ba'i bshes (115bsko nyen gang / /rdo rje bzhu blugs stan la zhabs rdul 'phreng / /legs bkod sangs rgyas stong gi 'phrin las gzis/ /'dzam gling mun sel de srid brtan par shog /ka ba med pa gnam gyi sgo 'phar nas/ /mes pos sa spyod bdag por dbang bskur ba'i/ /sku tshe mnga' thang chab srid ma lus pa/ /nga las nus kyi rjes su 'brang bar shog /dga' ba brgya pa'i tshems las nyer 'khrungs lha'i/ /'dul zhing gangs ri dpal dang ldan pa yi/ /bye brag 'phan yul sa yi thig le sa /dam chos chad pa med par 'khor bar shog /'dren pa sras slob bden pa'i ga phyiraḥ/ /tshul bzhin brjod pa'i dri bsung rab 'thul ba/ /nyesabargya'i gdung sel sim pa'i tshor ba'i ro/ /yid kyis rtag tu nyams su myong bar shog /ces pa 'di yang thang sag dga' ldan chos 'khor gling spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i mgon po 'dzam gling 'dir/ /brtul zhugs grub pa'i rig sngags 'chang ba'i skur/ /legs bstan dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung / /thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs pa lhur stsol kye/ /che mchog 'dus pa'i zil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal/ /a lha mi shigs ka ba rdo rje'i srog /'gyur med zhabs rdul rgya hor bod 'bangs 'gro'i/ /gtsug tor rtse mor rtag tu 'god par shog /zab gter mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs 'thul ba'i sgo/ /'byed mdzad pad gling smin grol gdams pa'i dpya/ /gangs can skal bzang gdul bya'i snying nor du/ /spyod pa'i dga' ston dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog /(116na thag dgu'i mchog gyur rnam gsum yo ga'i chos/ /tshul bzhin thos bsam sgom pasanyams bstar ba'i/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa rab tu rgyas byed gling / /chos srid zung du 'jug pas 'phel bar shog /bde gshegs kun 'dus bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha/ /dam can sde dgu bstan srung rgya mtsho yis/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod rdzu 'phrul mthus/ /bsams pa'i don kun sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /ces thugs sras sprul sku bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rjes snga 'gyur bstan pa'i —156

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ rton)btsas su theg mchog rab rgyas gling btsugs pa'i tshe smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rnam 'dren shākya seng shes bdud bzhi'i sde/ /byams pa'i dpung gis nyer bcoms bden pa'i mthus/ /'dus pa'i gra 'dir dam sri'i 'tshe ba kun/ /rab zhi thos bsam dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog /thub pas slob lam rang gi dbu dang spyan/ /btang ba bden pa'i tshig gis bsos pa'i mthus/ /deng 'dir dam sri'i gnod pa yongs zhi nas/ /tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor rgyas par shog /yid srubs mtshon cha sangs rgyas la 'phangs pa/ /me tog char du gyur pa'i rten 'brel mthus/ /'byung po'i gnag pa'i sems kyang mnyes gshin par/ /'gyur nus dkon cog mthu yis 'grub byin rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di'ang skyor lung mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi zhal 'don du dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /(116ba〉regs byas stobs kyis rtsibs stong 'khor lo'i shugs/ /kun bzod yangs pa'i gzhi la dbang sgyur nas/ khrims gnyis gser gyi gnya' shing yongs lci bas/ /'bangs rnams bde bar rab skyong zhabs brtan shog /ris med thub pa'i bstan la zhugs so cog /spyi dang khyad par 'jam dpal snying po yi/ /lugs 'dzin ma lus srid zhug gyen 'degs pa'i/ /gzugs can snying po'i mched zla rtag brtan shog /stobs ldan rgyal po'i bsod nams rtsa ba'i khyon/ /sbom por bskyed du bsringasapa'i grib ma la/ /skor gsum ru bzhi sgang drug lus can kun/ /bde ba'i stegs la ngal gsor spyod par shog /ga smi ra pa'i paṇa chen bsod snyoms pa'i/ /so thar sdom rgyun pad+ma'i skud pa ltar/ /tshes phra rdo rje'i srog tu byin brlabs nas/ /sde 'dir dar bar mchog gsum mthus byin rlobs/ /bde gshegasabargyad kyi byin rlabs med po ches/ /gtsang ris mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bdag gi smon lam 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /ces pa 'di'ang chag mig tshogs spyi so'i zhal 'don du dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi —157

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /lhan skyes ḍā ki gtso mos mngon sum du/ /mkha' spyod zhing du 'khrid pa'i skal dman yang / /sgyu ma'i bskyas chen 'degs tshe nyer bsus nas/ /bde chen dag pa'i zhing der thogs med drongs/ /bgrang yas zhing bzhugs yi rnal 'byor ma/ /baṃ yig nang gi yid 'ong mdza' na mo/ /sems nyid gsal stong gsang ba'i mkha' spyod mar/ /(117na jis rnyed bka' drin 'khor med bla ma'i drin/ /deng nasa'aja' lus rdo rje bas mo'i skur/ /mgo gyur gnas lugs rang ngo 'phrod de srid/ /zab chos 'di ston bla ma dam chos dang / /'bral med spyod pa'i smon lam lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di'ang nged rang gi dge sbyor gyi rten du rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sku bas sa mo glang lo dbu mdzad skal ldan gyis bris pa'i tshe smon lam gyis 'tshams sbyar ched du za hor gyi brnyes bkod pa'o/ / 'og min zhing khams zhing gi gtso bo mchog /rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad gangs can mtsho/ /dkyil 'khor bdag por yongs bzhengs sprul sku yis/ /dmigs yul gnas ngan len las drang du gsol/ /blo dang brtson pa bzang po'i bag chags kyis/ /dge la rab tu 'dun pa'i legs byas 'bras/ /mngon mtho'i lam brgyud thar pa'i khang bzang du/ /myur bgrod thugs rje snying la 'jug byin rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang ge ra chos mdzad blo bzang dge 'dun gyi phyi rten bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul chos mdzad blo bzang mkhyen brtses bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /'od mtshan stong 'bar zer 'phreng bde ldan nas/ /'dzam gling smag rum bcil la 'phros pa'i gzis/ /lha chen nyi bu'i me long 'dzin pa'i khur/ /bor ba'i chos dkar snang ba 'gro la stsol/ /'dus tshogs bden pa brjod mthus ngag gi dbang / /dbyangs can dgyes pa'i blo gter skal bzang can/ /nam mkha' rang gi ngo bo gtong min bar/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dpyid du brtan gyur cig /thos bsam (117ba/ri bras dkar smin pa yul gyi ljongs/ /gtan 'dun bde skyid 'grub pa'i dga' tshal —158

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenadu/ khrims ldan blo gsal yongs kyis rab gang ste/ /gzhung brgyar 'chad nyan spobs pa gzengs mthor shog /rgyan drug mchog zung tshangs pa'i ral klung nas/ /nyer babs gaṅgā stor 'chang sa rngog gi /lugasa'adzin kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel gyi bstan/ /dbyar gyi chu gter ji bzhin 'phel bar shog /ye dag rten 'brel mkha' la rgyu 'bras kyi/ /nyi zla bcu gnyis khyim gyi lam bgrod pa/ /dngos po'i gshis phyir smon pa'i dpag bsam gyi/ /ngo mtshar snye ma'i 'bras bzang dud par shog /ces smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni 'bras yul skyed mos tshal gyi mkhan chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa bzhu blugs su/ /khol ba'i mthu stobs rdo rje'i tsha tsha can/ /'dzam gling brtul zhugs grub dbang pad+ma 'byung / /lta stangs tsam gyis yid grubs las rgyal mdzod/ /che mchog zhi khro'i lha tshogs 'dus pa las/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon dus kyi dag grub pa'i rnal 'byor 'chang ba ba 'ad pa rtsal/ /skal ldan gdul bya'i mgon du zhabs brtan shog /dbang gi rgyud smin zab mo'i lam gyis grol/ /'phrin las thogs med lha srin bran du 'khol/ /gos dkar lcang lo'i 'phreng can sngags 'chang gis/ /ljongs 'dir so zur gnubs bstan 'dzin par shog /ces pa 'di yang so ye shes dbang phyug dang / (118na)so shākya dpal sogs sngags 'chang rim par byon pa'i gdung las snye mdo chos rje ngag dbang shākya dpal 'bar gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /su sti sid+dhi/ rdo rje'i gur nang gzhal yas khang gi dbus/ /dpal ldan bla ma dgyes mdzad he ru skar/ /glus bskul gsol ba btab las rab bzhedas sku/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mgon du zhabs brtan shog /ngag gi dbang phyug 'khon rigs kun gsal ngos/ /dga' chen khyab bdag rdul bral ston gyi zla/ /yid can bsod nams kun+da bzhad pa'i gnyen/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan zhing 'dir g.yo med shog /bkra shis g.yas 'khyil chos kyi grags pa'i sgra/ /dpyod ldan gdul bya'i rna bar rab —159

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'jebs pas/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgreng ba'i dpal/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i dpal du rtag bzhugs gso/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang bla chen sa skya pa'i/ /chos srid legs tshogos dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shing / /ma rig las 'khon 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu'i gdung / /bstan dang 'gro ba'i rgyun du 'phel bar shog /rigs byed tshogs bdag 'dod pa'i rgyal po yis/ /phun tshogs dpal 'byor ma lus dbang bsdu zhid / khrag 'thung lcam dral legs ldan gdong bzhi pas/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par shog /ces dpal ldan sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bstan 'gro'i mgon du 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i brtan bzhugs 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi (118ba〉gdung chad pa med pa dang bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo mkhan chen zha lu kun spangs pa tshe dbang lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bkas bskul ba dang du blangs te za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /su ste pra dza khyoḥ phyogs las rnam rgyal rdo rje brag rdzong rtser/ /gzhom zhig bral ba khro bcu'i gur khang dbus/ /rje btsun bla ma 'jigs med dpa' bo che/ /yid srubs sde bcas gnyen por zhabasabartan shog /ngag gi dbang phyug gas kun khyab bdag che/ /bcu drug dga' bzhi'i nya gang bkra shisaglu/ /rab snyan grags pa'i rgyal mtshan sgreng mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan skal ba bzang po rtag brtan shog /tshogs slob smin grol rgyud bshad man ngag lung / /tshad ma bzhi ldan sngags dang sde snod gsum/ /'jam mgon bla ma rim byon rjes 'brangs kyi/ /zhabrul med bzhed srol bstan pa dar bar shog /'od gsal 'chi med dmu thag las babs btsun/ /brtan pa'i 'khor los byin brlabs rigs kyi che/ /'khon brgyud gdung 'tshob yid bzhin rin chen 'phreng / /'chad med bla nas blar yang 'phel bar shog /dkon cog thugs rjes 'jug la g.yel ba med/ /dbang lha rnams kyis khams gsum rang gir sdud/ /dpal mgon lcam dral las kun myur bsgrubs pas/ /brtse chen snying po'i ring lugs —160

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhinargyas par shog /ces dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rin po che 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rdo rje'i khri la (119na tha skal brgyar g.yo med du bzhugs pa'i brtan bzhugs 'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi gdung chad pa med cing bstan pa 'phel ba'i smon lam dang bcas pa'i 'di ni rigs kun khyab bdag zha lu mkhan chen kun spangs pa tshe dbang lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bzhed pa dang du blangs te za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /'og min zhing gi gtso bo gangs can mtsho/ /dkyil 'khor bye ba'i mgon du sprul pa'i gar/ /rnam par snang mdzad ngo mtshar sku brnyan 'phreng / /pad rtsa ltar dkar lhag bsam gyis bzhengs mthus/ /ngag dbang khra hrig thog drangs mkha' mnyam 'gro'i/ /las nyon shes bya'i sgrib pa drung phyung ste/ /tshogs gnyis rdzings kyis sku gsum rin chen gling / /phyin nas skye rgu ma lus 'dren par shog /rab dkar kā shi'i ngos la dbang po'i gzhu/ /tshon brgyar nye ba'i shel gyi rjes 'gro mkhan/ /med byung dam pa'i snang brnyan tshar dngar ba'i/ /byed rte ma'i khengs pa bag la zha/ /dge 'bras phun tshogs dbang po sum yags so gos/ /tshul 'dir 'bad do cog rnams stobs ra tshe/ /yar 'phel yang srid kun tu mngon mtho'i rten/ /rim brgyud nges legs grong du 'jug par shog khres pa 'di yang 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tsho gos dbang pos pha ma'i don du rnam snang gi brgya thang dang kho rang dang spun gyi don du bla brgyud bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge (119ba)slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /thub pa'i gsung ngag chad med mdo rgyud la/ /dbang ba'i blo gros bzang po'i spobs pa can/ /rgya chen rnam dpyod mtsho byung lha mo yis/ /legs stsal bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /seng shes nyer bteg sna tshogs rdo rje yi/ /ri mo rab 'bar 'gyur ba med stan la/ /bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' gsol 'debs na/ /smon pa bzhin 'grub mchog gsum mthus byin rlobs/ /tshe yi —161—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)g.yung drung nya phyis khog pa sa /dpal 'byor mu thi la yis nyer gtams pas/ /'di snang phan dang bde bar longs spyod tshogs/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston rgyas par shog /'khor ba'i yang srid go la'i lam yangs por/ /lha mi'i rten bzang nyi zla'i bgrod pa zung / /nam yang chad med thar pa'i 'od stong gis/ /byang chen snang ba rab tu gsal bar shog /dus gsum bsags dang gsog 'gyur bsod nams kyis/ /sa bon dar babs dge legs a mra'i 'bras/ /mtha' klas 'gro ba kun dang lhan cig tu/ /'dzad med rtag tu spyod pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcasapa 'di ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang pos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /mchog gsum thugs rje nus rlud gis drangs pa'i/ /lam bzang ma la ya yi dri bsung gis/ /'khor ba'i tsha gdung 'jigs las mkha' 'gro skyabs/ /nyer drangs thar pa'i bde la spyod byin rlobs/ /shes sgrib yal 'dab gzings pa'i nags kyi klung / /thabs shes zhugs kyis sbar ba'i thang yangs por/ /kun (120na〉khyen ye shes rta yi gsar 'gros gom/ /don gnyis dkyus thog gcod par byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsa lag 'khor 'bangs rnams kyi gang gi ched/ /bsgrubs pa dge tshogs 'dzam bu'i 'bras bu rnams/ /bsngo smon rgya mtshor lhungs pa gtan mdun gyi/ /gser gyi snye ma yongs su dar drag shog /ces bi ji mkha' 'gro skyabs la dmigs pa'i smon lam zhig dgos zhes rgyal khang rtse'i sprul sku'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /blo bzang grags snyan 'bar ba'i chos srid bstan/ /zung 'brel khrims kyis bla nas blar 'degs pa'i/ /mthu stobs nus mnga' nor 'dzin skyong ba'i rje/ /mchog gsum thugs rjes rdo rje ltar byin rlobs/ /dzā ti'i 'bras bus dud pa'i yul gru nas/ /'jam mnyen dar zab thags su 'thag pa'i bar/ /btsan po'i lung gis 'bangs rigs gcig gyur te/ /rdzogs ldan la 'khru bde skyid dar —162

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ 3)drag shog /nges par shākya'i ring lugs thos bsam sgom/ /tshul bzhin sgrub so cog gi gra rnams kun/ /sdig to'i 'phrul gyis nam yang mi brdzi bar/ /lus can bsod nams zhing du 'phel bar shog /cesapa 'di'ang yar stod thos bsam dar rgyas gling gi slob dpon grags pa rnam rgyal dang gnyer pa blo bzang rab rgyas gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i grwa dmangs rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /lus ngag yid gsum dge la nyer bkol te/ /nges par legs la dbang du phyug pa'i lam/ /(120ba〉skrub blo'i mig yangs bzang po'i spyod pa yis/ /rgya chen chos dkar mtsho ltar 'phel ba'i rten/ /sras bcas rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /rdo rje slob dpon snang brnyan bskrun pa'i dges/ /byed po skye bar bshes gnyen dam pa yis/ /rjes bzung bla med byang chub mngon 'gyur shog /ces pa 'di'ang gsol dpon ge ra ba blo bzang mkhyen brtses 'di ga'i 'drag 'bag cig bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam btab pa'i dges/ shes rab dang ldan dal 'byor rin chen rten/ /gangs can ljongs su nyer thob mgon khyod kyi/ /'khor du skyes nas chos la sprod par shog /ces pa 'di yang dka' bcu shes rab rin chen gyi kha ton du bris/ /rgyal kun thugs rje bzhu blugs rdo rje'i khams/ /gzhes med srog gi zungs su nyer song ste/ /nam mkha' gzugs gzhan gyur min de srid du/ /mgon khyod rdo rje'i khri la zhabs brtan gsol/ /lus ngag yid gsum gcig tu rab 'bad nas/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan blo gsal mgon gcig pu/ /skal bzang gnyen du rgya mtsho dus kyi mes/ /skems min bar du g.yung drung ltar brtan shog /'jigasarung lus med gshed du tshogs gnyis kyi/ /btsun po'i go cha bgos mdzad thub pa'i bstan/ /lung rtogs lang tsho ches cher rgyas pa'i sde/ /'og min zhing gi gtso ltar brtan par shog /dga' ba'i dpal —163

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ster legs ldan chos kyi dpyid/ /rnam gsum 'khor los phan bde'i 'dod pa kun/ /'jo (121na)ba'i 'dus grwa kun gyi yang rtse sa /nyer son srid mtha'i bar du rgyas par shog /tshangs par mtshungs par spyod pa'i sdom brtson can/ /mi phyed rtse gcig gdung ba'i shugs drag pos/ /ji ltar smon pa lhun grub rgyu 'bras kyi/ bslu med rten 'brel ngo mtshar med du byung / /zhes pa 'di yang dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse bla gnyer spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /yangs pa'i sa chen byams pas legs skyong ba/ /dpal ldan mi yi dbang po tshangs pa che'i ngang tshul ji bzhin nyi zlas mun sel ba/ /de srid 'bangs rnams bde bar skyong gyur cig /'jig rten gsum gyi nya phyis khog pa sa /phan bde'i mu tig phung por cher spungs pa/ /bsod nams bsagasa'agro'i rgyan du 'khri shing gi /mdzes pa'i do shal ring por 'phyang bar shog khyad par gangs can lus phra'i sto ba sa /nad mtshon dbul phongs dang bral ring pa'i tshe/ /tshong pa khe spogs thon zhing lo tog sbrums/ /phun tshogs bsam kun 'dod pa 'jo bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /gdong lngas bteg pa'i rin chen bad nyi'i khrir/ /dpal ldan bla ma mi bskyod tshe dpag med/ /nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /mtshan dpe'i snang ba zhing 'dir g.yo med shog /gnyisa'athung gis bteg rin chen pad nyi'i khrir/ /dpal ldan bla ma snang mdzad tshe dpag (121ba〉yed/nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /mtshan dpe'i snang ba zhing 'dir g.yo med shog /rta mchog gis bteg rin chen pad nyi'i khrir/ /nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /mtshan dpe'i snang ba zhing 'dir g.yo med shog /dpal ldan bla ma rin 'byung tshe dpag med/ /nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /mtshan dpe'i snang ba zhing 'dir g.yo med shog /mdongs mtha' —164

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ rton)yis bteg rin chen pad nyi'i khrir/ /dpal ldan bla ma snang mtha' tshe dpag med/ /nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /mtshan dpe'i snang ba zhing 'dir g.yo med shog shang shang gis bteg rin chen pad nyi'i khrir/ /dpal ldan bla ma don grub tshe dpag med/ /nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /mtshan dpa'i snang ba zhing 'dir g.yo med shog /ces pa 'di ni dga' ldan gsung rab gling bla spyi thun mong gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /ngo mtshar dag pa'i zhing khams kun gyi gtso/ /bde ldan mgon po gar gyi dbang phyug gis/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin skyong ba mi yi rjer/ /phun tshogs dge legs dpal gyi 'bar bar mdzod/ /ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyab yol can/ /tshe sbyin dpal ldan yid bzhin 'khor lo mas/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin skyong ba mi yi rjer/ /phun tshogs dge legs dpal gyi 'bar bar mdzod/ /srid pa'i nyes brgya kun 'joms gtsug tor lha/ /bcom ldan rnam par rgyal ma'i lha tsho gos kyis/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin skyong ba mi yi rjer/ /phun tshogs dge legs dpal gyi 'bar bar mdzod/ /ces pa 'di'ang dga' ldan gsung rab gling bla spyi thun mong gis bskul (122na tha'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /che mchog 'dus pa'i lhun grub 'od lnga'i rtsal/ /ka dag dbyings su 'gyur med rdo rje'i lus/ /'khor 'das phyag rgyas zil gnon skur bzhedas gar/ /las can skal ldan 'gro ngor rtag sgyur shog /lo chen be+e ro bsams bzhin zab chos sgo/ /'byed la dus babs dngos byon gter bdag gling / /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtsor brtan rang dbang gter/ /ma lus 'dren pa'i rten 'brel lhun grub shog /sngon goms mthu yis theg mchog smra ba'i ngag /dbang phyug kun bzang rnam par rgyal ba lha'i/ /'phrin las nyin mor byed pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i 'dab brgya bshad par shog /ces pa 'di yang dbon po chos dbyings rang grol gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni —165

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /dkon cog mthu yis bsod nams zhing gyur pa'i/ /ngo mtshar sprul sku'i zla ba yongs tshes pa/ /rab brtan dbang phyug brgyad mnga'i 'phrin las kyi/ /snang ba gsar pa'i dga' ston rgyas par shog /tshe dpag med dang yid bzhin 'khor lo sogs/ /'chi med lha tshogs thugs rje chu bo'i rgyun/ /gtsug tor rtse nas chad med rab babs pas/ /mi 'gyur srog gi ka ba tshugs par shog /yi dam dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs dang / /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i 'phrin las rtsal/ /rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden tshig mthus/ /ji ltar smon pa yid bzhin lhun grub shog /ces kong (122ba)po yul smad grong du khyung rgyal mtshan gyi sras su de mo sprul pa'i sku gsar du zhakhrungs par mtshan dkon cog bsod nams dbang phyug tu gsol ba'i brtan bzhugs zhig dgos zhes de mo dpon po bsod nams nor bus bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /chu byi nged rang gi dad rten du sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi sku li brdzus gra tshar che sa gnyisabazhengs pa'i che ba'i kha byang smon lam srid zhi bde legs lhun grub/nā mi ku mā tra thu ta ma nu so rgyu se mā 'i ki rti 9ya rā dza lha co/ 5 de/mtshan tsam thos pas yid can bde ba la/ /legs par 'god pa yongs grags dpal gyi rgyal/pi ra ṇi khyo ra ta 'i lo pra tho k+ṣa ta mā de sa mā ñtsa ya smo/sngon gyi smon lam mdzad pa'i 'bras bu rnams/ /mngon sum bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la stsol//(123na 'a sne sa pa ཿ bai PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB /rin chen zla dang pad+mas rab brgyan gzi/ /gzi ldan sgra dbyangs phyogs bcur sgrogs pa yis/na ā na pi ṇi khyi ra ta 'i lo pra t+ya k+ṣa ta mā de sa mā byu ya smosngon gyi smon lam mdzad pa'i 'bras bu rnams/ /mngon sum bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la stsol//—166

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhen23brko:li lha1dzika nom lorat+na byupra ta sidha ka hi twa yu tsa//gser sbyangs bzang po'i mdangs ltar dri ma med//rin chen snang ba'i brtul zhugs grub khyod kyis/ā de pi ṇaḥskor ta phi lo pra tu k+ta ha mā de sa māñtsa yasmosngon gyi smon lam mdzad pa'i gos bu rnams//mngon sum bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la stsol//24na ) no sha ka duḥkha sus rā spro rgyu stur to〉nu bha ba gri yas/mya ngan med pas sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las//skye ldan sgrol ba'i mchog gi mthu dpal gyis/ā de piṇi sbyi ra ta phi lo pra tu snya)mā de sa muñtsa yasmosngon gyi smon lam mdzad pa'i 'bras bu rnams//mngon sum bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la stsol//24ba'i snyirla dharma su ra kā ya kaḥki rtesgyu hiḥslar stoṣa gi6zab rgyas chos sgra lus can rnar bsgrags pa'i//phan bde rgya mtsho'i dbyangs snyan glur 'bab pas/ā de piṇi sbyi ra ta phi lo pra kyi k+ṣuḥmā de sa māñtsa ya smo/sngon gyi sgron lam mdzad pa'i sa bu rnams//mngon sum bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la stsol//25na sgo dharma swā ga rlabar su mā tānā hi bi lā li tu a bhi dzha rādzñā//dam chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blo gros kyi//rnam par rol pa mngon mkhyen rgyal po yis/ ā de piṇiḥskor phi lo pra tu/ha mā de sa māñtsa ya smo/sngon gyi snon lam mdzad pa'i sa bu rnams//mgo sum bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la stsal//25bsgo ha d+ma hā ka skag med yo ṣa sgyu stur ba ḍūrla ge rā lha rādzñā/ches cher snyigs ma'i 'gro rabartse snyan gyi bla//be+eḍūrla yi 'od ldan rgyal po yis/ā dpiṇi ci ra ta phi lo pra tu k+ṣa)mā de sa māñtsa ya smo/sngon gyi sgron lam mdzad pa'i 'bras bu rnams//mngon sum bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la stsal//26na8)bta sgo gtata:/treḥste ku ko rdzobar no su zhwa khyu//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24) dpal gyi mgur nas bde bar tha shegs pa'i mdo/ /legs gsungs shākya'i skyes mchogo slu med bka'/ya : ñtsa sa sta sna tā rā dzñā ma du ra tha ñtsa shā dwa spyi ti na tra nā dzu/ /ji bzhin thub chen mched bdun bzhed pa'i don/ /lnga brgya'i 'gro rnams mngon sum nyams myong shog /sog tsan+dan dgon phyogs su yon bdag rnams kyi srog blu tshe thar mang po byed yong 'dug pa de'i dus su 'don rgyu gnang ba'i smon lam tshigs bcad sogs/ /(126ba〉kyin la srog gces de phyir ra lugs phyugs/ /'chi bdag lag nas blus te ring po sa'atsho thabs mi 'jigs skyabs kyi sbyin pa'i sgo/ khyu sbyor yon gyi bdag pos che ba'i dge /rab dkar legs byas ka pu ra yi rdul/ /'bum phrag lhag bsam zla ba las 'dzags pas/ /mkha' mnyam skye rgu'i tsha gdung ma lus pa/ /yongs bcil phan bde'i snang bas kun khyab shog khyad par dngos kyi byed po yang srid kun/ /mi yi lus thob tshe yang ring du 'tsho/ /lo tog sman rnams mthu ldan rnam smin dang / khyu mthun bdag po'i 'bras bus ches dkar shog /dkon cog gsum gyi thugs rje thogs pa med/ /chos nyid gdod nas dag pa 'gyur ba bral/ /chos can rgyu 'bras nam yang slu med phyir/ /ji ltar smon pa lhun gyis grub par shog /gnas skabs su yang yul phyogs 'di dag tu/ /mi nad phyugs nad 'thab rtsod zhabrug slong sogs/ /dus kyi chad pa ma lus kun zhi zhing / /bkra shis dga' ston dpal gyis khyab par shog /ces sog tsan+dan dgon phyogs su yon bdag rnams kyi srog blu tshe thar mang po byed yong 'dug pa de'i dus su 'don rgyu'i smon lam zhig dgos zhes bla ma blo bzang chos dpal gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan steng du/ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo mngon sum /68

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi rigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanadu/ /bzhugs nas 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen zhabs/ /'chi med rdo rje'i sku ru 'grub byin rlobs/ /thub pa'i gsung rab de don dgongs 'grel ba'i/ /rgya bod (127na〉khas pa'i bstan bcos dang bcas pa/ /'dzad med par du brkos nas mchode sbyin sgo/ /'byed la thugs rje'i spyan gyis nye bar gzigs/ /'gro ba'i dbang por rnam 'phrul mtha' klas kyang / /ngo bo gcig las mi g.yo rgyal ba'i yum/ /seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i zlos gar gyis/ /'jigs chen brgyad sogs 'tshe ba kun las skyobs/ /bskal 'tsho'i tshe dang rmugs 'dzin bang mdzod nor/ /lha dbang bsod nams gtsug na zla ba'i stobs/ /mdor na srid gzhi'i legs tshogs yod do cog /lhan cig longs su spyod pa'i skal thob mdzod/ /yig rkos las rnams gegs med tshegs chud 'grub/ /'bras bu gnas skabs lha mi'i go 'phang thob/ /ring min byang chub chen po'i rgyal srid la/ /dbang sgyur 'gro rnams phan bde'i sar sbyor shog /ces pa 'di yang dga' ldan phun tshogs gling gi par rkos pa rnams kyi kha ton du dgos zhes par zhus rab 'byams pa dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /gang gi ched du byas dang byed 'gyur ba'i/ /dge bas blo bzang bstan pa rgya mtsho'i ming / /'dzin pa gnas ngan 'ching grol mngon mtho'i rten/ /myur du thob pa'i skal ba ldan par shog /ces pa 'di ni mtsho sna sku skye dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i tshe grwa rigs rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /(127ba)nā tha ā : tsho 〉 rti sa khri na yoḥ /bde ldan zhing gi mgon po'i ngo mtshar sku/ /ri mor bris pa'i bsod nams gang thob des/re kha le khri ni pu stu ya ma stu sta thu/ /byed po nying mtshams sbyar tshe 'od dpag med/ /mngon sum lta zhing dam pa'i chos myong shog—/69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)kā ru kā la : ko ā yu no me ya yoḥ /bde ba can zhing bkod pa rgyal ba'i gsung / /gser sbyangs zhun mas bris 'dis sbyin pa'i bdagalha to : gi sā ṣ+ṭha rma ma swā da 5 tu/ /phyi ma bar do med par pad+ma'i sbubs/ /rdzus skyes theg mchog chos la spyod par shog /ces pa 'di ni dge slong phun tshogs rgya mtshos 'od dpag med kyi sku brnyan dang bde ba can gyi zhing bkod bzhengs pa'i tshe smon lam gyi tshigs bcad dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /blo chen bskal bzang rnam 'dren tsong kha pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin bde ldan zhing (128na/bams myul bzhed pa/ /phyogs 'dir 'gro don dus la babs gyur na/ /sprul sku'i gar bsgyur de smon lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di yang rgyal khang rtse ba'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'/ /rnam par snang mdzad thugs rje'i chu rgyun gyis/ /thog med bsags pa'i sdig lhung dri ma kun/ /rab bkrus blo bzang dngos grub mngon mtho'i rten/ /legs thob ring min byang chen sar bgrod shog /ces stag ru ba blo bzang dngos grub kyi phyi rten thang spu'i rgyab yig tu dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa mnga' ba'i bde bar gshegs/ /bden pa gnyis dang ldan pa dam pa'ichos/ /byang 'phags dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /smon dang 'jug pa'i byang chub sems mchog bskyed/ /gsang ba kun 'dus mi bskyod tshe dpag med/ /rang bzhin gnas nas gzugs kyi skur shar ba'i/ /spyan sngar bsod nams tshogs gsog rig 'dzin gyi/ /spyi dang bye brag sdom la brtson par bgyi/ /gdod nas dag pa'i rtsibs steng khro bo bcus/ /bskor dbus zhe sdang rdo rje'i lta stangs mthus/ /gnod mdzes drag shul spyod pas bgegs kyi dpung / /mthar byas srung ba'i gur khang lhun —170

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenagrub bzhugs/ /'khor 'das chos kun stong mtshan smon med dang / /ye shes tshon ris gzhal yas gdan bcas steng / /lhag mos 'od gsal chos sku'i lam khyer las/ /dang po'i (128bsgo gon po longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhugs/ /mkha' khyab 'gro byin brlab sprul mi bskyod tshogs/ /dbyer med rdor sems sprul sku'i phung po khams/ /skye mched gshegs sems khro bor yongs rdzogs pa/ /bdag nyid rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /gsang gsum bde ba chen por zhu ba'i dpyid/ /gnas gsum rtsa 'khor la thim byin brlabs pas/ /sgo gsum mi shigs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i mgon khyod brtan par bzhugs/ /mkha' dang mkha' sbyor ji bzhin snyoms bzhugs pas/ /zag med bde chen drangs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /brten pa'i lha rnams tshim bas srog zungs su/ /gyur nas rang don phun tshogs grub khyod bzhugs/ /rjes chags lha tshogs lhag bsam gyis bzhu'i khams/ /btsun mo'i mkha' nang gzhan don dkyil 'khor pa/ /'phro 'du'i rgyal po mchog gis 'gro ba'i rgyud/ /sbyangs nas nges legs sal 'god de bzhugs/ /brtan pa'i nga rgyal phra rags gsal snang tshogs/ /mgon khyod yid ngor zhe sdang rdo rje'i gar/ /bsgyur ba'i gom stabs gcig gis bdud bzhi'i dpung / /zil mnan gdul bya'i dpal du 'tsho gzhes bzhugs/ /lha sngags ye shes 'jug pa gcig pa'i gdangs/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i zhi rgyas dbang dang drag /grub pa che brgyad 'phrin las rgyal mchog gi /'gro 'dren dam bca' yol ba med de bzhugs/ /gzhan rkyen zhi bde'i dbyings 'jug nyer bsdog par/ khrims ldan 'dus pa'i tshad med lha mo bzhis/ /bskul 'bras bskal brgyar mngon sum spyod yul du/ /zhal (129na tshe6la rdo ba'i ri mo ji bzhin bzhugs/ /bgrang yas lus sprul sgo gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba de nyid mchod sprin 'bul/ /sdig lhung nyes pa ci mchis snying nas bshags/ /tshogs gnyis phung po bsags so cog la rangs/ /rdo rje theg pa'i chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /bskal mtha'i bar du mya ngan mi 'dar gsol/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags dang gsog 'gyur dge /'gro kun zung 'jug sku bzhi thob phyir bsngo/ /dhū ti'i mas snar —17/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dkar dmar thig ler sems/ /bzung bas dbab ldog dga' bzhi nyer drangs pas/ /rigs brgya la sogs lus dben sku rdo rje'i/ /mi g.yo ting 'dzin brtan por rtag tu bzhugs/ /sngags bzlas rdzas kyi sog stsol rnam gsum gyis/ /las rlung mi shigs thig ler rab bsdus pas/ /rtsa mdud grol dbus 'od gsal ngag dben pa/ /gsung gi rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid du bzhugs/ /snying ga'i a dang rjes gzhi bum can la/ /gnad du bsnun pas stong pa gsum gyi sems/ /rnam par dben pa'i dpe yi 'od gsal ba/ /thugs kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin g.yo med bzhugs/ /'od zer lnga ldan rlung sems ro gcig las/ /mtshan dpe'i rgyan spras ma dag sgyu 'phrul gar/ /bcu gnyis dpes mtsho ni bgrang yas gdul bya la/ /ngo mtshar sprul pa'i bkod pa brtan par bzhugs/ /stong nyid e dbyings waṃ yig 'ja' tshon lus//zhugs te dbyer med sbyangs pas lhan skyes kyi/ /don dam 'od gsal gnas lugs ma can sum du/ /rtogs pas gzhes zhig bral ba'i sku (129ba)ru bzhugs/ /bzhen pa'i rlung las dag pa sgyu lus su//langs mthar rnam grol don gyi 'od gsal dang / /mtshan dpe'i sku gnyis dngos po gcig pa yi//slob pa'i zung 'jug mngon du mdzad khyod bzhugs/ /phyi nang rkyen gyi shes sgrib drung phyungs te/ /mi slob zung 'jug kha sbyor yan lag bdun/ /lhun grub dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho spro bsdu'i ched/ /'khor ba stongs min chos 'khor bskor phyir bzhugs/ /ma dag gdul byar longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /snang bar ma gyur ngag dbang blo yi gter/ /mkhas btsun bzang pos rgya mtsho'i gos can gzhin/ /'khod pa'i skye rgu'i gnyen khyod zhabs brtan shog /srid zhi'i legs tshogis kun gyi srog gcig pur/ /rab song rgyal ba'i yab cig tsong kha pa'i/ /lung rtogs bstan pa rgya hor bod yul gyis/ /mtshon pa'i 'jig rten khams su rgyas par shog /gangs can rig 'dzin mgrin sngon ral pa'i rtser/ /'dus pa'i dge 'dun dkon cog zla tshes pa/ /dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang sa gsum gyi/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing du 'phel bar shog /'jam dpal rdo rje khros pa ma he'i zhal/ /bla mgon dbyer med myur mdzad phyag drug pa/ /las kyi gshin rje lha chen nyi ma'i sras/ /dam can srung mas 'dod pa'i don kun sgrubs/ / 172

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenamakha' la gza' skar bzang ba 'phrod kyi dge /'dzin mar ba po shis g.yang du chags pa'i dus/ /mchog gsum thugs rje bskul ba'i bden pa'i tshig /bslu med rten 'brel mthu las 'grub byin rlobs/ /zhes dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rim pa gnyis kyi lam la gsol 'debs dang ring 'tsho'i brjod (130na)don sbyar ba zhig dgos zhes kha ba'i ljongs 'dir rig sngags 'chang ba'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang gi slob dpon ngag dbang blo gros rgya mtshos thog drangs 'dus tshogs rnams kyis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /bdud bzhi'i dpung gis mi g.yo gtum po cher/ khrag 'thung phyag drug myur mdzad mgon po sogs/ /sna tshogs 'dod lhas yongs bskor bzhengs pa'i 'bras/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub par byin gyis slobs/ /zhes sde pa gdong nas blo bzang bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gyis rje btsun mi g.yo mgon po'i bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig tu za hor gyi bzhes bris/ /'khor 'das yongs kyi phyag rgya glang po'i mgor/ /'jam mgon gdong lnga'i dbang po'i mthu stobs sder/ /bsnun pas snang srid zil gnon tshe bdag gis/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /rab dkar kwa shi ka yi mtsho nang du/ /rgya bod mkhas grub du ma'i rgyu skar gzugs/ shar ba'i mod la skye rga na 'chi'i mun/ /rab sangs gtan bde'i nyi 'od lde bar shog /brgya phrag rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sku/ /bzheng pa'i rgyu sbyar te se'i yab gcig gi /gtsug tor las babs dge tshogs gaṅgā'i chab/ /rang rgyud sgrib bkru'i zhabs bsil sbreng bar shog /ces yar stod skyam pa sngags btsun ngag dbang chos 'dzin gyis rje dge 'dun grub kyi 'byungs rab gra tshar/ 'jam dbyangs kyi brgya thang / 'jam dpal tshe (130ba thad ga gi sku thang rnams bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /khyod bsgrubs zhi khro kun bsnyen chig thub sman/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng yab yum rdo rje 'chang / /skyabs mchog gsang 'dus bla ma'i brgya phrag sku/ /bzhengs pas bsams don lhun grub rtse dgod shog /—173

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ces chos dbang rin po che'i thugs sras mtshan ldan nyi ma'i gdung 'dzin brag sna chos rje blo bzang ngag dbang gis bla ma gsang 'dus kyi brgya thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brje tha sdo brib// /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen dang brtse/ sdu kyis mthu'i bdag nyid rigs gsum mgon/ /dbyer med rje btsun btsong kha pas/ /byin rlabs dngos grub char chen stsol/ /mos pa'i dbang gis gor ma'i ngos//shā rī ram bzhin 'dren pa sa /nges rnyed 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i dges/ /'di phyi'i gtan mdun 'grub par shog /ces hor bar ta chos mdzad kyis rgyal ba myong kha pa'i sku dang 'di da'i gzugs brtan bris pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni phun dbang ngo / /bskal bzang 'dren pa bzhi pa'i snang brnyan la/ /rgyal dang de sras du mas yongs bskor ba/ /bzhengs 'bras 'khor los mtshan pa'i phyag gi mthil/ /spyi bor bzhag nas bdag byin brlab tu gsol/ /gangs can blo gsal yongs kyi bsnyems pa'i rkang / /mkhas btsun bzang po'i rdo rje gdengs tsam gyis/ /mthar byed thub bstan 'chi med yongs kyi bdag /grags pa'i mu khyud khyod (131na)kyis bdag rjes zungs/ /zhes gong dkar mdo pa chos mdzad ngag dbang lhun grub kyis rgyal ba bu ram shing pa dang kun mkhyen btsong kha pa chen po'i sku thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /'phrog byed kyis bteg rin cen phras brgyan khri/ /'dab stong nyi zla zung 'jug gdan steng du/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i ngo bor rigs kun gyi/ /dbang phyug rje btsun bla ma brtan gyur cig /dag pa'i mtshams sbyor smon lam chu gter glong / /sngon goms legs byas dzaskru'i ljon pa'i 'bras/ /ro gcig phan bde'i gser gyi snye ma la/ /spyod pa'i skal pa bzang por 'gyur bar shog /ces pa 'di yang yar 'brog dpal de ba bsod nams rgyal pos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /—/74

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenanub phyogs bde ldan zhing gi 'dren pa mchog /tshe dang 'od snang dpag med pad+ma'i ljags/ /ldem ldem brkyangs rtser bstod bsngags bung ba'i dbyangs/ /rab blang rje btsun rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs/ /gang gi gzungs sngags bklags dang dran pas kyang / /gtan bde'i bdud rtse'i mchog sbyin stsal ba'i mod/ /me long ngos su las kyi dkar nag gzugs/ /ma shar chi bdag skyengs pas sa 'og bros/ /de phyir dang ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /phan bde'i rtsal ga rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas/ /rjes 'dzin dam pa'i mgon mchog zhabs pad brtan/ /'gro kun bde skyid nor la spyod par shog /(131ba jig 'a ba'i dpal ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i sder/ /tshul khrims dag pa'i zhing sa gshin pa la/ /chos spyod rnam bcu'i myu gu rgyas pa' rtser/ /nges par legs pa'i snye ma smin par shog /dam pa chos bzhin bsrung bar zhal 'tshes dang / /lha dang drang srong rig pa 'dzin pa sogs/ /bden tshig grub pa rnams kyi nus mthu yis/ /ji ltar smon pa lhun gyis grub par shog /ces brtan bzhugs smon lam gyi rim pa 'di ni rdo dga' ldan rnam rgyal du 'dzugs rtsis kyi bstan pa dar rgyas kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa sum cu rtsa lnga'i sku/ /rab bzhengs bsod nams sa bon yongs smin pas/ /dmigs yul gyur pa'i lus can mngon mtho dang / /nges legs snye ma g.yul du za bar shog /lnga par song rnams sdug kun las thar phyin/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtsug na mkhas grub dbang / /ngo mtshar sprul pa'i snang brnyan tshes kyi grangs/ /bskrun pa'i 'bras bu yol med smin par shog shes rab pha rol phyin yum 'du byas pa'i/ /dge bas tsha dus 'das rnams sdug bsngal tshogs/ /don dam spros bral dbyings su yongs dag nas/ /kun rdzob srid zhi'i sim pa myong bar shog /rdo rje btsun mos rjes su gnang ba'i mthus/ /paṇa chen 'jigs med kyis bkral rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /chu tshon dkyil 'khor bris las ched gtad rnams/ /ring min bcu gsum sa chen brnyes par shog /ces sprul sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyis rang gi mched po rnams kyi don du bris 'bur gyi rten bzhengs pa'i dge —175

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenab bsngo ba'i tshigs bcad dgos tshul byung ba bzhin za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni phun tshogs dbang po'o/ / bu ram shing pa'i gsung rab kun gyi bcud/ /'khor lo bar pa'i snying po sho lo ka /khri phrag gnyis dang tshig stong brgyad brgya pa/ /ngo mtshar glegs bam bzhengs pa'i legs byas mthus/ /blo bzang dngos grub thog med tshe rabs nas/ /da lta'i bar bsags sdig lhung kun byang ste/ /ngan song gsum gyi du khas mi brdzi bar/ /mngon mtho'i rten bzang brgyud mar 'thob par shog /lha dang mi yi them skas la brten par/ /dge ba'i gom stabs lhod por nyer 'dzegs te/ /thar pa mya ngan 'das pa'i khang bzang du/ /bgrod nas gtan bde'i dga' ston la spyod shog /rang nyid zhi ba don gnyer tsam min pa'i/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam sems can don gyi ched/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mchog /ring por mi thogs myur bar mngon 'gyur shog /'di dang tshe rabs du mar nye 'brel kun/ /byang chen brnyes pa'i thog ma'i 'dus pa sa /gyur nas dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi yis/ /tshim par byas te srid mtsho las sgrol shog /ces stag ru ba blo bzang dngos grub kyi phyi rten du de bzhin gshegasapa'i gsung rab nyi khri dang brgyad stong pa bzhengs pa'i smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /khyad mtshan tsan+dan dri bsung 'thul ba'i mod/ /'chi bdag tsha ba'i gdung ba rab bcil ba'i/ /tshe mtha' yas dang bcom ldan rnam rgyal ma/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo'i spyan gyis btsa' bar mdzod/ /thub pa'i bstan la rjes zhugs klog pa mkhan/ /zhwa ser ring lugs dar zhing rgyas mdzad pa/ /dus kyi pho nya'i mche ba las thar te/ /rdo rje lta bur g.yo med zhabs brtan shog /dkon cog rin cen rnam gsum mthu stobs kyis/ /'gro ba'i bla ma mkhan chen dam pa gang / /bskal pa rgya mtshor 'tsho zhing rab gzhes par/ /smon lam btab pa'i re 'bras lhun grub shog /ces ra sgreng mkhan zur pa bstan pa dar rgyas kyi brtan bzhugs kyi bden pa brjod pa 'di ni grwa rigs rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor —176

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang nam mkha'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi thugs rje rnams/ /snyigs dus 'gro ngor bshes gnyen tshul 'dzin pa/ /rje btsun bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ stun rlabs bdag gi snying la 'jug par mdzod/ /bzod dka' ngan song sdug bsngal gnas nas drongs/ /mngon mtho lha mi'i rten bzang dag la sbyor/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang mjal zhing dam pa'i chos/ /rtse gcig nyams su len par byin gyis rlobs/ /skye srid rim bzhin thar pa'i lam la zhugs/ /mkha' nyams 'gro la ma bzod snying rje'i mthus/ khyu 'bras theg pa'i gom stabs la brten nas/ /ring min bla med byang chub thob par shogaces pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam 'di ni cha gar thi yan chi'i tshab dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /'jam dpal (133na)rdo rje'i ngag la dbang 'byor blo/ /skal bzang gdul bya rgya mtsho'i mgon gyur pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs sen zla tshes bar/ /mos pa'i gtsug tor rgyas 'dud gsol bar 'debs/ /skye bar zhwa ser cod pan 'dzin pa yi/ /bstan la rjes zhugs tshul khrims rnam par dag /mdo dang sngags kyi chos tshul ma lus pa/ /ston pa'i bshes gnyen dam pas rjes 'dzin shog /dbu ma'i lta dang zab lam rim pa lnga/ /zung du 'brel ba'i rnal 'byor la brten nas/ kha sbyor bdun ldan go 'phang mngon gyur te/ /'gro kun 'dren pa'i ded dpon byed par shog /ces pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam dang 'brel ba 'di ni dge slong shes rab rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /bde ldan zhing gi mgon po tshe dpag med/ /rmad byung thugs rje lus phra 'gram chang gis/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i sku tshe ba kū la/ /rab rgyas srid mtha'i bar du brtan par shog /gang des legs bsngags gtsug tor rnam par rgyal/ /med byung thugs rje lus phra'i 'gram chang gis/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i sku tshe ba kū la/ /rab rgyas srid mtha'i bar du brtan par shog /sangs rgyas kun gyi yid —177

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ smyon)bzhin 'khor lo ma/ /med byung thugs rje lus phra'i 'gram chang gis/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i sku tshe ba kū la/ /rab rgyas srid mtha'i bar du brtan par shog /rje btsun bcom ldan seng ldeng nags sgrol mas/ /bdag cag dpon slob cho ge srid 'phel ba dang / /ji ltar smon pa bzhin la bar gcod pa'i/ /bgegasarigs kun zhi bsams don 'grub par 3|ga /legs ldan nag po lha chen phyag drug pas/ /bdag cag dpon slob chos srid 'phel ba dang / /ji ltar smon pa bzhin la bar gcod pa'i/ /bgegs rigs kun zhi bsams don 'grub par shog /las kyi gshin (133ba)rje chos kyi rgyal po yis/ /bdag cag dpon slob chos srid 'phel pa dang / /ji ltar smon pa bzhin la bar gcod pa'i/ /bgegs rigs kun zhi bsams don 'grub par shog /dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug mas/ /bdag cag dpon slob chos srid 'phel ba dang / /ji ltar smon pa bzhin la bar gcod pa'i/ /bgegs rigs kun zhi bsams don 'grub par shog /ces ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni myug legs bshad chos gling gi slob dpon phun tshogs chos 'phel/ gnyer pa dka' bcu blo bzang tshe ring / blo bzang rnam rgyal/ 'dus tshogs spyi dang bcas pas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /dkon cog rin cen rnam gsum thugs rje yis/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khyon la dbang sgyur ba/ /mi yi bdag po 'gyur med rab brtan cing / /mnga' 'bangs ma lus bde bar longs spyod shog /mthu stobs rtsal ldan dam can srung ma yis/ /rmad byung thugs rje lus phra'i 'gram chang gis/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i sku tshe ba kū la/ /rab rgyas srid mtha'i bar du brtan par shog /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis bden brjod mthus/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khyon la dbang sgyur pa/ /mi yi bdag po 'gyur med rab brtan cing / /mnga' 'bangs ma lus bde bar longs spyod shog /sa chen skyong ba'i brtan bzhugs 'di ni slob dpon gnyer ba gnyis dang spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /—/78

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)oṃ su sti/ dkon cog rin cen gsum gyi thugs rje yis/ /u chu mu chu che chen ring wang gang / /skye bar 'bral med rjes su 'dzin pa yi/ /smon pa (134na)ji bzhin lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lcang gseb pa 'jam dpal lo/ /sgo gsum bag yod bsdams pa'i zhing sa sa /tshul khrims snye ma g.yur za'i maṇ+ḍal 'di/ /yang dag bshes gnyen dam par 'bul lags na/ /thub bstan gnas pa de srid brtan par shog /bying rgod g.yeng bral rta ljang gis drangs pa'i/ /rtse gcig ting 'dzin zla shel maṇ+ḍal 'di/ /yang dag bshes gnyen dam par 'bul lags na/ /thub bstan gnas pa de srid brtan par shog /chos nyid 'gyur med chos can rgyu 'bras kyi/ /'byung tshul g.yo med rten 'brel maṇ+ḍal 'di/ /yang dag bshes gnyen dam par 'bul lags na/ /thub bstan gnas pa de srid brtan par shog /rgyal rnams spang rtogs mnyam yang snyigs sa dus 'dar/ /thugs rje lhag par che ba'i bde gshegs brgyad/ /bden pa'i tshig gi dpang por gsol 'debs na/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /lnga stong bzhi brgya nga gsum mtshan snyan gyis/ /'gro ba'i dbugs 'byin mthas klas bde gshegs kyi/ /bden pa'i tshig gi dpang por gsol 'debs na/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /bskal bzang 'di yi sgron me thams cad mkhyen/ /byon dang 'byung 'gyur stong phrag thub pa che/ /bden pa'i tshig gi dpang por gsol 'debs na/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /(134ba)rgyal bstan de srid mya ngan mi 'da' bar/ /'gro ba'i mgon mdzad gnas brtan bcu drug go /bden pa'i tshig gi dpang por gsol 'debs na/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /sprul pa'i dge bsnyen chos 'phel hā shang dang / /stobs ldan rgyal po chen po sdo bzhi'i tshogs/ /bden pa'i tshig gi grogs su gsol 'debs na/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gtsang ris dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i srung ma mthu rtsal can/ /bden pa'i tshig gi dpang por gsol 'debs na/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'jig rten —/79

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenakhams su nad mug 'thab rtsod pa'i/ /dus kyi chad pa nam yang mi 'byung zhing / /ring por 'tsho ba'i tshe dang longs spyod kyi/ /phun tshogs dga' ston chen pos khyab par shog /dge 'dun sde rnams khrims gtsang chos spyod 'phel/ /mi bdag tshogs kun brtan cing mnga' thang rgyas/ /lha srin 'byung po rtsub sems rab zhi nas/ khams gsum ma lus bde ba'i bkra shis shog /ces ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni ma byon sangs rgyas lnga pa kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bsod snyoms pa shākya shi'i ring lugs 'dzin pa mtshan sgrog mkhan chen ngag dbang 'phrin las kyi gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson 'jam dpal grags pa'o/ /chos kun zad mthar 'byol ba rdo rje'i sku/ /gzhom med 'ja' lus mtshan dpe'i gar mkhan ma/ /'jam mnyen 'dab brgya'i sbubs nas thon pa'i mod/ grub pa'i tshe dbang rigs 'dzin bdag la stsol/ /pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur yid 'ong mdzes pa'i sku/ /(135na〉ldobargyad gnyon por rdo rje srin po'i gzugs/ /ha har ba 'ad pa drag po'i rtsal ldan pa'i/ /zhi khro kun 'dus khyod kyis bdag byin rlobs/ /'chi bdag bdud rje'i me dpung cher 'bar ba/ /thugs rje'i char gyis skad cig gzhil mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan rnam par rgyal ma'i mtshan snyan gyis/ /lus can rnams kyi brnag dka'i sdug bsngal tshogs/ /srid rtsa dug lnga so sor 'joms byed pa'i/ /rang rang gnyen po'i rtsi sman rigs lnga yi/ /rnam sprul bde bar gshegs pa sum cu lngas/ /rgyud lnga'i sems can nges legs lam du drongs/ /sbyangs gzhi dag pa'i 'bras bu rdo rje sems/ khyod skur gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor kun/ /yongs shar gsol ba btab pas mchog thun gyi/ /dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba'i bka' drin stsol/ /ces ri rgya ba dbang rgyal rdo rjes grwa tshang du 'bul rtsis kyi zhal thang grwa tshar bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /—180

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gnas brtan bcu drug las brtsams pa'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad sogs bzhugs/rang bzhin gnas nas thub dbang shākya'i rgyal/ /theg pa gsum gyi dge 'dun 'khor dang bcas//'dir spyon bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /sde 'dir 'khor 'das gdung zhi dar rgyas shing / /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /gangs can ri nas gnas brtan yan lag 'byung / /chig stong gsum brgya'i dgra bcom 'khor (135ba)dang bcas/ /'dir spyon bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /sde 'dir khrims dag nyon mongs nyer zhi zhing / /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde//g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyisahrūb byin rlobs/ /drang srong ri yi ngos nas ma pham pa/ /brgya phrag gcig gi dgra bcom 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir spyon bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /sde 'dir spangs rtogs yon tan 'thob 'gyur zhing / /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /lo ma bdun pa'i phug nas nags na gnas/ /tshig stong bzhi brgya'i dgra bcom 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir spyon bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /sde 'dir gnod bral log rtog mun sel zhing / /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /'dzam bu'i zangs kyi gling nas dus ldan ni/ /brgya (136na)phrag gcig gi dgra bcom 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir spyon bstan dang —181—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhana'agro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /sde 'dir spangs rtog yon tan thob 'gyur zhing / /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /siṅgā'i gling nas rdo rje ma yi bu//stong phrag gcig gi dgra bcom 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir spyon bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /sde 'dir zhi 'dun don rnams legs 'grub cing / /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /chu bo ya mu'i gling nas bzang po ni/ /chig stong nyis brgya'i dgra bcom 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir spyon bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /sde 'dir chos mkhas ting 'dzin 'bras smin cing / /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ kha che'i yul nas gnas brtan gser gyi beg /brgya phrag lnga yi dgra bcom 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir spyon bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /sde 'dir gzungasaspobs yon tan 'thob byed cing / /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /ba lang spyod nas bha ra dh+wa dza gser/ /brgya phrag bdun gyi dgra bcom 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir spyon bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /sde 'dir 'byor rgyas gnas lugs mngon gyur cing / /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyisa'agrub byin rlobs/ /bri ya du yi gling nas sgra gcan 'dzin/ /tshig stong chig brgya'i dgra bcom 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir spyon bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /sde 'dir nyes 'joms chos kun don rtogs shing / /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal skal bzang rgya —182

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /bya rgod phung po'i ri nas lam phran bstan/ /stong dang drug brgya'i dgra bcom 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir spyon bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /sde 'dir nyon mongs sdug bsngal me zhi zhing / /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde//g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /lus 'phags gling nas dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len/ /stong phrag gcig gi dgra bcom 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir spyon bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /sde 'dir bzod dka'i sdug bsngal dang bral zhing / /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /sum cu rtsa gsum yul nas lam bstan ni/ /brgya phrag dgu yi dgra bcom 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir spyon bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /sdo 'dir spobs mtho blo gros rab 'phel zhing / /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung (136ba〉grang lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /ri rgyal ngos nas gnas brtan klu yi sde/ /chig stong nyis brgya'i dgra bcom 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir spyon bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /sdo 'dir 'dod yon bsam 'phel nad rnams zhi/ /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /ri rgyal bi hu la nas sped byed ni/ /chig stong bzhi brgya'i dgra bcom 'khor dang bcas/ / 'dir spyon bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /sdo 'dir lnga rig nyon mongs dag 'gyur zhing / /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /gangs can ri nas gnas brtan mi phyed pa/ /stong —183

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenaphrag gcig gi dgra bcom 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir spyon bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /sde 'dir sdig zhi 'dod don kun 'grub cing / /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /gnas brtan rnams kyi nye bar gnas pa sa /dge bsnyen chos 'phel rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan pa/ /'dir spyon bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /sde 'dir gdul bya ma lus yongs smin cing / /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /phyogs bzhi'i gnas nas rgyal chen sdebazhi po/ /rtsal stobs ldan pa'i 'khor tsho gos rgya mtshor bcas/ /'dir spyon bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /sde 'dir bsrung skyob mthun rkyen sgrub mdzad cing / /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyisa'agrub byin rlobs/ /snying nas mi phyed dad pas legs btab pa'i/ /smon lam sa ha ka ra'i sdong po la/ /'dod don ro bda'i 'bras bu yongs smin te/ /dus kun tshar du dngar ba'i (137na)bkra shis shog /ces gnas brtan bcu drug las brtsams pa'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad 'di ni bsam gtan rtser 'dzugs rtsis kyi bying pa blo bzang chos ldan gyis bskul ba la brten nas 'dod sbyar bzhin za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /sgrib gsum rgya las rnam grol spang rtogs kyi/ /yon tan mthar phyin sangs rgyas bden pa'i mthus//'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen rab brtan cing / /'khor ba de srid 'phrin las chad med shog /'gro kun zhi ba la sbyor theg gsum gyi/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i dam chos bden pa'i mthus/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen rab brtan cing / /'khor ba de srid 'phrin las chad med shog /myang 'das sgrub grogs mdzad cing lus can gyi/ /bsod nams zhing gyur dge 'dun bden pa'i mthus/ /—184

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen rab brtan cing / /'khor ba de srid 'phrin las chad med shog /mchog gsum bden pa nam yang mi slu
