ba'i/ khri( 'bras rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i mthus/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen rab brtan cing / /'khor ba de srid 'phrin las chad med shog /thub bstan legs dar rgyal ba'i bka' khrims btsan/ /'jig rten pa rnams rtag tu bde zhing skyid/ /rdzogs ldan bskal pa gsar du dang shar pa'i/ /dga' ston mngon sum myong ba'i bkra shis shog /ces bden pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni ngam ring mkhan po ngag dbang 'od zer gyi gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam grags pa'o/ /snod bcud bde ldan (137ba/rnyeng khams skye 'phags gar/ /snang dbus khri pad nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /dpal ldan bla ma tshe dpag med mgon skur/ /rab gsal 'khor ba stongs min rtag brtan shog /a lha mi 'gyur rdo rje'i ka ba can/ /snying dbus thabs shes zla nyi'i ga'u'i nang / /dngasama'i tshe srog yig gzugs 'od bkrag 'tsher/ /bskal brgyar mi phyed g.yung drung ltar brtan shog /pad 'byung yab yum zhal lung ches mngar bas/ /legs btags gsang mtshan rdo rje thog med rtsal/ /swā la'i sman ljongs phan bde'i nyer 'tsho sa /mi 'gyur smon pa'i bden tshig lhun grub shog /nor 'dzin skyong ba'i mi dbang zhabs brtan cing / /chos ldan rgyal po'i khrims kyis 'dzam gling khyab/ /thub bstan bshad sgrub dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel/ /'bangs rnams lha yi dga' ston la spyod shog /slu med dkon cog gsum gyi thugs rje dang / /bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro'i byin rlabs stobs/ /'dod khams dbang phyug la sogs srung ma'i mthus/ /bsams pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par shog /ces nged rang dang sde pa'i ring 'tsho bstan 'gro rgyas pa'i smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni grong smad pa sangasargyas rgya mtshos rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par 'dzugs rgyu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /rgyal ba kun yum yid bzhin 'khor lo yi/ /rab gsal ye shes spyan bdun rtag gzigs nas/ /—185

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu spung glegs bam dang po/ rton)ngag dbang blo ldan skal bzang skye rgu'i gnyen/ /bskal (138na)pa rgya mtshor mi g.yo zhabs brtan shog /spyi dang khyad par 'jam mgon btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs gnyis bstan pa rgya hor bod yul sogs/ /'dzam gling kun khyab rgyas pa'i byed po sa /nges pa lnga ldan ji bzhin bzhugs gyur cig /zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i srid kyi sde/ /gyen du bteg pa'i phan bde'i gdugs dkar po'i/ /grib mar 'bangs kun ngal gso la sbyor ba'i/ /sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs zhabs brtan shog /ljongs 'dir thub pa'i ring lugs rab dar ba'i/ /dkon cog rnam gsum thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis/ /'gro rnams dbul phongs nad zhabrug dang bral zhing / /phun tshogs bde skyid 'dod don lhun grub shog /yi dam 'jam dpal zhi dang khro bo'i gar/ /legs ldan phyag drug bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal/ /lha dang drang srong bden tshig 'grub pa'i mthus/ /ji ltar smon pa'i 'bras bu yongs smin shog /ces pa 'di ni grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /mar khu'i rgya mtsho yongs su 'khyil ba'i kong / /phun tshogs 'od stong 'bar ba'i sgron me yis/ /mun pa'i bskal pa ma lus mthar byas nas/ /'gro rnams sangs rgyas mngon sum mthong bar shog /ces kong rgya mtsho 'od 'bar 'di ni sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis phul skabs za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs ma spus/ /ngag dbang blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /bskal brgya'i bar du rdo rje ltar brtan cing / /rnam dkar 'phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi byin rlabs mthus/ /ngag dbang blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /bskal brgya'i bar du rdo rje ltar brtan cing / /rnam dkar 'phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i mthu rtsal gyis/ /ngag dbang blo gsal (138ba)skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /bskal brgya'i bar du rdo rje ltar brtan cing / /rnam dkar 'phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /bla ma yi —186

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dam srung ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /mkhan chen bstan pa dar rgyas g.yung drung ltar/ /mi 'gyur 'dir 'dus dge 'dun sde rnams kyi/ /chos srid legs tshogs zla bzhin 'phel bar shog /ji ltar smon lam btab pa'i 'bras bu kun/ /rab tu smin pa'i bsod nams phung po gang / /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams/ /bla med byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di yang rwa sgreng mkhan zur pa'i grwa mang rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /sngon goms smon lam rnam dag mthu btsan pas/ /bsams bzhin sprul pa'i zlos gar zla tshes pa//nyes brgya sgra gcan mche ba las grol nas/ /yon tan cha gang g.yo med brtan par shog /ces pa 'di yang 'khas drung ngag gi dbang phyug gi bzhed pa ba bris/ /rgyal rnams ma ro zhe sum mthong ba'i skal phra bar/ /de gsung ston mdzad dge ba'i bshes gnyen sku/ /ri mor byas pa'i bsod nams rgya mtsho yis/ /skye bar dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes 'dzin shog /lha sngags gzhan gyi nus mthu je zhan tshe/ /snyigs dus byin rlabs cher 'bar bder gshegs brgyad/ /legs (139na)byas zhing du bskrun 'dis 'khor ba las/ /nyer thar myang 'das bde chen sar bgrod shog /rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i bstan pa de srid bar/ /gzugs sku' bkod pa ma bsdus lus can don/ /rab mdzad 'phags pa'i gnas brtan tshogs rnams kyi/ /byin rlabs rgyu sbyor bdag snying la sim mdzod//rgyal 'gong dam sri'i tsha ngar snyigs dus 'dir/ /bdo ba'i gnyen por dbang chen rta mchog dpal/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol ba'i brtul zhugs rtsal/ /rdzogs pa'i khrag 'thung dpa' bos byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes rdo dgon pa ba blo bzang don ldan gyis bla ma/ sman bla/ gnas bcu/ rta mgrin rnams kyi zhal thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bkras rab pa phun dbang ngo / /rnam 'dren yongs kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpyid/ /gser zhun cod pan 'chang ba'i zlos gar —187

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedagyis/ /sa gsum skye rgu'i mchod sdong gcig pu pa/ /blo bzang grags pas deng 'dir dge legs stsol/ /gang gi thugs rje mtha' klas tshe yi khams/ /gzhu blugs g.yung drung srog tu bshes gnyen mchog /byin rlabs 'od mtshan stong du rab 'bar mgon/ /ji bzhin brtan pa'i smon pa lhun grub shog /ngag la dbang phyug brjod pa rnam dag sgras/ /blo ldan kun gyi bsnyems ga skal bzang can/ /rgya chen chos tshul mtsho bzhin gting zab pa/ /ston mdzad 'og min zhing gtso ltar brtan shog /sdebazhi gar du rtse ba'i thang yangs por/ /lnga brgya'i dpung gnyen 'jam mgon myong kha par/ /(139ba)kun bzang mchod sprin spro ba'i 'dus pa'i gling / /srid mtha'i bar du mi nyams 'phel bar shog /bdud sde 'jigs byed 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ /legs ldan phyag drug lha chen nyi ma'i sras/ /'dod khams dbang phyug la sogs srung ma yis/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'phrin las lhun grub mdzod/ /ces smon pa 'grub pa'i tshigs bcad 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes rtses dang lnga mchod pa'i 'dus tshogs spyi so'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun dbang ngo / /zas gtsang sras kyis ched du bsngags pa'i dbyangs/ /srid gsum rna ba'i rgyan du 'bar ba'i gzis/ /'chi bdag mun mthar byed pa'i bcom ldan ma/ /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal mas ring du skyongs/ /blo bzang snyan pa'i grags ldan btsong kha pa'i/ /chos srid bla nas blar 'degs mthu stobs can/ /sa dbang khrims kyi nyi mas phan dang bde'i/ /'dab brgya bskal par ba 'ad phyir zhabs brtan shog /deng 'dir rtse gcig smon lam yongs btab pa'i/ /'bras bu bsams pa ji bzhin legasasmin par/ /lha dang drang srong rig pa 'dzin rnams kyis/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i bden tshig brjod par shog /ces brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad 'di ni rtses dang lnga mchod pa spyi so'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun dbang ngo / /blo ldan skal bzang rnam par 'dren pa'i gtso/ thu kya seng ge'i bstan pa rin po cher/ /thos —188

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dang bsam pa'i 'phrin las rgyud zhugs(140na lnga'i/ /sngon goms bag chags sad la gsol ba 'debs/ /ring bsags legs byas zla ba'i ma ma la/ /mchog gsum thugs rje bskul ba'i sa 'dzin mas/ /yongs bsgril mi 'gyur brtan pa'i nyi 'od kyis/ /re 'dod 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i bkra shisashog /ces pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes shes rab bzang po'i ngor sbyar/ /snying dbus rlung sems dag pa'i 'od mtha' yas/ /yab yum dga' bzhi'i 'chi med byang sems rgyun/ /rtsa khams lus khyab bde stong zung 'jug pas/ /tshe la dbang ba'i rigs 'dzin 'grub par shog /ces sh+lau ka gcig la 'chi med sgrub tshul yod pa zhig dgos zhes zur mangs chos rjes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bkras rab pa phun dbang ngo / /chos rnams kun gyi 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i yum/ /gdod nas rang bzhin dag pa spros bral mkhar/ /slu med rgyu dang tsos bu dbang po'i gzhu/ /'gog med 'char ba'i rten 'brel bden pa'i mthus/ /blo bzang bstan 'dzin dal ba'i rten gyi gzings/ /legs rnyed srid pa'i mtsho chen las bsgral te/ /ma smad thar pa'i rin chen gling mchog tu/ /spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang dge gzhen rnams kyis dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi ched du yum chen mo'i stong thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun dbang ngo / /rgyal kun yab cig mgon po kun tu gzigs/ /mtshams sprin (140ba〉gos 'chang blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs/ /ding dus ngo mtshar med byung bkod zhing gtsor/ /'jigs med seng ge'i nga ro'i dbyangs snyan kye/ /nye ring med pa thugs rje nyi ma'i zer/ /bdag sogs mos blo'i 'dab stong yongasabashad nas/ /'dod don sbrang rtsi dngar po'i ro bda' bar/ /'dzad med longs su spyod par bdag byin rlobs/ /mgon khyod ring lugs 'chad rtsod rtsom pa la/ /ngag gi dbang phyug grub pa'i blo grosagater/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /yongs khyab bshes gnyen dam pa —189

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenazhabs rtan shog /nor 'dzin skyong la blo dang brtson pa yis/ /bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i bstan pa mchog /'degs pa'i mthu ldan stobs kyis dbang phyug che/ /rdo rje lta bur nam yang g.yo med shog /gtan gyi skyabs gnas rin chen rnam pa gsum/ /bden tshig grub pa'i lha dang drang srong rnams/ /dpang por byas te smon lam btab pa yis/ /'bras bu ji bzhin lhun gyis 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di yang sku skye blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis shar phyogs bstan pa'i sgron me dwags po grwa tshang du 'dzugs rtsis kyi dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun dbang ngo / /'dzam gling yongs kyi phun tshogs longs spyod rnams/ /g.yas 'khyil rin cen 'dus pa'i yol go 'di/ /bskrun pas deng nas bla med byang chub bar/ /chos srid 'byor pa'i bcud kun myang bar shog /ces mkhas mang blo gsal gling gi tshogs khro 'dzam gling g.yas 'khyil dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis bzhengs par ngag dbang bzang po'i (141na)gser zho gang gi zhal 'debs dang bcas bzo byed pa'i do dam sde pa 'bog gong dbang rgyal gyis bgyis pa maṅga le/ /rgyal kun 'chi bdag bdud bcom sa bon rnams/ /tshe mtha' yas skur smin pa'i thugs rje'i 'bras/ /bskal brgyar rab 'tsho'i ro bda' rtag myong ba'i/ /byin rlabs yongs 'du'i grib tu ngal gsor shog /mdzod spu g.yas 'khyil 'od 'bar zer 'phreng gis/ /lha chen nyi bu'i smag rum mthar byas te/ /gzhes med srog gi ka ba mi 'gyur ba'i/ /gtan bde'i snang bas khyab pa'i bka' drin stsol/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang grags pa yi/ /ring lugs rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' yongs brgal ba'i/ /nor 'dzin dpal mo'i mngal du legs sgrums pa/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen zhabs brtan shog /tshangs pa'i blo dang dbang phyug skal bzang ldan/ khyab 'jug mthu rtsal brgya byin stobs mnga' ba'i/ /mi yi bdag po nyi 'og rgyal khams kyi/ /mgon skyabs dpung gnyen gling du brtan par shog /bod chen skye rgu'i gnya' bar khrims kyi shing / /rab lci'i chos srid zung 'brel gser mdog zhu'i//—19()

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bstan pa byams mgon dbus 'gyur 'byon min bar/ /gyen nas gyen du 'phyur te 'phel bar shog /nad mtshon mu ge dang bral 'jig rten bde/ /chos spyod rnam bcus dge 'dun sde rnams dar/ /'di'i ched 'bad do cog kun 'dod pa'i don/ /rtsol bar bltos min ngang gisahrūb par shog /phun tsho gos bsil zer nya gang yang gyi ngo / /gza' skar sbyor byed (141ba tha zang ba'i tshes kyi dus/ /mchog gsum thugs rjes smin pa'i re skong ba'i/ /bkra shis rgyud mangs dbyangs su 'brol bar shog /ces pa'i smon lam tshigs bcad 'di ni 'ol kha 'bri lung pa blo bzang dpal 'byor gyis rdzing phyi sogs 'ol kha'i dgon khag rnams la 'dzugs rtsis kyi bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sgra 'dzin yol go'i nang / /gsung rab sbrang rtsi bcud du 'khyil mdzad pas/ /grangs med blo gsal rgya mtsho'i 'dod pa'i don/ /grub mdzad bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam gsum dkon cog rin chen thugs rje'i mthus/ /mgon khyod rdo rje'i stan la bskal pa'i bar/ /tshe mtha' yas pa ji bzhin legs bzhugs nas/ /mos ldan gdul bya'i re ba skong gyur cig /ces dga' ldan thos bsam gling slob dpon dge 'dun don grub kyi gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs 'di ni blo bzang chos 'phel gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun dbang ngo / /chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i gdan khri la/ /chos can rgyu 'bras zung 'brel nyi zla'i steng / /dpal ldan bla ma tshe mtha' yas pa'i mgon/ /g.yung drung mtshan pa'i gzugs sku brtan par shog /ngag dbang tshangs pa'i sras mo ba 'ad pa'i blos/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i spobs pa yongs dge ba/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can g.yin du 'gyur min bar/ /rab bzhugs 'gro ba'i gdung ba (142na)sel bar shog /dbyings phyug rdo rje btsun mo srid gsum la/ /dbang sgyur rnam bzhi'i las 'phrul mo che'i/ /byin rlabs drod kyis smon pa'i dzaskru'i 'bras/ /gser gyi snye ma smin pa'i dga' ston stsol/ /ces re —191—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung hā gas bam dang po/ zhenasmon 'grub pa'i tshigs bcad 'di ni rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i grwa rgyun ri bo bde chen pa rnams kyi 'bad pas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /tshe dpag med mgon ting 'dzin phyag rgya yis/ /legs bteg bum bzang las 'ongs bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /srog zungs gyur te sgrib pa'i lus can kun/ /lha chen nyi bu'i g.yul las rgyal bar mdzod//de ltar zla zhun rjes 'gro lhag bsam gyis/ /rab bskrun legs byas phung por spungs pa'i gzis/ /yid srubs sde dpung bag la yongs zha nas/ /dkar phyogs rgyal ba'i ba dan bsgreng bar shog /khrims ldan ngur smrig 'chang rnams mgrin gcig tu/ /nyer brjod bden pa'i tshig gis rdo rje'i khrir/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen srid mtha'i bar/ /rtag bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyis 'gro 'dren shog /gnyis 'thung 'gying 'dra'i ri bor gto gyi bde/ /don wo sgrub pa'i dge 'dun 'dusapa'i gling / /chos srid zung ldan dkar cha'i zla ba bzhin/ /bla nas blar 'phel bskal brgyar 'gyur med shog /ces legs smon gyi tshigs bcad 'di ni chos sde chen po ri bo bde chen spyi tshogs kyi gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs (142bskobang po'o/ /skabs gsum drang srong rig 'dzin grub pa sogs/ /srid dang zhi ba'i dbang phyug brgyad ldan rnams/ /phun tshogs shis pa brjod pa'i dbyangs snyan dang / /chabs cig me rtag char pa deng 'dir phob/ /kun bzod yangs pa'i khyon rnams bsod nams mthus/ /gcig tu bcings pa'i rgyal khab chen po'i khrir/ /gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor yongs la mnga' sgyur ba'i/ /mi yi bdag po rdo rje ltar brtan shog /mchog gsum thugs rje nam yang gsal 'grib med/ /bden tshig grub pa'i brjod pa don dang mthun/ /tshul ldan smon pa'i re ba lhun 'grub pa'i/ /ngo mtshar skal bzang snye ma deng smin shog /ces mi'i dbang phyug gi brtan bzhugs tshigs bcad 'di ni yul lho phyogs sman ljongs kyi 'dus pa'i —192

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)khyu rgyan ri bo bde chen spyi so'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar snyom las pa za hor bhu su kus sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /mthong ba'i mig gi bdud rtsi mtshan dpe'i sku/ /thos pas rna ba'i bcud len tshangs pa'i gsung //dran pas srid zhi'i gdung sel kun mkhyen thugs/ /gsang gsum 'khor lo'i mgon por gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog dman gdul bya'i snang ngor rgyal ba kun/ /bshes gnyen ngur smig 'dzin pa'i zlosagar du/ /nges rnyed gsol ba 'debs na 'di phyi dang / /gtan mdun lhun gyis grub par bdag byin rlobs/ /rdul bral ston zla ltar dkar legs byas mthas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' bzhin gzhal dka'i ma rgan 'gro/ /'dren phyir tsho gis gnyis sa bon btab pa'i 'bras/ /chos gzugs snyem g.yur (143na)du za bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang bkra shis chos 'phel gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /gar dbang 'od mtshan 'bar ba'i snang ba yis/ /gaṅgā'i klung rdul ji snyed 'jig rten khams/ /gsal mtshon rnon pos lha chen nyi bu'i zhags/ /bcad de 'gro tsho gos 'chi med grong 'jug mdzod/ /rang sems dag pa'i kun bzod maṇ+ḍal ra/ /dus gsum bsags dge'i ri rab gling bzhi sogs/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor tshom bur yongs bkod nas/ /'bul na bde ldan zhing mgon ltar bzhugs gsol/ /rjes chags snying rje'i 'dzum gyis lus can rnams/ /nges legs khang par bsus zin de srid bar/ /mi g.yo rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gcig gis/ /gdong lngas bteg khri rtag tu gnon gsol 'debs/ /gsung ngag chad med dbang bzhi mtho ris chu/ /blo ldan skal bzang yid kyi rgya mtsho cher/ /legs 'bebs 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /'og min zhing gtso ji bzhin brtan gyur cig /thub dbang dpal gyi mgur nas 'khor lo gsum/ /rab gsungs mdo dang bde chen 'dresanus pa'i/ /nges gsang theg par bcas pa'i chos kyi sde/ /thos bsam sgom pas srid mthar rgyas gyur cig /ches cher snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rgyal gzhan pas/ /thugs rje bla lhag bder gshegs mched —193

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ rton)brgyad kyis/ /byin rlabs 'chi gsos rtsi sman ljon pa yis/ /mkha' mnyam yid can rim pa'i srog 'tshor shog /dkon cog bden pa'i nyi ma 'char nub spangs/ /rgyu las mi 'chol (143ba 'bras bu dus su smin/ /tshul ldan dge 'dun smon pa lhun grub pa'i/ /slu med rten cing 'brel 'byung la spyod shog /ces sum rtsen yul la 'gran pa ru lag myang stod kyi sa'i cha nas chos sde dpal 'khor bde ba chen po'i mkhan slob spyi tshogs kyi gsung gis bskul ba ltar sdom brtson sde snod gsum pa za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /blo gros bzang po'i grags pa yongs 'bar ba'i/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku/ /mchog gsum bden pas yid srubs las rgyal nas/ /g.yung drung khri la g.yo med brtan par shog /mi phyed dad dang stobs ldan sa'i brgya byin/ /rdo rje thu she ye thu rgyal po che/ /bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma yis/ /sku tshe rab brtan mnga' thang rgyas par shog /ces khal kha 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i sku blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang dad stobs ldan pa rdo rje thu she ye thu rgyal po gnyis kyi brtan bzhugs sh+lau ka re yod pa zhig dgos zhes sku skye blo bzang 'phrin las kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo gros bye ba'i gter/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhabs la gsol 'debasan/ /rdo rje'i khri la bskal pa rgya mtsho sa /legs bzhugs gdul bya'i re ba yongs skang shog zhesabyang rtse chos rje ngag dbang blo gros rgya mtsho la brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs glo ka gcig la tshang ba zhig dgos zhes smad rgyud dbu mdzad kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge ni phun (144na ji bang ngo / /mkhyen brtse nus ldan sangs rgyas kun 'dus shing / /bden pa gnyis ldan dam pa chos kyi mdzod//rig grol dpal ldan dge 'dun kun gyi gtso/ /skyabs gsol don ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs dbyangs can lhas rjes bzung / /blo gsal skal bzang bzang po'i bag —194

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)chags sad/ /rgya mtsho ltar zab zab rgyas sa kun ston/ /gtan gyi mgon skyabs skyabs gsum ngo bor 'dud/ /bshes gnyen mthu las ma ho mtho'i rten bzang rnyed/ /thos bsam sgom pas dal 'byor don dang ldan/ /'di phyi bar gyi gtan mdun kun 'grub pa'i/ /bka' drin dran no snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon nas deng bar yang srid thams cad du/ /nyes brgya las bskyabs phan bde la sbyor ba//dam pa'i mgon gyi thugs rje mtha' klas na/ /mi phyed gdung ba drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ /'di nas 'phos te byang chub snying po'i bar/ /mngon mtho nges legs myu gu yongs smin pa'i/ /bsod nams sa bon khyod drin las rnyed na/ /zhabs kyi pad+ma ra mgo pos btud phyag 'tshal/ /dngos bshamasayid sprul kun bzang mchod sprin dbul/ /sdig lhung nyes tshogs bsags so cog rnams bshags/ /skye 'phags kyis bskrun dge ba'i tshogs la rangs/ /sras bcas rgyal slob chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /'khor mtha' rnyed min mya ngan mi 'dar bzhugs/ /rang g.yin kun gyis bsags pa'i 'dus byas kyi/ /dge tsho gos ma lus kun mkhyen thob phyir bsngo/ /bdag sogs 'gro rnams byang chub thob par shog /sngon dang (144ba〉phal gyi rgyu rkyen las byung ba'i/ /'jigs chen brgyad sogs dgra gdon nad rims gegs/ /dam cho ge tshul bzhin bsgrub la nyer 'tshe ba'i/ / 'gal rkyen bar gcod nye bar zhi bar shog /dal ba'i rten bzang yun gnas ring po'i tshe/ /kha na ma tho spangs pa'i zas nor gos/ /dpal 'byor snyan grags mthun pa'i yon tan rnams/ /'bad rtsol med par ngang gis 'grub par shog /bdag nyid mthong thos dran reg skye bo kun/ /phan dang bde ba'i dpal la legs sbyor zhing / /mngon sangs rgyas tshe 'khor du yongs bsdus nas/ /dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi ster bar shog /mdor na som nyi dang bral dad pa yis/ /nyin mtshan dus kun gsol 'debs lhur len na/ /dam pa'i mgon gyi thugs rje bdag snying la/ /'jug pa'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog /ces dge sbyor gang byed kyi bar mtshams su sbyar chog pa'i bka' drin dran pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes rgyal ba'i sras po blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi gsung gis bskul —195

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedab la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa tre bo ngag dbang nam mkha'o/ /'gro ba'i phan bde'i rtsa lag sangs rgyas bstan/ /ring por gnas pa'i bkra shis brgya phrag sgo/ /'byed pa'i phul byung rnam dpyod rab yangs pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs//byang phyogs 'dzin ma'i gzhi 'dir bdag sogs la/ /sangs rgyas kyis gsungs yang dag dam pa'i chos/ /bstan pas 'di phyi kun tu bkra shis pa'i/ /phun tsho gis dga' ston stsol la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde ba can gyi zhing na tshe (145na ji pag med/ /dgyes zhal 'dzum bstan dkyus ring spyan ras kyis/ /legs gzigs phyag na bum pa'i bdud rtsi'i chus/ /dbang bskur 'chi ba med pa'i dga' ston stsol/ /ma rig stug po'i gnyid las nyer sangs shing / /blang dor lta ba'i blo gros yongs rgyas pa/ /rab bkra sna tsho gos rdo rje'i re khā'i steng / /mi 'gyur shis pa'i bde legs lhun grub shog /sangs rgyas slob mar bcas pa'i thugs rje bskul/ /lha dang drang srong bden pa brjod par gsol/ /bkra shis dge ba'i dus 'dir bdag sogs kyi/ /smon lam btab pas ji bzhin bzhugs gyur cig /pa sangs ltar dkar dge tshogs a mra'i shing / /phan bde'i lo tog phang phung rab rgyas par/ /legs smon rnam bkra'i me tog sgrub pa'i 'bras/ /yongs dud shis pa'i dpal gyis 'bar bar shog /sangs rgyas kyis bstan lung rtogs yon tan rnams/ /tshul bzhin 'dzin pa'i theg gsum dge 'dun tshogs/ /dkon cog rin chen bkra shis snyan pa'i glus/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khyon gyis 'tsho bar shog /ces shi ral thu sangs rgyas bkra shis kyi gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa blo ka kha shas yod pa zhig dgos zhes khal kha rdo rje rgyal po'i rigs las paṇ+ḍi ta er te ni thas ris bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dgon gsar sbug pa ngag dbang rab brtan no/ /rang byung lhun grub lus kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tsho gos yongs rdzogasapa/ /rdo rje slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug dpal/ /blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtshor gsol(145ba tha 'debs/ /rin cen khris bteg pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rtag brtan cing / / —/96

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rnam gsum 'khor lo'i bya bas bdag g.yin 'gro /rab drangs nges par legs pa'i lam 'jug shog /ces pa 'di ni paṇ+ḍi ta er te ni tha'i ji dang bi yig thu ja'i sang gnyis kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /bden pa yongs brjod smon lam nam mkha' la/ /'phel 'grib med 'char dkon cog thugasarje'i nyis/ /srid zhi'i gdung mun mthar byas phan dang bde'i/ /snang ba'i 'od kyis 'jig rten kun khyab mdzod/ /ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i blo gros can/ /skal bzang gdul bya rgya mtsho'i mgon gyur pa/ /'gyur med g.yung drung 'khyil ba'i khrir bzhugs nas/ /bskal brgyar rnam gsum 'khor los 'gro 'dren shog /lhag bsam zhing sar sa bon dge ba'i tshogs/ /smon 'bras bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can kun/ /lha mi'i dga' ston chad med myong bzhin du/ /ring por mi thogs byang chen mngon 'gyur shog /ces bden pa brjod pa'i tshigs bcad 'di ni gu yang da khen nang sos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /mtshan legs yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po yis/ /phul byung thugs rje chen po'i dpung bskyed nas/ /blo bzang dngos grub mi khom gnas brgyad las/ /drangs te dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten thob shog /rin chen zla dang pad+mas rab brgyan pas/ /phul byung ྾/ blo bzang ྾/ drangs ter/ gser bzang dri med rin cen snang ba yis/ /(146na)phul byung ྾/ blo bzang ྾/ drangs te ྾/ bde bar gshegs pa mya ngan med dpal gyis/ /phul byung ྾/ blo bzang ྾/ drangs te ྾/ bde gshegs chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs snyan gyis/ /phul byung ྾/ blo bzang ྾/ drangs te ྾/ chos kyi rgya mtsho mchog gi mngon mkhyen pas/ /phul byung ྾/ blo bzang ྾/ drangs te ྾/ sman gyi bla ma be+eḍūrla 'od kyis/ /phul byung ྾/ blo bzang ྾/ drangs te ྾/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya seng ge yis/ /phul byung thugs rje chen po'i dpung bskyed nas/ /blo bzang dngos grub mi khom gnas brgyad las/ /drangasate dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten thob shog /ces stag ru ba blo bzang dngos grub kyi don du tshe dbang bkra —197—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanashis kyis bder gshegs brgyad so so'i brgya thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig gi smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /rang sems dad pa'i zla shel gtsang ma'i ngos/ /mtshan dpe'i gzugs brnyan ri mo rnam bkra ba//bde bar gshegs pa kun 'dus bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /gang gi sku la gdan gsum ma lus pa/ /legs tshang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid can/ /smin grol gdams pa'i 'dod dgu ma lus char/ /grangs med skye ba kun tu 'bebs byin rlobs/ /gang la gsol btab dkon cog rnam gsum gyi/ /thugs rje shugs la 'jug pa dngos po'i gshis/ /de phyir snying nas gsol ba 'debs byed na/ /byang chub bar du 'bral med rjes 'dzin shog /ces pa 'di ni bsam blo a 'ad rab 'byams (146ba)pa blo bzang 'jam dbyangs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i rdo rje slob dpon mchog /ngag dbang blo gsal mkhas btsun bzang po yis/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can kun khyab 'gro 'dren par/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag byin brlab tu gsol/ /zhes pa 'di ni mkhan chen ngag dbang 'phrin las kyi zhal 'don du de 'phral du bris/ /bsod nams rtsibs stong 'khor los nor 'dzin la/ /dbang sgyur mi yi bdag po rab brtan cing //'jig rten kun tu rdzogos ldan dga' ston la/ /spyod par dkon cog gsum gyis byin gyis rlobs/ /zhesasde pa'i brtan bzhugs 'di ni skyid tshal mkhan chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyi zhal ngor bkod/ /dkon cog rin chen rnam gsum mkha' dbyings ngos/ /thugs rje 'dzad pa med pa'i chu 'dzin las/ /phul byung byin rlabs char gyis skyed bsrings pa'i/ /phan bde'i snye ma g.yur du za bar shog /g.yung drung 'khyil ba'i nya phyis khog yangs par/ /mi 'gyur tshe yi mu thi la'i phung po/ /bgrang ring bskal pa'i srad bur rgyu nus par/ /smon pa'i re ba yid bzhin 'grub par shog /ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i blo gros kyis/ /skal bzang gdul bya 'dren pa'i mgon gcig pur/ /rgya mtsho'i —198—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gos can gzugs ga' na bsgyur min par/ /snang mtha' yas pa lta bur brtan par bzhugs/ /bdag kyang tshe 'dir chos bzhin bsgrub pa'i rkyen/ /ma lus kun tshang yang srid thams cad du/ /dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes su nyer bzung ste/ /gtan gyi mdun (147na)ma lhun gyis grub par shog /thogs med dus nas da lta phyin chad du/ /bsags pa'i dge ba ji snyed mchis pa rnams/ /sems can mtha' dag srid pa'i 'ching ba las/ /rnam grol stobs bcu mnga' ba thob par shog /ces pa 'di ni klu 'bum chos rje rin chen gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /bsod nams tshogs kyis yongs bskrun ngo mtshar gnas/ /bkod pa rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi rtser son pa/ /gto bde'i dga' bar skal bzang yid can rnams/ /spyod pa'i zhing gi mgon pos deng 'dir dgongs/ /kun khyab mdzod spu'i 'od zer 'bar ba'i gzis/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi smag rum mthar byas nas/ /gshin rje'i pho nya las kyi me long khur/ /'dzin pa'i ngal btang gnyid la g.yur byin rlobs/ /dga' ba brgya pa'i tshems dkar nya phyis khog /yangs po las sbrum mdzes sdug lang tsho can/ /dri za'i bu mo ngag gi dbang phyug mas/ /rjes bzung tshangs sras bzhad pa rab brtan shog /ji lta ji snyed shes bya la 'jug blor/ /'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal lhug pa sa /ston pa'i dpal ldan skal pa bzang po can/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon de zhabs brtan shog /zab dang rgya che'i chos kun mthong ba'i mod/ /mtsho byung drin las smra ba'i spobs pa yis/ /mkhas rlome g.yin la 'jigs pa med pa'i go /cha gang zla ba 'phel 'grib bral bar shog /thub pa chen po'i ba ched gzhud ji bzhin du/ /rab 'dzin zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan/ /ma snyigs 'dab stong lang tsho'i bcud kyi sde/ shes ldan bung ba'i dga' ston rtag (147bcung shog /stobs kyi 'khor lo mkha' la nyer 'phags pa'i/ /legs byas dpyid kyi nor 'dzin dpal mo'i mngal/ /rab lci gangs can lha gcig mi yi rje/ /sku tshe mtshan jus chab srid 'phel bar shog /rnam 'dren kun gang gzigs pa'i shes bya'i —199

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenakhyon/ /mngon sum tshad mas yongs gzhal tsong kha pa'i/ /bstan pa'i gdugs dkar gcig gi grib bsil du/ /'dzam gling skye rgu bde ba'i ngal gsor shog /ches dkon dal ba'i rten bzang mchog gsum gyi/ /drin las nyer thob dpa' mdzangs rtul phod can/ /mi yi rje bo'i tshe dpal mnga' thang kun/ /dar drag dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rgyas par shog /thos bsam dpyid kyi dga' spro yongs 'phel ba'i/ /nyams ldan mig stong can bzhin sbyin skyes mas/ /rnam par rgyal ba 'tshams sprin gos can gling / /nyi zla mun sel bar du dar bar shog /'gro rnams sngon bsags chos dkar nu ma'i zho/ /deng nas byang chen bar du chad med par/ /btungs pas spang rtogs lang tsho rgyas pa bzhin/ /chos gzugasasmin legs ma 'gugs lcags kyur shog /lho brgyud kun bzod yul gru e yig dbyibs/ /grangs med 'gro ba'i 'du 'khod yangs pa can/ /lo tog dus sbrum khe spogs mkho dgus tshig /nad 'khrug dang bral tshe yang 'phel bar shog /sras bcas rgyal ba nyan rang rig pa 'dzin/ /lha dang drang srong tshig btsan dmod pa'i mthus/ /deng 'dir gang btab smon pa lhun grub pa/ /yongs 'du'i tshal bzhin re ba skong bar shog /ces 'di ga'i ming sgra sogs tshang ba'i bden brjod kyi tshigs bcad glo ka bcu gsum tsam yod pa zhig se mdo dga' (148na)ldan rnam rgyal du 'dzugs pa'i ched nang so dkon cog dar rgyas shus bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /bde ldan zhing du 'od zer stong 'bar bas/ /ches cher bsngags pa'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal/ /mtshan gyi sgras kyang lha chen nyi ma'i bu/ /mthar byed dus gsum sangs rgyas kun yum kye/ /dkar ser sngo ba'i zhal ldan phyag brgyad kyi/ /tha mas legs bteg bum bzang las 'ongs pa'i/ /zil dngar bcud kyis phung khams gtams pa'i mod/ /mtshun lha skyengs te bag la zha bar mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i sras gnyis dgyes pas me tog 'thor/ /gtum chen khro bo rnam bzhi bgegs tshogs skrod/ /legs bris bu yis mtho ris a lha'i chab/ /sbrengs te ma dag dri ma kun khrus shig /bden brjod lhun —200

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)gyis grub pa'i sngon 'gro'i sgor//bcom ldan 'das mar snyan gsan gsol btab nas//yid la re ba'i 'bras bu deng gi dus//'bad med lag rtser stsol bar byin gyis rlobs//bgrang yas gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tsho gos rnams//rang byung lhun grub kyi lus dkyil 'khor du//yongs tshang dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'dzin//mchog gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs//'jam dbyangs gzhen nu dgyes pa'i bshes gnyen rje//tshang sras lha mo bzhad pa'i ngag dbang blo//mkhas btsun bzang po gdul bya rgya mtsho yi//'dren mchog dam pa bskal par zhabs brtan shog/rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ro btsong kha pa'i//bstan pa'i sgron mes 'jig rten gsum gyi mun//rab sel skye rgu 144mtha' dag bde skyid kyi//dga' ston mchog la rtag tu spyod par shog/'bras dkar rin chen spungs pa gsum pa'i gling //lho brgyud zhwa ser 'chang ba bstan pa'i srog/glang chen nyal 'dra'i ri bor chos kyi grwa/bde chen 'dus tshogos srid mthar rgyas gyur cig/rdo rje srin po legs ldan phyag drug pa//'jam dpal bka' sdod dus dgra ma lha'i zhal//'dod khams dbang phyug ma sogs srung ma yis//'phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog/ces pa 'di'ang ngag dbang nam mkhas ri bo bde chen du 'dzugs rtsis kyi bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab phun tshogs dbang po'o//mos dge'i dpag bsam ljon pa'i rtser//yongs dud bde skyid 'bras bu'i khur//legasasmin ro brgya bda' ba'i zas//tshe rabs kun tu myong bar shog tshongs rabs/mang rta r+ṣa po rnam gnyis kyi//gzhung lugs gangs can las babs chus//sal ma myu gu skyed bsrings nas//kun mkhyen ye shes thob par shog la gci/ngo mtshar zhing gi bkod pa'i phul//bde ba can du 'dab brgya'i sbubs//brdzus te skyes nas 'od dpag med/ /zhal mjal chos kyi smin grol shog bde ba can/log par blta ba'i mu stegs sde//sna tsho gis cho 'phrul gyis btul ba//ji bzhin rang rgyud bdud bzhi las//rnam par rgyal bar bdag byin rlobs/cho mi/a moX gdul bar mdzad pa bcu'i//tshul bstan ji ltar

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanabadag gzhan 'gro/ /ring por mi thogs mgon khyod dang / /tsos par 'gro ba kun sgrol shog mdzad ༄/ sku dngos deng bzhugs mkha' khyab kyi/ /(149na〉soms can ma lus don mdzad pa/ /'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi /byin rlabs bdag snying la zhugs mdzod gnas bcu/ rgyal yum 'phagasams glang seng sprul/ /me chu lcags sgrog sha za dang / /rkun por phangs pa'i 'jigs brgyad las/ /legs skyobs phan dang bde la sbyor sgrol ma/ dus gsum bsags dang bsag bzhin pa'i/ /dge bsardo rje slob dpon mchog /bskal brgyar mya ༅ mi 'da' bar/ /chos kyi 'khor lo skor gyur cig 'dra 'bag /ces pa'ang blo gros rgya mtshos thad ga'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni phun dbang ngo / /g.yu ljang lo 'dab phang phung g.yo ba phul byung bkod pa'i zhing khams nas/ /dri med rab gsal ye shes spyan bdun dus gsum grangs med nyer gzigs ma/ /mtha' yas rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo mas/ /mkha' mnyam skye rgu bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dga' ston stsol/ /gang la brten na bslu ba med pa dkon mchog rin chen thugs rje yis//ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i bshes gnyen blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur gzhom zhig dang bral gar gyi dbang phyug ji bzhin du/ /'chi ba med pa'i tshe la mnga' brnyes 'gro ba ma lus 'dren par shog /dga' ba brgya pa mgrin sngon can dang 'khor lo'i lag sogs me zhal gyi/ / gtso bo rnams dang bden pa'i ngag gis dmod pa'i tshig mngar dbang ba yis sa 'og sa steng sa bla gnas pa'i skye rgu yongs la gnas skabs dang / /mthar thug bsams (149ba tshe don lhun gyis grub pa'i smon lam bzang po'i 'bras smin shog /ces pa'ang ngag dbang mkhas btsun gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun dbang ngo / /gsung dang dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun blo gros kyis/ /bum bzang yongs gtam zab dang rgya che'i chos/ /dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel ba dga' ba'i bshes/ /rab brtan dkon cog 'phrin las 'asdug par shog /—202

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'phags yul shrī na la spro gnyis par/ shes bya kun rig rong ston chos rje dang / /mkhyen rab rin chen mchog tu grub pa yis/ /ring lugs srid mtha'i bar du 'phel bar shog /'khon rigs 'jam dbyangs ma dros chu bo las/ /ngor rdzong thu ston smin grol chos kyi mdzod/ /gong ma'i snyan brgyud slob bshad zab don gyi/ /rnam bzhi'i nyal 'gro chad med 'bab par shog /med byung mkhyen pa'i rab dang phul gyur pas/ /ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i rnam dpyod mthus/ /lhun grub chos dang rigs kyi bstan pa'i rgyun/ /bla nas blar 'phel gaṅgā'i klung ltar shog /gur mgon lcam dral stobasa'aphrog dbang po sogs/ /rdo rje chos skyong rnams kyis grogs mdzad cing / /rigs byed ma dang tshogs bdag 'dod rgyal gyis/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor char du snyil bar mdzod/ /ces pa 'di'ang gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i smin grol gdams pa'i bang mdzod bco brgyad chos rje mkhyen rab ngag dbang lhun grub kyi gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /tshe dpag med mgon yid bzhin 'khor lo dang / /(150na〉gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma la sogs pa/ /'chi med grub pa'i rig 'dzin lha tsho gos kyis/ /deng 'dir tshe yi dngos grub legs stsol cig /kun mkhyen bu ston ring lugs spel ba la/ /rin chen dbang rgyal lta bur gdul bya yi/ /bsod nams zhing gyur rnam kun mchog ldan pa'i/ grub pa'i rdo rje 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod 'chi med tshe la dbang 'byor te/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi shigs lhun grub sku/ /bskal brgyar gzhom med rab tu brtan gyur nas/ /rgya chen chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar shog /ces mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs 'di'ang mkhas shing grub brnyes mkhyen rab ngag dbang lhun grub kyi gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab phun dbang ngo / /tshe dpag med dngos snyigs dus 'gro ba'i don/ /'dzam gling che ba'i rig sngags 'chang ba'i gar/ /—203

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenalegs bsgyur mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje yi/ /rmad byung zad mi shes pa'i byin rlabs mthus/ /zil gnon 'jam dpal grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin/ /pad+mas ming btags rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ /'og min zhing khams zhing ga'i mgon po bzhin/ /nam yang g.yo med g.yung drung ltar brtan shog /bdag sogs 'od gsal rdo rje snying po yi/ /gsang las yang gsang nye ba'i lam bzang la/ /brten nas tshe 'dir 'pho ba chen po'i sku/ /yongs grub mkha' khyab 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang snga 'gyur gyi bstan 'dzin bres pa bla chen chos rgyal rdo rjes ched du bskul ba ltar za (150bskyong gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /mi byed dad pa'i yid kyi nam mkha' la/ /sras bcas rgyal ba kun 'dusang ga gi dbang / /blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i gnyen gcig pu/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe rabs brgyud mar dal 'byor rten rnyed cing / /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon gyis rtag tu zin/ /tshad ldan chos la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis/ /myur du 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal du shog zhes pa 'di'ang rab 'byams pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang mgon po don grub gnyis kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab phun dbang ngo / /snyigs ma'i sems can rnams la thugs rje'i mthu/ /rnam 'dren gzhan las ches lhag bder gshegs brgyad/ /ma smad thugs rje bskul ba mdo chog gzhung / /bstan pa'i rtsa lag zhi 'tsho bzhed pa'i srol/ /nyer mkho'i pho brang der 'god sku brnyan sogs/ /lhag bsam ston gyi zla ba ltar dkar bas/ /sgrub 'bras rme ru'i 'dus sde srid mtha'i bar/ /chos dang 'byor pa dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog /byed por gtogs kun bder gshegs 'khor bcas kyis/ /smon pa ji ltar rtag tu bde zhing skyid/ /rang don tsam min rgyud lnga'i yid can rnams/ /byang chub mchog la sbyor ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes pa yang mnga' bdag khri lde gtsug brtan gyi dus tshugs pa'i 'dus sde rme ru ba rnams kyis bder gshegs brgyad kyi cho ga la mkho ba'i pho brang dang lha tshogs rnams bzhengs pa'i smon lam dgos tshul ltar za —204

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras (151na)rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /dge bsnyen ming 'dzin dus kyi chos nyid can/ /mu med 'khor ba'i slong du yongs chud las/ /sgrol ba'i ded dpon mtshan legs yongs bsgrags ldan/ /thugs rje nyer bskul mthu dpung bskyed du gsol/ /dge bsnyen ྾/ mu med ྾/ sgrol ba'i ded dpon rin chen zla ba yi/ /thugs rje ྾/ dge bsnyen ྾/ mu med ྾/ sgrol ba'i ded dpon gser bzang dri ma med/ /thugs rje ྾/ dge bsnyen ྾/mu med ྾/ sgrol ba'i ded pon mya ngan med pa'i mchog /thugs rje ྾/ dge bsnyen ྾/ mu med ྾/sgrol ba'i ded dpon chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs/ /thugs rje ྾/ dge bsnyen ྾/ mu med ྾/sgrol ba'i ded dpon mngon par mkhyen pa rgyal/ /thugs rje ྾/ dge bsnyen ྾/ mu med ྾/ sgrol ba'i ded dpon bcom ldan sman gyi bla/ /thugs rje ྾/ dge bsnyen ming 'dzin dus kyi chos nyid can/ /mu med 'khor ba'i slong du yongs chud las/ /sgrol ba'i ded dpon don kun grub pa'i dpal/ /thugs rje nyer bskul mthu dpung bskyed du gsol/ /zhes khang gsar dge bsnyen gyi don du bde bar gshegs pa brgyad kyi sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos do dam byas nas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /bde dgyes gshin rje gshed sogs dkyil 'khor lha/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor legs bzhengs nas/ /bdud rtsi'i bum pas mgon khyod srid mtha'i bar/ /mi 'gyur 'chi ba med pa'i dbang bskur(151ba tshe nig /rin cen rnam gsum kun 'dus bsod nams zhing / /mchog tu sku tshe g.yung drung rang bzhin du/ /dbang phyug lhun gyis grub pas seng ge'i khrir/ /rab brtan zab rgyas chos 'khor skor bar bskul/ /gur mgon stobs 'phrog dbang po rnam thos sras/ /dpal ldan ma dang pu tra beg tse sogs/ /rdo rje'i chos skyong srung mas zhi rgyas dang / /dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod/ /ces khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po rin chen bsod nams mchog grub brtan par bzhugs pa'i tshigs —205

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenasu bcad pa 'di ni za hor gyi bzhes dang ba'i yid kyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /gang gi mtshan snyan thos pa'i mod la lha chen nyi bu'i pho nya rnams/ /legs nyes yongs gsal me long 'dzin pa'i ngal khur btang nas ci bder gnyid/ /stug por g.yur mdzad nub phyogs bde ba can zhing mgon po 'od mtha' yas/ /pad+ma rā ga'i bum bzang las 'ongs bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis tshim par mdzod/ /chos rnams yongs ye spros pa'i mtshan bral 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang nyid nas/ /kun rdzob rgyu 'bras nges par mi bslu rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i mthus/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi lcags khams ma lus gzhom med srog gi gser bsgyur bar/ /smon pa'i re ba ji bzhin skongs shig sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun tshogs/ /dus gsum bde gshegs gaṅgā'i rdul snyed 'gro la rjes su nyer brtse yang / /bdag sogs ma rig 'thug pos yongs bsgribs mngon sum mthong ba'i skal phra bar/ /rgyal kun thugs rje bshes gnyen gzugs kyis gdul bya'i mig ngor rab (152na〉bsgyur phyir/ /gsol ba'i re 'bras don grub ched du rdo rje khri la rtag brtan shog /legs byas phung por spungs pa'i ri bo sa la rgyu ba'i shugs chen pos/ /'jig rten gsum po rang byan byed pa'i mi yi bdag po'i grib bsil du/ /'bangs rnams rdzogs ldan lta bur spyod pa phan dang bde ba'i rtsi sman gyi/ /ljon pa'i shing gi yal ga rab rgyas phun tshogs 'bras bu dus smin 3|ga /chos grags rigs gzhung gtso bor gyur pa'i mtha' klas bka' dang dgongs 'grel la/ /mang du thos shing de don legs bsams lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum ldan pa'i/ /nyi zla'i 'od kyis mun pa sel bar chos srid ma lus dar rgyas pa/ /'dus pa'i gling gyur smon pa lha dang drang srong tshogs kyis grub par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang thos bsam dar rgyas gling spyi sos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rnam snang thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis/ /tshe ring bsam grub ngan song las/ /drangs te mngon —206

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)mtho nges legs sar/ /bkod nas don gnyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang che chen dbon pos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes bris/ /su sti bra dzā saḥ phun tshogs blo gros bum par 'khyil ba'i bcud/ /skal bzang gdul byar snol mdzad bshes gnyen mchog /tshe dang ye shes dpag med mgon po bzhin/ /rdo rje'i khri la g.yo ba med par shog /blo bzang grags snyan 'bar ba'i bstan srung che/ /ye shes mgon po las kyi gshin rje yis/ /mgon khyod skye rgu'i legs byas rab spel ba/ /zhing du sku tshe g.yung drung lta bur mdzod/ /ji ltar (152ba tshe spron lam legs btab dpag bsam gyi/ /ljon pa dar la babs pa'i grib bsil du/ /bdag sogs ring por phan bde la spyod bde/ /re ba'i 'bras bu yongs su smin par shog /ces sprul sku rin po che blo bzang ye shes kyi brtan bzhugs 'di ni shes rab bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /phun tshogs dge 'dun rnams kyi bzhed pa'i don/ /grub mdzad yongs 'dzin dam par gsol 'debs na/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i mgon du bskal brgya'i bar/ /rdo rje lta bur brtan par bzhugasagyur cig /sku skye blo bzang 'phrin las kyi ngor za hor gyi brnyes bris/ /'khor 'das chos kun ye nas ro gcig dbyings/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /bcu gcig zhal ldan nam mkha' rgyal po yi/ /ngo bor gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /bzod dka' ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal me/ /spyi blugs bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis rab bcil cing bde 'gror rlom yang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal rnams/ /thugs rje'i phyag gis bsal nas dbugs dbyung gsol/ /brgya phrag lus kyis phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /sdig lhung kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor bskor cing bskal brgyar rdo rje'i khrir/ /mya ngan mi 'da' brtan par bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /lha dang bla ma gnyis su med pa'i sku/ /'jig rten dbang phyug rnam par yongs shar ba/ /mthong bas don ldan snod bcud ma lus pa/ /rten dang brten pa'i rnam par 'char bar shog /khyod —207

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedagasung yi ge drug pa'i sgra dbyangs su/ /thos pas srid zhi'i 'jigs(153na〉pas rnam grol te/ /snyan dang mi snyan grag stong skye ba med/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i gdangs su bsgrag par shog /bde stong zung du 'jug pa gang gi thugs/ /dran pas chos rnams gdod nas nyer stongs pa/ /blo 'das rang sems thugs rje chen po sto /nges rnyed tshe 'dir grol bar byin gyis rlomes/ /nya stong brgyad gsum dge ba'i tsho gis gso zhing / /sdig sgrib legs sbyong yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims/ /tshul bzhin bsrungs bas yang srid mtha' dag tu/ /lha mi'i lus thob chos dang mjal bar shog /mngon mtho'i rten la sdig spong dge ba'i tshogs/ /sgrub pa'i gru rdzings la brten 'khor ba yi/ /rgya mtsho las bsgral thar pa rin chen gling / /mya ga 'das pa'i grong du 'jug par shog /sangs rgyas dngos byon lta bu'i jo shāka sogs/ /ye shes sems dpa' bzhugs pa'i snang brnyan la/ /gdung shugs drag po phyag dang skor ba rnams/ /byas 'bras thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs par shog /me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab dang/ /na bza' lda ldi phye ma phur ma'i tshogs/ /sri zhur bgyis mthus 'di dang phyi ma kun/ / lha mi'i bde skyid dpal la longs spyod shog /dge 'dun mchod cing dbul 'phongs sbyin pa gtong / / pha ma nyam thag nad par rim gro sogs/ /mdor na bsod nams bsags rnams rang don tsam/ /ma yin 'gro kun sangs rgyas 'thob rgyur bsngo/ /deng nas bla ma phyag na pad+ma gnyis/ /gcig pu nyid las du ma'i gar bzhin du/ /dbyer med gsol ba btab pas gru 'dzin du/ /skyes nas theg chen chos la spyod par shog /rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje'i byin rlabs (153brkong / /lha dang drang srong bden tshig grub pa'i mthus/ /bstan dza dar zhing sems can bde skyid ldan/ /phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu bkra shis shog /ces rang gang mos kyi bla ma spyan ras gzigs dang ngo bo dbyer med du gsol 'debs yan lag bdun pa dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs smon lam shis brjod dang bcas pa 'di ni 'phrul snang bsnyen gnas ma spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /—208

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)'phags bod paṇa grub dag las dbang mu chu'i rgyun//blo gros skal bzang rgya mtshor rab 'khyil bas//yid srubs dpung la 'jigs med go cha can//thub bstan 'ang tsho'i sdel gsol ba 'debs//he ru gaḥdangos dam pa'i bden tshig dang //rdo rje'i srung mang bka' bsgos nus mthu yis//mgon khyod 'og min zhing gi gtso bo ltar//'khor ba ma stongs bar du brtan par shog/pang nas skyes dang nye rgyal ji bzhin du/grub mtha' snyogs min de srid mi 'bral bar//yang dag bshes mdzad dge legs phun tshogs la//sbyor ba'i mdza' grogs dam par 'gyur bar shog/'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi gdung brgyud dri bral ba//skye rgu'i ma rdzo sdong wo du mi ho cing //rdo rje lang dngos bla 0 sa skya pa'i//mdo sngags bstan pa srid mthar rgyas par shog/khyad par gsung ngag gser chos bcu bzhi dang //mgon po che chung man ngag snyan nas snyan//legs brgyud slob bu mchog la bshad bya kun//mtho ris chu bo'i rgyun bzhin ho med shog/bde dgyes yang phur yi dam dkyil 'khor lha//gur mgon lha chen gdong bzhi las mkhan bcas//chos srung rnams kyis154na 〉 thun las ma lus pa//bsams pa ji bzhin lhun rgyas grub par mdzod/khams gsum brtan pa 'phrog mdzad rigs byed ma//stobs ldan glang po'i gdong pa tshogs kyi bdag/'dod pa'i rgyal pos srid zhi'i dge legs kun//dbang sdus bkra shis dpal gyis khyab par shog/ces gsol 'debs ring 'tsho'i bden brjod byang chub bar du mi 'bral zhing bstan pa rgyas pa'i tshigs bcad 'di lta bu zhig rtsoms zhes/bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya ba 'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi gdung las 'khrungs shing dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid yab rje ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang de sras khri chen kun dga' bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po yab sras kyis bka' stsal pa dang du blangs te zla hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o//rgyal kun 'dus pa rnga yab gling pa yis//rjes bzung gan jag thang ta sprul pa'i gar//pradzha ra smis spyan drangs zab gter las//lag na pad+ma ༷ khro bsgrubs pa'i mthus//spyi dang bye brag thub

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhinabastan de 'dzin rgyas/ /'gro rnams rdzogs ldan dus kyi ring po'i tshe/ /legs bris dga' ston gnod sbyin longs spyod tshogs/ /bde zhing skyid pa'i dpal gyis rtag 'tshor shog /yang sgos swā la'i ljongasa'adir 'thab rtsod g.yul/ /nad rims dbul phongs bskyed pa'i 'byung po'i gdon/ /gangs can 'gro snying zhugs pa' brlang spyod sogs/ /dgra bgegs de 'bras bcas pa zhi bar shog /khyad par lnga bde'i mthu yis sngon dus nas/ /smon lam log dang slo bur dam sri'i 'phrul/ /'jig rten phung (154ba)bar byed pa'i mun pa'i rum/ /byin rlabs rta bdun dbang pos sangs par shog /lho byang stod smad phyogs mtshams nas langs te/ /lus can mnar nus dmag dang rjesangs 'dre'i/ /nyer 'tshe na bun dengs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /bde skyid nyi zla zung 'brel 'char bar shog /theg mchog dpal gyi ri bo'i rtse mo nas/ /sgrub pa'i 'dus sdes rab mtshon zab chos 'di/ /nyams su len no cog gi bsod nams las/ /srid zhi'i 'dun ma'i 'bras bu yongs smin shog /dpal ldan rdo rje gshog rgod ma la sogs/ /zab gter bstan skyong tshogs kyis srung skyob cing / /rtsa gsum drang srong lha dang rigs 'dzin gyi/ /bden pas dus kun dge ba'i bkra shis shog /sprul pa'i gter ston rgyal sras shes rab 'od zer gyi gter byon thugs rje chen po pad+ma'i dbang phyug dang / rta mgrin dregs pa kun 'dul gnyis kyi 'phrin las bod 'bangs bde thabs kyi lung bstan dang bstun dpal ri sgrub sder 'dzugs pa'i bkod pa bgyis skabs tshigs bcad 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes mkhar chen bza'i sprul par rigs 'dzin srog sgrub dang / rigs 'dzin thugs tig gnyis kyi lung zin sprul sku ngag dbang pad+ma 'phrin las kyis ched du bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos pad+ma thod 'phreng gis/ /thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od zer rab sbar nas/ / mnga' bdag bstan pa 'dzin pa'i chos kyi dbang / /mkha' khyab 'gro 'dren bzhed pa 'grub gyur cig /snga 'gyur spyi dang khyad par nyang ral gyi/ /zab gter smin grol gdams pa'i nam mkha' mdzod/ /skal —210

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bzang gdul (155na)byar slar yang chad med du/ /rjes 'jug slob bu'i tsho gos kyis spel nus shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha/ /dpal mgon 'bar ba dregs pa'i sde dpon sogs/ /bstan skyong gter srung rgya mtshos bsam pa yi/ /re ba ji bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces mnga' bdag gdung brgyud tha ma chos rje bstan 'dzin chos dbang gi dgongs pa rdzogs shing chos rgyun mi chad pa'i bden brjod kyi smon lam 'di ni spang ston ngag dbang chos rgyal gtso bor gyur pa'i bu slob rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun dbang ngo / /bla med khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngor/ /yongs bltas yi ge brgya pa'i sgom bzlas kyis//sngon bsags sdig lhung dri ma yod do cog /mun khungs sgron me bteg ltar sangs par shog /snying nas sdig bshags dge tshogs spyad pa'i mthus/ /ngan 'gro'i gnas su nam yang mi skye zhid / /dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i mi yi lus/ /thob nas dam pa'i mgon gyis bzung bar shog /gsang sngags theg pa mchog gi lam zab mo/ /nyams su blangs pas srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /brgal te bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ /brnyes nas rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di yang saskyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyi zhal 'don du dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes bkod/ /dang pa'i rdzing bur rgyal kun 'dus pa'i zla/ /mtshan dpe'i cha gang ngag dbang blo (155brdzi gter/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'phrin las rlabs kyi phreng / /yol med thub bstan rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog gsum byin rlabs rdo rje rtse brgya pas/ /nyi bu lha min modang ngas cha ba'i mngal/ /nyer lhungs rab brtan sa srungs khri steng du/ /'gro ba'i dpung gnyen dam par g.yo med shog /mi yi bdag po mnga' 'bangs bcas pa la/ /rgud pa zug rngu'i tsher ma drungs phyungs te/ /tshe dpal stobasa'abyor rdzogs ldan dus kyi mi'i/ /bgo skal mnyam por nyams su myong bar shog /gsol 'debasabartan sdod dpon po sde dmangs dang bcas pa dar ba'i smon lam zhig dgos zhes bkra shis sgo mangs —2/1—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenakyi dbu mdzad al dar dka' bcus bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/bla dpon che dgu gang la'ang phul chog pa'i brtan bzhugs kyi yi ge thugs rje myur 'jug /swasti pra dzā saḥ mas/na khyod mkhyen pa'i me long gtsang ma'i ngos/ /rgyal kun yon tan gzugs brnyan rtag 'char ba/ /blo ldan skal bzang dpyid gyur grags pa'i sgras/ /yongs khyab 'jam dbyangs bla ma gtsug na mdzes/ /bslu med mchog gsum dpang du legs bzhugs par/ /dad pas gsol gdab bden pa'i tshig brjod dang / /phun tshogs rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i sgo/ /'grig pa'i rgyu las 'bras bu nges par smin//de phyir dge ba'i bshes dang mi bdag sogs/ /rang nyid mos yul gyur to cog rnams la/ /brten nas legs byas phung po mtho ris chab/ /'bebs(156na)byed skal ldan shing rta 'di na'o/ /de la 'dir mchod bkur gyi yul du gyur pa'i che rgu rnams g.yung drung gi rang bzhin du brtan par bya ba'i ched du phun tshogs rten 'brel gyi sgo brgya 'byed pa'i brjod don khrigs rim du bkod pa la/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum gyis skyabs sems sngon du btang ste rang nyid ji ltar 'dod pa'i don bsgrub pa'i ched du sa gzhi byin gyis brlab cing gsol gdab dpang po'i yul gyi tshogs spyan drang ba ni/ thams cad du ni sa gzhi dag /gseg ma la sogs med pa dang / / lag mthil ltar mnyam be+e ḍūrla'i/ /rang bzhin 'jam por gnas gyur cig /ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sdodapung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad la/ /dngos rnams ma lus yang dag mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /shākya seng ge gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rnam 'dren yod do cog /khyad par snyigs ma'i dus 'dir thugs rje'i mthu/ /lhag par che ba'i bcom ldan sman gyi bla/ /bde bar gshegs pa mched bdun ྾/ ma pham 'jam dpal dbyangs sogs rgyal ba'i sras/ /tsho gos spyod bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas/ /'od srungs ma ga zung gis mtshon nyan thos sde/ /theg gsum skye 'phags gnas 'dir ྾/ 'gro ba'i mgon po shākya seng ge yis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gang gi phyag —212

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)tu bzhag /gsung rab rin ོ sgrom gyi kha 'byed pa/ /chos stong dgra bcom wo po bzhugs(156ba)so 'tshal/ /dam chos spel ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis ma/ thub pasabaka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /yan lag 'byung dang ma pham nags na gnas// dusaldan rdo rje mo'i bu bzang po dang / /gser be'u bha ra dh+wa dza gser can mchog /'phags pa ba ku la dang sgra gcan 'dzin/ /lam phran bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len/ /lam bstan klu'i sde sbed byed mi phyed pa/ /'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir ྾/ chos sku zhi ba'i mkha' la g.yo med kyang / /las bzhi 'phrin las dbang gzhu ltar bkra ba/ /dpal ldan ye shes mgon po lcam dral sogs/ /chos stong bstan srung 'khor bcas ྾/ tshig la dbang zhing dmod pa mthu btsan pa/ /lha dang rig 'dzin drang srong grub pa'i tshogs/ /deng 'dir bden brjod smon pa'i re skong bar/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis thogasamed 'dir ྾/ spyan drang ba'i lha tsho gos rnams la mchod yon dbul zhing bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdo phral mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan 'khor bcas bzhugs/ khrus khang bskyed cing sku khrus gso le ba ni/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ka (157na tha yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'od chags bla bre bres pa der/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrusagasol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gso le/ /de dag sku la mtshungasapa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /sems can lusang ga yid gsum dri ma sbyang slad du/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ /sems can lusang ga yid gsum dri ma dag gyur cig /de dag sku la ྾/khyed sku rang bzhin yongs dag pas/ /sred sogs chang ba mi mnga' yang / /bdag cag sgrib pa sbyang —213

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ yodaslad du/ /gtsang ma chab kyis sku khrus gsol/ /de dag sku la ྾/ de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /de dag sku la ྾/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas/ / dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad cing / /rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa/ khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /de dag sku la ྾/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /de dag sku la ྾/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi/ /dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi (157ba〉dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi/ /sna tsho gos dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing / /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir dbul/ /bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan phyir/ /rgyan g.yin dag gis brgyan pa mi 'tshal yang / /rin chen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro ba kun/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku lus thob par shog /brtse ba'i khor yug snyan pa'i ba dan can/ /ting 'dzin bla bre spobs pa'i 'od gsal ba/ /mchog rkyen 'os pa'i nyer mkho 'di dag dbul/ /skye bos rnam dag ye shes thob par shog /rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis bum pa 'di/ /sna tshogs bcud kyis bkang ste phul ba yis/ /las dang nyon mongs dri ma kun byang nas/ /byang chub sems kyi rlan gyis brlan par shog /skyabs yul rnams la yan lag bdun gyi sgo nas tshogs gsog pa ni/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun/ /bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la/ /lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o/ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du/ /zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis/ /rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag(158na)/de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa/ /thams cad —214

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (24)rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos/ /de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon to rab brjod cing / /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod/ /me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang / /sil snyan rnams dang byug pa bdug mchog dang / /mar me mchog dag bdug spos dam pa yis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang / /phye ma phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang / /bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ / mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba/ /de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos/ /bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mchod rdzas las grub pa'i/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mchod yon rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas la/ /dad pa rgya mtshos 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /rgyal ba ྾/ zhing khams rgya mtsho'i zhabs bsil rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /yon tan ྾/ dad pa ྾/ rgyal ba ྾/ zhing khams rgya mtsho'i me tog rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /yon tan ྾/ dad pa ྾/ rgyal ba ྾/ zhing khams rgya mtsho'i bdug spos rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /yon tan ྾/ dad pa ྾/ rgyal ba ྾/ zhing khams rgya mtsho'i (158bskong gsal rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /yon tan ྾/ dad pa ྾/ rgyal ba ྾/ zhing khams rgya mtsho'i dri chab rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ / yon tan ྾/ dad pa ྾/ rgyal ba ྾/ zhing khams rgya mtsho'i zhal zas rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /yon tan ྾/ dad pa ྾/ rgyal ba ྾/ zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rol mo rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /yon tan ྾/ dad pa ྾/ e ma ho mchod pa bla na med/ /rang byung mchod pa wo po ste/ /gzugs kyi lha mo me long 'dzin/ / gzugs kyi mchod pa spyan la dbul/ /e ma ho ྾/ rang byung ྾/sgra yi lha mo pi waṃ sgrog /sgra yi mchod pa snyan la dbul/ /e ma ho ྾/ rang byung ྾/ dri yi lha mo dung chos 'dzin/ /dri yi mchod pa shangs la dbul/ /e ma ho ྾/rang byung ྾/ ro yi lha mo bsgos bzang 'dzin/ /ro yi mchod pa ljags la 'bul/ /e ma hor/ rang byung ྾/ reg bya'i lha mo na bza' 'dzin/ /reg bya'i mchod pa sku la dbul/ /zhing 'di 'bor lo rin —215

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenachen gyis/ /mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste/ /dngos grub 'dod pa sbyin pa'i phyir/ /nyin re shes rab can gyis dbul/ /zhing 'di nor ྾/ mkhas pa ྾/ dngos grub ྾/ nyin re ྾/ zhing 'di btsun mo ྾/ mkhas pa ྾/ dngos grub ྾/ nyin re ྾/ zhing 'di blon po ྾/ mkhas pa ྾/dngos grub ྾/ nyin re ྾/ zhing 'di glang po ྾/ mkhas pa za/ dngos grubasko/ nyin res/ zhing 'di rta mchog ྾/ mkhas pa ྾/ dngos grub ྾/ nyin re ྾/ zhing 'di dmag dpon ྾/ mkhas pa ྾/ dngos grub ྾/ nyin re ྾/ de las gzhan (159na〉nga mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ongs ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa'i/ /sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang / /mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la/ /rin cen me tog la sogs char/ khyun mi chad par 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas/ /rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs/ /mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod/ /yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshosabastod/ /bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la/ /nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig /sa gzhi spos kyisabyugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ / sangs rgyas zhing du dmigasate phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gus pas khyed la dbul bar bgyi/ /kun nas gzigs pa'i spyan ldan pa/ /yon gnas dam pa khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag la brtse bas nyer dgongs nas/ / bdag gi 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug dbang gis ni/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid skyes kyang / /sdig pa bdag gis (159ba) bgyis pa ci mchis pa /de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/ /rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang / /'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang / /de dag —216

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang / /gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma dag /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes/ /mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la/ /chos 'khor bla na med pa skor bar bskul/ /mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la/ /'gro ba kun la phan cing bde ba'i phyir/ /bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang / /bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing khrig gas pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /zhes pa sngon du btang nas/ /dngos gzhi brtan bzhugs 'bul ba'i yul la brtan par bzhugs pa'i gsol gdab kyi ched du maṇ+ḍal ni/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing / 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmosapa'i lo tog (160na)'khor lo rin po che/ bas mo rin po che/ blon po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg mo/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ me tog ma/ bdug spos ma/ snang gsal ma/ dri chab ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di dag bla ma 'am sbyin bdag che ge mo zhabs pad bskal brgya'i bar du brtan par bzhugs pa'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhesanas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ thos pa rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun nas 'khyil/ /yon tan me tog tshul khrims bdug spos sprin/ shes rab sgron me dad pa spos chu'i mtsho/ /ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i zhal zas dam pa dang / /bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sil snyan sgra 'byin cing / /kun nas snying brtse rnam dpyod spobs pa yi/ /—217

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedagadugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgrengs byas pas/ /bdag lus gzhal med khang brtsegs rab brgyan nas/ /snying dbus chu skyes thig le 'dab rgyas la/ /brtan par bzhugs pa' chos rje mchod byed cing / /nges par 'dun pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /'gro ba'i bla ma rtag tu mnyes gyur cig /chos kyi rgyal po rtag tu mnyes gyur (160bcug /bla ma spyi la bstod pa ni/ ma ro ne mtho ngesalegs legs tsho gos ma lus pa/ /gang gi zhabs pad kho nar rag las zhes/ /rgyal bas mdo rgyud kun las cher bsngags pa/ /bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ /thog med dus nas mi khoms gnas brgyad 'khyams/ /da lan gcig pu dal ba rnyed dus 'dir/ /don ldan snying po len pa'i thabs ston pa/ /bla ma rin po che la ྾/ las ga mi dge sdig pa'i rlung shugs kyis/ /bzod dka' ngan 'gro'i g.yang du mngon phyogs tshe/ /thugs rje'i phyag gis nye bar 'dzin mdzad pa/ / bla ma rin po che ྾/ sdug bsngal gsum gyi rlabs phreng g.yo ba can/ /'jigs rung 'khor ba chu srin 'byung gnas las/ /'gro kun thabs mkhas gru yis sgrol mdzad pa/ /bla ma rin po che ྾/ rang nyid gcesapar 'dzin pa'i gdon gyis bzung / /rnam mang zug rngus nyam thag gyur pa'i tshe/ /byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gso mdzad pa/ /bla ma rin po cha ྾/myang 'das dman pa'i mya ngam thang la 'khyams/ /nyes brgya srid pa'i chom rkun gyis bcom rnams/ /phyin drug lam bzang mchog tu 'khrid mdzad pa/ /bla ma rin po che ྾/ phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal ba ma lus pa/ /skal dman snyigs dus skye bo 'dul ba'i phyir/ /thabs la mkhas pas bshes gnyen tshul 'dzin pa/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus khyod la mo/dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bye ba phrag brgya yang / khyod thugs lhan skyes ngang du ro gcig cing / /dngosagrub rnam gnyis 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs pa/ /yi dam (161na tshe/na 'dus khyod la ྾/ dran pa tsam gyis bar chad ma lus sel/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub mdzad cing / /mthu ldan ye shes srung ma kun gyi dngos/ /chos skyong kun 'dus khyod la ྾/ sku gnyis mngon gyur yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ kha de na gnyis zung 'jug dam chos kun gyi mdzod/ /rig grol gnyis ldan 'phags—218

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)tshogs kun gyi rje/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus khyod la ྾/ de ltar zhing gi dam pa bla ma la/ /zhing rdul mnyam pa'i lus kyis phyog 'tshal zhing / /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin dang / /bla med sgrub pa'i mchod pas rtag tu mchod/ /thog med dus nas dug gsum nyon mongs kyis/ /sgo gsum sbags pa'i nyes lhung thams cad bshags/ /'khor 'das kun gyi dge la yi rang zhing / /zab yangs chos 'khor rtag tu bskor du gsol/ /lus can kun gyi phan bde ma lus pa/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la rag las de yang ni/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams la rag las phyir/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag tu bzhugs su gsol/ /skye 'chi spangs pa rdo rje'i sku brnyes kyang / /gdul bya'i don du skye 'chi sna tshogasapa/ /ston mdzad phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs bla ma rnams/ /'khor ba ma stongs bar du bzhugs su gsol/ /rnam dag mi byed dad pa rdo rje'i gdan/ /lhag bsam rnam par dkar ba zla ba'i gdan/ /shugs drag smon lam pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la/ /srid mtha'i bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyod (161ba〉spyo mig gi bdud rtsir mi 'bral zhing / /theg mchog gsung gis rtag tu 'tsho ba dang / /sku gsung thugs kyis nges par byin brlabs nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /skyabs mgon bla ma rnams kyi bka' drin las/ /'gal rkyen bdud sde'i bar chad kun las rgyal/ /gnas skabs mthar thug bsams pa'i don kun 'grub/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /ces dang / bla ma sgos kyi gsol 'debs bya bar 'dod na skabs dang bstun/ sku tshe spel ba'i rten 'brel du tshe dpag med la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ nyi gan 'char ga'i gdangs ldan li khri ltar/ /yid 'ong dmar ser dra bas khebs pa yi/ /'dab stong ge sar rtse na zla gdan la/ /hrīḥlas byung ba'i mgon po tshe dpag med/ /pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po dbang po'i gzhus/ /kun nas klubs pa ji bzhin khyod kyi sku/ /sna tshogs gos dang nor bu'i rgyan mang gis/ /kun nas mdzes par byas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khri shing gzhon nu'i yal gdab ltar mnyen pa'i/ /phyag gnyis dbus na 'chi med bdud rtsi yis/ /legs par gang ba'i lhung bzed rab bsnams nas/ /tshe yi dngos grub stsol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bung —219

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su yod pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenab ltar gnag ral pa'i thor cog ni//spyi bor mdzes pa'i lan bu ring du lung //'jam mnyen sna tshogs dar gyi smad g.yogs can//mtshan dpe'i gzi brjid 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo/khugs drag dad pas bskyod pa'i thal sbyar zhing //yid 'phrog shin tu snyan pa'i nga 162na kho yis/khyod kyisayon tan legs par brjod pa la//legs tshogs thams cad stsol la phyag 'tshal lo//ye shesamatshon gyis mi shes dra ba bcad//sems can kun la thugs rje rgyun chad med//'gro kun 'dren pa'i khur gyis mi ngal ba//gto gyi skyabs gnas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//mtshan tsam bzung bas dus min 'chi ba 'joms//yid la dran pas srid pa'i 'jigs las skyob//skyabs su bsten na gto gyi bde ster ba/khyod la rnam pa kun tu phyag 'tshal lo//skyon bral khyod la gus pas bsten pa bdag/gnas skabs mi 'dod nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang //mthar thug bde ba can du pad+mo las/kha rdzus te skyesanas khyod mnyes bgyid par shog/theg pa gsum gyi dge 'dun spyir gsol ba btab ste rten 'brel bsgrigs pa ni/mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa//thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po//bsod namasayon to rgya mtsho'i zhing //de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo//mi 'gyur brtan par byin gyis rlobs//dag pas 'dod chags bral bar gyur//dge bsag song las grol cing //gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa/ /zhi gyur chos la ྾/ mi 'gyur ྾/ grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gnas//zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan//tshogs mchogo dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/mtshungs med lta bas mi ngoms shing //gser gyi 162ba ) mdog can mdzes pa'i sku//zhal gcig phyag gnyis skyil krung bzhugs//sa gnon mnyam gzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/dus gsum sangs rgyas tshogos spyi dang /khyad par snyigs ma lnga bdo yi//'dren pa bcom ldan sman gyi bla//bde gshegs mched bdun la phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/nye ba'i sras chen la sogs pa'i//byang chub sems dpa' ma lus dang //rang rgyal nyam thos skye 'phags kyi//theg gsum dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/༷༷sa ri chen po te se la//'phags pa gnas brtan

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)yan lag khrung //dgra bcom stong dang sum brgyas bskor//spos phor rnga yab 'dzin phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/drang srong ri yi ngos shel na//'phags pa gnas brtan ma pham pa//dgra bcom brgya phrag gcig gis bskor//phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/lo ma bdun pa'i ri phug na//'phags pa gnas brtan nags na gnas//dgra bcom stong dang bzhi brgyas bskor//sdigs mdzub rnga yab 'dzin phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/'dzam bu gling gi zangs gling na//'phags pa gnas brtan dus ldan ni//dgra bcom stong dang bzhi brgyas bskor//gser gyi rna kor 'dzin phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/siṅga la yi gling na ni//gnas brtan rdo rje mo yi bu//dgra bcom stong phrag gcig gis bskor//sdigs mdzub rnga yab 'dzin phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/chu bo 163na)ya mu na'i gling na//'phags pa gnas brtan bzang po ni//dgra bcom stong dang nyis brgyas bskor//chos 'chad mnyam gzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/gnas mchag dam pa kha che na//'phagasapa gnas brtan gser belā/dgra bcom wo po lnga brgyas bskor//rin wo zhags pa 'dzin phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/nub kyi ba lang spyod gling na//bha ra dh+wa dza gser can ni//dgra bcom wo po bdun brgyas bskor//phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/byang gi sgra mi snyan na ni//'phags pa gnas brtan ba ku la//dgra bcom wo po dgu brgyas bskor//phyag gnyis ne'u le 'dzin phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/pri ya du yi gling na ni//'phags pa gnas brtan sgra gcan 'dzin//dgra bcom stong dang tshig brgyas bskor//rin wo brog zhu 'dzin phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/bya rgod phung po'i ri bo la//'phags pa gnas brtan lam phran bstan//dgra bcom stong dang drug brgyas bskor//phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur mo/shar gyi lus 'phagasagling na ni//bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len//dgra bcom stong phrag tsog gis bskor//glegs bam lhung bzed 'dzin phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/lha gnas sum cu rtsa gsum na//'phags pa gnas brtan lam bstan ni//dgra bcom wo po dgu ༷/sa bskor//glegs bam chos 'chad mdzad phyag

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhena'atshal//mi 'gyur ྾/ 163ba ) ri yi rgyal po ngos yangs la//'phags pa gnas brtan klu yi sde//dgra bcom stong dang nyis brgyas bskor//bum pa 'khar gsil 'dzin phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/ri yi rgyal po bi hu la//'phags pa gnas brtan sped byed ni//dgra bcom stong dang bzhi brgyasabaskor//phyag gnyis glegs bam 'dzin phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/gangs can ri yi rgyal po la//'phags pa gnas brtan mi phyed pa//dgra bcom stong phrag gcig gis bskor//byang chub mchod rten 'dzin phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/ dge bsnyen dharmā ta la ni/ /ral pa'i thod bcings glegs bam khur//snang ba mtha' yas mdun gnas shing //rnga yab bum pa 'dzin phyag 'tshal//mi 'gyur ྾/yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po//spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras//rang rang 'khor 'dul sgo bzhi bsrung //rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo//mi 'gyur ྾/phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la//zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi//lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu//mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo//mi 'gyur ྾/bden brjod smon lam dngos ni//sangs rgyas sras slob mngon sum mthong ba yi/skal dman 'gro ngor mgon skyabs gling gnyen du//yongs 'dzin dam pa'i zlos gar legs bsgyur ba//nges pa lnga ldan lta bur brtan par shog/mdo dang rgyud sde'i chos kyi bshad yi rgyun//'jigasalas dbugs dbyung zang zing gtong ba sogs//sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa'i//164na ) skyabs mchog bla ma zhabs pad brtan par shog/rang nyid zhi bde bsgrub na dman par gol//gzhan phan khur gyis zhus pa'i theg chen su//de phyir snyigs mar spyod la lhag par du//brtse chen snying stobs bskyed la rtag bzhugs gsol//dag zhing gnas rnams bde ba'i ro yis myos//thugs rje'i dpyad kyis nyes brgya'i zung rngu'i tshogs//'byin yul ma dag gnas 'dir nges legs na//duḥkhas mnar ba'i 'gro la dgongs te bzhugs//'phrog byed sder mos gyen du bteg pa'i khri//rab bkra za 'og 'bol stan brtsegs pa'i steng //sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i re khā la//zhabs sen dmar ba'i 'od chags rtag 'god gsol//rnam rgyal tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo ma'i//thugs22

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gsung sku yi gzi byin legs 'bar bas/ /yid srubs log par gsol 'debs mun sangs nas/ /'chi med gzugs sku'i snang ba ches dkar shog /kun la zhi yang bdud sder rab khros pa/ /legs ldan nag po lcam dral tshogs bcas kyis/ /bgegs rigs mthar bskrad mgon khyod shākya'i bstan//gnas pa de srid bstan pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bar snang lam du lha rnams gom bkod de/ /rtag par bzhugs gsol bden pa'i tshig brjod dang / /lhan cig me tog char 'bebs rol mo'i sgra/ /snyan par 'brol ba'i re ba don ldan shog /klog pa thos bsam spong ba bsam gtan dang / /bya ba las kyi 'khor los gdul bya rnams/ /yang dag lam la bkri phyir tshe mtha' yas/ /ji bzhin bzhugasapar (164ba〉pa chog gsum mthus byin rlobs/ /zhes dang / 'dren pa sras bcas dngos kyis thul min pa'i/ /gdul bya'i skye rgu phan bde la 'god ched/ /bsod nams stobs kyi dpung pas sa chen por/ /dbang sgyur nor 'dzin skyong ba zhabs brtan shog /mi bsrun rtsub mong spyod pa'i glang chen snar//bka' nan rnon po'i lcags kyus rab btab nas/ /dul ba'i ra bar bcug ste sim pa'i ro/ /gser zhun rgyan gyis klubs ched g.yo med shog /lta spyod ngan pas dbyen bcos log lam du/ /'jug las phyir ldog dge bcu'i sa chen por/ /btsan po'i shugs kyis khrid nas mtha' klas 'gro/ /bde bar nyer 'god don du bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /sku gsung thugs rten 'dus pa'i grwa mang spel/ /mdo sngags sde gnyis mchod cing bshad sgrub bstan/ /lus can bsod nams zhing du dar mdzad ched/ /gnam sa'i dbang phyug rdo rje ltar brtan shog /ma rungs brlang por spyod pa'i gnya' ba sa khrims gnyis gser shing gcig tu rab lci bas/ /'bangs rnams rdzogs ldan dpal la 'god bya'i phyir/ /mi bdag sku tshe nyi zla dang mnyam shog /bde ldan mgon po gar dbang phyag sor gyis/ /legs bteg bum pa lha khyod gtsug tor rtser/ /bkod nas 'chi ba med pa'i rang bzhin du/ /dbang bskur rigs kyi cod pan 'ching bar shog /kun gyis yongs bkur g.yung drung 'khyil ba'i khrir/ /sa yi brgya byin bskal brgyar 'tsho gzhes shing / /mnga' thang chab srid phyogs bcur rab rgyas pa/ /dkon mchog —223

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedabaden pa'i mthu yis 'grub gyur cig /ces dge ba'i bshes gnyen (165na skong sa skyong ba'i rigs spyi khyab la 'di ltar du byas nas dmigs bsal gyi ched du bya bar 'dod na bla dpon gyi brtan bzhugs tshigs bcad ci rigs pa sbyor/ mjug bzod par gsol zhing dpang por spyan drangs pa rnams gshegs su gsol ba ni/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmo mes blo yis ni//bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal gang / /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang / /cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang / /bdag gis brjed ngas ci mchis pa/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ khyed kyis sems don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangasargyas yul du gshegs nas kyang /
