/slar yang thugs rjes na par mdzod/ /mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis brtan par bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel 'grig par mdzad pa legs kyi so so'i zhing khams su rdzu snyul gyi 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol lo/ /rten 'brel legs par 'grig pa'i gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dbul/ shis pa brjod pa ni/ rgyal mtshan rtse mor dbang gi rgyal po ltar/ /lhag pa'i lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ /sgrub pa po la dngosagrub mchog stsol ba'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i mdun na rgyal srasabazang po skyong / kha ba can 'dir dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ /dga' ldan gnas na nam mkha' dri ma med/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur gzhan don mdzad/ /dpal ldan a ti sha yi ྾/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yongs kyi mgon/ /rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob (165ba)gyur pa rgyal ba'i sras/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'byung gnas rin po che/ /bshes gnyen ston pa'i zhabs kyi ྾/ dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ /dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ / gangasacan mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan myong kha pa/ /blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs kyi ྾/ rab mas gsung rab kun la lta ba'i mig /skal bzang thar bar bgrod pa'i 'jug ngogs mchog /brtse bas bskyod pa'i thabs mkhas mdzad pa yi/ /gsal mdzad bshes gnyen rnams kyi ྾/ nyin mo bde legs—224

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi ྾/ thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigs su ga spungs/ /gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung bcom pa/ /gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku/ 'i kya'i rgyal po'i dpal gyi ྾/mtshan legs rin chen gser bzang mya ngan med/ /cho so sgrags mngon mkhyen sman bla shākya thub/ /rgya chen smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa brgyad kyi ྾/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms mdzad cing / /mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi /mthun pa'i dge tshogs smon lam med byung zhing / /spyad pa spyod tshe nam yang mched gyur la/ /bskal bzang 'di la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong gi ྾/ gdul bya'i khams dang dbang por 'tsham pa yi/ /thabs mkhas mdzad pa mchog gis 'gro ba rnams/ /phan dang bde (166na)ba'i dpal la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi ྾/ ma pham 'jam dpal dbyangs sogs rgyal ba'i sras/ /tsho gos sbyor brtse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas/ /'od srungs mchog zung gis mtshone nyan thos sde/ /theg gsum skye 'phags tsho gos kyi ྾/ sangs rgyas sprul pa dgra bcom 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /'gro ba'i don du bstan pa skyong mdzad pa/ /dpon mchog gsum dngos gnas brtan bas drug gis/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i ྾/bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga mā /sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gang zag la/ /bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhesapa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma'i ྾/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing / /gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi gtso/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i gnod sbyin sa la/ /dngos grub mchog stsol nor lha'i ྾/ ston pa 'jig rten khams su 'byon pa dang / /bstan pa nyi 'od bzhin du gsal ba dang / /bstan 'dzin phu nu bzhin du mthun pa yis/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i ྾/ 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /sde 'dir byin rlabs dpal 'byor mi nyams shing / /bsam sbyor —225

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedangan pa'i gdug rtsub zhi ba dang / /bslab gsum rnam dag bstan pa'i khur 'dzin pa'i/ /dge 'dun tshogs kyis gang ba'i ྾/ bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bus sa steng kun tu khyab/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor pa rgyas/ /(166ba tha stan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /bstan 'bar ma ni/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob/ /'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srungs dang / shwakya thub pa go tam lha yi lha/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la ྾/ sems can don du bdag gis sngon/ /dka' ba gang zhig spyad gyur pa/ /bdag gi bde ba btang ba yis/ /bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig /ngas sngon nad pa'i ched dag tu/ /rang gi 'tsho ba yongs btang bas/ /sems can phongs pa bskyab pa'i phyir/ /yun ring bstan pa 'bar ྾/bu dang bu mo chung ma dang / /nor dang glang chen shing rta dang / /rin chen byang chub phyir btang bas/ /bstan pa ྾/ bdag gis sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas/ /nyan thos pha dang ma dang ni/ /drang srong dag la mchod byas pas/ /bstan pa ྾/ bskal pa bye ba du mar bdag /sdug bsngal sna tsho gos myong gyur cing / /byang chub don du thos btsal bas/ /bstan pa ྾/ bdag gis tshul khrims la zhugs dang / /dka' thub yun ring bsten byas shing / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas ngas mchod pas/ /bstan pa ྾/bdag sngon brtson 'grus dang ldan pas/ /rtag tu brtan cing pha rol gnon/ /sems can thams cad bsgral don du/ /bdag bstan yun ring 'bar ྾/ bzod brtul rtag tu bsten byas shing / /semasacan nyon mongs snyigs ma yi/ /sems can ngan bzod byas gyur pas/ /bstan pa ྾/ bsam gtan rnams thar gzugs med dang lta/ting 'dzin gaṅgā'i bye snyed pa/ /bsgoms pas de mthus bdag gi ni/ /bstan pa ྾/ ye shes don du bdag gis (167na〉sngon/ /dka' thub nags dag bsten byas shing / /bstan bcos du ma nyer bstan pas/ /bdag gi bstan pa 'bar ྾/ brtse ba'i rgyu yi sha khrag dang / /'tsho ba yongs su btang gyur cing / /yan lag nying lag btang ba yis/ /chos tshul rnam par 'phel gyur cig /bdag sngon bsdigs pa'i sems can rnams/ /byams pas gsal bar smin byas —226

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)shing / /theg pa gsum la rab bkod pas/ /chos kyi sbyin pa rgyas gyur cig /bdag sngon thabs shesagyur pa na/ /sems can lta ngan las bsgral cing / /yang dag lta la bkod byas pas/ /chos ni rnam par 'phel gyur cig /bdag gis sems can bsdudangos bzhis/ /nyon mongs me las thar byas shing / /bdag gis 'phel sdig pham byas pas/ /bdag 'khor yun ring gnas gyur cig /bdag gis mu stegs can g.yin dag /lta ba'i chu las bsgral byas te/ /yang dag lta la bkod gyur pas/ /bdag 'bor rtag tu gus gyur cig /yun ring bstan pa 'bar gyur cig /chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa'i/ /chos tshul rnam par 'phel ba la/ /gegs byed mtshan ma zhi ba dang / /mthun rkyen ma lus tshang bar shog /bdag dang gzhan gyi dus gsum dang / /'brel pa'i tsho gos gnyis la brten nas/ /rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa yi/ /bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig /phan bde 'gyung ba'i gnas gcig pu/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / /bstan 'dzin skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /sku tshe'i rgyal mtshan brtan gyur cig /gzhan yang tshigs bcad ci rigs pa bya'o/ /chos sku spros bral 'dus ma byas pa'i khams//longs sku 'khor mtha' de srid 'pho 'gyur 'das/ /spro (167ba tha sdu'i sprul sku rang dbang nyer thob phyir/ /rab brtan rten 'brel bsgrigs bar 'bras smin nges/ /skye rga na 'chi'i ri gzar las 'bab chu/ /gyen bzlog nus min bdag 'dra'i cher rlom tshor/ /tshul 'di mig ngor mdzes pa nam mkha'i 'jar/ / byis pas sbar 'dzin byed pa'i rnam thar bzhin/ /'on te rin wo rnam gsum dpang por byas/ / thugs rje bskul las byin rlabs char rgyun gyis/ /yongs smon sa bon smin pa'i myu gu'i skyed/ /bsrings mthar 'bras bu g.yur du cis mi za/ /smin grol cho ga las sbyor mtshan nyid dang / /mi ldan tshig skam ne'u tsho'i kha ton 'dra/ /de phyir brjod pa a 'dus ka 'phreng can/ /mdo dang 'brel 'di don du 'gyur bar sems/ /bsod nams byas 'dis mngone mtho'i rten bzang po/ /rnyed pa'i skye rgu mtha' dag dus min du/ /lha chen nyi bu'i zhag so pas mi 'dzin par/ /'tsho ba'i re ba yongs su skong bar shog /bla dpon che rgu gang la'ang phul chog pa'i brtan zhugs go rim khrigs su bsgrigs pa zhig —227

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenadagos zhes tshe ring gnam gyi she mong las mang pos bkur ba ching gis kyi rigs las khal kha dad stobs ldan pa rdo rje thu she ye thu rgyal po'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod sangs rgyas phal po che sogs bka' las byung ba/ rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba lha/ cho me kyi rgyal po 'phagasapa/ rgyal ba myong kha pa chen po/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho rnams kyi gsung byin rlabasakyi mthu dpung che bas gtso bor gzung tshig phrad cung zad bsgyur dgos dang spyi'i brtan bzhugs glo ka bcu drug gsar du bsnan (168na)pa'i brtan bzhugs kyi yi ge thugs rje myur 'jug ces pa 'di ni za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos rang byung 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis so/ / 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan zur 'gro kun la/ /rtag par btsa' yang blo bzang chos 'phel bdag /'di snang bde skyid la spyod phyi ma'i tshe/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du 'dren par mdzod/ /ces 'phags pa lo ke shwa rar se chen dbon pos phye phur phul ba'i kha byang smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor brdzes sbyar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas zhal 'dab stong ze'u 'bru'i rtser/ /zhi ba dam chos bung ba'i dbyangs snyan po/ /'dzin mdzad ngo tsha shes pa dge te 'dun/ /dkon mchoge gsum gyi ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /'jigasachen brgyad sogs mi bzad zug rngu yis/ /lus ngag yid la 'tshe ba kun zhi zhing / /sim pa'i tshor ba 'chi med bdag po ltar/ /tshe 'dir nyams su myong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bar dor mi sdug ya nga'i 'khrul pa yi/ /snang ba sna tsho gos shar ba'i rol pa kun/ /rang ngo 'phrod de mngon mtho'i rten bzang po/ /thob pa'i yul du ma nor 'jug byin rlobs/ /yang srid phyi ma rnams su bstan dang mjal/ /thosabasam sgom pa tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa yis/ /ring por mi thogs mi gnas myang 'das sar/ /bgrod nus 'gro ba ma lus sgrol byin rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang 'di phyi bar do gsum du skyob pa'i gsol 'debs shig dgos zhes chen po hor (168ba)gyi rgyal khams nas blo bzang dar rgyas kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /—228—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)mgon por mchod bstod smon lam btab pa'i 'bras/ /bskal bzang mchog gi sprul sku lnga pa sa /gyur tshe bdag sogs 'dus par rab skyes nas/ /dam pa'i chos kyis grol zhing tshim par shog /cesapa 'di yang chos rje dge 'dun dpal 'byor gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i pho brang bkod legs rgyan/ /bzang gos bar snang mdzod kyi ri mo can/ /phul bas bsod nams 'dzad pa med pa'i 'bras/ /byang chen ma thob de srid myong bar shog /e waṃ zung 'jug rigs 'dzin grong khyer gyi/ /mdzes rgyan yal ba kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /ri mo rnam bkra phul bas gnas skabs dang / /mthar thug don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /ces rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i 'du khang du 'gram rgyu'i yol ba gos dmar rgyan bzhi rnam pa bcu drug /gan gos tshoni khra'i gong ba/ 'ja' gos gser ma dmar ser sngo gsum gyis byas pa dang / yang ma gos dmar rgyan bzhi rnam pa bco lnga/ gong ba thon thi 'ja' gos gser ma sum gshibasacan gcig bcas shing yos mchod dpon rgyal dar gong pa ngag dbang shes rab kyis phul ba'i smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa maṅga lo bha / / /dar tshon 'ja' ris dra ba dra phyed kyi/ /gong pa gos sngon rdo rje gsang lam phreng / /rtsa gsum spyan (169na ra phul dge sa mchoge thun gyi/ /dngos grub nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'byed gsal/ /zhesarnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'du khang du mkha' 'gro rnam lnga dgyes bskyed snyan dar gyi gong pa gling bzhi ma mchod dpon rgyal dar gong pa ngag dbang shes rab kyis shing yos phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor byinas bris pa bi tsa tu rkarma ni rā bho ga bha / / /gos sngon rdo rje phreng las nyer brgyus pa/ /dbang gzhu ltar ba po dar tshon lda ldir bcas/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtshor legs phul bas/ /'di phyir dge ba'i bsam don lhun grub mdzod/ /ces ri bo chos gling gi 'du khang du bskang gso'i dus 'gram rgyu'i snyan dar sum brgya skor gong ba gling bzhi ma dang bcas mchod dpon rgyal dar gong pa ngag dbang shes rab kyis shing yos phul ba'i kha byang dgos —229

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung gleg bam dang po/ zhenatshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba sirnyi ra stu/ /bcom ldan tshe mtha' yas pa'i phyag sor gyis/ /legs bteg bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbab bskur pas/ /blo bzang grags pa'i bstan la mi 'jigs pa/ /sbyin pa'i sgo 'phar 'byed khyod zhes brtan shog /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las rdo rje rtse brgya pas/ /rgol ngan bcud bral 'joms dang lhan cig tu/ /rang srid skabs gsum pa rnams phan dang bder/ /spyod pa'i skal ba mngon sum nyams myong shog /ces sa skyong blo bzang sbyin pa'i brtan bzhugs blo ka gcig gnyis tsam zhig dgos zhes chos 'khor rgyal bla spyi thun mong nas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'o/ /(169ba) kā ruṇa 〉 k+ṣa ཿ khra skyo to no 'i re phu da pa tre ཿ bi tsha ྅nya gyu 2 wa thugs rje'i spyan zur dus las yol med du/ /lhungs pa'i mod la srid zhi'i gdung sel ba/ /su rla yi sa dze ta tsa kra ri 'a tsa ཿ rje : te lha ga ma rdo ga ṇa shā sa tu/ /nyi ma'i gnyen phyag 'khor lo'i ri mo can/ /spyi bor zhog la 'gro tshogs dbugs dbyung zhig /nang pa mu stegs kla klo drang srong gi /ston rlom mang yang lha mo bstan ma yis/ /lus phyed 'dzin ma nas thon dpang byas pa'i/ /skyob pa khyod las gzhan na dmigs su med/ /gang gsung gzhen nu nam mkha' mdzes ma dang / /dgyes mgur spyod 'dod gzugs khyan pha mtha'i tshad/ /ma nyams tshangs pasadagu tshigs ska rags kyis/ /'ching ba'i nus bral zag bcas gnyid kyi yur/ /'on te rgyal blon lo paṇa mdzad bzang grus/ /'phags yul chu gter las bsgral gangs ljongs 'dir/ /mdo 'dul (170na〉gar phyogs rgyud sde yid bzhin dbang / /legs drangs bsod nams zhing gi yang rtser son/ /mdo stod lho rong rdzong du sgyu ma'i nor/ /snying med snying po len phyir brgya phrag gi /glegs bam tshar du dngar ba'i mu tig phreng / /'bad rtsol srad bur lan grangs gnyis su brgyus/ /de tshul sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyi/ /rnam dpyod bkod pa khyad par las byung ba/ /rdzong gnyer ngag dbang phun —230

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)tshogs bsam mkhar ba/ /zung gis brtson pa'i byed pos rab tu bsgrubs/ /dkar por 'dzag pa'i rnam smin dngos po la/ /do dam dpon yig bzo rigs kyis mtsho ni pa'i/ /lusang ga yid gsum ngal ba brten pa rnams/ /'di phyi'i mdun ma lhun gyis grub par shog /thub bstan spyi dang khyad par dus gsum gyi/ /rgyal kun 'dus pa ngo bo btsong kha pa'i/ /chos srid ring lugs yongs 'du sa brtol gyi/ /phan bde'i 'bras bu rtag tu myong bar shog /mdo sngags lung gi don la thos bsam sgom/ /gomasanas rtogs pa'i yon tan dkar cha'i zla/ /ji bzhin 'phel ba'i 'dus sdo de 'dzin tshogs/ /rgyas shing srid mtha'i bar du brtan par shog /sa dbang bka' khrims gser shing ches sbom pas/ /mchog dman gnya' ba mnan te nag po'i dpung / /'joms pa'i rdo rje rtse brgya gdengs pa dang / /lhan cig skyid pa'i ba dan sgreng bar shog /nam yang bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /skabs gsum drang srong rig pa 'dzin rnams kyis/ /sa steng khyab pa'i bkra shis me rtag char/ /yongs phob dge tshogasabyang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /(170bsgo skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis zhal bkod mdzad nas mdo stod lho rong rdzong du rdzong sdod rdo pa ngag dbang phun tshogs dang chu shur bsam mkhar ba gnyis kyis do dam byas te bka' 'gyur rin po che tshar gnyis bzhengs pa'i smon lam tshigs bcad dgos zhes ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis yi ge bskur byung ba ltar ba hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rgyal dbang btsong kha pa yi sku brnyan drung / /nyer spyod mchod pa'i sprin phung rab spros pas/ khyu sbyor 'khor cas 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing / /'dod pa'i re ma ma lus skong bar shog /ces pa 'di yang byang gling mchis brang bro 'tshal skabs bsam 'grub rgyal pos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /sgyi yig zhun 'khyil ngag dbang thugs rje'i zla/ /nya rgyas zer gyis blo gros sa mos tshal ba 'ad pa'i skal ba bzang pos rgya chen chos/ /smra la mtsho byung mgrin par 'khyud der 'dud/ /don min sgro tsam btags kyang dus mkhyen rgyal/ /ji bzhin dad mthus brjod pa rnam dag las/ /legs byas rnam —231—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenasmin mkhris can gangs ri ltar/ /dngos myong mthong 'bras ro bdar longs spyod shog /rdzogs ldan skye rgu'i bde gzugs 'di snang gi /rnyog bral rdzing bur 'char dang lhan cig tu/ /mi gnas myang 'dasabargya phrag ri mo'i gar/ /gtan mdun chu gter ngos su gsal bar shog /ces pa'ang bya nag rigasakyi thig le rnam gling paṇa chen dkon mchog chos grags kyis nged rang gi 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i (171na〉sdes sbyar ba sirnyi de/ /ngo mtshar bde ldan zhing khams rgya mtsho yi/ /'dab stong sbubs su rdzus te nyer skyes nas/ /gar dbang mgon po'i zhal mthong dam pa'i chos/ /legs thos sa lam pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /'khor lo tha ma'i yang snying dkon brtsegs las/ /rab bstan sum cu rtsa lnga'i bder gshegs kyi/ /thugasarje'i chab kyis nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs/ /yongs bkrus mngon mtho nges legs sar bgrod shog /sngon nas sgrib gnyis 'ching rgya las grol kyang / /'gro ngor nyan thos tshul gyis rgyal ba'i bstan/ /dar mdzad 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gis/ /mchog dang thun slong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /shing rta che gnyis nas brgyud zab rgyas kyis/ /rnam gsum skyes bu'i lam gyi 'gros ma lus/ /rab spel bshes gnyen mu thi la yi 'phreng / /chad med byon pa'i tsho gos kyis bdag byin rlobs/ /rim par byon dang sprul pa sna tsho gos su/ /bstan las skye ba'i rabs zhes nyer btags nas/ /mos pa rdo ba'i ring bsrel ji bzhin du/ /slu med rgyu las 'bras bu yongs smin shog /ces pa lha sa ba blo bzang dpal 'byor gyis bde ba can gyi zhing bkod/ sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga/ gnas bcu/ lam rim brgyud pa/skyes rabs 'gro la rjes brtse ma rnams bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam grags so/ /zil gnon kun bzang 'jam mgon khro rgyal lam/ /ston mdzad rtsa ba'i bla ma ba 'ad pa (171ba)rtsal/ /rang rig dag pa'i ngo bo dbyer med par/ /mi phyed gdung ba'i yid kyis gso me ba 'debs/ /sngags 'chang blo gros rgyal bas legs byas mthus/ /rdo rje slob dpon bskal pa mtha' klas par/ /—232

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)pad+mā ka ra lta bur 'gyur med du//rab bzhugs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog/snying dbusang nu bum skur rig pa'i rtsal//sgrib bral chos sku rang yos mtho sum du//ngo 'phrod gyur min de srid bla ma lhas//nam yang 'bral ba med par rjes 'dzin shog zhes sngagasang blo gros rgyal bas 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag yang bzlog gi sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam grags pa'o//'dis mtsho ni dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tsho gis kyis//ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde//rab brtan don grub rgya mtsho byang chub bar//rjes bzung ring min rnam mkhyen sar 'god shog/ces pa 'di'ang dga' gdong sngags rams pas nged rang gi 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i tshe dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar//'og min zhing gi mgon po rnam snang mdzad//'khor ba mtha' can de srid g.yo med du//rje btsun bla ma gar gyi dbang phyug sku//bzhengs te bskal bzang gdul bya'i re skong shog/mi 'jigs gdong lngas yongs bteg rin chen khrir//sna tshogs rdo rje'i ri mo rab bkra'i steng //nam yang mi shigs skyil mo krung bcas nas//bgrang yas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol//rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam 172na ) mgon ngag gi lha//dbang phyug brgyad ldan blo bzang grags pa yi//ring lugs rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' yongs khyab phyir//tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhabs brtan shog/mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpal ldan rdzogs sangs rgyas//des gsungs bden pa gnyis ldan dam pa'i chos//rig grol yon tan brgyad ldan dge 'dun te//mchog gsum mthu yis 'dod don lhun grub shog/'dod pa khamasakyi dbang phyug dmag zor ma//bod skyong sman gcig rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong //lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin tsho gis rnams kyis//re gos 'grub pa'i bkra shis dge legs stsol//chos gra chen po dpal gyi rtses dang gi srung ma rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong ngam g.yu sgron mas mnga' ris gra tshang gi gnyer pa 'jam dbyangs dpal 'byor la 'di lta bu bskul nas tshugs shig ces gsungs tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedabarnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /mchog gsum spyan sngar bzang gos 'phan phul ba'i/ /'bras bu 'gro kun byang chub sar brnyes shing / /ro nus zhu rjes sman gyis skye rgu'i srog /nyer 'tsho mes bo'i rnam thar 'dzen par shog /'tsho byed ngag dbang lhag bsam gyis mkhar skyar 'phan phul ba'i tshe kha byang smon lam dgos tshul star za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa'o/ /khrims ldan 'dus pa'i kun dga' ra ba yi/ /gnam rgyan bzang gos las grub yongs bres pas//bdag sogs 'gro rnams srid zhi'i bde ba la/ /'bral (172ba thad spyod pa'i dga' ston myong bar shog /bkra shis rtags mtshan za 'og rgyal mtshan bzhi/ /rgyal sras slob mar bcas la legs phul ba'i/ /dge tshogs mtho ris chu bo zad mi shes/ /byang chen zla ba'i ma mar 'bab gyur cig /mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis ri bo chos gling du bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi ri mo can gyi bzang gos legs pa'i gnam rgyan dang gos 'brug ris ma'i rgyal mtshan bzhi phul ba'i kha byang smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba dza yan+tu/ /ma rig mun sel shes rab mar me yis/ /skye bar rgyal kun mchod nus bsod nams ched/ /rin chen gnyis pa'i kong bu 'di phul bas/ /'gro rnams 'dren pa'i ded dpon myur thob shog /ces pa 'di'ang 'phyong rgyas pa blo bzang chos ldan gyis smon lam chen mor sngags rams pa byas pa'i tshe gra tshang du dngul srang nyer gsum las grub pa'i kong phul ba'i kha byang smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bris pa sirnyi nge/ /dpal gyi ri bo'i dbyibs can gtor ma'i snod/ /dngul dkar zhun ma las grub phul ba'i 'bras/ /skye bar thod 'phreng rtsal gyis rjes bzung nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'grub par shog /rdo pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis gra tshang dge bskos byas pa'i 'jog la dngul srang bco lnga'i pad sder phul ba'i kha byang smon lam dgos tshul bzhin za hor gyi bzhes bris pa shu nga/ /—234

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od stong rab 'bar bas/ /tshes stegs lus can sdug bsngal mthar mdzad pa//rgyal ba sman (173na)gyi bla yis 'di snang spun/ /dang mtshungs ma rgan 'gro kun thar par drongs/ /'dis mtsho ni skye bar 'brel ba'i nye du rnams/ /srid 'khyams dub la bde skyid grib ma sa /bsil byed bcom ldan mgon po mi bskyod pa/ /mi 'khrugs rgyal pos deng 'dir byin gyis rlomes/ khyod zhal 'dzum pa'i brgya phrag 'od kyi snor/ /rin chen char gyis 'jungs pa'i sdug bsngal kun/ /bcil nusayon tan tshogs kyi 'byung gnas che/ /'gro rnams nges par legs pa'i sar sgrol shog /ces dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas nu bo bkra shis thog gcod kyi don du sman bla/ mi 'khrugs pa/ rin 'byung gsum gyi brgya thang bzhengs pa'i tshe rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa'ang bskul ba po nyid do/ /ye shes mchog gi bdud rtsis gzod ma nas/ /mtshan dpe'i lang tsho dar bab sprul pa'i gar/ /rnam 'dren sman gyi bla ma mched bdun zhes/ /lus can bsod nams srog zungs med po che/ /'phrin las skye rgu'i khams dang nyer 'tsham par/ /'jug tshul brgyad brgya'i grangs ldan glo ka /sman mdo shākya seng ge'i ljags ring por/ /brkyang ste skal bzang rna ba'i bcud du 'phel/ /thub gsung 'dri klog 'chang ba'i legs byas chab/ /blo brtson ma dros mtsho chen las babs pa/ /byang chub zla ba'i ma ma 'dzad min par/ /ro gcig 'bras bu bla nas blar 'phel shog /'chi med sman pa skye rgu'i bdag po'i gzugs/ /gangs ljongs lha rjer yongs(173dre byang ngos pa/ /bsod nams dar rgyas be+eḍūr snang ba'i zhing / /pad+ma'i sbubs su srid pa 'dzin par shog /rang don gcig bu'i ched min nam mkha'i mtha'/ /'jal nus sems can yongs kyi phan dang bde/ /kun mkhyen ye shes ma thob de srid du/ /nam yang zad pa med pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /gso rig smra ba kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu byang ngos drang srong nang so dar rgyas kyi phyi rten du rigs chos 'dzin pa nang so sman rgyal tshe dbang gis sman mdo brgyad brgya pa bzhengs pa'i tshe dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs —233—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung gsab ma dang po/ zhenagrags pa'o//nga rgyal ser sna yongs dag mnyam nyid kyi//ye shes rang gzugs rin chen 'byung ldan che'i//thugs rje'i 'od kyis mi shes mun sangs dang //bsgrub bya phyi ma'i yang srid gsal 'char shog/mi khom gnas brgyad 'dam gyis ma gos pa'i//dal 'byor pad tshal rab bzhad ze'u 'bru'i dbus//dmigs yul rigs gzugs 'byor dbang shes rab dang //tshe ring nad med mtho ris dpal 'bar shog/bgrang yas skye bar nyer bsags brnag dka'i dri//'khrud byed dge tsho gis 'chi med chu rgyun gyis//mngon mtho khyab 'jug rkang sor gyen bteg rtser//nges legs rgyal mtshan rtag 'od gsal bar shog/khyad par swā la'i nags ldan gangs ljongs 'dir//bsod nams lhun grub rdo rje mi lus rten//yongs 'thob gnyen 'dun rtsa lag bcas rnams kyis//mngon sum yid ches gnas su 'gyur 174na thar shog/ched du smon lam btab pa'i a skra la//'dod don gos bu smin pa ro bda'i bcud//myong bar rgyal dang de gsung slob mar bcas//dkon mchog thugs rje'i ma cu yis 'grub byin rlobs//se dkar rigs kyi thig le 'dar ba bsod nams lhun grub rdo rje'i phyi rten du rin 'byung gi brgya thang bzhengs pa'i tshe smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes ma hā lo tsā ba 'dar pa ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub kyi bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o//dus bzhi bde gshegs kun gyi gsar gsum gar//mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid che//au ḍi ya na'i slob dpon pad+ma 'byung //snying dbus gzhone nu bum skur rig pa'i rtsal//'on te nyi ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin//phul byung thugs rje'i mthu dpung rlabs po ches//ngag dbang kun bzang 'jigs med rnam par 'phrul//dbus gtsang dag zhing ljongs 'dir myur 'byon mdzod//ngo bo ka dag chos sku spros bral klong //rang bzhin lhun grub ye shes dbang po'i gzhu//thugs rje 'gag pa med pa sgyu ma'i 'phrul//zhing 'dir 'gro la mngon sum huXsal ston shog/kun bzang he ru ka dpal kong

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)chen pa/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba yi/ /(174ba tshe snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog tu thugs bskyed pa'i/ /yang srid mkhas grub rgyun mi chad par shog /rgya bod rigs 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /yi dam dkyil 'khor sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha/ khregs pa'i sde dpon dam can rgya mtsho yis/ /'dod pa'i re ba skong ba'i 'phrin las sgrubs/ /rdzogs chen sprul sku ngag dbang kun bzang 'jigs med kyi sprul sku myur du 'byon pa'i tshigs bcad dgos zhes dbon po chos dbyings lhun grub kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rgyal dang de sras snang brnyan gzugs sku'i rten/ /chos phung brgya phrag glegs bam gsung gi rten/ /rin chen byang chub mchod stong thugs kyi rten/ /bla med ye shes mngon du byed thabs rten/ /rab yangs gtang ba'i sgo 'phar 'byed la spro/ /rab dkar lhag bsam 'gro la spel phyir spro/ /rab mas bsod nams tshogs chen spel la spro/ /rab brtan mi phyed dad pa'i shugs kyis spro/ /rmad byung 'dod yon phung por 'i spungs pa gter/ /gter mdzod 'dzad med legs byas bye ba'i zhing / /zhing sa gshin por rab btab gtan bde'i 'bras/ /'bras bzang ro bda' byang chen bar myong shog /ngal ngal lus ngag yid kyis yongs 'bad pas/ /mang mang bgrang yas skye ba'i ma rgan rnams/ /ring ring sangs rgyas zhes bya'i go 'phang de/ /myur myur rtsol ba med par mngon (175na〉gyur shog khyu sbyor las byed bcas pa'i tshe dpal stobs/ /stobs ldan rnam thos bur 'gran yang srid kun/ /kun nas yongs bde nges par legs pa'i lam/ /lam bzang nyer brgyud sku bzhi thob par shog /ces 'brang rgyas shag pa nang so dgos dgos mchis brang rigs bcas kyis gser zangs kyi sku brnyan kha yar bka' 'gyur ro cog dngul gdung ste sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa'i dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba'i smon lam dgos tshul bzhin za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /—237

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenagadan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi dge 'dun rnams kyi zhal 'don du gnang ba'i smon lam tshigs bcad sogs/ /mgon po gar gyi dbang phyug tshe mtha' yas/ /byin rlabs bum pa'i gzugs shar phyag sor gyis/ /legs bteg zil mngar rgyun gyis yid can tshogs/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i bka' drin stsol/ /thub pa'i ljags bzang ring por brkyang pa las/ /rab bsngags gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i lha/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe yi mchog sbyin mkhan/ /ma smad thugs rje'i 'od kyis gdung mun sol/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams dpang por legs bzhugs par/ /lung rtogs chos kyi rgyud gtams dge 'dun tshogs/ /rtse gcig dang ba'i sgo nas nyer gsungs pa'i/ /bden tshig brjod pa don dang ldan gyur cig /bgrang yas chos phung smra la yangs pa'i ngag /dbang phyug 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa'i bstan/ /rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas kun (175ba tha zod yongs khyab par/ /rgyas mdzad rje btsun bla ma brtan par shog /yid srubs dpung la 'jigs med snying stobs go /cha gang ri bong 'dzin ltar thub pa'i bstan/ /spel bar rnam dpyod lang tsho dar ba'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur nam yang 'gyur med shog /seng ges yongs bteg rdo rjes mtshan pa'i khrir/ /mi gzhig skyil mo krung bcas zhabs sen zla/ /mtha' yas yid can mgrin sngon ral pa'i rtser/ /bskal par mi nub mdzes pa'i rgyan 'gyur shog /rtse mo'i bgrang byar brlams pa'i lha mi'i gdon/ /dus dgra'i dbang po dpal ldan ma he'i zhal/ /myur mdzad mgon po las kyi gshin rje yis/ /tshar bcad dmigs med dbyings su gzhil bar mdzod/ /chos rnams gdod nas rang bzhin gyis stong mkhar/ /chos can rgyu 'bras dbang po'i gzhu ris ltar/ /nam yang slu ba med phyir nyer btab pa'i/ /smon pa'i re ba yongs su skong bar shog /rig grol gnyis —238

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ldan 'dus bas bsgrub bya'i chos/ /'gog lam pha mthar phyin las mkhyen brtse nus/ /rab brnyes sangs rgyas thugs rje phun tshogs pas/ /yang so pa'i 'jig rten ma lus khyab par shog /ces gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi dge 'dun rnams kyi zhal 'don du 'dzugs rgyu yin pas nyi bu'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di lta bu zhig rtsoms zhes yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' (176na thad ga khri rin po che byams pa bkra shis kyi bkas bskul ba dang du blangs te za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bsam grub mthong smon pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /rgyal kun gsang ba rab 'byams 'khor lo'i mdzod/ /'dzam gling che ba'i brtul zhugs yongasagrub gar/ /pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur rdzus skyes thod 'phreng rtsal/ /phul byung thugs rje'i byin rlabs char du phob/ /zhi khro yongs 'dus sgrub pa sdebargyad dang / /lha yi mgon po legs ldan ma ning sogs/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung gis/ /ma smad mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung chen bskyed/ /brjod pa rnam dag ngag gi dbang phyug pas/ /kun mkhyen shākya'i bstan pa 'dzin pa la/ /blo mchog rab tu yangasapa'i sprul pa'i gar/ /mi g.yo rdo rje lta bur brtan gyur cig /tshe dpag med mgon phyag gi bum pa'i bcud/ khyu ti'i zungs gyur a nya 'gyur med bas/ /'chi bdag g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba yi/ /phun tshogs dga' ston dpal la spyod par shog /don dam spros dang bral yang kun rdzob kyi/ /snang ba mi 'gog thabs shes zung 'jug pa/ /bslu med rgyu 'bras rten cing 'brel 'byung mthus/ /'dod pa'i don kun lhun grub bkra shis shog /ces khyab bdag khra tshang ba chen po blo mchog rig pa'i rdo rje'i sprul sku'i brtan bzhugs kyi bden pa brjod pa 'di ni chos rjes ngag dbang thub bstan gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rab 'byams (176ba)pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /ā ga 2nyu rga to 〉 bi ka yi na 2 khya : me rje khru ma khyi lu yu ba da rnya//—239—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedatshur mthong 'gro blo'i rnyog bral rdzing bu'i grangs/ /de snyed zhabrul zla'i dkyil 'khor ji bzhin bdagamu ri shā t+ta lha ma khya ni swā bha ba sre gi lu la sa hi ni 6no de sha tsa/smig rgyu gsher dang gangs can mdangs sngon du/ /snang bar cal sgrog tshad ma'i yul min kyang / /bde chen chos kyi rgyal po yan chad du/ /dus mtshungs sprul pa'i rgyu gcig rim byon sogs//dam pa'i yang srid pha mtha' yas pa'i dbya/ /gro bzhin skyes kyi gdan ltar 'dzad pa med/ kho ra khor yug kha ba'i rdul brtsegs ljongs/ /skye rgu'i lha mchog lag na pad dkar 'chang / /gang 'dul der ston sna tshogs 'phrul po ches/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyi khengs pa bag la zha/ /'phags bod rgya bal paṇa grub saspyod dbang / /gcig las du ma'i gar bsgyur la mkhu bar/ /snang brnyan (177na)rlung gi rgyal mtshan tshon ris la/ /ye shes sems dpa'i mdangs bkrag 'od du 'tsher/ /rgya chen spyod dang zab mo lta ba'i gzhung / mang rta che gnyis las 'ongs lam rim brgyud/ /snyigs ma'i 'gro la rjes brtse thugs rje'i mthu/ /thub pa g.yin las khyad zhugs bder gshegs brgyad/ /dug lnga dbyings dag rgyal ba rigasalnga dang / /nyes kun yongs sel seng ldeng nags sgrol ma'i/ /rnam 'gyur nyer gcig ngo mtshar bkod pa la/ /blta phyir brgya byin mig stong sprul pa bzhin/ /snang srid ri mor bskrun la yangs pa'i mig /dkyus ring nam mkha'i pha mtha' gzhal nus pa/ /zur rigs sngags 'chang gzhis ka shar pa sogs//bkra shis grags ldan sor mo'i zlos gar bsgyur/ /bsod nams byas 'bras bod hor yongs kyi lha/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i mthar 'dzin rgyal po yi/ /'di dang skye ba kun tu phan dang bde/ /'dzad med mu thi la yi char 'bebs shog /rgyu sbyor sgo gsum 'bad rnams khengs 'byor stobs/ /rnam mang thos pa'i sras kyi rjes song ste/ /ma smad snyan pa'i grags pa — ཿ/ /tshangs pa'i yul sa brgal bar sgrog gyur cig /bstan 'dzin da la'i sa chen skyong ba'i rgyal/ /legs byas gser gyi 'khor lo mkhar 'phagasapa/ /khams gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i dbang phyug gtsug /zhabs sen kun+da'i gnyen de tshes par shog /zo chun ltar brgyud yang srid mtha' dag gung / /lha mi'i rten bzang nyi ma nyer shar ba'i/ /bde —240

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)skyid snang bas yongs khyab (177ba〉dud pa'i mun/ /ming gi lhag ma btsal kyang ma rnyed shog /dal dang 'byor ba'i rin chen them skas la/ /dge ba'i gom stabs lhod bor rab 'dzegs pas/ /stobasabacu mnga' ba'i khang par legs zhugs te/ /myur du 'gro kun 'dren pa'i dpal thob shog /mkha' la 'phrod sbyor bzang po'i gza' skar 'dzom/ khri gdugs 'od kyis nor 'dzin drod chen phebs/ /mchog gsum lha dang drang srong bden tshig gi /bkra shis char gyis 'jig rten khyab gyur cig zhes gnam sa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal pos thams cad mkhyen pa bde chen chos kyi rgyal po'i ngas rabs grwa tshar nyi shu rtsa gsum/ lha mgron lam rim bla brgyud/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/rgyal ba rigs lnga/ sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig rnams kyi gser thangs bzhengs pa'i ri mo ba sngags 'chang gzhis ka shar pa a gur/ legs pa rgyal mtshan/ lags rta mgrin/ shun shag khyi skyag chos skyong / a khu bsam 'grub/ phyon/ rkos pa do dam pa kong po gur bzang pa bsod nams dar rgyas rnams kyisabagyis pa'i rgyab yig smon lam 'di ni gsung gis skul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bsam mthong ba phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /khyab bdag pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs rje'i mthus/ /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par bod yul 'dir/ /thub pa'i lung rtogs bstan pa 'phel ba dang / /sems can tha dag bde zhing skyid par shog /za hor rigs 'dzin che mchog 'dus pa (178na sol/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor mi g.yo rtag brtan cing / /chosasrid zung du 'jug pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin ma lus khyab par shog kun bzang thugs kyi thig pas rnam grol te/ /bdud bzhi'i tha khul las rgyal ba'i he ru ka /rdzogs chen rnal 'byor kong spyon sprul pa'i gar/ /chad med bstan pa'i nyer 'tshor bsgyur bar shog /gnas chen mang por sku gsung thugs rten sogs/ /dge tsho gis bskrun pa'i byed po ma lus pa/ /'dir snang bsam pa'i reb lhun grub cing / /phyi ma pad+ma 'od du skye bar shog /'di'i ched mthun rkyen sbyor rnams nges legs lam/ /ma rnyed de srid rtsa gsum lha tsho gis kyi/ /thugs rje snying gi za ma rtag zhugs pa'i/ /bzang po'i skal pa can —241—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenadu byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gzungs 'bul gyi smon lam tshigs bcad 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes dbon po chos dbyings kyi ngor za hor kyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bsam grub mthong ba phun dbang ngo / /shākya seng ge'i 'jigs med nga ro'i dbyangs/ /rnam gsum chos kyi 'khor lo'i pusta gaḥ /bzhengs pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rab rgyas shing / /'jig rten kun tu bde skyid 'byung bar shog /khyad par ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /blo bzang grags snyan 'bar ba'i lung rigs kyis/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can khyon rnams yongs khyab cing / khrid mtha'i bar du mi 'gyur brtan par shog khyu sbyor 'dri klog mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar tshogs/ /'di phyir rnam (178ba)smin dkar po rab 'dzag cing / /ring por mi thogs mi 'jigs bzhi ldan pa'i/ /go 'phang mchog de mngon du 'gyur bar shog /ces pa'ang dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to gyis po ti so so'i mjug tu 'dri rgyu la dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /smra ba ngag gi dbang phyug pa'i/ /blo gros chos bzang rgya mtsho ltar/ /gting dpog nus min bshes gnyen gyis/ khyu spyor 'khor bcas shis gyur cig /ces pa'ang skyid thang nor bus bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes bkod/ /bde ldan zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rnam 'dren gyi/ /thugs gsang dpal be las 'phros zer 'phreng thig /༷ chu gter 'dab stong ge sar rtser/ /sgyu 'phrul rol gar 'chi med rigs 'dzin kye/ /bka' gter smin grol gdams pa'i lung rtogs bstan/ /spel la mgon khyod gdung song legs ldan rje/ /nyi zla 'od zer mchog gi sprul pa'i sku/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor byin gyis rlobs/ /spros pa'i mtshan ma yongs dag kun tu bzang / /ngo bo chos dbyings rig rtsal thugs kyi klong / /gzhen nu bum skur rtag brtan dngos po'i gshis/ /bdag sogs lus can snang ngor 'pho med shog /'od gsal sgron ma drug gi rnam par 'phrul/ /rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gar mkhan dbang po'i gzhu/ /nam yang 'char nub spangs pa'i gzi 'bar che/ /g.yin min 'khor tshogs gzigs mor mtshar bar shog /gaṅgā'i klung gi —242

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rdul gyis mi bsgrun pa/ /sna tshogs (179na/sprul pa bstan las sman ljongs 'dir/ kun khyab thugs rjes chos rgyal dbang po'i sde'i/ /ring lugs srog gi ka bar 'gyur med shog /blo gsal gdul bya'i skal pa bzang po la/ /rab sbyor pad+ma thod 'phreng 'phrin las rtse/ /theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po las 'ongs pa'i/ /bgrang yas dngos grub char chen rtag 'bebs shog /yongs 'du lta bur 'dod pa'i re skong sde'i/ /sku tshe'i 'phrang gegs yid grub dpung gi mun/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon nyin byed kyis/ /mthar bskrad phan bde'i snang ba 'bar bar shog /dngos rgyud bla ma'i ngo bo pad+ma 'byung / /yi dam bde gshegs kun 'dus bka' brgyad lha/ /bstan srung yongs rdzogs dpal ldan mgon po yis/ /bzhed pa'i don rnams ma lus sgrub par mdzod/ /chos nyid ka nas dag pa'i shel ngos su/ /chos can rgyu 'bras rnam bkra tshon gyi ris/ /rjen par 'char ba bslu med rten 'byung mthus/ /bsams pa'i re ba yid bzhin 'grub par shog /ces rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku mchog brtan par bzhugs pa'i bden brjod e waṃ lcog sgar ba'i tshogs 'don du 'dzugs rtsis kyi/ /rnam gling paṇa chen dkon mchog chos gragasakyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /bgrang yas rgyud sder mkhyen rab dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /'gro la byams pa'i ri dwags snang brnyan mjes/ /gsung ngag dbang chu'i bsil (179ba)zer yongs 'phro bar/ /lhun grub bstan pa'i zla ba zhabs brtan shog /dpal ldan shākya'i ring lugs rgyal mtshan che/ /legs bsgreng 'dam bu sbyin gyi 'dus pa'i sder/ /zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rab bstor nas/ /gdul bya'i re ba ma lus skong bar shog /nam mkha'i mtha' klas skye rgu'i bsod nam zhing / /mi nub dbang gi chu bo 'dren mkhas pa/ /tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i bstan pa'i srog /'dzin phyir bskal brgyar rdo rje ltar brtan shog grub mchog thang stong rgyal po'i thugs rje'i gzis/ /ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po'i bstan 'dzin par/ /rdo rje'i khri la mi 'gyur rtag bzhugs te/ /phun tshogs 'phrin las yun ring rgyas par shog /gsung ngag slob bshad nyin byed dkyil 'khor gyis/ /gangs can rmongs pa'i smag rum nyer sangs nas/ /snyan brgyud bshad —243

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanasgrub snang ba 'od po ches/ /thub bstan ma nub de srid dar gyur cig /khyab bdag zha lu ba chen pos bla ma rnam gsum la gsung ngag gnang ba'i tshe/ 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bka' stsal pa bzhin za hor gyi brjes 'phral du bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /gnyis med gsung ba ma lus pa'i/ /yab gcig mkhyen pa'i gter chen po/ /gzhen nu zur phud lnga ldan pas/ /dri med spyan gyis dgyes par gzigs/ /byang chub mngon du gyur min par/ /khyod kyis dge ba'i bshes mdzad nas/ /blang dang dor bya'i gnas kun la/ /mi zad blo gros spobs pa stsol//'dis mtshon bsod nams gang (180na)byas pa/ /drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma rgan rnams/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang mchog /ring min thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di'ang rgyal skor ba bsod nams dbang po'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes bkod/ / ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i blo/ /skal bzang gdul bya rgya mtsho'i gnyen/ /'dra 'bag ngag dbang nam mkha' yis/ /bzhengs 'bras byangs chen rgyu ru bsngo/ /'phyong rgyas pa ngag dbang nam mkhas 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes bkod/ /rgya ston ngag gi dbang po'i ring lugs kyi/ /kunywa'i dga' bskyed bsil zer mdza' na mo/ /bzhin mdzes da t+pā ra rdul 'dzag pa'i bde/ /nam yang mi gtong lhun gyis grub par shog /thub chen bstan pa si ta'i chom rkun mgrin/ /dge tshogs legs lam 'phongs kyis nyer bcad pas/ /'khrul pa'i smig rgyur ma 'byams rā ma ṇa'i/ /yang srid dpal ldan skal bzang rnyed par shog /lha gzigasabaka' brgyud rnam par rgyal ba yi/ /thugs rjeXlha'i bang steng bsrubs pa'i 'bras/ /thabs shes gaṅgā sa bskyed bsrings gdong drug sde/ /skyong phyir gtsug na zla ba slar tshes shog /phag gru'i gzhung lugs nya phyas yangs pa'i khog /'brug bstan phyur por spungs pa'i mu thi la/ /phyag rgya'i dkyus ring ri dwags mig can ma'i/ /spel legs rgyan gyi byed por myur 'byon shog /brgyud pa kun 'dus dpag bsam yongs 'du'i (180ba)dbang / /dkon chog gsum dngos 'khor lo sdom pa che/ /ma mgon bya rog —244

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gdong can mthu stobs kyis/ /'dod pa'i re ba skong ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces sprul sku ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub thub bstan dge legs dpal bzang po'i yang srid myur 'byon gyi smon lam zhig dgos zhes gra rigs rnams spyi tshogs nas skul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i ye ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bsam mthong pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /blo gros 'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i bdag nyid la/ /bzang po'i lhag bsam phyag na pad+ma dngos//mthu stobs gsang bdag grags pas yongs khyab sku/ /bzhengs pas skye ba kun tu rjes 'dzin lha/ga /ngag dbang phrin las kyis rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes bris/ /snyigs dus thugs rje'i mthu dpung 'bar ba'i mes/ /lus can sdug bsngal sdong dum bsreg mdzad pa'i/ /bde bshegs brgyad kyi snang brnyan tshar dngar ba/ /theg gsum skye 'phags sku par sna tshogs bskrun/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang de 'grel gsung rab sogs/ /rang gis nyan dang gzhan la legasabashad mthus/ /thub bstan spyi dang mnyam med myong kha pa'i/ /lugs bzang srid mtha'i bar du dar bar shog /bstan 'dzin tsho gos 'phel mi 'gyur rab tu brtan/ /yid can thams cad bde skyid dpal la spyod/ /'bras bu ma rgan don ched byang chub mchog /ring min mngon du 'gyur ba'i (181na)rgyu ru bsngo/ /skyid shod nyang bran pha bong kha'i gdan sa pa bshes gnyen chen po 'jam dbyangs grags pas 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar pa'i ye ge pa ni dge slong 'jam grags pa'o/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil snod spron skyogs zung / /dngul srang nyer gnyis las grub pa/ /ngag dbang chos 'dzin gyis phul dges/ /'di phyi'i don kun grub par shog /ces pa'ang grwa tshang gi sku drin bsab ched la phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /mchog gsum mthu dang rten cing 'brel 'byung gi /tshul khrims bsrungs sogs legs byas rgya mtsho yis/ /skye bar rnam 'byed shes rab la brten nas/ /thub pa'i bstan par thos bsam bgyi bar —245

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedashog /ngag dbang blo gsal bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i mgon/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rtag brtan zhing / /tshe rabs kun tu khyed kyis rjes bzung nas/ /myur du mkha' mnyam 'gro ba 'dren par shog /ces pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang shes rab bstan pa gnyis kyis bskul ngor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /lhag bsam zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang la/ /rin chen las grub snang brnyan ri dwags gzugs//rab gsal bsod nams 'bras bu yongs smin las/ /mgon khyod rdo rje lta bur brtan par shog khyu sbyor deng nas byang chub snying po'i sa/ /mngon du gyur min de srid 'khor (181ba 'das kyi/ /legasatshogs yon tan ma lus bla nas blar/ /mthon por spyod pa'i dga' ston 'phel bar shog /skye bar dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i rten bzang thob/ /dam pa'i mgon gyis rtag tu rjes bzung nas/ /zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsir longs spyod cing / /ma rgan 'gro rnams byang lho thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes gsol dpon ge re ba blo bzang mkhyen brtses 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i tshe 'di bzhin dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /che mchog la sogs zhi khro rab stims kun/ /'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor mgon po rdo rje 'dzin//thogs med rig sngags lhun gyis grub pa'i mthus/ /'khor 'das zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal la 'dud/ /'khor los legs mtshan 'jigs pa med pa'i khrir/ /'gyur med brtan par bzhugs nasabadud sde'i dpung / /mi bzad pha mthar byas nas ra gur du/ /nyer chud sgo gsum g.yo ba med byin rlobs/ /deng nas nges par legs pa'i lam zab mo/ /mngon du gyur min de srid mgon khyed kyis/ /rjes bzung srid dang zhi ba'i legs tshogs kun/ /'bad pa med par lhun gyis grub par shog /ces blo bzang don yod kyi kha ton du bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /dngul dkar bco brgyad srang las nyer grub pa'i/ /phud phor zung ldan dam rdzas gtore ma'i snod//—246

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dga' gdong sngags rams don grub rgya mtsho yis/ /phul bas 'di phyi'i don kun 'grub par shog /ces pa'ang za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /(182na)rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo mchog dang rjes su 'brel bar brtan bzhugs bya tshul 'dod pa'i re skong sogs/ /na mo gu ru : yurda 〈rta tsakru :/ /mtshan tsam dran pa'i mod la 'chi bdag mun/ /mthar byasasrog gi zungs kyur zil dngar gyis/ /yid dbang sim pa'i cho ga rtag ster mkhan/ /'phags ma dgyes pa'i spyan gyis dus kun gzigs/ /tshe sbyin zab don gangs ldan ri bo las/ /dam pa'i bzhes srol bka' babs chu klung rnams/ /mkhyen dpyod zla ba'i ma mar legs 'khyil ba'i/ /blo gsal rgya mtsho snyan brgyud bye ba'i mdzod/ /zhal lung rjes gnang nyams khrid man ngag sogs/ /nyer stsol rdo rje 'chang dngos gnas gsar ba/ /zur rigs kun mkhyen khyab bdag zha lu pa/ /rnam gsum bla ma'i mdzad pas yid rab 'phrog /bgrang yas bde gshegs ma lus bskyed pa'i yum/ /'chi med tshe yi mchog sbyin stsol ba'i mar/ /gsol btab mtshon gyis lha chen nyi bu'i zhags/ /bcad de mi 'gyur brtan bder nges pa brnyed/ /de phyir tshad ma'i phyag bzhes mang mthong dang / /lung rigs gtan tshig tshogs kyis bsgrub nus pas/ /rdo rje slob dpon 'og min zhing gtso ltar/ /bzhug thabs 'dod pa'i re skong 'di na spel/ /de'ang brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga zhes bya ba gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi phyogs su mkha' 'gro'i brtan bzhugs sogs brda chad gsal bar byung zhing / phyi 'gyur dang mdo phyogs su de rigs kyi gsal kha cher ma byung na'ang yan lag bdun pa rnams kyi drug pa mya ngan las mi (182ba)'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa don gyi brtan bzhugs yin la/ 'chi med rnga sgra sogs su 'chi glu'i cho —247

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (na)ga bshad pa brtan bzhugs kyi dgos don 'chi bdag gi g.yul las rgyal ba'i thabs su dgongs pa gcig cing rgyu mtshan de dag la brten nas mkhas grub du mas cho ga la brten pa dang ma rten yang rten cing 'brel ba'i sgo bsgrig thabs mang du gsungs pa'i nang nas yul de skye 'chi la dbang du gyur pa yin na zhu ba po'i re ba skong ba'i slad du sku tshe byin gyis brlab la/ gzhan dag la'ang dkon mchog gi thugs rje bskul ba'i byin rlabs dang lha sngags ye shes kyi mthu dang bden tshig sogs kyi nus pas bar chad las rgyal bas mchog dman bar pa gang la'ang bya rung bar mngon zhing raka gter ston/chos dbang rin po che/ rat+na gling pa/ dri med kun dga' sogs kyi gter khas mtshon pa rnam grangs ji snyed par mkha' 'gro bsu bzlog gi cho ga dkyil 'khor/ mdos gtor mar brten pa'i rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum shin tu mang bar gzhogs drung pa rgod tshang pa'i gsang yum mkha' 'gro mu 'gro ba bzang mo nas brgyud par grags pa'i mkha' 'gro'i dar lam gcod pa'i yi ge dgas rgyud shas che ba'i grub mtha' mang por dar ba mi 'phying pa dang khyi mjug ma'i dpe ltar mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i rigs dgos pa chung zhing khyad par sngags gsar ma'i che ba la sbyar na nya dang nyung ma bsres pa lta bu'i dpyod ldan mgu ba'i yul du mi 'gyur bar mthong la/ de'ang rje btsun tshe sbyin sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo sku tshe bsring (183na)bar byin rlabs che ba lo rgyus rnams su grags pa don la'ang gnas shing dkyil 'khor gyi cho gar ma brten pas 'jug bde don tshang gi dbang du bgyis/ de'i sgo nas rdo rje slob dpon bskal brgyar bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig par rje btsun ma 'di nyid la thun mong ma yin pa dang thun mong ba bka' babs bdun ldan gyi rjes gnang / nyams 'khrid/ las kha tshar gyi yi ge paṇ+ḍita ngag dbang grags pa'i 'chi blu'i yi ge rnams su mi gsal yang dze tā ri'i tshe dpag med du gsungs pa spyir gsang sngags nang gshin pas rgyu mtshan dang 'brel ba'i rung mthun sbyar srol yang snang zhing khyad par bya rgyud pad+ma'i rigs kyi gtso bo dang sgrol dkar rigs kyi yum du gtogs pa 'brel chags par mngon pas 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas 'chi ba blu ba'i phyag —248

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)len kha bsgyur bar gshin rje'i gzugs dang bre srang sogs yo byad rnams sta gon grub nas mdun bskyed kyi tshom bu/ bum pa/ mchod gtor sogs nye bar mkho ba'i rdzas dang yo byad rnams bsgrig gzhom dang bum pa sgrub tshul sogs thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi zin tho dang de'i mthar ram stegs g.yin ma gang yang rung bar sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rten rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad sogs bshams la gnas yo byin gyis rlab/ bdag mdun bum gsum bskyed chog rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i tshe 'khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun gyi nyams len bsdus pa'i steng nas rjes (183ba〉gnang gi skabs bzhin nyams su bstar/ long skabs dang bstun pa'i bzlas pa dang tshom bu rje btsun mar gsal ba la bla ma dam pa sogs 'bul yul gang yin pa de'i sku tshe'i bar chad zhi zhing bskal brgyar 'tsho zhing gzhes par byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'dod don gyi gsol ba nan to du gdab cing dpang po zhu/ /chos skyong la gtor sngo'i dus kyang 'phrin las 'chol/ /de nas 'chi blu'i cho ga mkhan rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyis mdzad pa'i tshe dpag med 'chi med rnga sgra 'chi blu mthong bas don grub sor bzhag la lha sngags sogs skabs thob kyi 'byin 'jug dang 'don pa bsgyur ba rig pas 'phul shes par bya/ /brtan bzhugs dngos la/ dar ras sogs la bris pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i ri mo can 'bul yul gyi stan du bting / 'bul yul swa bha wasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri gzhom gzhig dang bral ba sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i thugs rnam par mi rtogs pa'i ye shes bde stong zung du 'jug gang ga dkyus ma'i rigs la che ge mo'i rnam par shes pa zhes bsgyur/ pa'i ngo bo haṃ yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur ba las rdo gang ga gas la gzur skur/ rje slob dpon rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo sku mdog /(184na༄sa pa nas rgyas gdab kyi bar mdun bskyed bzhin snying ga —249

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanagos kyis ma sna pa'i tshol yul la kha sku/sbyar/mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab/maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma/lha rdzas las grub yan lag brgyad ldan chu//'thungs pas gdung sel mchod yon yid 'ong 'di//nam mkha' rab mas khams kyis mtha' gtugs pa//bkang ste bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//oṃ gu ru ār+ya tā ra sa pa ri wā ra a: pra ti ts+tsha pā dza me gha sa mu dra lpa ra ṇa sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/zhes sogs chu bzhi/nyer spyod rol mo/gos zungs/rgyal srid sna bdun/nye ba'i rin wo sna bdun/bkra shis rtags brgyad/'dod yon lnga/ja bre/gdugs/rgyal mtshan/ba dan/sil snyan/mchod pa nyi shu lnga dang bcas pa gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi sgrub thabs shar chen ye shes rgyal mas gyi dngos slob zar byang phug pa kun dga' legs pas mdzad pa ltar bya zhing mchod phreng gi rigs g.yin nas jangs kyang mi 'gal/bstod pa ni/'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma//tu stu re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol//tu res na 'chi rnams las sgrol//sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal lo//pad+ma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa'i//zla rgyas gzugs kyi gdan steng na//rdo rje skyil krung bcas mdzad cing //mchog sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal la//ston dzi'i zla ba'i mdangs 'dra zhing //zla ba la ni rgyab brten ma//rgyan rnams thams cad yongasasu rdzogs//ut+pal bsnams la phyag 184ba 〉 gyi lo//bcu drug lo lon sku nyams ldan//rdzogasasangs rgyas kun de yi sras//'dod sbyin dpal ni 'chang ba'i yum//'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal//'khor lo dkar po 'od zer dkar//rtsibs brgyad la ni yi ge brgyad//yongs su bskor ba'i rnam pa can//'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes paṇ+ḍita ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa 'di dang gzhan yang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub kyis mdzad pa'i rigs kyang spro na bya//snga ma rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs gar zla ba'i rang bzhin gyi 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa zhes pa nas//de'i phyi rol tu 'od zer sna lnga'i phreng ba g.yas skor du 'bar bar bsam pa'i bar mngon rtogs ltar la/de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa brgyud kyi snga ma rnams mngon sum du bzhugs par mos te thugs dam gyi brgyud bskul ba ni/bcom ldan thub pa'i dbang 0po yang /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gsol/ /gnas mchog 'di ru byon nas kyang / /dpal ldan ja ma dam pa yi/ /sku tshe bskal brgya'i bar du srings/ /'chi ba med pa tshe yi dngos grub stsol mdzod/ /oṃ tā re tu bhā re tu re sa du rang don ma ma'i sgo khu lho sumadzos pa yin/ro rā yur pu rtso dzñā na snyo ku ru swā hā/ rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo dang //mkhas pa ngag dbang grags pa dang / /paṇa grub rdo rje gdan pa yang / /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegasasu gsol/ /'grel chen rin chen grags pa dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug sle nag pa/(185na)/bshes gnyen sgre pa chen po yang / /gnas 'dir ྾/ chos rgyal zla 'od gzhon nu dang / /sgam pa tshul khrimasasnying po dang / /sgom chung shes rab byang chub kyang / /gnas 'dir ྾/ mtshungs med dwags pa 'dul 'dzin dang / /chos rje 'bri gung gling pa dang / /bla ma dam chos gling pa yang / /gnas 'dir ྾/ rnam 'dren chos kyis tshul khrims dang / /mnyam med bla ma lha lung pa/ /mkhas grub thog gnas chen po yang / /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /mkhas btsun chos kyi dbang phyug dang / /'dren mchog byang chub bzang po dang / /kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal yang / /gnas 'dir ྾/ /spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang dang / /yongs 'dzin dpal ldan rgyal mtshan dang / /paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal yang / /gnas 'dir ྾/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po dang / /kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dang / /mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan yang / /gnas 'dir ྾/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan dang / /rdo rje 'chang dbang bka' 'gyur ba/ /mkhan chen tshe dbang lhun grub kyang / /gnasa'adir ྾/ zhes tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma'i tshe 'dzab kyi gdangs dang bcas rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab pas bla ma rnams dang mdun bskyed kyi tshom bu thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros shing / de dang dus mnyam du spyi bo'i bla ma 'od dpag med (185ba) yongs su gyur pa las/ zhes pa nas/ gdon bgegs thams cad bya sgro mgar gyi sol mal du babs pa ltar ga zlokhe thul thul tshig par bsam gyi bar mngon rtogs bzhin bya/ de nas dmigs pa dang ma bral bar yi ge bcu pa spel tshig can brgya rtsa tsam zla/ bla ma'i phyag tu rje btsun ma'i sku bris 'bur gang yang rung ba 231—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenaphul te/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bstan dang 'gro ba'i dpung gnyen dang bdag sogs gdul bya rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo dus 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ tshe mdo'i glegs bam phul te bsod nams kyi zhing du yan gong ltar la/ gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs phyogs bcur sgrog par mdzad du gsol/ pad spungs phul te/ thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo rim gnyis zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin la g.yo ba med pas 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ bum pa bcud ldan phul te/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan gyi phung po zad mi shes pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar 'gro ba'i re ba ma lus pa skong bar mdzad du gsol/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan phul te/ rigs so so'i blo dang 'tsham par zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i 'phrin las 'khor ba ji srid kyi bar rgyun mi ho pa gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa bzhin 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ rgyal (186na)srid sna bdun rim par phul te/ /lha rdzas las grub lte ba shin tu zlum/ /rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud rab mnyam bzang / / sdang ba'i dgra las rnam par rgyal gyur ba'i/ /'khor lo rin chen 'bul gyi brtan par bzhugs/ /oṃ tsakra rat+na ni rla ta ya mi/ so so'i tshig rkang tha ma'i zur bsgyur zhing sngags 'byin 'jug byed/ bkra shis rdzasabargyad rab gnas kyi skabs bzhin dbul/ tshigs su bcad pa'i brtan bzhugs kyi rigs rnams kyis gsol ba btab rjes/ yun ji tsam bzhugs kyi zhal bzhes zhus te 'kha gyi bzhes pa'i yon tan du maṇ+ḍal dbul/ phun sum tsho gos pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas me tog gi char dbab/ rten 'brel gyi khyad nas mdun bskyed kyi tshom bu zhag gsum tsam gyi bar bsdu chog mi bya zhing / de nas mthug chog spyi dang 'dra'o/ /smras pa/ rdo rje slob dpon 'khor ba ji srid bar/ /bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen dam par legs bzhugs shing / /mi bdag la sogs mchog dman 'chi bdag las/ /mthar byed rten cing 'brel bar —252

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'byung 'di mtshar/ /sngon rabs mkhas pa'i bzhed pa 'ga' mthong bar/ /yongs dpyad nges rnyed ster ba'i khungs ldan las/ /gzhan zer tshig rjes tsam 'breng 'khor ba la/ /brten pa'i blun po'i gdol gtam 'di ma yin/ /de 'dra rgyal ba kun 'dus gnas gsar ba'i/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi snying gi za ma (186ba)tog /yongs su 'khyil bas brjod pa don yod glu/ /spobs pa'i rgyud mangs sgra dang lhan cig len/ /dge des gdan gsum tshang ba'i 'khor lo'i mgon/ /tha mal gdul bya'i snang ngor ngur smrig gar/ /legs bsgyur drin chen 'dren pa zha lu pa/ /'og min zhing gtso'i mgon ltar g.yo med shog /lus su snang ba yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku/ /ngag gi sgra kun yi ge bcu pa'i gdangs/ / yid ngor gang shar bde chen ye shes la/ /rnam par rol ba'i bkra shis dga' ston shog /ces skyid shod 'dzin ma'i thig le lho mos gzhis gar rigs brgya'i khyab bdag mkhan chen zha lu pa tshe dbang lhun grub rab brtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i snyan rgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gsang chen slob bshad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba'i tshe dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag chos rje bco brgyad pa byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub dang drin can rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba chen po'i rigs kyi dbon nam mkha' bsod nams dbang gi rgyal po/lcags zam rje drung ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs gsum gyis rje bla ma dam pa la nged mched grogs rnams kyis brtan bzhugs bzabs rgyas shig 'bul rtsis yin pa yid bsrubs kyi g.yul las rgyal bar gang zab cig khyod kyis brtags nas cho ga sgrigs shig par gsung gis bskul ba na rje btsun ma nyid skabs su babs par mngon nas rgyal ba kun (187na tshe yum tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i cho ga dang 'brel bar 'chi blu dang brtan bzhugs kyis mdzes rgyan du byas pa 'dod pa'i re skong 'di ni me 'brug sa ga zla ba'i dkar cha'i tshes bzhi la za hor gyi bzhes pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa 'dis kyang nges gsang bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs bcur 'char ba'i rgyur gyur cig /—253

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenasrang grangs bco lnga'i rin chen gnyis pa las/ / legs grub gsang 'dus bla ma'i sgrub gtor snod/ /chos rje blo bzang pad+mas legs phul mthus/ /thod phreng rtsal gyis rtag tu rjes 'dzin shog /ces pa'ang grwa tshang gi dge skos las sna'i 'jog tu phul ba'i za hor gyis brnyes sbyar/ /'jon dmar gser zhun las grub pa'i/ /'dra 'bag ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs kyis/ /bzhengs sa 'di phyi dus kun tu/ /phan bde'i dpal la spyod par shog /ces pa'ang za hor gyis brnyes bkod/ /rin chen las grub 'dra ba'i gzugs/ /chang khyim blo bzang dngos grub kyis/ /bzhengasapas srid dang zhi ba yi/ /legs tshogis thams cad lhun grub shog ces pa'ang za hor bzhes bris/ /gzugs brnyan rin chen rgyu tshogs las/ /dkar brag ngag dbang byams pa yi/ khri spya sbyar 'bras bu mngon mtho dang / /nges legs don kun 'grub par shog /ces pa'ang za hor brjes bkod/ /chos kun rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab kyis/ /legs bshad sbyin pas gdul bya tshim mdzad pa/ /blo ldan skal bzang dga' ston spel ba'i gnyen/ /rdo rje lta bur mi 'gyur brtan par shog /dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum byin rlabs mthu/ /lha dang drang srong bden tshig grub rnams kyis/ /deng 'dir smon lam ji ltar btab pa bzhin/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu yongs su smin par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di'ang nyi thang spyi tshogs kyi ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /zla ba lan brgyar byugs pa'i shel dkar gyis/ /cha tsam bsgrun min 'phags ma'i mdzes zhal khyim/ /bstan nas tshe yi mchog sbyin rgyal kun yum/ /yid bzhin 'khor los bgrang yas 'gro 'di skyongs/ /dbang sngon ral khur gyis dpal 'phrog byed kyis/ /legs bteg rdo rje'i ri mo bkra ba'i khrir/ /ris med 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon du/ /dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar brtan par shog /rdzogs sangs rgyas dngos rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs chos dang srid kyi kun bzod mtha'/ /bcings min de srid bde ldan zhing mgon ltar/ /bzhugs gsol 'dod pa'i re ba don yod shog /stobs kyi 'khor lo nam mkhar 'phags pa yi/ /legs byas dpung gis nor 'dzin rab skyong ba/ /—254

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rab brtan chab srid dkar cha'i zla ba ltar/ /'phel ba'i dus ston lhun gyis grub par shog /bshes gnyen gar mi yon tan g.yung drung gi /kun dga' ra bar zung 'brel dri gtsang khang / /khrus pa'i sdobacas lnga brgya phrag bcu'i bar/ /mi nyams bla nas bla ru 'phel bar shog /dge bcur longs su spyad pa'i rnam smin gyis/ /gsil ba'i ga bur zegs rdul nyer babs pas/ /'jig rten kun tu bde skyid ut+pal/ /dkar po'i 'dab ma yongs su ba 'ad par shog /'jam dpal drag por khros pa ma he'i zhal/ /legs ldan nag po myur mdzad ye shes mgon/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur dmag dang zor gyi lhas/ /smon lam btab pa ji bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /mi yi seng ge nges gsungs lung rtogasachos/ /nyer 'dzin slob mar bcas pa'i byin rlabs mthus/ /lus can yongs la rtag tu bde legasakyi/ /phun sum tshogs pas dus kun khyab par shog /ces rdzing phyi cho so sde spyi tsho gis kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyis brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /'dus tsho gis bsod na masang du gyur pa'i tshal/ /'khor yug gnyis med shākya seng ge bcas//snang brnyan mkha' la 'ja' tshon ltar bkra ba/ /mig gi bdud rtsi gsar pa'i dga' ston dpyid/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rten bskrun pa dang / /phyag mchod bkur bsti bgyid la mngon phyogs pa'i/ /sgo gsum 'du byed phra mo'i legs byas kyi/ /phung po mi mjed 'jig rten 'dir shong min/ /rang rgyud 'dul bar (188brkos pa'i slob dpon che/ /mtho btsun ching gis gnam gyi rigs las son/ /blo bzang dga' ldan lhag bsam ston zla ltar/ /ches dkar mthu las tshul bde 'bad pas bsgrubs/ /dge 'dis rgyal kun yab cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /bshes gnyen sgyu dra'i rnam 'phrul btsong kha pa'i/ /bstan pa dbus 'gyur 'chang du byams pa mgon/ /ma byon de srid 'phel zhing rgyas gyur cig /ngag dbang dbyangs can lha mo mgrin 'byud pa'i/ /blo gros yangs pa'i spobs pa bzang po yis rgya mtsho ltar zab lnga rig gtsug lag kun/ /'dzin khyod rdo rje lta bur brtan par shog /blo bzang snyan grags 'bar ba'i rjes su zhugs/ /dga' spros thos bsam lhur blangs don ldan gyis/ /thog ma med —255

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhananas da lta'i bar bsags pa'i/ /sdig lhung dri ma'i tshogs kun byang bar shog /mi khom bgrod dka'i chu bo chen po la/ /dal 'byor rten gyi zam pa rab btsugs nas/ /pha rol nges legs gnas su nyer son te/ /rtag du sim pa'i tshor ba myong bar shog /zhi bde dman lam gol ba'i nyes skyon sogs/ /shes nas bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sems bskyed de/ /rin min stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang mchog /mngon gyur 'gro ba ma lus 'dren par shog /'dis mtshon byas so cog gi bsod nams kyi/ /'bras bu rang nyid kho na bsams min pa/ /mtha' dang tshad du bral ba'i lus can kun/ /phan dang bde ba 'byung ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes 'dul ba slob dpon lha btsun blo bzang dga' ldan gyis stod lung rdzing ga'i kun (189na po ga' ra bar ldebs bris bgyis pa'i dge ba bsngo ba'i smon lam 'di bzhin dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /rig rtsal 'pho med chos sku'i klong chen por/ /ye shes 'od lnga'i mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i gar/ /kun khyab 'gro 'dren mtsho skyes rdo rje yis/ pad+ma tshul khrims rjes bzung thar par drongs/ /nyon mongs rtsa ba gti mug mun pa'i smag /thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od kyis nyer sbyangs nas/ / me long ye shesagasal ba'i snang mdzad kyis/ /pad+ma'i sbubs su tshul khrims ming can drongs/ /rnam par snang mdzad thugs rje'i chu rgyun gyis/ /tshe 'das thog med nas bsags sdig pa'i dri/ /rab bkrus dag pa bde ba chen po'i sar/ /legs bkod don gnyis ma lus 'grub byin rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang gsang mkhar bsama'i don du bris thang gsum bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus pad+ma thod 'phreng dang / /dbyer med drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /byang chub ma thob bar du gsol ba 'debs/ /'di phyi'i don kun 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang gsang mkhar ba bde chen dbang rgyal gyi kha ton du dgos tshul ltar bris/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon kun tu bzang / /'jam dpal rdo rje bzhad pa'i 'phrin las —256

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rnams/ /thogs pa med sgrub (189ba〉rgal ldan 'dren pa mchog /bslu med skyabs kyi ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kun gdod nas dag dbyings 'du ma byas/ /gsal stong rig pa'i khyab bdag rdo rje sems/ /bshes gnyen gzugs kyi rnam rol srid mtha'i bar/ /gtsug tor mdzes byed rgyan du brtan gyur cig /rdos bcas chos kun ye dag 'ja' 'od lus/ /zad sar 'byol te brjod bral bde ba che//thob min skye bar zab mo'i lam bsgoms nas/ /'di phyi gtan gyi mdun ma 'grub par shog /cesapa'ang ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs kyis kha ton du bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /bsod nams nyer bsags grangs med skye ba'i mtshor/ /mgon khyod thugs rje'i zla gzugs rtag shar te/ /byang chub bar du 'bral med rjes 'dzin par/ /smon pa'i re ba ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang gsol dpon ge ra ba blo bzang mkhyen brtses nged rang gi 'dra 'bag bzhengasapa'i kha byang skye bar rjes 'dzin gyi smon lam/ rab gnas brgya rtsa dang bcas dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /'grin par ngag dbang dbyangs can 'jo sgeg gis/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i blo yis skal bzang gi /gdul bya rgya mtshor smra ba'i 'jigs med go /cha gang thub bstan lang tsho'i sder gsol 'debs/ /tshangs sras zla zhin ba 'ad pa'i 'jum zer gyis/ /lnga rig ut+pal 'dab stong yong grol bas/ /blun rmongs nyes brgya 'joms pa rdo rje'i mtshon/ (190na)/gdegs mdzad dpal ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /tha snyad gtsug lag rnams dang nang don gyi/ /ma mar lta ba'i rnam dpyod gdong drug par/ /bsnyems pa'i sngon med lang tshor dar bab can/ /blo gsal yid dbang 'gugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /rdul mun gyis bsgribs mthor brtsegs khri stan la/ /mi shigs skyil krung gcig gi bang rjes shar ba/ /mig gsum 'phrul che des kyang mi dbyi bar/ /don grub de gsung 'dus pas deng byin rlobs/ /blo gros spobs pa yangs par 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /mchog tu dga' bas mthon mthing spyan —257

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ 3)ras kyis/ /mngon par yongs btsa' ma 'dres 'gro ba'i bshes/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bden pas rab brtan shog /g.yon 'khyil nam mkha'i rang bzhin g.yung drung gi /khog par tshugs pa srog gi ka ba la/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyis nyer bsdams par/ /lha dang drang srong dmod pa 'dor gyur cig /thosabasam me tog chun po ma rnyings par/ /thub bstan lus phrar 'byud pa'i rtse dga' can/ /rnam gsum 'khor lo'i nu mar sen rjes ris/ /blo bzang grags pa'i ring lugs 'phel bar shog /rdul brtsegasakha ba'i do ra yangs pa'i nang / /rnam smin dkar por 'dzag pa'i zlos gar gyis/ /'gro kun sim pa'i tshor bas yid brtas te/ /skyid pa'i dga' ston skabs gsum mched slar shog /sa 'og sa steng sa blar bcas pa la/ /bkra shis bde legs chen pos yongs khyab par/ /skyabs gan bas tshogis la thal sbyar (190ba〉na sol 'debs na/ /re 'bras don dang ldan par bdag byin rlobs/ /zhes gsol 'debs smon lam dang 'brel ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni rta tshags rje drung rin po che ngag dbang dkon mchog nyi ma'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar 'du shes gsum pa za hor bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /ngag gi dbang phyug tsong kha pa'i/ /chos srid bstan pa rin po che/ /rab spel blo ldan skal bzang rten/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can de la 'dud/ /bslu med dkon mchog rnam gsum gyi/ /rmad byung thugs rje chen po'i mthus/ /bskal par mgon khyod rdo rje'i khrir/ /g.yung drung lta bur brtan par shog /bdag sogs rnams kyi bsod nams dang / /tshe dpal dbang thang rab rgyas shing / /skye bar bde 'gro'i rten rnyed nas/ /rin min sangs gyes thob par shog /ces gsol 'debs smon lam dang 'brel ba 'di'ang sa dkar 'go pa lhun grub rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam mgon tsong kha pa/ /blo bzang grags pa'i bstan srid gdugs dkar gyis/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can yongs khyab 'phrin las can/ /rje btsun bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs//—258

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)nad gdon bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun zhi/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dbang thang rgyas/ /phyi ma bde ba can du pad+ma'i sbubs/ /skyes nas rnam grol lam la 'god par shog /(191na༄sa gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni gong dkar rta ra mdo pa 'dzam las bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o /'od dpag med mgon 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /rtse gcig gdung shugs drag po'i yid bstad mthus/ /'di nas nying mtshams bde ldan skyed tshal gyi/ /'dab stong ze'u 'bru'i dbus su sbyor bar shog /ces rta ra mdo pa ngag dbang lhun grub kyis nyam sgom gyi rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /'bod sgrogs zil gnon pad+ma rgyal po'i khab/ /dpal gyi ri bor dbyangs skyid nyer drangs nas/ /theg mchog snang ba bzhi yi lam zab mor/ /phung po 'od skur grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas ma'i don du bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar/ /yon sbyor thogs med nas bsags sdig lhung dri/ /sum cu rtsa lnga'i sangs rgyas thugs rje'i chus/ /rab bkrus myang 'das pho brang nyams dga' bar/ /spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por rjes su bzung //ma rig 'khor 'khyams 'khrul ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /bde chen dbyings su rnam par grol byed lha/ /zhi dang khro bo'i skyed rdzogs rdzogs pa ches/ /tshe 'dir 'pho ba chen po 'grub byin rlobs/ /rgya bod mkhas dang grub pa du ma'i sku/ /ri mor legs spel bsod nams mthu brtas pas/ /skye bar dge (191ba〉ba'i bshes dang mi 'bral bar/ /zab rgyas chos rnams thos bsam sgom par shog /dus kyi dgra bo gar dgu'i gzi brjid kyis/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya'i tshogs rnams zil gnon lhas/ /'di phyi bar do thams cad rjes bzung nas/ /kun bzang 'jam dpal mngon du 'gyur bar mdzod/ /ces gram pa blo bzang ngag dbang gis bris thang la tshan bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /—259

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenagang zhig mos pa'i mtsho nang chu shel dbang / /sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul dra ba mkha' dbyings kyi/ /zla gzugs ngo bo mi gtong 'od zer gyis/ /bdag sogs gto bde'i kun+da rgyas par shog /ces pa 'di yang 'gres lnga chu skor pa ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis rje dge 'dun grub kyi zhakhrungs rabs bzhedas pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod do/ /'jam mgon ljongs 'dir ngur smig tshul bzung yang / /ngo mtshar med byung bkod pa'i zhing khams na/ /seng ge'i nga ro'i tshul ston tsong kha pas/ /byang chub ma thob bar du bdag rjes bzung /zhes pa'ang 'phyong rgyas pa blo bzang dbang ldan gyis rje btsun btsong kha pa'i bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod do/ /mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing las ma g.yos par/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas kyi gtso mo mchog /dpal ldan khros (192na)ma nag mos rjes bzung nas/ /bde chen rigs 'dzin sa ru 'god par shog /'phags bod paṇa grub rgyal blon sna tshogs kyi/ /snang brnyan tshon ris dang nye shel dkar bzhin/ /rnam par bkra ba'i bsod nams gang thob des/ /srid dang zhi ba'i dge legs 'phel bar shog /chos rnams ma lus bskyed mdzad sher phyin ma'i/ /ma smad thugs rjes nyen mongs phrag dog tshogs/ /yongs dag bya ba grub pa'i ye shes skur/ /bstan 'dzin mngon par rdzogs pa 'tshang rgya shog/ces chos rje rkan phu ba zil gnon rdo rjes rang dang nu bo'i don du bris thang le tshan bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /lha yi lhar gyur shākya seng ge'i zhabs/ /sprul pa dgra bcom gnas brtan bcu drug tshogs/ /dge bsnyen chos 'phel phyogs skyong rgyal po bzhi/ /'khor tshogs 'dir spyon bden pa'i dpang por bzhugs/ /brjod pa rnam dag ngag la dbang phyug blos/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i re ba yongs skong bar/ /rgya chen gtsug lag mtsho ltar gting zab mtha'/ /nyer 'jal bshes gnyen rdo rje ltar brtan shog /rtse gcig dad dungs zhing sa gshin po la/ /btab pa'i smon lam smyu gu bskyed bsrings pa/ /re —260

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ba don ldan 'bras bu rab dud khur/ /legs smon ro bda'i zas la spyod par shog /ces 'di yang gnyal ba blo bzang rnam dag gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o (192ba)lha gi rje ra su ma ti ra sa mu da se ne de bi ṣ+ṭha ka ro : se pa laḥ nā/ /rta na mitā bha ke ba mā nāshā kye 4hi go ru be+e rla ste/ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde'i/ /snang brnyan 'di bskrun legs byas 'bras/ /mgon khyod tshe mtha' yas pa ltar/ /gzhom med rdo rje'i sku brnyes shing / /rgyu sbyor deng nas byang chub bar/ /yang dag dge ba'i bshes mdzad de/ /'di phyi gtan mdun ma lus pa/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par 3|ga /ces pa'ang dpal grong sngags rams pas rten bzhengs dus bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes bris/ /'khor lo'i mgon po khyab bdag rdo rje sems/ /dngos grub kun stsol phyag rgya zil rdo rje drag po rtsal/ seng ldeng nags gyi sgrol ma/ gnon lha/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma tī/ /rtsa gsum yongasa'adus bshes gnyen gzugs can gyis/ /bdag (193na〉sogs rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar/ /'gro min thar ba'i sa mkhan legs mdzad nas/ /'di phyi bar gyi mdun ma gru bzhi sa /'grub pa'i skal ba bzang por byin gyis rlobs/ /sgo gsum 'bad pa'i chos dkar phung po'i tshogs/ /rang nyid gcig pu'i ched min mkha' mnyam gyi/ /'gro kun don du dmigs pa'i bsod nams rgyun/ /mtho ris chu bo lta bur chad med shog /rtsa ba gsum dang dbyer med du mos gdung gis byin rlabs 'jug byed 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes lha sa ba blo gros legs pa/ ngag dbang mkhas btsun/ bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho gsum gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rang sems dri bral me long gtsang ma'i ngos/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' ngur smrig gar/ /bsgyur bar nges rnyed 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs//—261—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ rton)mgon khyod skye rgu'i bsod nams zhing mchog tu/ /rtag par 'gyur ba med pa g.yung drung gi /dngos por sku tshe 'tsho zhing nyer gzhes pa'i/ /smon lam mchog gsum mthu yisahrūb byin rlobs/ /bdag sogs tshe 'dir bde skyid dpal la spyod/ /yang srid phyi mar mngon mtho nges legs kyi/ /them skas rim bgrod zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang / /mngon gyur 'gro ba ma lus 'dren gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang rab 'byams pa blo bzang chos ldan gyi kha ton du dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o (193ba)ga ska du rka su na sto da yi rmi skyu hā yo pa nā kā ruṇa she na bo ra smi na//shā ma bha nā tā be ba ra do ba khyo ā ni ni nā ma du lha ga mya : rwa ya kaḥ cher snyigs 'dun ba 'a smag tu byams brtse'i rtas/ /nyer drangs thugs rje'i cha gang zla zer gyi/ /bde skyid snang ba'i dga' ston mchog sbyin mkhan/ /rnam 'dren brgyad kyi bdag sogs 'gro la dgongs/ /thog med 'khor 'khyams su bsags las nyone dri/ /'brud pa'i byin rlabs chu bo lhab lhub steng / /gtan bde 'phrog byed rkang pa'i tog brjid pa/ /nges legs 'chi med khang rtser bsgreng bar shog /mgon po rnams kyis smon lam gang btab pa'i/ /'bras bzang ro brgya 'bar bar bdag nyid tsam/ /min par mkha' mnyam 'gro kun longs spyod rgyur/ /nyer bsngos byang chub mchog bar 'dzad med shog /rgyal gzhan gyis spangs gdul dka' 'dul (194na)ba la/ /ma smad thugs rje'i mthu dpung zla med pa/ /bu ram shing pa khyod bstan rab 'dzin pas/ /rgyan drug mchog gnyis snyan pa'i grags pa dkar/ /gser gyi mdog can 'khor los mtshan pa'i phyag /ring po rgyu sbyor gyis mtsho ni lus can gyi//spyi bor bkod nas srid zhi'i 'jigs pa las/ /dbugs dbyung phan bde'i sal sbyor byin rlobs/ /shing rta che gnyis rjes 'brangs gzhud lugs la/ /deng nas skye bar thos bsam sgom pa'i 'bras/ /ring min kun mkhyen ye shes mngon gyur nas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro 'dren ded dpon bgyid par shog/'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po'i sprul pa'i gar/ /ngo mtshar 'phreng bar spel legs mdzes rgyan du//—262

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)mar me mdzad dpal rgyal dbang btsong kha pa'i/ /snang brnyan mthong na mi mthun med bkod cing / /mos blo'i dngas mtsho me shar gzugs mkha' zla'i gral/ /nyer bsgrigs ngag dbang brtan pa'i 'khor lo yis/ /rjes bzung blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /yongs khyab 'dren rloms 'dra 'bag legs bris dges/ /zo chun 'byud ltar 'khor ba'i srid lam las/ /bgrod de thar pa'i grong du ma slebs bar/ /yang dag dge ba'i bshes kyi sa mkhan dang / /nam yang 'bral med rjes su 'dzin par shog /yon sbyor byed po 'di snang mtho ris kyi/ /bdag po'i tshe dang dpal 'byor la spyod cing / /myur du mtha' med 'khor ba mtha' can (194ba)du/ /byas te mi 'jigs bzhi ldan mngon gyur shog /ces 'phyong rgyas spun bdun pa lhun grub rgya mtshos sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ thub dbang la rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyis bskor ba/ rje dge 'dun grub pa'i 'khrungs rabs te gsum bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /bde gtso thang / gshegs yongs 'dus gsang gsum mi zad pa/ /rgyan gyi 'khor lo yongs rdzogasazhi dang khro'i/ /stang stabs gar la rdo rje slob dpon che/ /nyer bzhengs thugs rje byang chub bar 'jug shog /rgyud thig le ༅ drug /sde rnam bzhi'i lha dang ja ma kun/ /bcu drug thig ler shar ba'i gnad gcig la/ /thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa nyams longs par/ /jo 'brom yab sras rnams kyis bdag byin rlobs/ /dug thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug lnga ye dag phung po rnam pa lnga/ /gnas bsgyur ye shes lnga yi tshon
