ris mdangs/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gtso 'khor rten brten par/ /snang bas cher snyigasa'agro rnams thar lam drongs/ /rigs bka' brgyad rigs 'dzin zhal lung 'dzin byin rlabs sa bon snying dbus sar/ /smin 'bras rig pa sgrub sde brgyad kyi skur/ /rang shar lhun grub ye shes 'od lnga'i zer/ /yongs khyab 'phrin las 'gro la rtag 'asngug shog /ngo thugs sgrub yang snying kun khrus mtshar bkod pa'i cho 'phrul (195nasgo tha' klas ding / /brgyad grangs mtshan snyan lha tsho gos 'bod sgrogs mgon/ / bstan des—263

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenadapal gyi ri nas gangs can 'gror/ /gzigs te thugs rje'i 'a blug pa chad med mdzod/ /kun bka' brgyad zhi 'am rol/ la rjes chags khrag gis myos pa'i gar/ /bde chen sang rol dpal dgu waṃ yig thabs//stong nyid shes rab e dbyings mnyam sbyor bas/ /tshe 'dir rig ngo 'phrod nas rang grol shog /ma rungs rta mgrin dam sri zil gnon/ dam sri'i snying ga 'dam lta bur/ /brdzi ba'i drag po'i bro yis nag phyogs dpung / /zil gnon srid gsum khyab pa'i rta skad sgras/ /khyab mdzad dbang chen lha des bdag rjes bzung / /tshe tshe dpag med 6 med mchog sbyin/ lha rigs 'dus lnga ldan 'chi med rgyun/ /mchog tu sbyin mdzad dpal ldan gar dbang lha/ /dngos grub bye ba'i gter mdzod sgo 'phar brgya/ /phye nas bdag sogs phan dang bde la sbyor/ /nyon yang ga4 lto drag po mongs dug lnga lhong stong 'tshi dus 'dir/ /bdud bzhi'i snying la gnam lcags phur ba'i dpal/ /gzir mdzad yang gsang drag po'i rna tshogis kyis/ /mthu stobs nus rtsal gzi byin bskyed du gsol/ /mtsho sku ju rol pa/skyes rdo rje gcig pu nyid kyi gar/ /du mar bsgyur ba sku gsum sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /gcig tu brtsen pa'i ngo mtshar rol gar gyis/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun rgyud la byin chen phob/ /phyag phyag rdor dregs la du po bdud dzi phyer 4ga(195ba) na rab 'bar mtshon rnon rdo rje yi/ /ri mo 'jig rten dregs pa mtha' dag gi /gtsug tu 'char ba mthu chen gsang bdag kye/ /sde brgyad kun 'dul nus dbang stsal du gsol/ /bgrang rdo rje gro lod/ yas rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon/ /'chol ba'i khro rgyal gtum drag gro bo lod/ /rdo rje nyer gzas phur pa phyir gdengs rtse/ /dga' rab dbang phyug sde bcas snying la gzir/ /thabs tshe dpag med dngas ma ge mi 'tho/shes zung 'jug dga' ba bzhi yi cha/ /dngas ma ༅ da du drangs pas 'chi ba'i dngos/ /nyer bcom srog gi ka ba g.yung drung du/ /'grub par tshe dpag med kyis byin gyis rlomes/ /rta rta ma' khams gsum zil gnon/zhal mgrin nas 'tsher ba skad bsangs sgra/ /'brug stong lta bur bsgrags pas khams gsum kun/ /khyab tshe snang srid dregs pa zil gnon pa'i/ /mthu rtsal dbang bskur bdag la deng stol zhig /rdo dpal ldan lha mo rje dbyings phyug srid pa'i rgyal mo sa /rnam par sprul pa 'dod khams dbang sgyur ma/ /—264

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dmag dang zor gyis mi bsrun dgra sde kun/ /'a sngoms mdzad re ma tī yis las rnams sgrubs/ /e ma chos kun rdzun pa'i rang dpar ldan lha mo/ 'tshang la/ /mig 'phrul byis pa jo 'drid nges par brdzun/ /'on te rtsa gsum lha tshogs legs bzhengs pa'i/ /bsod nams pha mtha' nam mkhas gzhal nus min/ /de phyir rgya bod yig rigs la sbyangasang / /tshad ma bzhi ldan chos kyis rgyud smin pa/ /'jam dbyangs bstan (196na)'dzin jo brtson gtong phod kyis/ /gtsug lag gnyis pa shes 'ga' brten nas bskrun/ /dge 'bras rgyal bstan dar zhing de 'dzin kun/ /zhabs brtan pha mas gtso byas mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /mtho ris them skas la 'dzegs mi ring bar/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i grong du 'asngug par shog/yon sbyor las byed phan par bsgrubs pa kun/ /skye bar mi khom gnas bral dal 'byor thob/ /zab rgyas chos la thos bsam sgom byas nas/ /myur du zung 'jug sku bzhi mngon gyur shog /ces gong dkar gnas gsar ba sngags btsun 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin gyis 'bad pa chen pos yo byad rnams 'du byas/ lha bris pa gsang sngags mkhar dbu mdzad tshe 'phel/ byams pa rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams don 'grub/ bsod nams mgon po/ gos bzo pa dgos pa/ don chen pa rnams kyis byas te rgya can gyi bris thang bzhengs nas rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par rab dkar dang ba'i yid kyis spyi 'bul byas pa'i rgyab yig smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa dza ( / /dad mtshor gdan gsum tshang ba'i ngag gi dbang / /blo bzang skal ldan rgya mtsho'i snang brnyan la/ shwakya seng ge gnas brtan bcu drug dang / /rgyal chen sdebazhi dge bsnyen ha shang bcas/ /srid gsum zil gnon pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /thams cad mkhyen dngos kun (196na)mkhyen tsong kha pas//nyer mtshon skyabs gsum 'dus tshogs rab bkra ba/ /blo bzang chos ldan brtson pas yongs bskrun dges/ /skye bar rjes 'dzin nus par smon pa'i 'bras/ /'grub ste 'di phyir bde skyid dpal la spyod//—263

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenaring por mi thogs mkha' mnyam lus can kun/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i sa la rab sbyor shog /cesabying pa blo bzang chos ldan gyis nged rang gi 'dra 'bag la gnas bcu sogs lha mgron du mas bskor ba'i bris thang gi rgyab yig smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /byu ru'i lhun po nyi 'od gos klubs pas/ /gzi 'bar tshe mtha' yas pa'i mgon po yis/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur brtan byin rlobs/ /lha yi rjer gyur gso rig rgya mtsho la/ /yangs pa'i blo yis skal bzang gdul bya'i mgon/ /chos kyi snyan grags 'phrin las yongs khyab pa/ /mtshungs med mkhas pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /sman bla drang srong rigs 'dzin srung ma yis/ /'dren pa mchog khyod rdo rje ltar brtan zhing da /dpal ldan rgyud bzhi cha lag bcas pa'i gzhung / /'chad nyan dar zhing go 'phang rgyas par shog /ces 'di gar ring 'tsho dang dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags kyi gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs shig dgos zhes 'tsho byed ngag dbang skal ldan sogs (197na)slob ma rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /bla ma dgyes mdzad rdo rje gur gyi mgon/ /stobs log dbang po la sogs mkha' 'gro lngas/ /ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid rab brtan zhing / /gsang chen bstan pa'i nyi 'od gsal bar shog /ces pa'ang sku zhang dbon brgyud gsar dris kyi rten 'byung du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /sgrib bral ye shes spyan gyis shes bya'i khyon/ /ma wa zhe sum gzigs pa lnga ldan zur phud can/ /ngur smrig gar gyi sgyu phrul btsong kha pa/ /g.yel med thugs rje'i 'jug pa skul byed na/ /rab 'byamasasmra ba dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ /bka' dang bstan bcos par du gsar bskrun pa/ lkog grangs tshig khri drug stong bzhi brgya lhag /zhib mor dpyad de zhus dag bgyis pa dang / /dge gzhon blo grosabartan pas de'i ched du/ /sku gsung thugs rten ches mang bzhedas pa'i mthus/ /skye bar mngon mtho'i —266

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /ring min rnam pa thams cad mkhyen thob shog /ces pa'ang par zhus pa blo gros brtan pas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bsam mthong pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /kun khyab kun bzang pad+ma tshe dbang rtsal/ /rang rig rang gsal gzhon nu bum pa'i skur/ /ye nas ye shes chen por lhun grub mthus/ /rtag tu rtag pa'i rdo rje bzhugs (197ba)byin rlobs/ /che mchog zhi khro 'dus pa'i srid zhi'i tshogs/ /zil gnon 'jam dpal 'grub pa'i ba 'ad pa rtsal/ /rtsa ba gsum gyi bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar/ /gzhom med khri steng 'og min mgon ltar shog /lha sras mtho'i mtshan can 'phrin las cha/ /e waṃ lcog sgar 'dus gra ma dang bu/ /gsang sngags chos 'khor gling zur 'brel ba'i sde/ /srid mtha'i bar du bla nas blar 'phel shog /pad+ma ka ra 'phags yul rigs 'dzin brgyad/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga so zur gnubs nyang sogs/ /mkhas grub rim byon yi dam bstan srung gis/ /'dod pa'i re sa yongs su smin par mdzod/ /swasti ka yi rgyud mangs las drangs pa/ /dusakun bkra shis snyan pa'i glu dbyangs kyis/ /yangs pa'i 'jig rten khams rnams legs khyab ste/ /bde skyid zlos gar rtag tu rtse bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang thub bstan rdo rje brag e waṃ lcog sgar ba dang yar 'brog stag lung gsang sngags chos 'khor ba ma bu'i 'dus tshogs kyi zhal 'don du rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku mchog gis rtsoms shig pa'i gsung dang du blangs nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /drug cu lhag bcas pañtsa li ku'i dar/ /dbang gzhu lta bur bkra ba'i lda ldi'i tshogs/ /rnam lnga'i mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i mchod sprin du/ /mi zad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin spel ba'i mthus/ /mtha' klas 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /lung rtogs bstan pa de 'dzin skyes bu dang / /(198na)'dus pa'i sde rnams dkar cha'i zla ba ltar/ /bla nas blar yang cha shas kun 'phel zhing / /rgyu sbyor 'di snang lha mi'i bde skyid myong / /skye bar rtsa ba gsum gyis rjes bzung nas/ /ring min zung 'jug rdo rje —267

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhena'achang gi sku/ /mngon gyur don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /ces dan 'bag blo bzang dbang rgyal gyis phan bde legs bshad gling du snyan dar drug cu lhag bcas phul ba'i tshe kha byang dgos tshul bzhin za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /tshe dpag med sogs dus gsum rgyal kun gyi/ /thugs rje'i mthu las ngag dbang blo yi gter//skal bzang gdul bya rgya mtsho'i mgon gyur pa/ /gzhes med g.yung drung lta bur gnas par shog /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /'phrin las nam mkha'i pha mthar khyab mdzad pas/ /'jam dbyangs rab dgyes ngo mtshar sprul pa'i sku/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor 'tsho gzhes zhabs brtan shog /dkon mchog rnam gsum thugs rje'i dpung tshogs dang / bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i nus pa'i stobs/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung bslu ba med pa'i mthus/ /ji ltar smon pa lhun gyi grub par shog /nged rang dang de mo sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang nam mkha' 'jam dbyangs kyi brtan bzhugs 'di lta bu dgos zhes spo bo sku skyes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa sna(/ /lha sngags ye shes rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ /yid srubs lha min 'joms la thogs med du/ /nyer gdengs (198ba〉brtul zhugs grub pa'i rtsal 'chang ba/ /'khor lo'i mgon po mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /rma bya brgyad kyis rab bteg rin chen khri/ /pad+ma nyi zla 'od zer 'bar ba'i dbus/ /mgon khyod rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i thod phreng rtsal/ /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin ngo bor rtag bzhugs gsol/ /be+e ro'i rnam sprul 'gyur med rdo rje rtsal/ /mgrin pa'i 'khor lo grol ba'i ngag gi dbang / /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i bstan srog 'dzin pa'i ched/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor g.yo med brtan par shog /rigs 'dzin gter bdag gling pa'i rang skal du/ /zab rgyas chos dad dam rdzas yod do cog /gegs med spyan drangs kha ba'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /phan bde nyi ma'i dngos brgya 'bar bar shog /skyon mkhan po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /smin grol ring lugs 'dzin pa 'dus pa'i gling / /rnam gsum 'khor lo'i rim pa —268

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bla nas blar/ /dkar cha'i zla ba ji bzhin 'phel bar shog /bka' gter dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /yi dam sgrub pa bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha/ /ma mgon dregs pa'i sdod pon bcasapa yis/ /bsam don ma lus grub par mdzad du gsol/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen mkha' dbyings ngos/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i chu 'dzin khrigs pa las/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'dod dgu'i char/ /mchog dman bar ma'i 'jig rten kun khyab shog /ces pa 'di'ang rgyal dbang pad+ma'i gdung 'tshob chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa'i dbon kun dga' tshul khrims rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni (199na)dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /ngo mtshar zhing khams bde ldan skyed tshal du/ /'dab stong ze'u 'brur kun phan nya gang steng / /mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar pad rwag mdangs 'od can/ /mgon po tshe mtha' yas pa'i thugs rje'i mthus/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang grags snyan bstan/ /rgya mtsho'i gos kyi pha mtha' de srid bar/ /spel phyir 'gyur med g.yung drung rang bzhin du/ /smon pa'i re 'bras lhun gyis 'grub par shog /stobs bcu mnga' ba bzhi ldan mngon gyur bar/ /'khor ba mya ngan thang las nyer bsgral te/ /thar pa'i rin chen gling du yongs bgrod nas/ /'gro rnams phan bde'i 'dod dgus tshim byed shog /ces pa 'di'ang ri sgo shag lho pa blo bzang mkhas btsun gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ / tshangs gnas 'khor lo'i lte bar seng khri'i steng / /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos dga' ba'i bshes gnyen la/ /snying nas mi phyed gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod rdo rje lta bur brtan par shog /dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum ma lus pa/ /'dus pa'i ngo bor rab mos byin rlabasamathus/ /bdag sogs 'di phyi bar do thams cad du/ /bde skyid dga' ston dpal la spyod par shog /ces pa'ang lha bris pa legs pa rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /bzhi yis lhag pa'i bcu phrag dngul dkar las/ /pad+ma'i (199ba/ri dab can dam rdzas gtor ma'i —269

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenasnod/ /sngags ban blo bzang ngag dbang gis phul mthus/ /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus char du phob//ces gram pa ba blo bzang ngag dbang gis dge skos kyi 'jog la phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /ye k+ṣa ra pra dzñā pa bla gya na sa ra rwa ba ma spu klo ba ro pa ya swā du raḥ.e dbyings shes rab pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru'i bcud/ /waṃ yig thabs mchog bh+ra ma ras myangs pas/ /su pa na da shu mu ཿ ha mon du/ tā ba spyi gi tho ḍa bī ya to mi tri ka/ /bde stong dngas ma'i sbrang rtsi lha gi rgyun/ /dhū tir mngon 'dod rtse dga'i mdza' na mo/ /phyi ru gnas gsum ḍā gī yongs kyi gtso/ /nang gi rdo rje btsun mo waṃ gi dbyibs/ /gsang ba sems nyid gcig bu'i rnam 'phrul gyi/ /gsal stong mkha' la spyod pa'i smin legs ma/ /bla med theg pa'i gnad kun dbang bzhi sa /tshang pa rgyal (200na〉yum khyod kyi bskyod rdzogs lam/ /nyamasabastar nye snying bklags pa dam bca'i gzugs/ /ri mo yid mkhar nam yang ma yal mthus/ /dril bu'i zhabs dang rje btsun nā ro pa/ /'khon rigs 'jam mgon tshar pa yab sras sogs/ /gong ma'i rnar thar bdag gis nyer 'gyongs nas/ /rten 'dir rab mdzes lha mos zhal ston gsol/ /skal dman tshe gcig mkha' spyod ma 'grub na/ /sgyu ma'i skyas chen 'degs dus rjes btsun mas/ /semasagyi khye'u chung dpa' bo dpa' mo'i grong / /khrid nas zung 'jug go 'phang mngon 'gyur shog /ming btags skye ba'i grags skam ma yin par/ /gaṅgā'i klung rdul snyed kyi sprul pa'i gar/ /zhing khams rgya mtshor bsgyur nas 'gro 'dren pa/ /'phags chen dam pa'i rnam thar 'dzin par shog /bshad yams blos byas zog rdzun dang bral ba/ /snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi yis brgyan pa'i chos/ /rnam dag bstan pas skal bzang gdul bya kun/ /'dren pa'i ded dpon mchog tu bdag 'gyur shog /ces pa 'di'ang legs sbyar gyi bstan bcos pā ṇi pa sogs gtsug lag rgya mtshor blo gros gyi 'jug pa yangs pa se —270

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)skar rigs kyi theg le 'dar lo ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub kyis/ dge sbyor gyi dmigs rten du rdo rje btsun po'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar slob bshad pa za hor brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal (200ba)dbyangs/ /blo bzang grags pa'i cho me srid bstan/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can mthar spel ba'i/ /mgon khyod tshe dpag med pa ltar/ /'khor ba ma stongs bar bzhugs nas/ /'gro kun phan dang bde ba yi/ /phul byung dga' ston rtag sbyor shog /zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan/ /de 'dzin dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde/ /rgya hor bod yul yongs khyab cing / /lusacan ngal gsor 'gyur bar shog /sa skyong rgyal po'i sku tshe dang / /mnga' thang chab srid mtshan jus rgyas/ /ngag gis 'di bskul mchod sprin sbyor/ /dbang ba'i shes rab rab tu rgyal/ /dpal ldan myur mdzad ye shes mgon po dang / /dbyer med bla ma snying ga'i pad+ma sa /byang chub bar du mi 'bral rtag bzhugs nas/ /mchog mthun dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /zhes pa'ang bsam blo chos rgya mtsho'i ngor za hor bsdos sbyar/ /ngag la brjod pa rnam dag dbang phyug blos/ /skal bzang rgya mtsho dga' bskyed 'dren pa mchog/'og min zhing mgon lta bur rtag bzhugs nas/ /phan bde'i nyi mas 'jigs rten gsum khyab shog /gsung ngag chad med dbang dang grol ba'i lam/ /legs ston bla ma yi dam chos srung tshogs/ /kun bzang mchod pas mnyes byed shes rab kyis/ /ma smad ri mo thags su bskrun 'di mtshar/ /zhes pa'ang wā gis pra dzñās rtsol bas bsgrubs pa'i tshe skṛ du su ra pri ya su mi tras bris pa dge bar gyur cig/gtsang (201na)byed 'dab stong ke sa ra yi dbus/ /mtshan dpe'i lang tsho mig gi gzil dngar can/ /gzhom med 'pho ba chen po'i sku 'grub pa'i/ /thod phreng rtsal sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma dang //zhi khro 'dus so cog gi rten brten par/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i khyab bdag he ru ga: /che mchog dpal dgu'i ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /rnam gsum yo gar 'byams klas yi dam lha/ /pho rgyud mo rgyud snang —271

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenasrid dregs pa'i tshogs/ /gnyis med rig pa'i rang rtsal khrag 'thung dbang / /dgra srog gcod la dpal mgon ma ning nag /gnam lcags spu gri ngar ma'i bstan srung kyi/ /ding dus pad 'byung gsung gi sras gcig pu/ /be+e ro'i rnam sprul zab gter chos kyi sgo/ /'byed mdzad rdo rje sems dpa' mi yi grol/ /nyer 'dzin gang gi bzhed pa'i snying po'i don/ /dngos nyams gter byon lung bstan las byung ltar/ /skyon smin grol gling zhes rig sngags sde'i/ /gas la dang dpa' bo'i grong khyer gyi/ /dgon gnas las kyi 'khor lo'i mdzad pa'i 'bras/ /rgyal bstan snying po'i yang snying theg pa'i rtse/ /bka' gter zung 'jug snga 'gyur ring lugs kyis/ /kha ba'i sman ljongs dog por yongs bkod mthus/ /e nyi ya na'i gling dang mtshungs par shog /rgyal sras gter bdag gling pa'i sku tshe 'phreng / /kun sgrol pha mthar phyin nas rang skal gter/ /rdzogs par gdan drangs de 'dzin smin grol gling / /chos srid mtha' dag bla nas blar 'phel 3(ga /pad+ma 'byung gnas dgyes (201ba)pa'i spyan ras kyi/ /gzigs pa mi yol rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ /zil gnon 'jam dpal grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin/ /a lha srog gi ka ba tshugs par shog /mi bsrun brlang por spyod pa dgra bgegs dpung / /phyogs mtshams steng 'og gar gnas ma lus pa/ /rtsa gsum mthu stobs 'bar ba'i thog mda' yis/ /phyer btags ming gi lhag mar gtong bar shog /gnam bskos dga' ba ldan pa'i pho brang nas/ /yangs pa'i sa chen skyong ba rgyal po'i khrims/ /gser gyi gnya' shing mchog dman mtha' dag gi /phrag par nam yang mi 'gyur lci bar shog /bod yul swā la'i ljongs 'khod 'bangs rnams kun/ /g.yul zhabrug dbul phongs nad rims rtsod pa'i skyon/ khongs bral ring po'i tshe dang rnam thos bu'i/ /dpal 'byor la spyod rdzogs ldan dus ltar shog /rigs 'dzin rje la dngos brgyud 'brel thogs tshogs/ /skye bar sgrib pa'i lus kyi 'ching rgya las/ /grol nas zhi ba'i go 'phang bde ba che/ /myong ba'i bzang po'i skal pa can 'gyur shog/de ltar bden brjod smon lam sa bon rnams/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i brlan gsher gyis smin pas/ /ba ched don dpag bsam yongs 'du sa brtol 'bras/ /las ldan 'chi med dga' ston la spyod —272

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)shog /ces pa 'di'ang gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rdo rje gling pa sogs gter ston rim par byon pa'i yang srid sprul pa'i skye mchog pad+ma dbang 'gyur med rdo rje rtsal gyis g.yo ru gra phyi yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i yul grur skyon smin grol gling par grags pa'i sngags (202na〉sde'i rten brten pa mtha' dag 'phrin las kyi cha shas las legs par bskrun pa'i tshe gzungs 'bul gyi spel tshig dang tshogs 'don gyi ched du rtsoms shig par bkas bskul ba dang du blangs te za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /zho ba chikhi sna lhag pa'i nyer gnyis srang gi dngul/ /lab grub kong bu phul bas ma rig mun/ /gsal byed ye shes sgron mes 'jig rten gsum/ /phan bde'i snang ba mchog la 'god par shog /ces pa rtses dang brag gdong pa blo bzang tshe dbang gis sngags rams pa byas skabs dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brjes bkod do/ /mkhyen brtse rab tu yangs pa'i blo ldan mas/ /rdo rje btsun mo sgrub pa nye ba'i lam/ /bstar pa'i 'bras bus ma dang dpa' bo'i gling / /mkha' spyod zhing du thogs med bgrod byin rlobs/ /nga rgyal ser sna'i las sgrib bag chags kun/ /yongs dag tshar ba'i phung po gnas bsgyur te/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bor sangs rgyas nas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' snyed 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog /slob lam spyod tshe tshad ma bzhi ldan chos/ /ston pa'i rdo rje sems dngos bshes gnyen gyis/ /rjes bzung 'dus pa gsum gyi 'phrang bsgal te/ /ring min zung 'jug ye shes mngone 'gyur shog /ces 'a zha mkhyen rab blo ldan gyi phyi rten du 'a zha mkhyen rab rnam rgyal gyis rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mor rin 'byung gis bskor ba'i brgya thang bzhengs pa'i tshe dgos tshul ltar (202ba)za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam grags so/ /zil gnon 'jam dpal dpa' bo bzhad pa rtsal/ /'khor lo'i mgon por nges nas gsol 'debs na/ /g.yo med rdo rje ltar brtan byin rlabs kyis/ /bdud rtsis bdag snying za ma tog 'gang —273

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (na)shog /ces pa'ang nam mkha' rgya mtshos dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bris/ /dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i 'dus gling gi /sangs rgyas gnyis pa rim byon rin chen khri'i/ /mdzes rgyan sprul pa'i zlos gar ngag gi dbang / /blo bzang bstan pa 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod spyi dang khyad par mtha' 'khob kyi/ /'gro rnams thar par khrid pa'i ded dpon du/ /tshe dpag med mgon lta bur rab brtan zhing / /chos 'khor rgyun chad med par skor bar shog /ces shar khang chos kyi rgyal po'i brtan bzhugs 'di ni 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i sku'i gsung gis bskul ba bzhin za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /ma 'dris lus can kun gyi gnyen gcig pu/ /lnga brgya'i mgon po shākya seng ge yi/ /bstan pa'i grib mar 'gro rnams ngal gso ba/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /dad pa'i me long ngos su thugs rje'i gzugs/ /mngon sum shar ba'i byin rlabs med po ches/ /skye bar dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten rnyed nas/ /ring min stobs bcu mnga' ba thob par shog /ces pa'ang u chu mu chu che chen ching dbang gi de shi dang /(203na)po ro gnyis kyi ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /dbyer med seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma la/ / deng nas byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /gsol 'debs so thugs rjesabyin gyis rlobs/ /glang chen seng ge me dang spyon pa sbrul/ /lcags sgrog sha za rgya mtsho'i 'jigs grol te/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor mnga' thang sogs/ /thun mong 'dod pa'i re ba yongs 'grub shog /skye ba kun tu mi khom gnas brgyad spangs/ /mtho ris skas las thar pa'i khang par zhugs/ /nying mtshams sbyar dus bde ldan zhing khams su/ /skyes nas 'od dpag med kyi rjes 'dzan shog /ces pa'ang skyid thang nor bu dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rang lus zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor chen po mā /mngon sum ngo sprad khyab bdag bla ma dang / /dbyer med rigs 'dzin rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /rig pa'i rang ngor nges pas gsol ba 'debs/ /ma —274

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rig mal du mi khom gnyid po che/ /sang byed rtsa gsum thugs rje'i skya rengs mas/ /yang srid bcu gnyis khyim kun mngon mtho dang / /nges legs snang ba'i rtsed 'jor rol bar shog /skyabs mchog bla ma lhar bcas byin rlabs kyis/ /gnas skabs nad gdon dbul phongs dgra las rgyal/ /ring 'tsho'i tshe dang longs spyod dbang thang rnams/ /'chi med bdag po'i dpal dang skal (203bsgo nyam shog /rang rig pad 'byung gdod nas lhun grub gdangs/ /ma 'dres 'od lngar mngon sum shar ba'i rtsal/ /chos nyid zad sar 'byol nas 'pho ba che/ /tshe 'dir nyams su myong bar bdag byin rlobs/ /drug ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dang / /chos nor gter srung mthu ldan tsho gos rnams kyis/ /mchog thun dngosagrub char kyis bdag rgyud zhing / /nyer brlan gtan bde'i myu gu smin par shog /ces gra phyi smon grub pa rin chen bkra shis kyis byang gter thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi nyams len dang 'brel ba 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rgyal kun ngo bo tshe dbang rigs 'dzin dang / /dbyer med ches chog 'dus rtsal bla ma rje/ /snying dbus pad+ma ra bzhugs la gsol 'debs na/ /byang chub bar du byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /rtsa gsum thugs rje rten 'brel mi bslu dang / /bdag sogs rnams kyis dad mthus mgon po khyod/ /sku tshe g.yung drung rang bzhin ltar gyur nas/ /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub par shog /ces pa'ang rta dpon rnam 'joms kyis ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrigs pa'i tshe za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /bde ldan zhing mgon phyag gi bum bzang las/ /zag med bdung rtsi tshe yi snying po'i bcud/ /reg pa'i mod la 'gro rnams 'chi bdag gi/ /me tog mda' can g.yul las rgyal bar mdzod/ /(204na〉pe yi seng ge'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i rje/ /mi shigs rdo rje'i khri la rtag bzhugs nas/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu yangs pa'i bde ba cher/ /mi sogs ltar bcas 'gro kun sbyor bar shog /tshangs sras —273

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedangag gi dbang phyug ngang mo dkar/ /blo gros 'o ma'i rdzing bur rtag rgyu bas/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho ches/ /mtha' klas bskal pa'i bar du khyab par shog /pha rol rgol bar 'jigasamed 'chad rtsod dang / /rtsom pa'i go cha brtan pos thub bstan gyis/ /lang tsho slar 'phel thos bsam sgom pa'i sde/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes khyod zhabs brtan shog /dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzugs/ /gtsang rong sar 'phos byams chen 'dus tshogis gling / /srid mtha'i bar du bshad dang sgrub pa yis/ /dkar cha'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar shog /'jig rten kun tu 'gro rnams nad mtshon dang / /dbul phongs nyes brgya'i dri ma nyer zhi zhing / /rdzogs ldan dus ltar bde skyid phun tsho gos la/ /spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por bdag 'gyur shog /ces ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad 'di'ang gso rig gtsug lag 'dzin pa sgo mo rab pa rat+na sī shas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi ban+desasbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /dpa' gtum stag steng gar dgu'i nyams 'gyur can/ /'chol ba'i khro rgyal gnam lcags phur bu yis/ /bdud dpung tshar bcad tshe yi bar gcod kun/ /brtul (244ba〉stugs drag po'i stobasakyis thal bar rlog /mtsho skyes rigs 'dzin bla ma'i thugs rje'i mthus/ /'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ /mi 'gyur srog gi ka ba g.yung drung gi /ngo bor byin rlabs bas mas don lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di'ang lha sab blo bzang rab brtan gyis kha ton du dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /kha tshar phun tshar dang ldan za 'og gi /rnam bkra ngo mtshar ri mo bkod legs can/ /skyabasagasum dam par bskrun pa'i sri zhu yis/ /tsho gis gnyis phung po bla nas blar mtho shog /bgrang yas zhi khro dge 'dun dkon mchog gzugs/ /skye rgya'i mig la mngon sum rab gsal bar/ /bkur sti'i ched du gnam rgyan yongs spel bas/ /'khor 'das yon tan dbyar mtsho ltar 'phyur shog /mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab spun tshas phul ba'i kha byang za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa dge /—276

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dpal ldan rtsa gsum mthu byin rab 'bar bas/ /bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par yongs rgyal ba/ /srid zhi'i phan bde'i 'byung gnas rdo rje'i theg /legs bshad dbyangs snyan 'brol ba'i 'dul gling du/ /rgya hor bzang gos sna tshogs nyer bsgrigs nas/ /nam mkha'i rgyan du sgo 'phar phye ba'i mdzod/ /mchod sprin spro byed ngag dbang shes rab kyi/ /ston mtshan zla 'dra'i lhag bsam gyisaphul mthus/ /thub bstan de 'dzin sder bcas mtha' klas 'gro'i/ /bsod (205na skoms bye ba'i zhing du nyer 'phel zhing / /rgyu sbyor 'di dang gtan gyi legs tshogos kun/ /rab rgyas 'dod pa'i re ba yongs skong shog /dmar ser can zhes pa me mo sbrul gyi lor ding phon/ hor gos bar snang mdzod le tshan/ rgya gos thon thi tshon khra/ rgyan bzhi sogs gos sna tsho gis las grub pa'i rgyur gra rgan dang lha sa gnas tshad kyis gsum bcad 'bring por brtsis pa'i gong thang gser zho brgyad brgya ri ba 'bras spungs gsang sngags pho brang gi khri'i steng lho tal rgyud/ shar gling gnyis/ nub gling gnyis/ byang gling gcig bcas 'du khang khebs pa'i bla bre yar klungs khe gsum pa mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab spun tshas phul ba'i tshe kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa la:/ /sgrib shar:nga gnyis pa bral rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /ris med 'gro 'dren rjes su nyer 'jug pas/ /kun ra yongs khyab gnam rgyan 'di'i ched du/ /'bad rnams don gnyis lhun gyisagrub par mdzod/ /rgyal nub gling dang po ba zhi khro'i rol gar bstan pa'i sku/ /rab bzhugs pho brang mkha' khyab mdzes rgyan gyi/ tsos bu 'khor dang myang 'das rnam par smin/ /ches dkar byang chub bar du myong bar shog /rdzogs nu skrug6pa/ ldan skye rgu lta bu'i ring po'i tshe/ /phun tshogs lor par myong ba'i bde skyid la/ /yon sbyor phan pa sgrub kun longs spyod par/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pas byin gyis rlobs/ /gnod byang gling / byed gzugs (205bcan gzugs med nag po'i mun/ /rtsa gsum thugs rje chen po'i nyi 'od kyis/ /ming gi lhag mar byas nas phan dang bde'i/ /snang ba dam pa'i gzi byin 'bar bar shog /—277—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhanarigs rnams kun gyi rgyal srid chen po'i khrir/ /hor gos lhab lhub mnye shun legs bskrun pa'i/ /dge tshogs bde phyi bar gyi mdun ma dag /lhun gyis grub par mchog gsum mthus byin rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang gsang sngags pho brang gi khri'i mnye 'bol dang 'bol shun khebs dang bcas hor gos las grub pa mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis phul ba'i kha byang za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa dge /gong gsal dang sngon ma'i gnam rgyan gyi a long rgyab sha bla bre'i sham bu sogs khyon bsdoms rin thang gser zho stong dang so bdun song ngo / /za 'og sna tshogs ri mo rab mdzes pa/ /dbang gzhu ltar bkra spel legs 'phan gyi 'phreng / /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zhing khams 'phrul snang gi /rten dang brten par bcas la phul ba'i dge /zur rigs sngags 'chang gu ru spun zla brgyud/ /khyo shugs mtha' dag tshe 'dir rdzogs ldan ltar/ /bde skyid dpal la yun du spyod pa dang / /bgrang ring skye bar lha mi'i lus thob nas/ /rang g.yin don gnyis grub pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang mngon gyur 'dis mtsho ni dge ba kun/ /mi mdzad byang chub chen po'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes gzhis ka shar pa a gur nang mir bcas pa'i gon pa'i phyi sha sogs bzang gos sna tshogs las grub pa'i 'phan me (206na〉sgrul sa ga zla ba'i dus chen gsum 'dzom gyi nyin 'phrul snang du phul ba'i smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i/ /mar go spyi/ gang gi yon tan cha tsam dran pa'i mod/ /'khor 'das gdung gcil kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen/ /sras dang slob mar bcas la sri zhu zhi gos/ /bla bre lhag bsam dag pas yongasang phul dges/ /zad pa'i mtha' bral mar gyur 'gro ba rnams/ /sdug bsngal gsum las rnam grol nges legs kyi/ /rin chen khang par bde ba chen po la/ /longs su spyod byin rlobasashig 'phags mchog kye/ /bsod nams byas 'bras 'dzad med chu gter che/ /nyes tshogs ro dang lhan cig mi gnas shing / /tshe dang dbang thang gtan mdun thar pa'i bde'i/ /yid bzhin nor gyi 'dod —278

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dgu bsnyel bar shog /jo shā ma sbyar/ thub dbang zhal skyin mthong bas don ldan par/ /gos bzang bla gos phul bas skye ba kun/ /rnam dag cho ga la brten rab byung nas/ /gtsang ma'i tshul khrims bsrung bar bdag byin rlobs/ /byam pa chos lor/ yid dga' chos 'dzin mgon po 'dzam gling 'dir/ /dngos byon lta bu'i snang brnyan 'od srungs ches/ /ye shes sems dpa' bcug pa'i byams chen mes/ /bdud bzhi'i tshang tshing ma lus bsreg par shog /byams pa khrus mdzad/lha gcig srong btsan yab yum khrus gsol ba'i/ /sman 'dams las grub ma pham mgon po yis/ /spyi dang khyad par gangs can du kha'i (206bsgon/ /mthar byas phan bde'i 'od kyis 'geng bar mdzod/ /rje gas sgrol ma/ rgyal ba kun yum ārla tā rā kye/ /bdag sogs 'gro la gzigs pa'i spyan ras kyis/ /'jigs chen brgyad mtshon nyes tshogs las skyabs nas/ /dga' zhing skyid pa'i dpal la rtag tu sbyor/ /bka' 'gyur rin po che/thub rnams mdzad pa'i yang rtse lung gi chos/ /glegs bam gzugs shar 'gyur ro ro cog gi bka'/ /mthong thos dran dang reg pas rnam grol ba'i/ /don bzang bdag sogs 'gro rgyud la 'jug shog yas༅/ 'gro ngor nyan thos tshul gyis thub pa'i bstan/ /'dzin kyang tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs sangs rgyas dngos//'phags pa'i gnas brtan rnams kyis nyes brgya'i mun/ /mthar byas sgo gsum sim pa myong byin rlobs/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ mtshan legs rin chen zla ba gser bzang dang / /mya ngan med dpal chos sgrags mngone par mkhyen/ /sman bla shākya thub pa'i lha tshogs kyis/ / bdag sogs snyigs ma'i lus can rjes su bzung / mchod rten gangs la nyi shar/ mi 'gyur chos sku bde gshegs thugs kyi rten/ /byin rlabs gzi byin rab 'bar rmad po che/ /gangs la nyi ma shar ltar mkha' mnyam 'gro'i/ /dug lnga'i smag rum dpung tshogs pha mthar mdzod/ /dmar ser can gyi lo sa ga zla ba'i nang du stod hor gyi gos rgya gos tshoni khra khyad mtshar drang gser gzhi ma gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i ber nyer gcig nang ldan/ra sa 'phrul snang dang ra mo che'i gnam rgyan du phul zhing 'gan sbyar gnyis la bla gos kyi tshal bus brgyan te jo shāka gnyis la phul ba'i che ba byang du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar (207na tha'i yi ge pa ni —279

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedaganas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /gcad byed 'dab stong grol las sprul pa'i gar/ /rgyal kun yongs 'dus rnga yab gling pa yi/ /thugs gsang byin chen nyer 'phros 'od zer gyis/ /'jig rten gsum snang dge ba'i shis pa stsol/ /pad+ma thod phreng ring lugs 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /skad gnyis smra ba be+e ro'i sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /legs bstan mkhas grub yang srid gangs ljongs mkhar/ /ngo mtshar sprul pa'i zla ba tshes par shog /bslu med rten 'brel mthu yis rtsa gsum dang / /chos srung phrin las sa bon rab smin pas/ /smon lam dpag bsam ljon pa rgyas pa'i rtser/ /'dod don 'bras bzang snye mas dud gyur cig /ces rtse le sprul pa'i sku pad+ma legs grub kyi sprul sku myur 'byon gyi smon lam dgos tshul bu slob spyi tshogs nas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam grags pa'o/ / rgyud mangs glu las chos kyi dbyangs snyan sgra/ /'brol yang srin mo'i gzugs can re ma tī/ /zhi ba'i las la dung skyong ston zla'i bzhin/ /'chi med lus phra'i lang tsho'i dpal 'phrog kye/ /'khor lo'i ri mo rnam par bkra ba'i gdugs/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod dang chabs cig par/ /dbang lnga'i yul du zag bral bde ba'i gdangs/ /yongs shar bsod nams tshangs pa'i yul brgal des/ /las gzhi gser sgong yongs su smin pa'i sbubs/ /gangs can bstan 'gro'i bde skyid zhal sgo las/ /chos nor 'dod thar dga' ston la spyod ba'i/ /re skong dpag bsam snye ma (207ba'i da par mdzod/ /ces snron zla'i bzang po'i tshes la dpal ldan dung skyong mar dbu khebs bum gdan ma phul ba'i kha byang du za hor gyi brnyes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i/ /srid zhi'i 'jigs pa kun skyob lha yi lha/ /mthong bas rnam grol shākya mu ne'i skur/ /bkra shis 'khor lo'i ri mo rab bkra ba/ /ngur smrig gos zungs phul ba'i legs byas 'bras/ /mtha' dang tshad du gzhal dka'i ma gyur 'gro/ /'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i gru bo che/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang myur thob nas/ /nges legs rin chen gling du 'khrid byin rlobs/ /bsil ldan skye rgu'i phan —280

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bde'i rtsa lag gzhi/ /blo bzang snyan pa'i grags 'bar cho me srid kyi/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma 'jig rten gsum gyi mkhar/ /rtag tu 'char ba'i 'od snang 'bar bar shog /ces me sprul snon zla'i bzang po'i tshes la jo bo shākya mu ne'i na bza' bum gdan ma phul ba'i kha byang du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'o/ /bslu med dkon mchog rin chen thugs rje dang / /mi phyed dad pa'i rten cing 'brel 'byung mthus/ /nam mkha'i mtha' khyab 'gro ba 'dren pa la/ /rnam pa rab bkra rtag tu shis par shog /yang srid phyi mar 'dren byed spyod yul du/ /bshes gnyen dam pas ma' sum nyer blta bar/ /legs smin sa bon yongs dud a ma'i shing / /re ba'i 'bras bu ro brgya'i dpal ldan shog /ces pa 'di'ang bya lung bla ma nam mkha' bkra shis kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /(208na) dṛ sna na 3 lu su ni mi ta ba 'o ḍa : rlu ba 〉 khu su pu yi dzaḥmathong na mi mthun med pa'i mtshan bzang can/ /bcu drug lang tsho'i cha shas gang ba'i gzis/ /no : byi ba lha lha ga 'i ku na sta tra gyu snyi : yu dza ya mā ta nā rnye/ /'chi med lus phra rgyu skar tshogs kyi zil/ /gnon mdzad rgyal ba kun yum 'phags ma kye/ /bskal mang thibs por spungs pa mun pa'i smag /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gcig shar sangs pa bzhin/ /sgrib gnyis des bskyed srid zhi'i sdug bsngal rnams/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs rjesagazhil bar mdzod/ /'dod zhen nyer 'a lcangasang rgyal zhe sdang ba/ /phrag dog lta ngan the tshom nyes kun gzhi/ /gti mug 'jigs chen brgyad kyis 'khor ba'i mtshor/ /'phyan las myur du sgrol zhig rje btsun ma/ /mtho ris yon tan bcun tshang rten bzang po/ /chad med legs thob bde ldan dag zhing du/ /(20sha skor dbang 'od mtha' yas pas rjes bzung te/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub par bdag byin —281—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenarlobs/ /snang brnyan 'di sgrub byed por gtogs so cog /dpal mo khyod zhabs dran pa'i mod nyid la/ /'khor 'das 'jigs kun ming yang mi grag par/ /srid dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs slar 'phel shog /ces me sbrul snon gyi zla bar rje btsun seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i sku brnyan dad rten du ri mo ba dbu mdzad rag kha a bar dang / dgos bsam gnyis kyis bzabs bris su byas pa'i tshe rgyab yig gi smon lam du za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa san+tarba ni rā stog bha wastu/ /kye ma srog gcod spangs pa'i rnam par smin/ /gcig tu dkar por 'dzag pa mu thi la/ /tshe yi g.yung drung nya phyis khog yangs por/ /legs 'khyil rten cing 'brel 'byung slu med shog /lusang ga yid gsum bag yod ra ba sa /nyer bcug bsod nams dang drags sa srung dbang / /blo mig stong ldan thub bstan chos bzang gi /rin chen khri la rtag tu 'gying bar shog /rgya che'i gtsug lag rgyud mang glur 'dren pa/ /mtsho byung mgrin chags 'chad rtsod rtsom pa la/ /'jigs pa med par rnam dpyod yangs pa'i go /dkar cha'i zla ba ltar 'phel brtan par shog /bdud bzhi nyer thub shākya seng ge'i bstan/ /thos bsams rab bsgoms lang tsho rgyas pa'i sde/ /khrims ldan 'dus pa'i tsho gis kyis rtse gcig tu/ /smon pa'i 'bras bu yongs su smin par shog /rgyal (209na༄sa nyan rang gtsang ris mgon rnams kyi/ /bden tshig mthu yis kun mkhyen tsong kha pa'i/ /bstan pa gdugs dkar grib mar 'jig rten gsum/ /bde ba'i stegs la dga' skyid ngal gsor shog /ces rten 'byung gi tshigs bcad 'di ni shar phyogs bstan pa'i sgron me dwags gra tshang bla spyi thun mong nas don gnyer chen pos dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /ston mtshan zla bas bsgrun min bzhin ras kyi/ /dkyus ring spyan ras gzigs pa'i mod nyid la/ /'chi ba'i dngos kun 'joms pa 'phags ma'i zhabs/ /yid bzhin 'khor los phun tshogs dga' ston stsol/ /rgyal dbang blo bzang grags pa'i bstan srid rgyun/ /mi 'dzad mchod sbyin sgo brgya —282

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'byed mkhas pa/ /sa spyod khrims gnyis srong ba'i 'gyur med khrir/ /g.yung drung lta bur zhabs zung rtag brtan shog /rnam dag brjod pa'i bden tshig khug pa la/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i lcags kyu yongs btab pas/ /sum rtsen sar snyeg ring 'tsho'i sku tshe yi/ /skal pa 'jig rten mes po dang mnyam shog /ces sa skyong blo bzang sbyin pa'i brtan bzhugs 'di shar phyogs dwags gra tshang bla sa bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen ngag gi dbang / /blo bzang grags snyan rab 'bar bstan pa yi/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can kun bzod yangs (209ba)pa'i mtha'/ /'ching mdzad rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan dpung la 'jigs med pa/ /'gro la rjes chags byamasabartse'i go cha yis/ /thub bstan lang tsho rgyas pa' dpyod ldan sde/ /mtshungs bral yongs 'dzin mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam mnyen pad+ma zla ba nya gang steng / /tshe mtha' yas pa'i skur gsal tshangasadabyangs sgras/ /gdul byar dga' ston spel ba'i ma 'dris bshes/ /skye rgu'i dpung gnyen bskal brgyar mi g.yo shog /ngag dbang mkhyen pa'i 'od kyis blo mun mthar/ /nyer bskrad don bzang rgya che'i rjod byed gzhung / /mtsho ltar gting dpag dka' la 'jigs med mgon/ /rdo rje'i khri la 'gyur ba med par shog /g.yin zer tshig rjes mi 'brang grub mtha' bzhi'i/ /bzhed srol go rim ma 'khrugs cha rdzogs pas/ /thub dbang bstan pa'i snying po thos bsam sgom/ /spel phyir 'og min mgon ltar brtan par shog /lang long g.yo ba'i sprin dbus dbyar rnga'i sgras/ /rma bya mngal khur 'dzin tsho'i dga' bskyid na/ /swā la'i sman ljongs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar brgya/ /'byed ched gsol btab re ba gos ldan shog /bgrang ring bgrod dka'i skye ba thams cad du/ /mgon po khyod kyis nyer bstan dam pa'i chos zab rgyas nyams su bstar bas gnas skabs dang / /mthar thug don kun lhun sa grub par shog /khyad par khrag 'thung rdo rje gzhen nu yis/ /rjes bzung 'phrin las phur pa'i rigs 'dzin du/ /gyur nasabadud sde'i g.yul las rab rgyas zhing / /rang (210na)rig dpal chen rang ngo myur 'phrod shog /—283—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenamador na dus gsum bsags pa'i legs byas mthus/ /'bras bu ro brgya bda' bar mkha' mnyam gyi/ /ma gyur 'gro dang lhan cig longs spyod par/ /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam ji bzhin bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di'ang bya rigs rnam snang gi btsun pa rnam gling chos mdzad ngag dbang blo gsal gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam grags pa'o/ /phun tshogs ngo mtshar med byung bkod par deng / /seng ge'i nga ror bstan kyang thugs rje'i nyi/ /'jig rten gsum mkhar 'char nub nyer spangs pa/ /kun mkhyen tsong kha pa des dge legs stsol/ /mgon de'i bshad sgrub bstan la ngag gi dbang / /blo gros lang tsho rgyas pa'i skal bzang can/ /gtsug lag rgya mtshor lta ba'i mig yangs pa/ /ris bral skye rgu'i gnyen du mi g.yo shog /ngag gi dbang phyug dkon mchog rnam gsum dang / /dbyer med bstan pa'i nyi ma yongs 'du'i ljon/ /bskal brgyar zhabs brtan rib mar gdul bya rnams/ /ngal gsos bde skyid dga' ston myong thob shog /gangs can ra bas yongs bskor stod smad kyi/ /rigs lam smra ba gzhan gyis zla bral ba/ /chos grags ring lugs snang ba 'od po ches/ /kun khyab 'dus sde rtag tu dar bar shog /rgya chen spyod dang zab mo lta ba yi/ /dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam srung mar bcas/ /bden tshig grub pa rnams kyi nus pa'i mthus/ /smon lam ci btab re 'bras 'grub par shog /'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes 'phyos pa sku skye bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor (210ba)za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /'jam dpal rdo rje tsong kha pa'i/ /snang brnyan lhag pa'i bsam pa yis/ /legs bskrun dge bas tshe rabs su/ /rjes bzung dam chos 'dzin par shog /mos ngor gdan gsum yongs tshang ba/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sdes/ /skye ba kun tu bshes mdzad nas/ /rang rgyud smin cing grol bar shog /ces rab 'byams pa blo bzang skyes mchog gis dad rten bzhengs pa'i kha byang dgos tshul bzhin za hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /—284

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs grags pas nyams len gyi dad rten du dgyes mdzad rdo rje gtso bor gyur pa'i sku bas bzhengs tshe rgyab yig gnang ba sogs/spru lo t+ta ra t+ta sa ni de na sa ཿ r+sā ཿ ha ma khyi lu sa re sha nye go:rtsa ba'i bla ma gdan gsum yongs tshang ba/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug kye rdo rjer/ /yo da skya bi rnyo t+ta ma na sa spru la smo sho bha ra sno ba ma la ya sho bhaḥshar ba rgyud ldan 'dren mchog rigs kun bdag /spel legs rin chen 'phreng ltar rab mdzes pa/ /lam bzang nges gsang theg (211na)pa'i nying khu'i bcud/ /tshe 'dir bcu gsum rdo rje'i sar bgrod pa/ /sa skya'i bla chen kho na'i khyad par chos/ /nyams su bstar la dmigs rten 'di ko med/ /grub thob yongs kyi 'khor sgyur bi ྅ pa'i/ /rnal 'byor spyod pas me tog mnga' can sde/ /rgya mtsho'i mthar bskrad mchog thun dngos grub kyi/ /byin rlabs gzi byin nyi ma stong las 'bar/ /mnar med bud shing sdig kyang ming tsam du/ /gtong zhing bde chen mkha' spyod grong khyer cher/ /zangs thal 'khrid byed rje btsun rnal 'byor ma/ /nā ro ta pa'i snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor/ /rgya mtsho'i mthas gtugs lus can yod do cog /chos rgyal 'phags pa'i 'bangs su dbang bsdus pa/ /rig byed ma dang tshogs bdag 'dod rgyal zhes/ /thun mong bsgrubs zhin mchog gi dngos grub ster/ /nyams len rten du dge sbyong 'jam grags pas/ /dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brangs legs bzhedas pa'i/ /ri mo 'dren byed bdud rtsi 'phrul po che/ /zur rigs 'phrin las rnam par rgyal nges so/ /dngos brgyud bla mar rtse gcig gsol btab mthus/ /gzhi lam 'bras bur grol byed dbang bzhi'i rgyun/ /ma nub nyamasablangs 'dus gsum 'phrang sgrol nas/ /zung 'jug tshe 'dir 'grub nus skal ldan shog /brtul —283

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenazhugs spyod pa'i nga rgyal brtan po'i ngang / shangs sbug drag por rab spus 'thor rlung gis/ /bar chad bgegs rigs pha mthar nyer bskrad de/ /mchog thun dngos grub lag rtser son par shog /tshe 'dir ma grol dpa' mos mkhrig ma nas/ /bzung ste mngon sum khrid pa'i skal dman na/ /sgyu lus 'dor dus rdo rje btsun mo yis/ /mkha' spyod gnas su bsus nas rjes 'dzin shog /brtan g.yo'i dngosakun 'dar byed dmar 'od zhags/ /'phangs pa'i mod la srid zhi'i legs tshogos rnams/ /rang gir byed (211ba〉kyis dbang gi lha gsum gyis/ /thugs rje'i byin chen mngon sum bdag la phog /bsod nams gangs brtsegs te se'i gtsug tor nas/ /phan bde'i chu bo skyid pa'i lhung lhung sgra/ /myang 'das mtshor babs rlangs kyi chu 'dzin char/ /'gro kun byang chub lo tog smin rgyur bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di'ang sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs grags pas nyams len gyi dad rten du dgyes mdzad rdo rje gtso bor gyur ba'i sku brnyan bzhengs tshe rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar slob bshad pa za hor bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /shu kra shu kra sha ra tsā sa ko ṭa sa me 〈 lha 〈 bha pra ti lwa ka ga rbe haraḥdakar dkar ston zla bye bas bsgrun min zhing / /mdzes mdzes thig le mchog ma'i khengs pa 'phrog /po na po na dha ma tri bi na mi t+ta ti dzaḥ kā sha kwa sha rnyi tswa yu rda dzi ྅spri kā/yang yang lta bas mi ngoms mtshan dpe gzi/ /gsal gsal tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo ma/ /snyan snyan yan lag drug cu'i (212na〉zhus kyi sgra/ /khrol khrol rgyud mang stong las drangs pa bzhin/ /lhung lhung rna ba'i bcud du blangs pa'i tshe/ /sim mim yid la phan bde'i 'dod 'jo mkhan/ /yang yang lkog gyur shes bya'i pha mtha' rnams/ /zhib zhib ma 'dres 'byed pa mkhyen pa'i tshad/ /ngal ngal tshangs pas bcal kyang ma rnyed de/ /'bol 'bol stan la bskal par gnyid du g.yur/ /mtshan thos tsam gyis 'chi bdag dpung 'joms tshe/ /tshe dang ye shes stsol ba'i lha mo gang / /gang zhig ting —286

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'dzin bzlas brjod lhur len dngos/ /dngos grub thams cad lhun rgyas tsā ba mdzad ma/ /ring nasakhyod zhabs zhabs pad bsnyen pa'i blo/ /skom pa chu 'dod 'dod can nor la bzhin/ /gsol 'debs gdung shugs shugs drag gis 'bod na/ /brtse chen thugs rjes rjes su 'dzin las ci/ /thang yangasamatha' skor tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i nags/ /kho ra khor yug kha ba'i do ra 'dir/ /mthar thug don rnams thos bsam gyis sgrub bstan/ /'dzin mkhas tshul ldan pha mtha' yas khengs shog /pad rtsa ltar dkar ga bur dri ngad can/ /rtse gcig rab bsgrubs 'bras bu dus min par/ /lnga pa'i lam du 'gro las nyer bzlog ste/ /'chi med bdud rtsis snying bum gang bar mdzod/ /ming dang don ngas bcom ldan ma khyod la/ /mos gus dang bas rtse gcig gsol 'debs na/ /me tog lta bur 'jam pa'i phyag brkyang ste/ /ma lus 'gro 'dren sal khrid par shog /ces brda sprod gzhung brgya smra bar spobs pa dge ba (212ba 'dar pa lo chen ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub kyis tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bris sku gsar bzhengs kyi rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi ban+de tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes le'u dang po dang gsum pa'i dgongs don ltar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /mtshan tsam gyis kyang nges legs la bkod pa/ /'jig rten gsum na yongs grags dpal gyi rgyal/ /mgon po thugs rje chen pos rab btab pa'i/ /smon lam bdag sogs 'gro la 'grub byin rlobs/ /ma dag log lam 'phyan las 'dren mkhas shing / /srid pa'i nyes brgya zil gnon gzi brjid can/ /snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs rgyal pos rab btab pa'i/ /smon lam bdag sogs 'gro la 'grub byin rlobs/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser sbyangs bzang po'i 'od/ /mun tshogs dri med rin chen snang ba can/ /brtul zhugs grub pa'i mthu yis rab btab pa'i/ /smon lam bdag sogs 'gro la 'grub byin rlobs/ /'khor ba mya ngan tshogs la 'jigs med pa/ /mchog gi mdzad pa'i dpal gyi rgyal po yis/ /skye rgu yongs la rjes brtses rab btab pa'i/ /smon lam bdag sogs 'gro la 'grub byin —287

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenarlobs/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug chos sgra 'gro kun gyi/ /thos 'dzin rgyan du legs bsgrags rgya mtsho che'i/ /gos can dbyangs kyis 'gengs des rab btab pa'i/ /smon lam bdag sogs 'gro la 'grub byin rlobs/ /chos kyi rgya mtshor mchog gi blo gros rlabs/ /yol med rnam par rol pas gzhan gyi sems/ /mngon par mkhyen pa'i rgyal pos rab btab pa'i/ /smon lam bdag sogs 'gro la 'grub byin rlobs/ /thugs rje sman gyi dri yis sgrib gnyis nad/ /drung 'byin 'gro ba'i bla ma be+eḍūrla'i/ /mdog bzang 'od kyi rgyal pos rab btab pa'i/ /smon lam bdag sogs 'gro la 'grub byin rlobs//snyigs ma lnga bdo'i skye (213na〉dur brtse ba ches/ /bde bar gshegs pa bdun gyi smon lam mdo/ /shākya seng shes legs gsungs de don bzhin/ /ma rgan 'gro drug kun gyis khrub par shog gru 'dzin ri bo'i spo nas dus drug tu/ /dkyus ring spyan kyis gzigs pa lhur mdzad pa'i/ /phyag na pad dkar 'chang des sems can rnams/ /mtho ris thar pa'i lam du drang bar gsol/ /rdo rje slob dpon lus la rgyal ba kun/ /tshang ba'i rten 'brel rgyu 'bras bslu med 'bras/ /'di dang tshe rabs gtan gyi mdun ma'i tshogs/ /'grub pa'i skal ba bzang por bdag 'gyur shog /ces pa 'di'ang drung 'tsho ngag dbang lhag bsam gyis sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ spyan ras gzigs/ 'dra 'bag rnams bzhedasapa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul bzhin za hor gyis brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i mgon pos rab bsngags pa/ /bder gshegs kun yum gtsug tor rnam rgyal mas/ /gshin rje'i las mkhan me long 'dzin pa'i khur/ /nyer gtong 'chi med grub pas mchogo sbyin stsol/ /skyabs gsum spyan sngar 'dus tshogis bden brjod mthus/ /smra ba ngag gi dbang phyug blo gros gter/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'phrin (213ba〉pas rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /yongs brgal gdong lngas bteg khrir g.yo med shog /yangs pa'i blo dang skye mang nyer goms pa'i/ /bzang po'i bag chags sad pa'i mu tig char/ /gser ldan kun khyab sa skyong mthu stobs dbang / /rdo rje'i gdan la mi 'gyur —288

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)brtan par shog /blo bzang grags snyan bstan pa'i gdugs dkar po/ /'dzin la legs byas phung po rab spungs bas/ /mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i dga' ston yongs skrud pa/ /skye rgu'i gnyen du g.yung drung lta bur shog /klog spong bya ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo gsum/ /bskor bar rgyal bas ches bsngags khrims ldan sde/ /'jig rten kun gyi bsod nams zhing mchog tu/ /byams bstan ma shar de srid dar bar shog /ces 'di lta bu zhig rtsoms shig par chos 'khor rgyal gyi gnas srung chen pos bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /zhi khro che mchog ngo bor yongs 'dus pa'i/ /phyag rgyas bdud dpung zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal//rdo rje slob dpon gzugs su legs shar ba/ /srid pa'i mtha' bsnyeg dkyil 'khor mgon bor bzhugs/ /thod phreng rigs lnga rang snang shes rab mar/ /snyoms 'jug dngas ma'i bdud rtsis rtsa 'khor kun/ /gtams pas a nya srog gi /ba'i zungs/ /mi shigs rdo rje'i khams su deng byin rlobs//ma (214na rkong mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor gyi lha/ /gter srung dam can mthu stobs ldan rnams kyis//nag phyogs rtsa lag pham pa'i dkar po'i dar/ /tshangs pa'i yul sar 'phyar ba'i bkra shis stsol/ /zhes pa 'di'ang lha sa byang gling pa blo bzang lhun grub spun ma sru rnams kyis rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par rgyun 'dzugs kyi ched du ji srid kyi bar zhing phul nas zhal 'don tshigs bcad dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /phyag na sna tshogs 'gro 'dul rdo rje'i mtshon/ /rab 'bar laṅka pu rir srin po'i rgyal/ /'phrin las rigs 'dzin rkarma gu ru yis/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char chen phob/ /rgyal kun 'dus pa ga me gu ru'i gar/ /yang gsang drag por khros pa'i stang stabs kyis/ /bdud bzhi'i zhan la 'dre srin 'byung po'i tshogs/ /phyer 'thag mngon spyod las rnams 'grub byin rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di'ang dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to gyis dad rten bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig slo ka re dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong mañdza 'o/ /—289

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenardo rje slob dpon gzugs sku'i za ma tog/mdzo sum gdul bya'i don du rtag brtan cing //bdag sogs byang chub thob min dge ba'i bshes/mdzad de theg mchog lam la 'god par shog khesapa'ang 214bskosang gling sngags rams pa ngag dbang legs ldan gyis ngor za hor gyi bzhes bkod//sgrib gsum rgya grol yon tan yongs rdzogs par//rnam 'dren mtha' dag mnyam yang snyigs ma lnga//cher bde'i 'gro 'dul thugs rje mthu stobs rnams//gzhan las khyad zhugs sman bla mched bdun dgongs//don kun grub pa'i ma smo 'jam ljags ring po'i//tshangs dbyangs sgrar drangs brgyad brgya'i grangs ldan mdor//rab dngar tshad ma'i bka' de mi bslu ba'i//bden gtam yid ches gtan tshigs gang gis 'gog/de phyir bde gshegs mched brgyad lha tshogs rnams//chos rjes 'brangs dang dwangs shel rtsig ngos la//gzugs sku bkod pa'i tshon ris rnam bkra ba//mngon sum smon lam dbang por deng bzhugs gsol/shwakya seng ge'i lung rtogs chos kyi mdzod//spyi dang khyad par mnyam med btsong kha pa'i//bstan pa rin chen rdzogs ldan shar min par//'jig rten kun khyab bla nasablar 'phel shog/brjod pa rnam dag ngag la dbang phyug blo//bskal bzang 'dren pa bzhi pa'i rgya chen gzhung //'chad rtsod rtsom par mtsho byung dbyangs can mgrin//bzhugs des srid mthar chos 'khor bskor du gsol//gangs ljongs dang po'i dpal ldan 'bras spungs sder//rgyan drug mchog gnyisarjes 'brangs bka' pod tshogs//bshad nyan klog pa'i bya ba dkar 215na ) zla'i char//rab 'gran mkhas btsun kun+da tshal ba 'ad shog/sdug bsngal mang brtsegs ngan song gsum gyi 'gro//'gyur dang 'du byed kyis mnar lha mi'i rten//rgyu dang mi rgyu'i mkha' mnyam lus can rnams//dkar min las kyi zug rngu zhi bar shog/gnas skabs sgo gsum brnag dka'i ming tsam yang //grag min sim pa'i tshor ba rtag myong zhing //mtho ris lam la gyen nas gyen 'dzegs te//thar pa'i sgor zhugs gto bder longs spyod shog/rgya hor bod dang khyad par gangs ljongs su//slo rdeg 'chi ba nad gdon 'khrugs bkren sogs//dus kyi chad rgyu // 'byung des skyed pa'i//sdug bsngal bden las

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rnam par grol bar shog /ring 'tsho 'du ba cha snyoms lo tog sbrum/ /khe spogs 'gro dang mi 'gro'i bya ba kun/ /rdzogs ldan ltar 'grub de rgyu dge ba bcu'i/ /khrims kyi ra bar bag yod gnas par shog /skye mang brgyud dang tshe 'dir rang dbang du/ /gyur dang ma gyur mi zad sdig pa'i las/ /bsam grub rgyal pos bsags kun dge ba'i mthus/ /yongs dag 'od dpag med zhal mthong bar shog /lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang chen gyi/ /bya 'dabs grib mar ngal gso byang gling pa/ /mi nor longs spyod 'di snang rab 'phel zhing / /ring por mi thogs nges legs sar bgrod shog /kun tu bzang (215bsta'i smon lam ji lta bar/ /bsags dang bsag bzhin gsog 'gyur dge ba rnams/ /lus can mtha' dag byang chen thob pa'i rgyur/ /bsngos pa'i 'bras bu dkon mchog mthus smin shog /byang gling pa blo bzang lhun grub ma sru rnams kyis dge 'phel ri khrod pa rnams la zla gcig gi bar zhabs tog dang de nas mthun rkyen sbyar te 'dzugs rtsis kyi ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad glo ka ma nyungs tsam dgos tshul byung ba smon lam khyab che ba legs par mngon nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /gar dbang tshe mtha' yas pa'i thugs rje'i mthus/ /nor 'dzin skyong ba blo bzang sbyin pa yi//sku tshe rdo rje lta bur rab brtan zhing / /legs byas dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel bar shog /ces pa 'di ni ri sgo dge 'dun rab brtan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /mtsho zla'i srang grangs dngul dkar pad+ma'i dbyibs/ /dam rdzas gtor ma phyur bur spungs pa'i snod/ /phul bas re 'bras mi mthun phyogs kun zhi/ /ring min dpal chen he ru ka 'grub shog /ces pa'ang ri bo chos gling pa dam chos dbang rgyal dge skos dus pad sder phul ba'i kha byang za hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /(216na)'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi/ /'dra 'bag gser zangs las grub pa/ /ngag —291—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenadabang 'phrin las lhag bsam gyis/ /bzhengs 'bras don gnyis lhun grub shog /ces pa'ang za hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /bgrang yas bde gshegs rnams kyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /rab 'dzin phyag gis gzas pa rdo rje'i rwa/ /gdengs pas bdud bzhi las rgyal zhi dul gyis/ /gar bsgyur drang srong chen po dri ma med/ /spros kun mtshan rtog dang bral chos dbyings nas/ /sde brgyad gnyen por khros pa'i zhe snang gis/ /lcags sreg rngams pa'i shugs drag rdo rje'i thog /mi srun 'byung po'i klad pa tshal brgyar 'gem/ /lha srin mdun bkug rgya gram brjid kyis mnan/ /srog yid nyer drangs lha gi gdan du byas/ /lce yi rwa gur me 'bar bdud dpung bsreg /snying dbus rig rtsal chos skur ngo 'phrod shog /gnas pa rtsa dang srog yig nye bar 'dren/ /gcod pa rtse dang man ngag rang sems su/ khres na gnas skabs lasabazhi kun 'grub cing / /ring min ye shes klong du grol bar shog /lho phyogs in+t+ra'i nags tshal nyamasadaga' bar/ /drang srong tshul gyis 'gro ba legs 'dren kyang / /snang srid dregs 'dul khro po'i dbang po yis/ /deng nas byang chub bar (216ba'i rjes zung shig /ces pa 'di'ang dbu mdzad ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis thang kha'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /kun rtog pir gyis ri mor bris pa'i gzugs/ /phra rags rnam pa thams cad mkhyen spyan ngor//gzigs nas smon pa'i dbang por dus gsum rgyal/ /sras dang slob mar bcas pa mtha' dag dgongs/ /'jam da byangs dgyes pasang ga la dbang phyug pa/ /blo ldan mkhas btsun bzang po'i zlosagar can/ /rgya mtsho'i gos kyis 'jig rten bteg pa'i bar/ /bgrang yas 'gro ba'i gnyen du brtan par shog /blo bzang grags snyan chos srid 'brel ba'i bstan/ /gyen du 'degs pa'i mthu stobs nusaldan dang / /bde skyid sbyin pa'i sgo 'phar 'byed mkhas pa/ /mi dbang zung 'jug rdo rje ltar brtan shog /thub dbang gnas brtan chen po bcu drug bcas/ /snyigs ma'i mgon po bde bar gshegs pa —292

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bdun/ /'chi med drang srong bden tshig 'grub rnams kyis/ /brjod pa don dang ldan par byin gyisarlobs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba dkar mo'i ljongs/ /sbas yul chos 'khor rgyal gyis 'dus pa'i sde/ shwakya'i bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /ces nged rang dang sde pa (217na〉gnyis kyi ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad chos 'khor rgyal spyi so nas bskul ba bzhin za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /dag pa don dam mi zad 'khor lo'i mdzod/ zhas rab pha rol phyin pa bzhin lag skur/ /nyer bstan brgya phrag gser sbyangs zhun ma sa /legs bzhengs pa da rtsa ltar dkar dge ba'i 'bras/ /mos gus mthar phyin stag lung thang pa'i bstan/ /rab 'dzin ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub kyi/ /rim gror lhod med blo bzang ngag gi dbang / /dal brgyad 'byor gas rten bzang rnyed par shog /skye mang rgyud la nyer bgos nag po'i dri/ /yum chen thugs rje'i klung gis rab bkrus nas/ /thar pa'i sa bon bskyed bsrings byang chub kyi/ /phun tshogs ro brgya'i snye mar longs spyod shog /dman lam zhi bde rang nyid 'khor ba las/ /yongs thar srid pa'i tshor ba rtag myong bar/ /ma chags srid zhi'i mtha' las nyer 'das pa/ /ring min kun mkhyen ye shes thob par shog /ji ltar smon lam rab btab dpang po mā /dus gsum rnam 'dren sras bcas la gsol na/ /de don mngon sum 'grub par gyur cig ces/ /drug cu'i dbyangs snyan rna ba'i rgyan du mdzod/ /ces stag lung (117ba)phyag mdzod dbu ma pa blo bzang ngag dbang gi don du rigs brgyud rnams kyis yum chen mo'i brgya thang bzhings pa'i smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po la/ /nyin byed 'bum gyi gos klubs pa/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med/ /sgrib bral spyan gyis dus kun gzigs/ /bde gshegs ljags kyi pad+ma las/ /bsngags brjod rkang drug snyan pa'i klu/ /rna ba'i bcud gyur bcom ldan 'das/ /rnam par rgyal mas dge legs stsol/ /—293

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ rton)gsal btab gzungs sngags bzlas tsam gyis/ 'chi bdag me long 'dzin pa yi/ /ngal ba gtong byed 'phags ma'i zhabs/ /yid bzhin 'khor los 'gro 'di srungs/ /brjod pa rnam dag smra ba'i ngag /dbang phyug blo ldan dga' skyid ba/ /skal bzang gdul bya rgya mtsho'i mgon/ /rdo rje lta bur brtan par shog /theg chen chos kyi myu gu mchog /byang chub lam gyi rim pa yi/ /lugs 'dzin dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gling / /srid mtha'i bar du dar bar shog /'jig rten gsum gyi skye rgu rnams/ /ring po'i bar du 'tsho ba'i tshe/ /dpal 'byor longs spyod gnod sbyin ltar/ /nyams su myong ba'i skal ldan shog /rgyal kun ngo (218na〉du btsong kha pa'i/ /chos srid gnyis ldan bstan pa yi/ /gdugs dkar grib mar lus can tshogs/ /ngal sor spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /ces ring 'tsho dang 'brel ba'i smon lam tshigs bcad 'di'ang 'phyos pa nam mkha' rgya mtshos lam rim pa'i tshogs stsa 'dzugs rtsis kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs rbe1/ / dhi kwa sha pa ṇ+ḍi khya ba rnyu sa ra pra ཿ hā khri gra ༷ sti dha dza ta bo di baḥblo gsal mkhas mang rgya mtsho'i gtsug tor rtser/ /mdzes rgyan grags pa'i rgyal mtshan tshangs gnas yul/ /su ༈ ya ka zlo sa ra rā shu ṅgā ra tsa ) rlo r+sha 〈 tu rdi ba ba ཿ ho su smu/legs bsgrengs snyan brgyud gser sbyangs rtsibs 'khor gyis/ /thub bstan gling bzhir dbang sgyur tshar pa rje/ /(218ba)nges pa'i don du bgrang yas dkyil 'khor kun/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i rdo rje 'chang dngos kyang / /thun mong sna ngor dpal ldan chos skyong nas/ /ngo mtshar skyes rabs bcu gnyis tshar du dngar/ /gnyis med rgyud rgyal dgyes mdzad he ru ga / /bstan srung bye ba'i sde dpon rdo rje gur/ /rab dkar kā shi'i ngos la sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /lha lam ngos su dbang po'i gzhu ris bzhin/ /mthong bas rnam grol thos pas don ldan pa/ /bla ma yi dam bstan srung snang brnyan tshogs/ /dbang rnon chos rjes 'brangs pa'i —294

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dad pa yis/ /bsod nams nyer byas ljid kyis kun bzod rdul/ /gos bu deng nas srid bar rnam thos bu'i/ /yon tan kun la mnyam par longs spyod cing / /ring min mdud pa gsum gyi 'phrang gegs las/ /yongs bsgral bcu gsum rdo rje'i sa brnyes shog /de ma gyur kun rnam dag dge ba'i bshes/ /dam pa'i mgon gyis gces par legs bskyangs nas/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan snyan brgyud slob bshad kyi/ /smin grol bdud rtsis ci dgar myos par shog /mdor na 'di phyi bar do'i gnas rnams su/ /mgon khyod thugs rje'i nyi ma snying dbus su/ shar nas phan bde'i snang ba 'od po che'i/ /bkra shis dpal gyis rtag tu khyab par shog /(219na)ga / kha tu tho sa na sa rba pa 4 swā nā gi sa 〉 skro PROBPROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROBPROB'gro ngor gdan gsum kun tshang ngag dbang blo/ /rab yangs mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'phrin las kyi//su rwa snya bi sgo hā ṇa nya bshu kla ཿ sa chu nga swā bha ya ba sbra sme na tā/ /rgya mtsho'i mthar khyab tshangs srasang nga mo dkar/ /bzhad pa'i mgrin khrol 'jigs med rdo rje'i sder/ /sgro btags ming snyan yang srid be+eḍūr+ya'i/ /'phreng ba tshig gi srad bur nyer brgyus pa/ /mkhas grub chos rgyal snang brnyan tshar dngar ba/ /legs byas mgron de ring nas bsu ba bzhin/ /dgra bo'i srog la mi bzad ha la'i dug /rnal 'byor las rnams sgrub la yid bzhin nor/ /'dod lha'i snying la bro brdung stobs 'phrog dbang / /gnyan zhing myur la grags pa don ldan can/(219ba)/dam tshig mtsho la ye shes sems dpa'i char/ /ro gcig skal bar mi dbyer tiṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha/ /brgya phrag me tog 'thor tshe lha rnams kyi/ /mgrin pa'i lam las bkra shis glu dbyangs len/ /legs byas mthu yis deng nas byang chub bar/ /rdo rje'i slob dpon gtsug tu mi 'bral bar/ /khas blangs ji bzhin brtse bas rjes bzung ste/ /mthar thug don rnams 'grub par bdag byin rlobs/ /—293—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenami ) rda yi na su pa re sa mo ma hā sa twa ga bi kri rnya ma ti tsa rba tsa raḥbyams brtses bdag gzhan mnyam pa'i sems dpa' che/ /ngag dbang blo gros yongs grub mkhyen dpyod can/ /kā ruḥ pu rgyu di sha bhā ba bha ṣa sa dhi shā sa na lha dzi ka da spu go dha raḥ/mtha' yas bsod nams zhing gyur bshad sgrub kyi/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan bsgreng mkhas rdo rje 'dzin//(220na ji kyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i ded dpon mtshams sprin gos/ /nyer klubs mi 'jigs bzhi ldan thob min bar/ /'khrid mdzad sa mkhan bslu med gtan gyi skyabs/ /zla bas yongs lhag dam pa bcu phrag gcig /bde chen mkha' la spyod pa'i pho brang du/ /bcu drug lang tshor dar ba'i rje btsun ma/ /zla zhun khu bas lan brgyar byugs pas kyang / /mtshon min mig gi bdud rtsi tshe sbyin lha/ /khrag dron rngubs pas ma tshim dgra bo'i snying / /rjen par za ba beg tse lcam dral dang / /da can khyung lung mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /sa gsum cig car 'gems la rings pa bzhin/ /'bad pa'i legs byas slob bu mchog rnams la/ /gces par gdams pa tshad ma bzhi ldan chos/ /ston pas skye bar yongs 'dzin spang rtogs kyi/ /yon tan dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel bar shog /'ja' lus 'grub dang rdo rje btsun mo yi/ /mngon sum rjes 'dzin skal bzang ma thob na/ /sgyu ma'i skyes chen 'degs dus rje btsun mas/ /skar mda' 'phangs ltar mkha' spyod gnas 'dren shog /'di snang tshe dpal stobs 'byor la 'khu zhing / /dam chos bsgrub pa'i bar gcod dgra dang bgegs/ /bstan srung dbang po'i tshogs kyis rkan sgrar bcas/ /chem chem za sogs las bzhi bsgrub par shog /(220ba)yi ji 〈 pe ru pha spu ra si — ཿ to ḍa ki ni sgru ma no dzñā ma hā ga ma kā/'ja' lus 'pho ba che 'grub thod phreng rtsal/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo yid 'dzin mkhar chen bza'/ /ga sdi rā the kho dha rma su : kho ṭa ༷ thu ba sde sko ni : ma rwa hā dhi kaḥ/zab don chos kyi sgo 'byed rnam gnyis sogs/ /bka' gter brgyud pa ngo mtshar phrul po che/ /—296

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rdo rje drag rtsal zhi khro kun 'dus lha/ /nges gsang bstan pa bsrung ba ral gcig ma/ /bod skyong rgyal po'i sku lha dri za'i rgyal/ /rtsa gsum yongs 'dus shel la tshon brgya bzhin/ /'bod sgrogs mgon po'i gar du rnga yab gling / /dngos bzhugs bod yul 'gro la dgyes pa'i spyan/ /g.yel ba med kyang lhag par gsol 'debs bur/ /thugs rje'i byin dbab mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i thugs rje mkha' glang 'khrig /sgrub sde(221na〉rgyad kyi dngos grub char du bsnyil//dam can 'phrin las snye ma g.yur za bas/ /bsam don lhun gyis yongs 'grub bkra shis shog /byang pa rigs ldan rim byon gyi mdun na 'don ngag rig pa 'dar ba'i brgyud las pā ṇi ka tsan dbyangs can ma ste brda' sprod bzhi/ sdeb sbyor snyan tshig rtsis dkar nag sogs rig gnas mang por blo gros kyi snang ba dkar ba'i lo chen ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub kyis gong gsal thang kha gra tshar gsum dang skyon chen po'i thang kha chung ba zhig bcas bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig spyi dang bye brag tu skye bar rjes 'dzin dang me tog brgya tshar dgos tshul ltar rig byed pa tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa sarba dzā maṅga le bha / / /rgyal ba 'od dpag med pa 'gro kun skyabs/ /skyabs bzung 'chi med mchog sbyin rnam par rgyal/ /rgyal yum tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zhabs/ /zhabs pad gtsug bsten 'dod pa'i 'brasakun stsol/ /gsal gsal mkha' la sangs rgyas sras slob rnams/ /yang yang bden tshig brjod pa'i dpang po mā /dung dung dang ba'i yid kyis spyan 'dren na/ /'dzum 'dzum zhal khyim bstan nas spyon zhig gu/ /dus gsum rgyal kun kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i/ /rgya chen gsung rab rab tu stims klasapa/ /mang du legs thos thos don bsam bsgom bstan/ /khams (221bsko sum ma lus lus med dar ba shog /ngag gi dbang po dbang phyug brgyad ldan lhas/ /rjes bzung blo gros blo gsal kun dga'i dpyid/ /skal bzang dga' skyed dga' ston rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /spel mdzad srid 'dir srid zhi'i mgon du bzhugs/ /yid srubs tsho gis kyis mtsho ni char phab kyang yid/ /'pham byed mchog gsum —297

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenathugs rjes bdud sde 'pham/ /sra brtan mi 'gyur rdo rje'i khri 'phang sa/ /grub nus smon lam ci btab lhun gyis grub/ /dga' ba brgya pa la sogs gtsug gi rgyan/ /dga' ba'i dpal ldan thub pa'i gsung rab la/ /dga' 'gur spyod pa khrims ldan 'dus gling gi /dga' ston srid mtha'i bar du rgyas par shog /rnam gsum chos kyi 'khor lo dang po'i don/ /rnam dag khrims las nyer sbyor mkhan po dang / /rnam mkhyen ye shes mchogo de thob min bar/ /rnam pa kun tu 'bral med bkra shis shog /ces rjesa'adzin dang ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad smon lam dang bcas pa 'di'ang rnam sras gling pa bslab gsum rgya mtshos dol gsung rab gling du 'dzugs rtsis kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /nges pa'i don du drin can bla ma mchog /dpal ldan rgyal ba yongs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /'dzin mdzad drang srong chen po dri ma med/ /gtum drag zhe sdang rdo rje'i rnam rol ba/ /deng nas kun bzang go 'phang ma thob bar/ /(222na snying gi ze'u 'byur 'bral med rtag bzhugs te/ /mi bzad mthu stobs 'bar ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal bar byin gyis zla mes/ /lag na rdo rje'i bskyed rdzogs gru rdzings la/ /brten nas 'gro rnams srid zhi chu gter mthar/ /sgrol la chos rgyal mya ngan med pa dang / /mtshungs pa'i snying stobs bla nas blar 'phel shog /ces bla ma dang yi dam dbye ba med par gsol ba 'debs pa zhig dgos zhes brag sdong sngags rams pa blo bzang tshe dbang gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rtses thang sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs the tho/ /rig dang grol ba'i dpal ldan dge 'dun tshogs/ /gtsug na nges par thams cad mkhyen pa mā /lhun gyis grub pa bslu ba med pa'i skyabs/ /ma smad thugs rje'i lcags kyus bdag bzung zhig /skye bar dge legs gangs can ri bo la/ /gcig tu 'dun pas mkhas grub rnam dpyod kyi/ /gaṅgā thub bstan rgya mtshor rtag 'bab pa/ /dbyangs can ba yid pa'i rdo rjes bdag rjes bzung / /chen po hor 298

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dang bod 'bangs skye rgu yi/ /bsod nams bye ba'i zhing gyur 'phrin las kyis/ /rgya mtsho'i mtha' klasanor 'dzin kun khyab pa'i/ /mkhyen brtse nus byin snying la rtag bzhugs mdzod/ /mtha' yas yon tan mkha' ltar rgya che (222btogong / /mtsho ltar gting zab bde chen chos kyi rgyal/ /ltar bcas lus can kun gyi skyabs gcig pu/ /byang chub thob min de srid mgon mdzod cig /gsung ngag chad med dbang gi chu rgyun gyis/ /rab smin blo gros lam bzang zab rgya che/ /mtsho ltar gting dpog mi mngon brgal ba la/ /'jigs med thos bsam sgom pa'i go cha can/ /sgrib gnyis dgra tshogs nyer thub zas gtsang sras/ /bstan pa rin chen las rtsod rtsom gsum gyis/ /lung rtogs lang tsho dar la babs pa'i sde'i//gzugs brnyan mos rten shel la tshon ris bzhin/ /rab dkar 'dab stong yongs bzhad ze'u 'bru la//lag rjes ri mo rnam bkra bh+ra ma ra/ /dngos grub ches dngar sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyi ro/ /myang ba'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog /rang rig bla ma'i ngo bor thag rdzo nas/ /rang gas don gnyis sgrub nus rdo rje sems/ /rang zhal mngon du ma gyur de srid bar/ /rang dang nam yang 'du 'bral med par shog /'bad pas bsod nams bsags pa bzang po'i las/ /las dkar rnam smin ma gyur semasacan tshogs/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i ched du yongs bsngos 'bras/ /gos bu yongs dud ro bda' myong bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang lha sa ba ngag dbang dkon mchog gi bris thang lnga tshar bzhengs pa'i smon lam du lag rjes 'khrul med dang skye bar 'bral med kyi tshig sbyor dgos tshul ltar za hor (223na)gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /mar gad lhun po'i mdzes pa yongs 'phrog /rgyal yum 'phags ma'i snang brnyan 'di la/ /me tog brgya rtsa'i shis pa brjod mthus/ /'jigs pa brgyad las myur du skyobs shig /spel legs me tog brgya rtsa'i 'phreng mdzes pa/ /myur mdzad ye shes mgon po'i zlos gar gyis/ /dgra bgegasayongs zhi bar do'i 'jigs skyabs nas/ /yang srid phyi mar gru 'dzin zhing bgrod shog /srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan nam gru ma'i/ /snang brnyan shis brjod brgya phrag gis spud pa/ /'bras bu 'phrin —299

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu spung glegs bam dang po/ zhenalas rnam bzhi'i dpal yon kun/ /'bad stsol med par lhun sa rgyas grub par shog /ces pa 'di'ang pho brang ge ra ba blo bzang mkhyen brtses gong gsal gsum gyi bris sku bzhengs par thor nas brgya rtsa yod tshul dgos zer ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rtses thang sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs the(/ /dkon cog rin chen rnam gsum thugs rje'i mthus/ /'dir snang 'gal rkyen bar gcod ma lus zhi/ /tshe dpal stobs 'byor lung rtogs yon tan kun/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /nying mtshams sbyar tshe 'od dpag med mgon gyi/ /ye shes lcags kyus bde ba can zhing du/ /nyer drangs pad+ma'i sbubs (223ba)su rdzus skyes te/ /sa lam yon tan mtha' dag lhun grub shog /dpon po tshe ring kyi kha ton du 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /ras dkar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ngos/ /dngos brgyud bla ma'i snang bas ri dwags gzugs/ /byin rlabs ga bur zegs mas sgrib gnyis dang / /bskyed 'bras tsha gdung gzhil ba'i cho ga mkhan/ /dge sdig gzugs brnyan ma 'dres so so sa /dbye ba'i bsod nams nyer byas dga' byed lhas/ /rnam smin ches gnag laṅka'i mgrin bcad de/ /gtan bde'i sī tā ra rtag tu rtse 'jor shog /rdzogs ldan skye rgu ji bzhin ring por 'tsho/ /dbang thang nya phyis khog pa yangs pa'i nang / /stobasa'abyor mu tig phyur bur yongs spungs nas/ /re 'bras grags pa don dang ldan par shog /ces skyid thang nor bus thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs bzhengs pa'i gtso thang gi rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs theg/ /mdo khams sgang gsum rab yangs sa chen por/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i/ /cho sodang srid kyi bstan pas legs khyab nas/ /'gro rnams ma lus bde zhing skyid par shog /—300

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)mgon de'i gsung rab lung gi char chen pos/ /'gro rgyud rtogs pa'i snye ma bskyed bsrings pa/ /(224na)thos bsam sgom gsum nyi mas smin byed mkhan/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho brtan gyur cig /'thab rtsod dbul phongs dus kyi chad pa zhi/ /lo rtag sprum zhing tshong rnams khe spogs thon/ /tshe dang bsod nams 'dod dgu lhun grub ste/ /bde skyid dpal gyis sa steng khyab par shog /ces pa 'di'ang mdo gzhis sdod blo bzang dbang phyug dang long po nga phod a bos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /su sti sirnyi/ don kun grub sogs dus gsum sangs rgyas sras/ /slob mar bcas pa dkon mchog thugs rje'i dpung / /lha dang drang srong bden tshig dmod pa'i mthus/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul lasarnam par rgyal bar shog /rin chen bsod nams mchag grub bshes gnyen cher/ /tshe mtha' yas dang yid bzhin 'khor lo yis/ /dbang bskur g.yung drung srog tu lhun grub pas/ /rab brtan chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /gur mgon legs ldan gdong bzhi rnam thos sras/ /dmag zor rgyal mo rdo rje rab brtan ma/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mthu ldan srung ma yis/ /'dod pa'i re 'bras lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ces mkhan chen khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po zhabs pad brtan pa'i bden pa'i tshig 'di ni za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag rig pa bsam (224bsgo thong phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /bskal bzang 'dren pa bzhin pa shākya'i tog /snang brnyan brgya phrag bcus bsgyur gser zhun las/ /legs grub 'di phyir sim pa'i byed po sa /rab bskrun 'bras bu lhun gyisahrūb byin rlobs//mdzod spu nas 'phros 'od kyi snang ba yis/ /bdag blo 'dab stong ba 'ad pa'i ze'u 'bru las/ /nyer 'dzag phan bde'i sbrang rtsir yang srid kun/ /longs spyod bzang po'i skal pa ldan par shog /thog mtha' bar du dge ba dam pa'i chos/ /rtag tu thos bsam sgom pa lhur blangs te/ /'gro ba kun 'dren ded dpon chen po sa /'gyur phyir dge tshogs bsngos 'bras zad med shog /ces lha sa ba ngag dbang mkhas btsun gyi skye rtags dang lhag pa'i lhar bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge'i stong thang bzhengs pa'i —301—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenargyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /pad dkar zla ba zhun ma 'khyil ba'i steng / /mdzes sdug lus phra'i nyams kyi 'jo sgeg can/ /dran pas 'chi bdag dpung 'joms tshe sbyin lha/ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor los dngos grub stsol//mkhyen brtse nus pa ma la ya yi dris/ /seng glang me sbrul chom rkun lcags sgrog dang / /chu klung sha za 'jigs brgyad tsha gdung rnams/ /zhi mdzad nags kyi sgrol mas mthu dpung bskyed/ /'jam dpal rdo rje dras drubs gos mnabs pa/(225na)/rje btsun bla ma kun mkhyen tsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs spel mkhasang ga dbang blo gros bzang / /thub bstan rgya mtsho g.yung drung ltar brtan shog /myur mdzad ye shes mgon pos phyag drug pa/ /las kyi gshin rje lha chen nyi ma'i bu/ /'dod khams dbang sgyur dmag dang zor gyi lhas/ /bsams pa'i re ba bkong ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gtsang ris dpal mgon bdun cu la sogs pa/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi yul khams 'dir/ /dge 'dun sde rgyas skye rgu'i bde skyid tshogs/ /'phel ba'i bkra shis dga' ston stsal du gsol/ /zhes ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad 'di ni bla ma sangs rgyas bkra shis kyi sku skye grags pa chos 'dzin gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /'bral med spyi bor bsgoms nas gsol 'debs na/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /bdag sogs snying la 'a lcag par byin gyis rlomes//gu'u shi ja'i sang / dge tshul/ chi khu la/ tha bu nong / u pa shi rnams kyi ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /ston dang skyabs dngos zla grogs mchoge gsum mthus/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i dpal//gdul bya'i don du nges pa lnga ldan ltar/ /'tsho (225ba〉na zhes gsol btab re ba don yod shog /rgya bod sa mtshams phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i sar/ /dga' ldan bstan pa'i gdugs dkar grib bsil la/ /rang gzhan phan bde'i srog zungs g.yung drung gzhir/ /rab brtan 'dzam gling rgyan du 'phel bar —302

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)shog /sde 'dir dpon slob yon sbyor dang bcas pa/ /chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs ma lus pa/ /lhun gyis grub par dmag zor rgyal mo sogs/ /dam can srung mas wen las spel bar mdzod/ /dga' ba brgya pa'i bsod nams gzi byin gyis/ /mched gyur sdebazhi'i dpal ldan pho brang che'i/ /khrims gnyis gser shing skye rgu'i gnya' ba sa /rab lci chab srid bla nas blar 'phel shog /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par yul phyogs 'dir/ /mi phyugs nad rims g.yul 'khrugs mtshang 'brus mtshon//rnam smin nag por 'dzag 'bras snyigs dus kyi/ /chad las rgyad pa nam yang med par shog /ring 'tsho'i srog gi ka ba nyer tshugs shing / /lo tog rab sbrums khe spogs dar drag sogs/ /'byor ba'i dbang thang rnam mang thos pa'i bur/ /'gran pa'i skal ba bzang por spyod par shog /rtsa gsum thugs rje'i mkha' la byin rlabs sprin/ /yongs 'khrigs dngos grub char gyis mchog mthun gyi/ /'dod dgu'i snye ma g.yur du legs za ba'i/ /phun sum tshogs pas dus kun khyab par shog /ces dar rtse mdo dga' (226na skon gzhan phan gling gi slob dpon ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bsam mthong pa ngag rig phun tshogs dbang po'o/
