/rnam 'dren sman gyi bla ma mngon par mkhyen/ /chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs dang mya ngan med/ /rin chen snang ba sgra dbyangs rgyal po che/ /mtshan legs bdun mdo de gsung shākya thub/ /mthong thos dran pas rnam par grol ba'i sku/ /ri mo rab bkra'i chos dkar phung po'i gzugs/ /mngon sum nor 'dzin dpal mo'i lto ba sa /mi shong tshangs pas gsar snod bskrun gos gos/ /sgyu sbyor rigasabargyud tshe dang stobs 'byor sogs/ /legs tshogs yon tan bla nas blar 'phel te/ /nying mtshams sbyar tshe be+eḍūr snang zhing gi /pad+ma'i sbubs skyes myur du 'tshang rgyar shog /rgyal ba'i gtsug tor rtse las nyer 'khrungs pa/ /bcom ldan ma khyod mthu stobs byin za yis/ /mi mthun bgegs tshogs bud shing rab bsregs shing / /bde skyid 'od kyis phyogs rnams khyab par shog /'jam mgon byin rlabs dpung pas yongs bteg pa/ /rnam dpyod ut+pal ze'u 'bru ba 'ad pa'i rtser/ /mkhyen pa'i ral gri rnon —303—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenapos chos kun gyi/ /log rtog dra ba gcod mdzad tsong kha pa'i/ /snang bas ka shi'i ngos la dbang gzhu'i tshon/ /nyer gsal bsod nams mtho ris chu bo yis/ /sdig sgrib de 'bras duḥkha'i dri ma'i tshogs/ /rab bkrus rmad byung bkod pa'i zhing khams (226ba〉ci/ /khyod kyis rjes su 'dzin par bdag byin rlobs/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i mkha' lding shugs 'gro'i rjes/ /sgro btags pha bong bsnyeg pa'i 'khrung rabs 'phreng / /spel 'dis skye bar yongs 'dzin bla ma yis/ /'bral med brtsebs byang chen sar 'khrid shog /'ol dga' 'bri lung pa blo bzang dpal 'byor gyis bder gshegs brgyad/ gdugasadakar/ rje btsun btsong kha pa/ blo bzang rgyal ma'i nang gi bris thang rnams bzhedas pa'i rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'od mtha' yas pa'i phyag sor gyis/ /legs btag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun srog zungs su/ /sgyur nas rdo rje'i slob dpon 'og min mgon/ /ji bzhin g.yung drung khri la g.yo med shog/ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i blo gros kyis/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho ltar/ /gting mtha' dpog par nus min bshes gnyen mchog /ris med 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor brtan par shog /phyi ltar dur khrod brgyad myul bram ze'i gzugs/ /nang ltar rtsa khams dag pa zhing stong che//gsang ba sems nyid gsal stong stobs 'phrog dbang / /mthu rtsal nus pas 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs/ /zhes yun du 'tsho ba'i tshigs bcad dgon khag tshor 'dzugs rgyu zhig dgos zhes ri khud bla ma shākya kun dgas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o// //(227na)be+e ḍūrla ba zlo dza sa re tsa la klu nu bya khya na pra ta bha ba 9 tsi tre/be+eḍūrla mdog dngas gsal mtshon nang du/ /mtshan dang dpe byad snang brnyan rab bkra ba/ /bu rnye da gu ro ṣa dhi gu ga swā kā dhi / pho zhi 〉 pra ṇi dha na ye //bcom ldan sman gyi bla mas legs btab pa'i/ /smon lam 'bras bu deng 'dir smin byin rlobs/ /—304

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanagang du thob pa'i lus kun kho lag yangs/ /nyi zla las lhag 'od kyis mun pa sel/ /'gro rnamasazad mi shes pa'i 'byor par spyod/ /dman lam ldog de theg chen lam 'jug shog /tshul khrims rnam dag ngan 'gro'i lam las ldog /nad sogs lus skyon kun bral dbang po tshang / /mgon skyabs med rnams zug rngu'i sdug bsngal bral/ /byang chub bar du yo byad phun tsho gos shog /skye bar skyes pa'i rten bzang rab rnyed cing / /bdud (227brdzogs 'ching grol yang dag lnga dang ldan/ /rlabs chen spyod pas byang chub 'tshol la sbyor/ /bgrang yas gnod pas 'tshe las grol bar shog /bkres rnamasabaza' bca' btung ba chos kyis tshim/ /brnag dka'i tshor ba med par bde ba myong / /'phags pa dgyes po'i tshul khrims dang ldan zhing / /nyon mongs tshogs bral rnam grol sa thob shog /'di nasa'aphos tshe be+e ḍūrla 'od zhing / /pad+ma'i snying por rdzus te nyer skyes nas/ /bzungs dang ting 'dzin la sogs yon tan thob/ /rgyal bas byin rlabs pa'aphrul mnga' brnyes shog /bslu med shākya seng ge'i ljags ring las/ /legs gsungs mdo chog 'dren pa sman gyi bla'i/ /bcu gnyis smon lam don rnams nyams myong pa/ /nyis stong sku brnyan bzhengs mthus lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di'ang dpon sa bu khrid rgyal mo skye gnas ngan pa las ldog pa'i ched du grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho ma bu gnyis kyis stong thang tshar re bzhedas pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /rgyal bas lung bstan sbas yul dkar mo ljongs/ /legs bshad sgrog pa'i dge 'dun tshogs rnams kyis/ /ston dang skyabs dngos zla bcas dpang bzhag nas/ /bden pa'i tshig gis nyer brjod smon lam mthus/ /mgrin par 'jam dbyangs dbyangs can legs zhugasang ga /dbang phyug don kun kun nas bsgrub pa'i blo/ /dpal ldan (228nasgo la bzang bzang po'i bag chags sad/ /thub bstan mdzes byed byed po brtan par shog /brgya phrag lor byon shākya seng ge yi/ /rgya chen sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde'i don/ /mtsho ltar gting zab brgal la 'jigs med pa/ /rnam dpyod go cha mnabs khyod —305

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)zhabs brtan shog /sgrib gnyis dgra tshogs ma lus nyer thub cing / /ma smad bstan pa lang tsho dar drag pa'i/ /sdebazhi'i sbyin pa ris med 'gro ba la/ /gtong phyir srid mtha'i bar du brtan par shog /'phrul snang bya 'dabs 'od kyis rab bskyangs pa'i/ /byang gling bsam 'grub rgyal po gnas ngan las//yongs grol dal 'byor rten thob ring min du/ /mya ga 'das pa'i sa der phyin par shog khul na mchis sogs tshe dpal mnga' thang gis/ /legs mtshon 'di snang yon tan ma lus pa/ /bla nas blar 'phel mngon par mtho ba'i lam/ /rim brgyud thar pa'i grong khyer la bgrod shog /mi 'gyur lhun grub chos 'khor rgyal gyi sde/ /gangs can phan bde bzhad pa'i nyer 'tsho'i gzhin/ /byams pa'i 'dus pa dang po 'phags yul du/ /ma byon de srid nyi zla ltar gsal shog /ces pa 'di'ang lha sa byang gling pas sbug chol gyi spyi 'bul sogs rnyed bskur dang bcas chos 'khor rgyal du 'dzugs rgyu'i smon lam tshigs bcad dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /(228bsko tshogs rab bkra'i srad bu nyer btags pa/ /dra ba dra phyed 'ja' tshon ri mo can/ /bgrang yas zhi khro 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor che/ /bar snang mdzes byed rgyan du legs spud chus/ /dge ba'i myu gu bla nas blar 'phel ba/ /nges legs khri shing rab rgyas rtse mo sa /byang chen snye ma ro mda' myangs ba'i rgyun/ /'gro la mchod sbyin ster ba'i ma mar shog /sngon bsags sdig stung dri zhakhru da mtho ris klung / /'di dang skye mang brgyud pa rkang pa'i rtser/ /bde ba'i tog mdzes nyer skyid lhab lhub gos/ /rgyu sbyor 'phrog byed zhabasi su bsil bar shog /thabs mkhas 'phrul gyis skye rgu'i zug rngu rnams/ /drungs nas 'byin pa lha yi rje bo gang / /bskal par 'tsho ba'i tshe dang dbang thang sogs/ /legs pa'i yon tan dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog /'dis mtshon bsags dang bsag 'gyur bsag bzhin pa'i/ /bsod nams phung po sa 'dzin dngos rgyu ba/ /nam mkha' pha mtha' des kyang mjal dka' ba'i/ /'gro rnams kun mkhyen thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di'ang 'tsho byed thabs mkhas—306

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanakyis rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par snyan dar brgya skor phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /'dren mchog bzhi pa shākya seng ge yi/ /legs gsung rnam gsum chos kyi 'khor lo'i don/ /lhun grub gdul bya rgya mtshor 'doms mdzad pa/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i (229na)zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /thog mtha' bar du bkra shis lung rtogs bstan/ /phun tsho gos sgo brgya mang po yongs phye ba/ /bgrang yas 'dus pa'i nyer 'tshor mgon po khyod/ /rdo rje lta bur rab tu brtan par shog /snying nas mi phyed dad pas gsol btab na/ /nam yang bslu ba med pa dkon cog gsum/ /phul byung thugasarje'i 'phrin las nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /bdag sogs mos ldan yongs la 'jug par shog /ces sgo mangs slob dpon don grub rgya mtsho'i gsol 'debs brtan zhugs 'di ni grwa tshang spyi sos skyes dang bcas te bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rigs 'dzin rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ /gang gis rang rig kun tu bzang / /mngon gsum rang ngo ma 'phrod bar/ /rjes bzung don gnyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /'di'ang sngags 'chang blo gros rgyal bas 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor brnyes bkod/ /rab dkar lhag bsam sis rgya mtsho'i klong / /'dab brgyad snying dbus ke sa ra yi rtser/ /drin can bla ma pad 'byung byu rar/ /mnyam sbyor bde chen dbyings su rtag bzhugaso gsol/ /gzhen nu bum skur ngo bo chos sku'i gdangs/ /rang bzhin mtshan dpe'i 'ja' ris longs spyod rdzogs/ /kun khyab thugs rje'i sprul pa mtha' klas kyang / /zhing 'dir bdag sogs 'gro ngor brtan par shog /(229ba)pad+ma gar dbang rgya gar paṇa chen gyi/ /'phrin las gangs can smin legs ltor 'geng ched//gdod nas 'gyur med 'pho ba chen po'i sku/ /grub pas rdo rje'i rang rtsal deng ston shog /zab gter chos kyi bdag por gling pa'i mtshan/ /rim brgyud thugs rje'i 'od 'bar nyin mor byed/ /bod yul —307

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)smag rum sel bar dngos byon pa/ /'char nub dang bral bstan pa'i mkhar gsal shog /dug lnga yongs dag ye shes rnam lnga'i gzugs/ /kun 'dus rigs brgya'i bdag por rab bzhengs nas/ /gang snang lha skur shar byed bum dbang gis/ /skal bzang sprul skur bsgyur phyir zhabs brtan sheg /gnam zhal yum gyi mkhar bskyil byang chub sems/ /dkar dmar dngas mas gdul bya'i rtsa khams rnams/ /legs khyab gtum mo'i drod 'bar longs sku'i sar/ /khrid min de srid rdo rje ltar brtan shog /thabs shes zung du 'jug pa dga' bzhi'i 'gros/ /bcu drug phyed phyed rdzogs pa'i bde ba che/ /pho nya'i lam gyis skal ldan chos sku'i 'bras/ /myong min bar du g.yung drung lta bur shog /ye nas sangs rgyas rig pa skyid rdo'i gser/ /nyer grub rang ngo mngon gsum ngo sprad de/ /brjod bral kun bzang ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ /'gro bkod ma gyur 'og min mgon bzhin shog /'tsho rgyal zhing 'dir zangs mdog dpal ri nas/ /dngos byon dhū ti'i mdud pa yongs bkrol mthus/ /gangs can phan bde'i dpyid du (230na 'ab mo gter/ /sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i rten 'brel lhun grub shog /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bka' rtags phyag gi rgya/ /'grol ba'i dus babs chos kyi 'phrin las la/ /mtho 'tsham bdud sde'i snying gar rtsa ba gsum/ /rab khros gtum drag 'bar ba'i bro chen rdungs/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus rnga yab gling pa yis/ /bod 'bangs 'gro ba'i don btab smon lam 'bras/ /phun tshogs ro bda' smin pa'i dpag bsam ljon/ /thugs rje'i grib mar yid can ngal gsor shog /tshe mtha' yas sogs dkon mchog rin cen gyi/ /gsang gsum mi zad 'khor lo'o gzi byin dang / /'bar ma ma ning bstan srung rgya mtsho yis/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhed pa'i don kun sgrubs/ /'phrin las rgyal mtshan mgon khyod phyag sor gyis/ /nyer bzung bka' gter dzam bu'i gser tog rtser/ /bshad sgrub yid bzhin nor las dngos grub char/ /phyogs dus kun tu ba smil ba'i bkra shis shog /ces slob dpon chen po be+e ro tsa na'i rnam 'phrul sprul pa'i sku chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa'i brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs su bcad 'di ni dmar ser can gyi lo mgo zla'i yar ngo tshes bcu'i mchod pa'i tshe za hor gyi bzhes rdo rje —308

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenathogs med rtsal gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bris pa su sirnyi ra sdu/ /(230ba) brtan pa'i 'khor lo dgyes zhal nyi zer gyis/ /ngag la smra ba'i 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i dbus/ /ma nub dbang gi chu bo ze'u 'bru'i bcud/ /gdul bya bung ba'i dga' ston rgyas mdzad bsngags/ /blo gros rnam par yangs pas gser mngal du/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i rig byed bzhi ldan lha/ /yongs smin thub bstan mi mjed zhing gi gtso/ /mtshungs med skye rgu'i gnyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgya chen mdo dang rgyud sde ma lus pa/ /mtsho ltar gting mtha' dpog par nus min gnas/ /smra la spobs pa'i mgrin pa gzengs mtho ba/ /zla bral dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgra chad gzo gso la sogs gtsug lag gi /dka' gnad tshig don rgyud mangs las drangs pa/ /brjod pa rnam dag glur 'bab dbyangs can ma/ /snying dbus pad+ma ra bzhugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshad du 'ching la nam mkha'i ska rags kyang / /thung ngur byed pa ma gyur 'gro ba'i don/ /sgrub par 'jigasamed lhag bsam btsan po'i go /dkar cha'i zla rjes 'gro la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgrib gnyis kun thub rgyal ba zas gtsang sras/ /lung rtogs bstan pa'i lang tsho bla nas blar/ /thos bsam sgom pas rab spel rnam dpyod sde/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ / mtshan tsam thos pa'i mod la dus min gyi/ /'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal ba'i smon lam mthu/ /legs grub tshe mtha' yas pa'i lha tsho gos rnams/ /bden tshig grub pa'i dpang po mdzad du gsol/ /ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo/(231na)/bskal bzang 'dren mchog mchog gyur bzhi pa'i bstan/ /spel nus rnam dpyod dpyod ldan yid dbang 'phrog /yongs khyab snyan grags grags 'bar zhabs brtan shog /rgya mtsho'i gos kyis nyer bteg lus can la/ /'jigs med skyabs kyi sbyin pas legs sman zhing / /gzhan phan phrag par len pa'i sems bskyed kyis/ /ma med go cha bgos khyod zhabs brtan shog /thub bstan lang tsho dar ba'i sgo 'phar nas/ /sdebazhi'i longs spyod 'gro la gtong mkhas pa/ /ma 'dris skye rgu'i gnyen khyod rdo rje'i khrir/ /bskal brgyar bzhugs la gdul bya'i re skong —309

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gsol/ /dpal ldan nā lan+da yi 'dus sde cher/ /dge 'dun bshad sgrub dar zhing dbang lung khrid/ /rjes gnang rig gtad chos 'khor bskor mdzad pa'i/ /nges par bstan 'dzin tshogs rnams zhabs brtan shog /gnyis med rgyud sde'i rigs bdag kye rdo rje'i/ /bstan srung bye ba'i sde dpon gur gyi mgon/ /mthu chen stobs 'phrog legs ldan nag po sogs /dam can rgya mtshos bsams pa'i re ba skongs/ /dran pas khams gsum dbang sdud rig byed ma/ /tshogs kyi bdag po 'dod pa'i rgyal po yis/ /srid zhi'i dge legs ma lus rab bkug ste/ /bkra shis dpal gyis dus kun khyab par shog /nged rang gi gsol 'debs ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad blo ka bcu gsum tsam yod pa zhig dgosazhes rgyud sde rgya mtshor mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen (231ba)rab mchog tu yangs pa'i mkhas grub chen po bco brgyad chos kyi rje byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub kyi gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /khyod zhabs 'khor lo'i ri mo 'gro kun gyi/ /gtsug tor rtser 'dzegs 'dren mchog shākya'i rgyal/ /thugs rje'i nyi 'od bdag snying pad+ma la/ /nyer zhugs srid zhi'i mdun ma lhun grub shog /rnam mkhyen srang la shes bya'i phung po dang / /khyod kyi blo gros gzhal tshe lci yang du/ /mi mngon bskal bzang bzhi pa'i lung rtogs chos/ /grags pa phyogs brgyar bsgrags des bdag byin rlobs/ /lus ngag yid dbang glang snar bag yod blo'i/ /lcags kyus yongs btab mkhas btsun bzang po'i gar/ /bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i mthar khyab pas/ /don gnyis grub pa'i dpal la bdag 'god gsol/ /zhes dpon sa bu khrid rgyal mo'i dad rten du/ /thub dbang / rgyal ba tsong kha pa nged rang gi 'dra 'bag rnams bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rtag tu yid la dad pa'i ri mo bris/ /dam bcas gzungs bklags 'bras bu ma pham mgon/ /mngon la4 rgyas tshe bdag dang thos so cog /btsal te byang chub lung bstan dbugs dbyung shog /ngan song —3/0

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhinasdug bsngal mngal gyi dri ma dag /stong phrag bskal par 'khor los sgyur rgyal 'thob/ (232na)/dge bcu dang ldan bsams pa'i don kun 'grub/ /nam yang mi brjed zhal 'tshes 'bras smin shog /sdig pa'i stobs bskyed thon ga'i gnas ngan du/ /skyes kyang nyi ma'i gnyen la gsol ba'i don/ /ji bzhin rjes su bzung nas bdag sogs rnams/ /byang chub ma thob bar du bshes mdzod cig /byams pasadam bcas pa'i gzungs kyi rjes su 'don rgyu'i smon lam tshigs bcad cig dgos zhes gzhis ka shar rgyal mos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bo thod phreng rtsal/ /zhi 6kun 'dus bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha/ /ma ning chos skyong yongs rdzogs gter srung tshogs/ /thugs rje mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung skyed la/ /pad+ma ka ra'i 'phrin las spel ba'i sde/ /mkha' 'gro'i gling du bsu ba'i pho nya mo'i/ /dar lam bcad nas mi g.yo rdo rje'i khrir/ /bzhugs par byin gyis brlab cing las kun sgrubs/ /mchog gsum thugs rje chos nyid 'gyur ba med/ /chos can rgyu 'bras mi slu'i rten 'brel mthus/ /rigs 'dzin che khyod sku tshe'i 'phrang bsgral nas/ /g.yung drung ltar brtan bden tshig 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di'ang thub bstan rdo rje brag tu rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma sogs 'phrang gegs kyi sku tshe'i dog gzhi che zhing sku khams nan tar mi bde ba'i dus za hor gyi brnyes bden tshig (232bachu brjod pa'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /dkon cog rin cen rnam gsum thugs rje'i mthus/ /tshe rabs kun tu skyes pa'i rten rnyed par/ /dal lor tshang zhing bstan la rab byung ste/ /khrims ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i dpal thob shog /rang blor 'tsham pa'i theg gsum chos kyi sgo/ /'brul ba med ston bshes gnyen dam pa yis/ /rjes bzung lam bzang them skas rim bgrod nas/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i khang par rab 'jug shog /mdor na deng nas byang chub mngon gyur bar/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtsho las legs byas grus/ /bsgral te bde skyid rin chen gling yangs por/ /'dzad med sim pa'i bdog par longs spyod shog /ces pa —311

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'di'ang rgya mtsho dge tshul mas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje dar nag ber chen sku/ /srin po'i rgyal por rkarma gu ru'i gar/ /yang gsang drag tu khros pa bris thang du/ /sgo gsum 'bad pas bzhengs pa'i legs byas 'bras/ /gnam lcags phur bus bdud bzhi'i snying gzer ba'i/ /mod la ral 'gri'i dbal gyis bcad pa'i mgo/ /do shal ring por 'phyang nas phyogs kun las/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par shog /nying mtshamasasbyar tshe rang nyid thod phreng rtsal/ /ches phra rlung gi bzhen pa la brten te/ /laṅka'i rgyal khab cher (233na)bzhugs mgon po'i thugs/ /bde stong chos sku'i ngang du ro gcig shog /ces pa'ang pho brang gnang byung ba sngags 'chang blo bzang mkhyen brtse'i dmigs rten du yang gsang drag po'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /blo bzang thogs med lhag bsam dag pa'i mkhar/ /'dra 'bag zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rab bzhengs pas/ /duḥkha'i smag rum kun sangs srid dang zhi'i/ /bde skyid snang ba'i 'od kyis khyab par shog /ces gser sku bzhengs pa'i kha byang smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor bzhes bkod/ /rta mchog rol pa bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa'i mthus/ /bdud sde'i bar chad g.yul las rnam rgyal te/ /deng nas kun mkhyen ye shes thob min par/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes 'dzin shog /ces pa'ang legs bshad gling chos rje'i zhal 'don du za hor gyi bzhes bris/ /phyed kyis lhag pa'i dngul srang bcu bzhi las/ /legs grub ba kla bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gnod/ /ngag dbang tshul khrims kyis phul dge tsho gos gos/ /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus khrub par shog /ces pa'ang grwa tshang gi dge bskos las sne'i 'jog la phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor bzhes bkod pa sirnyi sku/ /—312

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zheda'ajam zhing ches dul ngur smig gos kyis klubs/(233ba)/dam chos dbyangs snyan skye rgu'i rna lung 'jebs/ /grags pas kun khyab bshes gnyen zhing gzhan du/ /gshegs kyang bdag sogs 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs/ /ji ltar bzhed pa'i rnam dkar 'phrin las rgyun/ /nam mkha'i pha mthar bsnyegs pa'i yid can gyis/ /rgyud la nyer zhugs ma na par mtho ba dang / /nges legs lam der myur du bkri bar shog /dngos su bshams dang yid kyis rab sprul pa'i/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyis sri zhur brtson byed na/ /bsod nams bye ba'i zhing gyur bla ma yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin par shog /ces pa 'di'ang skyid shod sprul pa'i sku'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'a snga ma dbyangs grags pa'o/ /ris med kun la rjes su chags pa'i mdangs/ /mtshan dpe'i 'ja' 'od dang 'dres mdzod spu'i zer/ /bdud rtsi'i zigs ma legs 'bab 'gro kun gyi/ /a lha mi shigs srog gi ka ba tshugs/ /zhal khyim phyag zhabs mthil du rab gsal spyan/ /dkyus ring cho me kyi pha mtha' 'jal 'dra bas/ /shes byar srid la ma bsgribs ye shes kyi/ /'dren byed 'gro la mngon sum dngom pa bzhin/ /rnam 'dren ljags ring pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru'i rtser/ /ched du bang gas pa'i mtshan snyan bung ba'i glus/ /gshin rje'i las kyi me long ngal gso sa /byas zhes phyogs bral rna bar len pa bzhin/ /rgyal kun spang rtogs thugs rjer lci dang yang / /(234na skoti ma'i srang la gzhal tshe rnyed min kyang / /sngon gyi smon lam dam bcas 'chi bdag g.yul/ /pham par gcig tu dpa' rnams dbang por gsol/ /rnam dag ngag yid tshangs pa'i ral klung nas/ /dbang bzhi'i gdas gdul bya'i blo yi dri/ /rab bkrus lnga ldan ye shes bskal bzang du/ /bsgyur te bskal par mngon sum yul 'gyur shog /zab dang rgya che thub gzhung gting dpog par/ /mtsho byung drin las mi 'jigs spobs pa yis/ /yod med mtha' bral dbu mar gnas pa'i go /cha gang dkar phyogs zlar mtshungs 'grib med shog /sgrib gnyis dgra tshogasanyer thub lung rtogs kyi/ /bstan pa'i lang tsho dar la bab pa'i sde/ /mkha' sbyor lo pas spyod bdun —313

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ldan ji bzhin du/ /'khor mtha' rnyed min chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ /'jam dpal dbyangs kyis dga' mgur brtse ba'i lha/ /yid 'phrog dri za'i bu mos bshes mdzad gang / /ris med 'gro ba'i gnyen du g.yung drung gi /legs mtshan khri la g.yo ba med par shog /nyams 'gyur stong gi brjod pa rnam dag skur/ /tshangs pa'i sras mo dgyes pas nyer bshad las/ /lar rtsod rtsom pa'i rdo rjes rab rmongs pa'i/ /sa 'dzin bgrod byed mthar mdzad brtan par shog /dga' bzhi'i 'gros ldan gsang chen sngags kyi lam/ /med byung theg mchog rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gling / /rim gsum 'khor lo'i bya ba srid mtha'i bar/ /dbyar gyi chu (234bsko ter bzhin du 'phel bar shog /dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang che'i/ /khrims gnyis rtsibs stongs gser gyi 'khor lo yis/ /kun bzod pha mtha'i khyon la mnga' sgyur te/ /'dzam gling yongs kyi gtsug na mngon mthor shog /gser mdog zhwa yi cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan/ /lus can yongs kyi bsod nams zhing mchog tu/ /ma pham mgon gyi ring lugs 'phags pa'i yul/ /byon min 'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel shog /mkha' la dkon mchog thugs rje'i nyi 'od brdal/ /bar snang lha rnams bkra shis me tog 'thor/ /sa la 'gro kun bde skyid rtsed 'jor rol/ /dga' mgur spyod cing mched lcam spun grogs rnams/ /zhes pa 'di'ang dga' ldan gsang sngags gling slob dpon ngag dbang nor bu gnyer pa grwa dmangs dang bcas pas nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar pa'i yi ge pa ni snyan tshig smra ba lcang gseb pa bstan 'dzin dbang pho/ /sor rtog ye shes rang gdangs zad mi shes / /snang ba mtha' yas mtshan dpe'i sgyu 'phrul phyag /bdud rtsi'i bum bzang bteg nas 'gro kun la/ /'chi med rdo rje'i srog gi ka ba tshugs/ /ngag dbang blo yi nyi mas rmongs pa'i mun/ /nyer sangs mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'dab stong bcud/ /rab myong gdul bya bung bas rgya mtsho'i mtha'/ /yongs khyab srid pa'i pha mthar mi g.yo shog /tshangs sras lha mos bdungs pa'i pi waṃ rgyud/ /mgrin par (235na tshe lho brol bas dpyod ldan legs ba 'ad pas/ /—314

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhinadhū ti'i ka ba gzhom med rdo rje sa /'grub par tshe mtha' yas pas byin gyis rlobs/ /zhakhrul bral lam ston rgyud la mngon byed skyabs/ /zla grogs mchog gsum thugs rje'i chu 'dzin sbubs/ /bden tshig dbyar rngas skal ldan rma bya'i tshogs/ /dga' ba'i sgo gzhog zlum por gar byed shog /lhag bsam chu gter nang lhungs bsod nams kyis/ /'dzam bu'i snye ma gser du bsgyur ba'i dpyas/ /phan bde'i dpal 'byor mdzod la lus can kun/ /spyod par mi 'dzad gter gyi rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad cig dgos tshul grub rigs rgya mtsho'i gtsug tor rtse mor zhabs sen gyi zla ba mngon par tshes pa dpal stag lung pa chen po rnam rgyal legs grub kyi bka' stsal ba bzhin za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa bstan 'dzin dbang po'o/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa mnga' bas don gnyis grub/ /'gog lam ldan pas srid zhi'i 'ching las grol/ /mya ngan 'das par legs bkri zla grogs can/ /bslu med mchog gsum thugs rje chen po'i mthus/ /bag yod khrims kyis rang rgyud 'jam zhing mnyen/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i sgra dbyangs phyog bcur khyab/ /yongs snyan grags pa rab 'bar dge ba'i bshes/ /ljongs 'dir yang srid myur du 'byon byin rlobs/ /zhing g.yin gang 'tsham 'jug pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ /nam mkha'i mtha' (235ba)bsnyeg zad pa med na yang / /bdag sogs bsam pa'i 'dod pa legs 'jo'i ched/ /gangs can yul du gsal por ston par shog /mngon gyur nyon mongs 'dul ba tshul khrims kyi/ /lhag pa'i bslab pas thugs rgyud nyer gtams pa/ /'dus sde'i tshogs kyis bden tshig rab brjod mthus/ /gos bu ring por mi thogs smin par shog /legs ldan ma hā kā la phyag drug pa/ /bka' sdod bdud kyi mgon po trag shad dang / /dpal ldan dung skyong dbang mo la sogs pas/ /bsams pa'i don kun grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /slob dpon 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i sku skye myur 'byon gyi tshigs su bcad pa zhig dgos zhes dbon po blo bzang mkhas btsun gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /—315

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)shes bya kun mkhyen ngag dbang lhag pa'i lhas/ /phul byung blo gros bzang po'i mchog sbyin pas/ /gtsug lag rgya mtshor spobs pa rab dge ba'i/ /snang brnyan ngo mtshar dad rten 'di bskrun mthus/ /sgo gsum gdung ba'i tshor ba dang bral zhing / /bde skyid sum rtsen bdag po'i dpal la 'gran/ /'khor ba chu srin 'byung gnas las thar te/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i grong khyer la 'jug shog /skye ba rim brgyud mgon khyod nyam ring du/ /skyes nas nges gsang chos kyi bang mdzod la/ /longs su spyad pas rang rgyud legs smin cing / /gzhan rgyud 'grol ba'i smon pa lhun grub shog /'jam mgon ngur smrig 'chang ba (236na〉tsong kha pa'i/ /mdo sngags zab dang rgya che'i chos tshul kun/ /thos don legasabasams sgom pa mthar phyin te/ /gang gi 'phrin las bdag rgyud la 'jug shog /rgyal ba sman gyi bla ma mched bdun gyi/ /thugs rjes 'di snang dga' skyid phun sum tshogs/ /nying mtshams sbyar nas bde ldan dag zhing du/ /'od dpag med pa'i sras su skye bar shog /mchog mthun dngos grub sgrub tshe bdud sde'i snying / /dpal chen phyag na bsgril ba'i phur pa yis/ /thal byung phug ste bar chad las rgyal ba'i//'phrin las rnam bzhi bde blag 'grub byin rlobs/ /'chi bdag dpung tshogs 'joms byed gshin rje'i gshed/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyi rol pa'i stang stabs zhabs/ /yid srubs sder bcas snying la bro brdungs pas/ /dgra bgegs g.yul las rnam par rgyal bar shog /ces nged rang gi 'dra 'bag gtso thang du byas pa'i bris thang lnga char bkras rab dka' bcu ba blo bzang lhun grub kyis bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /nyer gsum srang ldan rin chen gnyis pa las/ /legs grub kong bur yongs sbar sgron me yis//dkon mchog mchod pas 'khor 'das gdung ba'i mun/ /rab bcil bde skyid snang bas khyab par shog/ces pa 'di'ang 'phyong rgyas pa blo bzang thugs rjes sngags rams pa byas skabs grwa tshang du dngul kong phul ba'i tshe kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi (236ba tha zhes bkod pa maṅga le/ /rtag tu bkra shis dbyangs su nyer sgrog glu/ /oṃ yig zol gyis len pa'i zhal gi sgo'i/ /—316

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedamakhur tshos nas brdol ā thas dran gsos pa/ /tshe yi rig byed srog gi zungs 'gyur shog /'chi med sor mos gtor ba man+da ra'i/ /spel legs char du bsnyil dang lhan cig tu/ /bden brjod grub par mchog gsum drang srong sogs/ /mthun 'gyur tshig gi rgyud mang 'brol bar shog /brjod pa rnam par dag pa ngag gi dbang / /blo gter dri za'i lus phra ngang mo dkar/ /mgrin pa'i rdzing bur rtag rol bskal bzang gtam/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dbyangs blo bzang grags pa'i chos srid bstan/ /spel la dga' ba brgya ba'i she mong gis/ /gnam gyi mthongs nas dbang bskur bshes gnyen mchog /g.yung drung lta bur 'gyur med brtan par shog /khrims gnyis gser gyi gnya' shing 'gro kun gyi/ /phrag par rab lci nor 'dzin skyong ba yi/ /sku tshe mnga' thang chab srid bla nas blar/ /mthor brtsegs tshangs pa'i yul sar bsnyeg par shog /rgyan drug mchog gnyis thugs la mnga' ba'i gzhung / /ris med thos dang bsam par byed pa'i gra/ /phyogs bral kun nas tshang ba 'dus tshogs sde//rdzogs ldan gsar 'byung de srid dar bar shog /nges pa'i don du rdo rje dbyings phyug ma/ /thun mong gdul byar sa bcu mngon gyur tshul/ /thub bstan bsrung la dmag dang zor gyi lha/ /'dod khamasabadag mos las bzhi sgrub tu gsol/(237na)/gsol 'debs smon lam gyi shis pa brjod pa 'di'ang mnga' ris grwa tshang slob dpon blo bzang nor bus ched gnyer du bskul ba la brten za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa bstan 'dzin dbang pa'o/ /dpal ldan shākya'i skyes mchogo zas gtsang sras/ /rgyal tshab sa bcu'i bdag nyid byams pa mgon/ /'jig rten dbang phyug pad dkar 'chang la sogs/ /sras bcas rnam 'dren thams cad deng 'dir dgongs/ /brgya phrag mchod pa dngos su bshams pa dang / /mos dang ting 'dzin stobs lasalegs spel te/ /lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang bzang du/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar ltar phye'i mthus/ /lus can kun la sman yon 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /thub bstan snying po bshad dang sgrub pa'i dpal/ /'dzin mdzad dge 'dun sde rnams dar ba dang / /'jig rten ma lus bde zhing skyid par shog /—317—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)sangs rgyas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma yi/ /zhabs zungs rdo rje'i khri la rtag brtan cing / /dga' ba'i dpal ldan sde bzhi'i pho brang gi /chab srid mnga' thang 'phel zhing rgyas par shog /zang zing bdog pa'i rgyu tshogs gtong ba dang / /ched du bsgrub tshul g.yos su bya ba sogs/ /mi dang dud 'gros mtha' brten gtogs so cog /nad gdon dbul phongs rgud tshogs zhi bar shog /brgya phrag lor gnas ston brgya'i 'bru bcud myang/ /'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor dbyar gyi char bzhin 'bab/ /sim pa'i tshor bas lus ngag yid gsum la/ /bde bar spyod pa'i bsod nams 'thob par shog /thos bsams (237ba〉skom la blo gros rab tu yangs/ /bag yod dang ldan rnam dkar sa bon tshogs/ / bsngo ba smon lam brlan gsher gyis bskrun pas/ /byang chub bar gyi myu gu smin par shog /rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya seng ge yi/ /phyag mthil 'khor lo'i ri mo rab bkra ba/ /bdag sogs lus can kun gyi spyi bo sa /bzhag nas dbugs dbyung byang chub lung ston shog /ma pham mgon khyod ris su ma chad par/ /rab snyoms byams pa'i chu rgyun bdag rgyud la/ /zhugs te rjes brtse'i me tog chun po yis/ /bdud sde'i dpung tshogs 'ching ba'i nus ldan shog /rigs gsum sgyu dra'i gar mkhan chos kyi rgyal/ /mes dbon rim byon gyis bzhengs gtsug lag khang / /rten dang brten par bcas la tshe rabs kun/ /bsod nams zhing du srid zhu bskrun nus shog /nying mtshams sbyar tshe bde ba can zhing du/ /pad+ma'i sbubs su rdzus te legs skyes nas/ /'od dpag med gsung chos thos rab grol bas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /skal dman dag zhing skye bar ma nus na/ /mi khom gnas su nam yang mi 'gro zhing / /dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i rten bzang po/ /thob nas theg chen chos la sbyor bar shog /bskal pa mang por bya dka'i spyod pa yis/ /sal ma tshogs kyis bsgrub la mi bltos par/ /gsang sngags smin cing grol ba'i gdams pa yis/ /myur du zung 'jug sku bzhi mngon 'gyur shog /nam mkha'i mthas kyang snyed par mi nus pa'i/ /ma rgan mtha' dag bsdu ba rnam pa bzhis/ /(238na)'khor du byas te pha rol phyin drug gi /rlabs chen spyod pa'i tshul la spyod par shog /mdor na ji snyed —318

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanabasags pa'i chos dkar gyi/ /'bras bus skye rgu mtha' dag stobs bcu'i rtsal/ /yongs rdzogs theg pa chen po'i mi slob lam/ /ring min sngon du 'gyur ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di'ang sa rta cho 'phrul chen mo'i thog dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis brgya mchod phul ba'i dus ngag 'don du byas chog pa zhig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa bstan 'dzin dbang po'o/ /dug gsum des bskyed nad 'joms gser mdog dang / /lhung bzed zil mngar bcud kyis nyer gtams pas/ /lus can yongs kyi sdug bsngal gzhil mdzad pa/ /be+e ḍūrla 'od ye shes spyan gyisagazigs/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i na chung tshangs sras thugs/ /rnam dpyod lang tshos phyogs pasayongs ba 'ad pa'i/ /bshes gnyen rdo rje rtse brgyas rgol ngan ri/ /mthar byed 'gro ba'i nye 'tshor brtan byin rlobs/ /lus ngag yid gsum dri 'khrud dbang bzhi'i chus/ /blo gros myu gu ye shes lnga 'bras su//smin pas skal bzang gdul bya'i 'dren pa mchog /rgya mtsho'i gos can gzhi 'dir brtan par shog /srog 'tsho'i rig byed gaṅgā'i yab cig las/ /'chi med grub rgyun phyog bzhin sbags pa'i klung / /drang srong 'dus pa zla ba'i ma ma'i gling / /bskal pa'i pha mtha' de srid 'bab par shog /gnod sbyin sdodapon rdo rje bdud 'dul dang / /ngag (238bsko nus thob lha mi'i rig 'dzin gyis/ /ji ltar smon pa'i re ba lhun grub pa/ /yongs 'du'i grib mar rtag tu ngal gsor shog /ces sman bla dang 'brel ba'i bden brjod kyi tshigs bcad lnga tsam yod pa zhig drang srong 'dus pa'i gling du 'dzugs rtsis kyi lha'i rje bo tshangs ris grub pa'i sman pa tsha rong pa spun gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa bstan 'dzin dbang po'o/ /ljags bzang bkram pa'i rgyud mang glur/ /mdo chog sgra 'brol nyi ma'i gnyen/ /bsod nams dar rgyas mngon mtho dang / /nges par legs pa'i lam la sbyor/ /be+e ḍūrla 'od rgyal po yis/ /thugs bskyed smon pa'i don ji bzhin/ /bsod nams der rgyas sdug kun gyi/ /bden las rnam par grol byin rlobs/ /mngon mkhyen rgyal po'i thugs rje'i zla/ /yongs bsil zegs ma 'bum phrag gis/ /bsod —319

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)nams dar rgyas 'khor ba yi/ /sreg byed tsha gdung mtha' dag gcil/ /chos grags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs snyan pos/ /skye bar yid la legs sim sgras/ /bsod nams dar rgyas thos 'dzin du/ /'jebs pa'i dga' ston myong bar mdzod/ /mi bzad mya ngan ming tsam yang / /med pa yid bde'i tshor ba la bsod nams dar rgyas skye ba kun/ /spyod par mdzod cig mchog gi dpal/ /legs byas bsags pa'i dzaskru'i 'bras/ /gser bzang snye mar yongs bsgyur te/ /bsod nams dar rgyas srid pa yi/ /zug rngu'i dri ma med par shog /tshogs gnyis yid bzhin rin (239na sgon las/ /rdul bral ston na'i zla 'od ltar/ /bsod nams dar rgyas chos dkar gyis/ /brgya phrag byugs pas ches gsal shog khred zhi'i mtha' bral sangs rgyas mtshon/ /legs par yongs bsgrags lung bstan gyis/ / bsod nams dar rgyas ring min du/ /stob bcu mnga' ba brnyes par shog /gru 'dzin la dgyes pad dkar 'chang / /byams dang brtse ba'i spyan ras kyis/ /bsod nams dar rgyas srid mtsho las/ /sgrol ba'i gzigs pa lhod med stsol/ /rgyal rnams pad+ma'i 'dab stong dbus/ /legs byung gtan gyi skyabs gnas kyis/ /bsod nams dar rgyas rang ring rtsal/ /tso bzang ngo 'phrod de srid skyongs/ /stong nyid snying rje'i nyams kyi gar/ /mdzes sdug phyag rgya man+da ras/ /bsod nams dar rgyas mkha' 'gro'i grong / /khrid la bde chen lam du drongs/ /mkha' la mkha' yi sbyor ba bzhin/ /rdo rje btsun mo 'tsho rgyal mas/ /bsod nams dar rgyasapad+ma 'od/ /dag pa'i zhing der drang du gsol/ /waṃ yig pad+ma 'byung gnas skur/ /e dbyings gzungasam legs 'khril bas/ /bsod nams dar rgyas dga' bzhi'i 'gros/ /tshe gcig rdo rje 'chang brnyes mdzod/ /rnam dag tshul khrims bring da kyis/ /yongs khyab pad+ma sam bha was/ /bsod nams dar rgyasabag yod sogs/ /yon tan sna tshogs la sbyor gsol/ /ji lta ji snyed kun gzigs pa'i/ /mkhas pa blo ldan mchog sred kyis/ /bsod nams dar rgyas shes bya'i gnas/ /nges par thams(239bcad mkhyen par shog /pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs 'dzin pa/ /'khor 'das yongs kyi rgyal po yis/ /bsod namasadar sri rgyas da kun tu/ /legs tshogos ma lus dbang du sdus/ /byin rlabs nya ma'i dkyil 'khor las//—320

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanathugs rje'i 'od zer med po ches/ /bsod nams dar rgyas ring min du/ /'gro rnams 'dul ba'i mgon por mdzod/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal gyi gzi 'bar ba/ /bcom ldan shākya seng ge'i mthus/ /bsod nams dar rgyas bdud bzhi yi/ /g.yul las rnam par rgyal byin rlobs/ /'jigs pa dang bral seng ge'i sgra/ /rab sgrog khro bo drag shul can/ /bsod nams dar rgyas mu stegs sogs/ /lta ngan gnod byed tsho gos kun skyobs/ /gtum drag rdo rje gro bo lod/ /za byed rngams pa'i stang stabs kyis/ /bsod nams dang rgyas skye ba kun/ /'byung po'i gdon bgegs las mthar mdzod/ /'jam dpal dge slong tshul 'chang ba/ /'dren mchog blo bzang grags pa yis/ / bsod nams dar rgyas byang chen sa/ /ma thob bar du rjes su gzung / /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag che/ /blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ /bsod nams dar rgyas thar pa yi/ /pho brang chen por drang bar gsol/ /ngag dbang tshangs sras blo gros la/ /spyod pa'i skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sdes/ /bsod nams dar rgyas gtan gyi bder/ /'god smon mchog gsum dpang por gsol/ /zhes sgom bu ba bsod nams dar rgyas kyi ched du rgyal phur rab brtan sogs shul mi rnams kyis sman bla bde (240na〉/gegs brgyad tshar gnyis/ bcu gcig zhal gu ru mtshan brgyad dang jo mo gnyis/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa gnyis/ paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chosakyi rgyal mtshan gnyis/ nged rang gi 'dra 'bag bzhi rnams gser zangs las bzhengs pa'i tshe smon lam dgos tshul ltar za tor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /smin byed bdud rtsi mdzes 'khyil ba'i/ /dngul dkar bum bzang rab 'byams pa/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis phul 'bras/ /ye shes sna lnga mngon gyur shog /ces 'phyos pa sngags rams pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis gra tshang du zho dgus lhag pa'i dngul srang nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod pa'i bum pa phul ba'i kha byang du za hor gyi brnyes bkod pa sirnyi ra stu/ /khyab bdag pad+ma ka ra'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rig sngags lhun grub 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i rdo rje gdul bya'i don/ /sprul sku'i yang srid myur du 'byon par shog /zhi —321 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang / /legs ldan 'bar ma ma ning bstan srung sogs/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon zab gter skyong rnams kyis/ /rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las 'bad med sgrub//gzhon nu'i bum skur ngo bo dag pa'i dbyings/ /ye rdzogs chos sku rtsal snang longs sku'i zhing / /rang bzhin nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od kyi zer/ /thugs rje mchog dman kun la khyab par shog /rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa (240ba)dres pa 'jam dbyangs chos rgyal rdo rje'i sprul sku myur byon gyi tshigs bcad cig dgos zhes gzhan phan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /gru dkar nor bu'i phra bkod gser sbyangs rgyan/ /mi phyed dad pas phul ba'i dge legs 'bras/ /dgos pa nor bu bsod nams phun tshogs gsum/ /mngon mtho'i rten brgyud sangs rgyasanyer thob shog /rgyu sbyor bsod nams dpal mo tshe 'dir bde/ /lha mi'i rten bzang rim rnyed ma pham mgon/ /mchog gi sprul skur gyur dus 'dus pa sa /skyes nas rnam par grol ba thob par shog /ka brgyad sbug bsod nams dpal mos gtsug g.yu 'gangs che ba jo bo rin po che'i sku rgyan du phul ba'i smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes bkod pa'o/ /rnam 'dren yongs kyi mkhyen brtse nus stobs gzugs/ /mtshams sprin bla gos rab klubs 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /blo bzang grags pa'i thugs rje'i nyi 'od kyis/ /phan bde'i snang ba ches cher 'bar gyur cig /khed shod khun 'du lur 'bod u ba sha /rigs rgyud bstan 'dzin chung gi ming can sogs/ /spun zla tsha bor bcas rnams legs kyi byas/ /dge ba'i 'bras bzang mngon sum myong bar shog /zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan pa'i zhabs/ /bla nas blar 'degs yon gyi bdag po sa /yongs gyur 'di dang phyi ma'i don chen tshogs/ /'bad pa med par lhun gyis grub par shog /bshesaganyen dam pa (241na)zhabs pad rtag brtan cing / /byang chub bar du 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ /blang dang dor bya'i gnas kun ma lus pa/ /ston pa'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog /'thab rtsod —322

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanand mug rgud pa'i 'tshe ba rnams/ /rje 'bangs yongs la ming yang mi grag cing / /rdzogs ldan dpyid kyi dpal mo rab 'bod pa/ /gzhan gsos mgrin rnga snyan po 'brol bar shog /er khe da'i ching gi bu rab 'byams pa blo bzang bkra shis dang bstan 'dzin hung tha'i ji'i mi sna che chen chos rje gnyis kyis smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /ngag gi dbang phyug grub pa'i blo gros kyi/ /mkhas btsun bzang por rnam rol 'phrin las rgyun/ /rgya mtsho'i gos kyi mtha' snyed yongs brnyes pa/ /bshes gnyen mchog gi mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i legs byas mchod sdong gzhin/ /rdo rje'i khri la 'khor ba stongs min bar/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i mgon dang dbyer med du/ /gsol btab yongs smin re ba 'bras ldan shog /byang chub mchog gi grong khyer nyams dga' bar/ /bdag sogs bgrod min de srid mgon khyod kyis/ /rjes bzung 'khor 'das yon tan ma lus pa/ /dkar cha'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar shog khresapa 'di'ang rgyal mo no yon dha ra'i ngag 'don du dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong (241ba〉sngags rams pa'o/ /gsung ngag dbang chu blo gros mtho ris lam/ /legs brgyud bskal bzang snying gi za ma tog /rab 'khyil smin grol rgya mtsho ltar zab pas/ /rang gzhan don sa gnyas ba la gsol ba 'debs/ /'og min zhing gi zhing khams gtso bo sa /nyer bzhugs lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku bzhin/ /lnga brgya'i lus can nyer 'tshor rdo rje yi/ /srog song 'gyur ba med par brtan gyur cig /bdag sogs rnams kyi srid zhi'i legs tshogs kun/ /dbyar gyi chu gter lta bur rab 'phel zhid / /kun mkhyen ye shes mngon du ma gyur bar/ /'bral med rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang mdo pa dbon chung gis nan tan du bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /—323

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'od dpag med mgon rgyal sras 'khor bcas la/ /mi phyed dang ba'i dad pas rtse gcig tu//kun tu bzang po'i smon lam shugs drag por/ /bto pa'i don bzhin mngon sum 'gyur bar shog /yid 'phrog lta bas mi ngoms zhing gi mchog /bde ba can du pad+ma sbubs nang du/ /rdzus skyes snang ba mtha' yas zhal mthong nas/ /yan lag drug cu'i sgra dbyangs rnar sim shog /thos pa'i mod la bdag rgyud rnam grol te/ /nam mkha'i pha mthar 'jal byed sems can rnams/ /'khor ba'i mtsho las nyer bsgral thar gling du/ /'dren pa'i ded dpon r+pā por 'gyur bar shog /ces pa'ang er khe (242na)chos rjes bskul ba'i ngor za hor bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /ngag gi dbang phyug kun mkhyen tsong kha pa'i/ /dri bral bstan pa rin chen rjes zhugs nas/ /ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa dge ba'i gshes/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam mang gdul byar chos kyi 'khor lo'i rgyun / /chad med bskor phyir mi g.yo rab brtan cing / /thosabasam tshul bzhin bsgrub pa 'dus pa'i gling / /srid mtha'i bar du dar zhing rgyas par shog zhes pa 'di'ang bi yig rab 'byams pa blo bzang chos 'phel gyi ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /pad rā ga zhun 'khyil sa yig tsheg drag can/ /mi 'gyur dang ma'i srog rtsa ka ba'i dbyibs/ /zla nyi'i rang bzhin a lha bskal brgya'i bar/ /'chi med grub pa'i rnam par rten byin rlobs/ /mkha' khyab bzhugs pa'i phyogs gsum rin chen la/ /bla gos khrag gzar bus btsugs yan lag 'dab/ /snying ga'i thad zum mos gus gdung shugs kyis/ /smon lam btab pas 'bras bu der smin shog /tshe mtha' yas pas phyag gi bum dbang bskur/ /gos dkar ma sogs mgrin pa'i rgyud mang 'brol/ /sems pa brgyad kyi me tog char du phob/ /khro bo'i stang stabs lha mos nyer spyod sbreng / /'chi med zil mngar mtho ris chu bo'i rgyun/ /chad med phung khams skye mched yongs btab pas/ /gzhom (242ba)med g.yung drung ngo bor gyur ba'i lhag /'gyur med rigs bdag snang mtha' rtag zhugs gso le/ /rgyal gsung mthar thug theg mchog ngag gi glur/ /legs khugs dbang gi rgyud mang blo ldan rnar/ /sim —324

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanapa'i skal bzang rgya chen mtsho byung ma'i/ /drin las brnyed de rdo rje ltar brtan shog /phun tsho gos 'dod dgu dar ba'i yang rtse'i mdor/ /sum rtsen bdag po'i dga' ston dpal ldan pa/ /ris med gzhan phan rab bsgrubs 'dus gling sde/ /nam mkha' gzhan gyur de srid 'phel bar shog /bcu gnyis go la'i khyim gyi rgyud lam du/ /gza' skar 'phrod dge dus kyi sbyor ba bzang / /'bru bas ljon pas nor 'dzin mngal khur lci/ /legs byas 'bras bu dar ba'i ba po shis shog khes pa 'di'ang sa dkar 'go pa lhun grub brgya mtshos mdo dga' ldan gzhan phan gling du 'dzugs rgyu'i rten 'byung gi tshigs bcad dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jams dbyangs grags pa'o/ /dngul dkar rin chen rgyur grub bde gshegs kyi/ /ngo mtshar ba po shis sgo mang che ba'i nang / /sman mdo las gsungs lha tsho gis nye sras brgyad/ /'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug tshe sbyin sku/ /gtong dang dad pa'i lang mtsho cher brtas pa/ /'phrul snang bya 'dabs chu mig khar grags nas/ /a bsod rgyal mo'i bgrang yas skye ba'i sdig /'brul byed mtho ris nyal 'gro deng 'dir babs/ /chosadakar 'bras bu mngon mtho'i them skas la/ /gom stabs lhod por bkod (243na)pa de nges legs kyi/ /rin chen khang par bzhugs pa'i smon pa kun/ /'grub par sras bcas rgyal bas byin gyi rlobs//zhes pa'ang lha sa chu mig kha pa a bsod rgyal mos sgo mangs mchod rten bzhengs pa'i smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /mkhyen spyan dgu tshogs zhags pas shes bya'i mkha'/ /bcings tshe dbyangs can lha mo nyer bzhad pas/ /phas rgol 'joms pa'i rdo rje thams bcad gzigs/ /dge 'dun dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid skur/ /sna tshogs 'dod lhas yongs skor ras dkar ngos/ /ma bris rang byung shar 'dra 'phrul po che/ /sgyu ma'i khengs pa bag zhan lha yul nas/ /bi shwa ga me gom bkod las gzhan ci/ / 'bras bu byang chub sems pa chen po yi/ /rnam par sprul pa'i lugs gnyis bzhed pa kun/ /'bad dang rtsol bar bltos min spyi bo skyes/ /gnyis pa'i ngo mtshar 'dzin nus byin gyi rlobs/ /srid par zo chun ltar —325

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24) 'khod byis blo can/ /bzang po'i bag chag tsam la byi ba'i lus/ /glang por ming btags dri bzhen gyis bteg sgro'i/ /tshul bzung za hor brje'i 'dra 'bag 'di/ /rgyal sras sprul sku gang snang lhar shar bar/ /dam par gsal ba'i bslu med rten 'byung mthus/ /mkha' nyams 'gro 'dren bzhed pa'i 'phrin kyilas/ /pha mtha' nam mkha'i tshad las brgal bar shog /rgya gar dgra lha mi yul cho me srung che/ /ma ru tsi yi dur khrod gnas kyi bdag /dbang phyug ma hā de wa'i bka' nyan can/(243ba) / gshin rje las mkhan gnod sbyin bshan pa yi/ /ris med 'gro la brtse ldan sems pa che'i/ /chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs ma lus pa'i/ /yon tan mtha' dag dbyar gyi chu gter bzhin/ /'phel ba'i 'phrin lasathams cad sgrub par mdzod/ khes dbus ru stod sems pa chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi sprul sku ngag dbang phun tsho gos kyis/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ nged rang sgo 'dra 'bag /gnod sbyin beg tse gsum la 'dod lha sna tshogs kyis bskor ba'i sku brnyan bskrun pa'i rgyab yig bris shig par gsung gi bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi gi pa ni dge slong 'jams dbyangs grags pa'o/ /shāka thub thos sgrog bcu drug chos 'phel dang / /hwa shang rgyal chen bzhi yi snang brnyan zla/ /ka shi'i dngas mtsho me shel tshon ltar shar ba/ /pad rtsa'i rjes 'gro lhag bsam gyi bskrun mthus/ /gnasangan sdong dum dkar min 'thor rlung gis/ /sbar ba'i brnag dka' tsha reg kyi zhugs dbal/ /thugs rje sa'adzin rtse nas byin rlabs chab/ khugs drag bos gzhi la gsum yags bder sbyor shog /thub dbang rgyal tshab rnam gnyis gnas brtan che/ /gzod ma nyid nas ris bral 'gro ba la/ /rjes chags 'gro 'dren ma dor dam bca'i khur/ /yol med thugs rje'i mthu dpung deng 'dir bskul/ /'khor ba chu srin chen po'i dba' klong du/ /yang srid gru rdzings bying 'degs nang gnas pa/ /sum yag dge tshogs 'dod pa'i rlung shugs kyis/ /thar pa nor bu'i gling mchog (244na 'dren par shog /gas wo lag na 'bar ba rdo rje'i mtshon/ /gdengs dang lhan cig sum yags thog med nas/ /bsags pa'i —326

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ 'dasdig 'bras mun khung sgron me bzhin/ /ming gi lhag ma tsam yang lus min shog /rnam 'dren ljags kyi rtse mos lha mo lnga'i/ /rgyun chags legs par gsung pa'i don gyi 'bras/ /dmigs yul bsgrub bya yang srid thams cad du/ /'grub pa'i skal pa bzang por 'gyur bar shog /ces sum yags kyi don du 'phyong rgyas lkog pa lha dbang grub pa'i blo ldan du 'bod pa'i rig byed pas gnas bcu tshar gnyis dang phyag rdor la gra lngas bskor ba'i bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jams dbyangs grags pa'o/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud kyi snying po'i don/ /ye dag 'jam dpal rigs ldan lhun rdzogs pa/ /rang rig 'dod ma'i rang bzhi mngon gsum du/ /tshe 'dir rtogs grol dus gcig 'byung byin rlabs/ /pad+ma'i thugs bcud stag tshang bsam grub nas/ /sar phan zla bral gyis drangs rigs 'dzin tshogs/ /brgyud ldan zhal drod dngar por 'thul byed pa/ /rgyal kun spyi gzugs rje btsun pad+ma dbang / /bka' drin 'khor med pha rgod bla ma de'i/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen snying gi dpal be'ur/ /'khyil ba'i gang shar rang sar nyer grol ba/ /za hor sngags smyon rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ /dran pa'i mod la bdud sde'i dpung (244ba〉gis rnams/ /'joms dang chabs cig mchog mthun dngos grub kun/ /stsol bar zla bral srid gsum dbang sgyur ma/ /rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i snang brnyan 'di med byung/ /ched btab sa bon smon lam drod gsher gyis/ /smin 'bras gzhen nu bum skur rigs pa'i gshis/ /ka dag nyi ma'i snying po dri bral gdangs/ /lhun grub 'jam dpal rigs lnga mngon gyur shog /skal dman tshe 'dir 'od skur ma grol na/ /theg mchog lam 'di ston pa'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /skye bar rjes su bzung nas kun bzang gi /sal ma yon tan myur du mthar phyin shog /mtsho skyes rdo rje des gsungs dam pa'i chos/ /sgrub pa'i rigs sngags 'chang du dkon mchog gsum/ /'dus par nges rnyed skyabs gzhan mi 'tshol bas/ /byin rlabs snying la zhugs pa'i bkra shis shog /snye mo ba blo bzang tshe dbang gis 'jam dpal rigs lnga'i bris thang rgyab yig dang rgyun du kha rtan sbrags ma zhig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi —327

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)sngags 'chang gang shar rang grol gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /'od dpag med mgon khyod zhabs snying dbus su/ /rtags tu goms pa'i bsam gtan la brten nas / /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug bde ba can/ /dag pa'i gnas der nying mtshams sbyor byed shog /'jam mnyen pad+ma'i dbus su thal sbyar te / /gang gsung lhang lhang rna bar nyer thos mod/ /sgrib gsum 'ching rgya yongs dbral 'gro ba rnams/ /'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por bdag 'gyur shog(245na)/gcig las du mar shar ba chu zla bzhin/ /gang ga'i rdul gyi grangs snyed 'jigs rten kun/ /khyab pa'i 'phrul gyis mtha' yas lus can rnams/ /phan bde la sbyor smon lam 'grub par shog /ces pa'ang rab 'byams pa bsam gtan rgya mtsho'i kha tan du dgos tshul ltar za hor gyis bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jams dbyangs grags pa'o/ / shādabyangs can lha mos mgrin 'khrud 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /dga' ba'i blo gros dpyod ldan tshogs kun dga'/ /gshes gnyen ston pa'i rjes zhugs ris med bshes/ /dad pas gsol 'debs byin rlabs 'jugs la dad/ /dung dung yid kyi mos pa brtan po dang / /lhang lhang tshig gi gsol ba 'debs byed na/ /mang mang bskal par bgrang yas skye rgu'i don / /brtan brtan g.yung drung lta bur 'gyur med shog /'jam 'jam snying rje che las ma g.yos kyang / /'jigs 'jigs srin po'i gzugs can phyag drug pas/ /ring ring sangs rgyas zhes bya'i sgra bo che/ /rnyed rnyed de srid mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod/ /ces pa'ang bka' bcu blo bzang rgya mtsho'i ngor za hor gi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /gar dbang thugs zer gtsang byed pad+ma'i sbubs/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar 'khor 'das yongs kyi mes/ /gdul dka'i gnyen por rnga yab gling pa zhes/ /srid gsum kun khyab mtsho skyes grub pas skyongs/ shes rab stong nyid rang gdangs mkhar (245bskon bza'i/ /dag snang zab gter du mar lung zin pa/ /brjod pa rnam dag ngag gi dbang po'i mthus/ /pad+ma'i 'phrin las spel de zhabs—328

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung tsā gsab ma dang po/ (zhanabartan shog/gan jag thang ta'i rigs sprul ra smi'i zhabs//thugs sras dmi kun tu bzang po'i gdung //dkon mchog chos kyi dbang phyug grags pa'i dpal//yang srid g.yung drung lta bur brtan par shog/yon tan 'od zer legs ldan rdo rje mched//bka' gter ring lugs yongs 'dzin 'bri gung pa//rin chen phun tshogs brgyud par bcas pa'i bstan//bka' babs ji bzhin gzung phyir g.yo med shog/zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo gnyis pa'i spor//rigs sngags 'chang ba'i dge 'dun sde rnams dang //zung 'brel mchims phu gsung gi yang dben bcas//snga 'gyur bstan pa'i btsas su rgyas par shog/zab ga kho chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs spyi dang //khyad par rdo rje gshog rgod g.yu sgron mas//'dod pa'i bsams pa thams cad yid bzhin du//re skong 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub mdzod//gangs can ra ba'i khor yug sman ljongs 'dir//dug 'a mun btsi pa bde skyid phun tshogs pa//mkhan slob chos rgyal rnam gsum bzhed pa yi//smon pa'i 'bras bu rab smin bkra shis shog/ces pa dpal ri gra tshang spyi sos nged rang dang sprul sku zung 'brel du brtan bzhugs shig dgos tshul byung ba 'di gar dmigs pa'i tshigs bcad sprul sku nyid kyis sngon nas bskul song gshis bskyar bldab la brjod don lhag por ma mthong bas dngos don ji bzhin tshigs su bcad pa 'di'ang za hor 246nasngags spyon gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o//phun tshogs blo gsal dge 'dun 'dus pa'i dbus//bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i bshes gnyen che//mi 'gyur mchog gi bde ba chen po'i klong //zag med dgongs pa yongs su rdzogasapar shog/ces pa'ang gzhi ba slob dpon phun tsho gis bstan 'phel gyis bskul ngor za hor gyi ban+desasbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa bstan dbang ngo //ngag gi 'o mtshor dbyangs can ngang mo dkar//rkang gdub dril chung 'brol la nyer dbang bas//blo gros dzam bu'i snye ma gser bzang khams//thos bsam rgya mtshor smin des rtag tu skyongs//stesadabang bya sgro mthon por g.yengs pa'i rjes//bgro/ kyang spangs rtogs phun tshogs su wa rna//ra gan

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)gur kum mdangs bsgyur 'dra 'bag la//'phags chen dam pa'i snang brnyan tshar du dngar//dge legs rdul mangs brtsegs pa lhun po'i spor//'gran bzod bka' gdams gtsang ma'i rnam thar la//skal ldan gdul bya rab 'dun bder sbyor ba'i//mkhas grub rim byon skyes rabs phreng spel bar//ston mas zla 'dra'i dad dang brtson pa yis//rgyu sbyor nor bu khyo shugs rigs brgyud rnams//'di snang tshe dpal mnga' thang 'byor pa kun//skabs gsum bdag po'i skal ba dang mnyam shog/mngon par mtho ba'i bshul ring lam brgyud de//gto gyi bde ba mi gnas myang 'das grong //nyer bzhugs nam mkha'i mtha' snyeg sems can 246bsgoms//sgrol nus mi 'jig bzhi ldan brnyed par shog/grong khyer pho brang rtse mo nas//bsil ldan 'gro 'dren dus bab rjer//rnam rol srong btsan sgam po zhes//phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas rgyal//lha chos bdun ldan bstan pa yi//mes po dge bsnyen tshul bzung yang //don gyi sgos spyo dpal 'dzin pa//'brom ston chos kyi rgyal por bsngags//rgyan drug mchog gnyis gzhud lugs kun//'chad la rnam dpyod spobs pa'i rtsal//'jigs med seng ge'i nga ro can//dge 'dun grub zhabs btsug na bsten//tshangs pa'i sras mo dbyangasacan ma//mgrin par 'i zhugs pa legs bshad kyi//'dod pa 'jo ba'i dpag bsam dbang //dge 'dun rgya mtshos bdag rjes bzung //gser gyi rgyal po la sogs pa'i //che rgu'i gtsug tor ral pa'i rtser//zhabs ho zla ba rtag 'char ba//bsod nams rgya mtshos deng byin rlobs//gdul dka'i 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ched//tshe ring gnam gyi she mong rgyud//bsam bzhin srid pa legs bzung ba//yon tan rgya mtshos shis par skyongs//zhes skyid thang nor bus dge 'dun grub pa'i 'khrungs rabs bris thang bdun tshar bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o//sna tshogs nad bral dbang po kun tshang sogs//mtshan legs yongs grags dpal gyi zhal 'tshes pa'i//smon lam yongs grub 'gro rnams khyoX drung du//brdzus te skyes nas mkha' khyab 'gro

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanasgrol shog /'khor lkoms sdug bsngal dang (247na)bral bder spyod sogs/ /mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs rgyal po yi/ /smon lam yongs grub 'gro rnams khyod drung du/ /brdzus te skyes nas mkha' khyab 'gro sgrol shog /dus min 'chos mtshon duḥkha kun bral sogs/ /gser bzang dri med rin chen snang ba yi/ /smon lam yongs grub 'gro rnams khyod drung du/ /brdzus te skyes nas mkha' khyab 'gro sgrol shog /mtha' klas sdug bsngal kun dang bral ba sogs/ /mya ngan med pa mchog gyur dpal ldan po'i//smon lam yongs grub 'gro rnams khyod drung du/ /brdzus te skyes nas mkha' khyab 'gro sgrol shog /log par blta sogs sgrib gnyis yis bral bar/ /bcom ldan chos grags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs snyan gyi/ /smon lam yongs grub 'gro rnams khyod drung du/ /brdzus te skyes nas mkha' khyab 'gro sgrol shog /dge la rtag sbyor sdig dang yongs bral sogs/ /chos kun rgya mtsho mchog blos mngon mkhyen pa'i/ /smon lam yongs grub 'gro rnams khyod drung du/ /brdzus te skyes nas mkha' khyab 'gro sgrol shog /mtshan dpe ldan sogs yon tan kun rdzogs par/ /be+eḍūrla 'od rgyal po sman gyi bla'i/ /smon lam yongs grub 'gro rnams khyod drung du/ /brdzus te skyes nas mkha' khyab 'gro sgrol shog /yangs pa can gsungasabargyad brgya sman mdo'i don/ shwakya seng shes legs par bka' stsal ba'i/ /smon lam yongs grub 'gro rnams khyod drung du/ /brdzus te skyes nas mkha' khyab 'gro sgrol shog /bzhin bzang tshon ris yid kyi shel dkar ngos/ shar ba'i mod la 'chi bdag kun 'joms pa/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i zhal bzhesasmon lam 'bras/ /ro brgya bdag sogs 'gro kun rjes myong shog /kun bzang smon lam don bzhin gang gi skur/ /rtse gcig mi g.yo'i ting 'dzin brtan po yis/ /nying mtshams sbyar tshe bde ldan dag zhing du/ /lus can mtha' dag thogs pa med sgrol shog /sdig lhung shing las sbyar ba ngan 'gro'i me/ /thugasarje'i char gyis gzhi la mdzod bcom ldan 'das/ /mi zhakhrugs rgyal pos mkha' mnyam sems can rnams/ /mngon dga'i zhing gi bde bar yongs sbyor shog /gzung jags thos pa tsam gyis mtha' brtan (267ba)rnams/ /gnas ngan las gdon dam bcas mi pham mgon/ /mchog gi sprul skur bzhengs tshe bdag —331 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)sogs 'gro/ /'dus pa dang po'i 'khor du skye bar shog /khyod zhabs rdul dmar lhungs pas gangs can gyi/ /nyes pa'i dri bkrus rgyal bstan gsal mdzad pa/ /pad+ma ka ras bdud sde'i dpung bcomasanas/ /'pho med rdo rje'i sku ru 'gyur bar shog /dhīḥyig zhun 'khyil snga gos mtshams sprin sbubs/ /shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i nyin mor byed/ /chos kyi rgyal po kun mkhyen myong kha bas/ /ja med byang chub bar du rjes 'dzin shog /ngag dbang dbyangs can mthu las jo gros kyi/ /bzang po'i skal thob thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sde/ /'khor lo'i mgon por nges rnyed dad pa'i mthus/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin par shog /rmug 'dzin pad+ma ra ga'i 'od gzi yis/ /srid zhi dbang sdud ne'u li'i mgrin pa nas/ /'dzad med nor bu'i phung po 'khrig pa'i dbyangs/ /legs chags 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor rgyas par shog /rin chen khu bas bris pa thub gsung rtser/ /gser zhun mdzod ldan tog gi 'od 'bar sogs/ /sri zhur bskrun pa'i dge ba byang chub bar/ /legs myong bkra shis dga' ston 'phel bar shog/ces pa 'di'ang mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rabs kyis khra 'brug dang sger gzhis su rten bzhengs/ /ri bo chos gling du bka' 'gyur dang gan 'jir phul ba'i smon lam tsho gos 'don du gtsug chog zhig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lcang gseb pa bstan 'dzin dbang po'o/ /(248na)paṇa grub dpal ldan chos skyong zhal gyi drod/ /gsung ngag dbang chu blo gros bum bzang du/ /rgya mtsho ltar 'khyil 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes/ /tshangs sras ba pa'i rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i ngo bor bla ma kun/ /yongs 'dus gdan gsum tshang byin snying zhugasapas/ /lam dus dbang bzhi'i 'gros kyis phrang gsum brgal/ khung 'du ka grus mtha' tsho 'dir stog par shog /gur mgon tsa tu rmu kha las mkhan bcas/ /gsang rten lus sba'i gnad kyi byang chub bar/ /mi 'bral mchog mthun dngos grub 'phrin las rnams/ /thogs med grub pa'i rten tshol lhun grub shog khris ka gsum tsam yod pa'i zhal 'don zhig rtsoms zhes khyab bdag bla ma bka' 'gyur ba chen po'i rigs dang chos kyi dpon rin po che ngag dbang blo gsal mchog ldan gyi gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs —332

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ 'date za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa bstan 'dzin dbang po'o/ /rtsa gsum dgyes skyed ba smra ta/ /zag med bdud rtsi legs 'khyil snod/ khris spyor phun tshogasalhun grub kyi/ /legs byas byang chub bar 'phel shog /dge skos kyi 'jog tu dngul srang bcu bzhi las bskrun pa phul ba'i smon lam za hor gyi brnyes bkod pa shu lha/ /bzang po'i skal bar 'gro 'dren stong gi nang / /snying stobs chen pos dpa' ba shākya'i bstan/ /'dzin la zla bral 'jam mgon tsong kha pas/ /byang chub bar du rjes bzung byin gyis rlomes/ /ngag dbang dbyangs can mgrin par 'jo sgeg gis/(248ba) blo gsal bye ba'i gtsug tor rtse mo sa /mkhasabatsun bzang po'i zla tshes cha 'phel ba'i/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i rgya mtsho rgyas la 'dud/ /snying dbusa'adabs stong ze'u 'bru nyer bzhad steng / /dkon mchog kun 'dus ngo bo bla ma la/ /mi byed dad pasagasol ba rab btab mthus/ /thugs rje'i 'jug pa dus las yol med shog /tshe dang bsod namasastobs 'byor mtha' dag la/ /dbang thang mes po'i bskal ba dang mnyam zhing / /chos srid bstan pa bla nas blar 'degs par/ /mya ngan med pa'i spun slar 'gyur bar shog /bgrod dka'i skye ba'i phrang la bshes gnyen gyis/ /skyel ma'i mgon skyabs mdzad nas mngon mtho'i rten/ /bde bar nyer khrid bla med byang chub kyi/ /grong khyer chen por myur du 'jug par shog /ces gsol 'debs smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni dad stobs ldan pa dga' ldan dwa chin bo shog thu ju nong gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags ram pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /'chi gsos bdud rtsis mtha' klas nad kyi rigs/ /drungs nas phyung dang lhan cig sgrib gnyis kyi/ khug rngu rnam par grol nas lus can kun/ /gtan gyi bde bar rtag tu spyod par shog / saskyong blo bzang sbyin pas khur bzhes yar stod dar mo sman rams pas lag len byas nas rin chen grang sbyor 'di rab byung bcu gcig pa'i nang gi sa rta zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu dgu la dbu btsugs shin tu ru nga ba'i hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu skor la grub par lhag bsam gyi smon lam za hor gyi brnyes —333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)(249na〉bkod pas 'gro ba mtha' dag nad kyi 'jig pa las grol bar gyur cig /rin chen rta ri ma sbyor sde shin tu rgyas pa 'di nyid sde pa blo bzang sbyin pas khur bzhes yar stod dar mo sman ram pa blo bzang chos grags kyi lag len byas nas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa pho rta'i lo hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu dgu nas dbu btsugs te sbyar ba'i dge bas lus can mtha' dag bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad dang skye mched nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa las rnam par grol bar gyur cig /dbang phyug chen po'i gsung rgyud me lce 'bar ma'i dug 'joms dbang po'i ril bu 'di nyid sde pa blo bzang sbyin pas khur bzhes yar stod dar mo sman ram pa blo bzang chos grags kyis lag len byas nas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa pho rta'i lo hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu dgu nas dbu btsugs te sbyar ba'i dge bas lus can mtha' dag bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad dang skye mched nyen mongs pa'i sgrib pa las rnam par grol bar gyur cig /rnam dkar dge la 'dun pa'i goms stabs kyis/ /don kun grub pa'i rten la slar 'jug pa/ /sa srung thos bsam sgom pa'i rgyan ldan gang / /mngon sum rgyu bar mchog gsum mthus byin rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang legs pa rgyal mtshan gyi ngor za hor bsdos sbyar/ /mthing zhun nyin byed dngos brgya legs 'bar gzi/ /mtshan dpe'i ri mo rab gsal mthong ba'i mod/ /rnam 'dren sman gyi bla ma'i spyan ras kyi/ /byang chen bar du lhod pa med par skyongs/ /(249ba〉tshe yi rigs byed nyer dran skye dgu'i bdag /gtsug na zla sogs lha dang drang srong che/ /'chi gsos grub pa'i bcud len 'gro kun la/ /yongs stsal bde ba'i ngal gso sbyin rnams rgyal/ /'tsho byed gzhen nu ma khol zla mngon zhabs/ /ris med skye 'gro'i srog zungs g.yu thog mgon/ /gtsug lag gnyis pa rab shes mkhas mang gi /mdzad pa'i shing rtas dpyod ldan yid dbang 'dren/ /rin chen grang sbyor de'i mched rta ri ma/ lha chen gsung rgyud las 'ongs dug 'joms ril/ /srog gi chad 'thud rdo rje bzhu blugs pa/ /bdud rtsi snying po'i bcud kyi yang zhun mtshar/ /sa khams cang shes bgrang —334

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanabya'i snron zla nas/ /mkha' klu'i zhag par dpon tshang dar mo ba/ /blo bzang chos grags sum cu'i slob bur bcas/ /sgo gsum gcig dril spel ba'i dge tshogs kyis/ /ngag dbang blo bzang skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sdes/ /nyer mtshon bshes gnyen rnams dang gso rig la/ /zla med slob dpon blo bzang chos grags kyis/ /skye bar mi 'bral rjes su 'dzin par lha rdzog /bag yod khrims ldan shes bya'i gnas spyi dang / /khyad par gso rig gtsug lag mthar son zhing / /rgyal sras spyod la 'jug pa'i sems bskyed kyis/ /'gro ba'i dpag yas zug rngu yongs snyun shog /bye brag bdag g.yin mtha' dag rgyu ba dang //mi rgyu'i dug dpal 'joms la gser gyi mdog /sman mchog rnam par rgyal ba'i ro nus pa/ /zhu rjes yon tan ma lus der smin shog /rang byung bcos ma'i sbyor ngan la (250na〉〈gas pa'i/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad bskyed las nyon dang / /rab bral de rgyus tshugs min sman pa mchog /be+e ḍūrla 'od rgyal po 'grub par shog smon lam deng btab bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /mchog gsum legs bris drang srong phyi nang gi /tshe yi rig byed 'dzin dang zhang blon sogs/ /mthu ldan srung mas lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /lus ngag yid la khod snyoms legs bkram pa/ /bde ba'i sa bon btab smin myu gu'i ljon/ /dar drag sim pa'i tshor ba myong ba'i 'bras/ /ro brgyar longs spyod bkra shis dpal 'bar shog /ces rab byung bcu gcig pa sa pho rta'i lo dar mo dpon tshang blo bzang chos grags slob bur bcas pas rin chen ril bu grang sbyor/ dbang phyug chen po'i gsung rgyud me lce 'bar ma las byung ba'i dug 'joms ril bu/ /rin chen rta ri ma rgyas pa rnams zhag brgyad bcu'i bar sgo gsum 'bad pa chen pos dngos gtsang bar bskrun pa'i tshe dkar chag tu gsal ba'i slob ma rnams kyis bkras btags/ /gser zho gang bzang ja bar khag dang bcas don gnyer che bas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /byang chen mchod rten dngul dkar las grub pa/ /bu khrid rgyal mos lhag bsam rnam dag mthus/ /bzhengs 'bras skye bar lha mi'i rten rgyud nas/ /ring min rnam pa thams cad mkhyen —335

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)thob shog /dad pa'i me long ngos su thugs rje'i gzugs/ /legs 'char dpal ldan bla mas skye ba kun/ /'bral med rjes 'dzin dge ba'i bshes mdzad nas/(250ba)mtho ris thar pa'i lam du 'dren par shog /dkon mchog byin rlabs rten cing 'brel 'byung mthus/ /bdag sogs rigs brgyud bcas rnams gnas skabs dang / /mthar thug phan bde'i bsod nams dpal 'bar ba/ /skyid pa'i nyi ma dgung nas 'char ba shog /ces dpon sa bu khrid rgyal mos dngul gyi byang chen mchod rten bzhengs pa'i smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pas bgyis pa oṃ ā tha/ /bā gi sa kā na ga ma ba rta to ma nya rbo ku lha zhe sa ri ka ku spyi rba tsa nge/ngag dbang tshangs sras zhal lung blo gros kyi/ /bum bzang rgya mtsho ltar 'khyil rnam dpyod la/ /ma lha su ra sdi ya ka mi tā ṇ+ḍi to mi shrī sa si — li ka ra tā yi rnya nyo/ /'jam dbyangs dag 'ba'i bshes gnyen snang ba mthar/ /mkhas grub rin chen 'phreng mdzes spel 'di mtshar/ /dad pa'i zla bar (251na tha sod nams ri dwags gzugs/ /yongs gsal ral dkar rdzing bur nyer shar ba/ /rig byed 'dzin pa phun tshogs dbang po zhes/ /lha dbang grub pa'i blo gros ldan des so/ /ngas srid kun tu 'bral med rjes 'dzin bar/ /rang mthu dman yang mchog gsum thugs rje yis/ /yongs smon khas 'che'i dpag bsam ljon pa'i 'bras/ /byang chen thob min bar du spyod par shog /dgo'adun 'i bos pa gtsug na mkhas grub kyi/ /zhabs sen zla tshes don ldan thams cad mkhyen/ /sku brnyan rnam sprul gar gyis rab bskor ba'i/ /byin rlabs bung ba bdag snying pad+ma ra gzhug /dge legasalus phrar yid 'dun thos bsam gyi/ /mngon 'dod rgya mtsho 'phel la dbyangs can ma/ /bshad pa rdo rje skyesachen phreng ba yis/ /yongs bskor bskrun pa'i bsod nams mkhar bsnyeg shog /blo gros bskal bzang 'dren pa bzhi bstan srog /zungs tsā ra grags pas 'jig rten gsum khyab par/ /dngos grub nyer stsol 'dod lha —336

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenashel tshon bzhin/shar ba'i gzi byin skye bar gsal gyur cig/bde gshegs mched brgyad byin rlabasanyin byed kyis/khrid zhi'i nyes brgya'i smag rum kun bsangs nas//ji ltar zhal 'tshes smon lam ro bda'i zas//spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por bdag 'gyur shog/ces 'phyong rgyas lkog pa bsam mthong ba lha dbang grub pa'i blo ldan gyis/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/dge 'dun rgya mtsho/'di ga'i 'dra 'bag gsum gtso thang du byas par/sa spyod mkhas grub lo pan gyi 'phreng ba mtshar du 251bdangar ba//rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po dang /sangs rgyas sman gyi blar 'dod lhas skor ba'i bris thang lnga tshar bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa sirnyi ra stu// a bya yur su ba k+ṇi ka rin rma mā yak+ṣa re7pa rān+ta rla stoṭa kaḥmi zad 'gro ngor mdzad 'phrin sgyu ma'i 'phrul//rnam 'gyur pha mtha' yas kyang 'phags bod yul//a gi nā me sha rtas rgya niḥk+ṣarā ho byuha snye tra kāk+ṣa:ta/gusamatshan brgyad sa rga brgya rtsa'i thang yig gi/ngo mtshar zhing bkod mig gi bdud rtsi'i dpyid//grangs med mkhas grub rtogs brjod dman blo dang //mtsham pa'i zol sbyor 'phrul la ya mtshan ci//sangs rgyas gzhan las che ba'i yon tan tshogs//pad+ma ka ra kho na'i khyad par tsam//rgyal rnams tshogs gnyis zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la//gcig tu mtshungs 252na ) kyang cher rnyigs skye rgu yi//bsam ngo bco lnga'i tshes kyi nam mkha' la//thugs rje'i nya gang dang 'dra gzhan du min//mgon khyod kho nar 'bad pa'i sri zhu yis//rnam 'dren kun la nyer byas bsod nams 'bras//thob phyir a phyi dbyangs can sgrol ma gang //'khor ba mtha' can thar lam bgrod par shog/dmigs pa'i yul dang yon sbyor las byed kun//pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nyams dga' bar//rigs 'dzin gral chud rang rig rdzogs sangs rgyas//gzhan nas mi 'tshol rang / 'phrod par shog/sngags kyi rnal 'byor bdud

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'joms rdo rje la/ /mdo tsam bstan pa si rgyu rgya mtsho ma'i/ /bkod pa 'di bzhin mas gtsos 'gro ba rnams/ /mgon khyod rnam thar dang mtshungs 'jug nus shog /sde brgyad gnyen por rdo rje srin po'i skur/ /thugs sgrub rnam gsum lo rgyus gser rdor 'phreng / /mdzes pas rgyu sbyor lus kyi rtsa 'khor la/ /zhi khro'i lha tshogs mngon sum rdzogs par shog /'bod sgrogs grong khyer yangs pa'i khor yug dbus/ /tsiti'i dbyibs can dpal gyi ri bo'i rtser/ /rtsa gsum rab 'dus dkyil 'khor legs bris mthus/ /nying mtshams sbyar tshe zhing der skye bar shog /rgya bod skyes chen sgyu skar nyer brgyad mthar/ /so skye'i gzugs brnyan dud pa nyer 'thul ba/ /'khrul ngor gangs ri sngon por snang ba bzhin/ /dam par mos 'bras thugs rje 'jug par shog /ces grwa phyi smon grub pa rin chen bkra shis kyis a phyi dbyangs can sgrol ma'i don du o (252ba)rgyan chen po mtshan brgyad rnams gtso bor byas pa'i gra tshar dgu la/thang yig shel brag ma'i bkod pa/ gtso bo slob dpon chen po la sis rgya mtsho'i zhing bkod/ rdo rje drag po rtsal la thugs sgrub gsum gyi lo rgyus/ mnal lam gser gyi rdo rje mas bskor ba/ zangs mdog dpal ri'i zhing bkod/ nged rang gi 'dra 'bag la thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs kyis bskor ba'i bris thang bcas bcu gsum gyi rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa sirnyi ra stu/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang grags pa yi/ /ring lugs rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' yongs spel ba/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ /bgrang yas skye bar rjes su 'dzin par shog /rgyal ba kun yum seng ldeng nag sgrol ma/ /skyabs song snying nas gsol ba 'debs byed na/ /seng ge glang chen rkun po me dang sbrul/ /lcags sgrog sha za rgya mtsho'i 'jigs las skyobs/ /mdor na sngon las 'phral rkyen gyis bskyed pa'i/ /mi mthun nyer 'tshe thams cad rab zhi zhing / /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor ma lus pa/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas par byin gyis rlomes/ /zhes pa 'di'ang dga' ldan e te na u chen gyis kha ton du dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes bris/ / 338

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ 'dabade ldan zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mgon mchog gi /thugs rje'i 'od kyis 'chi bdag mun bsal te/ /legs byas snang ba'i khri la (253nang ga gi dbang / /blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho brtan par shog /'dus pa'i sde la mchod bstod bsnyen bkur rgyun/ /lhag bsam dag pas spel ba'i bsod nams kyis/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po rigs brgyud bcas pa yi/ /srid zhi'i bde skyid ma lus lhun grub sgo/ga /gsol ba btab na nam yang mi bslu ba/ /gtan gyi skyabs gcig mchog gsum byin rlabs kyis/ /smon lam sa bon legs par smin pa'i 'bras/ /yongs su nyer dud dga' ston rab rgyas shog /ces pa 'di ni lha sa byang gling pas gsang phu grwa tshang spe ser du dge rgyun sbyar nas dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /'chi bdag dpung bcas za la ma he'i zhal/ /gdangs pa'i dpa' bo 'jam dpal khro bo'i dbang / /legs ldan phyag drug myur mdzad mgon po yi/ /mthu stobs nus pas 'dod pa'i re ba skongs/ /gdong lngas yongs bteg rdo rje'i khri chen por/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i zlos gar g.yo med du/ /g.yung drung srog gi ka ba nyer tshugs pa/ /smon pa'i 'bras bu dus su smin par shog /thams cad mkhyen dngos blo bzang grags pa yi/ /bstan pa dzam bu tri sha'i grib bsil gyis/ /khyab par dbyar gyi chu gter ji bzhin du/ /'phel ba'i bkra shis dga' ston dar drag shog /ces pa'ang lha sa byang gling pas 'bras spung sngags pa grwa tshang du sbug chol gyi spyi rdzas 'bul ba mang 'gyed kyi yon sbyar nas dgos tshul ltar za (253bstang gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad 'bod sgrogs grong khyer dbus/ /tsit+ta zur gsum zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtser/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma pad+ma thod phreng dang / /dbyer med srid mtha'i bar du bzhugs su gsol/ /ngo bo nam yang mi 'gyur chos sku'i gdangs/ /rang bzhin rdo rje'i 'od lus longs spyod rdzogs/ /thugs rje'i sprul pa mkha' khyab 'gro ba rnams/ /'dren pa'i skyabs dang gling du rtag brtan shog /khrag 'thung phyag rgya rdo rje 'bar ba'i rjes/ /gtsug tu gsal ba dpal mgon ma ning nag /dregs pa'i sdod pon —339

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)sum cu'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /'phrin las lus pa med par lhun gyis sgrubs/ /zhes lha sa byang gling pas stag lung gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du sbug chol gyis spyi rdzas/ 'bul ba mang 'gyed sogs sbyar te dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /gangs can phan bde'i 'byung gnas thog ma'i sgor/ /rigs gsum sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar mkhan gyis/ /srong btsan ba ched pa yongs gang sim pa'i rgyun/ /srid mthar chad bral rten cing 'brel 'byung mthus/ /'jam dbyangs gzhen nu dga' ba'i bshes gnyen dpal/ /'chi med grub pa'i nya phyis khog yangs por/ /mi 'gyur srog gi zungs gyur mu thi las/ /phyur bur gtams pa'i bsod nams rab 'bar shog /sangs rgyas kun yum dung skyong rgyal mo dang / /bdud mgon trag shad la sogs srung ma yis/ /dge 'dun sde 'di dar (254na tsā kho rgyas pas mtshon/ /smon lam gang btab grub ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa'ang lha sa byang gling pas pha bong khar spyi 'bul mang 'gyed sogs sbyar nas dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa 'o/ /rigs gsum mgon po'i mkhyen brtse nus mthu kun/ /gcig tu yongs bsdus rje btsun btsong kha par/ /yid ches nges pa rnyed nas gsol 'debs na/ /smon lam ci btab yongs 'grub bdag byin rlobs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /bde ldan zhing gi mgon po ji bzhin du/ /bdag sogs 'gro rnams byang chub chen po yi/ /sa la bkod min de srid brtan gyur cig /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par gangs can 'dir/ /zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan pa yi/ /yongs khyab ljon pa'i grib mar skye rgu rnams/ /bde ba'i stegs la ngal gso bgyid par shog /ces pa'ang lha sa byang gling pas/ra sa ra mo che/ po tā la'i dmigs brtse ma khag bzhin/ spyi 'bul mchod rdzas zhabs tog sogs sbyar nas 'dzugs rgyur dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /nor bu pad+ma'i gzungs las rab 'phros pa'i/ /'od kyis 'gro drug sdug bsngal kun sbyangs —34()

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhananas/ /snang ba lha dang grag stong sngags kyi sgra/ /dran rtog thug lo kyi khyer sor 'gyur bar shog /gangasacan lha gcig thugs bskyed smon lam mthus/ /khyod kyi thun mong ma yin 'dul zhing (254bsko /'bangs rnams skyong ba'i bla dpon zung 'jug par/ /'chi med grub pa'i rigs 'dzin stsol byin rlobs/ /bdag sogs gnas skabs bde skyid phun tshogs shing/ /skye bar mgon po gang gi rjes bzung nas/ /gru 'dzin ri bo'i gzhal med nyams dga' bar/ /zhugs te rlabs chen spyod la 'jug par shog /ces pa'ang lha sa byang gling pas/ ra sa ra mo che po tā la gsum gyi ma ṇi ba khag bco lngar spyi 'bul mchod rdzas zhabs tog sogs bskrun nas dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /thub dbang sku gzugs sangs rgyas dngos nyid du/ /rab mos 'khor ba'i tshul la nges 'byung blos/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i dus khrims legs srungs pa'i/ /'bras bu myang 'das de srid 'dzad med shog /thog ma'i dus nas da lta'i bar dag tu/ /'bad pas bsags pa'i dge tshogs nus mthu yis//dpal ldan bla ma rdo rjes yongs bteg khrir/ /bskal pa rdzogs smin g.yo med brtan par shog /sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos kyis/ /byang chub 'thob pa'i ched du bag yod dge /bgrang yas mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa/ /nges par legs pa'i go 'phang 'thob phyir bsngo/ zhes pa'ang lha sa byang gling pas ra sa'i bsnyen gnas ma tshor spyi rdzas 'bul ba zhabs tog sogs sbyar nas dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /bde ba can zhing chos sku 'od mtha' (255na dzes/ /gru 'dzin spo na longs sku 'jig rten dbang / /si rtse'i rgya mtshor sprul sku pad+ma 'byung / /sku gsum dbyer med thugs rjes bdag byin rlobs/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya ma lus zin gnon par/ /mthu stobs grub pa'i rig 'dzin ba 'ad pa rtsal/ /gangs can phan bde'i nyer 'tshor rdo rje yi/ /srog gi ka ba 'gyur med tshugs par shog /ru bzhi'i rgyal khams kun tu mi phyugs nad/ /'thab rtsod dbul phongs dus kyi chad pa rnams/ /rab zhi rdzogs —341 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24) ldan dga' ston la spyod pa'i/ /bzang po'i skal pa can du 'gyur ba shog /ces pa'ang lha sa byang gling pas ra sa ra mo che po tā la gsum gyi tshes bcu khag lngar/ spyi 'bul mchod rdzas zhabs tog sbyar nas dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /gdod nas rang rig don gyi tshe mtha' yas/ /dbyer med rdo rje slob dpon dwangs ma'i lus//'od skur smin pa 'pho ba chen po sa grub pa'i 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal bar shog /las kyi gshin rje'i rlang spyod rba rlabs 'phreng / /rang sems chu bo'i dbyings su yongs dag pas/ /'byul ba'i rnam rtog bde chen dbyings thim pas/ /pad 'byung thugs rje'i 'phrin las deng 'jug shog /ka dag ngang du spros pa'i mtshan ma kun/ /rab zhi gzhen nu bum sku las shar gdangs/ /ma 'gags longs sku'i snang ba 'khor ba'i mtha'/ /de srid g.yung drung lta bur brtan par shog khes pa 'ang lha spo byang gling pas skyon chos gter gling du sil snyan gyi spyi rdzas(255bsta ul ba mang 'gyed sogs mthun rkyen sbyar nas rten 'byung dgos tshul ltar za hor bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /chu mtsho'i zla bar zhen pa'i byis pa
