bzhin/ /mgon khyod phyag na pad+ma ra nges rnyed de/ /khyod shesami phyed dad pas gsol 'debs na/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi snying la 'jug par shog /chos nyid nam yang 'gyur ba med pa dang / /chos can rgyu gos mi bslu'i nus pa yis/ /deng nas byang chub bar du dge ba'i bshes/ mdzad de phan bde'i dpal la sbyor bar shog /'di nas nying mtshams sbyar tshe gru 'dzin spor/ /'dren byed thugs rje'i 'od zer lcags kyu yis/ /nyer drangs rgyal ba'i sras su rab bskrun te/ /theg chen chos kyi bdud rtsir longs spyod shog khes pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes mang bkur rgyal khab chen po'i nye 'dab nas bsam blo mer rgan chos rjes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /spyi gtsug seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / /sangs rgyas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /mi byed dad pas gsol ba 'debs byed na/ /thugs rje chen pos byang chen bar du skyongs/ /zhes pa'ang ma hā tsi —342

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenana'i rgyal khams nas don grub dpal 'byor gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /bgrang yas dge tshogs la 'dun mkhas grub kyi/ /'khrungs rabs mu snyi ka 'phreng brgyus pa'i mthar/ /bdag lta'i so skyer sgro btags (256na rdo ba yi/ /mtha' brten der ma 'dus pa'i thugasadam lha/ /rang gzhan mnyam par brje ba'i sems dpa' che/ /ngag gi dbang phyug phun tshogs sdi mtsho yis/ /bdog par bcas te mkhyen dpyod zhal bkod kyis/ /spel 'di 'jig rten rgan pos deng ma dran/ /dge bas sprul sku gang de'i chos dang srid/ /bzhed pa mtha' dag lhun gyis rab grub cing / /'bras bu 'gro rnams 'khor ba chu srin gyi/ /'byung gnas che las sgrol ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di'ang sems dpa' sprul pa'i skus smon lam rtsoms shig par gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /bgrang yas gdul bya'i bsod nams zhing mchog tu/ /rgya hor che dgu'i ston pa bla na med/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' kun khyab pa'i/ /lag na pad+ma ngur phrig bla gos bzung / /ye shesadabyings su dam pa khyod ṣ+ka dang / /thugs rgyud gcig 'dres ris bral bla ma'i sku/ /chos srung du masayongs bskor gser sbyangs las/ /bskrun pa'i dge tsho gos nam mkha'i mthas 'jal dka'/ khyu sbyor gnam skos gong ma'i gser yig pa/ /bsam blo rab mas chos rje yer te nas/ /lhag bsam dag pas spel gos 'di phyi yi/ /'dod pa'i re ba ma lus 'grub par shog /srid zhi'i yon to kun gyi phung po'i tshogs/ /rgya mtsho'i 'jings ltar zad pa med pa'i gter/ /bde chen chos kyi rgyal po dpal bzang zhes/ /sa gsum skye rgu'i ma 'dris mdza' ba'i bshes/ /gang dang thugs rgyud yongs tshos (256bsgom par 'phrul/ /gcig las du mar shar ba'i bla ma dang / /bka' sdod pho nyas mtha' nas rab tu bteg /gos dmar ngos su sa zla'i khu bas bris/ / gnam skos tshangs pas mngags pa'i gser yig pa/ /a zhang rab 'byams chos rje yer ti nas/ / bsod —343

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)nams spel ba 'bras bu byang chub bar/ /nam yang 'dzad pa med pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /rgyal dang de sras slob mar bcas pa yi/ /yon tan rdul gyi cha yang mi ldan par/ /tshur mthong bdag 'dra'i so skyer sgro btags pa/ /thag khrar sbrul du dngangs pa'i tshul nas ci/ /'on te rdo ba'i ring bsrel ji lta bar/ /mchog gsum ngo bor gting nas nges rnyed na/ /bslu med rten 'brel mthu lasabyin rlabs drod/ /'bar ba'i 'bras bu smin la klan ka su/ /mgrin par tshangs sras bshad pa'i gtsug lag sgra/ /'jigs med rdo rje'i glu ru rab len par/ /'jam dbyangs dga' bas legs 'byud bshes gnyen la/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i ming du 'bod/ /bad rā ga mdangs 'dzin gos ngos su wa rjes / /yongs bskrun byed po rab 'byams er te nar/ /nyer grags gser gyi rgyal khab chen po nas/ /gong ma'i lung gis ched du mngags des so/ /ston zla pad rtsa dung ltar rab dkar ba'i/ /rnam smin byang chen bar du mi chad pa/ /dge ba'i tshogs kyis srid zhi'i legs byas kun/ /bla nas blar 'phel zad pa med par shog khres tā la'i bla ma bsod nams rgya mtsho/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ nged rang gi 'dra 'bag rnams la 'khrungs rabs dang chos srung gis bskor ba'i gser thang gong gi gser yig pa er te (257na sko rab 'byams chos rjes bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag med pa dang / /dbyer med gcig tu snying nas gsol 'debs na/ /skye bar 'bras med rjes su nyer bzung ste/ /'di dang gtan gyi mdun ma lhun grub shog /ces pa'ang dge slong blo bzang kun dga'i 'dod pa ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /kun khyab thugs rje'i nyi mas 'jig rten rnams/ /gsal mdzad sangs rgyas yongs 'dusabatsong kha pa/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+ma la/ /bdag sogs 'gro ba'i gtsug btud gsol ba 'debs/ kha do rgyud man ngag tha snyad mtha' klas par/ /dbang po'i blo gros lus phra'i 'gram chang —344

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanagis/ /skal bzang ba ku la 'byed thub bstan gyi/ /rgya mtsho srid rtser 'phyo la gsol ba 'debs/ /mnyam med dga' ldan sum rtsen ltar 'phags gling / /lugs gnyis dpal gyis mngon par rab mtho zhing / /phyogs 'dir zhwa ser cod pan lang ba'i bstan/ /ris bral skye rgu'i mgon du 'gyur bar shog/legs ldan nag po myur mdzad phyag drug pa/ /dus kyi dgra bo las gshin ma lha'i zhal/ /'dod khamasadabang phyug dmag dang zor gyi lhas/ /mthu stobs nus bskyed mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod/ /sems can kun gyi snying la thog mtha' bar/ /gcig tu dge ba dkon mchog rnam gsum dang / /bslu (257bsgod rten 'brel bden pas smon pa'i don/ /legs 'grub 'jig rten khams rnams shis par shog /ces pa 'di'ang dga' ldan sum rtsen gling gi slob dpon ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang gnyer pa blo bzang rab rgyas gnyis kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /blo gros kun gsal dwangs pa'i ngos/ /bzang po'i 'phrin las dbang gzhu'i gzugs/ /rnam bkra ye shes sprul sku'i gar/ /legs par bsgyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /'phrog byed langs pa'i sder mo yis/ /nyer bteg rin chen khri 'phang steng / /'gro rnam 'khor ba mtha' can du/ /bsgral min de srid zhabs brtan shog /dge bas mgon khyod dag pa dang / /ma dag zhing gi 'dren pa mā /gang du bzhugasakyang 'bral med du/ /rjes 'dzin byang chen 'grub rgyur bsngo/ /zhes sprul sku rin po che blo bzang ye shesakyi gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs smon lam 'di ni a zhang chos rje er te ni rab mas kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /kun gzigs zhing gi mgon po 'jam pa'i dpal/ /lnga ldan zur phud cod pan 'chang ba'i sku/ /bco ma sa zla'i khu bas legs bskrun pa'i/ /bsod nams ched du yongs byas 'bras bu las/ /g.yang skyid yid la mi khom brgyad kyi dris/ /ma sbags dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i them skas ngos / /'dzegs nas ring por mi thogs myang 'das kyi/ /grong khyer cher zhugs gtan mdun 'grub par shog /(25ni) 343

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dge ba nam mkha'i tshad kyis gzhal dka' ba'i/ /pha mtha' byang chub snying po de srid du/ /'dzad med byed por ris bral sems can kun/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di'ang g.yang skyid kyi don du dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas 'jam dbyangs kyi brgya thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bri so/ /'dzad med mchod sprin phyur bur spung ba'i snod/ /rtsa gsum dam skong rin chen gnyis pa las/ /legs bskrun dge slong blo gros rgyal ba yis/ /phul bas srid zhi'i 'dod don lhun grub shog /ces dngul srang phyed bcu bzhi las grub pa'i pad sder phan bde legs bshad gling gi dge bskos skabs phul ba'i kha byang za hor bzhes bkod pa maṅga lo/ /mkha' khyab rgyal dang de sras slob mar bcas/ /spyan sngar kun bzang mchod sprin 'dzad med sgo/ /mngon par phye bas bstan 'gro'i phan bde rnams/ /dkar cha'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar shog /rgyu sbyor tshul 'di'i byed por gtogs so cog /gnas skabs rgyad pa'i smag rum kun sangs te/ /bsod nams nyi ma'i 'od brgya yongs 'bar zhing / /ring min rnam mkhyen go 'phang 'thob rgyur bsngo/ /zhes sa skyong blo bzang sbyin pas khur bzhes te jo bo rin po che'i phyag mdzod nas bzos pa'i phye phur bdun cu don drug kha btags kyi 'phan chung don drug /gzhung gi phyag mdzod nas brtan pa'i phye phur che ba cha/ 'phan ring cha gsum/ thung ba cha lnga/(258ba tshe stod g.yogs brgyad cu gya dgusmad g.yogs drug cu re bdun/ pad khebs tshig brgya so bzhi rnams sa lug cho 'phrul mchod pa'i dus ra sa 'phrul snang du phul ba'i smon lam za hor gyi brnyes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /dngos brgyud bla ma zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /pha ma gnyis med rgyud gsum thub pa'i bstan/ /rab skyong chos srung dregs pa dam can tshogs/ /dgyes skong dar gyi lda ldi dbang po'i gzhu/ /yid srubasasdelas rnam rgyal phan bde'i sgo/ /yongs 'byed smin grol legs bshad dga' ston can/ /rig sngags —346

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhena'achang ba'i 'dus grar phul ba'i mthus/ khyu sbyor 'di phyi'i don gnyis lhun grub cing / /bstan 'gro'i bde skyid brgya phrag nyi ltar gsal/ /dge tsos bdag gzhan ma lus ring min du/ /bcu gsum rdo rje'i sa la bsnyeg rgyur bsngo/ /zhes yar mthil pa dge slong blo bzang 'phags pa dang rgyal sman pa ngag dbang phun tshogs gnyis kyis rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par snyan shal brgya nyi shu skor phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /dkon mchog gsum la snying nas gsol btab mthus/ /'tsho byed skal bzang rgyud la sngon bsags dang / /'phral rkyen gyis bsgyur nad gdon kun zhi zhing / /mngon mtho rim brgyud nges legs 'thob par shog /ces tre bo (259na skol bzang gis dgos tshul bzhin za hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus mtsho skyes rdo rje dang / /mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan thugs rje'i zer/ /bdag sogs 'gro ngor dngos snang rdo rje 'dzin/ /che mchog 'dus pa rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /pad+mas ming btags rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ /gangs can bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i nyer 'tsho cher/ /'og min zhing gi mgon ltar rtag bzhugs par/ /re smon rtsa gsum thugs rjes 'grub byin rlobs/ /ka nas dag pa chos sku'i rang gdangs las/ /lhun grub ye shes 'od gsal khor yug ngang / /rang rig don gyi kun bzang tshe 'di la/ /mngon gyur mkha' khyab 'gro ba 'dren par shog /ces pa 'di'ang zhom mdangs bla ma rdzogs chen pa nam mkha' rigs 'dzin dbang grags kyi kha rtan du dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o /ma pham mgon khyod 'phags yul ma ga dhar / /mchog gi sprul skur bstan te bdag sogs 'gro/ /'dus pa dang po'i 'khor du legs skyes nas/ /rnam par grol ba'i lam bzang rnyed par shog /dge tshogs rab 'phel spungs pa'i 'dus sde rnams/ /dbyar zla gsum du zhal 'ches mthun rkyen la/ /'dod dgu'i snye ma g.yur du za ba'i zhing / /pad rtsa ltar dkar lhag bsam gyis phul mthus/ /ngag gi —347

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /gdong lngas bteg pa'i khri la rtag brtan zhing / khyu sbyor rigs brgyud (259ba tha cas pa deng nas bzung / /byang chub bar du phan bde la spyod shog /ces pa 'di yang skyid thang nor bus dge 'phel ri khrod pa rnams kyi dbyar gnas thebs su zhing phul ba'i dus smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /rin chen 'byung ldan thugs rje yis/ /kun dga' bu khrid 'jur gegs las/ /nyer bsgral tshor phung gnas bsgyur te/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ma' gyur shog /phyag na pad+ma'i sbyan ras kyis/ /kun dga' bu khrid nyer btsa' bas/ /'khor ba chu srin 'byung gnas las/ /bsgral te thar pa'i gling khrid shog /bde gshegs mtha' dag bla ma yi/ /ngo bor rtogs nas gzugs sku'i 'phreng / /bzhengs mthusabyang chub ma thob bar/ /bshes gnyen dam pas rjes 'dzin shog /rgyal gsung snying po sher phyin gyi/ /yang bcud stong phrag brgyad pa yi/ /glegs bam bsgrubs mthus mtha' gnyis dang / /bral ba'i gnas lugs rtogs par shog /chos kun skye med 'od gsal ba/ sher phyin sna tshogs pu sta gaḥ /bzhengs pas srid pa'i dus las/ /kun dga' bu khrid thar bar shog /ces pa'ang 'ol dga' stag ru pa'i ma kun dga' bu khrid kyi don du thang sku gsum/ brgyad stong pa/ sher phyin sna tshogs glegs bam bzhengs pa'i smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams (260na)pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /nyer gsum grang gi grangs ldan dngul dkar gyi/ /bum bzang sngags ra masang ga dbang dge legs kyi/ /rnam par rgyal ba phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /legs bshad gling du dang bas nyer phul dges/ /gnas skabs lha mi'i bde skyid la spyod cing / /nyen mongs lnga dag phung lnga gnas 'gyur ba/ /ye shes lnga ldan rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /mngon gyur rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub shog /ces rtses thang dpal grong sngags rams pas phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor bzhes bkod pa —348

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung gas bam dang po/ zhenadza / / /lus ngag yid gsum spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/ /byin rlabs blo ldan bzang po'i bag chags mthus/ /rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas 'gro 'dren mgon khyod kyis/ /skye bar bshes mdzad rjes su 'dzin par shog /'jig rten dbang phyug bod 'bangs gnya' ba'i khrir/ /btsad po'i lha gcig slar yang gang can rjer/ /srong btsan sgam por bstan des skye ba kun/ /lus rjes grib ma bzhin du skyong bar shog /lha yi rgyal dang tho ri snyan shal gyi/ /rten 'byung dus babs phyi dar bstan pa'i srog /'dzin mdzad 'byom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi/ /zhabs pad rdul dmar gtsug tu rtag lhung shog /mi 'gyur dad brtan khri srong lde btsan zhabs/ /dam chos sgron me legs spar sngon goms can/ /dge 'dun gtso bor mkhas grub gar bsgyur ba'i/ /rnam thar byang chen de (260ba)srid 'dzin nus shog /dkon cog gsum 'bangs khri ral da smi ra'i/ /rnal 'byor nyer spyod dge tshogs la 'dun thugs/ /rgya mtsho ltar 'khyil dbyangs can bzhad pa'i gter/ /sgo 'phar tshe rabs kun tu 'byed nus shog /dge ba'i dpal ldan brtse chen snying po dang / /mnga' bdag las lo'i nyi zer snang ba ches/ /bgrang yasalus can bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing / /ro bda'i snye mar rtag tu longs spyod shog /g.yu brag dge 'bum pad+ma badz+ra yi/ /rigs sad bde chen chos rgyal yon tan gter/ /rgya che'i mtsho ltar dpag dka'i 'phrin las rgyun/ /'khor ba ji srid bdag snying la 'jug shog /ces gdan sa chen po dga' ldan gyi 'jam dbyangs lnga pa ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang dkon cog nyi mas thamasacad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs gra tshar bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam dang 'brel ba rtsoms shig par bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa sirnyi ra stu/ /'od mtshan stong phrag zer 'phreng mdzod spu nas/ /'phros pa'i 'khor 'das gdung sel gar gyi dbang / /bde ldan zhing du nying mtshams sbyar ma thag /'dab stong ze'u 'brur brdzus te skye bar shog /—349

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)rnam dpyod ut+pal gyis bteg legs bshad kyi//ral gris zhabrul pa'i dra ba yongs gcod pa//blo bzang snyan grags 'bar ba'i ring lugs la//tshe rabs kun tu 'jug par bdag byin rlobs//ngag dbang zur 261na ) phud lnga pa'i blo gros ga kho//skal bzang gdul byar sgo rnga rgya 'byed nus pa//rgya che chos kyi gnas don mtsho byung mas//stsal ba'i bshes khyod thugs rjes rtag tu bzung //'phrin las rigs 'dzin dar nag ber chen sku//laṅka'i rgyal por rkarma gu ru'i gar//cher khros yang ga/sang drag pos bdud bzhi'i dpung //choms la snang srid dregs pa bran 'khol mdzod//zhi khro nas bzung grong rgyu 'gong po'i bar//phyag rgya ma lus zil gnon stang stabs kyi//khro gtum phal cher lag cha dus gcig tu//lang byed 'jam dpal rdo rjes rtag byin snos//spyo gong dkar blo bzang dpal 'byor gyis 'od dpag med/rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag/yang gsang /'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon bcas pa'i bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so//'jam dbyangs mi yi zlos gar can//blo bzang grags pas deng nas bzung //rnam 'dren thob min de srid du//'bral med dge ba'i bshes mdzad shog/che mchog lha tsho gis zhi khro'i mthu//yongasa'adus zin gnon bzhad pa rtsal//skye bar rdo rje'i slob dpon du/gyur nas nges gsang lam khrid shog/bgrang yas bde bar gshegs pa kun//dkyil 'khor gcig 'dus sgrub sdebargyad//lha sngagasaye shes cho 'phrul gyis//rol pa chen por 261ba〉༅mas klas shog/ces blo bzang don yod kyis rgyal ba btsong kha pa//'di ga'i gzugs brnyan/bka' brgyad gsum gyi dmigs rten bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o//'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i dges gnyen snang bas la//rgyal dbang pad 'byung kun mkhyen btsong kha pa//rigs 'dzin sprul sku 'phags mos bskor bzhengs mthus//dam pa'i bshes kyis rtag tu rjes 'dzin zhing //'chi med tshe yi btung bas 'tsho ༵ dang //seng ge glang chen chom rkun lto 'gro me//

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenalcags sgrog sha za rgya mtsho'i 'jigs pa sogs/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa kun las thar bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang zur khang don grub dbang rgyal gyis dad rten bris sku'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /snang srid zil gnon pad+ma thod phreng gi /spyan sngar khas blangs mtha' 'og rgyal po che/ /sngon gyi dam tshig gnyen po mi g.yel bar/ /bris rten 'di la g.yo med byu skyo/ /rgyal kun ngo bo rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /bstan pa spyi dang bye brag grwa tshang smad/ /thos dang bsam bar rab tu yongs 'dus grar/ /bshad sgrub dpal 'byor dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel mdzod/ /mi mthun bgegs rigs kun zhi 'khor 'das kyi/ /yon tan rab rgyas chos srid dbang du sdus/ /gnod byed tshar gcod 'phrin lasarnam pa bzhi/ /thogs (262na thad lhun gyis grub pa'i dpung bskyed mdzod/ /ces chos sde chen po se ra theg chen gling gi smad grwa tshang gi rigs lung dge skos kyis mtha' 'og rgya po'i bris thang bzhengs par rgyab yig tu 'phrin bcol dgos tshul 'chad nyan pa blo bzang don grub kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /yid bzhin mtsho 'khyil 'dab stong ze'u 'bru'i dbus/ /mngal gyi dri bral tshe dbang thod phreng rtsal/ /thugs rjes cher cher snyigs dus myur 'jug shugs/ /drag 'bar byin chen 'bebs par gsol ba 'debs/ /a dbyings shes rab 'tsho rgyal ḍā ki'i gtso/ /waṃ yig thabs mchog zung 'jug zhal lung las/ /rdo rje thogs med rtsal du nyer btags pa/ /gangs can bstan pa'i dpyid du brtan par shog /skyabs gnas rtsa gsum byin rlabs bden brjod mthus/ /mi phyed snying nas legs btab smon lam gyi/ /'bras bu yongs 'du'i bcud la mig mi 'dzum/ /spyod pa'i skal bzang gnyis par bdag 'gyur shog /ces sngags pa dbus sdings pa blo bzang 'phrin las dbang phyug gis bskul ba ltar za hor gi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /'byams klas ga gil pa'i grong du rang rig rtsal/ /pad+mā kā rar shar ba'i zhal drod las/ /rdo rje —351

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)thogs med rtsal du nyer btags pa/ /drin can bla ma mchog la ga gol ba 'debs/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i phyag gi bum bzang las/ /bdud rtsis lcags khams (262ba〉sgog rtsa'i ka ba yi/ /a rnya mi 'gyur 'chi med rigs 'dzin du/ /nyer 'grub bskal brgyar mi g.yo brtan par shog /chos dbyingasa'adus ma byas pa'i klong yangs su/ /bdag sogs grol min de srid mgon khyod kyis/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen lam ston bshes mdzad nas/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes 'dzin shog /ces pa 'di'ang 'on pa ngag dbang bkra shis kyis tshigs bcad 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o /mtshams sprin snang ba rab gsal gzhon nu'i sku/ /mtshan bzang 'jo sgeg zur phud lnga pa can/ /dpung steng ut+pal gyis bteg ral gri yis/ /bdag sogs 'khrul pa'i dra ba bcad du gsol//chos kun snying po sher phyin glegs bam gyi/ /dgongs don ji bzhin gnas lugs ma lus pa/ /mngon sum mthong nas 'khor ba'i 'jigs/ tshogs las/ /rnam par nyer grol lam bzang rnyed par shog /mgon po khyod la lhag pa'i lhar bzung mthus/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud kyi don rnams kun/ /thos bsam sgom pas gtan la legs phab nas/ /zung 'jug sku bzhi mngon du thob par shog /dus dgrar 'jam dpal khros pa'i zhi khro nas/ /grong rgyu 'gong po'i bar gyi snang srid kun/ /stang stabs phyag rgya gcig gis zil gnon pa/ /dran pa'i mod la bdud bzhi mthar byed shog /drag sngags spu gri rnon pos log 'dren snying / /rab gcod (263na)las sgrub 'jam mgon kun tu bzang / /rang zhal mthong bas 'di phyi ba re gsum gyi/ /mgon po khyod kyis rjes su 'dzin par shog /ga gil ngor shar ba'i dgra rnams mchod rten zhabs/ /bzlog bsad mnan gtad las kyang lugs 'byung du/ /yongs bsgral rnam shes lugs ldog nye ba'i lam/ /'pho med chos sku'i klong du 'dren par shog /ces pa 'di'ang ri bo chos gling pa chos rgyal mtshan gyis 'jam dbyangs dang / phyag rgya zil gnon gyi bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags —352

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenarams pa'o/ /ye shes 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khyim dbus/ /gar dbang mtshan dpe'i gzi yis 'chi bdag mun/ /mthar byas phan bde'i snang ba 'gro kun gyi/ /snying la sim pa'i dga' ston rtag tu rtsol//gsung dbyangs drug cur 'brol ba'i ngag gi dbang / /ngur smig gos klubs blo bzang grags pa yi/ /rgya chen ring lugs dbyar mtsho ji bzhin du/ /'phel mdzad bskal brgyar g.yo med brtan par shog /kun tu dga' ba chos nor 'dod thar sde/ /gdong bzhi'i zhal sgo las 'ongs 'dus tshogs gra/ /srid mtha'i bar du bla nas blar 'phel ba'i/ /smon pa'i re ba yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /sangs rgyas de'i gsung dge 'dun gtan gyi skyabs/ /legs bris drang srong ngag gi mthu ldan pa/ /khyad par gnas srung rgyal po shing bya can/ /dkar phyogs skyong bas 'phrin las lhun grub shog /lhag bsam mkha' la smon lam rta bdun pa/ /bden tshig drod (263ba)kyi snye ma g.yur za ba/ /'dzad mid ltas bur deng nas tshe rabs kun/ /longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang rnyed par shog /ces dga' ba gdong gnas srung rgyal po shing bya can gyi sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtshor 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag gsar du bzhengs nas dgon par skyel ba dang lhan du ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kyang dgos pa'i bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /bdud las rnam par rgyal ba ni dang khro'i/ /dngos grub phan bde'i legs tshogosang ba'i sgo/ /bshad sgrub rigs 'dzin gling du phul ba dge /chad med dbang gi chu bos rgyud smin shog zhes dngul srang nyi shu rtsa gsum las grub pa'i rnam rgyal bum pa gnubs btsun zil gnon rdo rjes phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o /smin byed dbang gi chu bo 'khyil ba'i snod/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas legs bshad gling chen por/ /phul bas 'di dang phyi ma'i don rnams kun/ /'grub pa'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog /ces dngul srang nyi shu rtsa gsum las grub pa'i rnam rgyal bum pa gnubs btsun zin gnon rdo rjes 'phul —353

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /bgrang yas dkyil 'khor bye ba'i spyan lnga sa /gsal byed mar me sbar snod dngul dkar kong / /phul bas sgrib gnyis de 'bras smag rum rnams/ /nyer sangs 'khor 'das yon tan kun thob shog /ces 'phyos (264na)pa sngags rams pa nam mkha' rgya mtshos grwa skor byas pa'i tshe phan bde legs bshad gling du dngul srang nyer gsum gyi mchod kong phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o /zag med bdud rtsi rab 'khyil bad 'dab snod/ /zhe ge lhag dngul dkar bcu bzhi'i srang grangasalas/ /legs sgrub bkras rab dka' dza cu ngag lhun pas/ /phul mthus 'di dang gtan mdun 'grub par shog /ces rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling gi dge skos thog phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o /rgyal kun thugs rje'i zlos gar sprul pa'i sku/ /rang bzhin longs sku'i zhing du nyer bsdus te/ /ngo bo chos sku ye dag dbyings 'dres pa/ /rnam sprul gsar pa'i dga' ston slar gsal shog /ngag dbang 'jam dpal kun bzang pad+ma 'byung / /'phrin las sgo brgya dbye ba'i rig pa 'dzin/ /yang srid kla klo'i yul du ma bzung bar/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i ljongs su 'byon par shog /sel can rnyog ma'i rdzing bu dang bral ba'i/ /rin cen phun tshogs smin grol dwangs ma'i mtshor/ /bad 'byung ring lugs zla gzugs nya gang ba/ /'grib med bstan pa'i gsal byed 'char bar shog /be+e ro'i thugasasprul pradzha ra smi yi/ /bzhed gzhung rab spel dpal gyi ri bo'i ngos/ /theg mchog sgrub pa'i 'dus sde'i mgon gcig pur/ /bsams bzhin skye ba'i zlos gar myur 'dzin shog /rtsa (264bsko sum thugasarje'i nyi ma yongs smin pas/ /rnam dag smon lam snye ma g.yur za ba/ /'dod don 'bras bu dud pa'i ro bda'i zas/ /myong ba'i skal ba bzang por bdag 'gyur shog /ces dpal ri sprul sku ngag dbang pad+ma 'phrin las mkhar chen bza'i thugs kar bsdus pa'i tshe sprul sku myur 'byon gyi smon lam dgos tshul —354

smon lam shi brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa ra po dkar dge ba'i chu spung glegs bam dang po/ zhenadapal ri spyi sos nga ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge rbe ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o//stod hor sa chen skyong ba'i gan mdzod kyi/ /rnam bkra gos yol rigs 'dzin 'dus gling du//phul dges bstan dang skye rgu'i bde skyid rnams/ /rab spel rdo rje'i slob dpon brtan par shog /mi phyed dad mos zhing sa gshin po sa /legs byas sa bon bskrun pa'i myu gu'i skyed/ /nyer bsrings dus kun yid sim tshor ba yi/ /ro bda'i snye mar longs su spyod nus shog /rgyal khab gong ri dkar po'i bya 'dabs nas/ /ngag dbang byams pa rigs brgyud dpal 'byor rnams/ /dbyar gyi chu gter lta bur yongs 'phel bar/ /rab 'byams zhi khro'i tshogs kyis deng byin rlobs/ /zhes dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pas rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par yol ba phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge 6sgogs the(/ /dwangs mtshor 'dab stong ba 'ad pa'i ge sar steng / /lo brgyad lang tsho dar drag 'dren byed la/ /bdud rtsi'i mchog sbyin dus gsum rgyal ba'i gtso/ /pad+ma ka ras tshe rabs kun tu skyongs/ /'dzam bu tri sha'i mtshan (265na sgos mdzes gling 'dir/ /bgrang yas mdzad bzang 'phrul po che yi zhing / /ngo mtshar bkod pa dman blo'i yul 'das pa'i/ /'dren byed bdud rtsi legs byas shing rtas drangs/ /mthong thos dran reg yid can mngon mtho dang / /nges legs lam la sbyor ba'i sa bon rnams/ /dad mos drod gsher gyis bskyed a mra'i ljon/ /ro bda'i 'bras bur rtag tu spyod 'di med/ /chags bral chags pa'i nyams ldan zla ba'i bzhin/ /gangs ri'i nu 'bur smin ma'i 'khri shing can/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje rtse 'jo'i gar mkhan ma/ /pad 'byung bdag sogs bde chen sa la sbyor/ /so thar khrims 'chal lta gzhog byang sems sngags/ /ches phra ltung bas ma gos sdom brtson mchog /pad+ma sa lha'i tshul khrims tsan+dan dris/ /nyon mongs gdung gzhil de rjes 'jug byin rlobs/ /mkhyen spyan dgu tshigs zhags pas shes bya'i mkha'/ /pha mtha' bcings tshe lkog tu gyur pa'i chos/ /ma rnyed blo ldan mchog sred ngang —355

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)tshul ding / /mngon gyur rnam pa thams cad mkhyen brnyed shog /zhabs sen zla ba 'khor 'das yongasakyi gtsug shar ba'i mod la brtan g.yo ma lus pa/ /dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal po khyod bzhin du/ /bdag sogs lus can mtha' dag 'gyur bar shog /'gro ba'i bde skyid myu gu smin byed pa/ /'bum phrag thugs rje'i nyi ma 'od zer gyis/ /gang 'dul 'phrin las 'jug pa srid mtha'i bar/ /tshad med rnam thar bdag gis 'dzin nus shog 'i kya seng ge'i rgyud kyi nga ro'i dbyangs/ /'jigs med mgrin par blangs pas bdud bzhi'i sde/ /glang chen smyon pa'i klad 'gems brtul zhugs rtsal/ /'bad med lhun grub dbang phyug bdag la rtsol/ /gtum drag rdo rje rab 'bar khro bo che/ /seng ge'i sgra chen bsgrags pas tirti ka /bgrang (265bsgos ri dwags mthar byas thub pa'i bstan/ /'dzin skyong spel ba'i rjesasu slob par shog /'chol ba'i khro rgyal rdo rje gro bo lod/ /stang stabs tsam gyis dregs pa sdebargyad tshogs/ /tshar gcod las la bkol ba ji bzhin du/ /thogs med rdzu phrul mthu mnga' brnyes par shog /dge sbyong chos bzhi spyod par nyer 'dun grar/ /bcu phrag bka' wo bshad dang nyan pa'i 'bras/ /mkhas grub bye bas thub bstan gsal mdzad pa/ /thams cad mkhyen dngos de yis bdag rjes gzung / /ngo mtshar dge mtshan ldan pa mkha' 'gro'i gling / /dkar mo'i ljongs su thos bsam sgom sgrub la/ /rab 'dun chos kyi sde spel 'phrin las rgyun/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar yol ba med de bsngags/ /bsod nams zhing sar phan bde'i lo tog tshogs/ /spel phyir rgya hor bod kyi 'byor ba'i rgyun/ /ma dros mtsho chen las babs gaṅgā bzhin/ /chad med srid gsum rnam par 'dren khyod bsngags//ching gis rigs brgyud yon tan rgya mtsho cher/ /bde chen chos kyi rgyal po yid bzhin nor/ /srid zhi'i klu dbang gdengs ga'i rtser 'dzegs pa/ /snyan grags phyogs bral rnar 'jibs dad pa'i sos ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs mgrin zhugs blo ldan pa'i/ /bzang po'i skal ba zab brling rgya chen por/ /mtsho byung lus phras 'byud pa mi gtong bar/ /nges pas 'di phyi'i don kun 'grub bar shog /ces zur khang pa don grub dbang rgyal gyis slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ gu ru mtshan brgyad la pad+ma —356

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ 'dabaka'i thang yig zhing bkod kyis bskor ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub sogs kyi snang brnyan gra tshar du bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbya ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams ba ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa oṃ a thā/ /sa gsum yongs kyi rnam 'dren myong kha pa'i/(266na)/lugs 'dzin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen sogs/ /bla ma yid dam chos srung thugs rje dang / /bden tshig mthu yis don rnamasa'agrub par shog /dga' ldan bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs mnga' 'bangs tshogs/ /skyong ba'i rnam dag bsam pa tshul bzhin du/ /rab bsgrub tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang dpal/ /bla nas blar 'phel skal bzang rnyed par shog /pha rol log 'dren nyer 'tshe'i smag rum sangs/ /bkra shis g.yang chags nyi 'od gzi 'bar bar/ /legs ldan phyag drug 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal/ /'dod khams ma sogasasrung mas gdong grog mdzod/ /ces mchog dman yongs kyi kha ton 'byer bde'i smon lam bden brjod 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes e khe paṇ+ḍi tas don gnyer chen pos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi ban+desasbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /bde ldan zhing gi mgon po gar gyi dbang / /yid bzhin 'khor lo 6 med mchog sbyin mkhan/ /rnam par rgyal ma sogs kyis thugs rje'i dpung / /skyed la deng 'dir 'dod pa'i 'bras smin mdzod/ /sangs rgyas stong las pad dkar bzhin ba jags pa/ /don kun grub bstan rgya chen 'dzam gling gzhin/ /dbyar mtsho ltar spel gnam sa'i dbang phyug che'i/ /sku tshe g.yung drung srog song brtan par shog /ka ba med pa gnam gyi mthongs nas sgo/ /rab phye dus kyi bdag po'i las shugs btsan/ /dar drag khrims gnyis gnya' shing skye rgu yi/ /phrag par lci bas rdzogs ldan gsar bskrun shog /bsod nams 'od gzi yongs 'bar rtsibs stong can/ /stobs kyi 'khor lo mkha' la nyer 'phags te/ /kun bzod sto bar legs bsgyur dbu rmog btsan/ /chab srid mnga' thang bla nas blar 'phel shog /mchog gsum lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin sogs/(266ba)/bden tshig grub pa rnams kyis nyer btab pa'i/ /smon —357

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)lam rin chen dbang gi rgyal po las/ /'dod 'jo'i char gyis 'jig rten khyab par shog /ces sa skyong sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i brtan bzhugs 'di ni gangs ri'i khrod kyi rigs gzhung rgya mtsho'i 'byung khungs gcig pu ba dpal gsang phu ne'u thog gi chos rje rnam gnyis chen slob grwa rigs rnams kyis gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa dza yas/ /dza em dzikā ru ṇa sru rla nga lha lha 'i lhag su sa : rta dharma go lha/rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thug rje'i nyer zer gyis/ /snying gi 'dab brgya bzhad pas kun rdzob chos/ /ya ཿ dzā ti ka :d+dha pa ci rma sa shā sku nyo mu khyi ta sprul lha dza ya rmu/gang shar a ti ka dag klong yangs por/ /rang sar grol ba'i rigs 'dzin rgyas gyur cig /che mchog a nu lus kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /zhi khro (267na)rab 'byams yongs 'dus lha sngags dang / /ye shes rig rtsal ma 'gags gdangs gsal ba/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /sgrub pa sde brgyad ma hā yo ga yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo shel ngos tshoni ris ltar/ /ma 'dres legs shar bla med he ru gaḥ/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso bos deng byin rlobs/ /bder gshegs zhi khro nas bzung grong rgyug gi /the'u rang 'gong po'i bar gyi phyag rgya kun/ /zil gnon brtul zhugs yongs grub ba 'ad pa rtsal/ /mgon po khyod kyis skye bar rjes 'dzin shog /zab gter cho me kyi nyi ma pad gling rje'i/ /thugs sras dbang chen sprul pa'i rol gar mkhan/ /bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje'i lung rtogs dang / /sku tshe dpal 'byor bzhed don lhun grub shog /dbang chen rnam 'phrul thugs sras zla ba'i sprul sku bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rjes 'di ga'i bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes gsungs gis bskul bar brten snyan ngag mkhan po'i sgro btags la nges pa med pas dpa' gzid dang bcas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni —358

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa ra bdakar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ 6)dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /chos rgyal mkhas grub mang por las dkar 'brel/ /thob la skye bar sgro btags lnga rig gzhung / /smra bas 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu dga' ba'i 'dzum/ /zhal khyim lhug par ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhom gzhig dang bral rdo rje'i rang bzhin can/ /gang la thogs med brtul zhugs rtsal ldan par/ /pad 'byung 'tsho rgyal yab yum mgrin gcig gis/ /dbugs dbyung ji bzhin mi g.yo rtag brtan shog(267ba)/bsod nams chu gter klong nas khrims gnyis kyi/ /nyi zla zung gi 'jig rten mun sel ba/ /sa chen skyong mdzad sangs rgyas rgya mtsho yi/ /sku tshe chab srid brtan cing 'phel bar shog /mnyam med dge ldan ring lugs yongs 'dzin pas/ /thar ba'i gling du bgrod la thos bsam dang / /nye bar sgom pa'i 'dus gra srid mtha' sa /dbyar gyi chu gter lta bur rgyas gyur cig /skyabs gnas rin cen gsum gyi byin rlabs dang / /legs bris drang srong bden tshig grub pa'i mthu/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i 'phrin las kyis/ /smon lam btab pa'i re 'bras smin par shog /ces pa 'di'ang dga' ldan thar pa gling slob dpon gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /lhar bcas skye rgu'i rnam 'dren btsong kha pa'i/ /chos srid bstan pa gyen 'degs snying stobs khur/ /blo brtson phrag par len nus dge ba'i bshes/ /tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /gdong lngas rab bteg rin cen rdul brtsegs khri/ /'gyur med rdo rjes mtshan par zhabasapad zung/ /bskal brgyar g.yung drung srog song gar gyi dbang / /'chi med grub pa'i ngo bor bzhugs gyur cig /dga' ldan dam chos gling gi 'dus sde 'dir/ /thos bsam sgom sogs rnam par dkar ba yi/ /'phrin las 'gro kun rgyud la nyer zhugs te/ /lus can bsod nams zhing du rgyas gyur cig /sgo mang zur pa chos rje ngag dbang lhun grub kyis dga' ldan dam chos gling du 'dzugs rgyur 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ma byung ba ltar za hor gyi (268na)bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan —359

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /ngag dbang dbyangs can dgyes pa'i blo gros gter/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i rgya mtsho rab 'khyil bar/ /gsol btab ji bzhin rdo rje lta bur brtan/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang chos rje ngag dbang lhun grub kyi ngor za hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /ngo mtshar med du byung ba'i bkod pa yi/ /zhing gtso seng ge'i rgyud las drangs pa'i chos nga ros yid srubs ri dwags klad 'gems pa/ /rje btsun 'jam dpal snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /de bstan spel la ngag dbang dbyangs can blo/ /bzang po'i bag chags mthus rnyed rgya chen gzhung / /mtsho ltar gting zab 'chad rtsod rab rtsom par/ /'jigs bral spobs pa dge bar gsol ba 'debs/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun/ /mgon khyod rang byung lus kyi pho brang cher/ /dad mos me long ngos su rtag shar bas/ /slu med legs byas gos bu myong byin rlobs/ /'od gsal lha yi lam nas 'ongs pa'i rigs/ /cho 'brang gdung gis mtho btsun sa'i dbang phyug /yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i sku tshe dang / /mnga' thang chab srid bla nas blar 'phel shog /myur mdzad legs ldan las kyi gshin rje'i rgyal/ /re ma tri dang stobs 'phrog gdong bzhi ba/ /dam can srung mas mi mthun kun zhi zhing / /phun tshogs bzhed don ma lus lhun grub mdzod/ /ces sa skyong lha rgya ri ba ngag dbang chos rgyal gyis zhal 'don gsol 'debs smon lam gyi rim pa zhig dgos tshul gsung pa ltar (268ba)za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /legs byas mi 'dzad gter gyi sgo 'phar brgya/ /phye ba'i 'bras bu rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ /'pho ba chen po 'ja' lus tshe mtha' yas/ grub pa'i rigs 'dzin ngo bor brtan gyur cig /mchod dpon las 'dzin ngag dbang shes rab kyis/ /ches dkar bsam dang sbyor byung brtson 'grus mthus//'jon dmar gser bzhun zung du 'jug pa'i sku/ /mthong thos dran pas rnam par grol 'di bskrun/ /rang rig rang zhal kun bzang he ru daḥ /mngon gyur de srid mi 'bral mgon mdzad nas/ /mchog dang —360

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (na)thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ /rab stsol yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal por shog /ces 'dra 'bag gi kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /'od mtshan stong 'bar mdzod spu'i zer 'phreng gis/ /rdo rje bu khrid rnam shes 'khor ba las//drangs te bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /chu skyes 'dab dbus skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ched du bsod nams byas so cog gi 'bras/ /mchog gsum spyan sngar rab bsngos zad pa'i mtha'/ /rnam mkhyen gzigs pas ma rnyed bla med kyi/ /byang chub che dang ro gcig 'gyur bar shog /gnas skabs lha mi'i yang srid chad min par/ /brgyud de mi pham mgon po 'phags yul du/ /chos 'khor bskor ba'i 'dus pa dang po sa /skyes nas smin grol dga' ston la spyod shog /ces rdo rje bu khrid kyi don du smon lam tshigs bcad dgos tshul (269na sko sa zur khang pas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /rgya btab ra mo che yi ga rjo lar/ /mi bskyod rdo rje gtso gyur sras slob kyi/ /sku brnyan mthong bas 'gro kun don ldan du/ /legs mdzad bsod nams bgrang yas zhing sa cher/ /tong khun yul gru'i gan gos sna tshogs las/ /'jam mnyen lus la bde ba'i reg bya can/ /phul ba'i thub bstan rab 'phel skye rgu rnams/ /sum rtsen bdag po'i dga' ston myong bar shog /bdog pa gtong dang yongs spel 'du 'khod mkhan/ /mtha' dag 'di phyir lha mi'i dpal thob cing / /byang chen ring por mi thogs mngon gyur nas/ /'gro rnams srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /ces rgya btab ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang du gos sna tshogs las bskrun pa'i pad khebs lnga bcu nga gcig stod g.yog dang smad g.yog bcu re sa skyong blo bzang sbyin pas khur blangs te bzos pa'i tshe smon lam du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /log rtog rnyog bral dad pa'i nam mkha' la/ /rgyal kun yongs 'dus ri bong can gyi gzugs//thugs rje'i cha gang 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba —361 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'debs/ /spyi bor seng ges bteg pa'i rdo rje'i khrir/ /mgon khyod rigs rnams bdag por rab mos nas/ /gsol btab thugs rje'i bdud rtsi snying dbus su/ rtag tu chad med 'jug par byin gyi rlobs/ /deng nas stobs bcu mnga' ba ma thob bar/ /rje btsun (269ba)bla mas mi 'bral rjes bzung ste/ /lha mi'i rten gyi rin cen them skas la/ /rim 'dzegs thar ba'i grong du 'jug par shog /gnas skabs su yang dgra gdon dbul phongs nas/ /nyer 'tshe'i rgud pa ma lus rab zhi zhing / /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dbang thang sogs/ /yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar shog /mdor na dkon cog rin cen rnam gsum gyi/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las 'jug pa kun/ /zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yongs 'du'i ljon shing ltar/ /bsam don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shisashog khres gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni khal 9u rang khang gi snga kha ching dpon po ngosakyi 'byor skabs kha tan du 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /gsang chen rgyud sde'i gsung ngag snying po'i bcud/ /smin byed dbang gyi chu bo rnam bzhi'i rgyun/ /blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtshor 'bebs mdzad pa'i/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i mgon por gsol ba 'debs/ /phas rgol log smra'i dpung la 'jigs med pa/ /'chad rtsod rtsom nus go cha btsan po can//thub bstan lung rtogs lang mtsho rgyas pa'i sde/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dbyangs ngang mo dga' ba'i mgrin tshal na /pad dkar ge sar steng du tshangs sras ma/ /ba 'ad pa'i lung rigs rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ /'dzin mdzad bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /gar dbang mnyam gzhag gis bteg ke la sha /yongs gtams bdud rtsi bde chen 'khor lo (270na)nas/ /dbu ma'i lam rgyud a snya 'gyur med mthus/ /mgon khyod zhing 'dir mi 'gyur brtan par shog /drug sbrags 'od khyim gur nang pad zla'i steng / /smin legs lang mtsho dar ba'i thugs ka'i dbus/ /'khor lo sngags phreng zil dngar chad med kyis/ /rdo rje'i srog tu 'grub par deng byin —362

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenarlobs/ /bde ldan zhing gi mgon des cher bsngags don/ /ji bzhin grub pa'i byin rlabs 'phrul po ches/ /'chi bdag g.yul las rnam par rgyal mdzad mas/ /'dod don re ba ma lus deng skong gsol//rin cen las grub seng ges nyer bteg khri/ /sra brtan rdo rjes legs mtshan re 'a la/ /mi shigasaskyil krung bcas te bskal brgya'i bar/ /g.yung drung lta bur gzhes zhig bral bar shog /ji ltar bsams pa'i don kun grub ched du/ /sangs rgyas de gsung sras dang nyan rang bcas/ /khyad par legs ldan nag po phyag drug pa/ /las kyi gshin rje 'dod khams dbang phyug sogs/ /dam can rgya mtshos rtag tu grogs mdzad shog /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i zhing sa la/ /rgyu 'bras smon lam sa bon drod gsher gyis/ /rab smin bde skyid gser gyi snye ma la/ /spyod pa'i skal bzang deng 'dir lhun grub shog /ces gsol 'debs ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kha thag ring tsam zhig dgos zhes hor tshang chos rje tā'i si tu blo bzang chos skyong gis bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /'phags pa phyogs bcu mun sel gyi don dang sbyar ba'i smon lam tshigs bcad sogs/shar phyogs nyon mongs bskyod pa'i zhing (2707khams na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rjes su sbyong ba la/ /ma yengs phyag btsal yid la dran pa'i mthus/ /'jigs pa yongs zhi don kun 'grub par shog /lho phyogs mun nag bcom pa'i zhing khams na/ /bde bar gshegs pa mngon 'phags rgyal po la/ /ma yengs phyag btsal yid la dran pa'i mthus/ /nub phyogs yul phebs bya ba'i zhing khams na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gnon pa la/ /ma yengs phyag btsal yid la dran pa'i mthus/ /byang phyogs spobs pa can gyi zhing khams na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin cen 'od snang la/ /—363

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ma yengs phyag btsal yid la dran pa'i mthus/ /byang shar bdud sde bcom pa'i zhing khams na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud 'joms rnam gnon la/ /ma yengs phyag btsal yid la dran pa'i mthus/ /shar lho rtag tu snang ba'i zhing khams la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor lo 'byung dpal la/ /ma yengs phyag btsal yid la dran pa'i mthus/ /lho nub gser dras g.yogs pa'i zhing khams na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gdugs 'phags sna ba la/ /ma yengs phyag btsal yid la dran pa'i mthus/ /nub byang mngon par 'phags pa'i zhing khams na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dul ba zhes bya la/ /ma yengs phyag btsal yid la dran pa'i mthus/ /steng phyogs yid la byed can zhing khams na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mngon 'phags rgyal po la/ /ma yengs phyag btsal yid la dran pa'i mthus/ /'og phyogs yon to brgyan pa'i zhing khams na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa the tshom gcod mdzad la/ /ma —yengs phyag btsal yid la dran pa'i mthus/ /'jigs pa yongs zhi don kun 'grub par shog shwakya gzhen nu bzhin rasarab gsal la/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyis ji ltar zhal 'tshes pa'i/ /'bras bu ji bzhin bdag sogs 'khor bcas (271na 'a/ / rab smin ro bda'i zas la spyod par shog /ces 'phags pa phyogs bcu mun sel gyi don dang sbyar ba'i smon lam smo dgos zhes o sto tsha tso si tu blo bzang chos skyong gis bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /sman bla mched bdun kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen/ /nye ba'i sras brgyad gnas brtan bcu drug dang / /lung rtog dmachos bslu ba med pa'i mgon/ /thugs rje'i mthu mnga' skyabs mchog ma lus dgongs/ /khyad par byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying pos/ /tre bo hor tshang yul dang sa phyogs 'dir//nor 'dzin g.yo ba'i 'jigs pa chen po kun/ /nyer zhi bde skyid dpal la 'god par shog /chos nyid mi 'gyur rgyu 'bras slu med phyir/ /dkon cog gsum gyi thugs rje rab bskul ba'i/ /gsol ba gdung shugs drag pos 'debs byed na/ /'jig skrag sdug bsngal kun las thar bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang —364

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhinatre bo hor tshang chos rjes bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong snga rams pa'o/ /gdul dka' 'dul phyir phyag na pad dkar 'chang / /rdo rje srin po'i skur bstan phyag drug mgon/ /bla ma yi dam chos skyong dbyer med pa/ /gtan gyi skyabs mchog mthu stobs nus pa yi/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen bde ldan zhing / /dbang phyug tshe mtha' yas ltar rab brtan zhing / /gegs med 'brang ri'i gnas su 'dus sde dang / /thos bsam sgom pa dar zhing (271ba)rgyas par shog /ces pa 'di ni rab 'byas pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /mang du thos pas ngag la dbang 'byor zhing / /rgya chen gzhung lugs dbyar mtsho ltar spel bar//zla bral rnam dpyod yangs pa'i yongs 'dzin mchog /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod 'phrin las mkha' mnyam 'gro ba la/ /'jug pa'i pha mtha' rdzogs min de srid du/ /bdag sogs slob mar bcas pa rjes bzung nas/ /'bral med dam pa'i chos la longs spyod shog /ces skyor lung mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtsho la gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni lho brag dga' ldan don gnyis gling grwa dmangs kyis bskul ba ltar za hor brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /phyag na pad+ma'i thugs rje spyan ras kyis/ /a snying byang chub bar du rjes btsa' bas/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i legs tshogs rnams/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsis gzhi bas a snying gi don du thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa'i bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul bzhin bris/ /rgyal kun ngo bo pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul nyin mor byed pa las/ /mtshan brgyad rol gar 'od kyis phan dang bde'i/ /'dab stong 'khor mtha' de srid ba 'ad par shog /gangs can 'gro la srong btsan sgam po yi/ /thugs rje'i 'jug pa yol med yang —365

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)srid kyi//rin cen phreng ba gtsug tor rtser bcings nas/272na/'di phyi'i mdun ma thams cad 'grub par shog/mi bsrun gdug pa 'dul phyir pad dkar lang //rdo rje srin po'i skur bstan myur mdzad mgon//lcam dral gnod sbyin rnam bzhi bka' sdod tshogs//ma g.yel zhi rgyas dbang drag las rnams mdzod//ces spyi khang dkon cog gi dad rten du thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs/gu ru mtshan brgyad/mgon po phyag drug pa bcas bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bris//mdun gyi nam mkhar bad zla'i dkyil 'khor steng //tshe dpag med mgon sras bcas rgyal ba yis//yongs bskor mchog gsum 'dus pa ngo bo la//dpang por gsol na bden tshigs hrūb byin rlobs//ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs blo bzang grags 'bar bstan//rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab mdzad tshangs sras lha//bzhad pa'i srog gi ka ba rdo rje ltar//srid mtha'i bar du nam yang 'gyur med shog/dga' ldan bshad sgrub zung 'brel don gnyis kun//nyer grub 'dus gling rnam gsum 'khor lo'i las//byams mgon mchog gi sprul skur ma gyur bar//yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par shog/ces ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad 'di ni lho brag bsngags nga dbang chen lhun grub kyis dga' ldan don gnyis gling du 'dzugs rtsis kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so//pad rā ga mdangs ldan rdul brtsegs gser zhun gos//nyer klubs ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gzugs/ 272ba/blo bzang bsod nams dad pa'i zla dkyil ngos /shar bas skye bar bde skyid 'od gsal shog/ces 'dra 'bag gi gdan ngos la brko rgyu zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes bris pa sarba a brasirnya me bha / // pad 'byung lus dkyil shel ngos zhi khro'i tshon//rab bkra bka' brgyad lhar rdzogs drag po rtsal//gar dgu'i sgyu 'phrul mngon gsum gsal ༷dra 'di//dngos grub char chen 'bebs la dngom

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenapa bzhin/ /sad ser nad zhabrugs lha min gdon gyi mtshon/ /'bebs sogs mi bzad zug rngu las skyob cing / /bde skyid cho gar bod 'bangs ci dga' sa /nyer spyod 'phrin las mang bsgrub dmigasarten mtshar/ /chos dkar 'bras bu mtsho skyes rdo rje yis/ /gangs ljongs 'gro rnams rjes 'dzin zhal 'ches pa'i/ /byin rlabs gzi byin brgya phrag nyi ma'i 'od/ /ches cher 'bar ba'i dpal la 'gran nus shog /ces pa'ang 'di kha bas bskor ba'i sman ljongs 'dir phan bde'i sgo brgya 'byed pa'i 'phrin sgrub rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pas gang dgos su mdzad pa'i rten zhig byung na zhes mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bskul bas rkyen byas don grub kyi lor gzhis ka shar pa 'phrin las rnam rgyal rgyas skya ris dang spyan 'byed/ shun pa shag khyi skyag gis tshon mdangs dang gser bcad/ sog po bstan pa tshul khrims kyis kyang bcad dang gser ris sogs bgyis pa'i tshe smon lam du za hor sngags smyon gyis bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pas bgyis pa dza / / /chos kun gdod nas nyer zhi 'jam (273na)pa'i klong / /rab khros srid gsum zar brngams 'jigs med dbyangs/ /drag po'i ngar sgra cher sgrog dus dgra'i dbang / /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon gar gyi rol/ /dran pa'i yid mkhar dpa' po'i stang stabs nyi/ shar tshe rang srid 'dab brgya bshad pa dang / /phas rgol kun+da zum nus ma ga spyod kyis/ /'phrin las thog 'khyug glog gi zegs ma 'phro/ /bsod nams nyer byas dbang phyug mig gi me'i/ /dpal rtser dgra bgegs 'dod lha sde bcas gzugs/ /lhag mar rab byas rnam par rgyal ba yi/ /ru mtshon srid pa'i rtse mor bsgreng bar mdzod/ /ces pa'ang rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pas 'jam dpal tshe bdag gi las sbyor skabs thob gang dgos kyi tshe sgrub rten zhig byung na zhes mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bskul bas rkyen byas don grub kyi lor gzhis ka shar pa 'phrin las rnam rgyal gyis skya ris dang spyan 'byed/ /shun pa shag khyi skyag gis tshon mdangs dang gser bcas/ sog po bstan pa tshul khrims kyis kyang bcad dang gser ris sogs bgyis pa'i tshe smon lam du za hor sngags smyon gyis bkod pa'i yi ge pa —367—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ni dpal 11nga sngags rams pas bgyis pa dza ( / /dri med drang srong gser gyi 'bor lo'i rtsibs/ /snang srid sdebargyad srog la mnga' bsgyur ba//zhe sdang dag pa'i rdo rje gtum po'i sku/ /mthong tshe yid srubs sde bcas snying rtsa 'gas/ /de nyid semasasu shar ba'i rnam par 'phrul/ /gnas pa rtsa dang 'dren dkyil gcod byed lce'i/ /ting 'dzin srung bzlog bsad mnan 'byung (273ba tha zhi'i mtsho ni/ /rnon pos 'gegs dpung lus srog phye mar 'thag/gdug rtsub bsam sbyor la brtse'i rgyus bskyed nas/ /rab bsgral dus kyi sdang sems 'bar ba'i mes /log 'dren dug rlangs des bskrun las nyon tshogs/ /cig car ming gi lhag mar bsreg par shog /ces pa'ang rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling nas drang srong dmod pa'i tshe sgrub rten zhig byung na zhes mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bskul bas rkyen byas sa lug 31ra gzhis ka shar pa 'phrin las rnam rgyal rgyas skya ris dang spyan 'byed/ shun pa shag khyi skyag gis tshoni mdangs dang gser bcad/ sog po bstan pa tshul khrims kyis kyang bcad dang gser ris sogs bgyis pa'i tshe smon lam du za hor sngags spyon gyis bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pas bgyis pa dza ya skyo/ /gnam stong smag gi rum las ches gnag sems/ /nyer 'chang dgra bgegs lcags kyus bkug pa'i mgo /'bar ba'i tho chen bsnun pas rkang mthil bar/ /phyer 'thag srog bdud gshin rje gi skong dmar/ /ka dag gdod ma'i 'jam mgon kun tu bzang / /chu las chu lhar bzhin du dus kyi dgrar/ /lhun grub dbang po'i gzhu ltar yongs shar ba/ /srid gsum skye rgu'i bla tsher brngams pa bzhin/ /mtha' med rgya mtsho'i gting nas 'chi bdag nag /chu srin rnam par langs pa'i gre ba mā /ma rung log 'dren gzugs can gzugs med ces pa'ang rnam par (274na)rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling nas dgra bgegs rnams thar med lcags khang nag por 'jug pa'i tshe sgrub rten zhig byung na zhes mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bskul bas rkyen byas don grub gyi lor gzhis ka shar pa 'phrin las rnam rgyal gyis sku ris dang spyan 'byed/ shun pa shag khyi skyag gis tshon mdangs dang —368

smon lam shi brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanagaser bcad/ sog po bstan pa tshul khrims kyis kyang bcad dang gser ris sogs bgyis pa'i tshe smon lam du za hor sngags spyon gyis bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pas bgyis pa dza / / /ma tshogs bran du bkol ba re ma tir/ /bod skyong bdud dang gnod sbyin sman mo'i rigs/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis bskor lha yi lam/ /dbang po'i gzhu ris lta bur rnam par bkra/ /mdosagator dngos bsham yid sprul mthun pa'i rdzas/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas nyer spel pur rgyal gyi/ /nad yams mu ge 'khrug rtsod zhi ba'i ched/ /'bul rten 'di la ye shes mngon gsum phob/ /lusang ga yid la mi bzad gdung ba yi/ /tshor ba drag po ming gi lhag ma sa /byas nas bde skyid dpag bsam ljon pa'i 'bras/ /spyod la lha yi spun zlar 'gyur bar shog /ces pa'ang rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling nas nad yams mu ge'i rgud pa sel ba'i slad du bod skyong bstan ma mchod pa'i tshe sgrub rten zhig byung na zhes mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bskul bas rkyen byas don grub kyi lor gzhis ka shar pa 'phrin las rnam rgyal gyis skya ris dang spyan 'byed/ shun pa shag khyi skyag (274ba)gis tshon mdangs dang gser bcad/ sog po bstan pa tshul khrims kyis kyang bcad dang gser ris sogs bgyis pa'i tshe smon lam du za hor sngags spyon gyis bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pas bgyi bas pa dza ( / /phun tshogs chos dkar sa bon btab pa'i 'bras/ /mngon mtho'i rten la dbang 'byor yang srid kun/ /don gnyis rgya mtsho 'phrin las grub rdzings kyis/ /gtan bde'i rin cen gling du bgrod par shog /ces rgyal byed slob dpon chos dbang rgya mtsho dus las 'das par smon lam la dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bsdos bkod/ /lus ngag yid gsum lha sngags ye shes la/ /dbang phyug blo mnga' mkhas btsun bzang po'i sgra/ /rgya chen nor 'dzin yongs khyab mtsho byung mas/ /mgrin 'khyud rdo rje 'dzin par gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dbyangs blo bzang grags pa'i bstan srid zung / /dga' ba'i dpal ldan pho brang —369

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)nas 'degs pa/ /gnam bskos rgyal khab sde bzhi'i 'dun sa cher/ /bshes gnyen dam pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /snying nas dad pas nyer bskul lhang lhang sgras/ /mgon khyod bskal brgyar g.yo med bden pa'i tshig /brjod na dkon cog rnam gsum thugs rje'i mthus/ /re ba don dang ldan par bdag byin rlobs/ /legs tshogs yon tan ma lus lhun grub pa/ /rab brtan rigs brgyud dngos grub 'bad med du/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i mdzod la mnga' 'byor pas/ /bsams pa'i re 'dod mtha' dag 'jo bar shog /'jam dpal khros pa ma he'i zhal can dang / /myur mdzad (275na〉gon po las gshin chos kyi rgyal/ /'dod khams dbang phyug la sogs srung ma yis/ /g.yel ba med par rtag tu grogs byed shog /ces pa 'di'ang 'ba' rdzong sdod shun lhun grub rab brtan pa dngos grub nor bus bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ / 'od mtshan stong 'bar rjes brtse'i skya rengs mas/ /nyer drangs mkhas btsun bzang po'i nyi zer gyis/ /lnga bdo'i mun sel phan bde'i snang ba yis/ /khyab mdzad lha gcig jo bo a ti shar/ /zas gtsang sras dang ma pham thogs med mched/ /rim brgyud rgya chen spyod pa'i bshes gnyen tshogs/ /nor bu'i do shal ji ltar chad med pas/ /bskor 'di bsod nams zhing du dngos byon zhing / /dge bas chung 'bring lam gyi sna drangs nas/ /bdag las gzhan gces bsgom pa'i sems bzang pos/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras mdzad par byang chub mchog /ma rnyed de srid nyams su bstar nus shog /mtha' bral dbu ma'i mkha' dbyings bde ba'i 'ja'/ /zung 'jug kha sbyor bdun ldan mngon gyur yang / /chags bral ngur smrig zol gyi gdul bya'i tshogs/ /gtsang ma'i rnam thar la 'god btsong kha par/ shwakya seng ge 'jam mgon klu sgrub sogs/ /zab mo lta ba'i brgyud 'dzin bla ma yis/ /yongs bskor tshon brgyar nye ba'i dwangs shel rjes/ /rab bsnyeg sngon med 'dren byed zil dngar bcud/ /bsod nams byas 'bras bden gnyis zung 'jug mtshon/ /rnon pos srid rtsa ngar 'dzin dra —370

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedaba'i (275ba)tshogs/ /bcad nas gtan mdun thar ba'i ba gom du/ /rab bgrod skal ba bzang por bdag 'gyur shogasangs rgyas kyis gsungs skyabs dngos mya ngan 'das/ /tshul bzhin bstar ba dge 'dun yongs kyi gtso/ /grags pa don ldan paṇa grub rnam par thar/ /ston phyir 'brom ston slar byon rol gar la/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i snang brnyan rnyog bral mtshor/ /chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor ltar gsal ba/ /dad pa'i kun+da 'dzum byed cho ga la/ /'jig rten mes pos gsar du bskrun pa bzhin/ /ched du nyer 'bad drang srong ā ga sdus/ /bdag sogs 'gro rgyud dug gsum nyal 'gro'i dri/ khrung phyungs gtan mdun yan lag brgyad ldan chus/ /'khor 'das yongs kyi nad brgya sel bar shog /dge legs yongs 'du'i rtsa ba brtan po sa /'dzugs par gcig tu nyer 'dun snying stobasagom/ /rgya mtsho'i pha mthar 'jog la khyab 'jug khengs/ /thung ngur rab byas dbyangs can bzhad pa'i sder/ /rtsa gsum mdzes chags rngam brjid rol ba yi/ /stang stabs gdul bya'i mos ngor shar ba'i gzugs/ /sgyu ma'i 'khrul la gdung ba 'phog nus pa/ /kun dga'i yid kyi rtse 'jor byon nam snyam/ /mgon khyod thugs rje ga t+pā ra yi rdul/ /bdag sems dug lnga'i tsha gdung nyer bcil nas/ shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang de/ /ring por mi thogs ma ho du 'gyur bar shog gru 'dzin ri bo'i spo zhinas bas mas ba na du/ /gnam bskos rje 'bangs bsod nams nyer byon pa/ /rgya chen thugasabaskyed (27na ji byar mtsho ltar 'phel ba/ /'gro rnams mthong thos dran pas 'dren mdzad cher/ /skyabs gnas sna tsho gos sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu yongs bsgyur ba/ /phun tshogs chos dkar ring nas 'bod byed brdar/ /phra zhib pir gyi rtse mor shar gyi dogs/ /mkhyen brtse nus mthu brgya byin gtsug gtor gyis/ /'khor 'khyams mi yi lus la reg pa'i mod/ /ngesalegs skabs gsum lus su skad cig tu/ /'gyur ba'i dga' ston mngon sum bdag la rtsol/ /dusasum rgyal kun yon tan phung po'i tshogs/ /rgya mtsho'i dbus na lhun po ltar 'phyur ba/ /bde chen chos—371—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)kyi rgyal po lhar bcas 'gro'i/ /gtsug na mngon par 'gying khyod mchog tu bsngags/ /dad pa'i zla zer 'thung ba'i pad+ma dkar/ /'dab brgya phyogs bcur grol ltar bla ma dang / /yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos skyong gis/ /yongs bskor mthong ba'i mod la rnam par grol/ /'jam gnyen phyag mthil bdag gi gtsug bkod nas/ /srid zhi'i 'jigs pa rnams las dbugs dbyung ste/ /'di phyi bar do kun tu phan bde yi/ /lam du 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bar/ /gsung ngag dbang bzhi'i chu bo chad med rgyun/ /blo gros bzang po'i bum par 'khyil ba'i gtam/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can yongs la khyab de bsngags/ /lhung lhung 'chi ba med pa bdud rtsi'i chab/ /lhod lhod tshangs bug nas 'bab mi 'jigs sbyin/ /yang yang rab rtsol tshe mtha' yas pa'i lha/ /mang (276bsgong nyi bu'i gnyen por mas pa bzhin/ /'phrin las kun bsgrub dpal chen phur pa'i lha/ /lha mchog dbyangs can rab khros dmag zor rgyal/ /rgyal chen 'dod dgu gter gyur rnam thos sras/ /sras btsun blon 'khor rnams kyis deng 'dir skyongs/ /gsang sngags rgyud sder 'byams klas don gnyis kun/ /lhun grub ched du blo brtson gru rdzings kyis/ /gtan mdun rgya mtshor bgrod 'dod lhag bsam gyis/ /bris thang bdun tshar 'bad pas bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /rdo rje'i slob dpon bskal brgyar zhabs brtan cing / /bdag sogs byang chen bar du mi 'bral bar/ /rjes bzung 'di phyi gtan mdun legs tsho gos kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin lhun gyisagrub par shog /ces dga' gdong sngags rams pa don 'grub rgya mtshos dpal mar me mdzad dang rgyal ba tsong kha pa la lam rim brgyud pas bskor ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs dang bcas pa'i bris thang bzhengs par rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa sarba mas lo/ /bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'chi med skyed tshal la/ /co 'dri'i gtor snod bcu bzhir zhos lhag —372

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenapa'i/ /dngul dkar las grub blo bzang bkra shis kyis/ /phul bas bsam don lhun gyis grub par shog /ces pa 'di'ang dge skos 'jog tu phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar ze hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /yid 'phrog 'ja' (277na〉zhi 'khrigs pa'i gur khyim nang / /sna tshogs pad 'dab bzhad pa'i ge sar rtser/ /nya gang zla dkyil steng na 'jo sgeg can/ /rje btsun brtan pa'i 'bor lor gsol ba 'debs/ /bcu drug lang tsho dar ba'i mtshams sprin mdangs/ /'dzum zhal tshems dkar phreng mdzes 'gror chags pa'i/ /dkyus ring spyan ldan gnag snum thor tshugs las/ /zur phud rnam lnga g.yo la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam gnyen chos 'khor phyag brgya'i sor mo yis/ /bzung ba'i ut+pal snyan thad gyes pa'i steng / /mi shes gcod pa'i ral gri spros bral don/ /gsal mdzad glegs bam 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro kun mtha' gnyis bsgral min mi bshig par/ /dam bcas rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gi bzhugs/ /rin cen rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' yis/ /'ja' tshon lta bur bkra la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal gyi mgur nas tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan pos/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshe skal ldan rnams/ /gnas lnga rig par blo gros rgyas mdzad pa/ /ngag gi dbang phyug stsol la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgrib gnyis g.ya' bral thugs kyi ā dar+shar/ /bden gnyis chos tshul gnas lugs yongs gzigs pas/ /'gro rnams 'dren la thabs mkhas thugs rje can/ khres bya thams cad mkhyen par gsol ba 'debs/ /dge tshogs bsgrub 'dun dpal 'byor rab rgyas des/ /mgon khyod lhar bsten snang brnyan bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /deng nas byang chub bar du rjes bzung ste/ /'khor (277ba 'das yon tan ma lus lhun grub shog /bka' pod chen po bzhi dang bcu yi grangs/ / gzhung lugs rgya mtshor rab tu 'byams klas par/ /blo gros yangs shing gsal ba'i 'dus sde'i gling / /ma pham dbusa'agyur byon min dar bar shog /'chad pa'i spobs pa dbyig g.yo lta bur mtho/ /rtsod dang chos kyi grags pa gzugs g.yin bzung / /rtsom la dpa' ba'i rjes 'gro mkhas mang gi /khrims ldan sde 'dir rtag tu gang gyur cig /bye brag mngon par rtogs pa rgyan rtsa 'grel/ /dbu ma'i rtsa ba de la 'jug pa'i —373

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gzhung / /mdo rtsa chos mngon mdzod bzhin yongs sbyangs pa/ /dpyod ldan mkhas mang dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog /mdor na rnam gsum 'khor lo'i bya ba kun/ /yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin du rab rgyas pas/ /blo bzang grags snyan 'bar ba'i bstan pa la/ /mdzes rgyan skye rgu'i bsod nams zhing 'gyur shog / ces spo 'bor chog thu chos rje dge 'dun dpal 'byor gyis mkhas mang blo gsal gling par mtshan yang dag par brjod pa gsung ba'i slad du dngul srang lnga bcu dang rjes su'ang sku bzheng pa'i thebs sbyar ba'i sku gtsang khang du bzhugs te gsol 'debs 'dzugs rgyu'i bskul ma dang / de la grwa tshang 'phel rgyas kyi smon lam yod pa zhig dgos tshul 'chad nyan mang thos legs pa don grub grwa dmangs dang bcas pas zur brgyan par brten/ za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ / nges gsang rdo rje'i shugs 'bar mtshon rnon po/ /gdengs (278na thas bdud las rnam par rab rgyal ba'i/ /snying po phan bde'i legs tshogos bshad sgrub kyis/ /bskal bar yongs spel rigasa'adzin gling chen por/ /bdun zhos lhag pa'i dngul srang nyer gsum rgyur/ /nyer grub bum bzang dbang chu kun mkhyen snod/ /phul bas srid 'dir tshe dpal dbang thang rgyas/ /ring min thar pa'i gring du bgrod par shog /'phyos pa gzims dpon blo bzang don grub kyis dngul bum phul ba'i kha byang za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa la:/ /dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi kha dog la/ /mtshan dpe'i snang ba rab bkra mthong bas don/ /kun grub bu ram shing pa'i zhal khyim dngos/ /jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku gzugs la/ /'jam gnyen reg bya'i yon tan khyad par rnams/ /legs tshang dge slong mchog gi spyad bya'i 'os/ /dras shing drubs sam lhan thabs sbyar ba yi/ /snam sbyar ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba'i dges/ /'jig rten 'di na phan bde ma lus tshogs/ /'byung gnas rnam 'dren bstan pa rab rgyas shing / /ngag dbang blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung srog gi ka ba tshugs gyur cig /lhag bsam dag pas ched du rgyu sbyor ba/ /sgra —374

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu spung glegs bam dang po/ zhenadabyangs mchod pa'i sprin phung spro ba yi/ /dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan tshe dpal dang / /'byor ldan dngos kun bla nas blar 'phel shog /skye bar nyi ma'i gnyen gyis rjes bzung nas/ /lha mi'i rten bzang rim brgyud thar pa yi/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i grong khyer du/(278ba)/'jug par thugs rje'i gter gyi bdag byin rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis lcags pho spre'u'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes gsum nas bcu'i bar ra sa 'phrul snang du brgya mchod dang / tshes brgyad kyi nyin jo bo rin po cher snam sbyar phul ba'i zhal byang 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /mthong bas don dang ldan pa nyi ma'i gnyen/ /dgung grangs brgyad lor slebs pa'i sku yi tshad/ /jo bo mi bskyod rdo rjer rung mthun gos/ /blo bzang yon tan dad pas phul ba'i dges/ /sangs rgyasabastan pa srid mthar rab rgyas shing / /de 'dzin rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i 'jig rten gsum gyi 'gro/ /rdzogs ldan dga' ston dpal la spyod par shog /bsod namasabyed po tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mi khom skyon bral rten bzang legs rnyed de/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /byang chub mchog gi khang par myur 'jug shog /ces lcags spre cho 'phrul mchod pa'i dus ra mo cher dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis mchode pa sna lnga brgya rtsa dang snam sbyar phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpon tshang dar mo ba'o/ /(279na)ma ji sto ṭa 1 lha/ ba shu kra :ka 'a phya gā ya sga ra gi 9 do khye sgro tā/'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug ngang mo dkar/ /mgrin pa'i 'o mtshor rtse 'jo'i rol gar gyis/ /lha kra lha ka rna ma mi me 〉 nyu tsu sha : lha pi 〉 bha ga bri ya mi to t+ta maḥblo gsal rna bar snyan 'jebs gdub sil sgra/ /'khrol bas skal bzang dga' ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /rgya chen gtsug lag tam bu ra yi rgyud/ /mtsho byung lus phra'i sor rtses nyer bskul glu /len par —375

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rnam dpyod 'jigs med go cha can/ /thub bstan lang tsho'i sde yi 'dra 'bag la/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khon ston rdo rje 'chang / /'chi med zil dngar ster byed tshe lha zung / /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon yi dam dang / /chos srung bram ze'i rnam rol gyis bskor 'di/ /dpal grong sngags rams ngag dbang dge legs kyis/ /drin can ma rgan phun tshogs phyag skor dang / /mchod pa'i rten du zla (259bcud ltar dkar ba/ /rnam dag bsam pas bskrun pa'i bsod nams 'bras/ /byed por gtogs rnams deng nas tshe rabs kun/ /bde skyid lha yi dpal la 'gran pa'i ngang / /ring min 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral nas/ /thar pa rin chen gling du bgrod nus shog /skye mang 'phreng bar yang dag ma nor lam/ /ston pa'i bshes gnyen mgon po khyod nyid kyis/ /nam yang 'bral ba med par rab mdzad de/ /srid zhi'i dge legs ci bsam lhun grub shog /bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gro ka shi spu'i/ /ngos su 'ja' mtshon ltar shar gyis mtshon te/ /slu med dkon cog rin cen rnam gsum gyi/ /thugs rje'i byin rlabs snying la 'jug par shog gru 'dzin ri bo'i spo nas pad dkar 'amang / /gangs can skye rgu'i mgon skyabs dpung gnyen du/ /gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor yongs kyi bdag po sa /legs byon srong btsan sgam po'i snang brnyan la/ /sprul pa'i dge slong sems nyid ngal gso dang / /'jig rten dbang phyug gnang ba gsal ba'i zhabs/ /chags med kun dga' yi dam bcu gcig zhal/ /bstan srung dung skyong dbang mos bskor ba 'di/ /dpal grong sngags rams ngag dbang dge legs kyis/ /sogs blo ka bzhi po sbyor ba 'og ma kun la 'gre/ /dge bsnyen tshul gyis dman cha blangs na yang / /don gyi sgo gsum bag yod btsun pa'i mchog /bgrang yas rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas che/ /bka' gdamasames po bshes gnyen 'brom ston la/ /phul byung rgyal po lha skyes dkon cog 'bangs/ /dad pa brtan dang rab brtan blo gros 'phel/ /khyi'u dga' 'dzin yi (280na rkom mi g.yo mgon/ /cho ge srung legasaldan lho nub pas bskor 'di/ /dpal grong sngags rams ngag dbang dge legs kyis/ /sgra tshad bzo ga sgomado rgyud rig pa'i gnas/ /kun gzigs gsal ba'i spyan stong rab bkra bas/ /mkhas mang nye —376

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanadabang gtsug 'gying 'chi med bdag /thams cad mkhyen nges dge 'dun grub pa la/ /blo bzang grags snyan btsun pa nor bu dang / /zla ba rin cen snying po pad+ma'i mtshan/ /'od zer yi dam yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zhabs/ /bstan srung 'dod khams dbang mos bskor ba 'di/ /dpal grong sngags rams ngag dbang dge legs kyis/ /snying la dbyangs can mdza' na mos 'khyud pas/ /bgrang yas shes bya smra bar spobs pa'i rtse/ /mthon por son pa dge ba'i dbang po'i mched/ /paṇa chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i sku gzugs mthar/ /mkhas grub nor bzang byams pa seng ge'i sgra/ /bde mchog lha yi rgyal po dge 'dun 'phel/ khro long kun rgyu yi dam 'khor lo sdom/ /chos srung gnod sbyin beg tses bskor ba 'di//dpal grong sngags rams ngag dbang dge legs kyis/ /thugs rje mthu dpung khab len rdo ba yis/ /rgya hor bod kyis lus can lcags phye kun/ /dbang med sdud mdzad bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhes/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sku yi 'dra 'bag la/ /dge 'dun bkra shis skyabs na gnya' khri btsan/ /tho ri snyan shal khri srong ral pa can/ /dge dpal yi dam rnal 'byor nam mkha' che/ /bstan srung sde dpon gur mgon gyis bskor 'di/ /dpal grong sngags rams ngag dbang dge legs kyis/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba'i 'phrin las sgo 'phar (280ba tha rgya/ /'byed la tshe ring gnam gyi rigs brgyud du/ /gting mtha' mi mngon yon tan rgya mtsho'i gter/ /bde chen chos kyi rgyal po dpal bzang po/ /blo bzang choms rgyal kha che dgon pa ba/ /sa chen g.yu brag nyang ral dge ba 'bum/ /pad+ma badz+ra yi dam dus kyi dgra/ /chos srung las kyi gshin rjes bskor ba 'di/ /dpal grong sngags rams ngag dbang dge legs kyis/ /zhes rtse dang dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis rang dang ma phun tshogs kyi ched du bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che gtso bor gyur pa'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs rin cen 'phreng mdzes nang bzhin la so so'i bla ma rnams rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa'i bris thang bdun tshar bzhengs par gzungs sug bris rab gnas me tog brgya rtsa dang bcas pa bgyis par kha byang smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam —377

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dbyangs grags pas byas pa bha ( / /'od gsal lha yi rmu thag las brgyud de/ /'khon ston grub brnyes sngags 'chang mang byon mthar/ /zur phud lnga ldan bla chen brtse ba che'i/ /chos srid ring lugs spel la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos 'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing / /thub bstan yongs 'dzin dbang por 7 byams pa'i thugs/ /legs skyes cho ge kyi rgyal mtshan bsgrengs mkhas pa/ /dpal ldan skal ba bzang por gsol ba 'debs/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi mi 'jigs seng khri'i steng / /mgon khyed bskal brgyar g.yung drung ltar bzhugs nas/ /zab rgyas 'khor lo gsum gyis 'gro (281na)ba rnams/ /mngon mtho nges legs sa la 'god byin rlobs/ /khyad par dbang bzhi'i chu bo chad med pa/ /dpal ldan chosaskyong thugs kyi nying khu yis/ /rin cen lta bu'i gdul bya 'phrang ring gsum/ /brgal nas zug 'jug grong du 'dren par shog /dgyes mdzad rdo rje mkha' spyod btsun mo che/ /rigs byed ma dang tshogasabadag 'dod pa'i rgyal/ /gur mgon stobs 'phrog dbang po las mkhan bcas/ /mkha' spyod rnam lngas dus kun bkra shis stsol/ /zhes dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdan sa 'og nas bdag chen 'jam dbyangs bsod nams bstan 'dzin dbang po byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs 'di ni rab 'byams rgyud sde rgya mtshor gzhan dring mi 'jog pa bco brgyad chosarje byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub kyi gsung gis bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis so/ /thugs rje bskul gsol lhun po bsgril ba yis/ /byin rlabs chu gter las thon 'chi med lpu/bdud rtsi srog rtsa rdo rje'i ngo bo sa /yid bzhin 'khor los tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra mdzod/ /lusang ga yid gsum thos bsam sgom pa la/ /dbang sgyur blo gsal bag chags bzang po'i mthus/ /gser mdog zhwa yi ring lugs rgya mtsho'i gos/ /pha mtha' mi 'gyur ched du zhabs brtan shog /sangs rgyas kun dngos rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /chos srid mnga' thang rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyi phreng / /nam yang yol med tshangs ris—378

smon lam shi brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhanayul sa cher/ /yongs 'degs (281ba tha dbang rdo rje ltar brtan shog /rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i mos rgyud bstan/ /bod dang bod chen kun tu rab 'phel zhing / /sde 'dir rnam gsum 'khor lo'i bya ba rnams/ /yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur rgyas byed shog /mchog dman bar pa'i gnya' bar khrims gnyis kyi//gser shing rnam par lci bas brgyad khri'i tshor/ /nyer spyod skye rgu'i bde skyid mngon sum du/ /mnga' 'bangs yongs kyis nyams su myong nus shog /myur mdzad mgon po dam can gshin rje'i rgyal/ /'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma la sogs/ /chos skyong srung mas ji ltar smon pa yi/ /'phrin las bsgrub la nam yang mi g.yel shog /dkon cog rin cen gsum gyi byin rlabs dang / /chos nyid 'gyur med chos can rgyu 'bras tshogs/ /rten 'byung bden pas rab smon re ba kun/ /legs skong bkra shis dga' ston rgyas par shog /ces se ra theg chen gling gi ha sdong mi tshan spyi tshogs nas nges rang dang sdo pa zung 'brel gyi ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /zho dos dman pa'i dngul kong nyer gsum gyi/ /srang ldan phan bde legs bshad gling pa la/ /ngag dbang mkhas btsun grwa skor dus phul mthus/ /'gro kun ma rig mun pa sel bar shog /cesapa'ang za hor bzhes sug bris byas pa shu lha/ /lha chos bdun ldan bka' gdams rin po che'i/ /mes po gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇ+ḍita/ /dge tsho gos la 'dun mkhas grub dam pa yi/ /rnam 'phrul (282na)mu tig 'phreng ltar rab spel mthus/ /thub dbang bstan pa'i grib tu nyer bsil bar/ /lus can thams cad bde bar ngal gso zhing / /rtsa ba'i bla ma rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /'gyur med g.yung drung ngo bor rtag bzhugs shog /bsod nams sa bon mtha' klas sems can tshogs/ /byang chub snye ma g.yur za'i rgyur 'gyur zhing / /blo bzang chos skyong dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /tshe rabs kun tu mi 'bral rjes 'dzin shog /chesacher snyigs ma'i smag tu du skaba'i mal/ /dug gsum gos kyis gtums pa'i sems can rnams/ /ma —379

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rig gnyid slong thugs rje chen po'i rnga/ /'jig rten kun khyab brdung mdzad bde gshegs kyis/ /brgyad brgya'i sman mdo dpal gyi mgur pa nas/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis legs gsung shwakya'i rgyal//mthong thos dran pas rnam par grol ba'i sku/ /lhag bsam dag pas ched du bskrun mthu yis/ khyu sbyor 'khor ba chu srin 'byung gnas las/ /nyer drangs gtan gyi bde skyid rin cen gling / /srid zhi'i 'dod pa 'jo ba dbang gi rgyal/ /gtsug tor rtse mor rtag tu 'ching bar shog / gyen thur spyan gyis gzigasapa mi yo bas/ /bdud rigs 'byung po phye mar 'thag pa'i lha/ /slu med gtan gyi mgon po bcom ldan 'das/ /khro rgyal ma lus 'dus pa'i bdag nyid la/ /bde gshegs thams cad tshang ba shākya'i rgyal/ /byang sems yod do cog 'dus spyan ras gzigs/ /lha mo'i rigs 'dus 'phags ma sgrol ma yis/ /rab bskor mig gi bdud rtsir spel ba'i dges/ /a ti sha dang 'brom ston sku mched gsum/ /glang shar (282ba)rim brgyud jo bo bka' gdams pa'i/ /bstan la tshe rabs kun tu legs bzhugs nas/ /rnam thar gtsang ma'i bka' brgyud 'dzin par shog /ces gnyal pa blo bzang chos skyong gis gong gsal bris thang gsum bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig brtan bzhugs smon lam dang bcas pa dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pas bgyis pa dza / / /gsal gsal 'dren byed bgrad nas nyer blta zhing / /lhang lhang snyan pa'i sgra yis gsol 'debs na/ /yang yang thugs rje'i 'jug pa 'bad med du/ /lhug lhug stsol ba bde gshegs sman pa'i rgyal/ /rgyal sras bla brgyud srung ma 'khor gyi tshogs/ /tshogs chen rdzogs phyir spel bas mgon pos sngon/ /sngon nas rab btab smon lam lhun grub skal/ /skal bzang bdag sogs 'gro la 'byor bar shog /dam pa'i chos kyi grags pa rgya mtsho'i dbyangs/ /dbyangs bdun nyer rdzogs klu yi khengs 'phrog gang / /gang zhig gdul bya'i rna bar 'jebs mkhas mchogo /mchog gsum dngos zhabs seng khrir bkod pa'i 'khor/ /'khor gtso byang sems gnod sbyin gyis mtshone kun/ /kun nas rnam par rab bkra lus can tshogs/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas bla med ye shes lam/ /lam ring myur du bgrod —380

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedapa'i mthu ldan shog /kha dog gser bzang bzang po dri med kyis/ /mtshon min rab mdzes mdzes sku mtshan dpe'i dpal/ /rin cen snang 'od 'od kyis lus can kun/ /khyab mdzad rnam 'dren 'dren mchog gzugs kyi sku/ /sku brnyan lta bas mi ngoms bkrag mdangs gzi/ /gzi brjid phung por zham ring sna (283na stags mtha'/ /mtha' med 'khor ba sgrol ba'i sa mkhan khyod/ /khyod kyi yon tan bdag la 'jug par shog /skal bzang rnam 'dren rnam pa thams cad mkhyen/ /don gnyis kun grub kun la ris med brtse/ 'i kya'i dbang po dbang phyug brgyad ldan pa/ /'o skol ston pa ston tshab slu med la/ /mang mang chad med chos 'di'i brgyud pa'i 'phreng / /'jam 'jam ches dul byang chub sems pa dang / /'jigs 'jigs srung mas bskor ba bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /dung dung bsams pa thams cad 'grub par shog /lag na pad dkar 'chang ba'i sprul pa'i 'phreng / /'phreng ba chad med yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes/ /rjes 'jug tsam la sgro btags mching bu'i zong / /zong bcas dbang gzhu lta bur rab bris 'di/ /'di phyi'i don kun 'grub pa mdun ma'i rtse/ /rtse mor son 'dod rnam dag bsam pa'i zla//zla rgyas ston mtshan shar tshe 'khor mtha'i tshad/ /tshad du gzhal sla ring min thar grong rnyed/ /rnyed 'dod brtson pas 'dir snang tshe dpal dang / /dang po'i sangs rgyas thob nas da can kun/ /kun mkhyen sar 'god smon lam 'grub pa'i dpang / /dpang gyur rgyal sras slob mas mdzad par shog /ces glang ra ba ngag dbang dpal bzang gis gtso bo bde gshegs bzhi la sman bla'i mdo chog gi bla brgyud dang mdo nas bshad pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs 'gro la rjes brtse ma sor gnas dang bcas pa'i rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal (283ba)grong sngags rams pas bgyis pa shrībha wastu/ /rang rgyud gnyis 'thung lang tsho tshes dar gom/ /mtha' med 'khor khrod nags su rgyu ba'i snar/ /bag yod lcags kyu btab nas dul byed pa/ /bstan pa'i rtsa ba so thar las gzhan ci/ /khyim par rab —381

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)byung bsgrub bya rigs brgyad kyi/ /yang rtse tshangs par spyod pa dpal gyi mchog /dge slong la 'os snam sbyar glegs bu sa /sbyar 'di chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba bzhin/ /rgya hor bzang gos sna tsho gis phyi nang gi /ri zla'i grangs ldan phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /legs bshad gling du rab 'phul bsod nams mtha'/ /snyeg par ga thi byung yang ma zin ngal/ /ched du yongs bskrun gos bu skye ba 'dis/ /nyer mtshon yang srid phyi ma thams cad kun/ /lha mi'i rten du sim pa'i tshor ba la/ /rtag tu legs spyod dga' ston myong bar shog /sangs rgyas bstan dang mjal zhing der 'jug cing / /khyad par theg mchog nges gsang smin grol gyi/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa chen mor/ /bgrod nas 'gro ba'i ded dpon byed nus shog /ces la4sa
