dpon gram pa blo bzang ngag dbang / gong dkar ba blo bzang dpal 'byor/ 'phyongs rgyas pa ngag dbang nam mkha' gsum gyis phan bde legs bshad gling gi dkon gnyer rtsis sprod byas pa' mjug tu ring mtsho'i rten byung gi thog grwa tshang la spyi 'bul snam sbyar ma gos dmar 'jam sang / dra lcags gan 'jus sangs rgyas stong sku thags grub can mtha' 'jag ta shun/ yang gos dmar 'jam dra lcags hor jus gzhi lu/ yang gos dmar zhe mi 'gre dra gan thus gzhi dmar lcags ra yas mas gan jus (284na)ma ṇi ma gag langs rag jus/ yang ma gos dmar dra lcags gos skyer rgyas byas pa dgu/ gos skyer gyi gcig /byang dar za shun la dra lcags gos skyer gyisabyas pa bzhi rnams phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa sarba maṅga lo bha ( / /ljon dmar las grub ka tho ra/ /che legs zung ldan phul ba'i dges/ /mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'dzad med ltar/ /bsod nams phung po ches 'bar shog /ces lcags spre snam sbyar bcu bdun dang lhan du phul ba'i tshe za hor bzhes bkod pa dge /ngag dbang blo bzang grags pa'i ring lugs mchog /dzā ti'i me tog bkra nas rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /spel bar 'jigs med snying stobs go cha can/ /thub bstan lang mtsho'i sdel gsol ba —382

smon la mo shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhena'adebs/ /'jam gnyen ut+pal rtse mor sher phyin gyi/ /glegs bam chos kun gnad lugs dbyangasabadun sgra/ /dga' bas 'grin pa'i dbus 'brol ma 'dris 'gro'i/ /mdza' bshes dpung gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /tshangs sras lha mo'i snying dbus 'jo sgeg gi /rnam dpyod sor mos lnga rig rgyud mangs glur/ /len la 'dzum ba 'ad spobs ba'i rtser son pa/ /rdo rje'i khri la bskal par brtan par shog /mi rig gnyid mun mthar sangs lugs brgya yi/ /gtsug lag yongs la blo gros rab rgyasapa/ /mkha' ltar rgya che mtsho bzhin gting zab 'phangs/ /nor (284ba)'dzin kun khyab skyong khyod zhabs brtan shog /zhwa ser cod can 'chang ba'i chos 'di bstan/ /gyen 'degs gnam sa'i dbang phyug sku tshe dang / /mnga' thang chab srid rab 'phel khrims gnyis kyi/ /gser shing gnya' bar rtag tu lci bar shog /e dbyibs rig pa'i 'byung gnas lte ba mā /bkra shis ri sgo steng gi cho me kyi sde/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba bskal mtha'i bar/ /yar ngo'i zla ba ji bzhin 'phel bar shog /smon lam 'di ched bsgrub par ga rta gos so cog /rdzogs ldan skye rgu dang mtshudas deng nas bzung / /skye bar bde skyid la spyod ring min du/ /bla med ye shes mngon du 'gyur bar shog /bstan srung bye ba'i sde dpon myur mdzad mgon/ /'jam dpal bka' nyan las gshin ma he'i zhal/ /'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo yis/ /bsams don lhun gyis khrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /slu med skyabs kyi dam pa dkon cog gsum/ /lha dang rigs 'dzin drang srong bden tshig la/ /dbang sgyur rnams kyi deng smon re 'dod tshogs/ /'jo ba'i bkra shis dpal gyis khyab par shog /ces nged rang gi gsol 'debs sde pa dang thun mong du ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bstan pa spyi sgos rgyas pa'i smon lam tshig su bcad pa 'di ni e ri sgo chos sde'i dbu mdzad dge 'dun rab brtan gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa bsam mthong pa ngag rig pa'i lo tsā ba phun tshogs dbang pos bgyis pa dza / / /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /snying dbus pad zlar tshe dpag med mgon —383

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)(285na〉skur/ /gsal bas skye 'dir bdag rgyud byin rlabs cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du 'dren par 31ga /ces pa'ang bā mkhan dge slong gi ngor bris/ /sgrub brgyud ut+pal ma rnyings gsar pa'i 'phreng / /tshad med skal ldan legs bris thod bcings mthar/ /sprul sku'i snang brnyan zla ba yongs tshes pa/ /gdul bya'i ku mud bzhad phyir myur 'char shog /ngag dbang dbyangs can rab dgyes snyan grags can/ /ring min bzang po'i bag chags yongs sad de/ /dwags rgyud gser sgong rdol lasarig byed bzhi'i/ /zhal sgo mngon sum myur du ston par shog /'phags yul rtsa bshad snyan grags bzang po'i gzugs/ /bod yul me long ngos shar skal ngan 'gro'i/ /rdul dang mun pas bsgribs pa ring min du/ /bsal nas gdung sems ngal dub mthar byed shog /mnyam med lha rje'i gdung tshab phag gru pa'i/ /thugs sras gling chen rtogs pa mtho ris chab/ /slar yang 'brug bstan rgya mtshor 'dren mkhas de/ /skal ldan shing rta'i mched por deng 'byon shog /'dod pa bsod nyams mtha' brten cog bu'i gra/ /stong chen phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor dge sbyong tshul/ /rab 'dzin slob mar bcas pa'i dpal mgon du/ /dngos byon yid kyi re ba yongs skong shog /don rgyud rtogs pa'i bdag nyid rnam 'dren tshogs/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i sdod pon he ru gaḥ / phyi nang gsang ba'i mgon po bya rog mtshan/ /bla ma yi dam srung mas las bsgrub shog /dkon cog thugs rje'i 'jug pa rgyun chad med/ /lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin tshig la dbang / /rten cing 'brel (285ba thar 'byung ba'i bden stobs mthus/ /bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces mnyam med 'brug pa rin po che'i bstan 'dzin mang thos gnas lnga rig pa cog gra sprul sku ngag dbang snyan grags bzang po'i sku skye myur gsal du 'byon pa'i smon lam ngag don du byas chog pa dgos tshul gra rigs rnams kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /gang shar rang grol rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon tshe bdag nag /'dod pa khams la mnga' sgyur re ma ti/ /dpa' ldan rtsa ba gsum la gsol ja mchod skabs la mchod par —384

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenatso la zhes skur/ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang 'jam dgon grub pa'i blo gros can/ /skal bzang rgya mtsho'i re skong 'khor lo'i mgon/ /che mchog 'dus pa bla med rdo rje'i rtsal/ /skyabs gsum kun gyi ngo ma rdzo par 'bul zhes 'gyur bor brtan 'gyur cig /legs ldan nag po srid gsum dbang mos gtsos/ /bstan dang zab gter skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs/ /dpal mgon bdun cu la sogs dkar phyogs lha/ /mthu stobs nus ldan rnams la gong par tshol zhes bsgyur pas bsam don 'grub byin rlobs/ /grangs med lus sprul yan lag lnga phyag 'tshal/ /nam mkha'i mdzod phye kun bzang mchod sprin spro/ /sgrib gsum des bsags nyes tsho gos mtha' dag bshags/ /mtha' klas rnam dkar las la snying nas rangs/ /rgyal sras slob mar chos ston mdzad par bskul/ /gzugs sku srid mthar mngon sum bzhugs gsol (286na 'debs/ /'dis mtshon byas so cog gi bsod nams 'bras/ /bdag gzhan sangs rgyasamyur thob rgyu ru bsngo/ /dga' bzhi'i 'gros kyis zag med bde ldan grong / /nges gsang rig sngagasa'achang ba 'i 'dus pa gling / /shin thos 'dul khrims bag yod bskyed rdzogs dang / /rdzogs chen lha sngags ye shes la rol 3|ga /srid zhi yongs kyi legs tshogis ma lus pas/ /sde 'di rab gang yid la bsams pa'i don/ /yongs 'du'i snye ma char du babs pa'i ro/ /spyod par legs bris mched por bdag 'gyur shog /rtsa gsum gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs/ ja mchod gang la'ang bsgyur chog pa bdun rnam dag dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes dga' ldan gsang sngags gling gi dbu mdzad sngags rams pa ngag dbang nam mkha' dang / blo bzang mkhas btsun gyis ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigasapa'i tshe grwa tshang du 'dzugs rgyur bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /zhi khro kun 'dus bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha/ /rang byung lus kyi rtsa khams thig le la / /gdod nas dag pa'i ye shes ras dkar ngos / /chu nang zla gsum lta bur yongs shar dges/ /deng nas rang rig dpal ldan kun tu bzang / /rang ngo 'phrod min de srid rtsa gsum gyis/ /rjes su bzung —383—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ste 'di phyi bar do sa /dngos grub char chen ma lus dbab tu gsol/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rang sems ngo bor rtogs/ /yi dam zhi khro rig pa'i rtsal du rdzogs/ /dam can rang shar las grub rang sar grol/ /snang grag (286ba)rig gsum chos sku'i klong grol shog ྅sa pa'ang blo bzang don yod kyis bka' brgyad kyi thos thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /phyag na pad+ma'i ye shes gcig pu'i zla/ /gdul bya'i dngas mtshor shar tshad tshur mthong blos//zhal dkar ji tsam spobs pa'i mig 'phrul gar/ /mkha' la 'ja' ltar 'dren byed gzigs mo'i dpyid/ /nyer brgyad rgyu skar phreng du mjug ring bzhi/ /bdag 'dra bsgrig 'os min kyang dad shugasakyis/ /byin rlabs phug ron skye bo'i rkang rjes zhe ne/ /'char ltar rgyu myos rten byung gang gis bslu/ /de phyir gra nang phun tshogs dge ba'i gling / /mtho ris skyed tshal 'phos 'dra'i yul gru nas/ /dkar nag rtsis rig tshul la mig yangs pa/ /bla mkhyen sngags long lhun grub kyis bzhedas mthus/ /bskal par 'tsho ba'i tshe ring rnam thos bu'i/ /'byor par nyer 'gran bde skyid 'di snang dang / /yang srid kun tu myong ba bsod nams kyi/ /phung po tshangs pa'i yul sar 'phyur bar shog /'khor bar ma chags myang 'das khang bzang du/ /'jug byed tsho gis gnyis them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /ring min 'gro rnams srid mtsho las sgrol ba'i/ /kun mkhyen ded dpon thob par bdag byin rlobs/ /zhes gra nang nas rtsis rig smra ba sngags 'chang 'phrin las dbang drag bdud 'joms kyis 'gro la rjes brtse ma dang mthun pa'i bris tha dza bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /(287na)lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan a ti shā /bka' gdams mes po 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal//yab sras zung dang las smon 'brel tsam gyi/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod ji snyed pas/ /nyer mtshon mchod pa'i sprin phung mtha' yas gang / /—386

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zheda'aphags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam sprul las/ /byung ba ji bzhin dngos bshams yid sprul mchod/ /nyon mongs shes bya bag la nyal sgrib kyis/ /skubs po'i mun par 'thoms pas bla dor la/ /cher rmongs mi dge'i las ngan ci bsags pa/ /gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang bas snying nas bshags/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas nas bzung ste sa gu tsi/ /yan gyis bsgrubs pa'i chos dkar phung po'i tshad/ /rang gis bskrun pa ji bzhin spro dga' dang / /bcas te bsam pa thag pas rjes yi rang / /tshangs dbang gnyis kyis shākya seng ge la/ /gsol btab dang mtshungs rnam 'dren sras slob tshogs/ /kun gyi 'gro blor 'tsham pa'i dam chos kyi/ /'khor lo ho pa med par bskor bar bskul/ /ngag dbang blo ldan skal bzang rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /bdag sogs 'gro ngor na rga skye 'chi las/ /rnam grol theg gsum 'phags pa'i ngo bo sa /mos ldan srid pa ji srid g.yo med gsol/ /pha mtha' mi sngon 'khor bar 'khyams pa nas/ /da lta'i bar bsags slad nas gsog 'gyur gyi/ /legs byas phung por spungs te bsgrubs pa'i 'bras/ /mkha' mnyam ma rgan sems can don du bsngo/ /thub pas rlabs chen bya (287brkoka' tsho gos mtha' klas/ /bskrun pa'i dbang po sa yi lha mo yis/ /khas blangs na ma yang slu med bden pa'i mthus/ /lung rtogs bstan pa yun ring 'bar cig /gri gug dmar nag dkar po brgyad cu dang / /phyed dkar jo bo la sogs bka' gdams kyi/ /bstan pa rin cen skyong mdzad chosasrung gis/ /bsams don lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces yan lag bdun pa'i nang du dmigs gsal gyi phyag 'tshal dang brtan bzhugs slo ka gcig la bstan 'bar ma tshang ba/ chos skyong la gnyer gtad dang bcas pa 'di ni rwa bsgreng dbu mdzad rgyal mtshan bkra shis kyis rang gi kha ton dang tshogs su 'dzugs rgyur 'god tshul bzhin za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /nyon mongs kyis brlams zhe sdang gdug rtsub me/ /ris med byams pa'i chu yis rab bcil ba/ /ma pham mgon po'i snang bas nyer mthong mod/ /mi bzad 'khor ba'i pha mtha' thung ngur byas/ /—387

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rgyal kun ngo bo pad+ma ka ra sogs/ /bla ma yid dam 'dod lhas yongs bskor 'di/ /bris pa blo bzang tshe 'phel gyis bskrun pa'i/ /yon sbyar bsod nams ga sgo'i rgyun ltar ring / /dge bas sbyin pa'i bdag po bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'dir snang mkha' yi dgung nas shar/ /phyi mar lha mi'i yang srid rab brgyud mthar//nges par legs pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes kyi 'dra 'bag la/ /jo 'brom yab sras tshe dpag med mgon sku/ /brgya phrag gis bskor ri mo pad dkar gyis/ /sgyu ma'i khengs 'phrog (288na jid du sor rtses bskrun/ /thugs rje'i nyi ma'i 'od kyis rab sangs nas/ /rdo rje'i srog gi ka ba g.yung drung gi /ngo bor lhun grub 'gyur ba med par shog /nying mtshams sbyar tshe bde ba can zhing du/ /mgon khyod spyan sngar skyes te theg mchog chos/ /thos ba yi sgom pas rang rgyud legs grol nas/ /gzhan don rlabs chen spyad pa spyod par shog /ces sgyid thang nor bu byams pa dang tshe dpag med kyi bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /nor bu chu shel ltar dngas dkar mdzes sku/ /rab gsal mkhyen brtse'i spyan bdun dkyus ring ma/ /dus gsum rgyal mtshon ut+pal grib bsil du/ /nyi bu'i gdung skyob yid bzhin 'khor lo kye/ /thugs rje bdud rtsi tshangs bug nang brgyud de/ /lusang ga yid khyab srog rtsa rdo rje'i khams/ /bzhu blugs gzhom du med pa'i g.yung drung gi /ngo bor brlab pa'i nus pa deng bskyed mdzod/ /tshangs sras lta mo mgrin dbus 'jo sgeg ma/ /'jam dbyangs gzhen nu dga' bas nyer 'byud pa/ /gnas lnga rig pa smra ba dge ba'i bshes/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rtag tu rgyas par shog /ma rig gnyid sangs gtsug lag gzung ldan ma/ /rnam dpyod 'jug pa rgyas pa'i khrims gnyis kyi/ /'khor lo rgya mtsho'i gos can kun khyab pa/ /sa dbang sku tshe chab srid 'phel brtan shog /rgyal yum 'phags ma'i sku dbyibs gnas chen du/ /dga' (288ba/rdon ring lugs gsang ba sngags kyi sde/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i yang rtser rab son pa/ /lus can bsod nams zhing du dar bar shog /pad+ma saṃ bha srong btsan —388

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanasgam po'i zhabs/ /jo 'byom la sogs snga phyi bar gsum du/ /rim byon dngos brgyud bla ma'i bka' srung gis/ /bsam pa'i re ba skong ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces nged rang dang sdeb thun mong gi ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad cig dgos che sko/mer pa dga' ldan gsang sngags gling pa'i bla gnyer grwa dmangs spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /ljon shing phur ma'i snying po skyems kyi mchog /dpal ldan 'bras spungs 'dus tshogs mchod yon du/ /sbreng snod dngul rgyan bum gzugs grangs tshang ba/ /legs phul bsod nams nam mkha'i mtha' klas pas/ /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par rgya bod hor/ /'gro rnams bde zhing kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs rab rgyas de 'dzin ngag gi dbang / /blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabasabartan shog /dga' ldan bstan pa 'dzin pa'i sbyin bdag che/ /gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor dbang phyug bo shog thu/ /rgyal po'i sku tshe rab brtan stobs 'byor rnams/ /yar ngo'i zla ba ltar bur 'phel bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang o rod kyi yangs pa'i sa chen por mnga' sgyur ba'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag dga' ldan bo shog thu khang gis chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs su dngul rgyan bcu dgu phul ba'i tshe gser yig tshogs gsog da rgan (289na)rab 'byams pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam grags pa'o/ /'chi med mchog stsol bcom ldan gar gyi dbang / /'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe sbyin ma/ /thub pas rab sngags rnam par rgyal ma yis/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis srog gi ka ba tshugs/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /bstan pa rin cen rgya mtsho'i gos can gzhir/ /yongs khyab bla nas blar spel gnam sa'i bdag /sku tshe g.yung drung bzhin du 'gyur med shog /'jam mgon sa spyod khri srong lde btsan gyi/ /lha sras mu khri btsan po'i rnam 'phrul du/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i zhal lung gis zin pa'i/ /mi dbang rdo rje lta bur zhabs brtan shog /gang gi bka' khrims gser gyi gnya' shing gis/ /'jig rten gsum gyi gnya' bar yongs lci bas/ /mnga' 'bangs kun bde chab srid —389

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)stobs 'byor rnams/ /gser gyi 'khor los sgyur rgyal rjes 'gror shog /lho rgyud yangs pa'i gser ldan lto ba sa /zhwa ser 'chang ba'i lugs gnyis bstan pa yi/ /nyin byed legs byas dgung nas rab shar bas/ /yid srubs mun zhi phan bde'i snang rgyas shog /myur mdzad mgon po las kyi gshin rje'i rgyal/ /'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo sogs/ /dam can cho ge srung rgya mtsho'i tshogasarnams kyis/ /bsams don lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dkon cog bden pa'i mthu dpung bsam yas shing /(289ba)khyu 'bras rten 'byung nam yang bslu ba med/ /lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin tshogs rnams kyis/ /bkra shis dpal gyi zla ba yar rgyas shog /ces bden tshig gi shis pa brjod pa 'di'ang me rag bla ma blo gros rgya mtshos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang pos bgyis pa dza ( / / sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /sgra bsgyur dbang po be+e ro tsa na'i zhabs/ /zab gter bstan pa rgyal mdzad rdo rje gling / /bla ma yi dam chos srung byin rlabs mthus/ /za hor gdung 'dzin che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/ /gdong lngas nyer bteg rdo rje'i khri chen por/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor rab bzhugs nas/ /'gro ba'i legs byas 'bras bzang dud par shog /bod skyong sa spyod khrimasakyi nya phyis khog /yangs por mnga' 'bangs bde skyid la spyod cing / /chab srid sku tshe stobs 'byor 'chi med gtso/ /mchod sbyin brgya pa'i dpal la 'gran nus shog /nges gsang bka' gter ring lugs ma lus dang / /khyad par 'jam dpal chos kyi bshes gnyen gyi/ /smin grol lung dang man ngag dbyar dus kyi/ /zla ba'i ma ma ji bzhin gyen 'phyur shog /lung bstan zhal 'tshes ji bzhin dam pa khyod/ /dus babs skye rgu'i gnyen gyur gter bdag gling / /rang skal zab chos ma lus gegs med du/ /legs bzhes snod ldan re ba yongs skong shog /pad 'byung be+e ro'i smon lam mthu btsan pos/ /bur rgyal bod dang bod chen 'dzin ma'i gzhin/ /'khor ba'i 'gro rnams rdzogs ldan skye rgu yi/ /(290na)tshe dpal 'byor pa dang mtshungs thob par shog /gdod nas rnam dag che mchog he ru ga: /gnyis med —390

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad ba rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedam ning nag por yongs shar ba/ /chos dang gter skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bsams pa lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa 'di'ang 'brom gyi sngags 'chang rdo rje dbang grags rgya mtshos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /bgrang yas rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i chu gter las/ /'jam mgon nyin byed dmar ser li khri'i gos/ /legs bsgyur 'gro ba'i mun sel myong kha pa/ /zla med gtan gyi skyabs der gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi chos srid bstan pa rgya hor dang / /bod dang bod chen 'dzin mar spel ba la/ /snying stobs lang tsho dar babs ngag gi dbang / /blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i bsod nams bye ba'i zhing / /dge legs snye ma'i 'bras bu g.yur za'i ched//mgon khyod tshe dpag med pa'i ngo bo sa /rab bzhugs phun tsho gos 'jig rten gsum khyab shog /ces pa 'di'ang a chi thu chos rje'i gra rigs rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i spyan gyis 'gro ba'i khams/ /nyer gzigs legs gsungs dam chos de don rnams/ /rab 'dzin skye 'phags dge 'dun bcas pa yi/ /slu med thugs rje rten cing 'brel 'byung mthus/ /a chi thur grags chos/rjes thog (290ba〉ped nas/ /bsags pa'i dge tsho gis mthu las dal ba'i rten/ /legs thob grwa rigs sbyin bdag tshogs rnams kyis/ /mngon sum nges rnyed 'dod don 'grub byin rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang a chi thu chos rje'i grwa rigs rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o /ma rig mun sel sgron me sbar snod kong / /nyer gsum srang ldan ngag dbang grags pa yis /phan bde'i legs bshad gling par phul ba'i dges/ /skye ba kun tu skyid pa'i dpal 'bar lha/ga /ces pa'ang rtses thang du sngags rams pa byed skabs dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /snyan brjid sgra dbyangs 'khrol ba'i stod kyi rgyan/ /za 'og rnam par bkra ba'i gos bzang la/ /—391 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)so gnyis mdzes pa'i dar dpyangs lhab lhub can/ /'ja' tshon lta bu'i 'dren byed bdud rtsi gang / /ga smi ra pa'i paṇa chen bsod snyoms pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin stan gcig tsha mig khrims ldan sder/ /phul bas bdag sogs mkha' mnyam lus can kun/ /ring min rnam pa thams cad mkhyen thob shog /ces pa'ang ngag dbang grags pa chos gra chen po rtses dang du sngags rams pa byed skabs phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang dbang po'i/ /rgyal gzhan las lhag mi zad thugs rje'i dpung / /ches 'bar sman gyi bla ma mngon par mkhyen//chos grags mya ngan med dpal gser bzang po/ /rin zla mtshan legs bdun gyis 'gro 'di skyongs/ /rnam dag (291na/sems bskyed dag pa'i smon lam mdo/ /dpal gyi mgur nas nyer gsung thugs dbang gi /slu med bka' yi don bzhin 'jig rten gsum/ /bde legs sgo 'phar brgya phrag 'byed par shog /rnam 'dren mched brgyad byang sems gnod sbyin sogs/ /pho brang chen po'i khor yug mdzes brjid pas/ /snyigs mar cher spyod skye rgu mtha' klas pa'i/ /mgon skyabs gnyen dang gling du mthu dpung skyed/ /lus ngag yid gsum dran shes lcags kyu'i dbang / /bye blo ldan thos bsam gom 'gros kyis/ /skal bzang sha snyi ka yi nags rgyu ba'i/ /gzhan phan rgya mtsho'i khar 'khyer zhabs brtan shog /bde skyid nor 'dzin snying stobs rus sbal gyis/ /'degs la 'jigs med 'jug pa bcu ldan go /bco lnga'i zla ltar cha rdzogs thub pa'i bstan/ /'phrul chen lang tsho'i sde gang zhabs brtab shog /rnam 'dren yongs kyi mkhyen brtse nus tshogs kun/ /bshes gnyen gzugs shar rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa ris med skye rgu yi/ /bsod nams bye ba'i zhing du dar bar shog/dga' ba brgya pa'i dpal ldan pho brang che/ /gnam sa'i dbang phyug sku tshe mnga' thang rgyas/ /chos srid khrims gnyis gser gyi 'khor lo yis/ /gling bzhi'i khyon la mngon par sgyur bar shog /mgon med zas sbyin kun dga' ra ba dngos/ /gangs can sar 'phos rgyal byed tshal gnyis par/ /'dus pa'i tshogs 'phel 'khor lo rnam pa gsum/ /srid mtha'i bar du bla nas blar rgyas shog /be+e ḍūrla —392

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhen(291bcud mched bdun mchod chog rgyun/ /nyer 'dzugs dngos grub rgya mtsho gnyen mdun dang / /rtsa lag bcas pa'i 'di phyi bar gsum gyi/ /'dod yon ma lus lhun gyis grub par shog /rdul bral ston zla lta bur rab dkar ba/ /rnam dag bsam pas legs btab smon lam 'bras/ /yongs smin 'phrin las gnod sbyin ded dpon dang / /stobs chen rgyal po sde bzhis spel bar mdzod/ /lan cig min pa srid pa'i 'khor yug tu/ /drin gyis nyer bskyangs nam mkha'i mthas gtugs 'gro /ma 'jigs bzhi ldan mngon du 'gyur ba'i rgyur/ /dus gsum rab bsags bsod nams thams cad bsngo/ /zhes snye mo rgyal byed tshal gyi chos sder sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal 'di ga'i ring 'tshor dmigs nas btsugs pa'i sman bla'i dkyil 'khor/ tsakli/ sman mdo brgyad rgya pa stegs bcas/gos bzang las grub pa'i gdugs gcig rgyal mtshan bzhi dang / gser 'bru lnga/ 'phan chung brgyad/stegs bu/ mdo chog tshar brgyad/ 'dzugs ston lha mchod mi mchod kyi bsnyen bkur nyin gcig dang rgyun 'jags su bogs mkhar ru'i khal nyi shu re rnams a gling chos mdzad dngos grub rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i tshe ring 'tsho'i smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /lha gcig srong btsan thabs mchog bde chen dang / /mnyam sbyor mong bza' khri lcam shes rab yum/ /zung 'jug thugs dam lha khang 'phags pa'i sku/ /brag dbyibs yer pa ra sa'i gong pa'i tshul/(292na)/sangs rgyas kun dngos pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan jo bo yab sras dang / /ku ma ra dza klong chen rab 'byams sogs/ /skyes mchog mang pos byin brlabs ngo mtshar gnas/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i ga smyo lar/ /dus bzang rtsa gsum mchod pa'i rgyun 'dzin pa/ /lha ldan bya 'dabs tshes bcu shar ma ba/ /spyi bsdus gan gos 'phan mang phul ba'i dges/ /ring por 'tsho zhing dpal 'byor longs spyod rgyas/ /pho rigs bu brgyud gnod sbyin ngal bsos po'i/ /sras kyi rjes 'gror 'phel sogs bsams pa'i don/ /re ba ji bzhin lhun gyis grub byin rlobs/ /'di nas nying mtshams 393

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)sbyar tshe rnga yab kyi/ /gling dbus zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang du/ /pad 'byung 'khor du skyes te rdzogs pa ches/ /rnam grol rang rig kun bzang ngo 'phrod shog /lcags spre sprel zla'i yer pa tshesabacu'i skabs lha sa tshes bcu shar ma ba rnams kyis gos 'phan du ma phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /chos sku snang mtha' rig rtsal ma 'gags gdangs/ /longs skur spyan ras gzigs dbang 'ja' klong las/ /sprul sku pad 'byung 'od zer 'gro kun la/ /yongs khyab sku gsum dbyer med brtse ba can/ /mgon po thugs rje bskul ba'i bzlas brjod dbyangs/ /rtse gcig dad pa'i rgyud las nyer drangs glu /rab stims zhi khro'i lha tsho gos ma lus pa/ /dgyes bskyed kun bzang mchod sprin yongs sprosamathus/ /ris med rgyud lnga'i (292ba thams can yod do cog /mngon mtho nges legs sar 'khrid shing rta che/ /thub bstan ma la ya ljon dar ba'i dris/ /'gro rnams snying la sim pa'i reg byar shog /phyan na pad+mas ched du 'dul zhing dngos/ /bod dang bod r+sā bshad dang sgrub pa'i sde/ /nor 'dzin skyong ba'i dbang phyug 'bangs bcas la/ /gnod byed nyer 'tshe ma lus bzlog tu gsol/ /'brum nag stod tshad rgyu gzer bshal rims yams/ /sad ser btsa' than dbul phongs mtshang 'dru dang / /'thab rtsod 'brug long rtsod ldan dus༅ gyi/ /ho pa ma lus bzlog cing bsgyur du gsol/ /khyad par pur rgyal bstan dang rje 'bangs la/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i stod smad hor/ /rgya gar rgya nag bal klo rdo mon sogs/ /phyogs mtshams mtha' dmag nyer 'tshe bzlog tu gsol/ /phyogs bzhi'i 'dod dgu ma lus kun 'du zhing / /thos bsam sgom 'phel bstan 'dzin bos sde dar/ /rje 'bangasatsho gos rnams rdzogs ldan gsar pa yi/ /rtse dga' khong nas rgod pa'i bkra shis shog /ces lcags spre bsam yas mchims phur yig drug dung phyur zhig gtong ba dang de'i dus su smon lam 'di lta bu zhig brtsams na legs zhes gnas kyi srung ma dpal ldan lha mo ral gcig ma'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /—394

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenamatsho skyes rdo rje gter ston cho so kyi dbang / /sman lung yab sras sgrub sdebargyad kyi lha/ /legasaldan tsho gos bdag ma ning nag bo sogs/ /rtsa gsum thugs rje'i byin rlabs(293na〉snyus mthu yis//bgrang yas rigs rnams kun gyi khyab bdag che/ /blo gros mchogo gi rdo rje dpal bzang po'i/ /sprul sku'i zlos gar myur ston bka' gter gyi/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i sgron me sbar bar shog /skyabasagasum lha dang drang srong bden tshig stobs/ khyu 'bras rten cing 'brel 'byung slu med mthus/ /smon lam ci btab re ba ma lus pa/ /bsam don ji bzhin lhun gyis grub par shog /ces khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po'i sprul pa'i sku myur du phebs pa'i bden tshig tu brjod pa 'di ni gdan sa chos rje sku skye ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i/ /bshad sgrub bstan dang de 'dzin dge 'dun sde//spyi dang khyad par ban mkhar chos kyi gra /srid mtha'i bar du 'phel zhing rgyas par shog /ngag dbang blo gros yangs pa'i rdzing bu sa /mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'dab stong ze 'bru'i bcud/ /dpyod ldan rgya mtshos myangs pa'i legs bshad glus/ /kun khyab g.yung drung lta bur brtan par shog /dkon cog rnam gsum drang srong grub pa'i gtso/ /lha dang rig 'dzin tsho gis kyi bden pa'i mthus/ /mi phyed dad pas btab pa'i smon lam gyi/ /'bras bu ji bzhin dus su smin par shog /ces pa 'di'ang ban mkhar bla mas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang dbang po'o/ /'chi med 'pho ba chen po'i sku 'grub pa/ /'khor ba'i pha mtha' ji srid mya ngan las/ /(293ba)mi 'da' rdo rje'i sku brnyes pad+ma 'byung / /zla bral gtan gyi skyabs kyi bdag byin rlobs/ /tshangs pa lha yi me tog bag chags mthu/ /srid pas zhi khro che mchog 'dus pa'i rtsal/ /gan jag thang ta'i sgyu 'phrul gter bdag gling / /rnam 'dren zung gis tshe rabs kun tu skyongs/ /rigs sa pad+ma ka ra'i rnal 'byor dang / /yi dam 'jig rten dbang phyug sgom bzlas kyis/ /'di snang phun tshogs lha yi dpal la —395

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'gran/ /yang srid brgyud mar dal 'byor rten thob shog /theg mchog cho ge kyi dga' ston la spyad pas//zangs mdog dpal ri bde ldan po ta la/ /so sor snang yang rig rtsal dag zhing du/ /sku gsum dbyer med mgon gyis rjes 'dzin shog /mdo sngags bshad sgrub sde rnams dar zhing rgyas/ /'dren mchog bla ma mtha' dag zhabs pad brtan/ /bdag gis smon lam btab pa'i tsos bu kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces rigs 'dzin gter bdag gling pa'i zhabs 'bring ba dge slong ngag dbang tshul khrims kyis smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /ri hūṃ/ ba dz+ra gu ru pa 〉 sid+dhi ྅ / si lha/ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza: sirnyi phal /āḥhri ma ha ri ni sa/ ra tsa hri ya/ tsi stom lha dzaḥdzaḥ zhi khro kun 'dus pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /dngos byon gzhan min 'dren byed bdud rtsi'i dpyid/ /mthong bas don ldan yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /dngos grub 'dod 'jo'i bang mdzod deng sgo 'byed/ /'di 'bras dad gdung shugs kyis gsol btab tshe/ /dpal ri (294na)pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ /thogs med spyon te lung bstan dbug dbyung zhing / /dbang bzhi nyer bskul smin cing grol byin rlobs/ /rgyud lnga'i lus can kun la gdod ma nas/ /rig pa ye sangs rgyas pa'i pad+ma 'byung / /rang ngo shes te 'khor ba'i mthas gtugasapa'i/ /'gro 'dren ded dpon chen por 'gyur bar shog /ces khri srong rnam 'phrul dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi thugs dam 'bral spang rten gyi zhal thang las lha mgron gyi bla ma gsum ma gtogs 'dra bshus su dad rten la lcags pho spre lo sprel zla'i dus sngags 'chang gzhis ka shar pa zur 'phrin las rnam rgyal gyis legs par grub pa'i rgyab yig smon lam du za hor gyi ban+de gang shar rang grol gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /tshe dpag med mgon 'phags ma rnam par rgyal/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs sogs/ /thugs rje'i bzhu blugs rdo rje'i srog gi zungs/ /mi 'gyur g.yung drung lta bur byin —396

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanagyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus rje btsun myong kha pa'i/ /gsung ngag chos kyi mdzod la dbang sgyur blos/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /yongs khyab bshes gnyen dam pa zhabasabartan shog /phas rgol sa srungs 'gros la 'jigs med par/ /thos bsam gdong lnga'i rtsal gsum go cha can/ /thub bstan gangs rir nyer bsgom lang tsho'i sde/ /'og min zhing gtso lta bur brtan par shog /zhwa ser bshad sgrub bstan pa dge 'dun tshogs/ /lugs gnyis pho brang skyong ba mi yi dbang /(294ba)/sku tshe chab srid mnga' 'bangs bde skyid rnams/ /rdzogs ldan dus bzhin bla nas blar 'phel shog /myur mdzad mgon po dam can ma ha'i zhal/ /'dod khams dbang phyug sprul pa'i chos rgyal che/ /lha dang drang srong bden tshig la dbang bas/ /smon lam ci btab lhun grub 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces bden pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa tshig nyung la don rgyas pa zhig tshogs chen dang grwa tshang du 'dzugs rgyu la rtsoms shig ces gnas chung lcog nas bstan srung sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen pos bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /'phrin las nor bu deng nas sangs rgyas sar/ /bgrod min bar du rje btsun 'phags ma yis/ /'jigs chen brgyad sogs sgrib gnyis des bskyed pa'i/ /sdug bsngal kun las rnam par grol bar shog /ces pa'ang za hor gyi brjes bris/ /zhi khro yongs 'dus dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho la/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung cher spros pas//ngag dbang blo gsal rang ngo legs 'phrod nas/ /yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen sa non shog /skye mang goms pa'i nga rgyal ser sna'i dri/ /tshor ba'i phung po nyer gos rab bkrus nas/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bor gnas bsgyur te/ /rin cen 'byung ldan sku ru 'tshang rgyar shog /tshe rabs gzhan du 'jungs pa'i do ra na/ /mi bzad dbul phongs rgyu la longs spyod pa/ /rat+na shā ki'i mthu chen med po ches/ /yongasabacil bde legs 'dod dgu'i char chen phab/ /chos mdzad ngag dbang blo gsal gyi ched du (295na)—397

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rnam gling paṇa chen gyis phan bde legs bshad gling par zhi khro'i skongs bshags thog kha thi'i bla bre dkyus 'dom gsum ma longs tsam nang zheng 'dom gang lhag tsam phul ba dang / brgya thang le tshan bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /zho gsum gyis lhag bcu bzhi'i srang gi snod/ /phan bde legs bshad gling du phul ba'i dges/ /zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho la/ /tshe rabs kun tu longs su spyod par shog /cesapa'ang bkra shis bde chen pa ngag dbang don grub kyis dge skos kyi las sne'i thog phul ba shu ste/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa sangs rgyas dang / /legs gsung skyabs dngos gtan bde dam pa'i chos/ /de bsgrub theg pa che chung dge 'dun te/ /dkon cog gsum gyis rtag tu shis par mdzod//sangs rgyas kun dngos rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /chos srid bstan pa rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas par/ /bla nas blar 'degs gnam sa'i dbang phyug lha/ /rdo rje lta bur mi 'gyur zhabs brtan shog /stobs ldan khro bcu'i mthu rtsal nyi ma'i gzis/ /nag phyogs yid srubs mun pa mthar byas te/ /gzhom med rdo rje bzhu blugs sra mkhregs gur/ /mi bshig srog gi zungs su 'gyur byin rlobs/ /gar dbang phyag sor gyis bteg gser bum nang / /'chi med bdud brtsi'i rgyun gyis lus gang bas/ /g.yung drung tshe yi nya phyis khog yangs por/ /'khor 'das yon tan mu tig 'phyur bar shog /mi dbang bsod nams phung po (295bsgom thos bur/ /'gran par nus pa'i khrims gnyis gyib bsil du/ /mnga' 'bangs mtha' dag tshe lo brgyad khri ba'i/ /skye rgu ji bzhin bde skyid phun tsho gos shog /rgya hor bod dang bod chen 'dzin ma'i gzhin/ /dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos sde gtsor gyur pa'i/ /zhwa ser ring lugasatsan+dan ljon pa las/ /phan bde'i dri bsung phyogs brgyar chad med shog /myur mdzad mgon po snye tra pā la dang / /dam can gshin rje 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /bstan srung sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po yis//bsams don lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i brtan bzhugs —398

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa ra bodakar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenatshogs su btsugs chog pa zhig dgos zhes chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi bla spyi rnams kyi gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes chu stod zla ba'i yar tshes la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /ma rig mun sel ye shes sgron/ /spar byed nyer gnyis srang grangs can/ /dngul kong rigs 'dzin 'dus gling du/ /phul bas chos kun mthong bar shog /ces 'phyong rgyas pa mkhas btsun rgya mtsho rab 'byams grwa skor gyi dus kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes bkod/ /'jon dmar khal gsum grangs kyi nang sha la/ /zho dos lhag pa'i gser srang nyer gcig gis/ /legs gtums kong bur sgron me rab spar nas/ /dkon cog gsum 'dus jo shāka drung phul dges/ /bā dur no mon khan sogs tshe 'das don/ /rgyu sbyor bha yan shu ling lhag bsam gyis/ /bskrun pas srid zhi'i ma rig mun bsal te/ /mngon mtho nges legs snang bas khyab par (296na〉gag /ces lcags spre sbus srang ser khang du bal po bar pa shi mu ṇi/ ya na dza ti gsum gyis zla gcig bar bzos pa'i gla lto zi gong mkhar khal brgya dang don drug song zhing / 'dzugs nyin dkon gnyer rnams la ston mo bskrun pa sogs dge ba spel ba'i smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /tshul 5la ga lung khrims sa bon bag yod 'dzin ma'i gzhin/ /rab smin mngon mtho'i myu gu dar drag rtser/ /myang 'das snyem g.yur du za ba la/ /mkha' mnyam sems can kun gyis longs spyod shog /khyad par bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po yi/ /sku tshe mnga' thang chab srid rab spel zhing / /bgrang yas skye bar lha mi'i rten brgyud nas/ /ring min zhi ba'i grong du 'jug par shogazhabrul shar phyogs rtog bden 'dzin snang ba bkrag po che/ /gzung yul sgyu ma'i rta glang lta bu'i chos/ /gdod nas rang bzhin gyis stong mtha' bral ltas/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog khyu sbyor nor 'dzin skyong ba'i dbang phyug che/ /chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi rnam par thar bzung —399

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)nas 'di phyi'i mdun ma ma lus pa/ /'bad rtsol med par lhun gyis 'grub nus shog /dkon bugs tha dad gdul bya'i blo yi dngas mtsho'i nang / /thub gsung gzugs brnyan bye ba phrag brgya sa shar yang drang nges phye ba'i gnas lugs don/ /lus can yongs kyi mngon sum rtogs par shog /sbyin bdag mi dbang legs byas mu thi la'i/ /char rgyun zad mi shes (296ba)pa'i 'khri shing gi /gnyis pa'i ngang tshul bzung nas tshe rabs su/ shwakya seng gis rjes su 'dzin par shog /phal chen zhing khams rgya mtshor rgyal dang de sras kyi/ /rlabs chen spyod pas don gnyis sgrub pa'i sems/ /ches dkar skye rgu kun gyi yid dbang du/ /nyer 'jug phrag par 'khur chen 'khyer nus shog /bsod nams brgya byin gtsug tor reg pa'i mod/ /mi bdag dbang thang legs bris lus bsgyur nas/ /'khor 'das yon tan gser sgong yongs smin pa/ /'jig rten mes po'i ngang tshul 'dzin par shog /sna mdo sna lis tshogos theg pa ro brgya'i bro ba rnams/ /so sor snang yang sgrib gnyis bkres phongs las/ /mthar byed gtso dang yan lag 'gal med du/ /yid can rnams kyis ji bzhin rtogs par shog /bzang po'i bskal pa 'di la mi yi rje/ /snga na med pa'i byang chub mchog brnyes nas/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis sems can ma lus kun//thar pa'i grong khyer chen por 'dren par shog /rgyud rgyud la sdum sde rgya mtshor 'jug pa smin grol lam/ /rdzings kyis sku bzhi'i grong khyer chen po sa /snyigs dus tshe thung gcig la 'gro ba rnams/ /bya ja tshegs chung thabs kyis bgrod nus shog /sbyin pa'i bdag po in+t+ra lha ti ltar/ /'dod yon ma spangs lam du yongs khyer nas/ /kha sbyor bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang chen po/ grub pa'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog/ces pa'ang bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal pos lung sdo bzhi/ sher phyogs/ dkon brtsegs/ phal chen/ mdo sna tshogs/ rgyud 'bum rnams bzhengs pa'i dus smon lam dgos tshul ltar za (297na〉ter gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /tshe mtha' yas dang sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma yis/ /dus min 'chi ba'i bar chad nyer 'tshe kun/ /zhi zhing tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod/ /gal te dus la —400

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanabab na 'od dpag med/ /mngon sum byon nas bde ba can zhing du / /drangs nas theg pa mchog gi chos tshul la/ /skye ba kun tu spyod par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang mes ston khro rgyal dpal mgon gyi don du za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /o.āḥ/ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma si rnyi hūm̐/ 7zhwaPROBPROB badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ badz+ra sa ma yadzaḥsirnyi pha la /āḥhrīḥ ma ha ri ni sar tsa hri ya/ tsit+ta dzaḥhri tri/ dag dang ma dag bye ba phrag zhing du/ /'gro 'dren sangs rgyas g.yin kun gcig bsdoms pa'i/ /rnam par thar dang srang la bteg pa na/ /lci yang tshad ma'i yul du gzhal bya min/ /'on te snang ba mtha' yas thugs rka'i zer/ /si rtse'i mtsho dbus pad+ma'i sbubs zhugs te/ /sprul skur bstan nas srin po 'dul bar gyi/ /rnam thar 'phrul chen tshad bzung nus min kyang/ /sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms gsol btab ngor/ /bka' stsal rtogs brjod dpag bsam ljon shing las/ /'phros don yal 'dab 'bras bu g.yur za ba/ /bde ba'i grib mar dad pa'i ro bcud myong / /rang lus phung khams skye mched 'dzam gling gzhir/ /rig pa'i khye'u chung pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /tshogs brgyad mtshon dang rnam 'gyur sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /'dul zhing sgo lnga'i (297ba〉yul du ci yang la jug /spros bral chos sku'i dbyings su longs sku'i gdangs/ /yongs shar snang bzhi mthar son kun tu bzang / /brjod bral rig pa don gyi bla ma sa /rang ngo mngon sum 'phrod par deng byin rlobs//sangs rgyas rang la dbul po'i skyed rdo gser/ /ji bzhin ring min rtogs te mgon khyod kyi/ /rnam thar bzung nas bgrang yas lus can kun/ /'dren pa'i skyob pa mchog tu 'gyur bar shog /'di'i ched sgo gsum bdog pa cha phras kyang / /mthun rkyen sgrub kun tshe 'dir bde skyid 'phel/ /phyi ma pad+ma 'od zhing rigs 'dzin gral/ /'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po'i sku 'grub shog /sangs rgyas gnyas pa skyon chen po'i rnam thar sis rgya mtsho ma 'phros don dang bcas pa khri srong rnam 'phrul chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi ljags bkod ma'i bris thang gi 'dra bzhus lcags pho spre'u'i lo zur 'phrin las rnam rgyal gyis skya ris dang / tshon 'byug gi rogs sog po bstan pa tshul khrims kyis bgyis par zhal byang chos rgyal —401

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'bri gung pa chen po'i thugs dam rten gra tshar 'dug pa dang / /rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che'i gsung rgyun gzhan yang rnam thar yig tshang mang bo dang sgo bstun nas bkod pa'i rgyab yig smon lam du za hor gyi sngags smyon rdo rje thogs med rtsal gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pas bgyis pa gu ru a dhi byu a dhi sti te swāhā/ / mthong thos dran dang reg pas 'gro ba kun/ /mngon mtho nges legs la sbyor nyi ma'i gnyen/ /nyan thos tshul 'dzin gnas bcur bla ma dang / /sangs rgyas byang sems 'dod lhas yongs bskor ba/(298na)/ras dkar dngas shel tshon ris bkra ba'i rgyu/ /skyid thang nor bu'i blo brtson gyis sbyar nas//blo bzang tshe 'phel tshe ring bsam 'grub ces/ /rnam dpyod mig yangs sor rtse'i gar bsgyur mthus/ /sras bcas rgyal bas skye bar rjes bzung ste/ /tshe 'byor dbang thang rnam thos bu che 'gran zhing / /ring min sku gsum grong du 'jug pa la/ /mda' bsnun zhabs kyi mched por 'gyur bar shog /gangs can sa 'dzin spo la dgra bcom pa/ /stong dang sum brgyas legs bskor yan lag 'byung / /khyed kyis bdag sogs 'gro rnams skye ba mā /lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum la spyor byin rlobs/ /nyon mongs dgra tsho gos las rgyal chig brgya dang / /drang srong ri yi ngos bzhugs ma pham pa/ / khyed kyis bdag sogasa'agro rnams skye ba sa /nag phyogs kun zhi rtag tu shis byin rlobs/ /nyon mongs las rgyal chig stong bzhi brgyas bskor/ /lo ma bdun pa'i phug bzhugs nags na gnas/ / khyed kyis bdag sogs 'gro rnams skye ba sa /sdig pa'i dri ma kun dang bral byin rlobs/ /zangs gling gnas su chig brgyas lhag pa yi/ /dgra bcom stong phrag gcig bskor dus ldan zhabs/ /khyed kyis bdag sogs 'gro rnams skye ba sa /rgyal sras spyod pas lus can skyong byin rlobs/ /rdo rje mo'i bu dgra bcom chog stong bcas/ /gnas mchog siṅga la ru legs bzhugs pa/ /khyed kyis bdag sogs 'gro rnams skye ba mā /mgon skyobs gling dang dpung gnyen mdzad du gsol/ /brgya phrag gnyis lhag dgra bcom stong dang bcas/ /bzang po ya mu na yi gling bzhugs pa/ /khyed kyis bdag sogs 'gro rnams skye ba sa /sems can —4(12

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs jog spya li su yi pa rang dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang dro / 'dabasod nams294zhing du 'gyur byin rlobs//kha cher brgya phrag lnga yi dgra bcom pas//legs bskor 'phags pa'i gnas brtan gser bes/khyed kyis bdag sogs 'gro rnams skye ba mā/chos kun rnam 'byed shes4 thob par shog/ba lang spyod gling bdun brgya'i dgra bcom dang //lhan cig bha ra dha dza gser can zhabs//khyed kyis bdag sogs 'gro rnams skye ba mā/rdzogs sangs rgyal zhal mngon sum mthong byin rlobs//byang gi sgra mi snyan gling nyen mongs dgra/bcoms pa dgu brgyas bskor ba bha kū la//khyed kyis bdag so gos 'gro rnams skye ba sa/dbul ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag sel byin rlobs//bri ya du'i gling 'phags pa sgra can 'dzan//chig brgya stong gi dgra bcom gyisabaskor ba//khyed kyis bdag so gos 'gro rnams skye ba sa/skye rgu mi khoms las 'dren nus byin rlobs//dgra bcom stong dang drug brgyas bskor ba yi//bya rgod phung rir gnas brtan lam phran bstan//khyed kyis bdag sogs 'gro rnams skye ba mā/nyam nga brgyad kyi 'jigs las sgrol byin rlobs//dgra bcom stong bcas shar gyi lus 'phags su//bha ra dha dza chen po bsod snyoms len//khyed kyis bdag sogs 'gro rnams skye ba mā/nyen pa ba na yi 'jigs las thar byin rlobs//lam bstan dgra bcom dgu brgyas yongs bskor ba//sum na rtsa gsum lha yi gnas bzhugs pa//khyed kyis bdag sogasa'agro rnams skye ba sa mdag tshul khrims bsrung bar nus byin rlobs//ri rgyal ngos yangs gnasabartan klu yi sde//stong dang nyis brgya'i dgra bcom gyis bskor ba//khyed kyis bdag sogs 'gro rnams skye ba mā/rtag tu sangs rgyas zhing khams myul byin rlobs//gnas brtan sped byed ri rgyal bi hu lar//stong dang bzhi brgya'i dgra bcom gyis bskor ba//99na khrid kyis bdag sogs 'gro rnams skye ba sa/chos kun gdod nas stong par rtogs byin lhos//'a mongs tshogis bcom stong phrag 'khor dang bcas//gangs can ri yi rgyal por mi phyed pa//khyed kyis bdag sogs 'gro rnams skye ba sto/byang ri phyogs kyi chos rnams bskyed byin rlobs//zhes skyid thang nor bus gnas bcu lha mgron dang bcas0thang gra tsā bas bdun bgos ba'i ༷ba yig dgos tshul ltar za sto gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi ljags yangs 'o ma'i mtshor/ /bde gshegs bdun gyi smon lam ngang mo dkar/ /mtha' yas yon tan snyan po mgrin pa'i rnga/ /yongs sgrog slu med bden gtam gang gis 'gog/cher snyigs lnga bdo'i phung po las nyen sbrul/ /sdug bsngal dug lce'i rlangs kyis bde skyid srog/rab 'phrog gnyen po'i sman mchog 'dren pa mched/ /bdun gyi byin rlabs chig thub pha lam bzhin//khri srong rje 'bangs thug brgyud la gos sgrib/ /'bras bcas glang gdong mche ba nyer phyung nas/ /nges legs lam snar rnam dpyod mdongs mtha' la/ /zhen pa'i mkhan chen zhi 'tsho me skyes lha/ /brgyad brgya'i mdo snying cho ga sbyin pa'i sgo/ /gangs can chos dkar ched bskrun sim tshor gyi/ /rin cen 'bru sogs mkho dgu'i longs spyod char/ /gser mdog rgyal po'i rjes su rkang pa 'jog /sman yon zla bzhin lang tshos phyogs pa'i yid/ /bsod nams lus phrar nyer 'byud rtse 'jo yis/ /dge 'bras khyi'u srid zhi'i khang bzang du/ /btsa' ba'i dga' ston cho gar gcig tu (299ba)brel/ /bde gshegs brgyad kyi lha tsho gisang gnyis grangs/ /gser bzang las grub rgyal phur rab brtan gyis/ /glang chen 'gying 'dra ri bo'i sde chen por/ /pad rtsa ltar dkar lhag bsam gyis phul mthus/ /bsod nams dar rgyasarigs brgyud dang bcas pa'i/ /thog med nas bsags sdig pa'i dri ma kun/ /rnam 'dren byin rlabs mtho ris chu bo yis/ /bkrus rgyun byang chen zla 'phel nang 'bab shog /'jam dbyangs gzhen nu dga' ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /bskal brgyar rab brtan dmigs yul yid can tshogs/ /yang srid kun tu rjes bzung 'khor 'das kyi/ /bde legs dpal la rtag tu spyod byin rlobs/ mdor na mdo chog smon lam don ji bzhin/ ju sbyor las byed rnams sa ba pa ltar/ / 'gro ba kun kyang mnyam por longs spyod par/ /yongs bsngos 'bras bu nam yang 'dzad med shog / ces ri bo bde chen du sku brnyan rnams 'bul skabs 'dzugs rgyu'i smon lam tshig don 'di bzhin dgos zhes 'brong rtse ba rgyal phur rab brtan gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam —404

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedadabyangs grags pa'o/ /spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma tshe dpag med mgon ngor/ /gsol ba btab pas dus min 'chi bdag gi /'jigs pa kun las rnam par rgyal bar 3|ga /mgon po khyod kyi thugs dar sems nyid ni/ /rlung gi bzhen pa la brten 'gro 'ong gis/ /thugs rje bskul bas byin rlabs nyer bzhugs te/ /dbyer med dag pa'i rang zhal mthong bar shog /mdor na deng nas sangasargyas ma thob bar/ /'od (300na)dpag med mgon kyi sras thu bo gnyis/ /'khor tshogs rgya mtshos rtag tu rjes bzung nas/ /bzhed 'bras ma lus lhun gyis 'grub par shog /ces 'di phyir dge ba'i kha ton du dbon chung gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs dbang byin rlabs kyis/ /tshe 'di'i bde skyid dpal 'byor phun tshogasashing / /rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bskyabs nas/ /dag pa'i zhing du 'dren par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di'ang bstan 'dzin tho yon gyi bu tsha brgyud dang bcas pas kha ton du byas chog pa'i nyung ngu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sder/ /mi phyed dad pa brtan pos gsol 'debs na/ /bdag gi 'di phyi bar dor bsams pa'i don/ /smon lam ci btab lhun gyis 'grub par shog /ces pa'ang rgyal mo rdo rje rab brtan gyi kha ton du dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes bkod/ /spyan ras gzigs dang rgyal bu 'jig rten dbang / /lha yi rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po rje/ / tho tho ri dang chos rgyal dad pa brtan/ /dkon cog 'bangs gyur srong btsan lha'i me tog /khri ral dge ba dpal dang dgon pa ba/ /'brom rje sa chen g.yu brag mnga' bdag myang / /dge 'bum pad+ma badz+ra dge 'dun grub/ /ba 'ad pa'i rdo rje bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde/ /bde chen chos rgyal sogs dang las smon gyis/ /'brel ba'i rnam dkar bag chags yongs sad par//kun (300ba〉khyus ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sder/ /yid ches gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba —405

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'debs/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun/ /mgon khyod rdo rje lus kyi pho brang cher/ /nyon mongs lnga dag ye shes chen po'i gdangs/ /'gag med gsal bar shar la gsol ba 'debs/ /phung khams skye mched gzhal yas khang gcig tu/ /rdzogs pa'i snying shun pad+ma snying gi tshil//zla steng sems nyid ngal gso drang srong sku/ /tshangs spyod cha lugs 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs sder bcas gnyen po sa /'jam dpal rdo rje rab khros dus dgra'i dbang / /sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug sku yi 'phrul/ /snang stong zlos gar bsgyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal bsen dam sri'i don snying phyir 'don par/ /lag na pad+ma dbang chen khro bo'i rgyal/ /rgod dang drag shul 'jigs rung gsung gi gdangs/ /grag stong dbyangs su len la gsol ba 'debs/ /gza' klu sdebargyad kun gyi gshed ma sa /gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin dregs tshogos kun 'dul sku/ /snying rje rngam pa zhi ba thugs kyi dbyings/ /rig stong kun khyab ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /g.yel med rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i bsod nams dpal mgon du/ /nam yang 'pho 'gyur med par rtag bzhugs nas/ /zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /sangs rgyas kun gyi blo gros gcig bsdus mthus/ /bdud las rgyal ba'i 'jam dpal gshin rje yi/ /rnal 'byor lhur len byang chub ma thob bar/ /'bral med brtse bas rjes su 'dzin par shog(301na)/gnas skabs tshe ring nad med dbang thang rgyas/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rab 'phel nas/ /ring por mi thogs 'jam mgon kun tu bzang / /mngon gyur lus can ma lus 'dren par shog /ces dge slong blo gros rgyal bas 'gro la rjes brtse ma'i bris thang bzhedas pa'i rgyab yig smon lam dang bcas pa kha don du byas chog pa zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /rmugs 'dzin dbang po'i bang mdzod la 'gran pa/ /rgya bod phun tshogs 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i sgo/ /dge bcu'i yon tan tshang ba dar rtse mdo'i/ /dga' ldan g.yin phan gling gi gas lar/ /slob dpon ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs lhag bsam gyis/ /khur blangs shing rtsi ri mo bskrun pa la/ /mdo yi 406

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanardzong sdod blo nga sbrel po yis/ /dge bskul kha 'debs dang bcas legs bsgrubs mthus/ /ched du lus ngag yid gsum 'bad rtsol dang / /dngos po'i mthun rkyen spel bar byed pa kun/ /nad gdon dus min 'chi dang dbul phongs sogs/ /srid pa'i zug rngu thams cad zhi bar shog /legs bris lta bur ring por 'tsho ba'i tshe/ /gnod sbyin bzhin du 'dzad med longs spyod sogs/ /mtho ris bde skyid yon tan mtha' dag la/ /'di dang skye ba kun tu spyod par shog /'khor ba sdug bsngal chu srin 'byung gnas las/ bsod nams rdzings kyis bsgral te thar pa'i gling / /bgrod nas gtan gyi mdun ma rin po che/ /spel legs phreng ba rgyan du 'chang bar shog /sems can kun (301ba〉don stob bcu mnga' ba yi/ /go 'phang mngon du byas nas skye rgu rnams/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob phyir 'dis mtshon pas/ /dus gsum bsags dang gsog 'gyur dge ba bsngo/ /slu med dkon cog rin cen bden pa dang / /lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin grub pa'i mthus/ /yangs pa'i 'jig rten kun tu bkra shis 'char/ /phab nas bde skyid snye ma g.yur za shog /ces pa 'di'ang mdo dga' ldan gzhan phan gling gi mchod khang dang 'du khang gi shing rtsi'i khur blas te gla sto dang spang ma srang zhe gcig /mthing srang go bdun/ de phyin rdzong sdod blo bzang dbang phyug dang / nga phod pa gnyis dge bskul byas par brten lnga mchod spyi sos sha phin dang 'bo ja 'khor drug re/ sbu kha/ dril sngo ljang / sman kha gsum/ kha btags/dge slong shes rab kyis mthing srang phyed nyer gnyis/ dbu mdzad blo bzang yar 'phel gyis gser shog brgya bam/ lcags la dpon mched kyis chung ju sha phin 'khor drug re/ dar yug bcad/ kha btags lnga/ chu 'gram dpon chung gis gser shog brgya bam gnyis/ ban gzan/ sman kha/ dbon a chos kyis mtshal srang gsum/ ras kha bdun/ khrom gnya' pa dpon tshe dbang lhun grub kyis dngul zho gang skar gsum/ sman kha/ kong sked/ spu kha/ tre bo dpon gyis mtshal zho bco lnga/ gser shog brgya bamoganyis/ gos sngon kha bcu/ sa yang ya ru'i gser zho do/ spos dkar dang mtshal dkar cha phyed do re/ sadakar mgo thab chen nas/ mthing srang gsum/ rams srang bzhi zho gsum/ bla ma ye shes bstan 'phel —407

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gyis dngul (302na)srang do/ ya ru gu rus srang do/ 'brug dar gyis srang drug /dkon shu rus srang drugamachod rten skyabs/ tshe ring dar rgyas/ bkra shis phrag /rgya bkra shis bzhis srang do re/ dge 'dun skyabs kyis srang gang zho lnga/ se'u bkra shis kyis srang gsum/ jo 'bum gyis srang gang / gzhung ra ba nang a shi skyabs kyis srang gang zho do/ g.yung drung dges srang gang zho brgyad/ rgyal mtshan gyis zho gang skar bdun/ a 'dab kyis srang gang zho lnga/ a dges srang gang zho bdun skar lnga/ shes rab thar gyis zho bdun/ gnam 'phel a ma chos zho dgu skar lnga/ lcags la ra ba nang dud brgyad kyis srang do/ kha btags/ rgya hor gyis zho gang skar drug rnam rgyal/ dge 'dun/ a spo ba/ a mdo/ ban+de rgyal lngas zho gang skar bzhi re/ gsang mkhar gyis zho gang / lhu bar gyis zho gang skar drug sa bdag chos skyabasakyis zho brgyad skar lnga/ tshe ring skyabs dang rnam rgyal thar gyis zho re/ sgron ma ga chu pas kyis zho gsum/bar lam ra ba nang dud bcu bzhis zho dgu skar do/ kha rtag gis zho gang skar gsum/ gi shi ban ko dang tshe dbang bsod nams/ tshe ring thar bcas kyis zho gang skar gsum re/ ya ru gzungs dar gyisamatshal srang nyi shu/ mthing dang li khri srang bcu re/ spang ma srang nyer drug bar lam thab chen gyis dngul zho bzhi/ mtshal srang do skar lnga/ mthing srang gang zho dgu/ dud chung shes rab skyabs kyis mtshal zho dgu/ a ma sdo lngas mtshal srang gsum zho bzhi/ gser shog brgya bam/ lug dor (302ba〉shākyasaspang ma srang gang zho do/ gser shog brgya bam/ kha btags/ tshe gzungs sgron gyis mtshal srang gang zho gang / bar lam a sras kyis spang ma srang bcu gcig gzhung ra ba nang spyi pas mtshal srang gang zho lnga/spu kha/ rgya ras kha gsum/ la ba 'dom bcu drug sngags pa thar gyis ldong ros srang gsum zho do/ spang mthil zho brgyad/ chu 'gram rtsa ra rgyal gyis mthing srang lnga zho gsum/ rnam rgyal gyis mtshal srang gang zho bzhi/ chang shug gis spang ma srang phyed bzhi/ sprul sku shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis rams zho lnga/ dkar dreg srang lnga/ ya ru rgyal gyis gser zho gang skar lnga/ chu 'gram ya ru tshe dbang nor bus skar brgyad/rgya dung a ka bkra shis kyis zho do/ gon ja a 'bum dang 'gi ba gnyis kyis zho gang skar bzhi/ rnam —408

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhanargyal tshe ring gis gser shog brgya bam bzhi/ rgya dung a mas gser shog brgya bam rnams phul ba'i dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i tshigs bcad dgos zhes bla ma ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyis bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs theg/ /mchog gsum thugs rje byin rlabs bden pa'i mthus/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i ngag dbang blo yi gter/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i gar bsgyur zhabs pad zung / /rgya mtsho'i gos can zhing 'dir rtag brtan shog /smra ba ngag gi dbang por blo gros kyis/ /bag chags bzang po'i dpal la mnga' 'byor ba / /mi shigs srog gi zungs su rgyal kun gyis/ /thugs rje'i bdud rtsis rtsa (303na tha tshugs par shog /lho rgyud nor 'dzin yangs pa'i sto ba sa /dga' ldan bshad sgrub bstan pa rab rgyas sde/ /khrims ldan 'dus gling lus can bsod nams kyi/ /zhing mchog dam par bla nas blar 'phel shog yi/ char legs 'bab lo tog 'bras bu smin/ /mtha' bzhi las sgo'i 'dod pa ma lus 'jo/ /nad zhabrugs mu ge dus kyi chad las zhi/ /bde skyid lha yi spun zlar 'gran nus shog /chos nyid 'gyur med dngas pa'i rdzing yangs por/ khri spya 'bras rten 'brel mi bslu legs 'grig gzugs/ /yongs shar smon lam 'dren byed gzigs mo sa /tshar du dngar ba'i dga' ston rgyas par shog /cesamatsho sna dga' ldan rab brgyas gling spyi sos 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /tshe dpag med sogs mchog gsum thugs rje dang / /lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin bden pa'i mthu/ /rten 'brel rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa yis/ /ci btab smon lam lhun gyis grub par shog /rgyal kun yab cig 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes/ /ma 'dris 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur ngag gi dbang / /blo bzang grags snyan bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gos/ /khyab 'dzad bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan par shog /ma rig gnyid sangs rnam dpyod rab brgyas pas/ /rgya chen gtsug lag mtsho ltar gting —409

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)zab par/ /mkhyen dpyod yangs pa'i lhas skyong lha sras kyi/ /rnam 'phrul g.yung drung lta bur rtag brtan (303bslog ga /mdo khams sgang gsum nor 'dzin lto ba sa /zhwa ser bstan pa yongs khyab rgyal po'i khrims/ /gser gyi gnya' shing lta bus mnga' 'bangs kun/ /me long gdong gi zhal che ltar 'grub shog /dus su 'bab pa'i char gyis lo tog smin/ /sad ser btsa' than nad rims mu ge dang / /'thab rtsod yongs zhi tshe ring longs spyod tshogs/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston dgod par shog /ces pa 'di'ang lha khang nas rdo rje nor bu dang bag gro can gnyis gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang pa'o/ /ne pa la yi sor mo'i rnam par 'phrul/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gzugs gser zangs las/ /legs grub mda' dpon phun tshogs kyis bskrun dges/ /mchog thun bsams don lhun gyis grub par shog /ces pa'ang za hor bzhes bkod/ / char sprin ltar gnag srin po khros pa'i zhal/ /ha ha'i gad brgyangs 'brug stong ltar sgrog kyang //'gro kun 'dren la brtse ldan myur mdzad mgon/ /'di phyi bar do'i skyabs kyis bdag rjes zungs/ /zhes rgyab yig 31 ka gcig yod pa zhig dgos zhes spyi khang mdo ma ba dkon cog gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang dbang po'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid kyi nyams len snying po bsdus pa tre(gas/'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che las nyer sgrol ba'i/ /snying nas skyabs 'gro'i gru gzings bzo ba dang / /byang chen khang par bgrod pa'i sems bskyed kyis/ /rin cen them skas 'dzugs par byin gyis rlobs//thog med bsags pa'i sdig lhung tshan po che/ /(304na/byab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor —410

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ 'dadang / /yi ge brgya pa'i gzungs chus rab bkrus nas/ /rdul bral ston zla lta bur 'gyur bar shog /bla ma spyan ras gzigs la skyabs gnas kun/ /'dus par rtse gcig gsol btab rnal 'byor gyis/ /thugs rje ma lus snying la legs bzhugs nas/ /lam mchog rgyud la 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /phun tshogs yon tan mtha' dag kun tshang ba'i/ /maṇ+ḍal dngos bshams yid sprul legs phul bas/ /bsod nams tshogs chen ma lus yongs rdzogs nas/ /dag pa'i zhing mchog 'grub par byin gyisarlobs/ /rang snying stong par bsgoms pa ye shes tshogs/ /bsags pa'i ngang nas thugs rje chen po'i sku/ /phra rags lha yi nga rgyal brtan po la/ /gnas pa'i g.yo med ting 'dzin 'grub par shog /snod rnams thams cad rab 'byams dag pa'i zhing / /bcud kyi sems can phyag na bad dkar skur/ /grag stong rang sgra yi ge drug pa'i gdangs/ /'gag med sgra yis 'jig rten kun khyab shog /bsgom bya sgom byed thams cad rang bzhin gyi/ /gdod nas stong pa skye 'gag gnas gsum dang / /yongs bral bde stong ye shes 'phags pa'i thugs/ /mngon sum rgyud la nyams su myong bar shog /tshe 'dir ma grol 'da' kha'i nyams len dang / /'pho bar ma nus bar do legs sbyang nas/ /chos 'di nyams su len pa'i dal 'byor gyis/ /rten bzang rnam dag skye srid 'dzin par shog /tha mal lusang ga yid kyi spyod pa kun/ /chu (34ba〉du rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la brten nas/ /ci byas chos su 'gro ba'i man ngag gis/ /'di phyi bar do'i gtan mdun 'grub par shog /ces thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid kyi nyams len snying po bsdus pa 'di ni bstan pa dge slong gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang pa'o/ /su sti pra dzā tho bskal bzang sgron me bzhi pa'i bstan pa mchog /gdong dmar kha ba'i ljongasasu yongs 'phel nas/ /phyi dar gsal byed gru mer phyed brgyad kyi/ /phyag rjes sol nag thang chen gas la/ /snang ba mtha' yas mgon po a ti sha /gsang bdag khu ston brtson tsos g.yung drung sogs/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i skyes chen mtha' klas pas/ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin phung cig car —411

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gtibs/ /gtsug lag sde bcas skyong ba yon tan rgyal/ /bka' yi blon po bshan pa lag dmar gyi//gsung bzhin rten dang brten pa'i zhig gsos su/ /gsar bskrun mig gi bdud rtsi bla na med/ /bgrang yas lus can bsod nams spel ba'i slad/ /rgyal sras slob mar bcas pa'i snang brnyan drung / /gnas srung chen pos brgya phrag mchod pa yi/ /'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar phye/ /'brasabu 'jig rten spyi dang khyad par du/ /bod dang bod chen skye rgu'i bde skyid tshogs/ /de 'phel rtsa lag shākya seng ge'i bstan/ /srid mtha'i bar du dar zhing rgyas par shog /gsung ngag chad med dbang gi chu bo bzhi/ /blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtshor legs 'bab pa/ /'jam dbyangs(305na jig 'a ba'i bshes gnyen dpal bzang po/ /nges pa lnga ldan mgon ltar brtan par shog /dga' ldan ring lugasagyen 'degs srid kyi khrims/ /gnam thig drang por 'debs pa'i pho brang che/ /legs skyong mi dbang sras brgyud mnga' thang rgyas/ /sku tshe g.yung drung rang bzhin ltar brtan shog /g.yo ru'i sa phyogs kun dang bye brag tu/ /sol nag thang chen lha mi sder bcas kun/ /rtag tu bde ba'i ro bcud myong ba la/ /skabs gsum bdag po'i ngang tshul 'dzin par shog /'gro ba rnams kyi phyag dang mchod pa yi/ /yul du gtsug lag khang bzang rab brtan cing / /sde 'dir chos srid legs tshogos ma lus kun/ /yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar shog /pad+ma kā ra'i srol 'dzin sngags 'chang spyi/ /bye brag pra dzña ra smi dbang po'i sde/ /dam tshig ji bzhin sprul pa'i chos rgyal ches/ /g.yel ba med par rtag tu grogs mdzad shog/mkha' la gza' skar bzang po 'phrod kyi dge /sa la khri gdugs nyi ma'i 'od kyis khyab/ /bkra shis zla ba rgyas pa yar ngo bzhin/ /rtag tu 'grib pa med pa'i dge legs stsol/ /zhes dpal sol nag thang po che'i gtsug lag khang gi phyi nang gi zhig gsos sde pa blo bzang sbyin pa dang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho gnyis kyis bkod pas khyab pa'i dus rigs kyi srung ma bshan pa lag dmar gyis mchod pa rgya chen po mdzad pa'i tshe smon lam tshigs bcad 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes gsungs pa dang du blangs te za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /(305ba〉nya stong —412

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhedabargyad gsum yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims/ /legs bsrungs snying po yi ge drug pa bzlas/ /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam btab pa'i mthus/ /od khon ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las thar bar shog /yang srid kun tu lha mi'i rten bzang thob/ /sangs rgyas bstan mjal chos kyi sgo ru zhugs/ /tshul bzhin nyams su blangs bas 'khor ba yi/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal che las thar bar shog /'gro la brtse ba'i snying rje chen po dang / /bdag gzhan mnyam par brje ba'i byang chub sems/ /chos kun rang bzhin stong pa dbu ma'i lam/ /zung 'brel nyams blangs sangs rgyas sar bgrod shog /ces pa 'di'ang dad ldan sgrod khon gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /bla ma thugs rje chen po dbyer med kyis/ /tshe 'di'i bar chad kun zhi bsams don 'grub/ /phyi ma bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /skye bar gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes tshig nyung don rgyas zhig dgos zhes dar ji tha'i ji khyo shugs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /gru 'dzin la dgyes phyag na pad dkar 'chang / /rnam 'phrul 'jig rten dbang phyug lha'i rgyal po/ /gangs can thog ma'i rje po gnya' khri btsan/ /tho ri dad pa brtan par gsol ba 'debs/ /dkon cog gsum 'bangs bsams bzhin srong btsan rjer/ /legs sprul rim brgyud khri srong ral pa can/ /'phags yul dge ba dpal dang dgon pa ba/ /'brom ston rtse (306na)chen snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /g.yu brag mgon dang gter ston mnga' bdag myang / /dge 'bum pad+ma badz+ra dge 'dun grub/ /dbyangs can ba 'ad pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /bde chen chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /yang srid du mar dam pa de dag dang / /rnam dkar las kyis 'brel ba'i bag chags mthu//yongs sad ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgya bod mkhas shing grub brnyes du ma yi/ /snang brnyan sman 'dam rig byed sor mo'i 'phrul//grang gser khu bas nyer byugs legs byas shing / /blo brtson gtong bas rab bskrun dge tshogs 'bras/ /nad gdon dbul phongs mi mthun phyogs kun zhi/ /tshe dpal bsod nams stobs ra ma —413—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)lus 'phel/ /nying mtshams sbyar tshe ri bo po tā lar/ /'phags mchog snying rje'i gter gyis rjesa'adzin shog /mtho ris lam brgyud thar pa'i grong du zhugs/ /phyin drug rlabs chen spyod par gcig tu brtson/ /gsang sngags theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor gyis/ /'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas myur thob shog /'jig rten bde zhing thub pa'i bstan pa dar/ /de 'dzin skyes bu srid mtha'i bar du brtan/ /saskyong rgyal po'i sku tshe mnga' thang rgyas/ /'bangs rnams lha yi dga' ston la spyod shog / dkon cog rin cen gsum gyi byin rlabs dang / /drang srong lha sogs bden tshigs grub pa'i mthu/ / rten cing 'brel 'byung bslu ba med pa yis/ /smon lam ci btab lhun gyis grub par shog /ces gsol dpon tshe dbang rab brtan gyis 'gro la (306ba)rjes brtse ma'i nang bzhin 'khrungs rabs 'bur sku bzhedas pa'i tshe gsol 'debs smon lam dang 'brel ba'i kha tan du byas choge pa zhig dgo che kha bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbya ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /'jig rten dbang phyug zlos gar 'phags bod kyi/ /mkhas shing grub pa'i sgyu 'phrul med po che//rin chen phreng ba lta bur spel legs su/ /mkhas la dbang gzhu ji bzhin rnam bkra'i mthus/ /yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po mi nor dang / /rigs brgyud tshe dang dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /'di'i ched sgo gsum 'bad brtson brten pa kun/ /don gnyis mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par shog /nyi ma sbasapas legs bstan 'phags ma'i sku/ /rnam 'gyur cir yang ston pa'i 'phrul po che/ /nyer gcig grangasaldan dri med ras dkar ngos/ /sna tshogs tshon gyi mdangs bkrag rab gsal bas/ /yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po mi nor dang / /yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po mi nor dang / /rigs brgyud tshe dang dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /'di'i ched sgo gsum 'bad brtson brten pa kun/ /don gnyis mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par shog /phyag na pad dkar srong btsan 'phrom ston rje/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing gyur dge 'dun gyi/ /yon tan rgyan gyis legs spung rnyog dral mtshor/ /chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor ltar shar bas/ /yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po mi nor dang / /yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po mi —414

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ (zhananor dang / /rigs brgyud tshe dang dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /'di'i ched sgo gsum 'bad brtson brten pa kun/ /don gnyis mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par shog /sna tshogs tshon brgya nye ba'i mal shel ltar/ /rab dkar ka shi ka yi ngos yangs por/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen 'dra bag la/ /skyabs mchog du ma'i snang brnyan gyis bskor mthus/ /yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po mi nor dang / /yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po mi nor dang / /rigs brgyud tshe dang dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing //'di'i ched sgo gsum 'bad brtson brten pa kun/ /don gnyis mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par shog /nyan thos tshul gyi shāka seng bstan pa la/ /ri mor legs mdzad gnas brtan bcu drug gi /sku gzugs sna tshogs 'dod lhas yongs bskong ba/ /mi phyed dad pa'i shugs kyis nyer (307na)bzhengs mthus/ /yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po mi nor dang / / rigs brgyud tshe dang dpal 'byor rab rgyasashing / /'di'i ched sgo gsum 'bad brtson brten pa kun/ /don gnyis mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par sgo/ga /thog med dus nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa las/ /sdig stung smag rum thugs rje'i nyi ma yis//mthar mdzad sum cu rtsa lnga'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /snang brnyan ri mor 'bad pas bskrun pa'i dges//yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po mi nor dang / /rigs brgyud tshe dang dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /'di'i ched sgo gsum 'bad brtson brten pa kun/ /don gnyis mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par shog /seng ge glang chen me dang chom rkun sprul/ /lcags sgrog sha za chu bo'i 'jigs pa las/ /skyob mdzad rgyal ba kun yum 'phags ma'i sku/ /ched du bskrun pa'i chos dkar phung po yis/ /yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po mi nor dang / /rigs brgyud tshe dang dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /'di'i ched sgo gsum 'bad brtson brten pa kun/ /don gnyis mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par shog /bde gshegs sgo so'i smon lam bden tshig 'bras/ /nam yang yol med thugs rje rlabs kyi phreng / /'khor ba chu srin 'byung gnas 'dir g.yo ba'i/ /snyigs ma'i mgon po bdun gyi deng dgongs la/ /yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po mi nor dang / /rigs brgyud tshe dang dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /'di'i ched sgo gsum 'bad —415

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)brtson brten pa kun/ /don gnyis mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par shog /nyi ma'i rgyud 'khrungs ris med 'gro ba'i bshes/ /gser gyi lhun po stong khrag nyi 'od kyis/ /'khyud pa'i dpal 'dzin shākya seng ge'i phyag /glang po rna zhags lta bu brkyang ba yis/ /yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po mi nor dang / /rigs brgyud tshe dang dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /'di'i ched sgo gsum 'bad brtson brten pa kun//don gnyis mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par shog /mtha' yas sems can snang ngor mdzad pa'i 'phrul/ /rlabs chen ston kyang blo dman dang 'tsham ched/ /zhing bkod bcu gnyis rnam par thar pa dang / /mtshungs par slob 'dod lhag bsam yongasadag pas/ /yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po mi nor dang / /rigs brgyud tshe dang dpal 'byor rab rgyasashing / /'di'i ched sgo gsum 'bad brtson brten pa kun/ /don gnyis mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par shog /rnam mkhyen srang la pad+ma kā ra yi/ /mdzad mtha' 'degs par dka' yang sna nam bar/ / zhal 'tshes ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho la/ /blta ba'i skal ba bzang por yongs bsgyur bas/ /yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po mi nor dang / /rigs brgyud tshe dang dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /'di'i ched sgo gsum 'bad brtson brten pa kun/ /don gnyis mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par shog /nying mtshams sbyar tshe yid 'phrog bde ldan nas/ /snang mtha' zhal dkyil mngon sum ston pa'i ched/ /mgon khyod tshogs kyis bsgrubs pa'i zhing gi mchog /mngon (307ba)sum sa la 'phos 'dra'i bkod pa yi//yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po mi nor dang / /rigs brgyud tshe dang dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /'di'i ched sgo gsum 'bad brtson brten pa kun/ /don gnyis mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par shog /slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i sku gcig la/ /rnam 'phrul brgyad kyis 'gro ba 'dul ba'i gar/ /bsgyur tshe srid zhi'i nyes brgya 'jig pa yi/ /byin rlabs nus mthu'i cho ga yongs bstar bas/ /yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po mi nor dang / /rigs brgyud tshe dang dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /'di'i ched sgo gsum 'bad brtson brten pa kun/ /don gnyis mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par shog /thub pa'i —416

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam dang po/ zhenadabang por snyigs ma'i mgon po bdun/ /'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug dang / /rgyal chen dharma wadhe ha shang gi /sku brnyan gra mtshungs lnga ru bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po mi nor dang / /rigs brgyud tshe dang dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /'di'i ched sgo gsum 'bad brtson brten pa kun/ /don gnyis mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par shog zhes gsol dpon tshe dbang rab brtan gyis sgrol ma nyer gcig /'di ga'i 'dra 'bag le tshan gnyis/ gnas bcu thang gcig ma gnyis dang bcu gsum gra tshar/ sangs rgyas sum bcu so lnga/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad tshar gnyis/ thub dbang gi sku gcig mdzad pa bcu gnyis/ sis rgya mtsho'i zhing bkod/ mtshan brgyad kyi thang ga gnyis/ bcas khyon bsdoms sum cu so lnga bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul ltar blo ka phyi ma bldabs chog pa'i rtsis 'di bzhin bcas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /sbyin sogs phyin drug spyod pa'i rgya mtsho cher/ /nyer goms bshes gnyen dam par gsol btab pas/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i mgon po ltar bzhugs nas/ /chos 'khor rgyun chad med par yongs bskor shog /ces pa'ang smad rgyud spyi tshogs kyi ngor za hor gyi bsdos bkod/ /bslu ba med pa'i dkon cog rnam gsum la/ /mi phyed dad pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus//thugs rje snying la zhugs nas 'di dang phyi'i/ /legs (308na)tshogs don kun lhun gyi grub par shog /ces pa'ang thu med dge 'dun shi ge me reng gis dgos tshul ltar bris/ /rgyal sras slob mar bcas pa'i rten brten pa/ /mngon sum 'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing mchog tu/ /legs dngom mthong thos dran dang reg pas kyang / /mngon mtho nges legs sal sbyor mdzad kye/ /'dis mtshon bsags pa'i mi zad dge ba'i 'bras/ /thub pa'i bstan dar skye rgu'i bde skyid rgyag /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus thar pa dang / /rnam mkhyen ye shes mngon du 'gyur bar shog /yon sbyor rnams kyi nad gdon bar gcod zhi/ /tshe ring dpal 'byor chos srid legs tshogs —417

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'phel/ /yang srid kun tu dal ba'i rten thob nas/ /ring por mi thogs byang chen myur thob shog /'jam dpal grags pa'i rgyud kyi yang snying mtshan/ /brjod pa rnam dag gsang chen kun gyi ma/ /chos kyi sbyin pa'i sgo 'phar yongs phye ba'i/ /bsod nams byas pa'i phung po 'di yi mthus/ /blo bzang grags pa'i ring lugs blar spel ched/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen dpal bzang po /bskal brgyar zhabs brtan yon sbyor las byed rnams/ /'di phyi'i don tsho gis las kun 'grub par shog /dkon cog rin cen gsum gyi thugs rje dang / /lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin bden pa'i tshig /rten 'brelabaslu ba med pa'i nus pa yis/ /smon lam ci btab 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces ka bzhi smad pa bsod nams nor bus mtshan brjod kyi par brkos pa'i par byang 'di bzhin dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lkog pa bsam mthong lo tsā bas bris pa dza yan+tu// sarba mthile/ /—418

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanasmon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung las glegs bam gnyis pa bzhus/sa/ /dzi ཿ tsa sha ga su ra ba sbra sri ta 〈 tu rlu : ṣa ñtsa lnga ra swā ma ko ma te:ba ṇa da na ya na 'o : ṣa gu bha ga swā re rwa di kā 'e ba ya thu ma tshe da tā/rgyal gsung ngag gi sgra dbyangs rdo rje'i glu/ /dbang bzhi'i snyan 'gyur gdangs su blo gros kyi/ /rgyud mangs las drangs skal bzang rna ba'i rgyan/ /rgya mtshor chu klung ji bzhin chad med par/ /sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i dad rten du bris thang bco lnga bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam tshigs bcad sogs/phyag na pad dkar 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / /lha yi rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po rje/ /tho ri dad brtan mes dbon rnam pa gsum/ /dge ba dpal dang kha che dgon pa 'brom/ /sa chen (2na〉na yu brag nyang ral dge ba 'bum/ /pad+ma badz+ra dge 'dun bsod nams gter/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i skyes rabs 'phreng mdzes kyis/ /legs bskor 'dod khams dbang phyug pe ha ra/ /sbyin bdag rin cen sna bdun sngon 'gro ba/ /gnam sa'i khyon la dbang sgyur sangs rgyas bstan/ /rab mdzes lugs gnyisarnam dpyod rgya mtsho ltar/ /zab yangs rigs brgyud tshul 'dir 'bad do cog /chos dkar gos bu nad 'brug dbul phongs sogs/ /rtsod ldan chad pa ming gi mthar byas nas/ /tshe ring stobs 'byor —419

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)mnga' thang chab srid kun/ /mchod sbyin brgya pa'i dpal la 'gran par shog /deng nas rnam mkhyen ye shes ma thob bar/ /bshes gnyen mgon dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing / /dal ba'i rten la thos bsam bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /byang chub chen po'i sa la myur bgrod shog /dga' ba rgya ba'i she mong dar drag pas/ /lugs zung dpal dang ldan pa pho brang che/ /cho'i/srid gser gyi 'khor lo 'dzam gling gi /yangasapa'i nor 'dzin khyon la bsgyur bar shog /ces sde pa (2bsgongs rgyas rgya mtsho'i dad rten du bris thang bco lnga bzhengs pa'i gtso bo dang g.yas bdun la lha mgron 'dod lha sna tshogs dang / rgya mtsho che ba'i zhing bkod dar rgyas shin tu che yang gzhan rnams kyi bkod pa yod 'phros ma thos par sde pa rang nyid lha sras kyi bag chags sad pa'i mthu dang / 'phrog tu med pa'i dad pa dang so sor 'byed pa'i shes rab smon lam rnam par dag pa'i rkyen gyis le'u rnams la zhing bkod 'di lta bu zhig byung na legs pa 'dug ces 'char bstan byung ba dang rigs 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi dgongs don mthun par 'dug pas de don bzhin bsam pa lhun grub mar 'di ga nas ngag spod dang / de phyin 'dar ba lo chen/ rnam gling paṇa chen/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa gsum zin bris brgyag bcug par nged rang nas zhib mor dpyad de gtso thang gi skya bris dang gzhug tshags dbu 'bring lha sa 'jam dbyangs dbang po/tshon mdangs dga' ldan gling rta mgrin rgyal po dang mkhar rtse dge bsnyen rgyal po/ 'khor gyi mjug skyong rong pa bsod nams rgyal po/ gser ris 'phreng 'go dkon cog dang lcang srung khang rin cen rdo rjes byas shing / thang kha gzhan tshor yang ri mo ba mjug tu ming byang thebs pa ltar dang / kha byang gi yi ge rgyal rtse 'jam dbyangs dbang po dang ngag dbang phun tshogs/ tshon sbyor ba lha sa dkon cog dang za dam mar dar/ do dam pa 'bog gong blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi bgyis nas bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam 'di ni za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa sarba ri bha ( / /(3na)nye g.yas dang po/ring med pa thugs rje'i rtsi sman gyis/ /'gro rnams snying la bde ba sbyin mdzad —420

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanamakhan/ /skal bzang snam 'dren bzhi pa don kun grub/ /mthong thos dran reg rnam grol skyabs mgon la/ /nyid las g.yin min sna tshogs gdul bya'i ngor/ /gnas brtan bsto drug bka' skyong rgyal chen bzhi/ /chos 'phel hwa shang gnam bskos thang gi rgyal/ /mang bkur khab kyi bkod pa gcig tu mtshar/ /shākya seng ge'i byin rlabs go po che/ /dgra bcom so sos srid zhi'i yon to kun/ /mchod chog gzhung las byung ltar yon sbyor dang / /phyogs 'dir byed por gtogs rnams la 'byor shog /g.yasadang po'i gtso bo'i skya bris dbu 'bring lha sa 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ 'khor gra sdings mi 'gyur/ tshon mdangs pho brang rab brtan/ gzhug tshags snye mo ga me/ gser ris 'phreng 'go dkon cog rnams kyisabagyis/ /bde g.yas gnyis pa/gshegs kun gyi blo gros ma lus pa/ /thugs kyi bum bzang bcud 'khyil grags pa'i sgra/ /tshangs gnas yul sar dge ba myong kha pa/ /zla med gtan gyi skyabs gnas gcig pu bar/ /rgyan drug mchog gnyis phul byung khu rngog zung / /mkhan chen phyag na rdo rje dbu ma pa/ /thugs sras rnam bzhi nor bzang dpal lhun rje/ /myur mdzad mgon dang las gshin gyis bskor bas/ /tshe rabs kun tu snying la 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /zhugs nas ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i gnad/ /rtogasate 'khor 'das legs pa'i yon tan tshogs/ /thogs med sngon du (3ba〉gyur bar bdag byin rlobs/ /g.yas gnyis pa'i gtso bo'i skya bris/ dbu 'bring pho brang phun tshogs/ 'khor snye mo dmi/tshon mdangs lha sa khyi skyag lcang srung khang rin cen rdo rje/ gzhis rtse rdo rje rab brtan bcas gsum/gzhug tshags snye mo ga rma/ gser ris lha sa grags pa rnams kyis bgyis/ 'od g.yas gsum pa/ mtshan stong gi dra ba'i gar bsgyur phyag /ma rgyad mdangs 'dzin lhung bzed zil mngar gyis/ /legs gtam chu rgyun gdul bya'i tshangs bug brgyud/ /snying gi za ma tog tu 'khyil mdzad pa/ /phyag mchod skyabs su song bas sdig lhung dri/ /sbyong mdzad bde bar gshegs pa mda' rtse dang / /rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo 'dod khams mas skor bas/ /srog gcod 'bras bu dus min 'chi ba'i mun/ /thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od kyis mthar bskrad cing / /las nag brnag dka'i rdul rnyog ma lus pa/ /—421 —
