rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)byin rlabs ke ta ka yis drungs par shog /g.yas gsum pa'i gtso bo'i skya bris dbu 'bring pho brang phun tshogs/ /'khor lha sab grags pa/ tshon mdangs mas gro thub dbang / gzhug tshags lcang srung khang rin cen rdo rje/ gser ris mtsho smad rdo rje rnams kyis bgyis/ / stang g.yas pa/zil brtsegasapa'i lhun po rta ljang can/ /brgya phrag gos kyis klubs pa mnyu shrī/ kā la 'bar ba'i brngams brjid mi mthun phyogs/ /ma lus cig car zil gyis gnon 'dra bar/ /'jam dbyangs dkar ser nag dang spyan ras gzigs/ /rnam 'gyur sna tsho gos dmar po skor gsum sogs//(4na〉mas gsum dbang byed nor lha mtha' klas dang / /chos skyong rgyal wo ngal bsos pos bskor mthus/ /gdon rims mi gtsang nyes brgya kun sangs shing / /blo gros rab yangs gdul dka'i 'gro rnams 'dul/ /brtan g.yo dbang sdus lha mi'i thor tshugs rtser/ /rkang sen zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'char bar shog /g.yas bzhi pa'i gtso bo'i skya bris dbu 'bring lha sa 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ 'khor dbu chung stag lung bkra shis/tshon mdangs khyog po dge bsnyen/ gzhug tshogs lcang srung khang rin cen rdo rje/ gser ris mtsho smad rdo rje rnams kyis bgyis/ las 'bras g.ya lnga pa/gzugs 'char mtshun lha'i me long de/ /bskal brgyar gzung yang ngal nus tshe sbyin ma/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo dngos grub bye ba'i mdzod/ /mdzes sku srid zhi'i brtan pa yongs 'phrog mar/ /sna tsho gis 'jigs pa'i 'tshe ba las skyob pa'i/ /'phags ma'i rnam 'gyur zla mig grangs can dang / /drag po gzi ldan dbang phyug stobs log nas/ /sgrol ging gnod sbyin chen pos bskor ba'i mthus/ /srog gi g.yung drung ka ba brtan po la/ /mi gshig rdo rje'i tshe yisargyas btab cing / /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jigs pa dug gi chu/ /bdud rtsi'i g.yang lon ṛ sti'i skrun zlar shog /g.yas lnga pa'i gtso 'khor gyi skya bris dbu 'bring pho brang phun tshogs/ tshon mdangs lha sa brkos pa/ gzhug tshags snye mo ga rma/ gser ris lha sa lags rta mgrin rnams kyis bgyis/ /g.yas drug pa/gaṅgā'i yab gcig zla zhun bye ba yis/ /byugs (4ba)pas sgrun min yid 'phrog lha mo'i gzugs/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis a snya mi 'gyur ba/ /gzhes med lcags kyi srog rtsar grub mdzad la/ /mtha' klas —422

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanazab gter las 'ongs tshe yi lha/ /mtshan dang nyams 'gyur sgyu 'phrul med po che/ /dung skyong rgyal mo zhi rgyas dbang drag gi /'dod khams bdag mo'i rnam rol gyis bskor bas/ /srog gi 'tsho ba don dang ldan byed thabs/ /sgrub yun bskal brgya'i bar der nyi ma'i bu/ /las kyi 'phen pa rdzogs nas yang srid g.yin/ /'dzin pa'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog /g.yas drug pa'i gtso bo'i skya bris dang / /gzhug tshags lha sa 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ 'khor rong pa bsod rgyal/ tshon mdangs zhol blo bzang / gzhug skyong dang gser ris lha sa lags rta mgrin rnams kyis bgyis/ /byang g.yas bdun pa/sems nam mkha'i snying po dregs pa'i gshed/ /gnyan rigs bod skyong rgyal po'i sku yi lha/ /rnam 'gyur brgyad dang gsang yum g.yu sgron ma/ /'jigs rung snang brnyan cho 'phrul cir yang brdzu/ /pho lha mo lha dgra lha srog gi lha/ /yul lhar bcas pa 'go ba'i srung ma yi/ /gcig las du mar 'phros pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /kun rtog 'char sgor 'dzad pa med pa'i lhas/ /nyin mtshan dus drug rnams su mel tshe dang / /srung skyob sba ba'i 'phrin las yongs mdzad de/ /mi nor rigs brgyud 'khor 'bangs bcas pa yi/ /bsams pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /g.yas bdun pa'i gtso bo'i skya bris dang gzhug tshags dbu 'bring lha sa 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ /(5na tshe tshe bor ba nam mgon po bkra shis/tshon mdangs pa nam mgon po bkra shis dang lha sa 'ba' lhug gnyis/ gzhug tshags rong pa bsod rgyal/ gser ris mtsho smad rdo rje rnams kyis bgyis/ /snang g.yon dang po/ba mtha' yas si rgyu rgya mtsho'i klong / brdzus skyes sprul pa'i gar mkhan pad+ma 'byung / /khams gsum dbang sdud srid gsum zil gnon zhing / /khyad par bod 'bangs skye rgu'i gnyen gcig pus/ /las can 'khor lngar bka' stsal le'u bdun ma'i/ /bla ma sku gsum sgrub pa'i bkod pa dang / /'di'i brgyud rigs 'dzin rim byon spel legs 'phreng / /dpal ldan sngags srung rdor legs kyis bskor bas/ /'di dang gtan 'dun bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal/ /re ba bskong ba'i dgos 'dod char 'bebs shing / /chos kyi dbyingasanas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'ja'/ /sprul sku'i zer gyis 'gro kun 'dren par shog /g.yon dang po'i —423

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gtso bo'i skya bris dang gzhug tshags dbu 'bring lha sa 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ 'khor skya bris dang tshon mdangs gzhug tshags rnams rong pa bsod rgyal/ gser ris zhol blo bzang rnams kyis bgyis//bgrang g.yon gnyis pa/yas zhi khre'i lha tshogs lus dkyil la/ /yongs 'dus skyabs gnas mtha' dag kun gyi go /gcig rdzo rigs 'dzin rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /mchog mthun dngos grub char du 'bebs mdzad par/ /bstan pa rmad byung gsol 'debs mnga' bdag rjer/ /stsal ba'i stong thun dngos bstan bkod pa rnams/ /snying (5bsgodzod gter ston dgongs don ltar bkod cing / /dur khrod ma gsum khyab 'jug gis bskor bas/ /bde bar gshegs pa sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha'i/ /thugs rje rang gi sems la rab zhugs te/ /bdud bzhi'i dpung tsho gos mthar byas deng nas bzung / /byang chub bar gyi 'dun ma lhun grub shog /g.yon gnyis pa'i gtso bo'i skya bris dbu 'bring pho brang phun tshogs/ gzhug tshags dbu 'bring lha sa 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ 'khor skya bris dang mtshon mdangs gzhug tshags lha sa grags pa/ gser ris 'o rlon nas dang lha sa grags pa rnams kyis bgyis/ /dag g.yon gsum pa/dang ma dag zhing dbye brdzun pa'i gtam/ /rlung la skur byed srin po'i grong khyer dbus/ /zangs mdog dpal ri'i gzhal med khang bzang du/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i sgyu 'phrul pha mtha' yas/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo 'tsho rgyal mar/ /nyi ma lho nub ma gsungs rten brten pa'i/ /zhing bkod rjes 'brel dur khrod brgyad kyi tshul/ /dbang gi ma mo mched bdun gyis bskor bas/ /'dir snang laṅka'i rgyal khab dang mtshungs su/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal thob cing / /yang srid phyi mar pad+ma 'od zhing du/ /'od gsal bzhi yi lam gyis grol nus shog /g.yon gsum pa'i skya bris dang gzhug tshags snye mo rkadze/ /tshon mdangs rong pa tshe bdag /gser ris lha sa lags rta mgrin rnams kyis bgyis/ /g.yon rga pa/lag na rdo rje drang srong zhi khro'i skur/ /zlos gar bsgyur nas dmod pa'i mtshon cha yis/ /(6na)sde brgyad lus tshogs phye mar 'thag byed pa/ /khro rgyal stobs ldan zhe sdang rdo rje la/ /nam mkha'i snying por spros bral bde chen ma/ /gsungs pa'i brjod bya'i don kun nyer tshang ba/ /mig gi bdud rtsir byed —424

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanadang sgrol ging che/ /stong dpon li byin ha ras yongs bskor bas/ /rdo rje brag ri'i bar du gnod byed tshogs/ /phyer btags lhag ma sdig pa'i zas su rol/ /rigs 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs kyis skye ba nas/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin par shog /g.yon bzhi pa'i gtso bo'i skya bris dbu 'bring pho brang phun tshogs/ 'khor rdo rje brag pa pad+ma kun mkhyen/ tshon mdangs rdo rje brag pa pad+ma kun mkhyen dang mal gro thub dbang / gzhug tshags dbu chung 'o rlon nas/ gser ris dga' ldan rta mgrin rgyal po rnams kyisabagyis/ /rta gzhi lnga pa/skad thengs gsum bsgrags pa'i mod nyid la/ /sdebargyad spyi dang khyad par rgyal bsen gyi/ /don snying dum bur 'gas nus dbang gi rgyal/ /gtum chen gar dgu'i nyams kyis rnam rol bar/ /rtogs brjod ses rgya mtsho cher grags pa/ /rdo rje bdud 'jom la gsungs zhing bkod dang / /skabs su babs pa'i 'phros don ngo mtshar ba/ /bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis bskor bas/ /mgon po gang gi 'gro 'dren dam bci'i khur/ /'dzin par 'dod pa'i sems bskyed kyis drangs nas/ /tshe 'dir 'ja' lus 'pho ba chen pa'i skur/ /'grub pa'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog /g.yon lnga pa'i gtso bo'i skya bris (6brkong gzhug tshags lha sa 'jam dbyangs dbang po/'khor gra sdings mi 'gyur/ tshon mdangs mkhar rtse dge bsnyen rgyal po/ gzhug skyong lcang srung khang rin cen rdo rje/ gser ris lha sa lags rta mgrin rnams kyis bgyis/ /g.yon drug pa/dus kyi dgra bo phyag rgya zil gnon che/ /ban bon byad ma'i gnyen por khros pa'i zhal/ /gnam sa tsam gdangs rab dkar mche ba'i rtser/ /phas rgol khong khrag wu 'phreng 'khrig byed par/ /mu khri btsan por sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin/ /gsungs pa'i gsol 'debs sis rgya mtsho chung / /gdangs dbyangs bya tshul so sor zhal gdams stsal/ /bkra bzang zhing skyong rnams kyis yongs bskor bas/ / yid kyi gdung shugs rgyud mangs glu ji bzhin/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pas gnas lnga las/ /sprul pa legs bstan dang mtshungs byin rlabs rnams/ /bdag sogs 'gro ba kun la 'jug par shog /g.yon drug pa'i gtso bo'i skya bris dang gzhug tshags lha sa 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ 'khor lcang srung khang rin cen rdo rje/—423

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)tshon mdangs mkhar rtse dge bsnyen rgyal po/ gzhug tshags dbu chung 'o rlon nas/ gser ris 'phrang 'go dkon cog rnams kyis bgyis/ g.yon bdun pa/gsang 'dzin lag na rdo rje'i thugs ka sa /mtsho skyes rdo rje sman pa'i rgyal po'i tshul/ /mkha' lding bya nag dug sman sto 'gro dang / /rgod g.yung phag rgod cho 'phrul mtha' klas par/ /lha sras la gsungs bsams pa lhun grub ma'i/ /las tshogos bcu gsum slar yang rnga yab nas/ /slob (7na)dpon bod rjes 'dzin par byon tshul dang / /dpal ldan lha mo nor bzang gis bskor bas/ /sa nad gnyan rgod rims kyi 'tshe ba kun/ /tsha grang nyi zla brdabs pas cher 'thag cing / /'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs ma lus pa/ /bsams don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /g.yon bdun pa'i gtso bo'i skya bris dbu 'bring pho brang phun tshogs/ gzhug tsho gos dbu 'bring lha sa 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ zhing bkod lcang srung khang rin cen rdo rje/ gzhug tshags rong pa bsod rgyal/ gser ris lha sa lags rta mgrin rnams kyis bgyis/gtso thang / ba spu'i bu ga kun nas me dpung dang / /lhan cig khro tshogs nyi ma'i zer rdul ltar/ /'phros pas stong gsum 'byung po'i sbur ma rnams/ /bsreg mdzad rta mchog rol pa khro bo'i rgyal/ /lha khyod dran pa'i mod la yon sbyor bdag /mi nor rigs brgyud bcas par 'tshe ba'i bgegs/ /gnod byed sdebargyad thams cad tshar bcad nas/ /rta skad gcig gi 'og tu zil gyis gnon/ /'bod grogs grong khyer dbus na srin po'i rgyal/ /pad+ma thod phreng drag po'i rol gar can/ /khyod kyis byang chub bar du rjes bzung ste/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /gtso bo'i skya bris dbu 'bring pho brang phun tshogs/ 'khor gra sdings mi 'gyur/ gzhug tshags dbu 'bring lha sa 'jam dbyangs dbang po dang lcang srung khang rin cen rdo rje/gser ris lcang srung khang rin cen rdo rje rnams kyis bgyis/ /'dus ma byas (7ba)pa rang rig chos sku'i rtsal/ /rnam dag dbyings kyi sgron mar longs sku'i zhing / /myul bas bla med ye shes phun tshogs pa/ /'khrul med sprul pa'i zlos gar myur 'byon shog /6ḍi ya ṇa'i mkhan po'i thugs kyi bcud/ /chos rgyal rat+na gling pa'i zab mo'i gter/ /slar yang 'dzin zhing spel ba'i sprul pa'i gar/ /rtsa gsum —426

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ zhenathugs rje'i mthu yis myur 'grub shog /bla ka ras dam la nyer btags pa/ /mthu ldan bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tsho gos rnams kyis// glo bur bams pas rtse gcig gsol btab pa'i/ /'bras bu ji bzhin dus su smin par mdzod/ /ces pa'ang dge slong ye shes phun tshogs kyi slob ma rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang dbang po'o/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin grub pa'i phyag sor gyis/ /legs bteg bum bzang las 'ongs mtho ris chab/ /bdud rtsi snying gi dpal ber 'khyil bar mdzod/ /zil gnon bzhad pa'i che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/ /gang shar chos kun rang sar yongs grol ba/ /ka dag dbyings su lhun grub 'od lnga'i gdangs/ /sprul pa'i zer phreng 'pho med brtan par shog /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gos can gzhir/ /rgyas mdzad mi dbang sku tshe mnga' thang dang / /chab srid 'phel nyid lugs gnyis bka' khrims kyis/ /'bangs rnams rdzogs ldan dga' ston la 'god shog /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i lung bzhin sha 'ug gi /zab chos sgo phye sprul sku gter bdag gling //sku tshe 'phrin (8na gyis mthar phyin rang skal gter/ /bstan 'gro'i don du slar yang bzhes par shog /tshe ring gnam gyi lung gis yangs pa'i sa/ /stobs kyi 'khor los mngon par sgyur ba yis/ /dga' ldan pho brang chos dang srid kyi bstan/ /rgya hor bod khyab 'phel zhing brtan par shog /gter gsar bshad sgrub lugs 'dzin smin grol gling / /thos bsam sgom dang srid zhi'i yon tan tshogs/ /bla nas blar 'phel gangs can bde skyid srog /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i rgyan du mdzes par shog /rigs 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro'i byin rlabs mthu/ /'bar ma ma ning bstan srung rgya mtsho yis/ /smom lam ci btab 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa'ang chos rje kun dga' tshul khrims kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas blo bzang dbang po'o/ /ngag la smra ba'i dbang por dbyangs can lhas/ /gzengs stod blo gros bzang po'i za ma tog /—427—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gtsug lag rgya mtshor 'khyil bas 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /dga' ba'i bshes gnyen mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /bskal par skyil mo krung gcig rdo rje'i khrir/ /bcas te bdag sogs yid can mtha' dag gi /mgon skyabs gling dang dpung du rtag bzhugs nas/ /thugs rje'i byin rlabs snying dbusa'ajug par shog /chos bzhin spyod pa'i 'dod don ma lus pa/ /'bad rtsol dag la bstos min lhun gyis grub/ /nying mtshams sbyar tshe gru 'dzin ri bo'i spor/ /skyes te phyag na pad+ma rjes bzung shog /cesapa 'di yang bla ma ngag dbang don ldan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /ba so sprul sku ngag gi (8ba'i bang phyug mchog /dkon mchog nyi ma'i thugs dam rten thang 'di//bzhengs pas srid zhi'i bzhed don lhun grub ste/ /'gro kun byang chub chen por 'dren gyur cig /cesapa'ang sprul sku rin po che ngag dbang dkon cog nyi ma'i thugs dam rten gyi rgyab yig sh+lauka gcig pa zhig dgos tshul bzhin za hor gyi brnyes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /thang pa'i gdan sang ga dbang dpal bzang gis/ /tshigs gsum nos pa mkhan po'i 'dra 'bag 'di/ /bskrun pa'i dge bas skye bar sangs rgyas kyi/ /rjes su zhugs nas bya ba byed par shog /bstan rtsaso thar 'dul khrims mchogo tu gtsang / /rlabs chen spyod pas ris med 'gro rnams 'dren/ /gsang sngags theg pa nye ba'i lam brgyud de/ /'gro kun bcu gsum rdo rje'i sar khrid shog /ngag gi dbang phyug thang pa'i lung rtogs gnyis/ /spel bar dpal ldan bzang po'i skal ba can/ khri1ba rigs yongs kyi bstan la 'phrin las rnams/ /dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel zhing rgyas par shog /ces stag lung gdan sa pa ka drug pa ngag dbang dpal bzang gis nged rang gi gzugs brnyan 'bri bar mdzad pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rgyal kun 'dus pa rnga yab gling pa yi/ /thugs rje'i nyi ma'i 'od kyis mtshun lha'i mun/ /mthar byas 'chi med grub pa'i phan dang bde'i/ /snang ba dam pas khams gsum yongs khyab shog /tha snyad —428

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ zhedamado sngags gzhud lugs rgya mtsho che/ /smra mkhas ngag gi dbang phyug chos rnams la/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dpal gyis dbang 'byor ba/ /'jig rten mig gcig bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /sgrub sdebargyad dang 'bar ma ma (9na)ning sogs/ /yi dam chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /rigs 'dzin chos rjer sngar gyi sri ga kun/ /rab zhi g.yung drung lta bur brtan par shog /lo wo ngag dbang chos dpal gyi brtan bzhugs shig dgos zhes chos mdzad ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis bskul ba ltar za hor brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /be+eḍūrla mdog mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar ba/ /thugs sprul mi bskyod rdo rje lhung bzed bsnams/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po che/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis legs gsungs ston pa po/ /de bzhin sku dang yon tan gsung sprul la/ /g.yu thog rnying ma'i gdung rabs rnam par thar/ /skal bzang yid ches bskyed pa'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /'byul med zhing bkod mig gi bdud rtsi'i dpyid/ /dge 'bras gso dpyad ma dros mtsho chen las/ /lha mi drang srong mu stegs tshe'i rig byed/ /chu klung rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i dug gsum po/ /des bskyed nad kyi rnyog dri yongs ga khyud shog /sman rgyal rigs 'dus g.yu thog legs bshad kyi/ /bdud rtsi skye bar btungs pas thar pa dang / /kun mkhyen ye shes lcags kyi srog rtsa yis/ /'chi med gtan gyi mdun ma 'grub byin rlobs/ /gso rig ring lugs srid mthar 'phel zhing rgyas/ /bstan dang de 'dzin skyes bu zhabs pad brtan/ /sa spyod sku tshe chab 'bangasamanga' thang dar/ /'jig rten kun tu bde skyid 'byung bar shog /yon sbyor dar mo dpon tshang sman rams pa'i/ /'di phyi gtan gyi legs tshogs (9ba〉pa lus pa/ /bsam don ji bzhin 'bad med lhun grub par/ /sman bla drang srong brgyud pas thugs rjes zungs/ /'gro la srog 'tsho mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i sman/ /rab bskrun gtsug lag be+eḍūrla yi 'phreng / /bshad sgrub srad bur brgyus nas chad med du//'jig rten gsum gyi bsod nams dpal 'bar shog /ces dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags kyis sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi ston pa lnga la g.yu thog gsar rnying gi rnam thar gyis—429

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bskor ba/ rnam sras gtso 'khor/ sman bla dang sgrol dkar so sor stong thang re bzhedas pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rab dkar sku sprul rnam par snang mdzad lha/ /'khor lo lhung bzed 'dzin pas bshad pa'i rgyud/ /ji ltar stsal ba'i tshigs don ma lus pa/ /skal ldan 'gro ba kun gyis rtogs par shog /yon tan sprul pa rin cen 'byung ldan che/ /nor bu lhung bzed bsnams pas man ngag rgyud/ /gsungs ltar 'gro ba'i gtsug nas rkang mthil bar/ /nad rnams 'joms pa'i sman gyi ljon par shog /mdog dmar snang mtha' gsung sprul zhu ba po/ /pad+ma lhung bzed 'dzin pas slad mar yang / /rigs lnga 'dus pas sman gyi bla ma la/ /chos 'khor chad med rtag tu bskul gyur cig /mdog ljang 'phrin las sprul pa don grub rigs/ /rgya gram lhung bzed 'dzin pas phyi ma'i rgyud/ /gsungs pa ji bzhin sman dpyad thog mda' yis/ /nad gdon brag ri phye mar 'thag par shog /brgya phrag nyi ma'i (10na/sdod kyang zil gnon pa/ /ngal bsos po yi zhal dang ne'u le'i khar/ /babs pa'i phun tsho gos 'dod dgu'i char chen pos/ /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag drungs 'byin shog /thugs rje snyigs ma'i dus 'dir cher lhag pa/ /sman gyi bla ma'i sku brnyan stong phrag gi /grangs ldan bzhengs pas srid dang zhi ba yi/ /bde skyid dpal la spyod par byin gyis rlobs/ /spyan bdun gzigs pa'i mod la nyi bu'i dpung / /mkha' mthar bskrad de 'chi med bdud rtsi'i srog /'tsho ba don ldan ster ba'i stong phrag sku/ /bzhengs mthus tshe sbyin lha mos rjes zungs shig /tshe dpag med mgon phyag gi bum bzang las/ /'chi med zil mngar chu rgyun rab sbrengs te/ /sprul sku ngag dbang kun dga' bde legs la/ /mi 'gyur g.yung drung ltar brtan dbang bskur stsol/ /mkha' 'gro sde lnga snang srid lha 'dre yis/ /zhing g.yin 'dren pa'i bsun ma phyir bzlog nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i skur/ /sra brtan khri la g.yo ba med par shog /bde ba can dang pad+ma 'od zhing mgon/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bo thod phreng rtsal/ /yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /—430

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanabyin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin phung dbab tu gsol/ /mtshan bcas mtshan med rnam par dkar ba yi/ /rgya che rim gro'i sa bon yongs smin las/ /sku tshe'i snye ma dar drag 'bras bu la/ /skal bzang gdul bya kun gyis longs spyod shog /thub bstan srung bar zhal bzhes ye shes mgon/ /lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams (10ba)kyis/ /yid srubs sde las rnam par rgyal ba yi/ /ru mtshon srid rtser bsgreng ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces gnas rnying sprul pa'i skur brjod don 'di lta bu yod pa'i brtan bzhugs yang yang 'bul dgos tshul thang sras dang / gnas rnying gi rta sgo lha btsan gnyis kyis lung bstan ltar drung chen dang ri bo bde chen gyi dbu mdzad kyis bskul ma byung ba bzhin za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /dge 'dis dkon cog rnam gsum thugs rje'i mthus/ /dga' ldan pho brang chos dang srid kyi bstan/ /de 'dzin ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /bskal brgyar zhabs zung rdo rje ltar brtan shog/sa yi dbang phyug sangs rgyas rgya mtsho yi/ /sku tshe mnga' thang chab srid ma lus pa/ /rnam mang thos pa'i sras la 'gran nus par/ /bla ma yi dam srung mas byin gyis rlobs/ /lhag bsam ston zla ltar dkar rgyu sbyor ba/ /'dir snang tshe ring nad med bde skyid 'phel/ /skye bar lha mi'i rten bzang nyer brgyud nas/ /bla med byang chub myur du thob par shog /ces pa 'di'ang dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags ris med la mang bkol dus tshogs 'don dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /za hor rigs las tshangs sras ma/ /bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i 'dra 'bag 'di/ /bskrun pas ngag dbang kun tu dga'/ /phun tshogs bde legs brtan khyab shog /brgya phrag zla zhun (11na〉grags pas bsgrun min pa/ /mtshar sdug lang tsho'i dpal gyi 'jo sgeg can/ /'chi med tshe dpal mchog sbyin phyag rgya yis/ /'gro kun rdo rje'i srog tu 'grub byin rlobs/ /lnga rig gzhung brgyar brjod pa rnam dag ngag /dbang phyug blo yi ma dros klung chen las/ /legs bshad rnam bzhi'i chu bo skal bzang gi /thos 'dzin —431 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rgya mtsho'i klong du 'bab par shog /phas rgol 'byog tshig mtshon char 'jigs med pa/ /lung rigs btsan po'i go chas thub bstan srog /yongs skyob 'khor lo gsum gyi lang tsho'i 'phrul/ /sdebazhi'i sgo 'phar rtag tu 'byed par shog /'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i ral gyis ma rig rgya/ /phral bas mun sangs dga' ston snang ba'i dpyid/ /thar lam gsal byed mdza' bshes dpung gnyen mchog /rdo rje'i khri la nam yang g.yo med shog /rgyal kun ngo bo rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa rab spel chos dang srid/ /zung 'brel khrims kyis gyen 'degs mi yi dbang / /sku tshe mnga' thang chab 'bangs dar bar shog /nyon mongs dgra bcoms sbas ti chen po yis/ /legs btab skye ba lung gi chos kyi sde/ /byams mgon bstan pa ma shar de srid du/ /swā la'i sman ljongs mdzes pa'i rgyan du shog /kun bzod rab yangs pha mtha' bsod nams kyi/ /do rar yongs su chud pa 'pheg rten 'dir/ /nad mtshon dbul sogs lnga bdo'i chad pa rnams/ /nyer zhi sim pa'i tshor ba rtag myong shog /'dis mtsho ni dus gsum yongs bsags rnam dkar gyi/ /sa bon (11ba tshe smon lam drod gsher gyis smin te/ /sa bcu lam lnga dzam+bha tri sha'i 'bras/ /ku ba'i gser gyi snye mar 'gyur bar shog /rnam 'dren de'i gsung legs 'dzin skye 'phags tshogs/ /lha dang drang srong bden pa'i tshig la dbang / /slu med rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i mthus/ /re ba'i 'dod don ma lus 'grub par shog /ces bden pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni khyams pa slob dpon bkra shis tshul khrims rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /pad+ma 'dab rgyas rjes 'gro dngul dkar sder/ /srang grangs bcu bzhi las grub ba kla snod/ /dpal 'byor rgya mtshos rtsa gsum spyan snga sa /phul dges don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /ces phan bde legs bshad gling gi dge skos thog spyi rdzas su phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos rje btsun tsong kha pa'i/ /sku brnyan dge slong dpal 'byor rgya mtsho yis//—432

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ rton)gser zangs las grub bzhengs pas tshe rabs kun/ /'bral ba med par rjes su 'dzin par shog /ces pa'ang za hor bsdos bkod/ /sdom brtson dpal 'byor rgya mtshos gser zangs rgyur/ /nyer bzhengs 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gzugs/ /bskrun pas dad pa'i rin cen them skas la/ /'dzegs nas nges legs grong du bgrod par shog /ces pa'ang za hor bzhes bkod/ /mkhyen brtse nus (12na sgong 'a sangs rgyas gar gyi dbang / /bden gnyis cho me phung dbyangs snyan tshe yi gzungs/ /rig grol dpal ldan rgyal sras dge 'dun te/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i gzi 'od deng 'bar mdzod/ /gtsug lag bye bar brjod pa rnam dag ngag /dbang phyug grub pa'i blo gros skal bzang gi /rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i ring lugs rgya mtsho'i gting / /dpogs nus 'jigs med bshes gnyen rtag brtan shog /thos bsam sgom pa'i go cha btsan po can/ /thub bstan ru bzhi'i dpung gis bdud tshogs kyi/ /g.yul las rgyal ba'i lang tsho dar drag pa'i/ /sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar 'byed phyir slu med shog /ma rig mun sangs chos nor 'dod thar la/ /'jug pa'i blo rgyas lugs gnyis rgya mtsho'i mtha'/ /mkhyen dpyod rdzings kyis brgal nas bde skyid dbyig /'dren pa'i sa dbang g.yung drung ltar brtan shog /dga' ba brgya pa'i rjes 'gro rdzogs ldan gyi/ /rnam thar sgo bzhi phye ba'i pho brang che'i/ /khrims gnyis gser 'khor dzasbu'i ljon pa yis/ /mtshan pa'i kun bzod lto bar rtag bsgyur shog /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi lung rtogs dam pa'i chos/ /'brul bral tshul bzhin 'dzin pa'i mdo rgyud sde/ /klog dang spong ba las kyi 'khor lo'i rgyun/ /srid mtha' de snyed tshad med 'phel bar shog /dbul phongs 'thab rtsod nad mtshon dus min du/ /'chi sogs cher snyigs lnga bdo'i chad pa'i mun/ /pha mthar byed pa legs byas rta bdun can/ /'jig rten khams kyi dgung du 'char bar shog /sgo gsum nyer (12ba)bde sman sngags mthu nus 'grub/ /lha min 'byung po rang rgyud zhi zhing dul/ /lo tog rtsi bcud tshong gi kho spogs 'phel/ /srid 'byor yongs 'du'i snyem g.yur za —433

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)shog /mang thos don bsam sgom pa'i them skas la/ /nges 'byung byang sems stong nyid bskyed rdzogs kyi/ /gom stabs lhod por 'dzegs nas sku bzhi dang / /ye shes lnga ldan grong du bgrod par shog /'di'i ched yon sbyor gyis mtsho ni bdag gzhan gyi/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i legs byas ji snyed pa/ /nam mkha'i mthas kyang gzhal dka'i lus can rnams/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang thob rgyur bsngo/ /dkon cog rin cen rnam gsum thugs rje dang / /bcud ldan rig 'dzin drang srong bden pa'i tshig /rten 'brel slu med mthu yis 'gro kun la/ /yongs khyab phan bde'i bkra shis 'dod 'jo shog /ces pa 'di'ang dbus gtsang gi grub mtha' ris su ma phye ba mtha' dag gis mgrin gcig tu bden tshig brjod bde ba zhig brtsams nas 'dzugs dgos zhes rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag na la lha'i bco brgyad chos rje mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub kyis bkras btags nyin mo bde legs ma/gos phyi nang rta sogs dgu tshan gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas 'bad rtsol chen po'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi ban+de tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje lcags mo bya lo cho 'phrul gyi zla ba'i yar tshes dge bar pho brang dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa bsam mthong lo tsā bas bgyis pa sirnyi ra stu/ /nam mkha'i (13na〉na zugs rnams gzhan du ma gyur bar/ /mi shigs skyil krung gcig bcas tshe dpag med/ /mdzod spu'i zer gyis srid 'khyams 'gro kun gyi/ /dus min 'chi ba'i smag rum mthar skrod cig /mgrin par 'jam mgon gzhen nu'i 'jo sgeg la/ /tshangs sras lha mos nyer 'byud bzhad pa'i sgra/ /gzhom med rdo rje'i glur len ngag gi dbang / /blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho brtan par shog /rdzogs sangs rgyas bstan rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas par/ /bla nas blar 'degs gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dbang phyug sku tshe mnga' thang chab srid gang / /rnam thos bu yi mched por 'gran nus shog /bka' brgyud gtsug rgyan dpal ldan sgam po pa'i/ /sprul sku rim par byon rnams mgon khyod dang / /bral med mtha' klas rnam dkar 'phrin las rgyun/ /rgya cher spel ba'i ba ched don lhun grub shog /bshad sgrub bstan pa kha ba'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /dbyar gyi chu gter lta bur rab 'phel —434

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanazhing / /'jig rten khams su rdzogs ldan gsar pa yi/ /bde skyid rtse dga' khong nas rgod par shog /kun la snyoms par 'jug pa mchog gsum gyi/ /thugs rje nyi ma'i dngos brgya 'bar ba'i lus/ /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par rgya hor bod/ /skye rgu'i bsod nams mkha' la 'char bar shog /ces nged rang dang sde pa'i ring 'tsho sprul sku rin po che nyid ngos kyi gam du zhakhrungs shing ji ltar bzhed pa'i 'phrin las bsgrub nus pa'i bden tshig smon lam dang bcas pa zhig dwags nang gi chos sde khag dang (13ba)rgyal por mang ja 'gyed bcas gang lcogs thog 'dzugs rtsis yin pas rtsoms shig par dwags lha sgam po nas sprul sku rin po che blo bzang 'phrin las rnam rgyal nges don grub pa'i shing rta mchog gi sde'i gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs te za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /rtsa gsum byin rlabs rten 'brel slu med mthus/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho bskal brgya'i bar/ /rdo rje ltar brtan thugs rje bdag snying la/ /zhugs nas 'di phyi'i don gnyas lhun grub shog/ces pa'ang gzhis ka ba blo bzang chos ldan gyi ngag 'don du bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos bkod/ /phan bde legs bshad gling du nyer gsum srang / /grangs ldan dngul kong blo bzang thogs med kyis/ /phul bas srid zhi'i mun sel ye shes che/ /sgron mes zung 'jug mngon sum mthong bar shog /ces pa'ang rab 'byams grwa skor gyi tshe dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /mtshan dpe nyi ma stong gi gzi byin gyis/ /'gro la phan bde'i snang ba ches dkar bas/ /cher snyigs lnga bdo'i smag rum mthar mdzad pa/ shwakya'i skyes mchogo mthong thos dran kun grol/ /mgon po khyod dang mnyam pa'i spang rtogs kyi/ /yon tan pha rol son kyang gdul bya'i ngor/ /theg dman dgra bcom tshul 'dzin gnas brtan che/ /bcu drug bstan pa'i mtha' rnyed mngon sum bzhugs//rgyal dang de sras slob mar bcas pa rnams/ /(14na)ris med skye rgur brtse yang zhi ba'i dbyings/ /gzugs sku ma bsdus 'dod khams gnas so sor/ /legs bzhugs zug rngu 'byin cing sim pa ster//—435

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)de phyir thub dbang gnas brtan brgya drug gi/snang bas bris thang bdun la nyer tshang ba//lha bzo chos skyong spun dang mar bcas pas/rnam dag bsam dang sbyor bas bzhengs pa'i mthus//dus kyi chos nyid gyur ba dpal lha yi//bgrang ring skye bar rab bsags sdig lhung dang //las nye zhe 'bras bu brnag dka'i sdug bsngal dri//thugs rje chu rgyun gyis bkrus dag par shog/tshe rabs kun tu lha mi'i rten bzang mchog/nyer brgyud 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po la//thos bsam sgom pa'i rdzings kyis legs bsgral nas//myang 'das nor bu'i gling du bgrod par shog/rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas gnas skabs lha mi yi//bde skyid dpal la spyod cing ring min du//rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mchog/ma wa zhe gyur 'gro ba ma lus 'dren par shog/yid dga' chos 'dzin gnas su rin po che'i//cod pan dbu la bcings nas rgyal tshab tu//bzhugs kyang bskal bzang rnam 'dren lnga pa sa/ring min dbus 'gyur 'chang 'byon ma pham mgon//khyod kyi dam bca'i gzungs sngags thos so cog/gnas ngan las drangs byang chub la 'god par//zhal 'tshes rdo ba'i ri mo slu med du//mi 'gyur dpyod ldan mtha' dag som nyi bral//brgya phrag snang brnyan ras dkar rdzing bu'i ngos//'char byed khyod zhal 4bskom mkha'i zla ba yi//dpal lha ngan song gsum mun la 'byon pa//rab gsal mngon mtho'i kun+da bzhad byin rlobs//dmigs yul yon sbyor gyis mtsho ni mkha' mnyam gyi//sems can mtha' dag srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis su//ma lhungs dbu mar gnas pa rdzogs sangs rgyas//thob phyir byams mgon phyag ring gtsug rkyong mdzod//ces pa'ang lha bzo ba chos skyong nang mir bcas pas tshe 'das dpal lha'i don du thub dbang la gnas bcus bskor ba dang ma pham mgon po'i brgya thang bzhengs par rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so//nam mkha'i rang bzhin gzhan du ma gyur bar//mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan mngon sum rab gsal ba//bde ldan zhing na bzhugs kyang 'dza/ gling 'dir//thugs rjes nyer gzigs spyan dkyus

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ rton)ring por khyongs/ /pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs 'dzin saḥyig mthar/ /gzungs sngags 'khor lo 'od zer dra ba can/ /kun khyab snang bas dus kyi pho nya'i mun/ /mthar byas skye rgu ma lus dbugs phyungs shig /rmad byung thugs rje bskul ba'i gsol 'debs rnga/ /lhag bsam rnam dag dbyu gus bsnun pa'i mthus/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho mgon khyod dang / /dbyer med rigs kyi bdag por brtan par shog /rdzogs sangs rgyas dngos 'jam dpal snying po'i bstan/ /'degs la mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar rgya che zhing / /mtsho ltar gting zab gnam (15na)sa'i dbang phyug mchog /gzhes med rdo rje'i ngo bor lhun grub shog /sku tshe rigs brgyud phun tshogs dpal 'byor kun/ /gser gyi 'khor lo sgyur rgyal ji bzhin gyi/ /khrims gnyis gnya' shing mnga' 'bangs phrag pa la/ /lci ba'i rdzogs ldan dus kyi rjesa'agror lha/ga /thub pas legs gsungs bgrang yas mdo rgyud chos/ /'gal med byang chub bsgrub la gdams pa sa /nges par 'char ba kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs thos bsam sgom pasa'aphel rgyas shog /bstan 'di gyen du 'degs la rnam dag sems/ /ches dkar rgya hor bod sogasa'adzam gling du/ /gnas pa'i 'gro kun 'di phyi bar gsum gyi/ /phan bde'i don rnams bde blag 'grub par shog /'dus tshogs 'dir yang 'dul khrims rtsa ba brtan/ /klog pa thos bsam sdong po yal ga rgyas/ /spong ba bsam gtan 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud/ /las kyi 'khor lo'i lo 'dab sdug por shog /rtsi bcud lo tog khe spogs rkang bzhi dar/ /sman sngags mthu ldan nad can nad las grol/ /mi dang mi min 'byung po'i gdug rtsub zhi/ /'jig rten khams su bde skyid 'phel bar shog /yon sbyor gyis mtsho ni bdag g.yin 'gro rnams kyi/ /dge 'bras gnas skabs lha mi'i dga' ston dang / /mthar thug bla med ye shes ring min du/ /thob pa'i skal pa bzang por 'gyur bar shog /thub bstan bsrung mdzad legs ldan lcam dral dang / /gtsang ris dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs/ /mthu chen dkar phyogs skyong ba'i (15ba)tshogs rnams kyis/ /bsams pa'i don kun 'grub pa'i grogs byed shog /ces nged rang dang sde pa'i rim gro gtso bor gyur pa'i smon lam gyi bden brjod tshig sbyor —437

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gsal zhing 'jam bde ba zhig 'bras spungs dang ri bo chos gling sogs chos sde kha shas su 'dzugs rtsis yin bas dgos zhes mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /yid bzhin mtsho dbus pad sdong ze'u 'bru'i steng / /bde chen gar gi nyams ldan tshe dbang rtsal/ /stong nyid snying rje'i rang gdangs 'tsho rgyal ma/ /mnyam sbyor dngas mas srog gi ka ba tshugs/ /tsaṇ+ḍasnyi sogs 'chi med lha tshogs kyis/ /mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro lha srin gdug can gyi/ /bsun ma'i lam chod bla tshe srog 'phrog pa'i/ /rtsub sems dpal zhi phyir bzlog 'phrin las mdzod/ /'khor 'das yongs kyi phyag rgya zil gnon par/ /kun bzang 'jam mgon rig pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /gang shar rang grol rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i byed skur brtan gyur cig /gangs can lugs gnyis skyong ba mu khri btsan/ /gnam sa'i khyon la stobs kyi 'khor lo yis/ /dbang sgyur sangs rgyas rgya mtsho g.yung drung gi /a lha ka ba nyer tshugs zhabs brtan shog /rigs brgyud dpal 'byor longs spyod mnga' thang sogs/ /ngal bsos po yi bsod nams skal mnyam zhing / /'jig rten gsum gyi gtsug na zhabs sen zla/ /'char bar mes po tshangs pa'i (16na)mched por shog shwakya seng ge'i ring lugs ma lus dang / /khyad par zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan/ /lha gcig snying stobs brtson pa'i dpung pa yi/ /nyer bteg srid mtha'i bar du yar rgyas shog /mtha' bzhi dbus kyi 'bangs su gtogs so cog /nad mtshon dbul phongs sdug bsngal kun zhi zhing / /ring po'i tshe dang mkho dgu'i 'byor pa rnams/ /lha yi grong khyer sa la 'phos 'drar shog /'khor 'das yongs kyi yon tan ma lus pas/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs 'byung ba'i/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i gling 'di nyer bkang ste/ /srid mtha'i bar du dar zhing rgyas par shog /'dis mtshon thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /bsags pa'i bsod nams phung por spungs pa las/ /deng nas byang chub bar du phun tshogs kyi/ /mdun ma mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par shog /khrims ldan rigs 'dzin 'dus gling —438

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ zhedatshogs rnams kyis/ /lhag bsam rnam dag kun blangs bden brjod dang / /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba slu med mthus/ /smon lam rab btab re ba 'bras ldan shog /srid gsum dbang sgyur dmag zor lha mo sogs/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gos rnams kyis/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las dang / /bkra shis dpal gyis dus kun khyab par mdzod/ /ces ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad don bzang la tshig 'jam bde ba grwa tshang du 'dzugs rgyu zhig dgos zhes mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams (16ba)pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /so so thar dang rgya chen spyod pa'i gzhung / /zab mo lta ba rdo rje theg pa yi/ /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma kun 'dus pa/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /gsang ba 'dus pa gshed skor bde dgyes dang / /dus 'khor rdor dbyings rnam snang mngon byang sogs/ /rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i lha tshogs kun 'dus pa/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam snang nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs/ /rigs lnga bskal bzang rnam 'dren stong la sogs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /byams pa rigs gsum mgon sogs rgyal ba'i sras/ /mtha' klas zhing khams rgya mtshor sems dpa' yi/ /tshul 'dzin rgyal sras 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /tsho gos spyod bse ru skyes bu zung bzhi dang / /gang zag ya brgyad la sogs nyan rang gi /skye 'phags dge 'dun 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang / /thub pa'i spyan sngar bstan pa bsrung ba sa /zhal bzhes chos skyong 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /mi phyed dad pa'i snying dbus me long du//skyabs gnas kun gyi thugs rje'i gzugs 'char ba/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i ngo bor zhabs brtan shog /tshe cig nyid la smin grol zab lam (17na)gyi/ /bcu —439

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar 'god pa/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /yi dam kun 'dus ngo bor zhabs brtan shog /mthong thos dran dang reg pa ma lus kun/ /'di phyi'i gtan mdun 'grub pa'i byed po mchog /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i ngo bo zhabs brtan shog /bdag gzhan mnyam par brje ba'i sems bzang pos/ /srid zhi'i 'ching ba kun las grol mdzad pa/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /byang sems 'dus pa ngo bor zhabs brtan shog /nges par 'byung ba'i khrims la mchog dman kun/ /bkod nas thar pa'i lam la bkri mdzad pa/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /nyan rang 'dus pa'i ngo bor zhabs brtan shog /nad gdon bgegs sogs bar gcod thams cad las/ /bsrung zhing skyob pa'i mthu stobs nus ldan pa/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /sna chas srung 'dus pa'i ngo bor zhabs brtan shog /smon lam btab pa ji bzhin mgon po khyod/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku bzhin 'khor ba'i mtha'/ /stongs min bar du gzugs sku bkod pa mchog /g.yo med rdo rje lta bur brtan par shog /dge 'dis zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan/ /byams pa bstan pa ma shar de srid du/ /'jig rten gsum gyi skyabs mgon dpung gnyen du/ /ches cher dar zhing yun du gnas par shog /dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu rgyal po/ /btsun mo sras blon 'bangs 'khor skye ba kun/ /blo bzang (17ba)grags pa'i bstan dang legs mjal zhing / /chos dang srid kyi 'dzin skyong spel nus shog /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes bzung nas/ /mgon khyod mnyes pa kho na legs bsgrub cing / /lugs gnyis 'phrin las rgyas pa byed por shog /bstan dang bstan 'dzin gtsug tu nyer bstan nas/ /skye ba kun tu thos bsam sgom pa'i mthus/ /sa dang lam gyi them skas rim 'dzegs te/ /'gro 'dren sangs rgyas go 'phang myur thob shog /slu med dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje dang / /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i mthu stobs kyis/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag bo shog thu rgyal po/ /sku tshe rigs brgyud mnga' thang rgyas par shog /mkha' la nyi zla gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge /—440

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (na)sa la phun tshogs bde skyid g.yang du chags/ /phyogs dus kun du bsam don lhun grub pa'i/ /thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i bkra shis shog /ces skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi brjod bya dang 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bstan pa rin po che la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang snying stobs phul du byung bas chos rgyal mya ngan med dang tshul mtshungs pa mi'i dbang phyug dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu rgyal pos rgyang ring nas gsol ba btab pa la brten/ rang la de lta bu'i yon tan med kyang gdul bya la yid ches kyi mos pa yod phyin byin rlabs 'jug pa rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin pas za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mchog dman kun gyis go bde phyir snyan dngags kyi (18na tshe pam nas ma drangs par 'bol rtsom du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags ram pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /phyag rdor dbang phyug blo gros rnam rgyal dang / /brag gdong sngags rams gsum gyi dung la bum bcur/ /dgu bcu'i srang grangs dkon gnyer las 'dzin dus/ /rab dkar bsam pas phul ba'i dge tsho gos kyis/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling / /srid mtha'i bar du dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /'di phyi gtan gyi sdug bsngal mun bsal nas/ /sgo gsum skyid pa'i snang bas kun khyab shog /ces pa'ang za hor ban+de bris/ /gser zhun brtsegs pa'i lhun po brgya phrag nyis/ /lan brgyar 'khyud pas bsgrun min mtshan dpe'i dpal/ /rab 'bar gdul dka'i 'gro 'dren shākya'i tog /mthong thos dran pas rnam grol zasagatsang sras/ /dbu sems mdo sde bye smra'i grub mtha' la/ /mkhas pa'i rtser son rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang / /gang gi rjes su 'jug la nyer smon pa/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i snang brnyan rnams/ /blo bzang skyes mchog dad pas bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /tshe ring nad med longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /skye bar lha mi'i rten bzang legs brgyud nas/ /ring por mi thogs sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces pa'ang rnam gling pa blo bzang skyes mchog gis thang ga'i rgyab yig dgos tshul bzhin za hor —441—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /tha mal so skye'i bags chags nyer goms (18ba)pas/ /dug gsum gom stabs shugs drag gnyis 'thung la/ /'phags chen dam pa'i seng ger sgro btags nas/ /thub bstan gangs ri'i spo la 'gying ba mtshar/ /'on te gdul bya'i dad pa dngas ma'i mtshor/ /sangs rgyas dngos kyi zla gzugasayongs shar na/ /byin rlabs thogs med 'jug pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ khyu gos bslu ba med la gang gi bston/ /de phyir bdag 'dra'i gzugs brnyan bris pa'i dges/ /skye bar theg pa mchog gi bshesaganyen gyis/ /rjes su bzung nas 'khor 'das legs tshogs kun/ /yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang skyid thang nor bu'i 'dod sbyar bzhi za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ / yid dga' chos 'dzin gnas su theg chen gyi/ /tshig don rgyun chad med par rtag gsung yang //'dzam bu'i gling 'dir thugs rje'i spyan ras dkyus/ /btsa' bar mi g.yel ma pham mgon po kye/ /gang gi snang brnyan ri mo bris pa dang / /dam bca'i gzungs sngags bzlas brjod lhur blangs pas/ khyu sbyor nor bus mtshon pa'i sems can rnams/ /gnas ga gang du skyes kyang myur du drongs/ / 'di nas 'phos te rim brgyud skye ba kun/ /lha mi'i rten bzang thob cing dam chos dang / /rab mjal thos bsam sgom pas ring min du/ /nges par legs pa'i go 'phang mngon 'gyur shog /khyad par dbus 'gyur 'chang du rje btsun nyid/ /mchog gi sprul skur mngon sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ /bdag sogs 'dus pa dang po'i 'khor (19na〉spyar nas/ /bdud rtsi'i thog ma longs su spyod par shog /'dis mtsho ni thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /bsags pa'i rnam dkar dge tshogs ma lus pa/ /nam mkha'i pha mtha' dang mnyam sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di'ang skyid thang nor busathang ga'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyis brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang pho/ /—442

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ 9)mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs/ /dran pa'i mod la 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa kun/ /nyer zhi mngon mtho nges legs la sbyor ba/ shwakya seng ges tshe rabs gtan du skyongs/ /rigs gsum mkhyen brtse'i nus mthu 'phrul po che/ /bshes gnyen dam par shar ba tsong kha pa'i/ /bstan la skye bar zhugs nas mdo rgyud don/ /thos bsam sgom pa pha mthar phyin par shog /sgyu mas sprul pa'i mkha' lding nam mkha'i mtha'/ /'jal ba'i don byed nus ltar gdul bya yi/ /grangs med bsod nams bye ba'i zhing gyur pa/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /mthong ba'i mod la khro rgyal mtha' dag gi /lag cha stabs gcig 'chor nus ma lha'i zhal/ /'jam dpal zhi khros deng nas tshe rabs kun/ /rjes su bzung nas don gnyis 'grub par shog /gang gi sku la skyabs gnas ma lus tshogs/ /tshang bar nges shes brtan pos gsol btab pa/ /ji bzhin lhun gyis grub par 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /dga' ba'i bshes gnyen khyod kyis bdag rjes zungs/(19ba)/rgyal kun 'dus pa blo bzang grags pa yi/ /legs gsungs mdo sngags lam gyi rim pa'i gnad/ /tshul bzhin nyams su bstar bas tshe gcig la/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar bgrod shog /ces bying pa byams pa nor bu dang rnam rgyal gnyis kyi dad rten du thub dbang / rje bla ma/ 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag gsum la lam rim brgyud pas bskor ba/ 'jigs byed/ 'di ga dang / rje bla ma'i sku brnyan bzhedas pa'i rgyab yig dgosatshul ltar ja hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /rang byung lus kyi pho brang la rdzogs pa/ /rdo rje'i slob dpon ngag dbang blo yi gter/ /skal bzang rgya mtsho'i gnyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod rma byas bteg pa'i rin cen khri/ /pad zla'i gdan la tshe mtha' yas pa'i skur/ /zhengs nas bskal brgyar mi 'gyur rtag bzhugs te/ /chos 'khor rgyun chad med par skor bar shog /bdag sogs 'di nas nying mtshams sbyar ma thag /bde ba can du 'jam mnyen pad+ma la/ /brdzus skyes gar dbang lha yis rjes bzung nas/ /'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon byed par shog khyun gyi kha rtan byed rgyu —443

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes rta ra mdo pa ngag dbang lhun grub kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dkon cog go /rgyal yum seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma la/ /bzlas brjod phyag 'tshal gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /seng ge glang (20na)chen chom rkun me dang sbrul/ /lcags sgrog sha za chu bo'i 'jigs las skyob/ /mdor na sngon dang 'phral rkyen las byung ba'i/ /dug mtshon nad rims bkres phongs 'thab rtsod dang / /mthu byad lha 'dre'i dal kha zug pa sogs/ /bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar shog /yun du 'tsho zhing lus ngag yid gsum bde/ /dpal 'byor snyan grags mnga' thang longs spyod 'phel//srid pa'i legs tshogs sems la gang bsams pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs//tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gags dus gru 'dzin zhes/ /phyag na pad+ma'i zhing du nyer drangs nas/ /theg chen chosal thos bsam sgom pa yis/ /lus can mtha' dag byang grol sar 'god shog /mdor na deng nasasangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /bcom ldan 'phags ma sgrol mas 'bral med du/ /rjes bzung lung bstan dbugs dbyung legs mdzad de/ /phan dang bde ba'i dpal la sbyor bar shog /ces rje btsun sgrol ma la 'dod don gsol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni rgyal sras lha bzang klu dbang gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /bla sman shākya dbang phyug sprul pa'i gar/ /gling stod blo bzang chos kyi rgya mtsho yi/ /yang srid gso dpyad smra la ngag gi dbang / /'tsho byed gzhen nu gnyis par gsol ba 'debs/ /skye mang goms pas tshe yi rig byed chab/ /blo gros hub kyis 'thung nus drang srong che/ /ngag dbang gzhen nu grangs med yid can (20ba)gyi/ /gnyen bshes mgon du mi 'gyur brtan par shog /ro nus zhu rjes bsdebs pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ /'gro mang srog gi chad 'thud 'chi med kyi/ /mchog sbyin sgo 'byed gso rig gtsug lag gzhung / /'phrin las dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rgyas par shog /sman rgyal rigs 'dus rje btsun g.yu thog mgon/ /ba ched phugs cha lag dang bcas ma la ya'i/ /nags klung nas ldang thangs gsos dri —444

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (na)bsung gis/ /yangs pa'i 'jig rten kun tu khyab par shog /gnod sbyin zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul che/ /lha dang drang srong rig pa 'dzin rnams kyi/ /bden pa'i tshig gis yid la bsams don kun/ /thogs pa med par lhun gyis 'grub par shog /ces gling stod chos rje blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sku skye ngag dbang gzhen nur gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs smon lam dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes nyi thang grwa tshang spyi tsho gos dang / dpon tshang dar mo sman rams pas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /zhid khams rgya mtsho'i sangs rgyas sras slob rnams/ /dpal ldan 'bras spungs gtsug lag khang chen gyi/ /ye shes sems dpa' rab 'khyil gzugs sku dang / /dbyer med mchog gsum 'dus pa'i spyan snga sa /gos 'phan zung gis nyer mtshon dngos bshams shing / /yid sbrul mchod sprin nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo/ /rab phye sa bon dar drag legs byas tshogs/ /'dzam bu'i snye ma 'dzad med g.yur za shog /rgyal bstan grib mar yid can ngal bsos bde/ /'gro 'dren (21na〉phogs gnyen 'dusasdebartan cing 'phel/ /khrims gnyis lci ldan sa dbang chab srid rgyas/ /'jig rten khams su skyid pa'i nyi 'char shog /'dis mtsho ni grangs med skye bar yongs bsags dge /rnam smin gcig tu dkar por 'dzag pa las/ /yon sbyor mi nor 'phel zhing tshe dpal dang / /dbang thang ngal bsos po yi mched zlar shog /nad rims gdon bgegs dbul phongs dus min du/ /'chi sogs 'khor ba'i zug rngu'i tsher ma rnams/ /dkon cog thugs rje'i cha dpyad kyis phyungs nas/ /sgo gsum sim pa'i tshor ba 'bral med shog /mi khom gnas kyi srid pa mi 'dzin zhing / /dam chos sgrub rten lha mi'i lus brgyud nas/ /sgrib gnyis 'ching rgya las grol ye shes mchog /ring por mi thogs mngon du 'gyur bar shog /bsags so cog gi bsod nams te si'i gangs/ /mtho brtsegs las babs phan bde gaṅgā'i klung / /mkha' mnyam lus can rdzogs sangs rgyas thob pa'i/ /chu gter dang 'dres 'phel ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /lcags mo bya lo mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis spyi bye brag gi dge legs 'phel —445

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ba'i smon lam gyi tshigs bcad gsar btsugs kyi tshe chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs su gos 'phan cha phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pas bgyis pa a thesirnyi ra sdu/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen ngag gi dbang / /blo gros rdzing bur mkhas btsun bzang po yi/(21ba)/tshangs sras ngang mo'i legs bshad mgrin rnga'i sgra/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab la gsol ba 'debs/ khru 'dzin dmar po ri yi pho brang che'i/ /rten dang brten par bcas la phyag skor gyis/ /legs mtshon sgo gsum nyer bsags rnam dkar dge /'gro kun don bsngos na ma yang 'dzad med 'bras/ /bdag sogs skye ba dal 'byor rten bzang thob/ /dam pas rjes bzung thos bsam sgom pa'i mthus/ /'khor ba'i pha mtha' myur du brgal byas nas/ /bla med kun mkhyen ye shes thob par shog /ces dge slong phun tshogs rgya mtshos po ta la'i skor tshad bzo ba dang / rgyun gyi kha ton gsol 'debs smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig 'dzin gyi btsun pa ngag dbang dkon cog go /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung / /ye shes rang gdangs nor gyi lha tshogs su/ shar bas mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo/ /phye nas longs spyod char du nyer 'bab par/ /zhal bzhes rdo ba'i ri mo 'chi med lam/ /rnam pa gzhan du gyur kyang 'jig min phyir/ /ches phongs nyam thag 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /brnag dka'i zug rngu mtha' dag drungs sun mdzod/ /khyad par gnasakhang 'di na lha dang mi'i/ /phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i chu klung chen po bzhi/ /legs babs 'khyil ba'i rgya mtshor bsod nams klu'i/ /gtsug tor yid bzhin nor bus re skong shog /ces khri smad phun tshogs dbang pos bsam pa lhun grub ma'i las tshogs bcu gsum pa'i zhing bkod (22na〉bzhengs pa'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs the(/ /—446

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ 'dablo chen bskal bzang 'dren pa stong phrag gi/ /mkhyen rab mgon khyod gcig pur yongs tshang ba'i/ /snyan grags sa gsum khyab dang rgyal tshab rje/ shes rab seng ge'i gzugs sku'i snang brnyan la/ /dga' ldan gnas nas 'jam dpal snying po'i zhabs/ /kha ba'i ljongs 'dir mi yi srid bzung nas/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i rtogs brjod kyis bskor char/ /babs bas dad pa'i myu gu gong 'phel gsos/ /ring nas mi phyed mos gus cang shes la/ /brtson 'grus lcag gis bskul bas tshogs gnyis 'gros/ /nges legs thang la dkyus thog legs bcad nas/ /byang chub chen po'i mdun sar bgrod par shog /gnas skabs yon sbyor byed po ring 'tsho'i tshe/ /rmugs 'dzin mdzod la 'gran pa'i 'byor pa sogs/ /srid zhi'i yon tan dge ba'i gzhog rlabs kyis/ /phan bde'i mkha' ngos na ma 'phang gcod par shog /tshe 'di'i lus bskyed pha mas thog drangs te/ khyud lnga'i sems can thamasacad mtho ris dang / /thar pa kun mkhyen ye shes thob pa'i rgyur/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum du bsags dge tshogs bsngo/ /zhes gram pa ba dge slong blo bzang ngag dbang gis rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i rnam thar zhing bkod bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams (22ba)pa'o/ /yan lag drug cu'i gsung ngag rgyud mang glur/ /len par mkhas dbang bag yod blo yis btsun/ /bzang po'i lhag bsam rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng ltar/ /yol med 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen la/ /lag na pad dkar rnam par 'phrul po che/ /'phags bod chos rgyal paṇa grub rtsa gnyis kyi/ /rab bskor sgyu ma'i khengs pa bag la zhar/ /gtong byed bsod nams mgron du dngosabyon bzhin/ /legs byas tshogs kyis bskrun pa'i dal ba'i lus/ /don ldan grub la skal ba bzang po de/ /rnam dag bsam pas nyer bskul brtson pa yis/ /mi phyed dad pa'i rten du deng 'dir bskrun/ /dge tshogs cha shas gong 'phel chu shel dbang / /mtshams sbyar smon lam ga bur gzegs ma'i rdul/ /babs pas srid zhi'i sdug bsngal tsha ba'i dbal/ /nyer zhi bde skyid dpal la spyod par —447—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)shog /rang nyid gcig pur ma dmigs mkha' mnyam 'gror/ /chos dkar 'bras bu bsngos rgyun 'dzad med nor/ /longs su spyod pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang ring por mi thogs mngon 'gyur shog /ces lha sa ba dpal 'byor bzang po'i dad rten gsar bzhengs kyi rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /tsan+dan byug pa ste'u khar gzas la/ /snying rje'i chab kyis thugs rgyud zhing sa'i khyon/ /mnyam par brlan mdzod don kun grub pa'i phyag /ring por byang chub bar du bdag gtsug khyongs/ /mtha' bral rgya mtshor stong (23na snyad nor bu'i thod/ /'od 'bar rnam 'dren klu dbang rang grib la/ /bltos min mched zla lang rigs srid sgrub phongs/ shes rab bdag por rtsal gyis 'phen nus shog /rang bzhin grub 'dod 'byog po'i gtan tshigs dug /'phags mchog bzhed pa'i rnam rgyal gser mdog gis/ /drungs 'byin lha yi sman pa thar skar skyes/ /nyon mongs nad brgya sel smon deng 'grub shog /bcu gnyis bgrang byar spyad pa'i dka' thub 'bras/ /dga' ldan gnas su thogs pa med gshegs nas/ /ma pham gsung ngag theg chen 'dzam gling 'dir/ /dar ba'i rnam par thar de 'dzin nus shog zhas bya gzhi lnga dbyig gi bang mdzod nas/ /legs bshad mchog sbyin lus can kun gyi gnyen/ /dgu bcu go dgu'i gtsug lag do shal phreng / /sbud pa'i bsnyems pa ring min 'phrog nus shog /phyogs bral dngos stobs rig pa'i 'khor lo yis/ /rgol ngan phyer 'thag glang po thub gsung gis/ kha' ka tshal rtag rgyur 'jam mgon gyis/ /rjes bzung yongs 'dzin dang mtshungs bdag thob shog /mu stegs chos kyi gnad gsang kun rtogs nas/ /dpyad gsum thog mangs log smra'i brag bsnyil ba'i/ /grags pa ji bzhin rtog ge'i tshig don la/ /'jug pa'i spobs pa rtag tu dge bar shog /'khor 'das yon tan yongs 'du'i rtsa lag mchog /rang rgyud 'dul lung dzi bzhi'i snying po'i gzugs/ /rab snang mkhyen pa'i nyi 'od stong 'bar ba/ /mtshar 'dzin gzigs mor dal 'byor mi g.yeng shog /shākya seng ge'i dpyad (23ba thams ut+pal thod/ /ma rnyigs bag yod rang 'od 'dom gang gis/ /—448

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ zhena'akhor 'das nyin mtshan bar med rab gsal lha'i/ /rkang rjes non pa'i gom pa deng 'god shog /rgyal dang de bstan mdzes byed rgyan mchog la/ /'phags yul sna tshogs mkhas mang rtogs brjod 'phreng / /bkod legs srad bur rab brgyus dbang po'i gzhu/ /ras dkar mkhar shar byed po gdong bzhi'i spun/ /sngon chog ba gam yang thog 'gol gnas la/ /rang bzo'i mig bu bgrad pa'i dgra min par/ /dar chog brgyud pa ma la ya yi dri/ /ches dngar tshul khrims 'khor ba'i gdung ba sel/ /nyer dkon dal 'byor rten mchog don ldan du/ /byed la rgya chen chos kyi rnam grangs mtha'/ /'jal ba'i grags snyan tam byu ra yi rgyud/ /brdung mkhas bya rigs paṇa chen me na gaḥ /bcu phrag rig gnasayongs la bag chags mthu/ /tshe 'dir sad pa yang srid phyi ma kun/ /rang nor bcol ba blangs 'dras sgrib gsum mdud/ /grol bas myang 'das grong du 'jug par shog /ces bya rigs rnam gling paṇa chen dkon cog chos grags kyis 'o skol gyi ston pa rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang bcas par paṇa grub du ma'i zhing bkod ngo mtshar thor bsdus spel bar rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul ltar tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pas bgyis pa praṇi dha na sirnyi bha wan+tu/ /phyag na gser sbyangs las 'ongs bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rgyun chad dang bral 'chi med mchog sbyin sgo/ /sgo 'phar brgya phrag 'byed mdzad (24na skor gyi dbang / dbang phyug brgyad ldan thugs rjes 'gro kun skyongs/ /'jam dbyangs dbyangs can dga' ba'i 'dzum zhal las/ /legs bshad bshad pas bcu phrag rig gnas la/ /smra mkhas mkhas pa'i gral chud bshes gnyen mchog /dam chos chosa'akhor bskor phyir rab brtan shog /rnam mang thos sras rjes 'gro'i bsod nams kyis/ /rnam 'dren rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mchog /rnam dag bsam pas rgya mtsho'i gos can gzhin/ /rnam par rgyal phyir g.yung drung ltar brtan shog /mang mang grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i gzhung lugs la/ /yang yang thos bsam sgom pa lhur blangs pas/ /mkhas mkhas 'du ba dga' ldan chos 'khor sde/ /ring ring —449

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'khor ba stongs min rgyas par shog /rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ /rgyal bar 'gyur ba'i shis pa brjod pa'i gtam/ /rgyal rnga srid pa'i rtse mor brdungs pa'i sgras/ /rgyal srasarlabs chen spyod la bdag 'jug shog /ces bden pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor du 'dzugs rgyu zhig dgos zhes ngag dbang bzod pas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa sngo bzang dbang po'o/ /ngag dbang dbyangs can drin las blo gros kyi/ /lang tsho spyig tshal bzang po dar drag pas/ /gtsug lag rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i rnam dpyod gdong / khrug dngom ga rti /lagasol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs deng nas skye bar rnam thos bu'i/ /(24bsgo 'byor dbang thang mngon sum nyams myong zhing / /tshad ma bzhi ldan smin grol zab lam gyis/ /ring min zung 'jug go 'phang mngon gyur sheg /gsol 'debasasmon lam 'di ni 'brog khri dpon kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub gyi zhal 'don du tshangs sras bag pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /bla ma yi dam srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dad stobs dbang phyug da las hong tha'i ji/ /dus min 'chi bdag las rgyal ring po'i tshe/ /gegs med pha mthar phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ /nad rims dbul phongs 'thab rtsod dgra gdon gyi/ /bar gcod nyer 'tshe mtha' dag yongs zhi nas/ /stobs 'byor mnga' thang bsod nams yon tan rnams/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /yab gcig bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po yi/ /bzhed don ji bzhin rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /bstan srid gyen du 'degs pa'i bsam sbyor tshogs/ /'bad rtsol bral te 'grub par byin gyisarlobs/ /thog ma med nas da lta'i bar bsags pa'i/ /dge tsho gis 'bras bu rigs 'dra phyi ma sa /dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i rten thob nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang mjal zhing 'jug par shog /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i/ /'khor du skyes nas rgyal ba'i gsung rab don/ /thos dang bsam pas tshul bzhin bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /myur du rnam mkhyen ye shes thob par shog /skyon bral yon —450

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanatan kun tshang rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /des gsungs lung rtogs dam (25na〉 chos kyi sgo/ /rab 'byed skye 'phags dge 'dun tsho gos rnams kyis/ /smon lam ci btab nyer 'grub dpang po mdzod/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma yis/ /phun sum tsho gis pa'i 'phrin las yongs spel nas/ /thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i ba po shis shog zhes ring por 'tsho zhing bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs dang phyi ma dal 'byor gyi rten thob nas 'khor du skyes te chos bsgrub pa'i smon lam kha ton byed rgyu zhig dgos zhes bsod nams kyi dpung pas sa chen po la dbang sgyur ba'i stobs kyi dbang phyug da las hong tha'i jis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi ba nas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dkon cog go /gser gyi lhun po mtshan dpes rab 'byud sku/ /tshangs dbyangs snyems 'phrog yan lag drug cu'i gsung / /bden gnyis chos kun mngon sum gzigs pa'i thugs/ /bskal bzang 'dren mchog bzhi pa shākya'i tog /ri mo g.yas 'khyil mgrin pa'i pi wang khog /seng ge'i rgyud las drangs pa sman mdo'i glu/ /cher snyegs lus can yongs kyi rna ba sa /yongs 'gyed phan bde'i srog 'tsho bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /brgyad brgya'i bu sta kar sa nyer bstan pa/ /sman bla mngon mkhyen chos grags mya ngan med/ /gser bzang rin cen zla ba mtshan legs zhes/ /rgyal gzhan kun las ches lhag thugs rje'i gter//gangs can lha gcig khri srong lde'u btsan gyi/ /sku yi rim gror thub bstan rtsa lag che/(25ba)/mkhan chen bo dhi satwa sa legs bkra la ba'i/ /mdo chog sngon med dpag bsam yongs 'du'i mched/ /pho brang lnga bcu rtsa gsum lha tshogs sku/ /bdun tshar mchod sprin dngos bshams yid sprul nas/ /spyan 'dren phyag mchod rnam dag smon lam grangs/ /stong phrag lo re star chug spel ba'i dges/ /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par rgya hor bod/ /bye brag khri skor bcu gsum rgyal khams 'dir/ /mdo tshig don bzhin sdug bsngal rnam gsum gyi/ /mi zad zug rngu dungs nas 'byin par shog/chos nor 'dod thar sde bzhi'i sgo phye nas/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs yon tan mtha' yas pa/ /lus ngag yid la rtag tu nyams myong ba/ /'bral med gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /ming tsam min par shākya seng ge yi/ /rjes su zhugs so —451

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)cog gi bstan pa dang / /yang sgos mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa'i/ /ring lugs srid mtha'i bar du rgyas par shog /chos spyod rnam bcu thub gsung dgongs 'grel rnams/ /thos bsam sgom pas legasa'adzin mdo sngags sde/ /dbyar gyi chu gter lta bur rab 'phel zhing / /bshad sgrub rlabs 'phreng dus las yol med shog /grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i bzhed gzhung smra ba'i ngag /dge dbang gnyis pa'i blo yi skal bzang la/ /legs spyod gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs can/ /rdo rje'i khri la g.yo med brtan par shog /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'degs la bsod nams mthu/ /rgya chen mtsho ltar gting zab khrims gnyis kyi/ /gser 'khor mkha' la rab (26na skor phags mi yi bdag /sku tshe chab srid mnga' thang rgyas par shog /lhag bsam tshangs pa'i ral klung stug po nas/ /dge tshogs 'dzad med gaṅgā 'dren mkhas pas/ /skal ldan shing rta'i mched zla hor bod kyi/ /skad gnyis smra ba se chen dpon po gang / /brgya phrag bgrang byar nye ba ring po'i tshe/ /rnam thos bu la 'gran bzod bsod nams kyi/ /'char dang nub pa dang bral dus kun tu/ /skyid pa'i nyi ma dgung du gsal bar shog /'di snang nub tshe bde bar gshegs pa bdun/ /mngon sum byon nas dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /thog med khrid de rgyal ba'i srasasu skye/ /rang gzhan don gnyis hrūb par byin gyis rlobs/ /rjes 'jug rnams dang don 'dir 'bad pa kun/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs snying zhugs nas/ /'di phyi bar de'i mdun sa ma lus pa/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces ho me bod kyi lo tsā ba se chen dbon po blo bzang chos 'phel gyis sman bla stong rtsa lo star gyi gtong rgyun btsugs pa'i tshe smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyis bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon ngag dbang dkon cog go /rnam dag dad pa'i me long gtsang ma'i ngos/ /rgyal kun 'dus pa'i gzugs brnyan yongs 'char ba/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos dga' ba'i bshes gnyen la/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen posagasol ba 'debs/ khugs drag mos pas thugs rje rab bskul mthus rje 'bangs rnams la nad —452

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanagadon bar gcod kyis/ /nyer 'tshe kun zhi tshe dpal rigs brgyud sogs/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar byin rlo mes shig /smon lam ci btab re ba ji bzhin du/ /lhun gyis grub par bla ma yi dam lha/ /sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang chos skyongs gis/ /dngos grub char 'bebs las kun bsgrubs par shog /ces sde mang gi 'don rgyu 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes jo rog thu kho shor che tha'i jis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /tsher bas du mar ngag dbang lha mo yis/ /blo gros bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bzang thos bsamargya mtsholas thon legs bshad srog /rab brtan tshangs pa'i mched zlar 'gyur med shog /gnas lnga rig pa smra la 'jigs med kyi/ /spobs mtho'i go cha btsan pos thub bstan la/ /rgol ngan nyer bsrung rnam dpyod lang tsho'i sde/ /'og min mgon po lta bur brtan par shog /sangs rgyas gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i bstan/ /mkha' ltar rgya che mtsho bzhin gting zab pa/ /legs skyong nor 'dzin dbang po'i sku tshe dang / /mnga' thang 'chi med gtso bor 'gran nus shog /lho brag lung gsum ljongs su dga' ldan pa'i/ grub mtha' gtsang mas rang gzhan don gnyis kun/ /nyer grub 'dus gling 'khor lo rnam gsum gyi/ /nam mkha' gzhan gyur de srid 'phel rgyas shog /dkon cog gsum gyi thugs rje nyi 'od brdal/ /'gro ba'i bde skyid snang bas phyogs bcur khyab/ /lha dang drang srong bden pa'i (27na thi 3 la dbang / /tshul khrims ldan pa'i smon lam deng 'grub shog /ces brjod don dang mang nyung 'di tsam yod pa'i smon lam zhig dga' ldan don gnyis gling bla spyi mthun mong gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon ngag dbang dkon cog go /dus kyi dgra bor khrag 'thung rol gar gyis/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal//'jam dpal tshe bdag ngo bor rtag bzhugs nas/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal bar shog/rtsa gsum thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog kyang zil gnon par//dpa' bo'i lag rtags so ston gong ma yi/ /rnam par thar pa tshul bzhin 'dzin nus shog /he ru —453—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rkaḥdapal so zur gnubs gsum gyi/ /bka' gter bstan skyong dam can rgya mtsho yis/ /dbang drag rgyas zhi mchog gi dngos grub rnams/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ zhes pa 'di'ang so'i sngags 'chang gnas byung ba gnam lcags zil gnon dpa' bos bskul ba ltar zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud kyi dngas ma kun/ /lha sngags rtsa thig rlung gsum rig rtsal gyis/ /a lha mi bshig srog tu legs 'dren pa/ /thod 'phreng rigs lnga'i thugs rje med po che/ /gang byin nyer brlabs ring por 'tsho thabs kyi/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung (27ba)yongs bsgrigs cho ga yis/ /bdud las rnam nga ra rgyal ba'i phan bde'i sgo/ /legs 'byed bshad sgrub nges gsang theg mchog gling / /de'i ched brtson ldan dge slong rig pa 'dzin/ /'jam dbyangs grags pas sgo gsum 'bad pa'i mthus/ /rdo rje slob dpon stug po bkod zhing gi /mgon ltar bskal par ga sdo med brtan par shog /mi yi dbang phyug sku tshe mnga' thang dang / /chab srid yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin du 'phel/ /spyi dang bye brag 'jig rten khams ma lus/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston dgod par shog khyu sbyor mi nor 'khor bcas rmugs 'dzin la/ /'gran par nus pa srid pa'i phun tsho gis kun/ /rab rgyas lus ngag yid gsum bde skyid la/ /rtag tu spyod pa'i bsod nams thob par shog /phyi ma'i yang srid rnams su dal 'byor lus/ /rnyed nas sangs rgyas bstan la thos bsam dang / /sgom pas dus gsum rgyal rnams gshegs bshul der/ /myur bgrod lus can mtha' dag 'dren par shog /'dis mtsho ni sngon bsags rnam par dkar ba'i 'bras/ /ma lus nam mkha'i mthas gtugs sems can rnams/ /srid zhi'i mtha' bral rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas lcags mo bya lo sa ga zla bar ring por gnas pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs skabs nyin bde ma sogs sna tshogs pa'i kha btags nyi shu rtsa lnga/ kha btags hor dus ma'i yol ba rnam pa drug dar (28na〉thing kha bcu drug sman rnying kha bcu/ rten khebs gnyis/ rgya gos se'u —454

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ zhenam/ gos yug bzhi/ gos gsang tshon khra kha do/ ling ser yug dang ling dkar kha lnga/ dril bu theg chen gsum dang bod dril gcig tshogs khro gcig /zangs dmar gyi ka 'o ra cha gcig rnams la dge skos ther zan tshos gong brgyab la khyon bsdoms dngul srang nyis brgya dang zho gsum thob pa rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par spyi 'bul gyi tshe smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dkon cog go /sbyang gzhi dug lnga'i lcags khams thabs mkhas rtsi/ /sna tshogs lam gyis(bsgyur ba ye shes lnga/ /gser zhun 'od 'bar khyab bdag rdo rje sems/ /stong phrag snang brnyan bzhengs pa'i dge legs 'bras//'phrin las rnam rgyal rgyud la thog med nas/ /nyer bgos las nyon dri ma ci mchos pa/ /thugs rje'i chab kyis deng bkrus mi yi lus/ /chos ldan rten du nying mtshams sbyor bar shog /yang srid bar med gsum du dal ba'i rten/ /rnyed kyang gzhan rkyen gegs dbang gyur pa'i rgyun/ /rab bcad 'di phyi gtan mdun bsgrub pa yi/ /'dod don 'grub pa'i grogs kun tshang bar shog /bde ldan zhing gi mgon po gar gyi dbang / /thugs ka nas 'phros 'od dkar sbubs lam du/ /'phrin las rnam par rgyal ba rab drangs te/ /chu skyes dbus su brdzus nas skye bar shog /mgon des ljags kyi pad+ma nyer bkram nas/ /legs gsungs (28ba)theg chen dam chos thos bsam dang / /sgom pas spyan ras gzigs dang gsang ba'i bdag /ji bzhin rlabs chen spyod pa 'grub par shog /gnas der rang bder ma chags snying stobs kyi/ /sprul pa mtha' dag bkye nas ma dag pa/ /grangs med zhing du gnas pa'i sems can tshogs/ /thar par 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan byed par shog /sgrib gnyis dgra bcoms spang rtogs yon tan kun/ /rdzogs par sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam na yang / /gangs can 'gro la thugs rje tshad med du/ /rab 'jug pad 'byung kun bzang he ru dziḥ /gaṅgā'i klung rdul snyed kyis mtshon min sprul/ /spro yang 'dzam bu gling 'dir grags che ba/ /gcig las du ma'i rol gar ka shi gar/ /sor mo'i 'phrul gyis bsgyur ba'i bsod nams mthus/ /'phrin —455

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)las rnam rgyal rnga yab grong khyer du/ /srin phrug bzang po'i bag chags nyer sad par/ khu/ra nas pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang cher/ /chos nyid zad sar 'byol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gzhis ka shar pa zur 'phrin las rnam rgyal dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i tshe rdo rje sems dpa' 'od dpag med kyi stong thang / slob dpon chen por mtshan brgyad kyis bskor ba rnams kyi thang ga bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon ngag dbang dkon cog go /rgyal kun mthu stobs gcig bsdus gsang ba'i bdag /drang srong chen po dri med zlos gar can/ /sde brgyad gnyen por zhe sdang (29na)rdo rje'i skur/ /bstan nas yid srubs sde bcas mthar byed mkhar/ /khyod bsnyen lhag pa'i lhar bzung bsgrubs pa dang / /las /la sbyar bas srid gsum 'byung po'i srog /nyer drangs bka' las 'das rnams lag mthil gnyis/ /gnam sa'i bar bcar sdig pas khong khrag drongs/ /kun rdzob tsam la mi zhen rang gi sems/ /gdod nas rnam dag phyag na rdo rje'i mtshon/ /rnon pos gnyis 'dzin 'ching rgya yongs bcad de/ /bde chen chos sku'i klong du grol bar shog /ces yar krung pa 'chams dpon ngag dbang skal bzang gis dge sbyor dmigs rten du drang srong dri med zhi khro'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon ngag dbang dkon cog go /gru 'dzin ri bo'i spo na pad dkar 'chang / /rgyud lnga'i 'gro la rtag tu rjes brtse yang / /ma rungs gdul dka'i gnyen por srin po'i gzugs/ /stobs chen myur mdzad mgon po phyag drug pa/ /rang snying 'dab stong rgyas pa'i ze'u 'bru'i rtser/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen dpal bzang dang / /lha mchog ma hā kwa la dbyer med du/ /nam yang mi g.yo bzhugs par gsol 'debs na/ /deng nas byang chub bar gyi skyabs mdzad de/ /'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs las sgrol ba dang / /mkha' spyod zhing du gsang sngags nye ba'i lam/ /nyams su bstar nas rdo rje 'chang thob shog /—456

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa ra bodakar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanaces spyi khang mdo pa dkon cog rab brtan gyis ngag 'don byed rgyu 'di lta (29ba)bu zhig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon ngag dbang dkon cog go /lho phyogs gru 'dzin ri bo'i pho brang rtser/ /rtag tu bzhugs kyang 'gro drug sems can la/ /thugs rjes nam yang mi lhod don mdzad pa/ /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /pad zla'i gdan steng mnyam par bzhengs pa'i sku/ /gangs ri ltar dkar mtshan dpe'i lang tsho can/ /rin cen rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas spras/ /'jig rten dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe rabs mang por nyer bsags sdig lhung 'bras/ /ma rig rang mdangs mig la shar ba yi/ /phyi nang bar gyi 'grib byed rtsa phyag gi /srin lag 'phrul gyis sel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhing khams rab 'byams gsal ba'i me long ngos/ /dngul bum bdud rtsis bkrus pas skye rgu yi/ /las nyon des bskyed sdug bsngal yongs sbyar nas/ /lus ngag yid gsum bde dang ldan par shog /mgon po khyod sku snang stong lha ru bsgom/ /gsang sngags bzlas brjod chu yis srin lag mnyes/ /phyag rgya'i thabs kyis mig gi nad rigs kun/ /nyer sangs rab rib mtha' dag drungs tshwan shog /sngon gyi las ngan mthu dang tshe 'di la/ /'byung po'i gdon tsho gos rkyen las byung ba yi/ /phyi nang bar gyi mig skyon ma lus pa/ /zhi bar phyag na pad+mas byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas skabs gzugs snang mtha' dag gsal bar mthong / /chos nyid mngon sum blta ba'i nus thob pas/ /bdag sogs(30na 〉 5kha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa/ /rnam dag ye shes spyan dang ldan par shog /ces pa 'di'ang dpon sa bu khrid rgyal mos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon ngag dbang dkon cog go /rnam dag dad pa'i dngas mtshor rgyal kun gzugs/ /yongs shar gcig 'dus ngag dbang blo gros gter/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i ngang tshul zab rgya can/ /mtsho byung drin las rnyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag sogs 'gro ba'i mgon dang —457

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)skyabs gcig pur/ /mi shigs rdo rje'i khri la skyil mo krung / /bcas te chos 'khor bskal brgyar skor bar shog /tshe rabs kun tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen che/ /nam yang 'bral med gtsug tu legs bsten nas/ /zab rgyas chos kyi ro la longs spyad de/ /phyin drug spyod pas 'gro rnams 'dren par shog /gnas skabs su yang dgra gdon dbul phongs na da/ /dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa mtha' dag zhi/ /tshe dang bsod nams stobs 'byor dbang thang rnams/ /yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar shog /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun bden pa'i mthu/ /myur mdzad mgon po las kyi gshin rje gshed/ /'dod khams ma sogs dkar phyogs skyong ba yi/ /dam can srung ma rnams kyis grogs byed shog /ces gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes sa'i tshangs pa bstan 'dzin dwa la'i rgyal po'i sras bstan (30ba 'dzin dbang rgyal dang / lha bzang klu dbang / kun dga' rab brtan lcam sring gsum gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon ngag dbang dkon cog go /'jam dpal tshe bdag rigs kyi cod pan du/ /legs bzhugs rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ /yid srubs gshed du dmag zor rgyal mo'i skur/ /nyer bstan byin rlabs mthu stobs rdzul gyis/ /za hor rigs 'dzin che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/ /a/ nam yang 'gyur ba med pa yi/ / srog gi ka ba rdo rje ltar tshugs nas/ /bgrang yas gdul bya'i re ba bkong bar shog /bdud btsan lta bur dpa' ba'i drag shul dang / /lugs gnyis rnam par dpyod pa'i shes rab kyis/ /dpal ldan skal bzang chos srid don rnams kun/ /thogs med lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ zhes 'phyos phug po lung pa bdud btsan dpal bzang gis dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon ngag dbang dkon cog go /srid gsum dregs pa kun gyi gnyen po sa /brtan pa'i 'khor lo za byed ma he'i zhal/ /gnam sa lta bur gdangs kyang chos kyi dbyings/ /'jam zhing ches dul 'gro la gcig tu brtse/ /gang —458

smon lam shi brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)gi snang brnyan bzhengs pas gnas skabs su/ /'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun kun zhi zhing / /'khor 'das yon tan mtha' dag dkar phyogs kyi/ /zla ba'i cha shas lta bur 'phel bar shog /dbang (31na〉bzhi'i chu bos ma dag dri bkrus nas/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs pas rang rgyud smin/ /lam bzhi rdzogs rim 'gros kyis yongs grol te/ /las bzhis 'gro ba ma lus 'dren nus shog /cesagadong dkar rdzong sdod mas gro tshe brtan gyis 'jig byed kyi bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dbon ngag dbang dkon cog go /'od zer drug sbrags rtsibs brgyad me dpung dbus/ /tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i ngo bo sa /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho legs bzhugs par/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon khyod gzhom med rdo rje'i skur gyur pa'i/ /mi shags srung ba'i gur khang bas po mā /bdag sogs nyer chud bdud bzhi las rgyal te/ /dngos grub yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar shog /dmag zor lha mo tshangs dbang dri za'i rgyal/ /zur phud lnga pas bar chad kun skyob cing / /tshe dpal bsod nams dbang thang stobs lhor rnams/ /rnam thos sras dang mtshungs pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa 'di'ang grong smad pa dmag zor tshangs dbang gi kha ton du dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes lcags bya hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bzhi'i rgyal phur 'grub sbyor gyi thog sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon ngag dbang dkon cog go / ka dag dbyings nas 'chi med chos sku'i gdangs/ /'ja' lus gar dbang longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zer/ /si rtsa'i 'dab stong rtse mor sprul sku'i gar/ /(31ba〉regs bsgyur mtsho skyes rdo rje'i thugs rje'i mthus/ /za hor rigs las zil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal/ /che mchog zhi khro kun bdus rnal 'byor pa/ /pad+mas ming btags rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ /srog gi ka ba g.yung drung ltar brtan shog /rmongasapa'i mun sangs blo gros snang ba rgyas/ /rgya mtsho lta bur zab dang rgya che'i khrims/ /bka' rtags btsan po mchog dman gnyar lci zhing / /sa dbang sku tshe chab srid 'phel bar shog /gangs can pad+ma'i lte bar —459

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bsod nams kyi/ /mngal khur sbrums pas bde skyid rngul chu'i rgyun/ /yan lag brgyad ldan zla ba'i ma ma mā /'khyil bas rlabs 'phrong mkha' la 'phyur bar shog /lo chen dpal brtsegs dpal gyi rdo rje yi/ /mkhyen brtse'i rang gzugs 'di mchog sprul pa'i skur/ shar pa'i bka' gter 'phrin las ro brgya'i bcud/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i tshogs kyis myong bar shog /skyon bla ma'i zab rgyas chos kyi gter/ /rab 'byed gsang sngags 'char ba 'dus pa'i gling / /bshad dang sgrub pa'i sgron mes snga 'gyur gyi/ /ring lugs snang bas 'jigs rten khyab par shog /rgya bod rigs 'dzin bla ma bka' brgyad lha/ /sngags srung ma ning dregs pa'i sde dpon sogs/ /rtsa gsum lha yis 'dod don ma lus pa/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa 'di'ang 'od mchog sprul pa'i skus skyon chos gter gling du 'dzugs rgyu zhig dgos tshul mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /(32na) mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje stong chen dbyings/ /zung 'jug gar dgu'i sgyu 'phrul rmad po che/ /bsgyur mdzad bcom ldan he ru ka dpal gyis/ /thugs rje'i rang gzugs 'gro ngor myur 'char shog /'khor lo'i mgon nus gsung ngag chad med pa/ /bskyed rdzogs snyan brgyud zab mo la dbang ba/ /ras chung bstan pa'i nyi 'od brdal ba la/ /chos rgyal dbang po'i yang srid myur 'byon shog /mtha' klas zhing mang skye rgu'i don gyi ched/ /sna tsho gos sprul pa gaṅgā'i klung rdul ltar/ /ston la 'gog pa med bzhin gangs ljongs 'dir/ /mos ldan gdul bya'i 'dren par myur 'byon shog /rtsa khams rlud gi zab gsang 'phrul po che/ /rang byung lus kyi zlos gar brtul zhugs la/ /spyod pas rdo rje'i grags pa kun khyab pas/ /deng smon ci btab 'grub par byin gyis rlomes/ /rje btsun thos pas rab dga'i sgrub rgyud kyi/ /bstan pa
