bsrung bar zhal bzhes dam can gyis/ /ji ltar bsams pa'i re ba ma lus yongs/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces ras chung phug sprul sku ngag dbang cho ge rgyal dbang po'i sku skye myur 'byon gyi smon lam zhig dgos zhes phyag mdzod gzi brjid dbang pos bskul ba'i —460

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa / zhenangor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bsam mthong lo tsā ba phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /'dab stong pad+ma'i lte bar zla ba'i stong / /tshe mtha' yas pa pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /mnyam par rab bzhengs mtshan dpe'i lang tsho can/ /bsgoms pas gzhom med (32brdo rje'i sku 'grub shog /thugs skar nyi ma'i steng du saḥyig mthar/ /gzungs sngags sgra dbyangs seng ge'i nga ro yi/ /dus min 'chi ba'i ri dwags mthar byas nas/ /bsgoms pas 'gag med rdo rje'i gsung 'grub shog /lha sngags thams cad rig pa'i rang rtsal du/ shar nas chos sku bde stong r+ṣa po'i klong / /ro snyag 'cha ba'i rnal 'byor la gzhol bas/ /'gyur med thugs kyi rdo rje 'grub par shog /'khor 'das tshe dang bsod nams bcud 'khyil ba/ /mar gad lhung bzed las babs tshangs bug lam/ /brgyud de lus kyi zungs dang srog rten du/ gyur pas tshe yi rigs 'dzin thob par shog /ring por 'tsho ba'i dal 'byor rten bzang la/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po'i sku 'grub nas/ /'gro ba ma lus 'dren pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /nam yang 'pho 'gyur med pa chos kyi sku/ /gdod nas dag pa'i rang rig gar gyi dbang / /gzhan nas btsal du med pa rang chas su/ /yod par rang ngo 'phrod pa'i bkra shis shog /gzhen nu bum sku bde ldan zhing khams su/ /sems nyid tshe dpag med mgon bzhugs bzhin du/ /'chi med rigs 'u 'i 'char sgo nang gdangs phyir/ shar ba nges pa rnyed pa'i bkra shis shog /glo bur 'chi bas nyams tha ga 'gro ba'i dbugs/ /'byin par nyi ma'i zer ltar sprul pa'i gar/ /phyogs bcur bkye nas tshe yi mcho ga sbyin pas/ /'phrin las rgyun mi chad pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dpal 'bri gung pa lha sras rgyal po'i rnam sprul dkon mchog phun tshogs sam dbur smyon la dpal skyon chen pos dngos su gnang ba'i gzungs la brten pa'i de sgrub dang 'brel ba'i bsngo (23na tshe smon bkra shis shig dgos zhes dga' gdong sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtshos tshe sgrub kyi mtshams byas skabs bskul ba ltar lja hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon ngag dbang dbon mchoge ji dzi /—461 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)yid bzhin 'khor lo'i snang brnyan brgya phrag tu/ /spel bas bkra shis dbang phyug dus min gyi/ /'chi bdag las rgyal ring 'tsho'i dal rten la/ /'di phyi'i don kun 'grub par byin gyis sgro mes//zhes sh+lauka gcig pa zhig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes bris/ /gting mtha' mi mngon yon tan bye ba'i gter/ /kun mkhyen ye shes spyan gyis sgrib med du/ /gags nas ched du rab bsngags 'phags ma'i zhabs/ /gtsug gtor rnam par rgyal mas dngos grub stsol/ /ngag dbang 'jam dpal blo bzang grags pa'i bstan/ /rgya chen mdo rgyud gzhung lugs dga' ba'i mdud/ /'grol la mtsho byung lha mo mgrin bzhugs pa/ /tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhabs brtan shog /sangs rgyas kun dngos rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /chos srid bstan pa rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas par/ /gyen du 'degs mkhas sa stong chos kyi rgyal/ /g.yung drung lta bur 'gyur med rab brtan shog /thang sag dga' ldan chos spyod rnam bcu yi/ /'khor lo rgyun chad med bskor 'dus pa sde/ /byams mgon bstan pa gling 'dir ma shar bar/ /dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel zhing rgyas par shog/gnam sa bar la ngan rtsub mtshan ltas rgyus/ /nyer bskyed 'bras bu rang bzhin gyis stong yang / /kun rdzob 'byul ngor sgyu ma ltar shar ba/ /dkon mchog bden pa'i mthu yis zhi bar shog /'gro rnams sdig lta'i bsam sbyor ngan dang bral/ /lha 'dre'i gdug rtsub zhi nas (33ba) sems rgyud dul/ /rtsi sman rigs sngags mthu ldan lnga bdo ba'i/ /mi bzad zug rngu drungs nas na par shog /'du ba 'khrugs rnams sgo gsum nad dang bral/ /sbrum ma bder btsa' tshong pa khe spogs lon/ /so nam 'bras smin sha 'khon 'thab rtsod bral/ /'jig rten khams kun bde zhing skyid par shog /bslu ba med pa'i skyabs mgon yin no cog /smon lam gdab yul dbang por spyan drangs nas/ /rtse gcig gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /thugs rje'i phyag ring khyongs la bdag dbugs phyung / /re ba don ldan mya ngan med pa yi/ /ljon shing lo 'dab phang phung grib bsil la/ / skyil mo krung bcas yid la bde ba'i ro/ /myong ba'i phun tshogs rtse dgar dgod par shog /ces bden tshig brjod pa'i smon lam 462

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanagyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni thang sag dga' ldan chos 'khor gyi slob dpon dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i byed po sngags rams pa nam mkha' bzang po gra bcas kyis 'bad pa chen pos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o /gsum zhos lhag pa bcu bzhi'i srang grangs kyi/ /rin chen gnyis pa'i pad phor mchod sprin snod/ /'chams dpon rab 'byams blo bzang skyes mchog gis/ /phul bas don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /ces rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i dge skos kyi thog phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor bzhes bris pa maṅga le/ /grangs med bskal par bsags pa'i legs byas phung po ri bo mngon sum ltar rgyu kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa la/ /gzod ma nyid nas sgrib gnyis spangs kyang slob ma'i tshul 'dzin bstan pa ji srid dngos (34na〉bzhugs gnas brtan bcu drug gi /cho ga'i gzhung las byung ba lta bur bdag sogasaskye rgu'i sdig ltung des bskyed nyes tshogs ma lus rab byed zhing / /srid dang zhi ba'i pha mthar mi lhung bden gnyis rdzings kyis 'khor ba chu'i srin 'byung gnas ngag las sgrol nus shog /mar me mdzad dpal yab sras bzhed srol lha chos bdun las khro rgyal kun 'dus rje btsun mi g.yo mgon po la/ /bka' gdams gzhung pa'i bstan srog legs 'dzin dpal ldan rnar thang mkhan chen mchims kyi dge slong nam mkha' grags pa yis/ /gong ma rnams kyi thugs dam snying po phyogs gcig bsdebs pa brgya rtsar grags pa yi dam chos skyong gis bskor ba/ /yongs bskrun dge ba pad rtsa lta bur gang bsags de'i mthus 'di phyi gtan gyi mdun ma thams cad 'grub par shog /'khor ba stongs min gzhan don mdzad la zhus pa med kyang ches cher snyigs ma lnga bdo'i skye rgu gdul dka' ba/ /'dul phyir mig sman lhun po bskal me'i gos gyon ma mgon lcam dral gnod sbyin bzhi dang dam can rgya mtsho yis/ /'dir snang zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun thogs pa med sgrubs nying mtshams sbyar tshe bar dor lha khyod dngos byon nas/ /mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du nyer khrid sa lam spang rtogs yon tan lhun rdzogs rdo rje 'dzin —463

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)pa'i sa thob shog /ces gdong kha ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gyis bris thang gsum bzhengasapa'i rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /lusang ga yid gsum bag yang la dbang ba'i/ /blo gros bskal bzang sangs rgyas bzhi pa yi/ /ring lugs rgya mtshor 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i grus/ /'gro kun thar gling 'dren la (34ba)gsol ba 'debs/ /thos dang bsam par 'jigs med brtson pa yis/ /rtag tu nyer goms shes rab go cha can/ /thub dbang shing rta che gnyis dgongs don bstan/ /lang tsho rgyas pa'i sgel gsol ba 'debs//'jam dpal dbyangs dngos blo bzang grags pa yi/ /ring lugs dga' ba brgya pa'i yul sa'i bar//spel mkhas ris med 'gro ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /mtshungs bral bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgra bcom tshogs kyang phra rgyas ba spu'i rtse/ /mthong bas gyen slong tshangs sras lus phra ma/ /mgrin par bzhad pa'i legs bshad rdo rje'i glu/ /rnam dpyod rgyud las 'dren la gsol ba 'debs/ /ma chags pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla'i khrir/ /mgon khyod smiḥyig las 'khrungs tshe mtha' yas mtshan dpe'i gzi byin 'bar bar legs bsgyur nas/ /bskal bar mi shigs skyil krung bca' bar shog /thugs ga'i 'od zer lcags kyus bkug pa yis/ /'khor 'das yongs kyi tshe bcud ma lus kun/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgyas bteg pa'i ka la shar/ /rab 'byams gyen 'phyur zil dngar gyis brtan shog /ma rig 'thibs mun rnam dpyod skya rengs kyis/ /sangs pa'i blo rgyas rgya chen lugs zung sogs/ /mtsho ltar gting zab khrims gnyis rin chen gter/ /sgo 'byed sa dbang rdo rje ltar brtan shog /lha khyod dus kyi bdag po'i che ba yis/ /'bangs rnams tshe yang ring du 'phel ba dang / /lus ngag yid bde dpal 'byor phun tshogs pa/ /gser gyi 'khor los sgyur rgyal rjes 'gror shog /bod yul mnga' bdag khri lde gtsug brtan gyis/ /'phrul snang phyogs bzhir rab byung sde btsugs pas//dmar rung rab sngags dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gling / /'dul (35na/byems yongs gtsang thos bsam —464

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ rton)'phel bar shog /gdon bgegs nad sogs sna tshogs rkyen ngan gyis/ /dus min 'chis mtshon 'jigs pa mtha' dag zhi/ /'thab rtsod sha 'khon dang bral phu nu ltar/ /mnyes gshin byams pas rtag tu mdza' bar shog /srong btsan zhal gyis 'ches bzhin mthal bzhi yi/ /las sgo lha ldan gnas su yongs 'du ba/ /dpag bsam shing gi 'bras bu sde 'dir yang / /longs spyod gnod sbyin mdzod mtshungasa'aphel bar shog /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par bod khams su/ /dus su char 'bebs lo 'bras rkang 'thung 'phrong / /me tog rtswa sogs snod kyi yon to kun/ /rdzogs ldan dpal gyi rtse dga' dgod par shog /mi phyugs nad rims 'thab rtsod mtshang 'dru ba/ /dgra jag chom rkun bkres skom mya ngan sogs/ /dus kyi chad pa'i smag rum mthar byas nas/ /bde skyid snang ba'i nyi ma ches 'bar shog /sangs rgyasadam chos dge 'dun bden pa dang / /rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs tshogis gnyis rdzogs/ /don dam spros bral rgyu gos slu med kyis/ /smon lam ci btab 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces gsol 'debasadang bden brjod kyi smon lam zung 'brel 'di ni lha sa sme ru slob dpon dkon mchog dpal bzang gisabaskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rung mthun gos gsum cod pan gser 'od 'phro/ /chos 'bor phyag rgyas bzung ba'i ut+pal rtser/ /glegs bam ral gri zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung / /mthong bas don ldan rgyal dbang tsong kha pa//gang gi rjes 'jug tshangs sras (35ba〉ba 'ad pa la/ /lhag pa'i lhas bskor bris thang bzhedas pa'i dges/ /skye ba kun tu lha mi'i bde skyid myong / /ring por mi thogs byang chub mchog thob shog /sems can yongs la chags dang sdang med par/ /byams brtses nyer 'gyud shākya seng ge zhes/ /mthong thos dran reg yod do cog grol ba'i/ /nyan thos tshul 'dzin gnas brtan bcu drug dgongs/ /bdag cag gti mug mun khung chud pa la/ /thugs rje ye shes sgron me rab spar te/ /thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzugs snang kun/ /dri med gsal bar mthong ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /rgyal rnams spangs rtogasamanyam yang sdig lhung tshogs/ /bshags yul mchog tu gyur pa dkon brtsegs kyi/ /phung po gsum pa —465

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)las bstan rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sum cu rtsa lnga'i spyan gyis legs gzigs te/ /ngag dbang rgya mtshos thog ma med pa nas/ /cher bsags rnam smin nag po'i rgyun bcad de/ /mtha' bral 'khor ba'i 'jigs pas mi brdzi bar/ /gtan gyi bde ba thob pa'i bka' drin stsol/ /pad dkar 'chang dang lag na rdo rje sogs/ /byang chub sems pa'i 'khor tsho gis rgya mtshor bcas/ /snang ba mtha' yas thogs med mngon sum du/ /bdag sogs 'chi khar byon nas dbugs dbyung mdzod/ /rnam par shes pa skar mda' 'phangs pa ltar/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams nyams dga' bar/ /pad+ma'i sbubs su btsas te theg pa che'i/ /dam chos nyams su len par byin gyis rlomes/ /zhi khro kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje sems//rdzus skyes rgya gar paṇa chen tshul bzung bar/ /sku gcig ldog pa tha dad mtshan brgyad ces/ /gang 'dul gdul bya'i snang ngor cir yang bsgyur/ /zhabs sen rdul dmar deng nas byang chub bar/ /gtsug tu 'bral (36na)med bsten na dngos grub kun/ /stsol bar rgyal dbang pad+ma ka ra la/ /gsol ba 'debs na gtan don 'grub byin rlobs/ /zhes chab nag pa ngag dbang rgya mtshos gong gsal thang ga lnga bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /bskal mang tshogs kyis yongs bsgrubs dag pa'i zhing / /snang la rang bzhin med pa 'od lnga'i gdangs/ /rnam mang rin chen las grub gzhal yas khang / /rgya phubs dra ba dra phyed rgyan gyis spud/gser zhan mig mangs ris bris be+e ḍūrla'i/ /sa gzhi khod snyoms lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ /me tog rab bkra ljon shing yal ga dang / /lo 'dab g.yur za dar zab lda ldi bres/ /rtse mor sna tsho gos bya risazlos gar bsgyur/ /mtsho rdzing 'bab chu lhung lhung sgra snyan sgrog /mar gad khu bas 'i byugs pa spang ljongasal/ /lha rnams pi waṃ gling bu dzornga brdung / /khor yug grong gi bkod pa ngo mtshar bas/ /bskor ba'i pho brang dbus su pad zla'i steng / /snang ba mtha' yas 'khor tsho gos rgya mtsho dang / /mkha' la rdzu phrul mnga' rnams 'phur lding rol/ /mgron thabs shāka seng be+eḍūr sman gyi bla/ /klu dbang ma pham snang —466

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanabarnyan bzhengs pas mtshon/ /dus gsum rab bsags dge ba ji snyed 'bras/ /sngon tshe dge slong chos kyi 'byung gnas thugs/ /legs bskyed ji bzhin 'od gsal 'a zha'i rigs/ /rje dpon mkhyen rab rnam par rgyal ba gang / /'di nas nyer 'phos yang srid phyi ma'i dus/ /bde ldan zhing du thogs pa med bgrod nas/ /gar dbang lha yis rjes bzung theg chen gyi/ /dam pa'i chos la thos dang bsam sgom pas/(36ba)/rgyal ba'i sras gyur rlabs chen spyod pa spyad/ /gcig las du mar shar ba'i rnam sprul gyi/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba/ /mgon po bsod gnams mchag ldan dpal bzang dang / /za hor rigs 'dzin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes/ /dbyer med dngos po gcig tu gyur pa'i drung / /skye ba bzung nas sgo gsum chig sgril gyis/ /dka' spyad brtson ba zang zing spyod lam sogs/ /sna tsho gos thabs kyis sri zhu rab bskrun pas/ /gzhal dka'i sku drin ma lus gsob nus shing //theg mchog a ti myur ba'i gsang lam la/ /rig rtsal rang ngo nyer 'phrod gom stabs kyis/ /longs sku'i zhing mang myul yang ma dag pa'i/ /'gro ba'i dbang bo dang 'tsham don gyi ched/ /byams mgon mchog gi sprul skur sangs rgyas che/ /'khor gyi thog mar skyes nas chos nyan pas/ /sa bcu rim bgrod rnam pa thamasacad mkhyen/ /mngon gyur sems can ma lus 'dren par shog /ces pa'ang gnas gsar rje drung mkhyen rab rnam rgyal gyis bris thang gi rgyab yig 'di lta bu zhig dgos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon mchog go /gtso thang / gsung gi dbang phyug rta mchog thugs ka nas/ /ngo mtshar zhing khams gaṅgā'i klung rdul gyis/ /mtshon par nusamin bkod pa rgya mtsho che/ /dngos grub rlabs phreng dus las yol ba ci/ /bde chen chos sku'i dbyings su mi g.yo bzhin/ /bgrang yas rtsa gsum zhi khro'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ /rdo rje thogs med rtsal gyi 'phrul snang gi/dngas mtshor sgrib bral 'char la su zhig bston/ /'dis mtsho ni bcu gcig grangs ldan ja ma dang / /sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang chos srung gi /bris thang bzhengs mthus 'di phyi bar gsum gyi/ /legs byas don kun lhun gyis grub par (37na〉skog /thub g.yas dang po/ bstan ji srid dngos sku ma —467

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bsdus par/ /nyer bzhugs 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi /'khor tsho gos zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang bar/ khyu skar 'phreng bas bskor 'dra'i don kun grub/ /mi bzad mthu stobs rdo rje 'bar ba yis/ /yid srubs sder bcas 'a sngoms pa'i dpa' bo che/ /bstan srung gtso bo rgyal chen sde bzhi'i dpung / /rtsub 'gyur tshal du lha rnams mas pa bzhin/ /sri zhu skrun byed dge bsnyen dharma tā/ /mi dbang thang ga pho nya hwa shang sogs/ /jon byung phun tshogs rnam par ji snyed pa/ /deng 'dir bdag sogs 'gro bas 'grub byin rlobs/ g.yon dang po/ gangs can skye rgu brtse bas rjes 'dzin par//zhal 'tshes gsol 'debs tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan po/ /lha sras mu tig btsan por bka' stsal ba/ /las sbyor bcu gsum yid bzhin nor 'dra'i chos/ /sngon med ngo mtshar zhing gi bkod pa'i dbus/ /mtsho skyes rigs 'dzin pad+ma ka ra zhes/ /'khor 'das yongs kyi rgyal pos srid pa gsum/ /zil gyisamanan pas 'gro rnams skal bzang byas/ /bsod nams 'di yis gnas skabs mthar thug kun/ /phan bde'i dpag bsam sdong po dar drag pa'i/ /phun tsho gis ro brgya'i 'bras bu myong ba yi/ /bka' drin zla med mgon po khyod kyis stsol/ g.yab7pa/phung po 'od skur grol dang sgyu ma'i lus/ /mngon sum mkha' spyod bgrod par skal dman rnams/ /'chi ba 'od gsal don gyi rnal 'byor mas/ /dag pa'i zhing du thogs med 'dren pa dang / /rigs byed lha mo 'dod pa'i rgyal po yis/ /srid zhi'i brtan pa ma lus yongs phyogs nas/ /rkang sen zla tshes dregs ldan mtha' dag gi /gtsug tor rtse mo'i rgyan du rab 'ching zhing / /tshogs bdag rmug (37ba 'dzin dbang pos lha klu mi/ /gnod sbyin tsho gos kyi bang mdzod kha phye ste/ /mi 'dzad nor bu skyugs pa ne'u le yi/ /mgrin las rtag tu chad med 'bab par mdzod/ g.yon gnyis pa/rnam dpyod dpung pas bteg pa ut+pal rtser/ zhes rab ral gri rnon pos ma rig rgya/ /gcod mdzad 'jam pa'i rdo rje tsong kha pa/ /thub bstan yongs kyi spyi mes chen po la/ /tshe mtha' yas pa longs sprul cha byad can/ /klu yi dbang phyug rgyal po bcom ldan 'das/ /lnga bdor thugs rje ches cher lhag pa yi/ /bde gshegs bdun gyis bskor ba legs bskrun mthus/ /dus min —468

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ zhena'achi dang sa bdag klu gnyen sogs/ /'byung po'i gdon gyi nyer 'tshe rab zhi zhing / /sangs rgyas rnamasakyis smon snyel ma gang btab 'bras/ /deng 'dir mkha' mnyam 'gro bas myong bar shog /g.yas gsum pa/rgyal rnams snying rje'i dngos kun rab bsdus nas/ /phyag na pad dkar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor che/ /yongs gang dngos grub da t+pā ra yi rdul/ /skye rgu'i gdung sel 'jig rten dbang phyug la/ /gnyan rigs grub pa mchog brnyes tshem bu pa'i/ /ba ched srol dmar khrid brgyud pa rin chen phreng / /sna tsho gos tshoni gyi srad bur legs brgyus te/ /rab dkar ka shi ga'i ngos zlos gar bsgyur/ /snang grag rig gsum 'byer so sum ldan gyi/ /rnal 'byor zab mo'i them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /lho phyogs gru 'dzin gzhal med nyams dga' bar/ /mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus bgrod par shog /g.yon gsum pa/rgya gar mkhas pa pad+ma thod 'phreng dang / /gangs can mig gcig lo chen be+e ro yi/ /thugs dam zab las chosazab rta mchog dpal/ /dbang chen yang gsang khros pa lha dgur grags/ /mthong bas don dang ldan pa'i gzugs sku (38na)'di/ /mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab sgrub rten du/ /bzhengs pas tshe 'di'i nad gdon bar chad sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rab rgyal zhing / /ring po'i tshe dang dpal 'byor snyan grags sogs/ /bsams pa'i don rnams lhun gyis grub pa dang / /myur du dbang chen kun bzang rig pa'i rtsal/ /mngon gyur lus can ma lus 'dren par shog /g.yas sto pa/ rtag tu zhi zhing dul ba 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /dus kyi dgra bor phyag rgya zil gnon gar/ /bsgyur te rab 'bar mtshon cha gdengs pa'i mod/ /dgra bgegs yongs kyi don snying dum bur gas/ /ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad pa/ /sna tsho gos gshin rje gshed po'i sgyu 'phrul che/ /drang srong dmod pa'i mthu rtsal gsang ba'i bdag /gtum chen zhe sdang rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyis/ /ban bon rigs sngags rbod gtong mdo sgrub dang / /lha srin sdebargyad za kha zug pa sogs/ /rang gshed rang la bab pa'i sbyor ba yis /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dran pa'i mod la ring por 'tsho ba'i tshe/ /sbyin mdzad yid bzhin 'khor lo'i mdzes sku las/ /dbang gzhu'i zer gyis 'chi ba'i mun bsal te/ /—469

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bdud rtsis phyi nang lus kun khyab pa dang / /'phrog byed gnyis 'thung chom rkun lto 'gro zhugs/ /g.yon bzhi pa/ lcags sgrog sha za chu bo'i 'jigs brgyad sogs/ /legs skyob ār+ya tā re rgyal ba'i yum/ /mkhyen brtse nus pas nyes tshogs mtha' dag srungs/ /seng ldeng nags sgrol rnam 'gyur nyer gcig gi/phyag 'tshal brjod don slu med ro bda'i 'bras/ /mngon sum smin nas skye 'gro mtha' dag rnams/ /sim pa'i tshor ba nyams su myong bar shog /g.yas lnga pa/ sna tshogs rin chen las grub gzhal (38ba)yas khang / /mtsho rdzing lteng ka me tog ljon shing 'phreng / /yid 'ong skyed tshal grong gis legs bskor zhing / /'dab chags rab rgyu lha yi bu bu mo/ /rin chen rgyan dang gos bzang mdzes pas klubs/ /snyan pa'i rol mo bstod bsngags glu dbyangs len/ /'phan gdug so bla bre phye phur mchod sprin spro/ /rdzu'aphrul can rnams mkha' la 'phur lding dbus/ /'od dpag med mgon sras thu bo zung / /'khor tshogs rgya mtshos yongs bskor bkod pa 'di/ /ri mor bris pa ji bzhin mngon sum du/ /myong ba'i skal pa bzang por 'gyur bar shog /g.yon lnga pa/sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i gdug can sogs/ /'dul phyir dbu dgu sum cu so bzhi'i phyag /bcu drug zhabs dang mtshan ma gyen bsgreng ba/ /rwa chen zhal gyi drod rlangs zhakhrul bral bar/ /pha rgyud 'dus pa ma rgyud 'khor lo sdom/ /gnyis med dgyes mdzad rdo rje la sogs pa/ /gong 'og rgyud sde'i lha tshogs mang po yis/ /legs bskor mkha' dbyings 'ja' ltar rnam bkra ba/ /nyen mongs lnga bkrus phung khams skye mched rnams/ /thabs mkhas lam gyi 'brasabu ye shes lngar/ /bsgyur nas rigs kun bdag po rdo rje sems/ /tshe 'dir mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gong gsal bris thang bcu gcig lcags mo bya'i lo mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis dad rten du bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rigs 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /nyi ma'i gnyen mchog sku bltams tshe/ /bang rim bzhi pa zlum po can/ /pad+ma spungs pa ser skya sa /bzhings ltar bu khrid rgyal mo yis/ /yon sbyar mthu las mig skyon sogs/ /nad gdon kun zhi —47(/

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ zhenamatho ris dang / /thar pa myur (39na)thob rigs brgyud bcas/ /'di phyi'i gtan mdun lhun grub shog /rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas tshe/ /gru dang bang rim bzhi ldan pa/ /bdud bcom byang chub mchod rten che/ /bzhengs ltar ྾/ yon ྾/ nad ྾/ thar ྾/ /'di phyi'i ྾/ wa ra ṇa sir chos gsungs tshe//bang rim gru bzhi glo 'bur can/ /bkra shis sgo mang mchod rten che/ /bzhengs mo/ yon ྾/ nad ྾/thar ྾/ /'di phyi'i ྾/ sum cu rtsa gsum sgyu 'phrul yum/ /bden pa la bkod them skas las/ /nyer byon lha babs mchod rten che/dze mo'i mo/ /mnyan yod ston pa drug btul tshe/ /bang rim gru bzhi slo 'bur can/ /cho 'phrul chen po'i mchod rten che/skor skor/ rgyal po'i khab tu dge 'dun rnams/ /brtsod par bang rim bzhi zur brgyad/ /cha mnyam dbyen 'dums mchod pa'i rten/mo mo mo mo/ yangasapa can du zla gsum bar/ /sku tshe byin brlabs bang rim gsum/ /zlum po rnam rgyal mchod rten che/྾za mo mo/ gzugs sku rtswa mchog grong bsdus tshe/ /bang rim dang bral mgur chu yan/ /khri steng myang 'das mchod rten che/ra mo mo mo/ /mtshan legs smon lam brgyad btab ltar/ /bu khrid rgyal mo'i mig nad sogs/ /zhi zhing rigs brgyud dang bcas pa'i/ /srid zhi'i yon tan dar drag shog /sgra dbyangs smon lam brgyad btab ltar/skor mo/ gser bzang smon lam bzhi btab ltar/khor mo/ mya ngan med smon bzhi btab ltar/mor mo/chos bsgrags smon lam bzhi btab ltar/skor mo/ mngon mkhyen smon lam bzhi btab ltar/〉〉mo/ sman bla'i smon lam bcu gnyis ltar/skoms/ 'i ka thub smon lam grangs med ltar/〉〉ri/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma yis/ /(39ba〉sdu khrid rgyal mo'i mig nad sogs/ /zhi zhing rigs brgyud dang bcas pa/ /'jigs brgyad kun las skyob byin rlobs/ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho yi/ /snang brnyan bzhengs mthus sbyin pa'i bdag /rigs brgyud bcas pa skye ba kun/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes 'dzin cing / /'di snang mig gi rab rib sogs/ /mi mthun kun zhi bsod nams tshe/ /rab 'phel lha mi'i rten brgyud nas/ /myur du rnam mkhyen thob par shog /tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rje yis/ /'dra 'bag bzhengs 'bras mchog gsum gyi/ /thugs rjes rgyu sbyor rigs —471 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)brgyad bcas/ /bsams pa'i don kun lhun grub shog /mtshan legs sgra dbyangs gser bzang mya ngan med/ /chos bsgrags mngon mkhyen sman bla shāka thub sku/ /sman mdo brgyad brgya par grags sangs rgyas bka'/ /pad spungs byang chen sgo mang lha lasababs/ /cho 'phrul dbyen 'dum rnam rgyal mya ngan 'das kyi/ /thugs rten yon sbyar bu khrid rgyal mo yis/ /legs bzhengs rigs dang brgyud par bcas rnams kyi/ /ston zla ltar dkar bsam pa rnam dag mthus/ /brgya phrag lus sprul gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang sngon zhun 'dra'i mchod yon lha dang mi'i/ /me tog phye phur dri dang shing sman spos/ /rtsi bas 'bru mar nyi zla nor bu yi/ /snang gsal bzang drug ga pur tsas chab/ /lha klu gnod sbyin mi yi ro bda'i zas/ /rna bar snyan 'a rjebs rol mo ji snyed 'brol/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan lda ldi bres/ /rgyal srid sna bdun nye ba'i rin chen bdun/ /bkra shis rdzas rtags 'dod yon lnga dngos bshams/ /rgya cher spel ba bdag pos yongs su bzung / /lhun po gser kyi ri dang rol mtsho bdun/ /gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla la sogs pa/ /bdag pos yongs su ma bzung mchod pa'i tshogs/ /yid bzhin nor dang (40na〉nga bzang mnga' 'bangs kyi/ /rnam par bdag gi lus 'dir rab sprul nas/ /'bul ba bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i mchod pa dang / /mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs sngags brjod pa yi/ /kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa bla na med/ /de dag tshad bzung bral ba blo yul las/ /brgal bar spel ba mos pa'i mthu yis mchode/ /skyabs yul rten dang byas pa'i sdig pa la/ /'gyod pas sun 'byin slad nas mi bgyid pa'i/ /slar ldog sdig tshogs ngo bo spros bral yang / /kun rdzob chu zla ltar snang bshags smon mthus/ /rnam 'dren 'khor bcas thugs ga'i 'od zer gyis/ /bdag sogs 'gro kun sgrib sbyangs kun tu spyod/ /stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas 'thol zhing bshags/ /bdag gzhan yongs kyis bsags pa'i dge la rangs/ /gdul bya'i blor 'tsham chos 'khor skor bar bskul/ /bskal bar mya ga mi mda' brtan par bzhugs/ /dge ba byang chub la bsngos bsod nams kyis/ /bdud bzhi gtan bcoms bu ram shing pa yi/ /—472

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyas pa/ (zhanamagur nas legs gsungs mdo chog brgyad brgya pa'i//dgongs don ji bzhin bde bar gshegs brgyad sras//'khor bcas smon lam btab pa'i nang tshan khrod//bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis//myong ba'i 'os min phyin chad rtsa ba nas//skye mi rung gi chos can spang bya'i rigs//rnam smin nag por 'byin pa 'di lta ste//lnga brgya'i tha mar gzhan 'drid tshul 'chos mthus//'gro rnams las ngan gyis bsgribs nad kyis gzer//mya ngan sdug bsngal tshogs kyis gtses phongs sogs//rnam dag smon lam mthu yis zhi bar shog/rims gshed mthu byad ro langs 'jigs shing skrag/long 'on spyo dang sha bkra tsha grang nad//dug gsum mtshams40bsgod lngas bsgribs ga spyod kyis//mtshon pa'i bya ba de 'bras mi 'byung shog/chos spong mi dge'i las mang ga 'gror skye//dbul po zas skom gos nor 'bru mal cha//spos phreng byug pa na ba'i gsos sman sogs//yo byad bral dang gzhan dbang gyur ba yi//chad las bcings brdeg go char gzhug pa dang //mtshon bsnun mes bsregs srog chags gdug pas 'tshe//phan tshun 'thab rtsod 'jigs skrag 'byug long dang //dngangs skrag mi 'dod thams cad drungs 'byin shog/chu bo chen po brgal dang grur 'jug pa'i//nyes dmigs rten yul gling med thang la 'khyoms//smre sngags 'don dang tshong zhing las byas par//khe spogs med sogs mnar ba kun bral shog/rgan 'tshe rgud yod blo ba tsha grang bkres//bud med nad mang skye gnas dag la smod//btsa' ba'i sdug bsngal dgra dang 'byog stong dgon//gnyen snag mdza' bo nye du'i mya ngan gyis//mtshan rgyu las mtha' mang zhugs sdig can gdon//dman mos shes chud rmongs pas nyan rang lam//don gnyer bskal me 'bar ba ngu zhing sdug/log pa'i lam 'phyan desabaskyed dag par shog/tshe thung dbul phongs bsgron me mdog ga zhing //phan tshun gnod sems srog gcod tshul 'chal bas//dad zas dkor gyis ga song gnas su skye//bskal pa'i tshe ldan dmyal bar sdug bsngal myong //mnar med mun 'khyams gnod sbyin srin po yis//mdangs 'phrog log ltas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed por//chos kyi ming la 4 med pa'i mtha' 'khob tu//mi dge'i bshes dang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)nam yang mi 'phrad shog /lus ngan dbang po ma tshang mdog mi sdug sha bem yan lag zhwa rgyar mgon skyabs bral/ /bud med skyon gyi nyon mongs mtha' dag pa/ /mi mthun lta bas nyer zings bdud zhags thebs/ /rgyal pos 'jigs skrag gsod (41na)pa'i rgyu mang chang / /sbrang bu sha sbrang gis za rgyal po la/ /bro nad dmag gshoms gza' skar sbyor byed sogs/ /ju zhags rtsis kyi nyes kun dang bral shog /dus min rlab wo sad ser than char gyis/ /lo tog nyams dang nad rimasamatshan bkra ngan/ /bgegs rigs nyer gyur las rkyen keg sri yis/ /bskyed pa'i byur sogs nyes tshogs zhi bar shog /mdor na thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /las ga sdig sgrib kyis sbags 'brasabu'i dri/ /bde gshegs sku gsung thugs rten rab bzhengs pa'i/ /mtho ris chu bos byang zhing dag par shog /skyabs yul rnams kyi mkhyen brtse 'phrin las mthus/ /thub bstan dar zhing de 'dzin skyes bu yi/ /sku tshe dge 'dun tshogs rnams klog pa dang / /spong ba las kyi 'khor lo 'phel ba'i mthus/ /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par rgya hor bod/ /yang sgos gangs can kha ba'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /'gro rnams bde zhing sa spyod rgyal po yi/ /sku tshe mnga' thang chab srid rgyas par shog /bye brag sgo gsum 'bad pas bde gshegs brgyad/ /bzheng pa'i sbyin bdag bu khrid rigs brgyud bcas/ /lha mi'i bde thob phan tshun byams shing brtse/ /'jigs pa kun bral zhi ba'i gnas thob shog /deng nas sangs rgyas go 'phang ma thob bar/ /bza' btung bgo ba rgyan phreng mal cha spos/ /byug pa gsos sman nor 'bru dbyig gser dngul/ /longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa rnyed par shog /dge ba 'phel zhing gzhan phan byang sems brtan/ /rlabs chen spyod 'grub sangs rgyas ma thob par/ /skye ba'i sdug bsngal med cing pho lus thob/ /mchod pa rim gro dag la brtson par shog /chos stobs byang chub yan lag ting 'dzin dang / /gzungs kyi sgo dang dkon cog rjes su dran/ shes rab chen pos rdzogs byed las mi ldog /dman pa'i sa las (41bskog tu 'das par shog /tshe ring nad bral dus min 'chi ba med/ /dbang phyug phun tshogs las sgrib nye nyon bral/ /byang chub bar du khrims gtsang sgo gsum sdom/ /mtshams —474

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanamed lnga byang re ba rdzogs par shog /brtse ba'i gnyen sdug dag dang mi 'bral zhing / /sangs rgyas sku yi 'od kyi reg pa dang / /mthong bas sdig dag lha yi lang tsho rgyas/ /'byung po'i gnod pa dang bral byams ldan shog /yang dag lta bas dkon cog gsum la dad/ /sangs rgyas mtshan dang chos kyi sgra thos pas//las ngan zad cing gnod pas 'phangs pa'i mtshon/ /phyir bzlog dgra rnams byams pa'i sems ldan shog /ring 'tsho rang rang stabs kyis cho go shes ldan/ /mkho rgu'i 'byor pa 'dzom zhing dge bas spyod//rang dbang thob cing bde bar gshegs pa'i mtshan/ /'chi khar thos pas mtho ris thob par shog /bdag lus mtshan dpes brgyan pa ci 'dra bar/ /'gro rnams der gyur 'od kyis 'jig rten khams/ /mtha' klas gsal zhing be+eḍūrla 'dra'i lus/ /rab gsal kho lag yangs shing rgya che ba/ /dpal dang gzi brjid nyi zla dag las lhag /'od kyis sdug po'i mun pa yongs sangs nas/ /phyogs rnams kun tu dga' mgur 'gro ba dang / /rang rang las rnams thogs med byed par shog /sman rgyal thabs shesamathu yis lus can kun/ /longs spyod zad mi shes pas bral g.yeng bral/ /sdom pa sum ldan 'phags pa dgyes pa yi/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa srung bar shog /da lta sems can mtha' dag bza' btung gis/ /tshim pas slad mar chos kyi bde la 'god/ /gos mang rin chen rgyan phreng rol mo yis/ /'gro rnams dga' zhing rnam grol thob par shog /thabs mkhas smon lam gzungs kyi mthu dag gis/ /bde gshegs kyis dgongs sras bcas rnams kyis sems/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas (42na〉bsrung zhing lha rnams kyis/ /nyin mtshan dus drug rnams su skyong bar shog /dgra yi dbang du mi 'gro ci bsam 'grub/ /yang dag bka' don 'gyur ba med pa mā /lus can kun gyis mdzo sum mthong ba dang / /bdud kyis mi brdzi skye rgu'i re skong shog /mdo sdo 'di 'chang gzhan la rgya cher ston/ /glegs bam brisapar sri zhu byed rnams la/ /bdag gis dngos dang rmi lam tsam du yang / /sman gyi bla ma'i mtshan gyi sgra sgrogs shog /bka' 'di rnam dag bsam pas 'dzin pa rnams/ /tshe mthar phyin pas dus min 'chi ba bral/ /gzhan gyi bkrag mdangs mi 'phrog 'phrogs na yang / /ring por mi thogs rang dbang thob par 473

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)shog/nad kyis gdungs te rnam shes gshin rje'i grong //phyin par zhe dgu bar du bdun wo gyi//mchod cing cho gas rnam shes slar ldog nas//nad can nad bral ring por 'tsho bar shog/rgyal posamado chog gis mchod sems bskyed kyis//btson rnams btang bas tshe stobs dbang phyug rgyas//lo legs ltas ga 'byung po'i gnod pa zhi//bde dang mchog tu dga' ba thob par shog/mdo sde 'di nyid gtso bor 'don pa la//rgyal ba rnams dang gsang bdag 'khor bcas kyis//bsrung zhing rtag tu tshe rabs dran pa dang //dam chos bstan pa yun ring gnas par shog/grong bhe grong khyer grong rdal dgon gnas su//sku gsung thugs rten tsho gos la mchod byed rnams//gnod sbyin bcu gnyis bdun 'bum 'khor bcas kyis//g.yel ba med par rtag tu bsrung bar shog/za hor rigs las 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes//ngag gis dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i dpal/lta to/ drung lta bur 'gyur med rab brtan zhing //rnam dkar 'phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas par shog/dga' ldan rnam par 42brgyal ba'i pho brang che'i//chos srid skyong ba sangs rgyas rgya mtsho yi//sku tshe rdo rje ltar brtan mnga' thang dang //rigs brgyud dpal 'byor rnam thos sras mtshungs shog/yon sbyor bu khrid rgyalamo'i 'di snang gi/mig gi rab rib la gsand gdon kun//zhi zhing skye bar lha mi'i rten bzang brgyud//myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog/gang gi bu dang tsha bo yang tsha so gos//rigs brgyud gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar chad med cing //tshe ring dpal lor bde skyid phun tsho gos pa//'a mi med bdag po'i bsod namasala'agran shog/sku gsung thugs rten 'di dag ba ched pa la//bzo bos na pa'i las byed zang zing gi//3 pa bsgrub rnams 'di phyir bde zhing skyid//ring yī byang tso wo po thob par shog/thub bas mdzad pa bstan pa'i mchod sdong che//bde gshegs mched 'khor bcas pa'i smon lam stobs//slu med rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yis//dpag bsam yongs 'du ji bzhin re skong shog/thar pa'i lam bzang ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas//thog mtha' bar du dge ba dam pa'i chos//de don tshul bzhin bsgrub pa dge 'dun gyis//srid zhi kun tu khyab pa'i bkra ༷༷shog/ces nyang bran grong smad gzhis dar gong

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ zhenagasal rten mchod rnams bzhengs pa'i dus rgyab yig la brko rgyu tshig rkang bdun ma dang / gzungasabazhugs kyi spel tshig dang kha tan sogs gang 'os la byas chog pa'i tshig rkang dgu ma 'di ni bskul ba po'i 'dod pa ltar tshig gi sbyor sde btang snyoms su byas nas go sla ba gtso bor brtan te/ za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gis bris pa sarwaṇ+ḍasirnyi bha wa skyo/ /byams mgon dga' ldan chos kyi seng ge'i khrir/ /mkhyen brtse rnam par bkra ba'i legs bshad kyis/(43na)/'gro rnams thog mtha' bar du bshes mdzad pa/ /rje btsun bla ma sku tshe rab brtan shog /lcags bya dga' ldan khri rin po che byams pa bkra shis sku snyun pa'i tshe chab shog tu stsal ba'i brtan bzhugs/ /phyag na pad dkar 'chang sogs mkhas grub kyi/ /sgyu 'phrul yid bzhin rin chen 'phrong ba'i gral/ /za hor brje'i snang bas 'ching bu'i rdo/ /mos pas ras dkar mkha' la 'ja' ltar shar/ /kun rdzob rgya mtshor bzang ga bar ma'i rlabs/ /'khrul rtog yol med don dam chu bo'i gshis/ /ro gcig chos sku'i klong du rang grol na/ /dad pa'i ri mo rdar bris gang gis bsub/ /de phyir ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /sras bcas rgyal ba yongs 'dus ngo bo sa /yid kyi zla ngos shar ba'i ri dwagasagazugs/ /byang chen bar du 'bral med rjes su gzung / /rgya bod yig rigs gtsug lag gnyis pa'i mig /rab yangs ngag dbang phun tshogs lhag bsam gyis/ /nyer bskrun dge bas tshe dpal bsod nams sogs/ /deng nas yang srid kun tu 'phel bar shog /lung rtogs yon tan sa bon dar drag pa/ /smon lam gsher gyis bskyed pa amra'i ljon/ /nges legs sa bu ro brgya dngar ba'i zas/ /myangasanas ris med 'gro la ster bar shog /sangs rgyas kun dngos rje btsun myong kha par/ /chos brgyad 'ching grol dag pa'i 'khor brgyad dang / /mgron thabs lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan jo 'brom zung / /khyab bdag rin chen bsod nams mchog grub zhabs/ /rnam 'byed shes rab sbyin mdzad 'jam dpal —477

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dbyangs/ /las kun thogs med bsgrub pa ngal bsos po/ /srid zhi'i 'dod pa 'jo ba rmugs 'dzin dbang / /tshon brgya nye ba'i dwangs shel lta bur bkra/ /bsod nams byas 'dis thu mi gnyis pa'i rigs/ /smyug thogs kha lo bsgyur ba'i (43brko pyod ldan can/ /rgyal rtse ngag dbang phun tshogs deng nas bzung / /yang srid kun tu bde zhing skyid par shog /bdog pa'i yon sbyor ri mo'i 'du byed mkhan//lus ngag yid kyis phan pa bsgrubs so cog /chos dkar mu tig 'khri shing char chen po/ /rim brgyud skye ba kun tu 'bab par shog /tshe 'di'i lus bskyed pha mas thog drangs pa'i/ /nam mkha'i mthas khyab gzhal dka'i sems can tshogs/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur/ /thog med nas bsags legs byas thams cad bsngo/ /brgya phrag nyi mas lkod pa mar gad kyi/ /lhun po'i mdzes brjid la 'gongs smin legs rten/ /dran pas 'jigs tshogs skyob pa rgyal kun yum/ /rje btsun seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma la/ /gang gi rnam par 'phrul po che yi gar/ /zla mig grangs su bsgyur nas lus can la/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las kyi 'dod pa'i don/ /bsgrub mdzad 'khor gyis yongs bskor rab spel mthus/ /'phags bod brda dag gzugs kyi rin chen rgyan/ /yig rigs sa srung gom 'gros shog bu'i thang/ /sgyu rtsal sor mos bgrod pa rgyal rtse ba/ /ngag dbang phun tsho gis dad pas bzhengs pa'i 'bras/ /deng nas byeng chub bar du 'jigs pa'i tshogs/ /dngos dang rmi lam tsam du mi 'byung zhing / /sum rtsen dag pa'i dga' ston lhan cig par/ /spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog /zhes rgyal rtse yig mkhan ngag dbang phun tsho gos kyis rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po/ seng ldeng nags sgrol/ nged rang gi 'dra 'bag gsum bzhengasapa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rgya bod kyi yig rigs du ma dang rtsis dkar nag la blo gros kyi snang (44na tha yangs pa mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos pad+ma 'byung gnas sku/ /gcig las du mar bsgyur ba mtshan brgyad dang //yid 'dzin 'tsho rgyal shāk+ki'i gtso mo yis/ /kun bzang rang zhal ma mthong bar rjes zungs/ rnga yab —478

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ zhedagling pa pad 'byung sam bha wa/ /mchog sred pad+ma rgyal po mkha' 'gro zung / /za hor rigs 'dzin dri za'i rgyal po yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu phan bde'i dpal la sbyor/ /bka' brgyad yongs 'dus rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /nyi ma 'od zer seng ge sgra sgrog dang / /'jam dpal snying po dam can srung mar bcas//rten 'dir bzhugs nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ thu ka seng 'chol ba'i khro rgyal bzang po grags//rgod ldem dpal gyi lha mo la sogs pa/ /rtsab gsum gyis rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag /'di phyi'i legs tshogs mtha' dag 'grub byin rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di'ang ri mo ba 'bag lhug gis thang bkod la gzhi ltas nas smon lam gyi tshigs bcad dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /thag khrar sprul du mngon pa'i dngangs skrag gis/ /don byed nus ltar 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes/ /spyan ras gzigs dang dbyer med ro gcig par/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dngos grub stsol/ /gangs can skye rgu yongs kyi chos skal du/ /bka' babs yig drug lhang lhang gsol 'debs dang / /bgrang yas ril bsgrub mthu yis mgon po khyod/ /g.yung drung lta bur rtag tu zhabasabartan shog /rnam dag dge 'dun 'dus pa'i thugs rje dang / /rten 'brel rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa yis/ /dam rdzas 'di zos mtha' dag 'khor ba yi/ /'jigs bral nges legs lam du bgrod par shog /(44ba po ge bcu kun tshang yar 'on gser gzhed kha/ /nyer sprad gsas khang rtse mor mnga' ris par/ /yongs grags 'dus gra 'khor lo rnam gsum gyi/ /srid mtha'i bar du bla nas blar 'phel shog /mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam par thar pa'i dpyid/ /gangs can 'dzin ma ches rdul bshad sgrub klung / /phyogs brgyar yongs 'phel zhwa ser 'chang ba'i bstan/ /'khor 'das yongs kyi gtsug tor rtser mdzes shog /chos rgyal tshangs pa lha yi me tog sras/ /mu tig btsan po'i yang sprul sangs rgyasakyi/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho 'degs pa'i sa dbang che/ /ngal bsos po dang skal ba mnyam par shog /chos srid dga' ston dpal dang legs ldan pa/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang chen po yi/ /khrims —479

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gnyis gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong can/ /gnam sa'i khyon la bar med 'khor bar shog /sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i 'jig rten na/ /'khod nas 'gro ba rigs drug skye rgu dang / /mi 'gro bar do mtha' dag sdug bsngal ba'i/ /tshor ba dang bral sgo gsum sim par shog /khyad par dbus gtsang khri skor bcu gsum gyi/ /ljongs 'dir mi phyugs nad rims btsa' 'bu than/ /sad ser mtha' bzhi'i tshong khe'i 'du sgo nyams/ /jag cho mes dmag zhakhrug ga 'bras zhi bar shog /brgya phrag lor 'tsho zas gos ma la cha stan/ /khang zhing sgo sdur 'bru ja rtsa mar shing / /rta drel gnag phyugs rin chen gos dar sogs/ /mkho dgu'i 'byor ba phun sum tshogs par shog /pad dkar 'amang ba'i 'byer so sum ldan dang / /nor bu pad+ma 'bod pa'i dbyangs snyan pos/ /'gro la spyan ras rtag tu nyer gzigs nas/ /bkra shisadapal gyi rtse dga' dgod par shog /ma ṇi dung phyur gtong skabs smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes gnyer pa 'phyong rgyas pa dka' bcu grags pa legs (45na〉zugad kyis skul ba ltar tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni brda dag yig rtsis la blo gros yangs pa mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi mdzad pa brgya'i zhal thang gi rgyab yig smon lam sogs/sras bcas rgyal bas mgrin gcig bsngags pa'i gtam/ /tshangs dbyangs rgyud du bkug pa snyan 'gyur glur/ /legs 'bab snying stobs chen po pad dkar ltar/ /rnam 'dren gzhan las khyad zhugs don kun grub/ /a ho grangs med bskal mang rgyal sras kyi/ /rlabs chen spyod pa'i tshad bzung tshangs pa yis/ /gdong bzhi sprul nas bltas kyang nus min na/ /tshur mthong byis blo phra mo des kyang ci/ /'on te a ma'i tshi gus rgya mtsho bzhin/ /dpal ldan dpa' bos pha rol phyin pa bcu/ /bcu tshan —480

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ zhedabacad pa rtogs brjod man+ta ra'i/ /chun po skal bzang thod du 'ching bya'i rgyan/ /gtsug lag gnyis pa shes pa'i mig yangs kyis/ /ras dkar ngos su ngo mtshar zhing bkod gar/ /ri gzugs grangs spel mthong bas don ldan la/ /blta phyir nyi zla mkha' la yang yang 'khor/ /bsod nams zhing sar 'dren la sa zla yi/ /bdog pa'i mchod sbyin gtong phod zur gyi rigs/ /'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal lhag bsam pad rtsa ltar/ /dkar ba'i 'bad rtsol mthu las deng der 'grub/ /phyag mchod ri mor bris pa'i legs byas mthus/ /ring 'tsho'i tshe dang dpal 'byor dbang thang sogs/ /thos bsam sgom sogasayon tan gong 'phel zhing / /lha mi'i rten brgyud byang chen myur thob shog /pha mas thogs drangs nye du rigs brgyud rnams/ /'di snang rmugs 'dzin dbang po'i dpal la 'gran/ /dge ba'i gzings kyisa'akhor ba'i mtsho bsgral nas/ /thar pa rin chen gling du bgrod par shog /rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi mdzad pa brgya'i zhal thang gi rgyab yig smon lam dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes zur btsun 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal gyis bskul ba'i ngor tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /ngag dbang dbyangs (45ba)can nyer dgyes blo gros la/ /bzang po'i bag chags sad pas rig pa'i gnas/ /bcu phrag rgya mtshor rab 'jug thos bsam rdzings/ /rnam dpyod rlung gis bskul la gsol ba 'debs/ /brjod pa yongs dag ngag gi rta bdun gyis/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la rab dbang nyin mor byed/ /blo gros mkha' las mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'od/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab khyod zhabs brtan shog /tshe lha drang srong rig 'dzin bden pa'i stobs/ /mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i nus mthu dang / /bslu ba med pa rten cing 'brel 'byung las/ /smon lam btab pa ji bzhin 'grub par shog /ces slob dpon dkon cog ngag dbang phag mo chos sde'i bla mar 'gro skabs chos skyong chen po'i bslab ston byung tshul gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /—481 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'gro ba kun la bu gcig ltar gzigs phyag na bad dkar 'dzin pa la/ /thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa dang rjes 'brangs 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes/ /nor gyi gter mdzod rmugs 'dzin dbang po srid gsum bdag mo dung skyong mas/ /yongs bskor bris sku'i rgyu rkyen sbyar mthus bsod nams nyi ma bdun 'bar shog /stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam don bzhin mtshan 'dzin dra ba ma lus pa/ shes rab ral gri rnon pos bcad nas rnam dpyod dpung pas rab bteg lha/ /mtshams sprin gos gyon mgon po khyod dang dbyer med jo bo yab sras gsum/ /zhabs rdul gtsug bsten tshangs sras ba 'ad pas bdag sogs 'gro kun rgyud byin rlobs/ /'chi ba'i dngos po ma lus mthar byed tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zhabs/ /klu mkha' gzugs grangs gtsug tor rtse mor mi pham mgon (46na)po'i rigs bdag can/ /nam mkha' bse ru'i grangs su yongs spel bris thang bskrun pa'i rnam dkar dges/ /yon sbyor nor bu rigs brgyud bcas pa srog gi ka ba tshugs pa shog /gzungs dang 'dzin pa'i nags tshal sdug por rtag tu nyer 'khyams 'gro ba rnams/ /'jigs brgyad gcan gzan mche sder rnon pos bde skyid lus srog yongs dbral bar/ /mar gad 'khri shing yal 'dab bskyod 'dra'i 'jam mnyen phyag ring gtsug khyongs la/ /sim pa'i tshor bar dbugs dbyung mdzod cig seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma kye/ /phung po gsum pa'i mdo las legs gsungs shāka thub la sogs bde gshegasabadun/ /yi ge drug pa kha rla pa ṇi rnam sras nor rgyun dpal lha mo/ khyu skar dbus na zla ba bzhin du so sor 'brang ma'i sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /rol pas rgyu sbyor nor bu'i rigs brgyud til gyi gang bu ltar 'phel shog /phung po gsum pa'i mdo las legs gsungs rin chen zla sogs bde gshegs bdun/ /seng ge'i sgra dang ha la ha la nor bu bzang po 'jam dpal zung / khyu skar dbus na zla ba ji bzhin stong chen rab 'joms sgyu 'phrul gyi/ /rol pas mo/ phung po gsum pa'i gdo las legs gsungs chu lha'i lha sogs bde gshegs bdun/ /gar dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug nor bzang dzam dmar srog sgrub yang dag shes/ /rgyu skar dbus na zla ba ji bzhin gsang sngags rjes 'dzin sgyu 'phrul gyi/ /rol pas ྾/—482

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa// (zhanaphung po gsum pa'i mdo las legs gsungs sred med bu sogs bde gshegs bdun/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang mgrin sngon don zhags lngas rtsen dzam ser ku be ra/ /rgyu skar dbus na zla ba ji bzhin bsil ba'i tshal gyi sgyu 'phrul gyi/ /rol (46ba)pas ྾/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo las legs gsungs dbang po'i tog sogs bde gshegs bdun/ /don zhags phyag bzhi phyag drug 'brog gnas dzam nag pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li/ /rgyu skar dbus na zla ba ji bzhin rma bya chen mo'i sgyu 'phrul gyi/ /rol pas ྾/ces skyid thang nor bus bris thang dgu bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni yig rtsis brda dag la blo gros dkar ba mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /'jig rten dbang phyug srong btsan sgam po'i zhabs/ /'gro 'dren dge 'dun kun bos mkhas shing grub/ /bsod nams zhing du srid zhi'i yon tan tshogs/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar yol ba med pa la/ /rnam dkar 'brel bar sgro btags za hor rigs/ /'jam dbyangs tshangs sras lus phrar dga' mgu sa /rtse ba'i legs bshad rgyud mang nyer bzhad pa'i/ /'jigs med rdo rje'i glur len snang brnyan tshogs/ /bris pas rgyu sbyor bzo rigs las grogs rnams/ /lha mi'i bde skyid skye ba rim brgyud myong / /myur du thar pa'i them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /byang chen khang par 'jug pa'i skal thob shog /ces pa'ang rdo rjes bgrang yas ma'i nang bzhin bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas rig byed pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i ster/ /rgya bod chos rgyal du mas yongs bskor ba/ /bskrun pa'i sbyin bdag 'di phyi kun bde zhing / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang myur thob shogalnga rig paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa la/ /rgya bod sa skyong mkhas grub bdun phrag gis/ /bskor ba bzhengs pas gnas skabs mthar thug gi /'dod pa'i don rnams ma lus grub par shog khres bya kun mkhyen dge 'dun rgya mtsho la/ /gangs ljongs skyes mchog drug dang dung (47na)skyong mas/ /bskor ba bzhedas dges srid zhi'i yon tan tshogs/ /yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar shog /dge 'dis ring por —483

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'tsho ba'i tshe dang ldan/ /'jigs pa brgyad sogs sdug bsngal mtha' dag bral/ /dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes bzung 'di phyi dang / /gtan gyi mdun ma lhun gyis grub par shog /ces dgos dgos a bar gyis 'gro la rjes brtse ma dang bstun pa'i 'khrungs rabs theng grangs gsum dang / seng ldeng nags sgrol bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa blo bzang dbang po'/ /sbyang gzhi gzhen nu bum rgya grol ba'i nang / /'bras bu rang rig ngo bo pad+ma 'byung / /chos sku 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang nyid du/ /gang shar rang sar grol phyir zhabs brtan shog /nad dbyings dag pa'i sems nyid 'ja' tshon zer/ /chu sgron las thon rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs/ /zhi khro'i rnam rol sgyu 'phrul zad mi shes/ /che mchog 'dus rtsal ngo bor zhabs brtan shog /sems can bsam pa'i khyad par de snyed du/ /'jug nus thugs rje'i sprul sku 'tha' klas kyang / /sum ldan rig 'dzin gar gyis phyag rgya kun/ /zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal du zhabs brtan shog /pad+ma thod 'phreng dri med bshesaganyen nas/ /rma gnyags so zur gnubs sogs mdo sgyu sems/ /bstan 'dzin he ru gaḥ dpal mi gzugs su/ /bsgyur spel bka' ma'i ring lugs dar rgyas shog /nyang ral chos dbang rgod kyi ldem phru sogs/ /bka' babs las 'phro sad pa brgya phrag gis/ /spyan drangs mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung dngar po'i ngad/ /'thul ba'i zab gter bstan pa rgyas par shog /dar rje dpal grags nas bzung nam mkha' la/ /rig 'dzin zam pa ma chad dkyil 'khor bkrag /sa la ma yal sngags 'chang bon grong pa'i/ /chos srid rigs (47ba7rgyud dar zhing rgyas par shog/skyabs gcig bla ma pad 'byung gnubs ban rje/ /yi dam tshe bdag khro chu dug stong nag /bka' srung ma gza' rdor gsum tshogs rnams kyis/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ring por 'tsho zhing snga 'gyur spyi dang bye brag bon grong pa dang rgyas kyi smon lam zhig dgos zhes dar rje dpal gyi grags pa'i rigs las sngags 'chang mchog grub rgyal pos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni yig rigs —484

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanabarda dag la blo gros kyi 'jug pa yangs pa mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /dkon cog gsum gyi mtshan snyan skye ba kun/ /'bral med thos byed bsod nams 'bod pa'i dung / /dngul shog rin chen phras brgyan 'dus tshogs rnams/ /kun rar 'du la sgra dbyangs bsgrags pa bzhin/ /'jungs bral bdog pa gtong ba'i mchod sbyin sgo/ /rab 'byed sgrub grogs bcas pa rdzogs ldan gyi/ /dga' ston myong ba'i mod la thar pa dang / /thams cad mkhyen par bgrod pa'i lam 'jug shog /dge legs zla zer rnam bkra'i ga pur rdul/ /bkra shis chos kyi kun+da ra 'thul ba'i 'dab/ /'dzum pa'i rkang drug bde ba chen po'i glu/ /nyer sgrogs sim pa'i sbrang rtsi rtag 'khyil shog /ces dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to gyis bkra shis bde chen pa'i dung la dngul shog rin chen phra tshom brgyab pa'i smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa bsam mthong lo tsā bas bgyis pa'o/ /lcags bya dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis dung gshog gnyis gsar bskrun gyi rgyur 'ba' dngul legs pa srang zhe bdun dang zho gsum/ gser zho bzhi bcu zhe gcig /g.yu pad gnyis dang phud rgyu gcig gi g.yu bsdoms pa'i rin gong gser zho zhe gnyis/ be+eḍūrla byu ru bcas pa'i rin gong la gser zho bcu dgu gzhan ma byu sa mu men/ ke ke sa pad rā ga shel sna'i/kha sna tsho gos mu tig dang bcas pa'i phras legs (48na)par spras ba sarbad dza yas/ /sna tshogs chos kyi de nyid ro gcig pa'i/ /mig sman gyis bsal ye shes rnam dag spyan/ zhes byar srid kun res 'jog med gzigs pa/ /dge 'dun grub sogs 'khrungs rabs tshar du dngar/ /rten mchog spyan sngar sran ma'i me tog ltar/ /skye phal mching bu 'phags chen yid bzhin gral/ /bsgrigasabadag rgyal rnams snod bas dag snang du/ /sbyong phyir bsnyems pa'i spobs mtho deng 'dir brtsegs/ /tshangs sras lha mos bzhad pa'i mchog sbyin las/ /legs bshad rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len mkhas par/ /'jig rten dbang phyug chos rgyal dge ba'i bshes/ /chos srung gis bskor mkha' ngos 'ja' ltar bkra/—485

— rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)mgon khyod thugs rje yongs 'du'i grib bsil du/ /ngal gso'i stegs la 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ /srid zhi'i legs tshogs dngar ba 'bras bu'i ro/ /byang chen bar du dga' ston myong bar shog /bsod nams bsags kun tshe lus stobs 'byor gyi/ /srog song mig stong can dang skal mnyam thob/ /lha mi'i rten bzang rim par dge bcu'i skas/ /'dzegs nas rnam mkhyen gzhal med khang 'jug shog /'gro kun rjes brtse'i sa bon khyod thugs kyi/ /zhing sar snyoms par bkram pas srid dang zhi'i/ /bde skyid snye ma dar drag gtong ba'i sgo/ /rab 'byed don kun grub phyag bdag gtsug khyongs/ /rgyal dang de sras slob ma dang bcas 'khor/ /bkra shis grangs ldan ras dkar dngas ma'i mtshor/ /zla gzugs 'char byed thu mi gnyis pa'i rigs/ /bstan 'dzin dbang po'i blo brtson gtong ba'i mthus/ /legs bskrun 'bras bu deng nas byang chub kyi/ /pha mtha' rdzogs min de srid 'dzad med du/ /myong bar 'di don bsgrub la phan 'dogs mkhan/ /kun dang bgo shar smon pa 'grub byin rlobs/ /(48ba)mnyam gzhag phyag rgyas ngan 'gro'i sgo 'gags shing / /dga' bde rig pa'i ye shes spel mdzad pa/ /bha ra dha dza gser can 'khor bcas kyis/ /yon sbyor mngon mtho nges legs sar 'god shog /ne'u le mthong regs 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /byams dang snying rje bskyed mdzad ba ku la/ /'khor tshogs rnams kyi 'jig rten 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i yon tan thams cad mngon gyur shog /gar dbang mdzod spu'i zer gyis 'chi ba'i mun/ /nyer bsal shākya seng shes bdud tshogs thul/ /rigs byed lha mo dzam dmar srog sgrub kyis/ /'dzad med mkho dgu'i 'byor ba snyil ba dang / /gzugs mig grangs ldan ārla tā re mas/ /brnag dka'i zug rngu zhi dang bsod nams rgyas/ /mi nor dbang sdud log 'dren tshar gcod pa'i/ /thugs rje'i mthu dpung bskul na deng dgongs shig /yig ris brda dag daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung lugs sogs/ /gtsug lag mang ngo/ra mig yangs lcang gseb pa/ /bstan 'dzin dbang po'i mi nor rigs brgyud rnams/ /spel legs gsar pa'i zla tshes 'phel bar shog /seng ldeng nags sgrol bkod pa sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /'jigs tsho gos brgyad sogs zug rngu kun zhi zhing / /mar me mdzad kyis dbugs —486

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ 'dadabyung gnas skabs su/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la spyod par shog /zla zhun stong gis byugs min tshe sbyin ma'i/ /bzhin gyis nyi bu'i smag rum pha mthar byas/ /byams pa'i 'dus pa dang por ma gyur bar/ /rmugs 'dzin bang mdzod rang gir dbang thob shog /lcang gseb pa drung yig bstan 'dzin dbang pos bris thang bdun tshar bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar blo ka'i grangs sogs blo dang sbyar te za hor gyi bzhes tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pas bgyis pa a the sid+dhi/ /bdud bzhi'i dgra bcom tshe (49na sko pag med pa'i mgon/ /mgon skyabs gling gyur 'phags ma rnam par rgyal/ /rgyal ba'i yum gcig yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zhabs/ /zhabs pad gtsug bsten tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang grags pa'i bstan/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho'i mthar spel 'phrin las sgo/ /sgo 'phar brgya phrag 'byed mkhas skye rgu'i bshes/ /bshes gnyen dam pa srid mthar zhabs brtan shog /sangs rgyas kun dngos kun mkhyen tsong kha pa'i/ /chos srid gong nas gong du spel ba la/ /snying stobs rgya chen rgya mtsho ltar zab pa/ /ga chokhe gzhi rab spangs rab tu brtan par shog /rno rno rtog ge'i rig pa brgya phrag gis/ /yang yang dpyad kyang klan ga'i skabs bral ba/ /dag dag dri med dga' ldan ring lugs la/ /mkhas mkhas gzur gnas ma lus 'jug par shog /dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i pho brang dga' bzhi kun/ /kun nas rdzogs ldan gsang ba sngags kyi grong / /grong khyer bde chen gter mdzod sras kyi gnas/ /gnas 'dzin 'dus sde rtag tu dar rgyas shog /yang yang rngul chu 'gram ngos mi 'dzag par/ /lhod lhod gtsug lag kun la mig yangs pa'i/ /dam dam khrims gnyis gser shing rab lci bas/ /snyan snyan dga' ba'i rgyang glu len par shog /tshur mthong srid gdung mun stug 'khyams pa rnams/ /tsha zer rnam 'dren thugs rje'i gzigs sangs nas/ /tshe rabs lha mi'i bde skyid la spyod pa/ /mtsho chen rlabs ltar dus las yol med shog /long long sprin dkar g.yo ba'i sbubs nang nas/ /ldir ldir dbyar gyi rnga gsang bsgrags pa'i tshe/ /mdzes mdzes mdongs ldan mngal khur 'dzin pa —487

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ltar/ /ring ring sangs rgyas sa de myur thob shog /rgyal bar gyur cig su sti ka yi glu/ /rgyal srasamagrin gcig blangs pas bdud bzhi las/ /rgyal rtags ba dan bsgreng dang dus (49ba)mtshungs su//rgyal rnga srid rtse'i bar du brdung bar shog /ces smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni lho brag sras dgyes pa rdo rje'i gzhal med khang du 'khod pa'i dga' ldan gsang sngags bde chen gyi slob dpon don grub rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor za hor bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /snyigs dus 'gro 'dren thub dbang shākya'i tog /'od dpag med sprul jo bo yab sras zhabs/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus med byung thugs rje'i mthus/ /blo bzang snyan grags bstan pa 'dzin spel bar/ /rnam gsum 'khor lo'i rim pa rgya mtsho rlabs/ /nam yang yol ba med par bsams bzhin du/ /skye ba'i zlos gar myur du bsgyur bar shog /rjes 'jug slob bu gra ris yon gyi bdag /rnam dag bsam pas dkon cog rnam gsum mchod/ /dbul phongs sbyin gtong sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs/ /dge tsho gis ched du dmigs pa'i 'bras 'byin shog /rtse gcig dad pa'i mthun rkyen rlung shugs kyis/ /gsol 'debs gru rdzings bskul bas mngon mtho yi/ /yon to bdun tshang rin kho gling yangs por/ /yongs 'dzin yang srid yid bzhi nor rnyed shog /sgo gsum 'bad pas nyer bsags bsod nams mthus/ /gdul bya'i don du dpal ldan bla ma khyod/ /slar yang 'byon pa'i zhal bzang mngon sum du/ /mthong ba'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog /myur mdzad legs ldan nag po phyag drug pa/ /ma he'i zhal can lha chen nyi ma'i bu/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma tis/ /bsams don lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /don dam rang bzhin gyis stong dbu ma'i lam/ /kun rdzob rgyu 'bras nam yang slu med pa/ /bden gnyis thabs (50na ting thabs byung rten 'brel gyis/ /smon lam ci btab 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces tre bo chos rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i sku skye myur du 'byon pa'i smon lam dgos tshul gra ris rnams kyis byung ba —488

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ zhenaltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /rgyal sras snying rje'i gter chen pad dkar 'chang / /rang byon lo ke shwa ra'i snang bas la/ /gos 'phan 'dis mtshone dngos su bshams pa dang / /yid sprul kun bzang mchod sprin phul ba'i dges/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i bsod nams zhing dam pa/ /ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo por rtag bzhugs nas/ /chos 'khor rgyun mi 'chad pa bskor bar shog /blo bzang dpal 'byor thog med nas bsags pa'i/ /sdig lhung mi dge'i las kun rab byang nas/ /skye bar lha mi'i bde skyid la spyod ring / /myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par shog /ces ri mo ba blo bzang dpal 'byor gyis bskul ngor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon ngag dbang dkon cog go /brgyud pa kun 'dus pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /yi dam kun 'dus sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha/ /chos skyong kun 'dus legs ldan ma ning nag /rtsa gsum kun 'dus tshogs kyis byin chen phob/ /paṇa chen dri med bshes gnyen rnam par 'phrul/ /nyang rigs blo gros mchog gi rdo rje yi/ /sprul pa'i zlos gar zhing 'dir mngon gyur pa/ /yid srubs sder bcas tsho gos las rgyal bar shog /gsang gsum mi gzhig rdo rje'i rang bzhin du/ /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin tshogs kyis byin brlabs te/ /snga 'gyur bstan lamakhyen brtse nus mthu'i bdag /dpal ldan skal pa bzang por 'gyur bar shog /mdo sgyu sems phyogs gter kha gong 'og sogs/ /gsang chen rnying ma'i smin grol rgyud bshad lung / /zab don man ngag spel phyir (50ba)slar byon gang / /g.yu drung srog gi ka ba tshugs par shog /sde brgyad 'byung pos glags blta khon grib byad/ /sngon gyi dus sri ngan sogs bar gcod kun/ /dbang drag pad+ma'i phyag g.yon lcags sdig gis/ /tshar bcad mthar bskrad mthu rtsal dbyung bar shog /gangs ri ser por mthong ltar log rtog mthus/ /nyams grib rkyen gyis mkha' 'gro'i 'khru ldog rnams/ /sel byed sna tsho gos thabs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /rdul bral ston gyi zla ba ltar 'gyur shog /bdag sogasarnams kyi rdzas sngags ting 'dzin la/ /brten nas 'chi med grub pa'i bcud len kun/ /mi gzhig —489

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)srog tu song nas mgon po khyod/ /'gro ba'i re skong ched du brtan par shog /khyad par sman lung khu dpon rim byon gyi/ /rigs dang brgyud la 'go zhing dus rgyun du/ /bsten cing sgrub pa'i chos skyong srung ma yis/ /rtag tu g.yel med 'phrin las byed par shog /ngo bo chos sku'i klong las ma 'gags gdangs/ /rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur shar las/ /thugs rje sprul sku mngon sum deng byon pa/ /'gro la chos 'khor bskor phyir brtan par shog /khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i sprul sku gtsang rong rgyal mkhar phyogs su zur gyi rigs las byon pa rdo rje tshe dbang dpal bzang gi brtan bzhugs 'di ni chos rje sku skye ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs rab rgyas kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho dpal bzang po/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bor yid ches nas//gsol ba 'debs na 'di phyi bar gsum gyi/ /bsams pa'i 'dod don ma lus lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di yang a khas kyis 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gsol dpon sngags rams pa'o/ /(51na)kā swā rwa smo ྅ khe tha 'o/ ke shwa ra mā ya lu si t+ya na rta mi thu kwa sha bi sbaḥgatso thang / ras dkar man shel ngos su 'jig rten dbang / /sgyu 'phrul rol gar ma 'dres gsal ba'i gzugs/ /ma hwa bo dhi sa smyu : shu bā li pu rdo ga ro shā ta mā lha ba na dz+wa la ( / /byang chen bar du gzigs mor tshar dngar ba/ /bsod nams nyi ma'i dngos brgya dpal 'bar shog /ngag gi 'dod 'jo dbang ba'i blo gros la/ /bzang po'i skal ba can sbyor rgya mtsho'i rlabs/ /'phreng ba yol med rten 'byung mi bslu'i mthus/ /srid zhi'i bde legs lhun gyis grub par sgo/ga /byang sems nam snying tshangs ris dri za'i rgyal/ /sde brgyad dregs ldan gtsug na zhabs(sen rdul/ /dmar 'od chags pa'i gzi yis dbang drag dang / /zhi rgyas las kun lhun gyis grub par shog /'di'i —490

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanagras me yis bsgyur ba mda' yi grangs/ /bskrun pas g.yo ru yar klungs khe gsum pa'i/ /(51ba/ye nor rigs brgyud dbang thang gsar tshes zla/ /dkar cha ji bzhin bla nas blar 'phel shog /mkhas grub dam pa'i thugs rje lha lam ngos/ /sras bcas zhi khre'i byin rlabs chu 'dzin 'khrigs/ /chos srung 'phrin las dbyar rnga ldir ba las/ /phun tshogs dga' ston char chen 'bebs par shog /g.yas dang po/shin tu 'jam zhing snyan pa'i dbyangs ldan kyang / /dus dgrar za byed ma he'i zhal gdangs pas/ /bdud bzhi'i klad 'gems nyi ma'i gzi byin gyis/ /sa gsum 'byung po'i me khyer 'jomasapar shog /dgra nag dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag nyid kyis/ /las kyi mthar thug sgrub pa mi g.yel zhing / /dngos grub kun 'byung ya mā ri tā ga /spros med lam gyi zung 'jug mngon gyur shog shes byar srid tshad 'jal ba'i blo gros mig /yangs pa'i mchog ster dkar ser zur phud rgyan/ /rnam rtog lcagasakhams bde skyid gser sbyangs su/ /bsgyur mdzad 'jam dpal nag pos deng skyongs shig /g.yel/'khor ba'i mtsho las 'gro ba kun sgrol bar/ /gru 'dzin ri bo'i spo na 'jig rten dbang / /bgrang yas dkyil 'khor chen po'i khyab bdag tu/ /bzhengs par 'od mtshan 'bar ba'i cod pan mdzes/ /legs bris bcud bral mi dang byol song dang / /yi dwags dmyal ba'i lus can rnam 'dren mgon/ /gang 'dul sprul pa'i rol gar thub pa drug /'khor gdung zug rngu 'byin pa sman gyi mchog /byams dang snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms kyi/ /ngo bo phyag rgya mtshan ma'i gzugs shar ba/ /sdug bsngal gsum las skye rgu ma lus pa/ /drongs shig sgo skyong khro mo rnam pa bzhi/ /gsum pa/rdo (52na)rje'i lus kyi pho brang chen po la/ /sgrub pa sde brgyad lha tshogs kun tshang ba//rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid drag po rtsal/ /byin phob dbang dang dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /nyi bu'i gnyen por 'jam dpal khro bo'i rgyal/ /tshe bdag dregs pa'i rgyal po 'char ka nag /ki gang phyag rdor khros pa drang srong gi /dmod pas sdebargyad gnod pa rbod gtong bzlog /lhung bzed ka la sha nas phyir lud pa'i/ /'chi med zil dngar rgyun gyis srog gi zungs/ /yongs gyur tshe yi g.yung drung nyi —491 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)zla ltar/ /rtag tu gzhom zhig bral bar byin gyis rlobs/ /7kho/chos rnams spros bral dbu ma'i lam po cher/ /dus gsum rgyal kun bgrod pa'i yum gcig ma/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa bzhin lag tu/ shar ba'i mi mthun phyogs rnams zil gyis gnon/ /so sor 'brang ma rma bya chen mo dang / /stong chen rab 'joms gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin/ /bsil pa'i tshal gyis rigs brgyud gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /ji bzhin chad pa med par rjes su gzung / /bde bar gshegs pa'i gtsug tor las byon pa/ /gdugs dkar lha mos pha rol rbod gtong byad/ /gdon bgegs dus min 'chi dang nad rims mun/ /mthu stobs nyi ma'i 'od kyis sangs par mdzod/ /lnga pa/ zhal khyim rgyal mtshan tog dang ne'u le yi/ /mgrin las bskyugs pa'i phun tsho gos rin chen dbye/ /phyur bur spungs dang mnyam par 'dod dgu'i char/ /phob cig dpal ldan nas ma thos pa'i sras/ /rmugs 'dzin nor bu bzang po su pu r+ṇa/ /ku be ra dang yang dag shes log gnas/ /lnga rtsen 'jam po 'khyil rnams cang shes la/ /zhen nas srid zhi'i dpal 'byor skad cig sdus/ /gnod sbyin bye ba'i dpung gi tshogs rnams kyis/ /log 'dren dgra sde (52bsgo tha' dag tshar bcad de/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon 'ja' ris kyis/ /dar chen lha lam kun tu khyab par phyor/ /drug pa/ mkha' la be con gzas pas dgra bgegs klad/ /bcom pa'i khrag rgyun bde skyong yol go sa /blug nas 'thung ba'i dpal ldan re ma tis/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs choms/ /zla ba'i bzhin dngom gser zhun brjid mdangs can/ /rjes chags lang tsho dar ba'i sprul sgyur gyis/ /sgrib gnyis nad gdon yongs zhi tshe 'byor rgyas/ /srid zhi'i legs tshogs dngos kun dbang sdus shig /snga phyir rgyug pa'i gdong can rnam gnyis dang / /dmar ser ral pa'i khrod shar ma mo bzhis/ /dus bzhi'i mi bzad cho 'phrul sna drangs nas/ /log 'dren yul 'khor bcas pa rdul du rlog /bon pa/shel dkar lhun po dbang gzhug stid pa yi/ /rjes 'gro mtshar sdug na chung 'chi med skur/ /dar zla ba rin chen rgyan gyis rnam pa bkrag / srid zhi'i dbul sel dpal ldan dung skyong ma/ /rgyal dbang —492

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ smyon)pad+ma'i spyan sngar pur rgyal gyi/ /bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel ba'i g.yar dam can/ /bdud dang gnod sbyin sman ma'i rigs 'dzin pa/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /nad rimasagadon bgegs sad ser btsa' than sogs/ /rgud pa'i nyer 'tsho mtha' dag drung phyungs nas/ /snod bcud yon to thams cad ma rmos pa'i/ /lo tog ji bzhin lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /g.yon dang po/bgrang yas blo gsal mgon du mkhas btsun bzang / /legs gyur grags pa'i dpal 'bar mkhyen brtse nus/ /rigs gsum mgon po'i bdag nyid myong kha pa/ /zla med gtan gyi skyabasadang dpung gnyen mchog /lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan jo 'brom yab sras gnyis/ khres byar srid kun mkhyen pa bu ston rje/ /gsang bdag dngos gyur nam mkha' rgyal mtshan (53na〉ltas/ /sras kyi thu bo rnam gsum tshar du dngar/ /dus gsum 'dren rnams ma dag gdul bya'i don/ /bshes gnyen gzugasasu 'char phyir thugs rje'i sprin/ /lang long khrigs las byin rlabs gru char gyis/ /bde skyid myu gu skyed du bsring bar shog /gnyis pa/ mi bskyod 'jam dpal sku la gdan gsum lha/ /cig car tshang ba bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / /rim lnga grol ba'i thig le'i lam bzang la/ /brten nas rdo rje 'chang dbang myur 'grub shog /bgrod dka' gsum gyi 'phrang ring las brgal nas/ /zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du/ /'khrid pa'i ded dpon dgyes mdzad he ru gaḥ /bdag med rdo rje btsun mo dus kun skyongs/ /gsum pa/ rnam par 'joms pa'i gsang sngags me dpung gis/ /gdon tsho gis 'byung po'i bud shing kun bsreg cing / /dran pas 'chi med dpal ster bi dza ya/ /gtsug tor lha mos tshe yi mchog sbyin zhig /7kho/shin tu gdul dka'i sems can nam mkha'i mtha'/ /ji snyed zhi bas 'dul yul ma gyur pas/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang khro bo'i skur bzhengs pa/ /bla mgon ngo bo gcig gyur myur mdzad lha//gnod sbyin lha chen gshin rje bdud kyi rigs/ /bka' sdod rdzu 'phrul thogs med rnam bzhi sogs/ /dam can rgya mtshos gang 'tsham cho 'phrul gyis/ /log 'dren gdug pa'i tshogs rnams spa bkongs shig/ 493

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bstan srung bye ba'i sde dpon gur gyi mgon/ /legs ldan gdong bzhi dpa' bo bram ze'i gzugs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drags las kun ma lus pa/ /sgrub pa'i mthu stobs nus pa da skyed cig /lnga pa/ yid bzhin nor bu'i mtshan dang don mthun par/ /bkres skom tsha gdung bcil ba'i zla zhal mgon/ /dngos grub gtur yi zegs ma'i (53bsil/ /phab nas yid kyi gdung ba sel bar mdzod//srid gsum brtan pa 'phrog pa rigs byed ma/ /glang po'i gdong can lha chen bgegs kyi rgyal/ /'dod pa'i rgyal pos sa 'og sa steng dang / /sa bla'i legs tshogos wa sha du ru ho/ /phyag mtshan bzhi 'dzin gnod sbyin ngal bsos pos/ /dbang drag 'phrin las cig car bsgrub pa dang / /gangs ri'i mdangasa'adzin dpal ldan dzam bha las/ /lha mi'i zas nor longs spyod phyur bur spungs/ /drug pa/ rim bdun sa 'og thod pa lcags mkhar nang / /srid gsum skye rgu'i srog gi bdag po'i gshed/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i las gshin 'khor bcas sa/ /mngon spyod drag po'i las rnams bsgrub par mdzad/ /brkyang bskum zhabs kyis srid gsum 'byung po'i lus/ /g.yo 'gul med par gnon mdzad gsang ba'i bdag /log 'dren 'dul ba'i phyag rgya thugs ka mā /bcings nas nam yang ldang ba med par mdzod/ /'jigs brgyad skyob dang nyer gcig las bsgrub pa'i/ /rnam 'gyur du ma spro ba'i gzhi gcig po/ /seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol mas mi 'jigs pa'i/ /sbyin pa'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag dbye bar mdzod/ /bdun pa/ yid 'phrog rin chen chu mtsho'i gzhal med dbus/ /rgyal kun mthu stobs gcig bsdus gsang ba'i bdag /phyag na rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon rnon pos/ /klu gnyen sa bdag gdug rtsub zhi bar mdzod/ /dkyil 'khor gcig tu gdengs can ma lus pa/ /'dus nas dga' bder spyod pa'i rten 'brel mthus/ /sa brkos rdo gshags shing bcad rtsing spyod kyis/ /phog thug nyes tshogos ma lus zhi bar shog /mi bzad gdung bas lto 'gro'i tshogs man reg /ting 'dzin sngags rdzas cho ga la brten nas/ /nyer zhi lus sems bde bas khyab gyur pa'i/ /rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa lhun grub shog zhes—494

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung hā gas bam gnyis pa/ (zhanayar klungs khe gsum du 'grem rgyu'i bris thang grwa tshar bco lnga'i rgyab yig mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab (54na)kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gtsug lag du mar blo mig yangs pa mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang pos bgyis pa dza yas/ /dge bcu kun tshang gangs can lha lam ngos/ /sa hor rgyal rigs chu shel dkyil 'khor la/ /dal 'byor ri dwags snang brnyan rab bkra ba/ /phan bde'i kun+da ba 'ad la gsol ba 'debs/ /thag khrar sprul bzhin skye ba'i grags snyan 'bar/ /rje btsun rim byon gdan sar gom pa bkod/ /mtha' yas gdul bya'i re ba yongs skong ba/ /mtshungs med sprul sku'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs pas mkhas/ /so thar khrims kyi rtsa ba brtan pas btsun/ /ris med 'gro la lhag bsam dkar bas bzang / /thub bstan 'dzes pa'i rgyan la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos du ma'i zhabs pad bsnyen/ /bgrang yas gsang chen 'khor lor yongs su smin/ /grol lam bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen thos bsam la/ /sgom pa'i bag chags sad par gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bshad gdams pa rig gtad rgyab brten lung / /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i phyag bzhes man ngag sogs/ /tshul bzhin 'bad pas brgyan pa'i goms 'dris kyi/ /smra ba'i spobs pa dge la gsol ba 'debs/ /lha sngags ye shes nam mkha'i glang po las/ /zhi rgyas dbang gi dngos grub gru char 'bebs/ /mngon spyod thog mdas yid srubs sde bcas brag /ming gi lhag mar 'thag la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsung rab 'chad la dbyig ga tshe rjes su 'gro/ /rtsod pas rgol pha tshar gcod chos grags ma/ /rtsom la dge dbang ngur smrig gos mnabs pas/ /blo gsal re ba skong lagasol ba 'debs/ /legs byas tshe ring gnam gyi dpung pa yis/ /rtsol ba'i ngal bar bltos min rkang sen zla/ /rgya hor bod sogs che dgu mgrin sngon gyi/ /gtsug tor rtse mor 'char la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros (54ba)kyis/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i mdza' bshes gnyen gyur pa/ /tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i legs bshad rgya mtsho'i gter/ /'jigs med rdo rje'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsol btab mthu las dbang chen sprul —495

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)pa'i gar/ /bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rde rje dpal bzang po/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i rang zhal mngon gyur par/ /mi 'bral brtse bas rjes su 'dzin par shog /dus gsum sangs rgyas pha mtha' mi mngon kyang / /kun 'dus gag chos pad+ma thod 'phreng gis/ /chos dang srid kyi bsam don ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dbang chen zlos gar thugs sras zla ba'i sprul sku bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rjes rgyun gyi zhal 'don dang theg mchog rab rgyasang du 'dzugs rgyu'i rnam thar gsol 'debs rjes 'dzan gyi smon lam dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes gsungs gis bskul ba ltar byi ba la glang chen gyi dpe bzhin sgro btags gyi stong shob bla chen spyi pa'i phyag mdzod nas bton te za hor gyi bsdos tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed smra ba mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ / gtso thang / ngag la ngag ster zur phud lnga ldan pa/ /rab gsal rab mang shes rab snang ba'i lha/ /'jam mnyen 'jam dkar smra ba'i dbang phyug gis/ /blo ldan blo yi 'dab stong bzhad la 'dud/ /rnam 'dren bskal bzang bzhi pa shākya'i rgyal/ /rgyal tshab rnam gnyis gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i 'tha'/ /mtha' 'jal rnam dpyod gzings kyis shes ldan kun/ /kun dga'i 'dod 'jo mi 'dzad ster la 'dud//'jigs 'jigs yol med mtha' zung ma lhung dbus/ /drang drang srid sgrub mda' 'dra'i bden gnyis go /btsan btsan zhi ba'i cha gang thub bstan zla/ /gsal gsal lang tsho dar ba'i sdel 'dud/ /mchog gsum (55na〉〉sa pa'i byin rlabs zil dngar can/ /mgon khyod phyag sor gyis bteg yol go'i nang / /gyen 'phyur rmu rgyun yon sbyor tshangs bug nas/ /nyer zhugs lus gang rten cing 'brel 'byung mthus/ /'gos rigs ye bzang rtse pa g.yu lo pa'i/ khyud las nyer son skyid skyid dus na gyi//'chi ba'i g.yul las rnam par rab rgyal te/ /mi shigs srog gi ka ba tshugs par shog /mdzad pa bas gnyis/ skad cig bskal par bsgyur ba'i rdo snyul mtha'/ /byang sems slob mar bcas pas rnyed min na/ /tshur mthong blo gros phra mos 'jal ba'i khur/ /byung bshul bsnyeg pa'i bung ba ji —496

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ zhe)bzhin ngal/ /dpag tshad lnga bcur ldan pa chu shel dbang / /rmig rjes chu nang 'char ltar 'gro ba'i blor/ /nyer 'tsham mig gzugs grangs kyi mdzad pa la/ /blta ba'i skal bzang legs byas bya bsabaskrun/ /bsod nams spel 'dis mgon khyod rlabs chen tshogs/ /bsags pa'i phung por yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag /mnyam por longs su spyod byin rlakhas pa'i ched/ /'khor los mtsho ni pa'i phyag mthil deng gtsug khyongs/ /tshe dpag med/ mdzod spu'i 'od zer spros pas mtshun lha'i mun/ /mthar byed tshe dang ye shes dpag med sku/ /mda' mig grangs su bskrun pa'i legs byas kyis/ /phung por ri bo dngos su rgyu ba bzhin/ / 'gos rigs ye bzang rtse ba g.yu lo pa'i/ /rgyud las nyer son skyid skyid dus min gyi/ /'chi ba'i g.yul las rnam par rab brgyal te/ /mi shigs srog gi ka ba tshugs par shog /mgon khyod zhal bzang pad+ma rwa ga'i mdangs/ /rjes chags gser 'gyur rtsi yis bdud bzhi'i lcags/ gtan mdun sa le sbram du nyer bsgyur nas/ /bde skyid 'byor pa'i dpal la spyod par shog /rnam par yi ma/ khyod zhal mthong sgom mtshan tsam 'dzin pas kyang / /gshin rje'i me long 'chang ba'i pho nya rnams/ /skyid skyur nyi ma'i gnyen gyis (55ba)cher bsngags pas/ /rnam par rgyal ma dbang zung bskrun pa'i dges/ /'gos rigs ye bzang rtse pa g.yu lo pa'i/ /rgyud las nyer son skyid skyid dus min gyi/ /'chi ba'i g.yu las rnam par rab rgyal te/ /mi shigs srog gi ka ba tshugs par shog /gang gi gtsug tor reg pa'i mod nyid la/ /nyi bu'i zhags pas bcings pa mi yi gzugs/ /'chi med lus su gyur nas bskal par yang / /gnas pa'i 'tsho ba don dang ldan par shog /sgrol dkar/ tshe dpag sbyin par yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /re 'dod 'khor lo rtag skor sgrol dkar sku/ /'byung lag grangs spel legs byas yongs 'du'i ljon/ /phan bde'i 'bras bzang dus su smin pa'i mthus/ /'gos rigs ye bzang rtse pa g.yu lo pa'i/ /rgyud las nyer son skyid skyid dus min gyi/ /'chi ba'i g.yul las rnam par rab rgyal te/ /mi shig srog gi ka ba tshugs par shog /sngags 'phreng —497

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)zil mngar srog gi zungs gyur cing / /'od zer drug sbrags mnyen lhag ut+pa las/ /nyer gtams bskal pa'i rlung gis mi gzhom par/ /bcug gnas ārla tā res rjes zungs shig /ces yar klung khe gsum du 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag /mdzad bcu/ tshe dpag med/ sgrol dkar rnam rgyal ma lnga so sor mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis ma'i tshe sgrub tu bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshus ltar za hor gyi ban+desasbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /rang rig che mchog ngo bor gdod ma nas/ shar ba'i rang gdangs ye shes 'od lnga'i gzugs//dpal chen khrag 'thung lus kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /zhi khro kun 'dus gcig chog yi dam lha/ ti de la la tshon bzhin sems kyi rnam 'phrul du/ /skyed rim gsal snang rang las gzhan min gdengs/ /rnyed nas ya nga med (56na)pa'i stang stabs kyis/ /bdud bzhi'i snying gar thog brdzis rab gtad zhing / /rtsa thig rlung gi bgrod pa la brten nas/ /tshe 'dir grol lam rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang / /rang rig don gyi sgrub pa bka' brgyad rnams/ /phreg chod thod brgal gnad kyi ngo 'phrod shog /ces khe gsum pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi dmigs rten bka' brgyad bris thang gi rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /mi bsrun 'byung po lha min mo yi mngal/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyi rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ /gdengs pa'i mod lhung rta mchog rol pa zhes/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas bde 'byung thugs kyi bcud/ /snang stong lha skur bsgom dang grag stong 'dzab/ /nyer bzlas rig stong chos sku'i klong nyid nas/ /zag med bde stong chu 'dzin sdug po las/ /dngos grub char gyis don gnyis 'bras smin cing / /ye shes rdo rje'i tsha tsha 'phros pa'i dpal/ /bgegs rigs rtsa spur ma lus rab bsregs lhag /rgya mtsho'i mthar bros don snying lkog mar 'thon/ /rnam shes gar dbang thugs dang 'dres gyur cig /ces gnas chung chos rgyal chen po'i sku khog tshe dbang dpal bzang gi kha ton gyi dmigs rten rgyab yig 'di'ang mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed blo bzang —4(38

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ rtonanadabang po'o/ /yid srubs snying stobs chung ngur byed pa yi/ /mchog gsum snang brnyan drang srong chu lha'i bus/ /dmigs yul las nyon dug bral yang srid chab/ /gtan mdun yan lag brgyad du 'gyur bar shog /thub gsung 'khor lo thar pa'i rtser son pa/ /sher phyin rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum pusta rka'i/ /don bzhin sgrub bya 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /bsgral nas byang chen grong du bgrod par shog /mdo rgyud gzungs sngags nor bu be+e ḍūrla/ /brda dag gzugs mdzes yi ge'i (56ba〉sud bu la/ /nyer brgyus phan yon do shal skye ba kun/ /mgul pa mdzes pa'i rgyan du spud par shog /hor dzo dmar dpon rgya mtsho'i dge bar sku dang gsung rten bzhengs pa'i smon lam zhig dgos zhes gtsug lag mang por blta ba'i mig yangs pa 'jam dbyangs blo ldan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i bstan pa la/ /sde snod thos 'dzin bsam sgom lhur len pas/ /sgo gsum 'bad nas brtson pa'i dge tshogs spel/ /smon lam rnam dag tshon gyis kha bsgyur bas/ /zhwa ser chos srid bstan pa rab 'phel zhing / /de 'dzin dge ba'i bshes rnams zhabs pad brtan//'dus pa' tshogs kun skye rgu'i bsod nams kyi/ /zhing du chos spyod rnam brgya 'phel bar shog /bod hor sa chen skyong ba sbyin pa'i bdag /gnam sa'i dbang phyug tshogs rnams sku tshe dang / /stobs 'byor mnga' thang yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas/ /'bangs rnams bde skyid dga' ston la spyod shog /skal bzang bstan 'dzin sngon bsags sdig sgrib kyis/ /bsgrubs pa'i sdug bsngal
