mtha' dag rab zhi zhing / /ring 'tsho bsod nams dbang thang ma lus pa/ /'chi med bdag po'i dpal la 'gran par shog /dkon cog rin chen gsum gyi thugs rje dang / /rten 'brel rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i mthus/ /ji ltar smon lam yongs btab re ba kun/ /'bad med lhun 'i rgyas grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces mthar rgyas rab 'byams pa skal bzang bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal 499

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)grong sngags rams pa'o/ /(57na)ā dzi nā ya dzñāshā kya dwa pu tā ) tā dī rga 6 〉 tre ba sa kwa ka lha bri k+ṣaḥrgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa'i sa bon skyed/ /bsrings las bshes gnyen dam pa dpag bsam ldon/ /kā ruḥ dru pa tā ྅ ri shu ya ge si rnyi ra sga ma tha lca dzñā ri na ri ṣ+ṭhathugs rje stong po yal 'dab phang phung rtser/ /dngos grub ro bda'i 'bras bu'i khur gyis lci/ /dbang rnon dad pa'i rdo ngos yang dag gi /gtan tshigs ri mor nyer bris snang bas gzugs//gcam bu tsam min mos pa'i zhing sa la/ /bgrang yas bsod nams snye ma g.yur za ldem/ /ka shi'i tshal du yan lag bzhi yi rjes/ /puṇ+ḍa rī ka yongs ba chad ye shes sems/ /ma ro zhe sum 'jug pa'i cho ga bh+ra ma ra'i/ /bden tshig rgyang glu rna ba'i dpyid du blangs/ /de phyir kun rdzob zhabrul ngo'i ri mo tsam ma yin don dam gdan gsum rab tshar mgon/ /rdo (57ba)rje'i slob dpon gzhan nas mi 'tshol bar//mthong ba'i mod la byin rlabs snying dbus 'jug /legs byas g.yung drung 'khyil ba gar dgu'i stan//tshe mtha' yas skur bzhengs te skyil mo krung / /bskal brgyar mi shigs mdzod spu las spros pa'i/ /'od kyis bdud bzhi'i mun pa zil gnon cing / /ma dag gdul dka'i sems can lcags khams gzhi/ /sna tshogs 'phrin las lam gyi rtsis bsgyur nas/ /'khor 'das bde skyid sa zla cher spungs pa/ /srid rtser bsnyeg pa'i ba ched pa lhun grub shog /mdo rgyud gzhung lugs dpyad gsum gyis dag pa/ /blo bzang grags snyan 'bar ba'i ring lugs dang / /zhwa ser bstan srid nyi zla zung 'brel gyi/ /snang bas 'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel zhing / /sna mang grub mtha' chos kyis bslad pa dang / /rang lugasatshul 'chos dug can dris sbags klung / /rten 'byung chu lha'i bu yis rabs bkrus nas/ /bzhed gzhung yan lag brgyad du 'gyur bar shog /mkhas grub chos rgyal rim byon ut+pa la'i/ /chun po sgo gsum la bsten thod mdzes su/ /nyer bcings mi bslu'i rgyu las byung ba'i 'bras/ /dam pa'i dri med spyan ras—500

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanakyis gzigs mthus/ /lha mi'i rten bzang zo chun ltar 'khor bar/ /nad gdon phongs sogs mi bzad zug rngu yi/ /tshor ba dang bral ring por 'tsho ba'i tshe/ /bsod nams rnam thos bu dang mtshungs par shog/ngag dbang lha mos blo gros skal bzang la/ /sbyar bas 'jam (58na po byangs gzhen nur dga' ba'i phyag /mgrin 'khyud ris bral skye rgu'i bshes gnyen dpung / /thugs rje rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'phreng yol med pas/ /deng nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar/ /bgrod phyir dam chos thur mas ma rig mig /rab phye ji lta ji snyed kun mthong nas/ /bgrang yas 'gro 'dren dpal du 'gyur bar shog /ched du rtsol bar bltos min smon pa'i don/ /lhun grub ma rmos lo tog snye ma la/ /lus can yongs kyis spyod par mchog gsum gyi/ /mkhyen brtse nus pas kun khyab bkra shis shog /thang khag ldan brgyad la 'bri rgyu/mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje gcig pu'i 'phrul/ /du mar bsgyur ba mig gi bdud rtsi yi/ /yon sbyor 'di'i ched 'bad rnams gnas skabs dang / /mthar thug bde skyid dpal la sbyor byin rlobs/ zhes mang thos mkhas pa'i dbang po byang ma khang gsar ba dpal 'byor bsod nams lhun grub kyi dpon brgyud zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa 'phyos chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtses thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs rin cen 'phreng mdzes la gzhi byas grwa tshar bzhengs pa'i gtso thang gi 'dra 'bag la brjod don gyi sa bon dmigs bsal bgyis 'dug pa gzhan dag khrel ba'i rgyur song dogs kyang / snyan ngag rab btags kyi rgyan la mtha' gcig tu ma nges pas bskul ba po'i blo dang sbyar te tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes (58ba)bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni gtsug lag du mar blo mig yangs pa mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /bde ba yo gyi snyo bkod/ rtse gcig ting 'dzin rlung gi 'gro 'ong gis//'od dpag med zhal mngon gsum nyer mthong ba/ /tshegs chung don chen ji ltar smon pa bzhin/ /'grub par gar dbang sras bcas mthu dpung skyed/ / rje btsong kha pa/ shing rta che gnyis rjes 'brangs gser ri'i dbus/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i bang —501 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rim mtho brtsegs par/ /legs bshad nyi zla'i sgron mes gling bzhi yi/ /ma rig mun sel btsong kha pas byin rlobs/ /gtso bo/ lus ngag yid dri dbang bzhi'i chus bkrus pas/ /phung lnga gnas gyur blo yi bum bzang du/ /lnga ldan ye shes rgya mtshos yongs 'khyil ba/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes kyis bdag rjes bzung / /sras bcas rgyal ba'i snang brnyan chu shel dbang / /ras dkar kun gsal la shar sna tshogs gzugs/ /bgrang yas bsod nams rdzing bur rtag gsal ba/ /'od snang byang chub bar du 'bar bar shog /rgyu sbyor rab 'byams blo bzang chos ldan dang / /ri mo'i 'du byed mkhan sogs phyogs 'di la/ /sgo gsum 'bad rnams 'khor 'das yon tan kun/ /dbyar gyi chu gter lta bur 'phel bar shog /srong ba 'a sgam po/ khrims gnyis drang por srong la chos btsan pa/ /sgam po'i blo yis dpa' mdzangs brtul phod can/ /gangs ljongs phan bde'i sgo 'byed rtsi sman gyis/ /dug gsum (59na skod brgya mtha' dag gso bar mdzod/ /las/tshangs spyod dge bsnyen dmar cha'i na phra yang /gzhan phan snying rje rgyal rigs che ba yis/ /mkhas btsun mdun na 'don rnams zil gnon pa/ /'phrom ston dri med spyan gyis btsa' bar mdzod/ /rje dge bon grub/shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i yid bzhin nor/ /bgrang yas dge 'dun yongs kyi gtsug rgyan du/ /lhun grub rnam 'dren mchog gis srid zhi yi/ /'jigs pa kun las bskyabs nas bdag rjes gzung / /rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ rtag tu dge ba'i rkang gdub drel chung sgra/ /'brol bar 'dun pa'i legs byas ngang mo dkar/ /ye shes 'o ma'i rgya mtshor rtse 'jo mkhan/ /dbyangs can ba 'ad pa'i rdo rjes rtag tu skyongs/ /rje bsod nams rgya mtsho/ bsod nams dpal 'bar rgya hor che dgu'i gtsug /zhabs sen rdul dmar bkod pa'i snyan grags rnga/ /mtsho byung lha mos phyogs brgyar legs brdungs pa/ /mgon po bdag sogs 'gro kun dbugs dbyung zhig /srid zhi'i yon tan rin cen 'byung ba'i gnas/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'phreng yol med pa/ /mthu stobs nus pas mkha' mnyam yid can kun/ /bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa che las skyob tu gsol/ /zhes 'phyong rgyas sngags rams pa blo bzang chos ldan gyis bde ba can gyi zhing bkod/ rje btsun btsong kha pa/ 'di ga'i —502

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhana'adra 'bag gtso thang du byas par/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po/ 'brom ston pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa rim pa bzhi'i bris thang la gsol 'debs rin cen 'phreng mdzes sor bzhag gis bskor ba rnams bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni reg byed smra ba blo bzang dbang pos bgyis pa lasgri/ /grangs med bskal mang bsgrubs pa'i tshogs gnyis kyis/ /bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam rgyal thub pa mchog /dam tshig gsum bkod lha yis grangs ring gi /skye bar rjes gzung myang 'das sa la sbyor/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus snang brnyan chu shel dbang / /ras dkar kun gsal la shar sna tshogs gzungs/ /bgrang yas bsod nams rdzing bur rtag gsal ba/ /'od snang byang chub bar du 'bar bar shog /rgyu sbyor lha sa ngag dbang thub bstan dang / ri mo'i 'du byed mkhan sogs phyogs 'di la/ sgo gsum 'bad rnams 'khor 'das yon tan kun/ dbyar gyi chu gter lta bur 'phel bar shog /zhi khro rab 'byams mtha' dag mgon khyod skur/ /rdzogs pas skyabs mgon gcig chog drag po rtsal/ /gsal stong rig ngor rang ngo 'phrod pa yis/ /phung po 'od skur tshe 'dir grol bar shog /ces lha sa ba ngag dbang thub bstan gyis thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod dang drag po rtsal gyi bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed smra ba blo bzang dbang po'o/ /pad 'byung gsang gsum mdzad mtha' rnyed min kyang / /gling (60na)'dir sgyu 'phrul rol gar che long tsam/ /sna nam par gsungs 'di mtshungs brtul shugs kyi/ /spyod pa bdag gis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsa ba gsum gyi snang brnyan chu shel dbang / /ras dkar kun gsal la shar sna tshogs gzugs/ /bgrang yas bsod nams rdzing bur rtag gsal ba/ /'od snang byang chub bar du 'bar bar shog /rgyu sbyor lha sa blo gros legs pa dang / /ri mo'i 'du byed ra/lan sogs phyogs 'di la/ /sgo gsum 'bad rnams 'khor 'das yon tan kun/ /dbyar gyi chu gter lta bur 'phel bar shog—503

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dus dgrar dbyings nas bzhengs pa'i 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /zil gnon phyag rgya'i zlos gar longs spyod rdzogs/ /mi bzad 'chi bdag sprul pa'i cho 'phrul gyis/ /dgra bgegs srog mthar byas nas ru mtshon sgrengs/ /lha sa ba blo gros legs pa'i dad rten du si rgyu rgya mtsho'i zhing bkod dang 'jam dpal zil gnon gyi sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed smra ba blo bzang dbang po'o/ /mgon khyod thugs ka'i lam gyi sbubs nang du/ /nying mtshams sbyar tshe thogs pa med bgrod nas/ /brdzus te pad+ma'i sbubs skyes rgyal sras su/ /yongs gyur mkha' khyab 'gro kun 'dren par shog /mtshan legs yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po yis/ /gzod ma nyid nas thugasabaskyed smon lam gyi/ /'bras bu bdag gis(60bsgo' sum nyams myong nas/ /grangs med lus can tsho gos la sbyin nus shog /rin cen chu shel khams las legs grub pa/ /thugs rje zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha rdzogs las/ /phan bde'i ma spyi ra yi zegs ma yis/ /sdug kun bden pa'i tsha gdung bcil bar shog /sngon goms 'gro la thugs bskyed dzasbu'i 'bras/ /ris med skye rgu'i bsod nams mtshor lhungs par/ /gtan bde'i gser bzang snye mas lus can rnams/ /dbul phongs sdug bsngal drungs nas 'byin par shog /du byed 'gyur dang mi bzad sdug bsngal gyis/ /mnar ba'i mya ngan zug rngu mtha' dag kun/ /'jig rten yongs la ming tsam med pa sa /bde gshegs thugs rje can gyis rjes su gzung / /dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis rgyud lnga'i 'gro'i/ /thar pa'i srog gi 'tsho ba 'gyur med du/ /mdzad pa'i grags snyan ji bzhin bdag sogs la/ /slad mar don dang ldan pa'i bka' drin stsol/ /lus can bsam pa'i khyad par mtha' klas pa/ /ma' sum mkhyen nas sgrib gnyis bag la nyal/ /'joms pa'i gnyen po thabs mkhas thugs rje'i sgo/ /cher snyigs dus 'dir lhag par 'byed du gsol/ /sman gyi bla ma'i mtshan snyan thos pa dang / /sku brnyan bzhengs shing mchod bstod smon lam mthus/ /nying mtshams sbyar tshe be+eḍūr snang ba'i 'od/ /dag pa'i zhing der thogs med skye bar shog /thub dbang dpal gyi mgur nas legs gsungs pa/ /bde gshegs bdun gyi mdo chog tshad ma'i —504

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanabaka'/ /slu med 'bras bu mkha' (61nasgo nyam sems can gyis/ /mngon sum nyams su myong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bgrang yas zhing rdul zhabs kyis nyer bcags kyang / /ku sha'i rtses gtor rgya mtsho'i thigs pa bzhin/ /bcu gnyis mdzad pa bstan pa'i rnam par thar/ /ring por mi thogs bdag gis 'dzin par shog /bsod nams mthu yis ngag dbang nam mkha' dang / /rnam rgyal dpal bzang 'di phyi bar gsum gyi/ /mdun ma lhun grub dge tshogs ci mchis pa/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams sangs rgyas thob rgyur bsngo/ /zhes 'phyong rgyas pa ngag dbang nam mkha' dang rnam rgyal dpal bzang gnyis kyis bris thang bcu tshar bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa blo bzang dbang pos bgyis pa maṅga lo/ /ngag dbang dbyangs can mgrin chags blo gros kyis/ /bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i ring lugs kun/ /spel phyir rig gnas rgya mtsho'i sgo 'phar brgya/ /'byed mdzad bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /gdong lngas nyer bteg sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /mgon khyod tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bo mā /bzhengs nas bskal brgyar gzhom zhig bral bar shog /sangs rgyas gnyis pa kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i/ /chos srid bstan pa gting zab rgya che ba/ / dbyar mtsho lta bur 'byur mdzad sa'i tshangs pa/ /sku tshe mnga' thang mtshan jus dar drag shog /dga' ldan gtsug (61ba〉pag bla nas blar 'phel zhing / /nyer rgyas nges ga dge 'dun 'dus pa gling / /'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba ma lus pa/ /dkar cha'i zla bzhin cha shas gang bar shog /dkon cog bden dang byin rlabs tshogs gnyis kyis/ /mnga' thang rab 'bar chos dbyings rnam dag cing / /rgyu 'bras nam yang bslu ba med pa'i mthus/ /ji ltar smon lam btab pa lhun grub shos /ces pa 'di'ang mnga' ris khyung rdzong dkar po'i chos sde dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling spyi sos bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa bsam mthong lo tsā ba phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /rigs kun khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /brgya phrag snang brnyan bskrun pa'i dge tshogs —505

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)kyis/ /ri mo'i 'du byed mkhan po rta mgrin gyis/ /rang rig gdod ma'i dbyings su ngo 'phrod shog /gal te sngon goms las nyen bag chags mthus/ /de tshul rnyed pa'i skal ba ches phra na/ /srid pa bar do'i 'jigs pa las thar nas/ /dal 'byor rin cen myur du thob par shog /mngon mtho'i rten la nges gsang theg pa yi/ /smin grol gdams pa nyams su blangs byas nas/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa chen por/ /myur du bgrod de rang gzhan don 'grub shog /spang rtogs yon to gcig tu mtshis na yang / /'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par gangs can 'dir/ /bka' drin 'gran zla med pa'i rigasabargya'i bdag /pad 'byung gzugs sku bcu phrag bcu bzhengs mthus/ /laṅka'i pho brang pad+ma 'od kyi zhing / /bgrang yas rigs 'dzin bye (62na tha'i 'dun gas /pir thogs rta mgrin srid pa yongs bzung nas/ /rnam gsum yo ga'i chos la spyod par shog /sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol rang gi sems/ /kun tu bzang po dbul po'i skyid rdo'i gser/ /ji bzhin ngo 'phrod sna tshogs sprul pa yis/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'gro ba'i don byed shog /ri mo ba rta mgrin gyi ched rten le tshan bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /rgyal kun 'phrin las bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor/ /tshogs gnyis rgyal mtshan rtser bkod phan bde'i char/ /bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tshor 'bebs mdzad ngag gi dbang / /blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la tshangs sras dbyangs can lha/ /dgyes 'dzum bzhed pasargol ngan gnyen po mā /'jig med dpyad gsum dag pa rdo rje'i sde/ /g.yung drung srog gi ka ba tshugs par shog /rnam dpyod zla tshes gsal bas rmongs mun sangs/ /blo gros cha rgyas lugs gnyis rgya mtsho che/ /'phel mdzad mi dbang sku tshe mnga' thang kun/ /gser gyi 'khor los sgyur rgyal la 'gran shog /legs bshad ke ta das drungs shākya'i bstan/ /dngas mtshor blo bzang grags pa'i ring lugs bzhin//ma pham dbus 'gyur 'chang du byon min par/ /rab dkar skye rgu'i dpung gnyen dam par shog /tshul —da//6

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ ( nana'adi bskul dang kha tan byed po rnams/ /dam pa'i mgon (62ba)gyis skye bar rjes 'dzin zhing/ /'di phyi bar do'i legs tshogs ma lus pa/ /bsams pa ji bzhin lhun gyis 'grub par shog /rgya hor bod kyi nor 'dzin pad+ma'i ltor/ /nad mtshon mu ge'i zug rngu dang bral ba'i/ /bde skyid sgrums pa'i khye'u nyer btsas te/ /rdzogs ldan bzhen nu'i rtse 'gyur 'jo bar shog /mkha' la gza' skar 'phrod sbyor phun sum tshogs/ /sa gzhir bkra shis g.yang chags g.yas su 'khyil/ /dge legs yar ngo'i zla bltar rgyas pas/ /yangs pa'i 'jig rten kun tu khyab gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang sho pa mdo'i rdzong sdod dge slong rin cen rgyal mtshan dang stod lung cha dkar ba gnyis kyis dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling sogs chos sde khag tshor 'dzugs rgyu dang rang gi kha ton gyi ched du dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /gang gi sku la rtsa ba gsum gyi lha/ /yongs shar 'khor 'das zil gnon bas pa rtsal/ / ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde'i/ /snang brtan sa zla'i khu bas legs bris dges/ /deng nasabazung ste zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rab smin bskyed rdzogs rdzogs ོ po yi/ /grol ba'i lam gyisabacu gsum rdo rje'i sar/ /myur du bgrod nas 'gro kun 'dren par shog /gnas skabs su yong nad gdon bar gcod sogs/ /mi mthun nyes pa'i tsho gos rnams rabazhi zhing / /ring po'i tshe dang dpal 'byor lung rtogs kyi/ /yon (63na 〉 tha mtha' dag gong du 'phel bar shog /ri mas pa chos dbang rgya mtshos 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag gi bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /gdan gsum tshang ba nges gsang lha yi tshogs/ /'dus pa'i lor lo mnya ne ye shes rten/ /dbu rgyan spel legs tshar du dngar ba'i rgyud/ /lhag bsam dag pas bdog pa sbyar ba'i mthus/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos dga' ba'i bshes gnyen zhabs/ /'phrog byed ster mos gyen du bteg pa'i khri/ /sna tsho gos rdo rje'i re khas mtshan pa'i steng / /bskal brgyar migayo chos lor skor bar shog /—507

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)yon sbyor byed po rigs brgyud mnga' thang tshe/ /rmugs 'dzin dbang po'i mched por 'gran bzod cing / /ring por mi thogs mkha' mnyam sems can kun/ /'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por 'gyur bar shog /ces lha sa la khang pa tshe dbang bstan 'dzin gyis chu shur thar gling bar lo rim tsar gyi bar rigs lnga lnga re dbul ba'i smon lam dgos tshul byung ba byang gter cigs rje chen por rigs lnga gyon srol med kyang gsang 'dus la byed rgyu yin 'dug gshis za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /ngo bo ka dag nang dbyings 'od gsal dang / /gang shar rang sar grol ba chos kyi sku/ /sems nyid don gyi bla mar ngo 'phrod pa/ /nam yang 'pho 'gyur (63ba)bri gang med par shog /rang bawo lhun grub snang srid rgyal ba'i zhing / /'byams klas che mchog yongs 'dus rig pa'i rtsal/ /ye shes dbang po'i sgor shar longs spyod rdzogs/ /mdzo gsum dbyings rig dbyer med brtan par shog /kun khyab thugs rje phyag rgya'i cho 'phrul gzis/ /'khor 'das zil gyis gnon pa'i ba 'ad pa rtsal/ /zhing 'dir 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen du/ /sprul pa'i zlos gar mi nub brtan par shog /khri srong sde'u btsun 'phrin re ma'i 'phrul/ /ngag dbang tshangs sras ba 'ad pa blo mdzod sgo/ /'byed pa'i skalabazang rgya mtshos gangs ljongs kyis/ /phan bde'i dga' ston spel bzhed lhun grub shog /gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor kun la dbang phyug pa'i/ /bsod nams dpung pas rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan/ /'degs pa'i sku tshe mnga' thang rgya mtsho'i rlabs/ khred mtha'i bar du yol ba med par shog /lha sras mu khri btsan po sngon goms kyi/ /bag chags bzang pos bod dang bod chen gyi/ /skye rgu'i gnya' bar khrims gnyis gser gyi shing / /lci ba'i rdzogs ldan dga' ston dar drag shog /'gyur med rdo rjes rab mtshan khri chen por/ /ngag gi dbang phyug grub pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /pad+ma kā ra'i bka' gter bshad sgrub bstan/ /'dzin phyir chos 'khor rtag tu skor bar shog /gan jag thang ta zhing 'dir srid bzung ste/ /sngon nas zab gter sgo phye'i 'phrin las dang / /slad mar bka' babs 508

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (na)mtha' dag gegs med du/ /lhun grub bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tshor 'gyur bar shog /chos rgyal (64na)yab sras lo chen be+e ro'i zhabs/ /rnam dag smon lam 'bras smin dus gcig tu/ /'dzom pa'i rten 'brel mthu las su la'i ljongs/ /phan bde'i srog gi ka ba tshugs par lha thog /sangs rgyas gnyis pa skyon pad+ma yi/ /theg pa rim dgu'i smin grol gdams pa'i gling / /klog pa thos bsam spong ba bsam gtan dang / /bya ba las kyi 'khor lo rgyas par shog /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par rgya hor bod/ /yang sgos dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i rgyal khams 'dir/ /mi phyugs nad rims 'thab rtsod dbul phongs sogs/ /dus kyi chad pa mtha' dag zhi bar shog /tshe yang ring por gnas pa'i dge mtshan dang / /lo tog rtsi shing nags tshal dus su smin/ /mtha' bzhi'i dngos kun 'du ba longs spyod 'phel/ /sgo gsum sim pa'i tshor ba myong bar shog /rnam dag bsam pas 'dir 'bad rgyu sbyor mkhan/ /skye bar dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes bzung nas/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dga' ston gyis/ /phyogasadus kun tu khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /ces bden pa brjod pa'i smon lam gyi tshigs bcad 'di ni chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa'i 'brungs rabs gsol 'debs dang lhan du skyon smin grol gling du 'dzugs rtsis kyis 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bskul ba po nyid do/ /phyag na pad dkar thugs rje'i byin rlabs mthus/ /za hor rigs 'dzin byang sems myu gu rtsal/ /rnam snang gangs can mtsho ltar (64ba 〉 khor ba'i mtha'/ /stos min de srid rdo rje ltar brtan shog /sangs rgyas bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid rnams/ /rgya mtsho che bzhin rtag tu 'phel mdzad pa/ /mi dbang sku tshe nyi zla dang mnyam zhing / /rigs brgyud mtshan jus mnga' thang 'phel bar shog /'jig rten sbyi dang khyad par bod yul du/ /dbul phongs na da rims 'thab rtsod kun zhi zhing / /'dzam gling tshe lo brgyad khri'i skye rgu yi/ /bsod nams mnyam por dbang ba'i skal thob shog /nya stong brgyad gsum la sogs dus bzang por/ /'phags mchog mchod bstod sgom bzlas bgyis pa kun/ /tshe 'dir bde —509

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)skyid nyams su myong ba dang / /phyi ma gru 'dzin gnas su skye bar shog /chos sku snang mtha' longs sku spyan ras gzigs/ /sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas byin rlabs kyis/ /deng 'dir smon lam ji ltar btab pa kun/ /'bad rtsol med par ngang gis 'grub par shog zhes pa 'di yang ma ṇi ba dgos pa sogs spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen 'dra 'bag la/ /bla ma bde gshegs yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /dam can srung mas yongs bskor 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /rnam bkra mig gi gzigs mor tshar du dngar/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i zhing sa gshin po la/ /zang zing gtong ba'i sa bon yongs btab pa//legs byas zad mi shis pa'i snye ma yi/ /'bras bu'i khur gyis rtag tu dud par shog /g.yor (65na)pa mdo btsun ngag dbang lhun grub kyi/ /mi nor rigs brgyud tshe dpal 'byor pa kun/ /nyi zla'i bgrod pa ji bzhin chad med cing / /bde skyid snang bas yongs su khyab par shog /ces mdo pa ngag dbang lhun grub kyis bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa blo bzang dbang pos bgyis pa maṅga lo/ /thugs bskyed sa bon tshogs gnyis brlan gsher gyis/ /legs bsrings chos gzugs stong po dar drag par/ /'phrin las 'bras bu'i khur lci 'gro kun la/ /nyer 'jug bu ram shing pa sa brtol dbang / /e ma srid pa'i mig 'phrul bkrag po ches/ /'drid pa sems can bsam pa'i khyad par bzhin//dpal gyi mgur las gsungs pa'i chos kyi mtha'/ /nam mkha'i ske rags mas kyang ga la 'ching /'on te snga phyi'i bstan la tshad ma'i dpang / /lo paṇa gyis bsgyur mdo mang mkhas rnams kyis/ /dkar chag btab las glegs bam bu ga'i grangs/ /legs bskrun bsod nams bye ba'i phung po yis/ /rtsod can dogs pa'i gnas min dpyod ldan kun/ /rnam dag thub gzhung dgongs 'grel bgrang bya mā /'dren nus shākya seng ge'i lung rtogs bstan/ /bshad sgrub bya bas dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing / /—510

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ zhenabaka' gdams bstan pa'i srog tu mkhyen brtse'i sman/ /legs song 'jam dpal rdo rje btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs dar zhing de 'dzin bshes gnyen bstan/ /khrims ldan (65ba)'dus sde bla nas blar 'phel shog gser mdog zhwa yi chos srid gnyis ldan khrims/ /dzasbu mi k+ṣa sa mtshan pa'i sa chen por/ /legs khyab sdug bsngal kun zhi bde skyid kyi/ /rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i rtse dga' dgod par shog /rgyal ba'i mdzad mchog gsung gi 'phrin las kyi/ /zla ba'i ma ma a mra'i tshig gu yis/ /ga khul pa'i glegs bam yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag /tshe dbang dar rgyas mchis 'brang rigs brgyud bcas/ /bris mkhan shog sbyor sgo gsum 'bad pa'i bran/ /mdor na ched du ngal bsten dud 'gro sogs/ /'di snang nad mug 'thab rtsod tsher rnon rtses/ /lus ngag yid la zug rngu mi 'byin shog /dal 'byor rten la tshe yang ring por gnas/ /'dzad med longs spyod snyan pa'i grags pa 'bar/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam bzang la brten nas/ /gtan gyi mdun ma rnam dag bsgrub nus shog /yang srid brgyud mar lha mi'i rin cen skas/ /dge bcu'i gdang bur 'dzegs nas nges legs kyi/ /nor bu'i ba gam mtho brtsegs la zhugs te/ /sgrib nga gnyas gtan bcoms sangs rgyas ma ro zhe gyur shog /tshe 'di'i lus bskyed pha mas thog drangasapa'i/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams byang chen thob ched rgyur/ /'dis mtshon sngon bsags chos dkar bsgrubs so cog /dri bral lhag bsam dag pa'i mthu yis bsngo/ /zhes mdun na 'don tshe dbang dar rgyas kyis mdo sdo bskal bzang / rgya che rol pa/ phal chen/ snying rje pad dkar/ dam chos pad dkar dang bcas pa'i glegs bam dgu blo ngan zhes (66na)pa lcags mo bya'i lo gsar du bzhengs pa'i bsngo smon 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes rgyu sbyor mkhan pos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed 'dzin pa mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang pos bgyis pa sarba de klu le khris〉bha wastu/ / slu med dkon cog rin cen rnam pa gsum/ /khyad par 'od dpag med mgon thugs rje yis//hor tshang nor bu'i mchos gong klu ga dang / /phun tshogs rab brtan don gnyis lhun grub shog /ngag gi —51/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sder/ /mi phyed dad pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / /tshe dpal bsod nams mnga' thang rgyas par shog /yang srid kun tu mgon po khyod nyid kyis/ /'bral ba med par rjes su rab 'dzin cing / /bde ba can du brdzus te pad+ma las/ /skyes nas 'gro rnams ma lus 'dren par shog /ces 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes tre bo hor tshang nor bus bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /bgrang yas lus can bsod nams zhing mchog tu/ /skye 'phags dge 'dun sdud pa'i sgra snyan po/ /phyogs bcur lhang lhang sgrog byed dung gi gos/ /sna tshogs za 'og dar gyi phon po can/ /mi phyed dad pas phul bas rgyu sbyor rnams/ /yang srid kun tu rgyal ba'i gsung rab tshogs/ /rna ba'i rgyan du nyer spud nyams bstar bas/ /'di phyi'i 'dun ma lhun gyis grub par (66ba〉skog /ces 'phyos bkra shis sde chen gyi dung gos dar bcas rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling gi gra rgyun bcu gnyis kyis so so nas dngul srang do dang zho re bsdus nas phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa bsam mthong lo tsā ba phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /nam mkha'i mtha' ltar yangs pa'i blo gros kyis/ /legs par bshad pas bgrang yas gdul bya rnams/ /skal pa bzang por bsgyur mdzad ngag gi dbang / /don kun grub pa'i dpal la gsol ba 'debs/ dze brtan seng shes bteg pa'i khri chen po/ /pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la mgon po khyod/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor bzhugs gyur nas/ /chos 'khor rgyun 'ad bral bar rtag bskor shog /skyabs mchogo rin cen gsum gyi bden pa dang / /mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i mthu stobs kyis/ /ji ltar bsam pa'i re ba ma lus pa/ /thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par shog /ces chos rje sngags rams pa nam mkha' bzang po'i gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs 'di ni thang sag dga' ldan chos 'khor ba spyi sos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa bsam mthong lo tsā ba —512

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanaphun tshogs dbang po'o//tshe mtha' yas mgon phyag gi lhung bzed kyi//kha nas gyen 'phyur bdud rtsi srog zungs su//'gyur bar gsol ba nyer btab re 'bras kun//'grub par mchog gsum 67na khrigs rjes deng byin rlobs//zhabrul med rgyal ba'i gsung ngag smin grol la//dbang phyug blo gros bum bzang yongs gtamasapa//rgya chen gnas lnga rig pa mtsho byung ma'i//drin las legs rnyed bskal par zhabs brtan shog/gti mug mun sangs sde bzhi'i gtsug lag cher//rnam dpyod rab rgyas khrims gnyis gser 'khor gyis//rgya mtsho'i gos can rna la mnga' sgyur ba//sku tshe g.yung drung lta bur brtan par shog/blo bzang grags bsnyan bstan pa'i rgyal mas tog/'od stong srid gsum kun khyab 'gro rnams kyis//'khor mun dukha mthar byas phan dang bde'i//snang ba gsar pa phyogs brgyar 'bar bar shog/dga' ldan lugs gnyis pho brang rgyal po'i khab//rdzogs ldan rnam par thar pa sgo bzhi po//ma pham 'phags yul byon par yongs phye nas//lus can kun gyi ngal gsor 'gyur bar shogashes rab mchog gyur shā ri'i bu yi spyan//g.yas pa bsod nams zhing bzhugs ga rdo la//gra pa mngon par shes pas legs btab pa//sde dgon ma bu srid mthar rgyas par shog/rin cen rnam gsum bden pa rgyal sras bcas//byin rlabs tshogos gnyis rab rdzogs mnga' thang che//chos dbyings mi 'gyur chos ho slu med mthus//smon pa'i re ba mtha' dag lhun grub shog/ces spyan g.yas spyi sos ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrigs pa'i tshe mkhan chen rab stims smra ba'i shes gnyen sku skye bstan 'dzin rgya 67bsgo tsho'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa bsam mthong lo tsā ba phun tsho gis dbang po'o//rnam shes tshogos brgyad srin po'i grong khyer dbus//zur gsum snying dbyibs zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtser//rig pa'i rang rtsal pad+ma thod phreng dang //dbyer med drin mā bla mar gsol ba 'debs//tshemachog la sogs zhi khro yongs 'dus pa'i//ma 'gags gdangs las snang srid 'khor 'das cho me//gang shar rang grol bskar brgyar zhabs brtan cing //tshe rabs kun tu dbang bskur bdag byin rlobs//nye lde

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dbon po ngag dbang 'phrin las kyi kha tan du tshigs bcad 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa bsam mthong lo tsā ba phun tsho gos dbang po'o/ /rnam 'dren de sras slob ma'i tsho gos rnams kyi/ /phul byung thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs mthus/ /rje dbon ngag dbang dpon cog rgya mtsho yi/ /dal 'byor rten bzang srid pa myur 'dzin shog /rgyal gsung yongs la klog pa thos bsam dang / /nang du mnyam par 'jog pa tshul bzhin du/ /bsgrub nus dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams 'dir/ /mtho ris yon to bdun tshang lus thob shog /brlang por spyod pa lha mi'i gdon tshogs kyis/ /nyer 'tshe glags blta'i mun pa kun sangs nas/ /bstan 'gro'i snang ba rab ster nyin mor byed/ /gdul bya'i mkha' (68na)la shar zhing brtan par shog zhes sgyi tsha dbon po ngag dbang dkon cog rgya mtsho'i yang srid gyur 'byon gyi bden tshig brjod pa 'di ni sprul sku'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa bsam mthong lo cwa ba phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / /dam can chos srung thams cad khyod kyi skur/ /nyer tshang 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa yi/ /thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa'i mthu dpung skyed/ /gang gi bstan pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par/ /spel ba'i bka' babs ngag dbang blo yi gter/ /skal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i 'phrin las rgyun/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin yol med zhabs brtan shog /sangs rgyas gnyis pa kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i/ /bstan srid rgya che mtsho ltar gting zab pa yongs 'dzin lha mi'i dbang phyug rnam thos bur/ /legs ldan sku tshe mnga' thang rgyas par shog /tshe ring gnam gyi she mong dpung pa yis/ /sa la stobs kyi 'khor los yongs sgyur ba/ /dga' ldan pho brang lugs gnyis rgyal ba'i khrims/ /gser shing kun gyi gnya' bar rtag lci shog /mtha' 'khob mon yul lha min gnyen po ru /dga' ldan tshangs pa'i 'khor los sgra gcan mgrin/ /bcad nas rnam par rgyal ba'i dar dkar po/ /lha dbang pho brang rtse mor 'phyar bar shog /ye shes mgon po lcam dral bkakha sdod tshogs/ /—514

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ rton)khyad par gnod sbyin k+ṣe tra pā la dang / /las(68ba〉kye gshin rje 'dod khams dbang phyug mas/ /bstan la 'khu ba'i dgra bgegs tshar chod cig /bslab gsum lus la sde snod gsum gyi rgyan/ /nyer spras zhwa ser rnam dag bstan pa yi/ /rten 'brel mi bslu dkon cog bden pa'i mthus/ /bdud sde snying zhugasadapung tshogs zhi bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang dga' ldan rnam rgyal lha rtser 'dzugs rgyur me rag bla ma blo gros rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /ngag dbang tshangs sras bzhad pa'i blo gros kyis/ /skal bzang rgya mtsho'i re stong phas rgol tshogs/ /gzhom la mi 'jigs rdo rje pha lam mtshan/ /thub bstan yongs kyi shing rtar gsol bar 'debs/ /'jam dbyangs dbyangs can mgrin par rtse 'jo yi/ /rnam dpyod dpyod ldan dga' ston spel ba'i bshes/ /ma 'dris 'dris pa'i 'gro bzhin ris med gnyen/ /srid mtha' mtha' bral bar du zhabs brtan shog tags bya kun la 'jigs med grags pa'i sgra/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i shing rta che/ /'dren pa'i 'dus sde dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing / /bshad sgrub 'phrin las rgyun mi chad par shog /ces smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni mngon dga' chos sde sogs kyi mkhan po rje dbon ngag dbang nam mkhas bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /shel gyi lhun po zla ba zhun ma yis/ /(69na tshe pan brgyar byugs pas bsnen min mtshan dpe'i sku/ /'gro ba kun sgrol phyag na pad dkar 'chang / /thub drug sgo ma bzhir bcas lha tshogs la/ /zab gter rigs 'dzin brgyud pa mu tig 'phreng / /spel legs ngos kyi sug pa'i ri mo yi/ /mdzes rgyan mthong thos dran reg yid can kun/ /gru 'dzin ri bor 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan bzhin/ /ris med sems can kun la byams pa'i spyan/ /dkyus ring nyer gzigs rlung gis bskul ba'i gzings/ /'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral te myang 'das kyi/ /rin cen gling du 'khrid par bdag byin rlobs/ /tshe dbang rab —5/5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)brtan mchis gong rigs kyi bu/ /brgyud par bcas kun tshe dpal bsod nams stobs/ /rab rgyas yang srid phyi mar 'phags mchog gis/ /rjes bzung dag pa'i zhing du 'dren par shog /spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan sangs rgyas rnams/ /mnyam yang lnga bdo'i 'gro la thugs rje'i dpung / /rnam 'dren gzhan gyis 'gran min pad+ma 'byung / /dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs khyod kho na/ /gang gi gdams pas rnam grol rgyu 'phrul gar/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa'i gzigs mo tshar dngar ba/ /rje 'bangasanyer lngas yongs bskor legs byas kyi/ 'ang rtas drangs pa'i nor bu'i mched zla bzhin/ /dad pa ras dkar gtsang ma'i rdzing bu'i ngos/ /lag pa'i ri mo pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i rgya/ /gsal ba'i byin rlabs snying la nyer 'jug pa/ /mig sngon 'phrul po ches kyang 'gog nus ci/ /tshe dbang rab brtan mchos(69ba)'brang rigs kyi 〉〉〉〉/ /rdzus skyes mig gsum me yis bdud dpung lus/ /bsregs kyang steng 'og bar gsum lha ma srin/ /'dul phyir rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi skur/ /rab bzhengs zhi khro'i lha tshogs yongs shar bar/ /brgyud pa drug ldan bla brgyud kun gsal ngos/ /dbang po'i gzhu ris lta bur rnam bkra ba/ /mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba'i byed po sa /rtsa gsum thugs rje mngon sum shar ba bzhin//mos pa'i lcags gyos khrid pa'i glang po yis/ /lag pa'i gom 'gros lhod por bkod pa'i rjes/ /mngon sum gsal ba'i byin rlabs gru char gyis/ /phan bde'i myu gu byang chen bar skyed srings/ /tshe dbang rab brtan 〉〉〉〉/ /ji lta ji snyed chos kun spyan ras kyis/ /gzigs pas lhag po rgyal gzhan mtha' dag la/ /med kyang sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ngur smig gar du nyer brdzu btsong kha par/ /zab rgyas brgyud pa ma chad rin cen 'phreng / /bkod legs srad bur brgyus pa 'dren byed la/ /sngon med zil dngar dga' ston cho ga dag /rdzogs 'di skal bzang bsod namasazong gis bsgrubs/ /skye bar phan pa bsgrub la rab smon pa'i/ /lag sor rtags kyi ri mo rnam bkra ba//nam yang lhod pa med pa'i mdza' na mo/ /re ba'i 'dod pa 'jo ba kun dga'i dpyid/ /tshe dbang rab brtan 〉〉〉〉/ /'khor 'das yon tan phun tshogs mi ldan kyang / /gangs ri sngon por snang ba'i —516

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ sgon)zhabrul shes ltar/ /za hor btsun pa a wa sgru tī pa'i/ /gzugs brnyan (70na pod ldan bsod nams zhing gi phul/ /lag pa'i ri mo rab bkra'i mtha' skor du/ /lam rim bla brgyud gong gi 'phro mthud pas/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi rlabs chen spyod pa'i tshul/ /skal bzang gdul byar ston la rings pa bzhin//klu sgrub thogs med bzhed srol mtho ris chab/ /mar me mdzad dpal dzaḥs btungs rgyun/ /blo bzang grags snyan thugs kyi rgya mtsho cher/ /babs 'dis 'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis sgo kun zhakhru da/ /tshe dbang rab brtan khor mo mo/ gser gyi mdog can mtshan dpe'i nyi ma yis/ /'gro kun ma rig gnyid las slong mdzad pa/ /bu ram shing pa'i zhabs sen rdul dmar po/ /bdag sogs kun gyi gtsug tu lhung bar mdzod//rnam dag bsam pas nyer bskrun bsod nams 'dis/ /tshe dbang rab brtan mchis 'brang rigs brgyud dang / /bzo bor bcas pa'i 'di phyi bar gsum gyi/ /mdun ma mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par shog /tshangs sras ba shā da pa'i ngag gi dbang phyug gis/ /ji snyed shes byar blta ba'i blo gros mig /yangs pasaskal bzang gdul bya rgya mtsho yi/ /snying gi gdung sel khyod kyis rjes su zungs/ /rnam dag khor mor/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyang rgya gar paṇa chen tshul/ /chags dang bral yang shes rab dga' mar rol/ /kun la brtse yang sde brgyad snying rtsa 'dar/ /srin yul rtag bzhugs rgyun du bod skyong mtshar/ /rnam dag skorakhor/ /dag zhing yid dga' chos 'dzin gzhal yas su/ /bzhugs kyang 'dzam gling 'gro ba'i (70ba)don mdzad par/ /nam yang ngal ba med par mi pham mgon/ /lnga bdo'i 'gro ba mtha' dag 'dren par mdzod/ /rnam dag 〉〉〉〉/ /phur pa'i dpal gyi bdud sde'i snying 'gas kyang / /thub bstan 'phrin las spel ba'i dar chen po/ /srid rtse'i bar du 'phyar ba'i khro bo'i rgyal/ /rdo rje gzhen nus mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /rnam dag mo 〉 〉 〉/ /gar dbang mgon po'i sras mchog gru 'dzin mgon/ /gangs can lha gcig lag na pad dkar 'chang / /thugs ma'i yi ge las babs bdud rtsi yis/ /'gro ba drug gi sdug bsngal mthar mdzod cig /rnam dag mor mo mo/ /mgon po kun tu gzigs khyod blo gros mtha'/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pas gzhal dka' yang / /da dung slob pa'i lam la gnas —5/7—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)pa'i tshul/ /ston mdzad zur phud lnga pas rtag tu skyongs/ /rnam dag 〉〉〉〉/ /dmar zlum spyan gyis lta stangs gzigs pa'i mod/ /bdud dpung lag cha stabs cig 'chor nus pa/ /gsang ba kun gyi mdzod 'dzin khro bo'i rgyal/ /lag na rdo rjes mi mthun phyogs las srungs/ /rnam dag skor〉〉/ /'khor ba stongs min de srid rang gi don/ /yal bar bor ba'i dam bca'i khur chen po/ /snying stobs phrag par len pa spyan ras gzigs/ /'jam mnyen phyag khyongs 'gro dbugs ma lus phyungs/ /rnam dag 〉〉〉〉/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin g.yo dang bcud 'tshor sogs/ /nyes tshogs mtha' dag gang gi thugs rje'i mthus/ /rnam par gzhil te bde skyid la sbyor bar/ /(71na)byang sems sa yi snying pos mthu dpung skyed/ /rnam dag 〉〉〉〉/ /lus can kun gyi rgyud la shes bya dang / /nyon mongs bag la nyal gyi sgrib pa kun/ /rnam par sel ba sa bcu'i dbang phyug gis/ /srid mthar lhod med rjes su 'dzin par shog /rnam dag skor zas/ /lha yi lam nas bkra shis dge ba yi/ /mtshan ltas bzang pos 'jig rten ma lus pa/ /khyab mdzad nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs rje che'i/ /mthu dpung bskyed par gsol la deng dgongs shig /rnam dag mdzes mo/ /mtho dma' med par snyoms pas nyer drangs te/ /rjes brtse'i chu yis du:kha'i me dpung kun/ /bsad nas sim pa'i tshor bas bsil pa yi/ /reg bya la sbyor byams pa mgon po kye/ /rnam dag 〉〉〉〉/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da lta'i dus kun tu/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gis nyer 'phyan te/ /sgo gsum mnar rnams lam bzang la 'khrid par/ /mdzod cig chos kyi sprin gnas sems dpa' che/ /rnam dag mo skor mo/ /'di phyi bar do gsum gyi skyabs gcig por/ /bla ma chos skyong dbyer med thugs rje'i gter/ /myur mdzad ye shes mgon po phyag drug pas/ /deng nas byang chub bar du rjes zungs shig /rnam dag 〉〉〉〉/ /rgyal mtshan tog dang ne'u le'i kha nang nas/ /phun tshogs nor bu'i char rgyun legs phab ste/ /dbul phongs dang bral rmugs 'dzin 'byor pa la/ /bdag sogs sbyor zhig lha (71ba〉sko ngal bsos po/ /rnam dag mo mo skor/ /klu sgrub bzhed pa'i zab mo lta ba dang / /gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgru lus gnad 'gag —5/ci

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ rtonadal/ /sngon med shing rta chen po tsong kha pa/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i byin rlabs snying 'jug mdzod/ /rnam dag 〉〉〉〉/ /phyag sor gyis spras gser sbyangs bum pa nas/ /dkar dmar mdangs ldan zil dngar babs pa'i rgyun/ /dus kun khyab pa'i 'chi med dpal ster ba'i/ /tshe mtha' yas de gtsug gi rgyan du bzhugs/ /rnam dag bsam 〉mo mo 〉 / /gzhen nu'i mtshan 'dzin rgan po'i blo gros 'chang / /rgyal kun yab gyur rgyal sras ngang tshul 'dzin/ /'jam zhing dul yang phas rgol tshar gcod pa/ /rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor los shis par mdzod/ /rnam dag ra mo mo mo/ /rgyu 'bras gcig par gser mdog zhal ldan pas/ /nyi bu'i gshed gyur g.yin las khyad zhugs pa/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed mthong tshe khro bo kun/ /lag cha cig car 'chor de e ma mtshar/ /rnam dag mo mor ra/ /'jigs chen brgyad sogs srid pa'i du:kha las/ /skyob pa'i rgyal yum ār+shatā re kye/ /margad 'khri shing gzhon nu'i phyag ring po/ /bdag sogs sems can kun gyi gtsug tu khyongs/ /rnam dag khor〉〉/ /mtshan tsam thos pasadus min 'chi 'joms na/ /gzungs sngags mthu yis gzhom med tshe yi dpal/ /sbyin mdzad bcom ldan yid bzhin 'khor lo mas/ /mi shigs rdo rje'i srog gi ka ba tshugs/ /rnam dag mo ra mo sa/ /gser sbyangs mdangs 'dzin ser (72na)dkar sngo dmar zhal/ /ral gri 'khor lo rtse gsum mda' dgra ste/ /gzhu zhags rdo rje 'dzin cing rol pa'i stabs/ /sna tshogs rgyan ldan so sor 'brang mas skyongs//rnam dag 〉〉skosko/ /mgod mdangs can ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal/ /rma bya'i sgro mnga' mchog sbyin rin cen chun/ /gzhu bum 'dzin cing phyed pa'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /sna tshogs rgyan ldan rma bya chen mos skyongs/ /rnam dag skoskorki mo/ /kha ba'i rdul brtsegs ltar dkar zhal 'dzum pa/ /ral gri mda' dang mchog sbyin gzhu zhags pa/ /dgra sta 'dzin cing sgeg nyams sems skyil rgyan/ /legs spras stong chen rab 'joms ma yis skyongs/ /rnam dag ri sngar sko/ /stang zil brtsegs pa'i sku dang zhal mtshungs pa/ /rdo rje mchog sbyin dgra sta zhags pa bsnams/ /sna tshogs mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis nyer spras pa/ /gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin mas rtag tu skyongs/ /rnam dag khor mo mo/ /pad+ma rā ga'i gzugs sku —519

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)chags pa'i zhal/ /bgrad 'phrang mchog sbyin lcags kyu po ti bsnams/ /skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs shing sna tsho gos rgyan/ /rab spras bsil pa'i tshal gyis dus kun skyongs/ /rnam dag 〉〉skor/ /bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'phrog pa'i chom rkun ske/ /bdud zhags nag pos bcings nas thod dbyugs gis/ /phye mar 'thag 'dzad 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal/ /dpal ldan ma he'i zhal can khyod cig bsngags//rnam dag 〉〉〉〉/ /ma rungs gdul dka' 'dul phyir dbyings phyug ma/ /srid pa gsum (72ba)la dbang sgyur re ma tī/ /'dod khams bdag mo dmar zor rgyal mo yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod/ /rnam dag 〉〉〉sko/ /las bzhi bsgrub pa'i sna tsho gos 'phrul chen las//rab dkar lha mchog zhi ba'i dngos grub kun/ /stsol mdzad dung skyong ma yis dus kun tu/ /g.yel ba med par mel tshe mdzad du gsol/ /rnam dag 〉〉〉〉/ /zhes gsol dponang tshe dbang rab brtan gyis 'di ga'i lag rjes gsal ba'i thang ga lnga/ gzhan ma sum cu tham pa bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed du ma la blo gros kyi snang ba dkar ba mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /zho dos lhag pa bcu bzhi'i srang grangs kyi/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung 'khrigs pa'i snod/ /dge slong yon tan dpal bzang gis phul bas/ /'di phyi'i bsam don ma lus lhun grub shog /ces pa'ang phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i dge skos skabs pad sder phul ba'i kha byang du za hor brnyes bkod/ /shel dkar zhun ma'i lhun po 'bum phrag zlas/ /'byud pa'i 'od kyis 'chi bdag smag rum rnams/ /mthar byed rgyal ba kun yum tshe sbyin ma/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo'i spyan bdun gyis gzigs shig /bgrang yas rgyud sde'i gsung ngag snying po'i dbang / /sgo gsum smin pa blo gros bum bzang nas//rgya chen gdul bya'i re 'dod dbyar mtsho ltar/ /spel mdzad dam pa'i mgon khyod zhabs (73na)brtan shog /che mchog la sogs zhi khro ma lus pa/ /yongs 'dus 'khor 'das kun gyi phyag rgya rnams/ /cig —520

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ rton)car zil gyis gnon pa bzhad pa rtsal/ /gang shar rang sar grol khyod zhabs brtan shog /'jam dbyangasamagrin bzhugs mgul par dga' ba'i phyag /nyer 'khyud tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /'chad rtsod rtsom la 'jigs med rdo rje'i sde/ /g.yung drung srog gi ka ba tshugs par shog /rmongs pa'i mun sangs rnam dpyod rta ljang gi /dkyil 'khor rab rgyas rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /skye rgu'i dbang phyug sa yi tshangs pa che'i/ /sku tshe rigs brgyud chab srid dar bar shog /dga' ldan pho brang gnam skos rgyal po'i khrims/ /gser gyi 'khor lo'i she mong dpung pa yi/ /yid can lta shog sems med nor 'dzin ma//rjes su 'brang ba'i dbang thang 'bar bar thog /zhwa ser cod pan 'chang bstan rjes zhugs pa/ /rgya hor bod dang bod chen skye rgu kun/ /du lta'i ming yang mthar byas rdzogs ldan dus/ /gsar pa'i dga' ston mgron du bsu bar shog /bsam mkhar bde chen dbang gi rgyal po yi/ /rigs brgyud 'khor bcas nad gdon dbul phongs bral/ /'chi med bdag por 'gran nus yun ring 'tsho/ /bsod nams mnga' thang bla nas blar 'phel shog /tshe 'di'i lus bskyed pha mas thog drangs pa'i/ /nang mi gnyen 'khor gyis mtshon mkha' mnyam gyi/ /sems can mtha' dag 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /bsgral nas thar pa'i grong khyer (73ba tshes sdug par shog /mkhyen brtse nus gsum ldan pa rdzogs sangs rgyas//bden pa gnyis dang ldan pa dam pa'i chos/ /rig dang grol ba'i dpal ldan dge 'dun te/ /slu med bden pa'i rten 'brel lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di'ang bsam mkhar ba bde chen dbang rgyal gyis dga' ldan thar pa gling dang / gsang sngags byang chub gling gnyis su 'dzugs rtsis kyi bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas rig byed pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /mchog gsum slu med thugs rje bden tshig mthus/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i khri la srid mtha'i bar/ /legs bzhugs bzhed don 'phrin las lhun grub shog /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs kyis/ /blo bzang tshe ring rigs brgyud bcas pa yi/ /tshe dpal bsod nams dbang thang ma lus pa/ /yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar shog /'di —521 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)snang nying mtshams sbyar tshe mgon khyod kyis/ /rjes gzung lho phyogs ri bo po ta lar/ /phyag na pad+ma'i 'khor du legs skyes nas/ /gtan gyi mdun ma lhun gyis grub par shog /ces pa 'di'ang blo bzang tshe ring gis bde yangs dang sngags pa'i grwa tshang gnyis su lo ja nam 'tsho'i bar btsugs pa'i tshe 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa blo bzang dbang pa'/ /sngon bsags las 'phro 'od kyis log rtog dug /rab bsal dad pa'i mtsho nang bshes gnyen gzugs/ /srid zhi'i yon (74na 〉 tha cha gang ston pa'i zla/ /phan bde'i ga bur zegs ma 'bum 'gyed pa/ /mgon khyod byin rlabs bdud rtsi bdag snying la/ /zhugs nas tshe ring bsod nams dbang thang 'phel/ /yang srid phyi mar dal ba'i rten thob ste/ /ring min sangs rgyas sa la bgrod par shog /rgyal kun mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa'i mtshon/ /rab 'bar rdo rje rtse brgya gdengs pa'i mod/ /bdud bzhi'i klad 'gems gsang ba kun gyi mdzod/ /'dzin mdzad gar dgu'i rnam 'gyur ston mdzad kye/ /bdag sogs byang chub bar du rjes bzung nas/ /gnas skabs srid pa'i legs tshogs rab 'phel zhing / /ring por mi thogs mkha' mnyam sems can kun/ /'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por 'gyur bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang dga' ru shag pa 'jigs med dbang pos dad rten du 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag dang gsang ba'i bdag po'i bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa blo dbang ngo / / rnam dag bsam pas smon lam btab pa'i mthus/ /byang chub ma thob bar du mgon khyod kyis/ /lam bzang ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes mdzad nas/ /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /zhes pa 'di'ang pad rdor gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa'o/ /zho gang gis dman srang grangs nyer bzhi yi/ /dngul dkar las grub gsal byed mar me'i kong / /byams pa skal bzang rab 'byams gra skor dus/ /(74ba)phan bde legs bshad gling du phul ba'i dges/ /—522

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanam rig smag rum stug po mthar byas nas/ /lung rtogs yon tan med byung 'od po ches/ /srid zhi'i legs tshogs gzugs brnyan ma lus pa/ /ma ho sum mthong ba'i skal pa bzang bar shog /ces pa'ang za hor brnyes bkod/ /bgrang yas srid zhi'i lam ston rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /slu med gtan gyi skyabs mgon dam pa'i chos/ /tshul bzhin sgrub pa skye 'phags dge 'dun te/ /dkon cog gsum gyi rmad byung thugs rje'i mthus/ /gnam gyi she mong 'dzin pa jing gir brgyud/ /dad brtson gtong phod dang ldan mi yi bdag /tha'i ji blo bzang tshe ring ming can gang / /skye ba kun tu dal pa'i rten thob shog /der yang 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /rtag tu 'bral med rjes su nyer bzung ste/ /bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa legs phog nas/ /tshul khrims mig gi 'bras ltar bsrung bar shog /ngur sgrig 'dzin pa tshangs spyod mchog rten la/ /theg chen lam zhugs bdag pas gzhan gces mthus/ /'gro ba'i don du lus srog 'dor nus sogs/ /pha rol phyin drug yongs su rdzogs par shog /grangs med phun tshogs srog la ma bltos par/ /gsang ba sngags kyi smin grol la brten nas/ /ring por mi thogs rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar/ /legs bgrod 'gro ba 'dren pa'i don byed shog /ces pa 'di'ang khal kha g.yas ru nas dad stobs ldan pa blo bzang tshe ring gis 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong (75na jig dbang dkon cog go /ma rig gnyid sangs lung rtogs cha shas kun/ /nyer rgyas ye shes zla ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /phan bde'i kun da ba 'ad pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo bzang grags snyan bstan pa byang phyogs su/ /'dzin pa'i snying stobs rgyas sras spyod pa yis/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rabs 'phreng yol med can/ /mtshungs bral sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /dga' ldan bstan pa rin cen 'dzin pa la/ /slar yang byang phyogs yangs pa'i sa chen por/ /dbang sgyur dad stobs ldan pa bo shog thu/ /chos kyi rgyal por gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi sku tshe nyi zla —523

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dang mnyam zhing / /bsod nams snam thos sras kyi mched zlar 'gran/ /chab srid mi nub chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du/ /chad pa med par dkon cog mthus byin rlobs/ /legs byas gser gyis bteg pa'i khri chen por/ /sa yi tshangs pa mi shigs skyil mo krung / /bcas nas bstan la dad pa'i phu dud dang / /mnga' 'bangs skyong ba'i bzhed don lhun grub shog /ces dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu rgyal po'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs dang brtan bzhugs shig dgos zhes sngags pa grwa tshang spyi sos bdog pa'i dngos po maṇ+ḍal dang bcas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol btab mthus/ /'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs pa kun zhi nas/ /tshe ring nad med (75ba7de skyid phun sum tshogs/ /ring min rdzogs ba'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces dpon mo al pan gyi kha ton du 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes/ /spyi gtsug pad mtshor bzhugs la gsol 'debs na/ /'di phyi'i don kun ma lus nyer 'grub pa'i/ /thugs rje'i byin rlabs 'asdug pa myur stsol shog zhes bi lig er khe tha'i ji'i kha rtan du dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'o/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs mthus/ /sku skye ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin lasakyi/ /yang srid zhing khams gang du len pa la/ /nyer 'tshe'i bar chad thams cad zhi bar shog /'dra brdzus 'khrul pa'i dbang du mi 'gro bar/ /rnam dag skye srid bzung der ring po'i tshe/ /bsod nams lung rtogasachos kyi yon tan kun/ /bla nas blar 'phel rang g.yin phan 'grub shog /gdul bya gdul ba'i yul gru pha mtha' yas/ /sngon nas las 'brel thogs dang smon lam gyi/ /mtshams sbyar ji bzhin 'grub pa'i don bzang 'bras/ /rab smin ro brgya'i dpal la spyod par shog /nam yang bden par gsung ba rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /slu med skyabs gnas nyag cig dam pa'i chos/ /skye 'phags dge 'dun tshogs —524

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanakyi thugs rje yis/ /'jug pa dus las g.yel ba med par lha/ga /dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral bstan srung (7na〉gis/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i 'chi med drang srong dang / /rig 'dzin tshig gi dmod pa la dbang bas/ /bden pa legs brjod don kun shis par shog /skyid shod sprul sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyi yang srid gang du 'dzin kyang bar chad mi 'byung zhing legs tshogs 'phel ba'i smon lam 'di ni gra rigs rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i byin rlabs dang / /rgyu sbyor bdog pa'i gtong phod lhag pa'i sems/ /zla shar kun tu dge 'dun mchod pa sogs/ /byang chub mchog bsngos mi 'dzad rnam dkar mthus/ /rdo rje'i khri la 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes/ /'og min mgon po lta bur rtag brtan cing / /bstan dang lus can phan bde ma lus pa/ /yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin du rgyas par shog /so thar byang sems rig 'dzin sdom pa dang / /grol lam man ngag rnam bshad la sogs kun/ /legs par ston mdzad dngos dang brgyud pa yi/ /mnyam med bla ma rnams la gsol ba mchod pa la bul ba po shis shog gang dgos kyi 'don pa bsgyur/'debs/ /chos longs sprul sku'i bde gshegs thams cad dang / /zhi khro yi dam dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs/ /rgyal sras nyan rang skye 'phags dge 'dun la/ /mi phyed gus pa chen posagasol ba 'debs/ /mchod 'bul bkra shis la bsgyur chog /skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim sngon song nas/ /bskyed rdzogs (76ba)nyams bstan thub bstan 'gal med rtogs/ /gsung rab gdams par shar nas ring min du/ /'gro 'dren kun mkhyen ye shes 'thob par shog /ces dkar brag dpon po ngag dbang bzod pas rang gi lus chas sogs bdog pa'i gtong phod la brten thod ri dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling du srid mtha'i bar du zla ja btsugs pa'i dus tshogs pa'i zhal 'don dang rang gi dge sbyor du 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /—525

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)brjod pa rnam dag ngag la dbang phyug pa/ /dbyangs can drin las phul byung blo gros mthus//bskal bzang 'dren pa bzhi pa'i sdosnod gsum/ /rgya mtsho'i pha mthar spel khyod zhabs brtan shog /rtog ge'i rgol bar 'jigs med lung rigs kyi/ /btsan po'i go chas thub bstan lang tsho'i srog /'dzin la sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar yongs 'byed pa/ /sku tshe g.yung drung lta bur brtan par shog /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rnam dpyod ga 'one nu la/ /'jam dbyangs dga' bas mgrin par legs 'byud pas/ /mdo rgyud gzhung brgya smra ba'i spobs pa can/ /mtshungs med bshes gnyen rdo rje ltar brtan shog /snying dbus tshangs sras lha mo 'jo sgeg can/ /gtsug lag bye ba'i rgyud mang ba 'ad pa'i glur/ /bden gnyis chos kun blangs pas legs bshad kyi/ /rdo rje rtse brgya gdengs khyod zhabs brtan shog /sangs rgyas gnyis pa rje btsun tsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs thos bsam sgom sogs bya ba rnams/ /byams (77na〉pa gon 'phags yul ma byon de srid du/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par shog shwakya'i bstan pa rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin pa'i/ /rgyu sbyor kha ton byed rnams mgon khyod kyis/ /rjes bzung myang 'das them skas la 'dzegs te/ /'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon byed par shog /mchog gsum 'dod khams bdag mo'i nus mthu yis/ /gti mug mun sangs gtsug lag mtha' klas par/ /rnam dpyod rab rgyas rgya chen legs byas mtsho'i/ /rlabs 'phreng srid rtser 'phyur khyod zhabs brtan shog /dga' ldan pho brang lugs zung rab 'brel ba/ /khrims gnyis gser gyi gnam gyi she mong gis/ /'dzam gling kun tu 'khor ba'i rgyal khab cher/ /mang pos bkur ba'i rnam thar 'dzin par shog /mnga' 'bangs mtha' dag 'thab rtsod nad mug sogs/ /sdig 'bras du lta' mun pa mthar bskrad nas/ /ring po'i tshe dang dpag yas bsod na mas tshogos/ /rdzogs ldan skye rgu'i skal mnyam 'thob par shog /ces rab 'byamasasmra ba'i mkhan chen bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos 'phyong rgyas lho brag sogs kyi dgon pa'i 'dzin bdag nam mdzad kyi bar du sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin bsnyen bkur nyin thub kyi thog smon lam 'dzugs rgyu 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams —526

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnis ge / ('dadapon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho la/ /mi phyed gus pa'i sgo (77ba)nas gso le ba 'debs/ /mchog gsum thugs rjes srid mthar brtan bzhugs shing / /'di phyi kun tu dge ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /zhes pa 'di'ang dbu mdzad chas rje'i kha 'a du za hor gyi brnyes bkod/ /rin cen gser zangs las grub 'dra 'bag la/ /phyag na pad+ma srong btsan 'byom ston rje/ /dge 'dun grub sogs rim byon bzhis bskor ba/ /ngo mtshar mig gi bdud rtsi bla med 'di/ /tshe dbang rab brten dad dang gtong phod sogs/ /blo dang brtson pas nyer bar bsgrubs pa la/ /ye shes sems dpa' mtha' klas nyer 'jug ched/ /brgya phrag me tog dang bcas rab tu gnas/ /dge 'dis yang srid brgyud mar lha mi'i rten/ /legs par thob nas bde skyid phun tshogs shing / /ring por mi thogs 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /'dren pa'i ded dpon mchog tu 'gyur bar shog / rje btsun ma pham snang brnyan rin cen las/ /legs grub tshe dbang rab brtan gyis bzhengs mthus/ /gling 'dir mgon khyod mchog gi sprul sku sa gyur tshe 'dus pa dang por skye bar shog /gnasaskabs srid pa'i nyes rgya yongs las grol/ /mthar thug zhi mthar mi gnas byang chen thob/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub nas lus can kun/ /'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por bdag gyur shog /gang gi zhabs rdul me tog man+ta ra/ /thod du bcings nas smon lam btab pa'i mthus/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtsho las sgrol ba'i gru/ /mdzod cig bde gshegs mtshan legs yongs bsgrags dpal/ /(78na)thugs rje chen po'i 'od dkar 'bum phrag tu/ /bkye bas sdug bsngal de rgyu kun 'byung mun/ /mthar byas bde skyid snang ba'i sgo 'phar brgya/ /phye zhig bde gshegs rin cen zla ba'i zhabs/ /ma smad mkhyen brtse nus pa'i char rgyun gyis/ /sems can kun gyi legs byas myu gu rnams/ /skyed bsrings rten 'brel snye ma rab smin par/ /mdzod cig bde gshegs gser bzang dri ma med/ /tshe rabs mang bsags rnam smin nag pa yis/ /bskyed pa'i rigs drug yang srid goms pa'i 'gros/ /sgo gsum mnar ba'i —527

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)thang du mi 'khyam par/ /mdzod cig bde gshegs mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ /sems can rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang / /'tsham par dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi yis/ /thar pa'i srog gi rtsa ba legs tshugs par/ /mdzod cig bde gshegs chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs/ /ngan song gnas kyi me 'obs gting zab par/ /thugs rje'i char rgyun phab nas sgo gsum por/ /sim pa'i tshor ba rtag tu myong ba mā /mdzod cig bde gshegs ma par mkhyen pa rgyal/ /phyag sor gyis bteg gser mdog rnam par rgyal/ /ro nus khams gsum khyab pa'i 'gro kun gyi/ /mi bzad nad brgya mtha' dag drungs 'byin par/ /mdzod cig bde gshegs snan gyi bla ma mchog /mdzod spu'i 'od zer 'dom gang spros pas kyang / /pha mtha' mi mngon skye rgu'i dbugs dbyung nas/ /mi gnas myang 'das sa la legs 'god par/ /mdzod cig bde gshegs (78ba po kya seng ge kye/ /zhes gsol dpon cho dbang rab rten gyis dad rten gsar bzhengs kyi kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /ras dkar dngas mtshor yan lag rjes bkod zla/ shar ba'i dkyil 'khor snang brnyan ri dwagasagazugs/ /sna tshogs mos ldan sku yi ga spyi ra'i/ /zegs mas sgo gsum du:kha'i tsha gdung bcil/ /bsod nams ma dros mtsho las babs pa'i klung / /chad med rnyog bral rgyu ba'i rlabs kyi 'phreng / /phan bde'i dbu ba dkar po'i do shal de/ /skye mang chu lha'i bu mo'i mgrin par dngom/ /mtha' med srid pa'i kha dog cha bsags sgro/ /zlum po'i gdugs 'byir 'di snang rma bya mo/ /gtan mdun mngal khur sbrums pa dge ba'i 'bru/ /thar lam sprin gyi lam nas skad gsang ldir/ /rgyu sbyor dbu mdzad ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis/ /rdzogs ldan dbyar gyi dga' ston 'bod pa'i bya/ /dge legs gzhan bsosaglu dbyangs phang 'gro'i sgra/ /snyan po rna ba'i gsos su 'a rjebs par shog /yon sbyor tsam min bzo risalas byed du/ /gtogos rnams srid zhi'i dge ba ke sar/ /bcud du myangs pa'i dngar po sbrang rtsi'i ro/ /skye ba kun tu longs su spyod par shog khres dbu mdzad ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag yan —528—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ zhinalag gi rjes yod pa zhig bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 4sgos dpon dge slong ngag dbang (79na po kon cog go / 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos dga' ba'i bshes gnyen la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /rigs kyi bdag po tshe mtha' yas pa'i skur/ /bzhengs nas skye ba kun tu rjes 'dzin shog /ces paṇ+ḍita chos rje'i ngor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'o/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i sgyu 'phrul gaṅgā'i rdul/ /de snyed 'gro blor grangs su nyer bcad pa/ /bsod nams zhing du spel bas ngag gi dbang / /blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho zhabs brtan shog /'chad rtsod rtsom la 'jigs pa med pa'i mthu/ /rnam dpyod btsan po'i go cha rab bgos pas/ /thub dbang shākya seng ge'i bstan pa yi/ /lang tsho rgyas pa'i sde gang brtan gyur cig /sna tshogs bdog pa'i phung po cher spungs shing / /blo mig yangs pa'i mkhan po rig byed bkug /sgo gsum rab 'bad zhing sa gshin po la/ /'di snang bde skyid snang ba smin par shog /tshe rabs mang por rang rgyud la bgos pa'i/ /sdig lhung des bskyed 'du kha' dri ma kun/ /legs byas chus bkrus gtan mdun zla ba'i bzhin/ /las kyi me long ngos su 'char bar shog /sgrib lus lto 'gro'i shun pa ltar rjes shul/ /ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i snang ba yongs shar ba/ /semasacan kun gyis mthong bas don ldan pa/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang thob par shog /ces bkra shis dbang phyug gis 'gro la rjes brtse ma'i thang ga bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes (79bskyor ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /yid ches mos pas gtan gyi skyabs gnas su/ /bzung ste me khyer nam mkha'i nor bu rtswa /sgro btags snang brnyan mtha' skor bla ma dang / /sangs rgyas byang sems mgron thabs tshul bzhedas dge sa/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur brtan bzhugs nas/ /chos 'khor rgyun chad med par bskor ba sogs/ /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par shog /bdag sogasamagon po khyod kyis tshe rabs su/ /'bral med dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad pa'i mthus/ /dal ba'i —529

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)rten thob thos bsam sgom pa yis/ /sal ma yon tan pha mthar phyin par shog /gnas skabs su yang dus min 'chi ba dang / /'thab rtsod dbul phongs nad rims gdon bgegs sogs/ /'jigs chen brgyad dang bcu drug gis mtshon pa'i/ /mi 'dod nyes pa'i tshogs kun zhi bar shog /tshe ring lus ngag bde zhing yid dga' rnyed/ /tshong la khe spogs lo tog dus su smin/ /dbang po sgo lngar sim pa'i tshor ba yi/ /bsam dgu thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par shog /nag phyogs bdud rigs 'byung po'i bsam sbyor zhi/ /dkar phyogs skyong rnams mthu stobs nus pa ldan/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba bslu ba med/ /bden pa'i stobs kyis 'gro rnams bde bar shog /kun la ma 'dris mdza' bshes rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /mthong thos dran reg 'tshengs pa dam pa'i (80na 〉 le/ /yang dag lam ston skye 'phags dge 'dun te/ /dkon cog gsum gyi bkra shis deng 'dir stsol/ /zhes 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag la 'dod lhas bskor ba'i bris thang sgrol ma lha mdzes kyis bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /shāka seng ring lugs yod rtsod rtsom pa la/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo gros bye ba'i gter/ /mkhasabatsun bzang ba'i mdzad phrin rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /yongs khyab bstan pa'i bdag por gsol ba 'debs//gang sku bla ma yi dam srung ma'i tshogs/ /ma tshang med par rab gtams nus mthu yis/ /mi shigs srog gi ka ba nyer tshugs nas/ /g.yung drung lta bur srid mthar zhabs brtan shog /zhwa ser 'chang ba'i stobs 'byor longs spyod sogs/ /gyen du 'degs la 'gran bral gdugs dkar po'i/ /grib mar mnga' 'bangs skye rgu phan bde la/ /sbyor mdzad sangs rgyas rgya mtsho zhabs brtan shog /thub bstan spyi dang rje btsun tsong kha pa'i/ /chos srid bya ba mtha' dag bla nas blar/ /gong 'phel mi mthun bar bcod rab zhi ste/ /bsam don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par shog /dkon cog rin cen rnam gsum thugs rje dang / /mthu ldan dam can rgya mtsho'i drag rtsal stobs/ /bden tshig grub pa'i drang srong la sogs pas/ /re 'bras ji bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di ni sngags (80ba)rams pa —53(/—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanadon grub rgya mtshos nged rang sde pa ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad dga' ba gdong du 'dzugs rgyur bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /brgya phrag ro bda'i dpag bsam nying khu yis/ /zla zhun ltar dkar dngul rgyan grangs ldan nang / /legs gtams bsod nams bya ba'i zhing gi mchog /mtha' yas dge 'dun tshogs la yongs phul dges/ /ngag dbang 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa yi/ /lung rtogs bstan pa rgya mtsho'i mthar thug par/ /spel phyir phyag na pad+ma ngur smrig gar/ /legs bsgyur rje btsun bla ma zhabs brtan shog /gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor chen po ma lus par/ /stobs 'byor mnga' thang la sogs 'dzad med bsgo/ /yongs byed bstan pa'i sbyin bdag bo shog thu/ /btsun mo sras bcas blon 'bangs thams cad kyi/ /rang gdon kun bral tshe dang bsod nams rgyas/ /khams gsum dbang 'dus pha rol log 'dren dpung / /rang zhir gyur nas yid la gang bsams pa'i/ /ba ched don mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par shog /ces pa 'di ni nor 'dzin gyi gzhi chen por stobs kyi dpung pas dbang sgyur ba bstan pa'i sbyin bdag dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu dang / rgyal mo ar+ya lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas blangs te tshogs gsog dar rgan rab 'byams pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan ched du mngags nas chos sde chen po so sor mang ja brgya phrag gsum re btang ba grub (81na tsher tshams dpal ldan 'bras spungs dang bkra shis lhun por snga sor phul ba'i 'phros dngul rkyan lnga re/ se ra theg chen gling du bcu gsum/ri bo dga' ldan du bcu gcig rnams 'bul rgyur kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gis bgyis pa dza yas/ /skye rgu'i mgon gyur bla ma rjer/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i snang brnyan 'di/ /yongs bzhengs mthu yis yang srid kun/ /bshes gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ /zhes a gling chos mdzad dngos grub rgya mtshos dad rten du nged rang gi 'dra 'bag gser zangs las grub pa bzhengs pa'i kha byang du za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa bha wastu/ /—53/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)mchog thun dngos grub yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /'bral med stsol mdzad rje btsun thams cad mkhyen/ /mi phyed dad pas snying nas gsol 'debs na/ /byin rlabs thugs rjes bdag rgyud smin par shog /ces pa'ang bo ro jang gi'i ngor za sto brnyes bris/ /ngag dbang 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa yi/ /rmad byung lung rtogs bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gzhir/ /khyab par yongs spel bshes gnyen dam pa mchog /g.yung drung lta bur bskal brgyar zhabasabartan shog /deng nas ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bla ma mchog dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing / /byams brtse'i thugs rje chen pos nyer bzung ste/ /zag bral bdud rtsi'i ro yis tshim nus shog /slu med dkon (81ba khyog rnam gsum byin rlabs kyis/ /gnas skabs nad gdon nyes kun zhi ba dang / /mthar thug nges par legs pa'i gtan gyi bder/ /sbyor ba'i smon lam myur du 'grub par shog /ces pa'ang tho gol tha'i ji nang tshang gnyis kyis 'di lta bu zhig dgos tshul byung ba bzhin za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i gtso bo bde ldan mgon/ /mtshan dpes nyer spras tshe dang ye shes gter//yid bzhin 'khor lo rnam par rgyal ma sogs/ /'chi med grub pa'i lha yis shis pa stsol/ /zab cing rgya che'i gnad rnams ma lus pa/ /bstan nas 'gro ba mtha' dag nges legs la/ /'khrid par 'gran bral mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag /mtshungs med dpal ldan bla mar gsol bar 'debs/ /gdong lngas rab bteg rin cen khri chen por/ /mi 'gyur g.yung drung g.yas su 'khyil ba'i steng / l+le ral thu yi sprul pa'i sku mchog 'di/ /bskal brgyar rtag bzhugs theg mchog chos 'khor skor/ /tshul khrimasalegs gtsang sgo gsum bag dang ldan/ /dngos stobs rigs pas pha rol rgol ba bcoms/ /thub gsung dgongs pa ji bzhin yongs rtogs te/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /chosakun rgyu 'bras rten 'brel slu med cing / /lha dang drang srong bden par grub pa'i tshig /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i srung ma'i tsho gos rnams kyis/ /smon pa ji bzhin (82na ji 'bras lhun grub mdzod/ /ces pa'ang —532

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanadage slong phyag na rdo rjes gong ma shi ral thu'i sku skye'i gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs smon lam dang bcas dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /mkhyen brtse nus stobs bkrag mdangs 'od po ches/ /ma rig rmongs pa'i mun tshogs sel mdzad pa/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /gnyis med ngo bor mi phyed gsol 'debs na/ /yang yang drin gyis bskyangs pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /mi bzad du ltas mnar ba ma bzod par/ /smon 'jug byang chub sems gnyis yongs bskyed de/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i nyin mtshan 'da' bar shog /grangs med bskal par ma bltos tshe gcig la/ /mtshan ldan bla mas dkyil 'khor chen po sa /legs bcug skye shi bar do sku gsum du/ /mngon gyur bla med zung 'jug 'thob par shog /ces pa'ang rab 'byams pa shākya rin cen gyis bla ma yi dam dbyer med la gsol 'debs dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /dgyes skong slad du dngul dkar bkod legs snod//phul bas skye bar mtho ris rten brnyed cing / /ring min kun mkhyen ye shes thob byin rlobs/ /zhes(82ba)pa'ang 'phyong rgyas sngags rams pa blo bzang thugs rjes gra tshang dge skos kyi 'jog la dngul srang bco lngar zho dos ma longs pa'i pad ster phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bris/ /lha sngags ye shes rol pa'i pho brang cher/ /gan gos dbang gzhu ltar bkra'i bkod legs la/ /sna tsho gos lda ldi'i chun po rab g.yo'i 'phreng / /mchod sprin nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar phye/ /dus gsum rtsabargyud bla ma thams cad dang / /zhi khro'i lha tsho gos kun 'dus wen las lha/ /rdo rje ga 'one nu gtsor gyur gsar rnying gi /yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho mkha' 'gror bcas/ /thugs dam gnyan po skong ba'i byin rlabasadang / zhus stobs mthu yis rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ /bskal pa'i bar du a lha mi shigs pa'i/ /ka ba brtan po nye bar tshugs par shog /'phrin las rnam bzhi grub chen brgyad la sogs/ /thun mong las—533

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)kun thogs med bsgrubs pa'i zhar/ /phan bde'i rtsa ba nges legs go 'phang mchog /bshad sgrub bya bas 'dzam gling yongs khyab shog /dge bas rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas nad gdon zhi/ /tshe dpal bsod nams dbyar mtsho lta bur spel/ /mi nor longs spyod srid zhi'i 'dod rgu sdus/ / log par 'khru ba'i tshogs rnams 'joms par shog /ces pa'ang yar klungs chu mig mgo pa dbu mdzad dam chos dbang rgyal gyis snyan dar gong ba gan gos tshon (83na khri/ /gong skyor kha thi ljang khra/ mtha' 'ja' sum gshibs/ rgyab sha ras ljang / ljang ser gyi a lung / sham bu ling ljang dang bcas pa 'dom nyi shu rtsa bzhi/snyan dar nyin bde rnam bcu mngags btags ma bcu drug /ma rig gnyid sangs ma gsum/ rtags brgyad ma brgyad/ mthing khra gsum/ zangs khra gnyis/ ling gser bar ma tshos kha sna tshogs bdun/ sman rnying kha phyed sum 'brel gcig dkar chag bris pa'i 'dom 'khor ma gcig rnams rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par phul ba'i tshe smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /chos kun 'byung gnas bde bar gshegs pa'i yum/ /gdod nas skye 'gag gnas bral nam mkha'i dbyings/ /bslu ba med pa'i rgyu 'bras dbang gzhu ltar/ /yongs shar rten 'brel gshis lugs kho nar nges/ shwaka seng mgur nas gsung dbyangs drug cu yi/ /chos 'khor bar ma'i yang snying pusta ga /lags par bzhengs pas dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos khyab bdag zha lu pa/ /rin cen bsod nams mchog grub dpal bzang po/ /dag pa'i zhing du skal ldan gdul bya rnams/ /tsho gis gnyisardzogs phyir mchag gi sprul sku'i gar/ /nyer bsgyur bla med ye shes sbyor bar shog /rnam dkar gaṅgā'i yab cig nas babs te/ /'phrin las chad pa med pa'i chu bo'i rgyun/ /(83ba tshe sdus can bde skyid rgya mtsho chen po su /dbab mjad khyod nyid thugs ba ched 'grub par shog /bla ma yi dam rnams kyi byin rlabs dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung lta klung bcas/ /bden tshig grub pa'i tshogs kyi nus mthu yis/ /ji bzhin 'gab pa'i re ba bstong bar mdzod/ /ces khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang rin cen bsod nams mchog —534

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanagrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dag pa'i zhing khams su skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams smin grol mchog la 'god par bzhed don 'grub pa'i ched du phyag mdzod bsod nams rin cen gyis 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa'i gser chos dbus gtsang gsung rten du bzhengs pa'i tshe smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus mthu rnams/ /yongs 'dus ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho yis/ /yang srid kun tu mi 'bral rjes bzung nas/ /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus 'grub byin rlobs//zhes pa'ang em chi blo bzang nor bu'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes bris/ /bla med ye shes bdud rtsi gdod ma nas/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi byin 'bar ba sprul pa'i gar/ /sman gyi bla ma mched bdun zhes grags pa/ /skye rgu'i bsod nams gzhi rten rmad po che/ /byin rlabs lus can khams dang nyer 'tsham par/ /(84na)yongs 'jug brgyad brgya'i grangs tshang sman gyi mdo/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gyur thub gsung ljags ring las/ /legs 'ong skal ldan gdul bya'i dpal du shar/ /khyed gsung par du bskrun pa'i bzang po'i chab/ /brtson 'grub ma dros klung chen nas babs pa/ /smon lam zla ba'i ma ma zad min par/ /ro gcig 'bras mchog zla ltar 'phel bar shog /ces pa'ang lhan du su mkhan pos sman bla'i mdo par du brkos dus dgos tshul bzhin za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /mkhyen brtse'i spyan zur nam yang yol med du/ /cung zad lhung bas 'khor ba'i gdung bcil ba/ /bu ram shing pas phyag ring rab brkyangs te/ /spyi bor theg la byang chub lung bstan mdzod/ /phyi nang drang srong kla klo la sogs pa'i/ /ston par btags pa mang yang sa lha yis/ /gser ldan las thon thal mo nyer sbyar nas/ /skyob pa khyod nyid zla bral dpang po byas/ /chos rgyal mes dbon sras bcas blon 'bangs dang / /paṇa chen 'jig rten mig gcig mdzad bzang grus/ /rgya gar rgya mtsho cher bsgral —533

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gangs ljongs 'dir/ /legs drangs rgyas 'bring bsdus pa yid bzhin nor/ /dge mtshan bcu tshang lha ldan yul gru nas/ /dkon cog mchis 'brang bcas pa'i bdog pa'i tshogs/ /snying po len phyir nyer gcig glegs bam 'phreng / /'bad rtsol srad bur legs brgyus tshar dngar bsgrubs/ /thub gsung sri zhur dang bas rgyud rab bskul/ /'dri klog ched du mchod sprin legs spros (84ba'i gos/ /tshe rabs thog ma med nas deng gi bar/ /bsags pa'i sdig ltung tshogs rnams dag par shog zhan tu bgrod ku'i mi khom chu chen la/ /dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i zam pa nyer btsugs par/ /rab phyin bla med ye shes gnas son te/ /rtag tu bde ba'i dga' ston longs spyod shog /'dis mtshon rnam dkar bsod nams byas so cog /'bras bu rang nyid kho na'i ched min par/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por 'gyur bar shog /dar gling dkon cog g.yang can dpal 'dzom nang mir bcas par dgra lha dmag dpon gangs la nyi shar dang rab 'byams pa mkhas btsun gnyis kyis bzheng pa'i bskul ma byung bar brten bka' bar pa'i yang snying mdo rgyas pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa po ti bcu drug /'bring nyi khri po ti bzhi/ bsdus pa brgyad stong pa po ti gcig rnams bzhengs pa'i tshe smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /sangs rgyas sras bcas slob ma'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /dri med ye shes spyan gyis rab gzigs nas/ /don grub dbang rgyal srid pa gar 'phyan yang / /mthu dpung skyed la dag pa'i zhing du drongs/ /zhing khams khyad 'phags bde ldan pad+ma las/ /nyer thon ston pa 'od dpag med mgon zhal/ /mthong ste dam chos bdud rtsi rab myangs pas/ /'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon myur thob shog /'dis mtshon dus (85nab sum yongs bsags dge ba'i mthus/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa drungs phyungs nas/ /ring por mi thogs stobs bstomang 'a ba'i rtsal/ /thob par mchog (85na gi sum thugs rjes ba byin rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang zur khang don grub dbang rgyal dus kya chos nyid du gyur ba'i tshe gzhis mi rnams kyis dgon kha shas su 'dzugs rgyur dgos —536

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung lhags bam gnyis pa/ zhenatshul ltar za hor brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /ba 5 mu bī da pra lā rgyu ka khyu ma hā ra sma sa tā na bi sa rjo ka ro gha naḥpad+ma thod phreng brtse chen 'od po ches/ /skye rgu'i ma rig stug po'i smag gi sum/ /bha pra 'i ri shā dha mi rā dza snodhiḥ hi pa ti 'i pa bo dru snya ཿ t+ta )9//bsel phyir gdung 'tshob chos rgyal gter bdag gling / /byang chub bar du mi 'bral snying gar bzhugs/ /khyod kyi gsang (85bsko sum zlos gar bgrang yas pa/ /brjod par nus min rdo rje chos la sogs/ /nyer byon 'brungs rabs cung zad 'phreng bkod pa'i/ /ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul mthong bas dad gus 'phel/ /zab las ches zab thugs gter nas byung ba'i/ /rtsa gsum snang brnyan dbang gzhu ltar bkra ba/ /ma 'dres yid kyi dngas mtshor rab shar bas/ /lha sngags ye shes rol pa cir yang 'char /g.yel med rtse gcig gsol bsgrub bgyid pa yi/ /dmigs rten bzhengs mthus skye zhing skye ba sa /bdag sogs 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs rab mdzad de/ /re 'dod ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlebe sa//gnas skabs nad gdon zhi zhing tshe bsod rgyas/ /srid gsum dbang 'dus nyer 'tshe las rgyal te/ /mthar thug mkha' sbyor yan lag bdun ldan skur/ /'gyur bar ring min mchog gsum mthus byin rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang nged rang gi dmigs rten du pad+ma'i gdung 'tshob sprul sku gter bdag gling pa'i 'khrungs rabs dang phyag zhabs kyi rjes/ /zab gter las byung ba'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i sku brnyan dang bcas pa dbu chung snye mo /rma dang mkhar rtse dge bsnyen rgyal pos lcags bya nas dbu btsugs pa chu khyi lor grub pa'i tshe rgyab yig tu za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gis bgyis pa sarba sirnyi ho:/ /(86na)—537

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dha to ma hā su kha sa ma khyu sam nyu sto ṣa shrī rgya ྅te dza gu ni mi ta bha ba n+ta shu rgya/bde chen dbyings las kun bzang 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi byin 'khor ba stongs min bar/ /ni ma la rbi tsa la sha tha ta ya su de ba shu dzha kra pā ji ta sum khyi la tsa kra ku shu/nam yang g.yo med nges pa lnga ldan pa'i/ /dag pa rab 'byams lha yi 'khor lor gsal/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs gshed du khro gtum gzugs/ /drag shul rngams brjid mi bzad gar dgu'i nyams/ /dus kyi dgra bor khros pa'i gshin rje'i gshed/ /mthong ba tsam gyis khro g.yin lag cha 'chor/ /phyi dkyil bcos ma'i gzhal yas nyams dga' dang / /rang byung lus kyi pho brang gnyis med pa/ /phyag rgya'i 'du 'phro don dam dkyil 'khor cher/ /rab bzhugs kun bzang go 'phang mngon 'gyur shog /rgyud lnga'i yid can rnams kyang dang po nas/ /rang ngo ma 'phrod 'khor bar nyer 'khyams pa/ /rnam dag lam gyis brtan g.yo'i dngos po'i tshogs/ /bcom ldan rten dang brten par (86ba 'char bar shog /dkon cog rin cen mthu dpung brjod las 'das/ /rgyu 'bras rten cing 'brel 'byung bslu ba med/ /bden tshig grub pa rnams kyis bkra shis char/ /phyogs bcur phob la re 'bras lhun grub mdzod/ /ces pa'ang nged rang gi dmigs rten du gshed dmar ru mtshon dmar po'i lha tshogs rnams dbu chung snye mo dme dang mkhar rtse dge bsnyen rgyal pos chu khyi lor bris pa'i tshe rgyab yig tu za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gis bgyis pa sarba sirnyi pra ya:ni /snya na sa rbu ra mā dzñā na dī su lha / ma ti swā ra nā nywa di ba bha ska rwa/shes bya'i gnas kun chags thogs med mnga' ba/ /ngag dbang dbyangs can lha mo'i blo gros kyis/ /bha dra ka ṣ+ṭha sa pa 4 bi tā be na sa rba bra ba bro sa mu dro sa ha sta 'i dziḥ / /—538
