smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa / (zhanamagrin pa'i 'dab bzang lhag par yongs ba 'ad pas/ /gsung rab rgya mtshor blta ba'i mig stong rgyas/ /dad brtson snying stobs (87na sgom dpyod zla bral rje/ /zhwa ser cod pan ring lugs bla nas blar/ /rab spel dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thus/ /mngon mtho nges legs rnam dkar bskrun pa'i ched/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen snang brnyan la/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'grosayongs bskor ba/ /bzhengs mthus skye zhing skye bar mgon khyod dang / /'bral med rjes su 'dzin pa'i bka' drin stsol/ /gnas skabs kun rdzob 'khrul ngor shar ba tsam/ /ma yin don dam phung khams pho brang cher/ /gdan gsum rab tshang rdo rje 'chang dbang las/ /dpung gnyen g.yin nas mi 'tshol brtse bas skyongs/ /mthong thos reg pas srid zhi'i yon tan kun/ /bde blag nyid grub mkhyen pa'i spyan ras kyis/ /nyer gzigs gnas skabs mi mthun rab zhi zhing / /bde skyid sum rtsen rtse dga' dgod par shog /ma dag skye rgu'i brnag sems lcags kyi khams/ /thabs mkhas nyams len sgom pa'i rtsis bsgyur te/ /'khor 'das legs byas sa zla'i phung po che/ /srid pa'i rtse mor 'byur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /thub bstan gzhung lugs dpyad gsum yangs dag pa'i/ /dgongs don 'khrul med 'dzin mdzad thams cad mkhyen/ /blo bzang grags pa'i chos srid nyi zla yi/ /'od kyis 'jig rten mun tshogs sel bar shog /'di nas tshong thang ga so sor 'og gi dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i tshogs zhes pa'i blo ka gnyis po bldab dgos/ g.yas dang po/ rgyal ba'i sras mchoge gru 'dzin brtse chen bdag /(87ba7 lha'i mgon gcig pad dkar 'chang ba'i lha/ /thugs rka'i khyo:las zag med bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /babs pas yid can bde chen ye shes rnyed/ /g.yasaganyis pa/shin tu mtho ba'i rigs gzigs dad pa brtan/ /mi bsrun srin po'i dpung tshogs bgrang yas pas/ /thabs kyis rab btul mkha' 'gro spyan drangs pas/ /bdud mo nyer bsgral rnam dag phyag rgya ldan/ /g.yas gsum pa/ nyi ma'i gnyen gyur rgyal rigs swā la pa'i/ /brgyud du legs byon 'phags mchog thugs rje yi/ /byin rlabs bod khams yongs kyi skyabs mgon du/ /gnam gyi yongs bskos gnya' khri btsan po zhes/ /g.yas pha pa/ mi rung sa gzhi btul zhing gangs ljongs 'dir/ /dam pa'i chos kyi srol —539

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)chen nyer btod par/ /snang ba mtha' yas sgyu 'phrul med po che/ /srong btsan sgam pos slar yang phan bde spel/ /g.yas lnga pa/yab mes mdzad bzang rnam dkar phun tsho gos kyis/ /thugs rab phrogs te thub bstan rin po cher/ /brgya phrag sri zhu mi zad nam mkha' mdzod/ /sgo 'phar phyogs kun rab phye khri ral rje/ /g.yas drug pa/mdo sngags gzhung lugs shin tu rtogs dzodaka'i mdud/ /rnam dpyod sor rtses nyer bkrol dgongs don rnams/ /mthong ba tsam gyis bsil ldan mgon po sa /byon par nges 'drongs paṇa chen dge 'dun grub/ /g.yas na pa/shar phyogs ma hā tsi na'i mang bkur rje'i/ /gtsug tu zhabs zung zla tshes gsal bkod cing / /gdul dka'i 'gro (88na 〉 gis smin grol lam bzang mchog /sbyin mkhas rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde/ /g.yon dang po/ji lta ji snyed chos kun thugs mtsho'i nang //zla gzugs ltar gzigs phyon mkha' 'gro yi/ /ye shes gtso mos bde stong lam bzang por/ /nyer bkod dkon cog 'bangs kyi snyan grags 'bar/ /g.yon gnyis pa/ longs spyod mnga' thang 'byor pas ma gos par/ /mar me mdzad kyis rjes bzung lhag pa'i lhas/ /sngon nas 'byung 'gyur lkog gyur dngos po kun/ /ji bzhin yongs mkhyen lha yi rgyal po'i zhabs/ /g.yon gsum pa/ gangs can skyong bar ches cher dpa' ba'i mgon/ /kun bzang sgyu 'phrul 'od stong 'bar ba'i gzis/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs mun stug rab sangs te/ /dam chos dbu brnyes tho ri snyan shal rje/ /g.yon sto pa/ yab mes dus kyi g.yung drung bon chos kyi/ /grol thabs med dgongs mkhan slob lo paṇa gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rin cen bla nas blar/ /dar mdzad khri srong lde btsan khyod min su/ /g.yon lnga pa/ bka' dang bstan bcos gsung rab ma lus pa/ /mi 'gal nyams len gcig tu 'khyer shes pa'i/ /lam mchog sgron mes 'jig rten gsum khyab bstan/ /bdag por mnga' gsol 'brom ston bla ma rje/ /g.yon drug pa/ dri med rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' yas par/ /mkhyen pa'i spyan ras lhungs pa'i mod nyid la/ /thugs chud 'jig rten kun gyi mig gcig pu/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /(88ba〉〈 ring gnam gyi she mong gis bteg pa'i/ /mang bkur rigs byon lha sngags ye shes mdas/ /log 'dren bdud dpung —540

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanadon snying cher phug ste/ /dag pa'i zhing sbyor bde chen chos kyi rgyal/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus mthu tshogs/ /g.yon bdun pa/ yongs 'dus rje btsun blo bzang grags pa yi/ /chos srid dpag bsam ljon 'bras phan bde la/ /rtag tu tshad med longs su spyod byin rlobs/ /spyi dang khyad par yangs pa'i nor 'dzin mgon/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag dga' ldan bo shog thu'i/ /mi mthun rab zhi chab srid mnga' thang sogs/ /gong 'phel 'di phyi'i 'dun ma lhun grub shog /ces pa yangs pa'i sa chen por bsod nams stobs kyis dpung pas bdag gir spyod cing khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi bstan pa rin po cher mi byed pa'i dad gus kyi dbang phyug dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu'i dad rten du nged rang gi 'dra 'bag /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs gzhan yang 'dod lha sna tshogs pas bskor ba'i bris thang grwa tshar dgos tshul ltar sdo pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos legs par bzhengs pa'i tshe rgyab yig tu za hor gyi brjes dge sbyong sde snod gsum pas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gis bgyis pa dza / //dkon cog snang brnyan 'di bzhengs rnam dkar mthus/ /ngag la dbang thob blo gros bzang po yi/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas rgya mtsho'i gos can kun/ /khyab phyir mi shigs (89na)srog gi ka ba tshugs/ /byams mgon dbus 'gyur 'chang du ma byon par/ /dga' ldan pho brang chos srid zung 'jug bstan//dar zhing 'gro rnams smin grol la 'god pa'i/ /gtan gyi mdun ma mtha' dag lhun grub shog /slu med rten cing 'brel 'byung zhing sa la/ /lhag bsam rnam dag sa bon rab btab pa/ /mtshams sbyor drod gsher gyis bskyangs gser gyi snye/ /legs smin mngon sum dga' ston la spyod shog /ces pa'ang sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos nged rang gi rim gror mo rtsis nas byung ba'i gser thang bzhengs pa'i tshe smon lam tshigs bcad de lam du ma zad nged rang gi ring 'tsho'i ched du bris 'bur sogs snang brnyan chung ngu bzhengs res kyi tshigs bcad gsar pa mi dgos par bris chog ma zhig dgos zer ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /—541 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi/ /snang brnyan 'jon dmar gser zhun las/ /yongs grub bzhengs mthus rgyu sbyor kun/ /skye bar yang dag lam 'khrid shog /gnas skabs nad rimasageg sri dang / /chags che nyam nga rab zhi zhing / /tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang rnams/ /rmugs 'dzin dbang por 'gran bzod shog /lhag bsam smon lam mkha' gos las/ /dngos grub 'dzad med char gyi rgyun/ /byang chen myu gu cher smin te/ /don gnyis 'bras bur g.yur za shog /bcom ldan thub pa'i dbang po la/ /sprul pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug tshogs/ /dharma tā la rgyal (5ba)rtsen bzhi/ /hā shang la sogs 'khor dang bcas/ /dri bsung ngad 'thul ma la ya'i/ khyur bskrun dge bas shi gson kun/ /'di phyi'i bsam don lhun grub nas/ /rnam 'dren go 'phang myur 'grub shog zhes pa 'di'ang rig byed pa bstan 'dzin dbang pos 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang dgos pa/ bsod nams dbang 'dzin gsum dus las 'das pa dang ma a snying sogs shul mi rnams kyi don du gser zangs las grub pa'i nged rang gi 'dra 'bag khru gang lhag pa dang tsan dan gyi gnas bcu'i sku bzhengs tshe smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /thog med nas bzung da lta'i bar/ /bsags dang 'dis mtshon rnam dkar mthus/ /za hor zil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal/ /g.yung drung lta bur brtan par shog /ces pa'ang gong dkar ngag dbang bslab gsum gyis nged rang gi 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i tshe kha byang dgos tshul bzhin za hor brnyes bkod pa bha wan+tu/ /bkod mdzes rngams brjid ldan pa'i dpal bshos snod/ /rab dkar zla zhun las grub yongs phul bas/ /ring min lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung ste/ /rang gzhan don kun 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa rdo pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i dge skos kyi 'jog la dngul srang bco lnga zho do'i pad sder phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba dza byu/ /—542

spen lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ ( bladabartse ba chen po'i thugs bskyed smon lam (90na〉ba thu/ /nyer smin thun mong ma yin 'dul zhing che/ /gangs can 'gro rnams skyong ba'i 'jig rten mgon/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis dpung gnyen mdzad du gsol/ /ma gyur skye rgu'i gnas skabs bde skyid rgyas/ /skye bar khyod kyis 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ /sa lam spangs rtogs yon tan mthar phyin nas/ /kun mkhyen ye shes chen po thob byin rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang gzims dpon gyi las 'dzin dge slong blo bzang don grub kyis ma dkon cog sgrol ma'i don du thugs rje chen po'i bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /dbyer med 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi/ /'dra 'bag bzhengs mthus skye bar 'bad med du/ /rjes gzung mchog thun dngos grub thob byin rlobs/ /zhes rdo pa dge slong phyag rdor dbang phyug gis 'dra 'bag gser zangs las bzhengs pa'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes bkod/ /lhad bral rin cen gnyis pa phyed bcas srang / /nyer bzhi las grub snang byed sgron me'i kong / /phan bde'i 'byung gnas nges gsang 'dus sde cher/ /phul bas ma rig las nyon stug po'i smag /ye shes 'od kyis 'thar byas smin grol lam/ /bdag sogs skye rgu kun gyis rab thob nas/ /ring min rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /go 'phang mngon du 'gyur bar (90ba)byin gyi rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang blo bzang thabs mkhas kyis smon lam chen mor rab 'byams kyi grwa skor byas dus dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /zab gsal mtshan dpe'i nyi 'od 'bar ba'i gzis/ /skye rgu'i phan bde'i snang ba rab dkar bas/ /ches cher bdo ba'i snyigs ma lnga yi smag /mthong thos dran pas rnam grol shākya'i rgyal/ /bdud bzhi'i sdo bcom bla med ye shes kyi/ /go 'phang brnyes tshe ma ga dha yi yul/ /byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bzhengs dzi ltar/ /bsgrun pas don grub dbang rgyal 'khor ba dang / /ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa kun las thar ba'i dpung / /mgon skyabs mdzad de yang srid thams cad du/ /gnas skabs lha mi'i dpal la —543

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)spyod pa'i nang / /dal 'byor rten thob dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /rjes bzung thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs nas/ /theg pa'i mchog gyur gsang sngags nye ba'i lam/ /smin grol kha sbyor bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang / /mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel lhun grub shog /dri ngad phyogs bcur 'geng ba'i ljon shing las/ /nyer grub bkra shis sgo mang mo cho de pa'i rten/ /bkod legs phun sum tshogs pa bzhengs pa'i 'bras/ /sgrib byang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /rgyal ba sras bcas snying rje'i dngos po kun/ /yongs 'dus mi zhakhrugs mgon gyi zla dkyil na/ /rab gang byin rlabs ga bur zegs 'phreng gis/ /dmigs yul rmonges pa'i gdung bcil lhag pa'i lha/ /zhi khro bde gshegs kun 'dus thod phreng rtsal/ /(91na po ngos su 'dren byed yul du bdud rtsi'i dpyid/ /mthong ba tsam gyis don ldan yid bzhin nor/ /'dod 'jo'i sku brnyan lhag bsam dag pas bskrun/ /dge bsan grub dbang rgyal dpal gyi rir/ /skye srid bzung nas theg mchog dam chos kyi/ /dga' ston ngo mes pa med par legasamyangs te/ /rigs 'dzin rnam bzhi'i go 'phang 'grub byin rlobs/ /ka dag dbyings las mthing zhun 'od bkrag 'tsher/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi byin rab 'bar pad+ma 'byung / /rdor dril dang bcas zung 'jug bde ba ches/ /mi bzad gnas ngan len las 'dren byin rlobs/ /bshes gnyen zhi ba'i cha byad rab bzung pa/ /pad+ma saṃ bha'i mchog sbyin phyag rgya yis/ /kun rdzob log lta'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs te//don dam ka dag snying po rtogs byin rlobs/ zhan tu bya dka'i mdzad bzang 'phrul po che/ /thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngor ra ba las/ /rab 'das blo ldan mchog sred thod rnga'i sgras/ /ma rig gnyid rum thug po slong byin rlobs/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa/ /cig car dbang bsdu pad+ma rgyal po ches/ /ā li kā li'i char gyi zil mngar ror/ /spyod pa'i skal bzang myur bar thob byin rlobs//las nyone sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma'i smag /mkhyen pa'i spyan mnga' nyi ma 'od zer gyi/ /snang ba chen posanyer bsal mngon mtho dang / /nges legs lam mchog thob par byin gyis rlobs/ / gzod ma nyid nas 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /'dren mdzad (91ba po kya seng ge'i spyod tshul gyis/ /bdud bzhi'i sde dpung —544

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanabatul nas thar pa dang / /rnam mkhyen ye shes rgyud la skye byin rlobs/ /drag shul 'jigs rung mi bzad me 'bar ba'i/ /skur bzhengs khro rgyal seng ge sgra sgrog gi /gnam lcags rdo rjes log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs/ /myur bar tshar gcod dngos grub stsol byin rlobs/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyi stang stabasabacas pas kyang / /gnod byed sde brgyad don snying phyir 'byin pa'i/ /rigs 'dzin bla ma rdo rje gro lod kyis/ /sgo gsum sgrib sbyongs sku gsum 'grub byin rlobs/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i 'dra 'bag mchog /bzhengs mtshon dus gsum rnam dkar ji snyed pa/ /bsags mthus don grub dbang rgyal yang srid kun/ /dam pa'i mgon dang nam yang mi 'bral shog /ces pa'ang lha sa zur khang pa don grub dbang rgyal dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i tshe gzhis mi rnams kyis tsan+dan las grub pa'i bkra shis sgo mang gi mchod rten dang / gser zangs kyi byang chub mchod rten/ rdo rje mi ga byugs pa/ slob dpon rin po che/ sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad/ nged rang gi 'dra 'bag rnams bzhengs pa'i dus dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho yi/ /'dra 'bag blo bzang bkra shis bzhengs pa'i dges//mi mthun nyes brgya zhi zhing sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di'ang 'jon dmar las grub pa bzhengs(92na)pa'i tshe dgos tshul ltar za hor bsdos bkod/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /mchod gsol bsnyen sgrub rtse gcig rab 'bad mthus/ /'di nang nad gdon zhi zhing tshe bsod rgyas/ /phyi ma po ta la ru skye bar shog /ces pa'ang dpon sa bu khrid rgyal mos dad rten du mig 'byed thugs rje chen po bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes ban|da/ /rgyal ba'i yab gcig rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i spro bsdu'i byed po sa /bshes gnyen tshul bzung kun dga' snying po'i bstan/ /srid mthar mi nyams spel phyir gsol ba 'debs/ /gdod nas yongs dag bde chen snang mtha' dang / /mi phyed rdo rje slob dpon dngas ma'i —545

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)srog /mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar tshe dbang rig pa 'dzin/ /skye rgu'i gnyen gyur khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /phan bde'i rtsa lag dpal ldan chos skyong gi /zhal lung chad med phun tshogs bkra shis sgo//rab phye tshangs dbyangs drug cur grags pa'i sgras/ /sa gsum cig car 'god la gsol ba 'debs//lha sngags ye shes mi bzad rdo rje yis/ /sbyin skyes sde dpung phyer btags srid rtse'i bar/ /rgyal mtshan cher bsgrengs dpal ldan skal bzang che'i/ /mgon por g.yung drung khri la zhabs brtan shog /snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan zab ma'i chos/ /go rim ma 'chol rten cing 'brel 'byung sgo /rtsol bar bltos min yongs (92ba 'grig bzhed don kun/ /ji bzhin lhun grub g.yo ba med par shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma dgyes mjad he ru ga:/ /khams gsum brtan pa 'phrog mdzad dbang lhar bcas/ /mthu ldan srung mas dus drug ma g.yel bar/ /mchog thun dngos grub char chen nye bar phob/ /gnam la gza' skar 'dzom pa'i 'phrod bzang dang / /sa la bkra shis g.yang chags phun sum tshogs/ / mchog gsum thugs rje bskul ba'i bden mthu yis/ /rdzogs ldan dga' ston dpal sbyang bkra shis shog /gdan sa 'og gi khri chen 'jam dpal dbyangs tshe dbang rigs 'dzin bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel phyir yun du 'tsho bzhes kyi brten bzhugs 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas bco brgyad chos rje mkhyen rab ngag dbang lhun grub kyi gsung gis bskul ma byung ba ltar za hor gyi ban+de tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gis bgyis pa bidza ya /thub pa'i gsung ngag mdo rgyud la dbang ba/ /gting mtha' mi mngon rnam dpyod rgya mtsho cher/ /sku gsum nor bu'i snyan grags srid gsum khyon/ /yongs 'geng bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin khyod rgyal/ /mtshan tsam thos pas nyi bu'i pho nya yis/ /blang dor blta ba'i me long phyir dor te/ /ngal gso rab ster mgon po tshe dpag med/ /bum bzang bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur mdzod/ /chos kun spros dang bral ba'i ngang nyid las/ /rgyu 'bras nam yang bslu ba med pa'i mthus/ /'chi —546

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanabadag (93na〉bdud kyi lcags khams gser 'gyur rtsis/ /thongs bsgyur mi shigs ka ba brtan tshugs shog /gaṅgā'i rdul snyed rgyal rnams 'gror brtse yang / /ma rig stug pos mngon bsgribs rtogs dka' ba/ /thugs rjes bshes gnyen gzugs bzung mig ngo sa /re gos bsgrub phyir rdo rje ltar brtan shog /'khon rigs 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gdung 'dzin mgon/ /bstan 'gro'i bsod nams zhing du 'tsho gzhes par/ /nyer 'tshe'i tshogs kun rab zhi mdzad 'phrin rnams/ /gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di'ang 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang nor bu grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po skye rgu'i mchod sdong dam par ring por bzhugs pa'i smon lam 'di lta bu zhig rgyud lung man ngag rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag bco brgyad chos rje mkhyen rab ngag dbang lhun grub kyi gsung gis bskul ma byung ba bzhin za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gis bgyis pa sirnyi ra stu/ /ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sprul pa'i sku mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug ngag dbang dkon cog nyi ma'i 'khrungs rabs dang 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam tshigs bcad sogs/ma su ste pra dza saḥ/ rab 'byams gaṅgā'i zhing rdul las 'das pa'i/ /rgyal kun rnam mkhyen phung po gcig bsdus gang / /gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi rol gar rtsen/ /rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangasal gsol ba 'debs/ shes bya'i chos rnams blo gros me long nang / /nyer shar mkhas btsun bzang po'i snyan grags che/ /srid pa'i rtser sgrog sras kyi thu bo pa/ /ba so chos rgyan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /(93ba)thugs rgyud yongs dag dbyig 'dzin 'jam po'i ngos/ /bsod nams nor mchog phung por rab spungs te/ /rnam dpyod shing rtas thar grong cher 'jug pa/ /'phags dbon rin cen zhabs la —547

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)gsol ba 'debs/ khas la stong ma 'gags rdzing bur zla gzugs ltar/ /bden dngos dang bral gang la'ang mi 'jigs pas/ /sgrib gnyis 'ching bcom don gnyis mthar phyin mdzad/ /lha yi skyabs gyur zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon goms ma la ya yi klung chen nas/ /dam pa'i bag chags nyer sad tsan+dan dri/ /skal bzang snying zhugs stobs 'byor mnga' thang cher/ /'god mdzad li yi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /brjod dka'i gzhung lugs mang gzigs thugs rje'i grib/ /mtha' yas skye rgu bde bar ngal gso ba'i/ /ma 'dris lus can dpung gnyen lha dbang rje/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /ye shes rang snang ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul che'i/ /lang tshor rab dar ngag dbang dbyangs can lhas/ /mgrin 'byud mang rgyud tha snyad gtsug lag sogs/ /kun mkhyen dkon cog nyi mar gsol ba 'debs/ /rang bzhin rnam dag ma bsgribs thugs mtsho'i nang / /chos rnams zla snang ji bzhin rol gar can/ /rgyu 'bras mi bslur nges pa yongs gzigs pa/ /mtshudas bral rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /ris med 'gro la brtse chen lhag bsam ljid/ khur gyis nor 'dzin bu mo ma bzod rngul/ /nyer babs las nyon bkru ba'i cho ga mkhan/ /thugs rje'i gting gyur khyod la (94na)gsol ba 'debs/ /bcom ldan 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i rnal 'byor cher/ /gzhol grub gnam lcags thog mda'i tsha dbal gyis/ /mi bsrun brag ri phye mar rab 'thag pa'i/ /nus mthu'i gzi byin 'bar la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla med ye shes be+eḍūr zhun ma'i khams/ /mtha' yas tshe yi gzugs su nyer grub snod/ /'chi ba med pa'i bcud du legs 'khyil ba/ /lha mchog dbang bskur dam pa myur du stsol//ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang grags pa yi/ /ring lugs rgyas par gegs byed nag po'i mun/ /dkon cog thugs rje'i nyi ma'i zer 'od kyis/ /rab gsal snang ba chen pos khyab gyur cig /zhi dul sdom brtson dam pa'i dpal mnga' zhing / /brtan pa'i 'khor los rjes su bzung ba las/ /gsung rab dga' ston bye ba'i zil dngar ro/ /skal ldan yongs la 'gyed phyir zhabs brtan shog /mkhyen dpyod zab brling mkhas btsun bzang po yis/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i legs bshad nyer stsal bas/ /kun —548

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ zhenagazigs 'jam dpal snying po'i chos srid bstan/ /mi nyams spel phyir g.yung drung ltar brtan shog /sngon gyi thugs bskyed sa bon rab smin las/ /'gro ba'i yang dag mdza' bshes dar ba'i 'bras/ /lus can phan bder 'god pa'i gnyen gcig pu/ /'khor ba stongs min chos 'khor rgya cher skor/ /mchog gsum rin cen byin rlabs rmad po che/ /zla ba'i ma ma las 'ongs bdud rtsi yi/ /dri med thugasakyi za ma tog yangs por/ /yongs 'khyil bzhed don lhun gyis(94ba〉spyab par shog /khrims ldan mang thos 'dus pa'i tshogs chen gyi/ /rnam par dag pa'i lhag bsam rgyal mtshan rtser/ /rtse gcig smon lam btab ltar yid nor ches/ /ci bsam don kun myur du 'grub par shog /de ltar bsden stobs brjod mthus mkha' dbyings las/ /ma smad mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gru char che/ /babs pas don gnyis myu gu legs smin nas/ /dga' ston mchog la spyod par byin gyis rlabs/ /klog pa thos bsam spong ba bsam gtan dang / /bya ba las kyi 'khor lo rnam gsum gyis/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i yid la ci 'dod kun/ /stong bar byin gyis brlab pa'i mthu dpung skyed/ /dge bcur spyad pa'i rnam smin nyer bdo bas/ /bsil byed ga skru ra yi zegs rdul gyis/ /'jig rten khams su bde skyid ut+pa la'i/ /'dab 'phreng gsar pas phyogs kun 'geng bar shog /yid can phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas//zas gtsang sras po'i dri med ring lugs dang / /khyad par zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan/ /srid zhi'i snang byed sgron me ches 'bar shog /sa gsum gtagos so cog gi lus can spyi/ /bye brag swā la'i sman ljongs mdo khams 'gro/ /rnam dkar 'bras bu rdzogs ldan skye rgu dang / /lhan cig spyod pa'i skal ba deng smin shog /khyad par yul 'di'i bla dpon sbyin pa'i bdag /'bangs bcas gnas skabs nad yams 'thab rtsod dang / /mi mthun gdon bgegs 'tshe bral phan tshun kun/ /mnyes gshen byams lasartag tu mdza' bar shog /tshe ring longs spyod (95na8pal 'byor mnga' thang rnams/ /gong 'phel mtha' bzhi'i las sgo kun 'dus te/ /rmugs 'dzin dbang po'i phun tsho gos la 'gran pa'i/ /bde skyid nyi ma gung nas 'char bar shog /chos nyid mi 'gyur lha lam yangs pa'i dbyings/ /chos can rten cing 349

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'brel 'byung mkha' glang las/ /slu med bden tshig mi 'dzad chu rgyun gyis/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i 'bras bu g.yur za shog /dus dgra'i dbang po rta mchog he ru ga /ye shes mgon po las gshin rnam thos sras//gur zhal beg tse 'dod khams ma la sogs/ /mthu ldan srung mas las bzhi lhun bsgrub shog /sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang skye 'phags tshogs/ /lha dang drang song bden mthur dbang rnams kyis/ /med byung bde legs me tog char phab nas/ /phyogs dus kun tu dge ba'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi gdan sa drug pa ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sprul pa'i sku mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug ngag dbang dkon cog nyi ma'i zhakhrungs rabs dang 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos tshul gyi sa bon dang bcas spag shod mkhar gsol bkra shis rab brtan grwa mang rnams kyis bskul ma byung ba lhar yul lto brgyud du skyes pa'i za hor gyi ban rgan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes chu phag hor zla gnyis par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gis bgyis pa'o/ /rgya che'i thabs (95ba〉nang shes rab sa bon las/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu ro bdar legs smin bcud/ /skye rgu yongs kyi longs spyod skal bzang can/ /thub dbang shākya'i rgyal pos shis pa stsol/ /phyogs dus dge ba'i chu klung rab 'khyil nang / /phun tshogs dbyangs kyi mgrin rnga cher bsgrags pas/ /rna ba'i zil dngar rab ster kun dga'i dpyid/ /nyer stsol lus dkar dbang pos zas gtsang sras/ /khyod kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i dri ngad kyis/ /srid zhi'i tsha gdung bcil ba'i byed po sa /theg gsum skyes 'phags slob ma dang bcas pa'i/ /sngon med sa mchog ljon pas lus can skyongs/ /thog ma med nas da lta'i dus kyi bar/ /rnam dkar byas dang byed 'gyur gyis mtshon pa'i/ /dge bas skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /bshes gnyen dam pas rjes su 'dzin par shog /bgrang dkar las nyon mi bzad 'bras smin te/ /'jigs rung duḥkha'i g.yang sar nyer 'phyan pa/ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i shugs kyis rab drangs nas/ /thar pa'i grong khyer chen por 'jug par shog /mi khom dang bral dal ba'i rten —550

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (na)bzang pos/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan go 'phang bsgrub pa la/ /'grub byed rgyu 'bras rten 'brel mi bslu ba'i/ /chos nyid mi 'dzad gter la myur spyod shog /gnas skabs su yang 'byung 'khrugs nad rigs dang / /gdon bgegs mi mthun bar gcod kun zhi zhing / /ring 'tsho mnga' thang dpal wor longs spyod rgyas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes pa'ang dpal gro ba 'bag lhug /khyim 'dzin mchog yags/ bu mo bde chen dbang mo dang dbyangs 'dzin (96na〉cas pas ston pa shākya'i rgyal po'i gsung rab kun gyi snying por gyur pa yum rgyas pa pod tshad bcu drug 'di phyi'i don du bzhengs pa'i tshe smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /gnas gsum zhing mchog bde chen pad+ma 'od/ /sku gsum rang bzhin grub pa'i mkha' dbyings las/ /rtsa gsum mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i sprin gtibs nas/ /gsang gsum byin rlabs char chen dbab tu gsol/ /'od gsal snying po 'ja' lus 'pho med skur/ /lhun grub kun bzang rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ /bka' gter bshad nyan smin grol zab chos la/ /'gro rnams bkod min de srid brtan par shog /mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag po yis/ /dkon cog thugs rje legs par bskul ba'i mthus/ /deng 'dir 'dod 'bras re ba ma lus kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang pad+ma dbang chen gyi sprul pa'i zlos gar du lung gis zin pa thugs sras bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rjes rang don phun tshogs lo gsum la mngon par grub ste nged rang gi ring 'tsho'i ched du lhag bsam rnam dag gi sgo nas zhi drag gi gsung bsnyen lo sgrub thun mtshams kyi tshe bden brjod mdzad rgyur bskul ma byung ba bzhin za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /rma su sti pra dzña saḥ bgrang yas skye rgu nyer 'tsho (96brko pyid kyi sprin/ /bde skyid dga' ston char rgyun snyan po'i rnga/ /chabs cig rab ldir rdzogs ldan gsar mgron du/ /'gugs mdzad rtsa gsum lha —551 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)tshogs 'khor bcas kye/ /mi mthun g.yul las rnam par yongs rgyal ba'i/ /phan bde'i sgo 'phar phye ba 'byed nus pa/ /gsang sngags rgya mtshor legs bshad 'dus gling cher/ /thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i rten 'byung cher/ /rin cen zhun ma'i yol gor ro brgya'i bcud/ /'i myangs pa zag med bde chen drangs mthu yis/ /ma gyur 'gro kun 'dren pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ /pha mtha' nam mkha'i tshad kyang brgyal nus shog /ces rdo pa blo bzang bkra shis/ yar klungs pa ngag dbang skal bzang / lha sab blo grosalegs pa gsum gyis rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling grwa tshang gi dkon gnyer 'jog la dngul srang dgu bcu las grub pa'i sti ri cha bal po'i gla lto dang bcas zin pa'i dus smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gisabagyib(pa dza yas/ / lhag bsam zla dkyil cha shas yongs rdzogs par/ /rin cen gnyis pa'i ri dwags rnam bum cher/ /nyer shar skye bar sor rtog shes rab kyis/ /dpyad de thub bstan 'dzin pa'i dpal thob shog /ces pa'ang pho brang sngags rams pa blo bzang skyes mchog gis phan bde legs bshad gling du dngul bum phul ba'i tshe kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa bha wastu/ /'chi med zil mngar ro bda' mi zad rgyun/ /'khyil bas rtsa gsum lha tshogs ma lus pa/ /dgyes stongs (97na rko ga' bzhi'i 'gros kyis thar grong cher/ /nyer zhugs zung 'jug go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa'ang lha sa ba blo bzang rab brtan gyis dge skos kyi 'jog la dngul srang bcu bzhi dang zho dgu'i pad sder phul ba'i tshe kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /sras bcas rgyal bas rab bsngags bde chen zhing / /ngo mtshar bkod legs mgon po snang mtha' yas/ /mdzod spu'i zer 'phreng gzi byin yongs 'bar bas/ /'chi bdag bdud sde'i smag dras lhag par gzhil/ /ngag dbang lha mos mgrin 'byud blo gros gzings/ /skal bzang rgya mtshor sgrol la 'jigs med kyi/ /btsan po'i go chas yid srubs dpung tsho gis bcom/ /thub bstan lang tsho'i sdel —552

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanagasol ba 'debs/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos blo bzang grags pa yi/ /mdo sngags ring lugs 'gyur ba brgya phrag glur/ /nyer blangs dpyod ldan dga' ba bskyed pa'i bshes/ /bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /bden tshig mthu yis 'di phyi bar do sa /mgon skyabs re 'brasagayin nas mi 'tshol bas/ /srid zhi'i gdung ba mtha' dag legs bsal te/ /bde skyid dpal la spyod par byin gyis rlobs/ /thub bstan spyi dang khyad par dus gsum gyi/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus rje btsun tsong kha pa'i/ /lung rtogs chos srid yongs 'du'i ljon pa yis/ /ro bda'i 'bras bu 'gro bas rtag myong shog /bstan la gus mchod dga' ldan bo shog thu'i/ /sku tshe bsod nams stobs 'byor gong 'phel nas/ /mtshan jus mnga' thang mes (97ba)po'i skal pa dang / /mnyam zhing mya ngan med pa'i mched slar shog /rab yangs sa steng skyong ba'i rgyal po che'i/ /legs byas gser 'khor nam mkhar nyer 'phags pa/ /srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i dbang phyug gtsug /zhabs sen kun+da tshes lasayol med shog /dkon cog rin cen rnam gsum bden dpang du/ /mnga' gsol spyi sgos ring por 'tsho thabs la/ /chig dril brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs gra tshang gis/ /ji ltar smon pa lhun gyisagrub par shog /chos nyid mi 'gyur mkha' dbyings yongs dag las/ /chos can slu med rten 'byung 'od bkrag can/ shar te mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /re ba'i 'bras bu yid bzhin 'grub par shog /dngos brgyud bla ma dus dgra'i dbang po dang / /phyag drug mgon po las gshin phyi nang gsang / /rnam mang thos sras 'dod khams ma la sogs/ /mthu ldan tshogs kyis nyin mtshan ma g.yel srungs/ /mchog gsum yon tan brjod pa rnam par dag /glu dbyangs rgyud las nyer drangs gtam snyan dang / /lhan cig man+da ra yi char chen pos/ /phyogs dus kun tu khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang rab 'byams pa bstan pa lhun grub kyis brtan bzhugs grwa tshang la 'dzugs rgyur gong gi brjod don tshang ba'i tshigs bcad dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa sarba maṅga le/ /—553

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)bgrang yas dwangs mtshor snang ba 'bum phrag brgya/ /nyer shar mkha' zla (98na tshe/ceg pu'i rnam 'phrul ltar/ /sku yi bkod pa'i bye brag mtha' yas kyang / /stong nyid snying rje'i rang gdangs dbyangs can ma/ /rtag tu bsten na bsam pa'i re ba kun/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po'i mched po mā /nges rnyed snying mun sel dang chabs cig par/ /sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar rdzogs ldan ltar 'byed phyir/ /khrag zhag 'khrug steng me rlung 'khyil ba'i nang / /rkyang ser dre'ur phyed skyil srin gzugs gar/ /yongs bsgyur dpal ldan dmag zor re ma ti/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos dge 'dun rgya mtsho yis/ /sde 'di'i phyi nang nor rdzas ma lus dang / /khyad par lung rtogs yon tan bla nas blar/ /spel bar bka' bsgos dam tshig gnyen dgongs te/ /dal med mgon skyabs mdzod cig srung ma'i gtso/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas gnyis pa btsong kha pa'i/ /dri bral ring lugs bstan pas nor 'dzin khyon/ /rab gang legs tshogos dkar cha'i chu shel dbang / /nya rgyas ji bzhin gong 'phel 'phrin las sgrubs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dpal bzang pos phyag bstar ba'i chos 'khor rgyal zhes mkhas mang 'byung gnas 'dus sde'i nang tshan mnga' ris grwa tshang bla gnyer thun mong nas 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i 'bral spang thang ga'i rgyab yig la chos srid gnyer gtad kyi 'phrin bcol dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa sarba sirnyi me pra ya tsā spyi /lhag bsam dag pas gser (98ba)zangs las/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi/ /'dra 'bag bzhengs mthus lha mi'i rten/ /rim brgyud myang 'das myur thob shog /ces pa'ang sngags rams pa ngag dbang grogs pa dang gzhen nu skal bzang spun gyi ngor bris pa shrī bha snye/ /rab dkar bsod nams yongs smin mu thi la/ /'dzad med nyer stsol thub dbang shākya'i tog /khyed gsung slob bcas spyan sngar rnam bkra'i gos/ /khyad mtshar bar snang mdzod ris can phul dges//ngag dbang lha mos mgrin 'khyud blo gros gter/ /bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i lung rtogs bstan/ /dbyar gyi rgya mtsho ji bzhin rab 'phyur ched/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la zhabs brtan shog /—554—

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ rton)sangs rgyas kun dngos rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /dri med ring lugs rgya mtsho'i sgo 'phar brgya/ /'byed mdzad sa yi dbang phyug tshangs pa che/ /mi 'gyur g.yung drung lta bur rtag brtan shog /ces pa 'di'ang mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab spun tshas/ nged rang yun ring 'tsho dgos pa'i nan bskyed byung ba sgrib pa'i lus can du song gshis rang dbang cir 'du rung mchog gsum gyi thugs rje bskul ba'i mthus 'grub bam snyam khas len byas po'i gtang rag dang / sde pa'ang bstan pa rin po che gyen du 'degs phyir ring por gnas pa'i rten 'byung mtshon byed thun mong la/ bkras btags nyin bde ma/bkra shis kha btags brgya tham pa/ gon la cha tshang re/ gser zho brgya/ dngul srang brgya/ (99na〉sprin rtsa yug brgya/ byang dar yug brgya/ gos chen legs pa yug lnga/ gos log thang gser ma yug drug cu dang tshos gcig ma bzhi bcu bcas yug brgya/ rgya dkar yu thung nyis brgya/ zam so yug brgya/ sag ri bubs brgya/ bur ltang bcu gnyis/ bye shel ltang rtse re/ spos dkar ltang rtse gsum/ gos rgyan bzhi'i yol ba rnam pa sum cu so gnyis re yod pa'i cha gcig /gos dkar yug bcas/ gong gsal rnams gnas tshad gsum gyis lam tsam dngul la phab par/ khyon dngul srang stong phrag gcig dang drug brgya bdun cu don bdun thob pa dang bcas stong 'bul bstar ba'i tshe yol ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi ban+de 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa sarba mgi lo bha ( / /phul byung bde ldan zhing gtso 'od dpag med/ /rnam par rgyal ma tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor/ /lha dang drang srong bden tshig grub mthu yis/ /sra brtan mi 'gyur g.yung drung g.yas 'khyil steng / /ngag dbang lha mos rjes bzung shes bya'i chos/ /sa chen blo gros gom pa gcig gis kyang / /'gom mdzad bzang po'i bag chags nyer sad pa/ /dbyar gyi rgya mtsho ji bzhin yongs phyur shog /gur bkum ngad pa 'thul ba'i yul gru nas/ shar phyogs chu gter mthar thug 'dzin ma'i khyon/ /zhwa ser cod pan mnabs pa'i lugs bzang bstan/ /nyi zlas mun sel de bzhin kun khyab shog /dad (99bskong gtong bas —555

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)mchog gsum bsnyen bkur bar/ /mgon med zas sbyin la 'gran dpa' zhing mdzangs/ /rtul phod rtsal mnga' dga' ldan bo shog thu'i/ /tshe bsod stobs 'byor bla nas blar 'phel shog /rgyal ba sras bcas mkhyen brtse ma yol chab/ /phan bde'i chu gnyer bgrang yas 'khrigs klong las/ /gang bsam 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dbang rgyal nor/ /mi 'bral spyi bo'i gtsug tu mdzes gyur cig ces pa'ang tha sur kha'i bu rab 'byams pa blo bzang dar rgyas kyis rtsal stobs bskyed nas phyin te yangs pa'i sa chen bde bar skyong ba dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu rgyal por ja tshul thebs kyi sbyin bdag bskul bar dad pas kun nas blangs te ri bo dga' ldan tshogs chen du dngul srang stong dang lnga brgya/ rgyud smad du nyis brgya/ thos bsam gling par stong dang phyed sum brgya rnams sbyar ba'i dus so sor 'dzugs rgyu'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi ban+de gdong drug bsnyems pa'i lang tshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /rgyal ba kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /ma smad mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzi byin nyis/ /zur gyi sngags 'chang a gur sgo gsum mun/ /nyer sangs rnga yab gling dang 'bral med shog /zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor mthong thos dran reg mthus/ /rang rig rang zhal kun bzang rdo rje 'chang / /mngon du gyur min de srid rigs 'dzin las/ /mi 'gyur yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal por shog /'dis mtshon (100na sgom dkar dge tshogs zhing sa la/ /lhag bsam smon lam sa bon drod gsher gyis/ /rab smin bde skyid gser snye dar drag par/ /spyod pa'i skal mchog myur du 'grub par shog /ces gzhis ka shar gu ru rta mgrin dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i tshe zur dpal nor bus tshes bcu khag sogs su 'dzugs rgyur bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gis bgyis pa sirnyi ra sdu/ /sgrib gnyis 'ching rgya nyer grol yon tan kun/ /rdzogs par rnam 'dren mtha' dag mnyam na yang / /tshe dang ye shes gter la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /'od dpag med kyis mkhyen brtse nus dpung —556

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (na)skyed/ /zla zhun bye ba'i mdangs ldan dngul dkar las/ /legs grub mtshan dpe'i gzi byin rab rgyas sku/ /bskrun pasang ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /mi 'gyur srog gi ka ba brtan tshugs shog /gser mdog zhwa yi cod pan yongs 'chang ba'i/ /dri med lung rtogs lus can bsod nams kyi/ /zhing du ma pham mgon po 'dzam gli nga dbus/ /byon min de srid bla nas blar 'phel shog /ces nor 'dzin gyi khyon yangs por mnga' sgyur ba dad stobs kyi dbang phyug dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu rgyal pos kun+da ltar dkar ba'i lhag bsam kun blangs kyis nged rang ring por 'tsho ba'i rten 'brel du rin cen gnyis pa las grub pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi sku lnga bcu grub pa'i tshe smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag (100bar bang dkon cog gis bgyis pa ā sdo/:sid+dhi pra ya:spyi /zag bral mi zad 'chi med a mri ta/ /lha sngags ye shes rol pa'i 'od snang las/ /lhun grub a nya ka ba sra brtan srog /nyer 'jug rigs bdag pad+ma tshe dbang rtsal/ /thugs rjes byin rlobs dbyangs can ba 'ad pa'i sder/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung chos zab rab bsgrigs pas/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde'i sgo/ /legs phye nges gsang bshad dang sgrub gling cher/ /dpag bsam bcud 'khyil rin cen gnyis pa las/ /yongs grub phul mtshon sgo gsum gang 'bad mthus/ /rje btsun bla ma 'og min mgon po ltar/ /mi 'gyur 'phrin las phyogs kun khyab par shog /ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa la mi phyed pa'i dad stobs kyi dbang phyug dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu rgyal pos nged rang ring por 'tsho ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs skabs rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par dngul stir tsha gser ma ngo mtshar bkod legs dgu phul ba'i tshe smon lam dgos tshul bzhin za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gis bgyis pa she ya bhawa n+tu/ /zhi dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'/ /lha sngags ye shes yongs 'dus rig rtsal gdangs//—557

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)ma 'gags rang shar khro rgyal gro bo lod/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyis rgyal bsen gdon bgegs brdzis//rnam gsum yo ga'i (101na skogongs don mtha' klas pa/ /yongs tshang yi dam sgrub sde bka' brgyad lha'i/ /mchog thun dngos grub mnga' brnyes rje dang 'bangs/ /nyer lnga'i 'phrul gyis skye rgu phan bder bkod/ /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin sngags srung ral gcig ma/ /gza' mchog chen po dam can rdor legs kyis/ khyu sbyor nyin mtshan srung skyob ma g.yel bar/ /'dod don lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /g.yas thang brgyad pa'i skya ris nas mjug tshags kyi bar lcang srung khang pa rin cen rdo rjes bgyis/ /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor khyab bdag dbang po'i sde/ /zab gter nying khu 'chi med sku gsum dpyid/ /rigs 'dus mtsho skyes rdo rje nyi snang gis/ /dus min mtshun lha'i smag them mtha' dag gzhil//mkha' spyod ḍā ki'i gtso mo tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / /pad+ma kā ra rta mchog bdud btsun klus/ /yongs bskor bzhengs mthus sa spyod sangs rgyas bstan/ /rgya mtsho'i mthar spel skye rgu'i rtsa lag gi /gzhi mar bstan 'gro'i legs tshogs rab 'bar ba'i/ /nyi ma srid pa gsum gyi kun gsal ngos/ /rtag tu 'char ba'i 'od snang deng 'bar shog /g.yas thang dgu pa'i skya ris nas ma lcag tshags kyi bar rnam sras gling pa ji las bgyis/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug rin cen gsal ba yi/ /dkyus ring spyan zur lhung ba'i mod nyid la/ /rdo rje rtse brgya nyer gdengs steng gdon kun/ /thal bar rlog cig gsang bdag gtum po che/ /rdo rje 'chang (101bskos rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar/ /ma chad brgyud 'phreng bcom ldan rigs gsum mgon/ /lha chen lcam dral dang bcas rab bskor bas/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i 'gro kun snying / /nyer sgul yid la bsam dgu'i 'dod yon nor/ /gter sgo phye ste rgyal khab yol go'i nang / /phyur bur spungs shig dbul bral longs spyod tshogs/ /dbyar mtsho ji bzhin rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /g.yon thang brgyad pa'i skya ris nas mjug tshags kyi bar rong pa bsod nams rgyal pos bgyis/ /—558

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhananges ngor dbyangs can lha mo ma rungs pa'i/ /gshed mar 'dod khams dbang phyug (rgyud par bcas/ /dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa dang / /dgra lha skyes gcig rdo rje grags ldan gyis/ /dus drug mi g.yel gdong grogs skyabs mdzad par/ /thugs dam gnyen bskul dbyings nas nyer dgongs la/ /sgrib gnyis nad gdon 'chi med bum pas khrus/ /bsam 'phel nor gyis tshe bsod mnga' thang spel/ /'gugs byed tshogs kyis brtan g.yo dbang du sdus/ /mi bzad mtshon chas dgra bgegs phye mar thogs/ /dga' ldan pho brang lugs zung nyer 'degs pa'i/ /snying stobs lhag bsam bla nas blar 'phel mdzod/ /g.yon thang dgu pa'i skya ris nas bzung mjug tshags kyi bar lha sab bsod nams kyis bgyis/ /zhes pa 'di'ang lha sras kyi rnam sprul mi dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtshos lcags spre dad rten grwa tshar bco lnga bzhengs pa'i kha longs su rdo rje gro lod la pad+ma tshe dbang rtsal/ byin rlabs dbang gi chu rgyun las byung ba'i rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ /ma gza' (102na snar gsum gyis bskor ba/ /tshe dpag med sku gsum rigs 'dus la lha mo tsaṇ+ḍasnyi brgyud pa'i bla ma dang lus dkyil gyi lha gnyis/ bdud btsan klu gsum gyis bskor ba/ nyi ma mdung gang ma'i phyag rdor/ bla brgyud/ rigs gsum mgon po/gter gsar lha chen gyis bskor ba/ dpal ldan dmag zor ma zhi drag gtso 'khor la bla brgyud/ gnyen chen po/ rdo rje grags ldan dang bcas pas bskor ba lha bzo ba so sos rtsal gang yod 'don pa las gzhan 'dres med par legs nyes phyed cing mig ltos la phan pa chu phag lor bzhengs pa'i tshe smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gis bgyis pa sarba sirnyi me pra ya:ni /gsang gsum yon tan cha tsam dran pas kyang / /srid zhi'i gdung bcil rtsa gsum lha'i 'khor lor/ /pad rā ga mdangs 'dzin gan gos ri mo can/ /dbang gzhu ltar bkra'i yol ba yongs spel dges/ /skyid skyid sri thar dbang mo ma dag gnas/ /rab spangs bde ba can du pad+ma'i sbubs/ /rdzusaskyes 'od dpag med kyis rjes bzung nas/ /'gro 'dren ded dpon myur du byed par shog /nam —559

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)mkha'i mtha' mnyam ma gyur sems can rnams/ /zug rngu'i du lha ba las grol nges legs kyi/ /rin cen yid 'ong khang par bde chen la/ /rtag tu spyod pa'i skal bzang nyer thob shog /rnam dkar 'bras bu mi 'dzad rgya mtsho che/ /nyes (102ba ji rgya'i ro dang lhan cig mi gnas shing / /phun tshogs dpal 'byor lhun grub gtan mdun bde'i/ /yid bzhin nor gyis ci 'dod re skong shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i lha/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma yis/ /legs byas 'phrin las sgo 'phar yongs phye ste/ /thog mtha' bar dge'i phun tshogs bkra shis stsol/ /zhes pa 'di'ang mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis ma skyid skyid dang sring mo sri thar dbang mo sogs kyi don du g.yo ru khra 'brug bde gshegs mthong grol lha khang du cod ldan dmar po'i yol ba phul ba'i tshe smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gis 'i brgyas pa bha wastu//rin cen gnyis pa las grub pad+ma'i dbyibs/ /dam rdzas ba kla rgyan ldan gtams pa'i snod/ /mchog gsum la phul bde snang bde zhing skyid/ /phyi ma rnga yab dpal rir skye bar shog /ces pa'ang snye thang pa blo gros rnam rgyal gyis dge skos byas pa'i 'jog la srang bcu bzhir grub pa'i pad sder phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor brnyes bkod pa bhawastu/ /mkhas pa'i rtser son ngag dbang blo gter dngos/ /byams brtses 'gror chags rje btsun pad dkar 'chang / /bzang po'i mthu stobs rgya mtsho rdo rje 'dzin/ /rigs 'dzin 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /deng nas skye ba kun tu mgon khyod dang / /nam yang 'bral med mi khom skyon bral zhing / /dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i rten bzang po/ /(103na jir thob theg chen dam chos ston par shog/bskal mang tshigs kyis rlabs chen spyad pa dang / /sa lam tshogs bsgrub bltos pas ma ngoms par/ /gsang sngags smin cing grol bas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /kha sbyor bdun ldan myur du 'grub byin rlobs/ /be ri rab 'byams pa ngag dbang legs pas 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes nan gyis bskul bar ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go / 56()

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (na)nyer bzhi'i srang ldan dngul dkar las/ /yongs grub kong phul ma gyur 'gro'i/ /sgrib gnyas smag rum ye shes kyi/ /mes bsal zung 'jug myur thob shog /ces pa'ang snye mo a gling chosamadzad dngosagrub rgya mtshos sngags rams pa bgyis pa'i tshe dgos tshul bzhin za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa dza byu/ /phun tshogs gsung rab mtha' yas gzhud lugs don/ /legs par thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab gyis/ /gtan phab ngag dbang blo bzang lhag bsam can/ /rgya mtsho ji bzhin zab yangasabartse chen mgon/ /zas gtsang sras po'i ring lugs dri ma med/ /yongs su nyer bzung spobs pa rtser son mthu/ /dar drag 'phrin las bla nas blar spel ba/ /dbyangs can bzhad pa'i sdol gsol ba 'debs/ /dad gus gdung shugs drag pos rtse gcig tu/ /mi phyed snyan pa'i gdangs kyis gsol btab pas/ /byang chen thob min de srid dpung gnyen mchog /rab mdzad 'di phyi'i mdun ma lhun grub shog /ces (103ba)pa 'di'ang mkhar sngon blo bzang dpal 'byor dge slong gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /'gro khams dang 'tsham ris med rjes 'dzin par/ /'char nub spangs pa'i dam bca' brtan po'i khur/ /yongs btegs sangs rgyas de gsung dge 'dun bcas/ /dkon cog thugs rje'i mthu dpung ches cher skyed/ /lus ngag yid gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi/ /rnal 'byor la dbang blo grosabazang po'i grus/ /rim gnyis rgya mtsho'i mthar son zung 'jug nor/ /'dren mchog ded dpon khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /dad gus blo brtson mi dman lhag bsam gyis/ /gtong phod ri bo dngos su rgyu 'dra ba'i/ /bsod nams bsags mthus yang srid bzung ma thag /mgon po khyod kyi 'khor du skye bar shog /'jam dbyangs mi yi tshul bzung tsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs bskal 'tsho lus can rtag bde la/ /'god ched mang bkur rigs thob zhwa ser bstan/ /phyogs bcur gong nas gong du spel nus shog /'disamatshon dus gsum rnam dkar dge tsho gos rnams/ /'dzad med mtho ris chu bo'i mched po bzhin/ /kun mkhyen ye shes rgya mtsho chen po'i klong / /nyer babs skal bzang mngon sum mthong bar shog /ces pa —561 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)'di'ang od nod dhu ring wang gi ma mi 'phrog pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa kho shol ge ge shes rab rgya mtshos zang zing gi bdog pa gya nom pa dang bcas 'di lta bu zhig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar (104na tha'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gis bgyis pa sirnyi nge/ /tshogs gnyis bsir bu'i shugs 'chang rta bdun gyis/ /rab drangs zas gtsang sras po tsha zer can/ /byin rlabs 'od stong skye rgu'i snying gi dbus/ /myur du bkye zhig ma 'dris mdza' ba'i bshes/ /dpal gyi mgur nas bden gnyis dam pa'i chos/ /nam mkha'i mtha' ltar tshad bzung dang bral ba/ /tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i skye 'phags dge 'dun te/ /mchog gsum spyi dang bye brag lnga bdo'i 'gro/ /sgrib gnyis des bskyed gnyid po cher 'thibs las/ /nyer slong thugs rje'i gzi 'bar bde gshegasabadun/ /byang sems gnod sbyin phyogs skyong rgyal chen bzhis/ /rtag tu 'char nub spangs pa'i snang ba stsol/ /dge bcu'i yon tan kun tshang sman ljongs nang / /rdo rje gdan mtshudas lha ldan gtsug lag 'dabs/ /sngon bsags mthur grub rnam 'joms o chog zung / /sangs rgyas bstan mjal dal 'byor rten rnyed nas/ /tshe 'di'i srid 'byor nags klung stug po'i ljon/ /dad mos shes rab rnon po'i ral gri yis/ /yongs bcad nges legs spang ljongs chas yangs por/ /gtan mdun chu skyes 'dab brgya deng bzhad smon/ /rten gsum bzhengs dang bka' gsang rab bsgrags shing / /dkon cog bsnyen bkur dbul phongs sbyin la sogs/ /byas dang byed bzhin byed 'gyur rnam dkar las/ /ma (104ba)lus gcig tu bsdus pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /bskal brgyar zhabs pad rab brtan rgyu sbyor ba/ /deng nas rnam mkhyen ye shes 'thob min bar/ /brtse bas rjes bzung nam yang 'bral med shog /thub pa'i bstan dar zhwa ser 'dzin pa'i sde'i/ /ring lugs gong 'phel mnga' 'bangs gtogs kun gyi/ /mi mthun dus kyi skal ngan nyer zhi zhing / /mkho dgu'i 'byor par rdzogs ldan ltar spyod shog /yang srid brgyud mar lha mi'i rten bzang thob/ /dam chos sgor zhugs thos bsam sgom la sogs/ /tshul bzhin nyams su bstar bas 'khor ba yi/ /sdug bsngal —562

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ zhenagasum gyi rtsa ba drungs 'byin shog /grangs med bskal mang yun tshad ma gyur 'gro'i/ dusto ma bzod gsung gsang rgya che'i nang / /theg pa chen po'i nye lam ches zab mos/ /rgyud grol sku bzhi'i dbang phyug nyer 'thob shog /byin rlabs nyer stsol rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /dngos grub char 'bebs rgyal sras slob mar bcas/ /bar chod kun sel mthu ldan chos srung gis/ /'dod don lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di'ang ka brgyad mdo pa khyo shugs kyis dmar ser can nas bzung khrag skyug gi lo'i bar zang zing gi bdog pa dngul thog tu phab pa srang stong phrag phyed bzhi lhag bcas kyis jo shāka gis gtsos dkon cog mchod pa/ ser 'bras dge gsum sogs dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur ba/ so skyer sbyin gtang / rten gsum bzhengs pa/ rang gis (105na khi tan bgyis pas mtshon rnam dkar dge tsho gos bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskrun par brten/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa dang / de 'dzin gyi skyes bu zhabs pad brtan cing sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba/ sgos su nged rang dang mchod yon gyi ring 'tsho/ rta dpon rnams 'joms/ a chog /dpal mo/ chog skyid rnams kyi 'di phyi'i legs tshogs sogs bla nas blar 'phel ba'i bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor/ sman bla tshugs pa'i grwa tshang rnams dang / sde dgon che phra mang po la 'dzugs rgyur dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi ban+de 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gis bgyis pa bha ( / /zab gsal ye shes rgya mtshor mnga' 'byor ba'i/ /'dus tshogs bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi//dgyes skong bcud 'khyil yol go ches yangs pa/ /phul dges mchog thun dngos grub char du snyil/ /zhes pa'ang byings pa byams pa nor bus dge skos 'jog la dngul srang bco lnga lhag bcas kyi pad sder phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes bkod pa bha — / /snod bcud bde ldan zhing mgon 'od dpag med/ /lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku'i mdzod spu nas/ /nye bar 'phros pa'i 'od 'phreng snang ba yis/ /mi bsrun 'chi bdag mun rum mthar skrod mdzod//—563

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)sangs rgyas de gsung byang sems nyan rang tshogs/ /(105ba〉gra med skyabs gnas dkon cog rnam gsum dang / /khyad par bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gror bcas/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i re gos deng smin stsol/ /ngag dbang dbyangs can blo gros zab gter gyis/ /skal bzang yongs la rgya che'i gsung rab don/ /dwangs mchor zla gzugs ji bzhin mngon sum du/ /ston mdzad rigs kun bdag por gsol ba 'debs/ /phyi nang rig gnas 'chad la 'jigs med kyi/ /spobs mtho'i go btsan rnam dpyod cha rdzogs nya/ /thub bstan chu klung lang tshor dar ba'i sde/ /tshangs sras bshad pa'i rdo rje zhabs brtan shog/mes po'i lung gis mang bkur khri yangs por/ /dbang bskur nor 'dzin skyong ba'i mi bdag rje'i/ /sku tshe stobs 'byor mnga' thang mtshan jus sogs/ /dbyar gyi chu gter lta bur gung 'phyur shog /'jig rten spyi dang bye brag gangs ljongs 'dir/ /phyogs dus kun tu bde skyid dpal spyad rjes/ /ring por mi thogs thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /go 'phang myur thob bshes gnyen mdzad par shog /rgyu 'bras mi bslu rten cing 'brel 'byung chos/ /bde bar gshegs pas nye bar gsungs pa'i bka'/ /tshad ma'i dpang gyur smon lam btab don bzhin/ /lhun gyis grub par mchog gsum mthus byin rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di'ang gnya' nang sho pa jo rdzong pa dang spyi khang dkon cog /bstan 'dzin bzang po spun/ rgan po dang bcas pas ring 'tshor byang gter thugs sgrub las byang 'bring por brten nas tshes bcu (106na)btsugs skabs dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa sna(/ /rnam dkar legs byas 'bum phrag kun gsal bu mo'i 'gram par rtag tu yang / /nyer rgyu mtshan dang dpe byad ku mud dar bab rjes chags rab bkra'i gzugs/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i yid kyi dwangs shel ngos shar ngo mtshar phul byung gar/ /bsgyur la lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyis mi phyed dad pas yongs su 'dud/ ti shin tu bgrang dka'i bskal par rlabs chen tshogs bsags bden dpang du/ /skad cig de nyid sa yi lha mo mngon sum rab 'thon nas/ /legs so'i drang tshig me tog char gyis —564

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ (zhanaphyogs kun dog po mā /bkang ste bu ram shing pa zas gtsang sras mchog skye rgu'i gnyen/ /rgyal rnams spang rtogs mnyam par mtshungs kyang lhag pa'i thugs/ /gzhan gyis 'gran zla'i dper bya snyems pa dang bral ba'i/ /dam bca'i khur chen snyigs ma lnga yi bgo skal du/ /thob la rnam 'dren sras slob kun gyis mgrin gcig bsngags/ /rig gnas bcu phrag smra bar spobs dge bas/ /ma ga dha sogs 'phagasapa'i yul gru che'i/ /thub gsung dgongs 'grel dang bcas bsil ldan ljongs/ /bsgyur mdzad lo paṇa tshogs kun phyag gi gnas/ /dus gsum rgyal bas shes bya gang mkhyen gnang / /ji bzhin mngon gzigs rje btsun tsong kha pa/ /'jam mgon mi srid zlos gar brtse (106ba tha la/ /nges rnyed chos rjes dad pa cis mi thob/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gsang gsum bkod pa che'i/ /mdzad 'phrin smra bsam brjod pa'i yul 'das nang / /khyad 'phags mgur bum las drangs bden gnyis chos/ /yongs 'khyil bus 'phreng pha mtha' su yis rnyed/ /bye brag chos rnams don dam gdod ma nas/ /bden stong kun rdzob mi 'gal 'jog nus kyi/ /mnyam gzhag rjes thob zung du 'brel byed pa'i/ /lam mchog nye bar ston pa sher phyin bka'/ /rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i gsung rab yid bzhin dbang / /'dri klog 'chad nyan 'chang sogs sri zhu yi/ /legs byas phung po cher spungs rin cen ri/ /rings brgyus dbul bral dga' skyid phan bde'i dpyid/ /rab 'jam shog bu man shel ltar dwangs ngogs/ /brda dag gzugs mdzes 'od bkrag brdzid chags pa'i/ /bcu phrag sum skor glegs bam tshar dngar ba/ /ston zla lta bu'i lhag bsam mchog gis bsgrubs/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos blo bzang grags pa yi/ /bstan pa'i gdugs dkar 'dzin par sngon goms mthus/ /bsod nams tshar spungs sbyin pa'i sgo 'phar brgya/ /phye ste dbul phongs ming yang mi grags shog /byas 'bras rā ma ṇa yi mda' bo ches/ /sgrib gnyis de rgyu laṅka'i mgrin bcad de/ /bshes gnyen si tu'i mdza' na mor brten nas/ /rnam mkhyen rtsed 'jor 'gro bas gar bsgyur shog /'bangs 'khor nya phyis rgya khyon rab yangs por/ /legs tshogs (107na tshe yu thi la yis cher gtams pa/ /rin thang dang bral dga' bde zag med kyi/ /skyid pa'i —565

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)dpal 'byor sum rtsen rjes bsnyeg shog /dkon cog rin cen byin rlabs mi zad rgyun/ /dmigs bya'i lus ngag yid la phog pa'i mod/ /sdig sgrib bcas rang kha na ma tho ba'i/ /mi dge'i dri tshogs rtsa ba drungs 'byin shog /rnam dag bsam pas tshul 'dir sgo gsum gyis/ /bzo g.yos bran dang yang bran nyer bkol sogs/ /rdul phran tsam gyis mtha' brten byed po sa /gtogs rnams brgya byin skal mnyam deng thob shog /'jig rten gsum dang khyad par gangs can ljongs/ /mi mthun dus ngan btsal kyang mi rnyed par/ /rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston med byung ros/ /skye rgu'i ro 'dzin rtag tu sim nus shog /sngon goms shing rta bcu yi shugs drag gis/ /'gog med bstan nyi mkhar shar a ti sha'i/ /ring lugs legs 'dzin kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i/ /bshad sgrub bstan dang skye bar mjal bar shog /srid par thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /ngal dub dang bral byams pa'i ma gyur 'gro/ /lha mi'i rten bzang legs thob mi ring bar/ /thar pa'i grong khyer chen por myur 'jug shog /re 'bras ji bzhin 'grub pa'i dpang po ru /dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas nyer dgongs la/ /smon lam gang btag mngon sum lhun grub par/ /drug cu'i gsung dbyangs rna ba'i dpyid du sgrogs/ /slu med (107ba)mchog gsum thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang / /chos nyid mi 'gyur gdod nas rnam par dag /chos can rgyu 'bras 'char ba'i rten 'brel slad/ /kun mkhyen go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ /zhes sde pa zur pa sne'u stong blo bzang sbyin pa dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i dus thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob ched 'di gnas byang bu bzhu ba'i rtags gsal ltar/ 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang pos chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa'i nang nas ches cher rmad du byung ba'i snying po bka' bar pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ nyi khri/ khri brgyad stong pa/ shes(rab khri pa/ brgyad stong pa/ khri sna tsho gis te pod longs nyi shu rtsa bdun bzhengs par bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor zhig dar rgyas bkra shis sogs las byed pa rnams kyis dgos tshul ltar za hong gyi ban+de sde snod gsum pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 566

smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis pa/ smyon)'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gis bgyis pa ya thā sarba pra ṇi dha na ni ra bho ga su she ya bha ban+tu/ /zla ba du ma spungs pa'i 'od kyis kyang / /cha tsam bsgrun min rin cen gnyis pa las/ /nyer grub rtsa gsum thugs dam gnyan skong snod/ /phul dges kha sbyor bdun ldan sar bgrod shog /ces pa'ang ngag dbang nam mkhas dge skos kyi las sne'i 'jog la srang phyed bco lnga'i pad sder phul ba'i tshe za hor bzhes bkod pa'i dza ya/ /(108na)sug ta tsa bi nā ka sa ma ma ga ti ni pra ti dzñā/ /a ba ya ba sa rba gu rna na bi sa rba ṇa ba ka ste/rgyal kun mkha' mnyam 'gro 'dren dam bca' yi/ /cha shas yongs rdzogs 'phel 'grib rab spangs pa/ /pra bha ni dhi bha ba shā : tsa bi pa :mod ya su/ // 89 tsa lo tsa nā ya ta co di ཿ re ta da rnyi/snang mdzod srid zhir 'char nub dang bral ba'i/ /thugs rje'i spyan dkyus ring po deng 'dir gzigs/ /sku rten 'dis mtshon rnam dkar bgyis so cog /nyer bsdus bstan 'gro'i legs byas rgya mtsho'i zhing / /slar spel ched du mgon khyod srid pa 'dir/ /'gyur med 'dod don yid bzhin skong bar shog /dga' ba'i dpal ldan pho brang lugs zung bstan/ /phul byung sde bzhi drug cu'i g.yas 'khyil dung / /blo bzang snyan grags srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar/ /cher sgrogs gtan gyi mdun ma lhun grub shog /ces pa'ang mi dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtshos nged rang ring por 'tsho thabs su gtso bo (108ba)sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ gdugs dkar gyi bcu bdun/ phyogs bcu mun sel dang khye'u zla ba'i bcu re/ don grub ste brgyad cu gya gcig steng paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi skyes rabs/ skyon/ jo bo rje/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa/ 'khor sangs rgyas stong / dpang skong phyag rgya pa'i sangs rgyas/ byams 'jam dbyangs/ /snyen bdag /chos skyong dmag zor ma dang bcas pa'i sku rgyur gos ta hung 'jam sang yug nyer bdun la kha bzhi brgya dang gya drug grang gser zho bzhi brgya dang lnga/—567

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)tshon 'os 'tsham song ba'i lar rgya'i 'go pa 'bog btsun blo gros rgyal mtshan/ /do dam pa grong mo chung ba dang mthar rgyas pa/ ri mo ba lha sa 'jam dbyangs don grub sogs nyer bdun/ gong gsham kha thi sngon po kha bzhi brgya go drug dmar po kha gya lnga/ ser po kha gya gcig /hor gos lu hang kha zhe gnyis/'chor ling 'dres pa kha tshig stong bdun brgya nyi shu/ zhal khebs sman rnying kha chig stong nyis brgya bcu gcig /hor dar dmar po kha chig stong drug brgya gya gsum/ rlung gnon hor dar sngon po kha lnga brgya re bdun/ 'dogs thag ling men 'dres pa kha sum brgya so lnga/ skud rgyur gos sna tshogs kha brgya zhe bzhi/zur bkag la sag ri zhe brgyad/ /'dra ba'i 'go pa bya sgo ba blo bzang dbang phyug /do dam tshogs rgyal gling pa/ dbu chen ra rtse shag pa bsod nams/ dbu chung rgyal rtse dpal 'byor dang chos dbang / byings bcu bdun/ sngo bzo dbu chen gu sa dbu chung a lkug dang phag skyag byings nyer lga tog (109na〉pa dngul srang phyed sum brgya/ ti tsha zho drug /gser 'dam srang nyi shu/ dngul chu srang bcu bcas bzo bo'i 'go pa rgyas bskor ba dang gzhis ka ba/ bal po in du shing dang dha na shing / byings nyer brgyad/ rgya bod kyi yig rigs 'dri mi rgyal rtse 'jam dbyangs dbang po sogs kyis byas te grub pa'i tshe rgyab yig smon lam du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gis bgyis pa bha ( / /ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam mgon blo gros gter/ /skal bzang gdul bya rgya mtsho'i re skong mchog/za hor tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rje che/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /snyoms par 'jug pa gsang gsum mi zad pa'i/ /byin rlabs nyin byed dngos brgya rab 'bar ba 'jig rten spyi dang bye brag rgya hor sogs/ /lus can bsod nams mkha' la rtag 'char shog /deng nas bzung ste yang srid thams cad du/ /theg pa mchog gi bshes gnyen legs mdzad de/ /srid dang zhi ba'i yon tan ma lus pa/ /dkar cha'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang thor god thur khen tha'i ji'i dpon mo tshe skyid kyi ngor za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag 368

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (24)nyid las du ma'i gar ji bzhin/ /gdul bya'i snang ngor mtshan brgyad sku'i bkod pa/ /sna tshogs tshon dang nye ba'i man shel ltar/ /ma 'dres so sor shar 'di rmad du byung / /pur rgyal bstan pa'i rin cen ba gam ngos/ /lta log laṅka'i gzugs brnyan shar ba'i mod/ /mkhyen rab mda' yis snying phug rā ma ṇa'i/ /khengs pa'i ri bsnyil dpal ldan a ti sha/ /blo gros bzang pos skal ldan yongs smin par/ /zla med grags pa'i dbyangs snyan srid rtse'i khongs/ /ches cher rab ldir thos 'dzin rna ba'i rgyan/ /khams gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren pa tsong kha pa/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa yi/ /dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis legs myos shing / /ring lugs rgyal mtshan mthon por nyer bteg pa'i/ /grib mar longs spyod dpyid kyi thig le dngom/ /skye bar 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rjes bzung bas/ /kun la dga' (115ba tha ster ba'i ston pa mchog /phul byung tshogs gnyis lhun grub bshes gnyen che/ /mi 'bral brtse bas rjes su 'dzin la brel/ /lha dpa mi yi 'byor ba'i yid bzhin nor/ khyur bur 'khyil ba'i yol go cher yangs nang / /mgrin btsir mi mdzad 'dod dgu'i longs spyod char/ /'bebs mkhas gnod sbyin ārla ra la/ /ma tshang med pa'i dge bcu phun tshogs kyis/ /mngal khur nyer dud g.yo ru'i nor 'dzin gzhir/ /lugs gnyis kha lo bsgyur ba dpa' mdzangs dang / /blo mig zung 'brel snying stobs che 'di med/ /'di'i ched sgo gsum 'bad par gtogs kun dang / /khyad par yon gyi bdag por bcas pa rnams/ /deng nas bzung ste rnam mkhyen ma thob bar/ /'chi med dbang po'i mnga' thang la spyod shog /yongs rdzogs sdebazhi'i dpal ldan sgo 'phar brgya/ /'byed pa brgyad khri'i tshe lor 'dzam gling 'dir/ /mgon khyod chos 'khor bskor ba'i thog ma sa /gdul byar skyes nas byang chen myur thob shog /dge ba mkha' mnyam sems can la bsngos pa'i/ /legs byas chu yi zegs ma'i thigs 'phreng rgyun/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas klung chen dang 'dres te/ /mi 'dzad nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes shog /dkon cog rin cen rnam gsum byin rlabs dang / ā 'bras rten cing 'brel 'byung slu med kyi/ /bden stobs mthu yis sa 'og sa yi steng / /sa blar phun tshogs dga' ston khyab —570
